CGP efficiently utilizes all frozen layers via a gating mechanism and exposes the location of latent task-relevant information. Guided by CGP, we rework the entire SSL pipeline to address reproducibility issues in current SOTA audio models that use legacy implementations of prior SSL methods. By refining data preprocessing, model architecture, and pretraining recipe, we introduce Better Audio Transformer (BAT), and establish new SOTA on audio benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: BAT: 由Convex Gateted 验证法引导的更好的音频变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 测试在计算机视觉中被广泛采用,以忠实地评价自我监督的学习嵌入,因为微调可能曲解其内在质量。 相比之下,音频SSL模型仍然依赖微调,因为简单的测试无法释放其全部潜力,在AudioSet上竞争SOTA时改变排名。 因此,需要一个强大而高效的测试机制来引导音频SSL走向可靠和可复制的方法。 我们引入了CGP(CGP ) , 这是一种以原型为基础的方法,能大大缩小音频微调和探测之间的差距。 CGP通过加丁机制有效利用所有冷冻层,并暴露潜在任务相关信息的位置。 在CPP的指导下,我们重整了整个SSL管道,以解决目前SOTA音频模型中的可复制性问题,这些模型使用以往SSL方法的遗留实施。 通过改进数据处理前、模型结构和培训前食谱,我们采用了更好的音频变换器,并建立了新的音频基准SOTA。

papers.title: AVFakeBench: A Comprehensive Audio-Video Forgery Detection Benchmark for AV-LMMs
papers.authors: Shuhan Xia, Peipei Li, Xuannan Liu, Dongsen Zhang, Xinyu Guo, Zekun Li
papers.abstract: The threat of Audio-Video (AV) forgery is rapidly evolving beyond human-centric deepfakes to include more diverse manipulations across complex natural scenes. However, existing benchmarks are still confined to DeepFake-based forgeries and single-granularity annotations, thus failing to capture the diversity and complexity of real-world forgery scenarios. To address this, we introduce AVFakeBench, the first comprehensive audio-video forgery detection benchmark that spans rich forgery semantics across both human subject and general subject. AVFakeBench comprises 12K carefully curated audio-video questions, covering seven forgery types and four levels of annotations. To ensure high-quality and diverse forgeries, we propose a multi-stage hybrid forgery framework that integrates proprietary models for task planning with expert generative models for precise manipulation. The benchmark establishes a multi-task evaluation framework covering binary judgment, forgery types classification, forgery detail selection, and explanatory reasoning. We evaluate 11 Audio-Video Large Language Models (AV-LMMs) and 2 prevalent detection methods on AVFakeBench, demonstrating the potential of AV-LMMs as emerging forgery detectors while revealing their notable weaknesses in fine-grained perception and reasoning.
papers.title_zh: AVFakeBunench:反车辆地雷综合视听假冒检测基准
papers.abstract_zh: 伪造视听材料(AV)的威胁正在迅速演变,超出了以人为中心的深层假象,包括了复杂自然场景中更为多样的操纵,然而,现有的基准仍然局限于深假伪造和单色说明,因此无法捕捉真实世界伪造假象的多样性和复杂性,为此,我们引入了AVFakeBench,这是第一个涵盖人类主题和一般主题的丰富的伪造假冒语义的全面的视听假冒检测基准,AVFakeBench由12K个认真整理的音像问题组成,涵盖7种伪造类型和4个层次的说明。 为确保高质量和多样的伪造,我们提议一个多阶段混合伪造框架,将任务规划的专利模式与专家的典型模型结合起来,以便精确操作;该基准建立了一个多任务评价框架,包括二元判断、伪造类型分类、伪造细节选择和解释性推理;我们评价11个视听大语言模型(AV-LMMs)和2个常见的AVFakeBench探测方法,表明AV-LMMs作为新兴伪造探测器的潜力,同时揭示其在精细的认知和推理方面的显著弱点。

papers.title: Asynchronous Temporal Modeling with Two-Agent Framework for Streaming Dense Video Captioning
papers.authors: Yolo Y. Tang, Chao Huang, Susan Liang, Jing Bi, Yicheng Wang, Daiki Shimada, Chenliang Xu
papers.abstract: Streaming dense video captioning requires real-time processing of continuous visual input while determining precisely when and what to caption. Current approaches primarily focus on designing complex external memory mechanisms, failing to leverage Large Multimodal Models' (LMMs) inherent long-context capabilities. Moreover, existing methods employing threshold-based caption triggering face a severe Threshold-Gated Discrepancy (TGD) problem, a training-inference mismatch arising from data imbalance, where models predominantly predict silence tokens, requiring thresholds that vary drastically across videos with extremely narrow effective ranges. We introduce Takusen, an asynchronous temporal modeling two-agent framework comprising a Small Multimodal Model (SMM) as an Oracle agent and an LMM as a Listener agent. The Oracle agent processes sparse video inputs at an accelerated rate to detect event boundaries, while the Listener agent processes dense inputs to generate accurate captions when prompted by the Oracle's signals. This architecture eliminates threshold dependencies by fundamentally changing how silence/generation decisions are made, resolving the TGD problem. To enhance robustness against boundary prediction instabilities, we integrate uniformly distributed fixed decoding points with Oracle-predicted boundaries. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions and YouCook2 datasets demonstrate that Takusen achieves state-of-the-art performance with a simpler and more efficient design that balances temporal sensitivity with descriptive accuracy.
papers.title_zh: 配有双代理框架的同步时时建模,用于串流感量视频说明
papers.abstract_zh: 串流密集的视频字幕需要实时处理连续的视觉输入,同时精确地确定时间和标题。当前的做法主要侧重于设计复杂的外部记忆机制,未能利用大型多式模型(LMMs)固有的长相能力。此外,使用基于门槛的字幕的现有方法引发了一个严重的临界差分差异问题,即数据不平衡导致的培训-推论错配错,模型主要预测静默标记,要求各种极窄有效范围的视频之间的阈值差异很大。 我们引入了Takusen,这是一个由小多式模型(SMMM)组成的无同步时间模拟双剂框架,作为甲骨文剂,而LMM是听力剂。 甲骨文剂以加速速度处理稀有的视频输入,以探测事件边界,而听力剂则处理密集输入,以便根据甲骨文的信号生成准确的字幕。这一结构通过从根本上改变沉默/一代决定的方式,消除了临界依赖性,解决了TGD问题。为了增强抵御边界预测不稳定的稳健性,我们把分布一致的固定解码点与甲骨文预测的边界结合起来。关于活动网的实验和YouCook2数据集表明,Takusen实现了最先进的性能,其设计更简单、更高效,平衡了时间敏感性和描述准确性。

papers.title: ArtiMuse: Fine-Grained Image Aesthetics Assessment with Joint Scoring and Expert-Level Understanding
papers.authors: Shuo Cao, Nan Ma, Jiayang Li, Xiaohui Li, Lihao Shao, Kaiwen Zhu, Yu Zhou, Yuandong Pu, Jiarui Wu, Jiaquan Wang, Bo Qu, Wenhai Wang, Yu Qiao, Dajuin Yao, Yihao Liu
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of educational applications, artistic creation, and AI-generated content (AIGC) technologies has substantially increased practical requirements for comprehensive Image Aesthetics Assessment (IAA), particularly demanding methods capable of delivering both quantitative scoring and professional understanding. Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based IAA methods demonstrate stronger perceptual and generalization capabilities compared to traditional approaches, yet they suffer from modality bias (score-only or text-only) and lack fine-grained attribute decomposition, thereby failing to support further aesthetic assessment. In this paper, we present: (1) ArtiMuse, an innovative MLLM-based IAA model with Joint Scoring and Expert-Level Understanding capabilities; (2) ArtiMuse-10K, the first expert-curated IAA dataset comprising 10,000 images spanning 5 main categories and 15 subcategories, each annotated by professional experts with 8-dimensional attributes analysis and a holistic score. Both the model and dataset will be made public.
papers.title_zh: 艺术博物馆:与联合定位和专家级理解一道的精美图像审美评估
papers.abstract_zh: 教育应用、艺术创作和AI-GM(AIGC)技术的迅速发展大大增加了综合图像审美评估(IAA)的实际要求,特别是提供量化评分和专业理解的严格方法。 以多模式大语言模型(MLLM)为基础的AID方法与传统方法相比,更具有更强的观念和一般化能力,但是它们受到模式偏差(只有分数或只有文本)的影响,缺乏细微分化的属性分解,从而无法支持进一步的审美评估。 在本文中,我们介绍:(1) ArtiMuse, 一种具有联合定位和专家级理解能力的基于MLLM的创新性国际宇航科学院模型;(2) ArtiMuse-10K, 由专家完成的第一个国际宇航科学院数据集,包括涵盖5个主要类别和15个亚类的10 000张图像,各由专业专家附加说明,附有8维特征分析和整体分数,模型和数据集都将公布于众。

papers.title: Are We Ready for RL in Text-to-3D Generation? A Progressive Investigation
papers.authors: Yiwen Tang, Zoey Guo, Kaixin Zhu, Ray Zhang, Qizhi Chen, Dongzhi Jiang, Junli Liu, Bohan Zeng, Haoming Song, Delin Qu, Tianyi Bai, Dan Xu, Wentao Zhang, Bin Zhao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL), earlier proven to be effective in large language and multi-modal models, has been successfully extended to enhance 2D image generation recently. However, applying RL to 3D generation remains largely unexplored due to the higher spatial complexity of 3D objects, which require globally consistent geometry and fine-grained local textures. This makes 3D generation significantly sensitive to reward designs and RL algorithms. To address these challenges, we conduct the first systematic study of RL for text-to-3D autoregressive generation across several dimensions. (1) Reward designs: We evaluate reward dimensions and model choices, showing that alignment with human preference is crucial, and that general multi-modal models provide robust signal for 3D attributes. (2) RL algorithms: We study GRPO variants, highlighting the effectiveness of token-level optimization, and further investigate the scaling of training data and iterations. (3) Text-to-3D Benchmarks: Since existing benchmarks fail to measure implicit reasoning abilities in 3D generation models, we introduce MME-3DR. (4) Advanced RL paradigms: Motivated by the natural hierarchy of 3D generation, we propose Hi-GRPO, which optimizes the global-to-local hierarchical 3D generation through dedicated reward ensembles. Based on these insights, we develop AR3D-R1, the first RL-enhanced text-to-3D model, expert from coarse shape to texture refinement. We hope this study provides insights into RL-driven reasoning for 3D generation. The code is released at https://github.com/Ivan-Tang-3D/3DGen-R1.
papers.title_zh: 我们是否准备好在文本到3D世代里进行RL?
papers.abstract_zh: 先前证明在大型语言和多模式模型中行之有效的强化学习(RL)最近成功推广,以加强2D图像生成;然而,由于3D天体的空间复杂性较高,3D天体需要全球一致的几何学和精细的本地质地,因此对3D天体非常敏感,以奖励设计和RL算法;为应对这些挑战,我们首次系统研究3D天体成型的文字到3D自动递减生成。 (1) 奖励设计:我们评估奖励尺寸和模型选择,表明与人类偏好保持一致至关重要,以及一般的多模式模型为3D特性提供了强有力的信号。 (2) RL 算法:我们研究GROPO变式,强调象征性优化的效果,并进一步调查培训数据和迭代的扩大规模。 (3) 文本到3D基准:由于现有基准无法衡量3D代模型的隐含推理能力,我们引入MME-3DR(4) 高级RL范式:受3D代自然等级的驱动,我们建议Hi-GROP通过专门的奖赏组合优化全球到地方等级的3D代。基于这些洞察,我们开发了AR3D-R1号,即第一台RL-enchanced文本到3D型模型,这是从粗糙形状到纹理的专家。我们希望这项研究为3D一代提供RL驱动推理的洞见。

papers.title: Are Image-to-Video Models Good Zero-Shot Image Editors?
papers.authors: Zechuan Zhang, Zhenyuan Chen, Zongxin Yang, Yi Yang
papers.abstract: Large-scale video diffusion models exhibit strong world-simulation and temporal reasoning capabilities, yet their potential as zero-shot image editors remains underexplored. We present ifedit IF-Edit (Image Edit by Generating Frames), a tuning-free framework that repurposes pre-trained image-to-video diffusion models for instruction-driven image editing. ifedit IF-Edit addresses three core obstacles--prompt misalignment, redundant temporal latents, and blurry late-stage frames--via: (1) a Chain-of-Thought Prompt Enhancement module that reformulates static editing instructions into temporally grounded reasoning prompts; (2) a Temporal Latent Dropout strategy that compresses frame latents after the expert-switch point, accelerating denoising while preserving global semantics and temporal coherence; and (3) a Self-Consistent Post-Refinement step that refines the sharpest late-stage frame through a brief still-video trajectory, leveraging the video prior for sharper and more faithful results. Extensive experiments across four public benchmarks--covering non-rigid deformations, physical and temporal reasoning, and general instruction editing--show that ifedit IF-Edit achieves strong performance on non-rigid and reasoning-centric tasks while remaining competitive on general-purpose edits. Our study offers a systematic view of video diffusion models as image editors, revealing their unique strengths, limitations, and a simple recipe for unified video-image generative reasoning.
papers.title_zh: 图像到视频模型是好零热图像编辑吗?
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视频传播模型具有强大的世界模拟和时间推理能力,但它们作为零弹图像编辑的潜力仍未得到充分探讨。 我们提出“IF-Edit”(IF-Edit),这是一个无调制框架,用于将经过训练的图像到视频传播模型重新定位,用于指令驱动的图像编辑。 Ifedit IF-Edit处理三个核心障碍-即时不匹配、冗余的时间潜值和模糊的晚期框架:(1) 探索快速增强模块,将静态编辑指令重新改写成有时间根据的推理提示;(2) 时间迟缓的辍学战略,在专家切开点后压缩潜伏,在保持全球语义和时间一致性的同时加速脱色;(3) 自我一致的后修步骤,通过短短的静视轨迹改进最尖锐的后期框架,利用先前的视频取得更清晰和更忠实的结果。 围绕四个公共基准进行了广泛的实验,这些基准覆盖非硬性变形,物理和时间推理,以及一般指示编辑,显示如果IF-Edit在非硬性和以推理为中心的任务上取得强有力的业绩,同时在普通用途编辑方面保持竞争力。 我们的研究系统地展示了作为图像编辑的视频传播模型,揭示了其独特的长处、局限性,并提供了统一的视频图像推理的简单秘方。

papers.title: AR2-4FV: Anchored Referring and Re-identification for Long-Term Grounding in Fixed-View Videos
papers.authors: Teng Yan, Yihan Liu, Jiongxu Chen, Teng Wang, Jiaqi Li, Bingzhuo Zhong
papers.abstract: Long-term language-guided referring in fixed-view videos is challenging: the referent may be occluded or leave the scene for long intervals and later re-enter, while framewise referring pipelines drift as re-identification (ReID) becomes unreliable. AR2-4FV leverages background stability for long-term referring. An offline Anchor Bank is distilled from static background structures; at inference, the text query is aligned with this bank to produce an Anchor Map that serves as persistent semantic memory when the referent is absent. An anchor-based re-entry prior accelerates re-capture upon return, and a lightweight ReID-Gating mechanism maintains identity continuity using displacement cues in the anchor frame. The system predicts per-frame bounding boxes without assuming the target is visible in the first frame or explicitly modeling appearance variations. AR2-4FV achieves +10.3% Re-Capture Rate (RCR) improvement and -24.2% Re-Capture Latency (RCL) reduction over the best baseline, and ablation studies further confirm the benefits of the Anchor Map, re-entry prior, and ReID-Gating.
papers.title_zh: AR2-4FV:固定视频录像中长期定位的原型参考资料和重新定位
papers.abstract_zh: 固定视图视频中的长期语言指导参考是具有挑战性的:参考材料可能被隐蔽,或离开现场,进行长期间隔,然后重新进入,而框架性地将管道漂移作为再识别(ReID)不可靠。AR2-4FV利用背景稳定性作为长期参考。离线的Anchor Bank是从静态背景结构中提取的;推断,文字Query与该银行一致,以产生一个锚图,在参考材料不存在时作为持久性的语义记忆。一个基于锚的重返前加速器在返回后重新捕捉,一个轻量级ReID定位机制利用锚框中的移位提示保持身份的连续性。 该系统预测每个框架的捆绑框,而没有假设目标在第一个框架中是可见的,或明确模拟外观变异。 AR2-4FV在最佳基线中实现了+10.3%的再生率改善和 -24.2%的再生率降低,而反通货膨胀研究进一步证实锚图、再入前和再入定位的好处。

papers.title: APPO: Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization for Video Reasoning
papers.authors: Henghui Du, Chang Zhou, Xi Chen, Di Hu
papers.abstract: Complex video reasoning, actually, relies excessively on fine-grained perception rather than on expert (e.g., Ph.D, Science)-level reasoning.Through extensive empirical observation, we have recognized the critical impact of perception.In particular, when perception ability is almost fixed, enhancing reasoning from Qwen3-8B to OpenAI-o3 yields only 0.7% performance improvement. Conversely, even minimal change in perception model scale (from 7B to 32B) boosts performance by 1.4%, indicating enhancing perception, rather than reasoning, is more critical to improve performance.Therefore, exploring how to enhance perception ability through reasoning without the need for expensive fine-grained annotation information is worthwhile.To achieve this goal, we specially propose APPO, the Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization algorithm that leverages token-level dense rewards to improve model's fine-grained perception.The core idea behind APPO is to optimize those tokens from different responses that primarily focus on the same crucial video frame (called intra-group perception tokens).Experimental results on diverse video benchmarks and models with different scales (3/7B) demonstrate APPO consistently outperforms GRPO and DAPO (0.5% 4%). We hope our work provides a promising approach to effectively enhance model's perception abilities through reasoning in a low-cost manner, serving diverse scenarios and demands.
papers.title_zh: APPO: 关注引导感知政策优化视频理由
papers.abstract_zh: 事实上,复杂的视频推理过度依赖精细的认知而不是专家(如博士、科学)层面的推理。 通过广泛的实证观察,我们认识到了认知的至关重要影响。 特别是当认知能力几乎固定时,从Quen3-8B到OpenAI-o3的推理只能带来0.7%的性能改善。 反之,即使认识模型规模(从7B到32B)的最小变化也能够提高1.4%的性能,表明认识的提高而不是推理的提高,对于提高性能更为关键。 因此,探索如何通过推理提高感知能力,而不必花费昂贵的细微批注信息是值得的。 为了实现这一目标,我们特别提议APPO, 关注引导的感知政策优化算法,利用象征性的密集奖励来改进模型精细的感知。 APPO的核心思想是优化主要侧重于同一关键视频框架(所谓的群体内部感知符号)的不同反应的象征物。 不同规模的不同视频基准和模型(3/7B)的显著结果显示APPO一贯优于GROPO和DAPO(0.5% 4%) 。 我们希望我们的工作能够提供一种有希望的方法,通过低成本的推理,为不同的情景和需求服务,有效提高模型的认知能力。

papers.title: AlphaRouter: Token-level Routing Between SLM and LLM with Reinforcement Learning and Tree Search
papers.authors: Siteng Liao, Yuzhu Liang, Hengzhong Rao, Xizhao Luo, Tian Wang
papers.abstract: SLM-LLM routing accelerates generation by strategically invoking LLMs for critical tokens. However, existing methods typically train routers to mimic the LLM, capping performance at the reference trajectory's limit. In this work, we demonstrate that the SLM-LLM collaborative inference space offers a richer solution set, yielding correct answers even when the LLM fails. To exploit this, we propose AlphaRouter , a routing framework learning optimal collaborative inference paths via a search and iterative update paradigm. Formulating routing as a Markov Decision Process, we introduce Collaborative Inference Tree Search (CITS) to explore the solution space. To tackle the severe credit assignment challenge posed by sparse rewards, we propose Tree-Advantage Policy Optimization (TAPO) to optimize the routing policy. By leveraging counterfactual advantages within the tree structure, TAPO effectively attributes the final reward to specific routing decisions, stabilizing training without dense supervision. Extensive experiments show that AlphaRouter advances the Pareto frontier of accuracy-efficiency trade-offs by exploiting better inference trajectories in the collaborative space. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AlphaRouter.
papers.title_zh: AlphaRouter:可持续土地管理与有强化学习和树木搜索的LLM之间的当量路由
papers.abstract_zh: SLM-LLM路由通过战略性地援引LLMs获取关键标志加速生成,但是,现有的方法通常训练路由器模仿LLM, 将性能限制在参考轨迹的极限。 在这项工作中,我们证明,可持续土地管理-LLM合作推理空间提供了一套更丰富的解决方案,即使LLM失败,也得出了正确的答案。 为了利用这一点,我们提议阿尔法罗特(AlphaRouter),这是一个通过搜索和迭代更新模式学习最佳合作推理途径的路线框架。 作为马可夫决策程序,我们引入合作推论树搜索(CITS)来探索解决方案空间。 为了应对微薄回报带来的严重信用分配挑战,我们提出“树木优势政策优化(TAPO) ” , 以优化路径政策。 TAPO利用树木结构内的反事实优势,有效地将最终奖励归功于具体路线决定,在没有密集监督的情况下稳定培训。 广泛的实验表明,阿尔法罗特通过在合作空间利用更好的推断轨道,推进了Pareto的准确-效率权衡边界,代码见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AlphaRouter。

papers.title: Air-Know: Arbiter-Calibrated Knowledge-Internalizing Robust Network for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Zhiheng Fu, Yupeng Hu, Qianyun Yang, Shiqi Zhang, Zhiwei Chen, Zixu Li
papers.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) has attracted significant attention due to its flexible multimodal query method, yet its development is severely constrained by the Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC) problem. Most existing robust learning methods rely on the "small loss hypothesis", but the unique semantic ambiguity in NTC, such as "partial matching", invalidates this assumption, leading to unreliable noise identification. This entraps the model in a self dependent vicious cycle where the learner is intertwined with the arbiter, ultimately causing catastrophic "representation pollution". To address this critical challenge, we propose a novel "Expert-Proxy-Diversion" decoupling paradigm, named Air-Know (ArbIteR calibrated Knowledge iNternalizing rObust netWork). Air-Know incorporates three core modules: (1) The External Prior Arbitration (EPA) module, which utilizes Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as an offline expert to construct a high precision anchor dataset; (2) Expert Knowledge Internalization (EKI) module, which efficiently guides a lightweight proxy "arbiter" to internalize the expert's discriminative logic; (3) Dual Stream Reconciliation (DSR) module, which leverages the EKI's matching confidence to divert the training data, achieving a clean alignment stream and a representation feedback reconciliation stream. Extensive experiments on multiple CIR benchmark datasets demonstrate that Air-Know significantly outperforms existing SOTA methods under the NTC setting, while also showing strong competitiveness in traditional CIR.
papers.title_zh: 航空知识:仲裁人-校准知识-合成图像检索内部强力网络
papers.abstract_zh: 合成图像检索(CIR)因其灵活的多式联运Query方法而吸引了人们的极大关注,然而其发展却受到Nisy Triplet通讯(NTC)问题的严重制约。 多数现有强健的学习方法依赖于“小额损失假设 ” , 但NTC中独特的语义模糊性,如“部分匹配 ” , 使这一假设无效,导致不可靠的噪音识别。 这使得模型陷入一个自成一体的恶性循环中,即学习者与仲裁者交织在一起,最终造成灾难性的“ 代表性污染 ” 。 为了应对这一严峻的挑战,我们提议了一个名为 Air-Kood(ArbItER校准知识网络)的“专家-Proxy- Diversion”解耦模式。 航空知识包含三个核心模块:(1) 外部事先仲裁(EPA)模块,该模块使用多式大语言模型(MLLM)作为离线专家,以建立一个高精准锚数据集;(2) 专家知识内部化模块,该模块有效地指导轻量代用“仲裁员”将专家的歧视性逻辑内在化;(3) 双流调节模块,该模块利用EKI的匹配信心来转移培训数据,实现清洁的对齐流和代表性反馈对调流。

papers.title: Agile Deliberation: Concept Deliberation for Subjective Visual Classification
papers.authors: Leijie Wang, Otilia Stretcu, Wei Qiao, Thomas Denby, Krishnamurthy Viswanathan, Enming Luo, Chun-Ta Lu, Tushar Dogra, Ranjay Krishna, Ariel Fuxman
papers.abstract: From content moderation to content curation, applications requiring vision classifiers for visual concepts are rapidly expanding. Existing human-in-the-loop approaches typically assume users begin with a clear, stable concept understanding to be able to provide high-quality supervision. In reality, users often start with a vague idea and must iteratively refine it through "concept deliberation", a practice we uncovered through structured interviews with content moderation experts. We operationalize the common strategies in deliberation used by real content moderators into a human-in-the-loop framework called Agile Deliberation that explicitly supports evolving and subjective concepts. The system supports users in defining the concept for themselves by exposing them to borderline cases. The system does this with two deliberation stages: (1) concept scoping, which decomposes the initial concept into a structured hierarchy of sub-concepts, and (2) concept iteration, which surfaces semantically borderline examples for user reflection and feedback to iteratively align an image classifier with the user's evolving intent. Since concept deliberation is inherently subjective and interactive, we painstakingly evaluate the framework through 18 user sessions, each 1.5h long, rather than standard benchmarking datasets. We find that Agile Deliberation achieves 7.5% higher F1 scores than automated decomposition baselines and more than 3% higher than manual deliberation, while participants reported clearer conceptual understanding and lower cognitive effort.
papers.title_zh: 审议:主观视觉分类概念审议
papers.abstract_zh: 从内容调和到内容调和,需要视觉分类的应用程序正在迅速扩大。现有的“人到流”方法通常假定用户首先要有一个清晰、稳定的概念理解,才能提供高质量的监督。在现实中,用户往往从一个模糊的概念开始,必须通过“概念审议”来反复完善它,这是我们通过与内容调和专家进行结构化访谈而发现的做法。我们通过实际内容调和人到流的评议,将共同的战略落实到一个名为“Agile De Consider”的“人到流框架”,明确支持不断演变的主观概念。这个系统通过让用户接触边际案例,支持用户为自己定义概念。 系统通过两个审议阶段来做到这一点:(1) 概念范围界定,将初始概念分解成一个结构化的子概念等级;(2) 概念迭代,它代表了供用户思考和反馈的语义边际实例,使图像分类器与用户不断变化的意图迭接。 由于概念考虑本质上是主观和互动性的,我们通过18次用户会议(每1.5小时)而不是标准基准数据集来认真评估框架。 我们发现“Agile De Consider”的F1分数比自动分解基线高出7.5%,比人工评分高出3%以上,而参与者则报告说概念理解更清楚,认知努力较少。

papers.title: Affordance-First Decomposition for Continual Learning in Video-Language Understanding
papers.authors: Mengzhu xu, Hanzhi Liu, Ningkang Peng, Qianyu Chen, Canran Xiao
papers.abstract: Continual learning for video--language understanding is increasingly important as models face non-stationary data, domains, and query styles, yet prevailing solutions blur what should stay stable versus what should adapt, rely on static routing/capacity, or require replaying past videos. We aim to explicitly specify where stability lives and where plasticity should be focused under realistic memory and privacy constraints. We introduce Affordance-First Decomposition (AFD): videos are mapped to slowly varying affordance tokens that form a shared, time-aligned substrate, while a lightweight, query-routed, conflict-aware scheduler concentrates adaptation and grows capacity only when needed. The substrate is stabilized via weak alignment and teacher consistency, and training uses question-only replay. AFD achieves state-of-the-art across protocols: 51.6% average accuracy with -1.8% forgetting on domain-incremental VideoQA, ViLCo R@1@0.5 of 29.6% (MQ) and 20.7% (NLQ) with 18.4% stAP@0.25 (VQ), and 39.5% accuracy with -1.6% forgetting on time-incremental iVQA. Overall, AFD offers an explicit, interpretable split between a stable interaction-centered substrate and targeted adaptation.
papers.title_zh: 以视频语言理解方式持续学习的支付能力-第一次分解
papers.abstract_zh: 视频语言理解的持续学习越来越重要,因为模型面临非静止数据、领域和Query风格,但普遍的解决办法模糊了什么应该保持稳定和什么应该适应、依赖静态路由/能力或需要重播过去视频。我们的目标是明确规定稳定生命和在现实的记忆和隐私限制下易塑性应集中在何处。我们引入了“fordance-First Decomposition ” (AFD):视频被映射为缓慢变化的发价标牌,形成一个共同的、与时间一致的基调,而轻量的、有Query路径的、有冲突意识的排程仪则只在必要时集中适应和增加能力。基调是通过松散和教师一致性而稳定下来的,培训则只使用问题重播。 AFD在各种协议中达到了最新水平:51.6%的平均精确度,其中-1.8 %忘记了域入围视频QA,VilCo R@0.5,29.6%(MQ)和20.7%(NLQ),18.4% STAP@0.25(VQ)和39.5%的精确度,-1.6%忘记了时间入圈 iVQA。 总体而言,AFD提供了一种明确的、可解释的区分,即稳定的互动中心基调和有针对性的适应。

papers.title: ADSeeker: A Knowledge-Grounded Reasoning Framework for Industry Anomaly Detection and Reasoning
papers.authors: Kai Zhang, Zekai Zhang, Xihe Sun, Anpeng Wang, Jingmeng Nie, Qinghui Chen, Han Hao, Jianyuan Guo, Jinglin Zhang
papers.abstract: Automatic vision inspection holds significant importance in industry inspection. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong language understanding capabilities and hold promise for this task, their performance remains significantly inferior to that of human experts. In this context, we identify two key challenges: (i) insufficient integration of anomaly detection (AD) knowledge during pre-training and (ii) the lack of technically precise and context-aware language generation for anomaly reasoning. To address these issues, we propose ADSeeker, an anomaly task assistant designed to enhance inspection performance through knowledge-grounded reasoning. ADSeeker first leverages a curated visual document knowledge base, SEEK-MVTec&VisA (SEEK-M&V), which we construct to address the limitations of existing resources that rely solely on unstructured text. SEEK-M&V includes semantic-rich descriptions and image-document pairs, enabling more comprehensive anomaly understanding. To effectively retrieve and utilize this knowledge, we introduce the Query Image-Knowledge Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Q2K RAG) framework. To further enhance the performance in zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD), ADSeeker leverages the Hierarchical Sparse Prompt mechanism and type-level features to efficiently extract anomaly patterns. Furthermore, to tackle the challenge of limited industry anomaly detection (IAD) data, we introduce the largest-scale AD dataset, Multi-type Anomaly (MulA), encompassing 72 multi-scale defect types across 26 categories. Extensive experiments show that our plug-and-play framework, ADSeeker, achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on several benchmark datasets.
papers.title_zh: ADSearker:关于工业异常检测和理由解释的知识化理由框架
papers.abstract_zh: 在行业检查中,自动视力检查十分重要,虽然多式联运大型语言模式具有很强的语言理解能力,并有望完成这一任务,但其业绩仍大大低于人类专家,在这方面,我们确定两大挑战:(一) 培训前的异常检测知识(AD)整合不足,以及(二) 缺乏技术准确和符合背景的语言来进行反常推理,为解决这些问题,我们提议ADSeker,这是一个异常任务助理,旨在通过基于知识的推理提高检查绩效。 ADSeker首先利用一个经整理的视觉文件知识库SEK-MVTec & Visa(SEEEK-MT & V),我们建立这个知识库是为了解决完全依赖无结构文本的现有资源的局限性。 SEK-M&V包括语义丰富的描述和图像文件配对,从而能够更全面地理解异常现象。为了有效地检索和利用这一知识,我们引入了Query 图像-知识检索-提炼一代(Q2K RAG)框架。为了进一步提高零弹反常探测(ZSAD)的性能,ADSeerker利用高射速快速机制和类型特性来有效提取异常模式。 此外,为了应对工业异常现象探测数据有限的挑战,我们引入了最大的自动数据数据集,多类型异常(MulA),涵盖26个类别的72个多级缺陷类型。 广泛的实验表明,我们的插座和游戏框架ADSERker在一些基准数据集上取得了最先进的零点效果。

papers.title: Adaptive Utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation via Conditioned Gating
papers.authors: Guang Yang, Changhao Guan, Chao Huang, Yufeng Chen, Kaiyu Huang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) achieves parameter-efficient fine-tuning by constraining model updates to a low-rank subspace and has been widely used in practice. However, LoRA typically employs a shared low-rank update across tokens, which limits its ability to fully exploit the adaptation subspace for tokens from different sequences. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation (U-LoRA), which employs conditioned gating to explicitly learn effective token-level utilization of the limited low-rank adaptation subspace. Specifically, U-LoRA generates utilization coefficients along low-rank directions for each token and jointly coordinates and constrains them using sequence-level contextual information, thereby inducing more consistent adaptive patterns within a sentence. To further enhance training stability, we introduce a bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) historical prior that calibrates utilization signals across optimization steps, suppressing noise caused by batch-to-batch fluctuations. The effectiveness of our method arises from a better utilization of the existing low-rank subspace via input-conditioned strategies, rather than from expanding the subspace. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate that U-LoRA achieves competitive performance under comparable parameter budgets when with strong LoRA baselines and recent variants.
papers.title_zh: 通过有条件调节利用低温适应的适应性利用
papers.abstract_zh: 低Rank适应(LORA)通过限制对低级子空间的模型更新,实现具有参数效率的微调,并在实践中得到广泛使用。 然而,LORA通常在象征性品之间采用共享的低级更新,这限制了它充分利用适应性子空间处理不同序列的象征性品的能力。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议适应性地利用低排适应(U-LORA),该适应利用有附加条件的格子,明确学习如何有效象征性地利用有限的低级适应子空间。 具体地说,U-LORA为每个象征物按低位指令生成利用率系数,并联合协调并限制它们使用序列级背景信息,从而在句子内形成更加一致的适应模式。 为了进一步加强培训的稳定性,我们引入了一种纠正偏差的指数移动平均数(EMA),这是在校准各种优化步骤的利用信号、抑制批次到批次波动造成的噪音之前的历史性指数移动平均数(EMA)。 我们的方法之所以有效,是因为通过以输入为条件的战略更好地利用现有的低级子空间,而不是扩大子空间。 关于数学推理和自然语言理解基准的实验表明,U-LORA在具有强大的LORA基线和最近的变式的情况下,在可比参数预算下取得竞争性业绩。

papers.title: Adaptive Depth Lightweight RGB-T Tracking with Holistic Token Routing
papers.authors: Tian Ding, Hongtao Yang, Liangtao Shi, Jun Li, Xiantao Hu, Jian Yang, Ying Tai
papers.abstract: The appeal of RGB-T tracking lies in its resilience when RGB fails under night scenes, glare, fog, and partial occlusion. Despite notable accuracy gains, recent architectures emphasize deep fusion and large parameter counts, driving up FLOPs and bandwidth. This computational burden constrains real-time performance and limits scalability beyond high-end GPUs. To balance accuracy and efficiency, we propose Adaptive Early-Exit (AEE): we augment the backbone with anytime heads and pair them with a confidence-calibrated early-exit policy that halts inference at the earliest reliable layer, skipping redundant computation. For cross-modal interaction, we design a Holistic-Token-Guided Interaction (HTGI) module, where each modality is compressed into a compact set of holistic state tokens and injected into the other modality's modeling stream without layer-wise alignment, enabling targeted information exchange at extremely low cost. On RGB-T benchmarks, the lightweight tracker substantially reduces latency while maintaining competitive accuracy; on LasHeR, it achieves 70.2% precision and 56.3% success, running at 148.3 FPS on GPU, 50.2 FPS on CPU, and 28.7 FPS on an edge device.
papers.title_zh: 以全式调控路由跟踪适应性深度轻量RGB-T
papers.abstract_zh: RGB-T追踪的吸引力在于它的复原力,当RGB在夜间场景、玻璃、雾和部分隔离下失灵时,RGB-T追踪的吸引力在于它的复原力。 尽管取得了显著的准确性收益,但最近的建筑强调深度聚合和大参数计数,驱动FLOPs和带宽。这一计算负担限制了实时性能,限制了高于高端GPUs的可缩放性。为了平衡准确性和效率,我们建议“适应性提前出口 ” ( AEE):我们用随时随地的头部来增强骨干,用一个信任性强的早期输出政策来配对它们,在最可靠的层停止猜测,跳过多余的计算。 对于跨模式互动,我们设计了一个全方位引导互动模块(HTGI ) , 将每种模式压缩为一套集集集的整体状态标牌,并注入其他模式的模型流,而没有分层协调,从而能够以极低的成本进行有针对性的信息交流。 在RGB-T 基准上, 轻量级跟踪器在保持竞争准确性的同时大大降低了延缓度; 在LasHER 上, 它实现了70.2%的精确度和56.3%的成功率,在GPU上运行的FPS为148.3,在CPU上运行的FPS为50.2,在边缘装置上运行的FPS为28.7。

papers.title: Adaptive 3D Perception for Small Aerial Targets Under Sparse Sampling via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Shenghai Yuan, Wei Yihan, Jason Yee, Zhuoran Qiao, boyang lou, Enwen Hu
papers.abstract: Detecting small aerial targets (SATs) in long-range LiDAR is challenging because motion causes extreme variations in point density, breaking fixed-voxel and static-threshold assumptions in standard 3D detection and tracking. To address the challenges, we introduce A3PRL, an RL-driven adaptive perception framework that closes the loop between LiDAR sensing and tracking. A3PRL uses a sparsity-aware proposal stage with Temporal Dispersion Signatures and velocity-change cues, and a lightweight 5D policy that jointly adjusts voxel resolution, detection sensitivity, and association gating from label-free statistics of sparsity, foreground acceptance, and track stability. The policy is trained with privileged ground-truth trajectories to optimize a reward balancing geometric accuracy, temporal stability, and regularized acceptance, but runs fully label-free at test time. On the public MMAUD benchmark, training on V1 and evaluating on unseen V2/V3, A3PRL reduces 3D localization error by about 19% over its non-RL counterpart and consistently outperforms LiDAR-only and multimodal baselines under both day and night conditions. The same policy is able to transfer to other SAT datasets with heterogeneous scan patterns, maintaining accurate and stable trajectories.
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习在粗略抽样下对小空中目标的适应性 3D 感知
papers.abstract_zh: 在远程激光雷达中探测小型空中目标(SATs)具有挑战性,因为运动造成点密度的极端变化,打破了标准3D探测和跟踪中的固定蒸汽和静态临界假设。为了应对挑战,我们引入了A3PRL,这是一个由RL驱动的适应感知框架,它关闭了激光雷达遥感和跟踪之间的循环。 A3PRL使用一个具有空间意识的建议阶段,有时空分散感和速度变化提示,以及一项轻度5D政策,它共同调整对氧化物的分辨率、探测灵敏度以及从无标签的孔隙统计、地面接受度和跟踪稳定性中得出的联系。 该政策经过特许的地面真象轨迹培训,以优化奖励,平衡几何精确度、时间稳定性和正常接受率,但在测试时完全没有标签。 在公共MMAUD基准上,关于V1的培训和对看不见V2/V3、A3PRL的评定,将3D定位错误比非RL对口单位减少约19%,并在日夜条件下始终优于LIDAR专用和多式基线。同一政策能够向具有混杂扫描模式的其他SAT数据集转移,保持准确和稳定的轨迹。

papers.title: Action-Sketcher: From Reasoning to Action via Visual Sketches for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Huajie Tan, Peterson Co, Yijie Xu, Shanyu Rong, Yuheng Ji, Cheng Chi, Xiansheng Chen, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Shanghang Zhang
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation is increasingly important for real-world deployment, requiring spatial disambiguation in complex layouts and temporal resilience under dynamic interaction. However, existing end-to-end and hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely on text-only cues while keeping plan intent latent, which undermines referential grounding in cluttered or underspecified scenes, impedes effective task decomposition of long-horizon goals with close-loop interaction, and limits causal explanation by obscuring the rationale behind action choices. To address these issues, we first introduce Visual Sketch, an implausible visual intermediate that renders points, boxes, arrows, and typed relations in the robot's current views to externalize spatial intent, connect language to scene geometry, and provide a human-verifiable bridge between high-level reasoning and low-level control. Building on Visual Sketch, we present Action-Sketcher, a VLA framework that operates in a cyclic See -> Think -> Sketch -> Act workflow coordinated by adaptive token-gated strategy for reasoning triggers, sketch revision, and action issuance, thereby supporting reactive corrections and human interaction while preserving real-time action prediction. To enable scalable training and evaluation, we curate diverse corpus with interleaved images, text, Visual Sketch supervision, and action sequences, and train Action-Sketcher with a multi-stage curriculum recipe that combines interleaved sequence alignment for modality unification, language-to-sketch consistency for precise linguistic grounding, and imitation learning augmented with sketch-to-action reinforcement for robustness. Extensive experiments on cluttered scenes and multi-object tasks, in simulation and on real-world tasks, show improved long-horizon success, stronger robustness to dynamic scene changes, and enhanced interpretability via editable sketches and step-wise plans.
papers.title_zh: Action-Skecher:通过机器人操纵视觉动画片从理性到行动
papers.abstract_zh: 长视距机器人操纵对于现实世界的部署越来越重要,要求在复杂的布局中进行空间解耦,并在动态互动下保持时间弹性,但是,现有的端对端和上下级视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策往往依赖只使用文字的提示,同时保持计划意图潜伏,这破坏了在布局紧凑或未定的场景中的优先定位,妨碍将长视距目标与近距离互动有效地分解任务,并由于掩盖了行动选择背后的理由而限制了因果关系。 为了解决这些问题,我们首先介绍视觉Sletch,这是一个令人难以置信的视觉中间体,它使机器人当前观点中的点、盒子、箭头和打字关系外化空间意图,将语言与现场几何相连接,并在高层次推理和低层次控制之间提供可人核查的桥梁。 在视觉Sletch的基础上,我们介绍了“行动-Sketscher”这一VLA框架,它以“循环观察-思维-> Sletch-> Act”为操作,通过适应性象征性战略协调,通过推理触发、草图修改和行动发布来协调,从而支持反应性纠正和人际互动,同时保持实时行动预测。 为了进行可扩缩的培训和评估,我们以不同图像、文字、视觉图纸监督和行动序列等形式整理各种内容,对Action-Sketscher进行培训,培训多阶段课程配方,将不同序列的组合结合起来,以统一模式、语言和背景一致的方式精确进行语言定位,以及模仿学习,辅之以加强素描对行动,以强化强健性。 在模拟和现实世界任务中,对各种场景和多对象任务进行广泛的实验,展示了更好的长方位成功、对动态场景变化的更强的坚固性以及通过可编辑的草图和渐进计划提高解释性。

papers.title: Achieving Expert-Level Agent from Foundation Model via Complexity Curriculum Reinforcement Learning with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents exhibit strong mathematical problem-solving abilities and can even solve International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) level problems with the assistance of formal proof systems. However, due to weak heuristics for auxiliary constructions, AI for geometry problem solving remains dominated by expert models such as AlphaGeometry 2, which rely heavily on large-scale data synthesis and search for both training and evaluation. In this work, we make the first attempt to build a medalist-level LLM agent for geometry and present InternGeometry. InternGeometry overcomes the heuristic limitations in geometry by iteratively proposing propositions and auxiliary constructions, verifying them with a symbolic engine, and reflecting on the engine’s feedback to guide subsequent proposals. A dynamic memory mechanism enables InternGeometry to conduct more than two hundred interactions with the symbolic engine per problem. To further accelerate learning, we introduce Complexity-Boosting Reinforcement Learning (CBRL), which gradually increases the complexity of synthesized problems across training stages. Built on InternThinker-32B, InternGeometry solves 44 of 50 IMO geometry problems (2000–2024), exceeding the average gold medalist score (40.9), using only 13K training examples, just $0.004 %$ of the data used by AlphaGeometry 2, demonstrating the potential of LLM agents on expert-level geometry tasks. InternGeometry can also propose novel auxiliary constructions for IMO problems that do not appear in human solutions. We will release the model, data, and symbolic engine to support future research.
tags: Large Language Model, Reinforcement Learning, Geometry Agent Prover
papers.primary_area: foundation or frontier models, including LLMs
papers.explain_zh: - 解决的问题是什么？（一句话） - 构建一个能解决国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）级别几何题的专家级大语言模型代理。 - 动机是什么？（为什么要做） - 当前大语言模型在几何题求解上仍受限于缺乏有效的辅助构造启发式方法，难以达到人类金牌选手水平。 - 现有专家模型（如AlphaGeometry 2）依赖海量合成数据和复杂搜索，成本高、可扩展性差。 - 希望用更少数据和更高效的方式，让大模型代理实现专家级几何解题能力。 - 方法是什么？（核心思路/关键模块/训练或推理流程） - 提出“迭代式命题与构造”机制：模型不断提出几何命题和辅助线/点，通过符号引擎验证并反馈。 - 引入动态记忆模块，支持单题超过200次与符号引擎交互，实现深度反思与修正。 - 设计复杂度增强强化学习（CBRL）：训练中逐步提升合成题目的难度，引导模型循序渐进学习。 - 基于InternThinker-32B构建，仅用13K训练样本完成训练。 - 结论是什么？（实验结果/收益/适用范围） - 在50道IMO几何题中解决44道，超过金牌平均分（40.9），达到人类顶尖水平。 - 仅使用0.004%的训练数据（相比AlphaGeometry 2），显著降低数据依赖。 - 可生成人类未见的创新辅助构造，具备创造性潜力。 - 适用于高难度几何问题求解，未来可拓展至其他形式化推理任务。 - 创新点是什么？（相对已有工作的新意） - 首次将复杂度课程强化学习（CBRL）应用于几何求解，实现高效渐进式训练。 - 提出动态记忆+符号反馈的迭代反思机制，突破传统单次推理局限。 - 用极少量数据实现专家级性能，挑战了“高精度需大数据”的范式。 （总字数：432） --- ✅ 说明： - 严格依据摘要内容，未添加外部信息。 - 语言通俗，避免术语堆砌，如“符号引擎”解释为“验证工具”。 -
papers.title_zh: 通过复杂课程强化学习合成数据合成数据,从基础模型中实现专家级代理
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理物具有很强的数学解决问题的能力,甚至能够在正式验证系统的协助下解决国际数学奥林匹亚(海事组织)一级的问题。 然而,由于辅助建筑的功率薄弱,用于解决几何问题的AI仍然以阿尔法几何2等专家模型为主,这些模型严重依赖大规模数据综合和搜索,以进行培训和评价。 在这项工作中,我们第一次试图建立一个奖牌级的LLM代理,负责几何学和目前的InternGhophy。 通过反复提出提议和辅助工程,用象征性的引擎进行核实,并思考发动机的反馈,以指导随后的建议书,国际计量学克服了几何的超自然限制。 动态的记忆机制使InternGeasy能够与每个问题的象征性引擎进行200多次互动。 为了进一步加速学习,我们引入了复杂-压力强化学习(CBRL ) , 这逐渐增加了各个培训阶段综合问题的复杂性。 在InternThinker-32B上,InternGeophasy解决了海事组织50个几何问题中的44个(2000-2024年),超过了平均金奖获得者分数(40.9),仅使用13K培训实例,仅使用阿尔法几何2使用的数据的0.004%,表明LLM代理人在专家一级几何任务方面的潜力。 InternGhomas 还可以提出新的辅助工程,解决在人类解决方案中并不存在的海事组织问题。 我们将发布模型、数据和象征性引擎,以支持未来的研究。

papers.title: ACE-Merging: Data-Free Model Merging with Adaptive Covariance Estimation
papers.authors: Bo Xu, Haotian Wu, Hehai Lin, Weiquan Huang, Beier Zhu, Yao Shu, Chengwei Qin
papers.abstract: Model merging aims to combine multiple task-specific experts into a single model, but inter-task interference often causes severe degradation, especially when the experts are trained on heterogeneous objectives. Existing data-free methods are practical, yet largely rely on parameter-space heuristics without explicitly modeling task statistics. In this paper, we show that under a local linear approximation, the input covariance of each task can be estimated directly from its fine-tuning update, providing a principled bridge between parameter changes and data geometry in the data-free setting. Based on this insight, we propose ACE-Merging, a closed-form model merging framework with adaptive covariance normalization, a collective structural prior, and spectral refinement. Across both vision and language benchmarks, ACE-Merging achieves strong overall performance among data-free baselines. In particular, it improves the average score on GPT-2 by more than 4 points over prior methods, while also delivering strong scalability and competitive efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/unravel-xu/ACE-Merging/tree/main.
papers.title_zh: ACE-Merging:无数据模型与适应性共差估计合并
papers.abstract_zh: 模型合并的目的是将多重任务专家合并为单一模型,但任务间干扰往往导致严重退化,特别是在专家接受关于不同目标的培训时。现有的无数据方法是实用的,但在很大程度上依赖参数-空间超常,而没有明确的模拟任务统计。在本文中,我们表明,在当地线性近似值下,每项任务的投入共差可以直接从其微调更新中估算,在无数据环境下提供参数变化和数据几何测量之间的原则桥梁。基于这一见解,我们提议ACE-Merging(ACE-Merging)是一个封闭式模型,与适应性共同变迁正常化、集体结构前和光谱完善合并框架。 在视觉和语言基准方面,ACE-Merging在无数据基线中取得了良好的总体业绩,特别是使GPT-2的平均分数比以往方法提高了4个百分点以上,同时也提供了强大的可缩放性和竞争效率,我们的代码可在https://github.com/unravel-xu/ACE-Merging/tree/main上查阅,网址是https://github.com/unravel-xu/ACE-Merging/tree/main。

papers.title: Accelerating Transformer-Based Monocular SLAM via Geometric Utility Scoring
papers.authors: Xinmiao Xiong, Bangya Liu, Hao Wang, Dayou Li, Nuo Chen, Andrew Feng, Mingyu Ding, Suman Banerjee, Yang Zhou, Zhiwen Fan
papers.abstract: Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently advanced monocular SLAM by providing robust, calibration-free 3D priors. However, deploying these models on dense video streams introduces significant computational redundancy. Current GFM-based SLAM systems typically rely on post hoc keyframe selection. Because of this, they must perform expensive dense geometric decoding simply to determine whether a frame contains novel geometry, resulting in late rejection and wasted computation. To mitigate this inefficiency, we propose LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward frame-gating network. LeanGate predicts a geometric utility score to assess a frame's mapping value prior to the heavy GFM feature extraction and matching stages. As a predictive plug-and-play module, our approach bypasses over 90% of redundant frames. Evaluations on standard SLAM benchmarks demonstrate that LeanGate reduces tracking FLOPs by more than 85% and achieves a 5x end-to-end throughput speedup. Furthermore, it maintains the tracking and mapping accuracy of dense baselines. Project page: https://lean-gate.github.io/
papers.title_zh: 通过几何功用扫描加速以变速器为基础的单体SLM
papers.abstract_zh: 几何基础模型(GFMS)最近通过提供强健、无校准的3D前置技术,推进了单方SLMM。然而,在密集视频流上部署这些模型会引入大量计算冗余。当前以GFM为基础的SLM系统通常依赖后特设键框架选择。因此,它们必须进行昂贵的密集几何解码,以便确定一个框架是否包含新的几何方法,导致延迟拒绝和浪费计算。为了减轻这种效率低下,我们提议建立轻量进料前向框架定位网络LeanGate。 LeanGate预测一个几何实用分,以便在重GFM特征提取和匹配阶段之前评估一个框架的绘图值。作为预测性的插和游戏模块,我们的方法绕过90%以上的冗余框架。 对标准SLAM基准的评价表明,LeanGate将跟踪FLOP减少85%以上,并实现了5x端到端输送速度的加速,此外,它还维持密集基线的跟踪和绘图准确性,项目网页:https://lean-gate.github.io/。

papers.title: A Linear Expectation Constraint for Selective Prediction and Routing with False-Discovery Control
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Wang, Aniri -, Tianlong Chen, Yue Zhang, Heng Tao Shen, Xiaoshuang Shi, Kaidi Xu
papers.abstract: Foundation models often generate unreliable answers, while heuristic uncertainty estimators fail to fully distinguish correct from incorrect outputs, causing users to accept erroneous answers without statistical guarantees. We address this through the lens of false discovery rate (FDR) control, ensuring that among all accepted predictions, the proportion of errors does not exceed a target risk level. To this end, we propose LEC, a principled framework that reframes selective prediction as a decision problem governed by a linear expectation constraint over selection and error indicators. Under this formulation, we derive a finite-sample sufficient condition that relies only on a held-out set of exchangeable calibration data, enabling the computation of an FDR-constrained, retention-maximizing threshold. Furthermore, we extend LEC to two-model routing systems: if the primary model's uncertainty exceeds its calibrated threshold, the input is delegated to a subsequent model, while maintaining system-level FDR control. Experiments on both closed-ended and open-ended question answering (QA) and vision question answering (VQA) demonstrate that LEC achieves tighter FDR control and substantially improves sample retention compared to prior approaches.
papers.title_zh: 使用假发现控制进行选择性预测和运行的线性期望限制
papers.abstract_zh: 基础模型往往产生不可靠的答案,而超常的不确定性估计者未能完全区分正确的产出和不正确的产出,导致用户在没有统计保证的情况下接受错误的答案。 我们从虚假发现率控制的角度处理这一问题,确保在所有公认的预测中,误差比例不超过目标风险水平。 为此,我们提出LEC,这是一个原则性框架,它将选择性预测重新定义为一个决定问题,受对选择和误差指标的线性预期限制所制约。 根据这一提法,我们得出一个有限抽样的充足条件,它仅依赖于一套稳妥的可交换校准数据,从而能够计算出一个受限制的、保留-最大化的FDR阈值。 此外,我们把LEC扩大到两个模式的路线系统:如果主要模式的不确定性超过其校准阈值,输入将委托给随后的一个模式,同时保持系统一级的FDR控制。 关于不限名额和不限名额问题回答和视觉问题回答的实验表明,与以前的做法相比,LEC实现了更严格的FDR控制,并大大改进了样本保留。

papers.title: A Graph Foundation Model with Cross-Modal Alignment and Modality-Aware Expert Fusion for Multi-Modal Graphs
papers.authors: Dongxiao He, AnKang Yang, Jitao Zhao, Di Jin
papers.abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) aim to learn universal patterns through large-scale pretraining on diverse graphs and generalize to open-world scenarios. While GFMs have garnered significant attention, existing works primarily focus on sigle-modal graphs. However, many real-world graphs are multimodal, consisting of structures alongside diverse features derived from modalities such as text and images. To date, exploration into Multimodal Graph Foundation Models (MGFMs) remains limited. Incorporating multimodal data provides a more comprehensive view, allowing models to learn richer semantics, thereby advancing GFMs. We are therefore motivated to explore MGFMs, where the core challenge lies in synergistically encoding structures and multimodal features to achieve effective cross-modal alignment and fusion. To this end, we propose a graph foundation model with Cross-modal Alignment and Modality-aware Expert fusion, CAME. Specifically, CAME first generates graph embeddings for each individual modality. We then introduce a multimodal multi-expert encoding mechanism, which includes a dimension-wise routing strategy to fuse multimodal information. Finally, we employ a cross-modal contrastive loss to train CAME, enabling the adaptive alignment and fusion across different modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CAME across multiple tasks and diverse multimodal graph datasets.
papers.title_zh: 多模式图集跨模式调整和多模式图集模式-软件专家融合的图形基础模型模型
papers.abstract_zh: 图表基础模型(GFMs)旨在通过对各种图表进行大规模预培训来学习普遍模式,并概括到开放世界的情景。 虽然GFMs吸引了极大关注,但现有工作主要侧重于硅状模式图。 然而,许多真实世界图表是多式联运,由结构组成,具有文本和图像等模式产生的不同特征,迄今为止,对多模式图基础模型(MGFMS)的探索仍然有限。 纳入多式联运数据可提供更全面的观点,使模型能够学习更丰富的语义,从而推进全球调频。 因此,我们有志于探索MGMMs,其核心挑战在于协同编码结构和多式联运特征,以实现有效的跨模式的配合和融合。 为此,我们提出了一个与跨模式的一致和有模式意识的专家融合的图表基础模型(CAME ) 。 具体地说,CAME首先为每种方式生成图形嵌入器。 然后我们引入了多式多专业编码机制,其中包括一个多维化多式信息集成路径战略。 最后,我们用一种跨模式的对比性损失来培训CAME,使适应性调整和融合能够跨越不同模式。 广泛的实验表明CAME在多重任务和多种多式联运图表数据集方面的有效性。

papers.title: 4D-RGPT: Toward Region-level 4D Understanding via Perceptual Distillation
papers.authors: Chiao-An Yang, Ryo Hachiuma, Sifei Liu, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Raymond A. Yeh, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Min-Hung Chen
papers.abstract: Despite advances in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), their ability to reason over 3D structures and temporal dynamics remains limited, constrained by weak 4D perception and temporal understanding. Existing 3D and 4D Video Question Answering (VQA) benchmarks also emphasize static scenes and lack region-level prompting.We tackle these issues by introducing:(a) 4D-RGPT, a specialized MLLM designed to capture 4D representations from video inputs with enhanced temporal perception;(b) Perceptual 4D Distillation (P4D), a training framework that transfers 4D representations from a frozen expert model into 4D-RGPT for comprehensive 4D perception; and(c) R4D-Bench, a benchmark for depth-aware dynamic scenes with region-level prompting, built via a hybrid automated and human-verified pipeline.Our 4D-RGPT achieves notable improvements on both existing 4D VQA benchmarks and the proposed R4D-Bench benchmark.
papers.title_zh: 4D-RGPT:通过概念蒸馏实现地区一级4D理解
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在多模式LMS(MLLM)方面取得了进展,但由于4D观念和时间理解薄弱,他们了解3D结构和时间动态的能力仍然有限。 现有的3D和4D视频问题解答(VQA)基准也强调静态场景,缺乏区域一级的提示。 我们处理这些问题的方法是:(a) 4D-RGPT,这是一个专门的MLLM,旨在从视频输入中获取4D陈述,同时提高时间感;(b) 概念4蒸馏(P4D),这是一个培训框架,将4D陈述从一个冻结的专家模型转移到4D-RGPT,以综合4D感知;(c) R4D-Bench,这是一个通过自动化和人核查混合管道建立的区域一级深度觉悟动态场景基准。 我们的4D-RGPT在现有的4D VQA基准和拟议的R4D-Bench基准上都取得了显著的改进。

papers.title: ViMoE: An Empirical Study of Designing Vision Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Xumeng Han, Longhui Wei, Zhiyang Dou, Yingfei Sun, Zhenjun Han, Qi Tian
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models embody the divide-and-conquer concept and are a promising approach for increasing model capacity, demonstrating excellent scalability across multiple domains. In this paper, we integrate the MoE structure into the classic Vision Transformer (ViT), naming it ViMoE, and explore the potential of applying MoE to vision through a comprehensive study on image classification and semantic segmentation. However, we observe that the performance is sensitive to the configuration of MoE layers, making it challenging to obtain optimal results without careful design. The underlying cause is that inappropriate MoE layers lead to unreliable routing and hinder experts from effectively acquiring helpful information. To address this, we introduce a shared expert to learn and capture common knowledge, serving as an effective way to construct a stable ViMoE. Furthermore, we demonstrate how to analyze expert routing behavior, revealing which MoE layers are capable of specializing in handling specific information and which are not. This provides guidance for retaining the critical layers while removing redundancies, thereby advancing ViMoE to be more efficient without sacrificing accuracy. We aspire for this work to offer new insights into the design of vision MoE models and provide valuable empirical guidance for future research.
papers.title_zh: VimoE: 设计远见专家混合的经验研究
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模型体现了分而治之的概念,是提高模型能力的有希望的方法,表明在多个领域具有极好的可伸缩性。 在本文中,我们将MoE的结构纳入经典的视野Transformer(VIT),将其命名为ViMoE,并探讨通过对图像分类和语义分化进行全面研究,将MoE应用于视觉的潜力。 然而,我们注意到,绩效对MoE各级的配置十分敏感,因此,如果不仔细设计,取得最佳结果将具有挑战性,其根本原因是,不适当的MoE各级导致路线不可靠,阻碍专家有效获取有用信息。 为此,我们引入了一位共同的专家来学习和捕捉共同的知识,以此作为构建稳定的ViMoE的有效途径。 此外,我们演示了如何分析专家路线行为,揭示了MoE哪些层次能够专门处理具体信息,哪些层次不是。 这为保留关键层面提供了指导,同时消除冗余,从而推动ViMoE在不牺牲准确性的情况下提高效率,我们期望这项工作能为设计视觉MoE模型提供新的洞察力,并为今后的研究提供宝贵的经验性指导。

papers.title: UniSTD: Towards Unified Spatio-Temporal Learning across Diverse Disciplines
papers.authors: Chen Tang, Xinzhu Ma, Encheng Su, Xiufeng Song, Xiaohong Liu, Wei-Hong Li, Lei Bai, Wanli Ouyang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Traditional spatiotemporal models generally rely on task-specific architectures, which limit their generalizability and scalability across diverse tasks due to domain-specific design requirements. In this paper, we introduce UniSTD, a unified Transformer-based framework for spatiotemporal modeling, which is inspired by advances in recent foundation models with the two-stage pretraining-then-adaption paradigm. Specifically, our work demonstrates that task-agnostic pretraining on 2D vision and vision-text datasets can build a generalizable model foundation for spatiotemporal learning, followed by specialized joint training on spatiotemporal datasets to enhance task-specific adaptability. To improve the learning capabilities across domains, our framework employs a rank-adaptive mixture-of-expert adaptation by using fractional interpolation to relax the discrete variables so that can be optimized in the continuous space. Additionally, we introduce a temporal module to incorporate temporal dynamics explicitly. We evaluate our approach on a large-scale dataset covering 10 tasks across 4 disciplines, demonstrating that a unified spatiotemporal model can achieve scalable, cross-task learning and support up to 10 tasks simultaneously within one model while reducing training costs in multi-domain applications. Code will be available at https://github.com/1hunters/UniSTD.
papers.title_zh: UNISTD: 走向跨不同学科的统一空间-时间学习
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的时空模型一般依赖特定任务的结构,由于特定领域的设计要求,这些结构限制了它们的普遍性和可伸缩性,因而限制了它们在不同任务中的普遍性和可伸缩性。在本文中,我们引入了UniSTD,这是一个基于单一Transformer的时空模型统一框架,其灵感来自最近基础模型的进展和两阶段培训前的适应性模式。具体地说,我们的工作表明,2D视觉和视觉文本数据集的任务不可知性预培训可以建立一个可概括的时空学习模型基础,随后是有关加强具体任务适应性的随机数据集的专门联合培训。 为提高各领域的学习能力,我们的框架采用按级调整的专家混合适应办法,利用分解内插来放松离散变量,以便在连续空间中实现最佳化。此外,我们引入了时间模块,明确纳入时间动态。我们评估了我们关于涵盖4个学科10项任务的大规模数据集的方法,表明统一的时空模型可以在一个模型内同时实现可扩展、跨任务学习和支持多达10项任务,同时降低多领域应用的培训成本。代码将在https://github.com/1hunters/UniSTD上公布。

papers.title: Unified Multi-Agent Trajectory Modeling with Masked Trajectory Diffusion
papers.authors: songru Yang · Zhenwei Shi · Zhengxia Zou
papers.abstract: Understanding movements in multi-agent scenarios is a fundamental problem in intelligent systems. Previous research assumes complete and synchronized observations. However, real-world partial observation caused by occlusions leads to inevitable model failure, which demands a unified framework for coexisting trajectory prediction, imputation, and recovery. Unlike previous attempts that handled observed and unobserved behaviors in a coupled manner, we explore a decoupled denoising diffusion modeling paradigm with a unidirectional information valve to separate the interference from uncertain behaviors. Building on this, we proposed a Unified Masked Trajectory Diffusion model (UniMTD) for arbitrary levels of missing observations. We designed a unidirectional attention as a valve unit to control the direction of information flow between the observed and masked areas, gradually refining the missing observations toward a real-world distribution. We construct it into a unidirectional MoE structure to handle varying proportions of missing observations. A Cached Diffusion model is further designed to improve generation quality while reducing computation and time overhead. Our method has achieved a great leap across human motions and vehicle traffic. UniMTD efficiently achieves 65% improvement in minADE20 and reaches SOTA with advantages of 98%, 50%, 73%, and 29% across 4 fidelity metrics on out-of-boundary, velocity, and trajectory length. Our code will be released here.
papers.title_zh: 带有蒙面轨迹扩散的单一多源轨迹模型
papers.abstract_zh: 理解多试剂情景中的移动是智能系统的一个根本问题。 以前的研究假设了完整和同步的观测。 但是,由于隐蔽性造成的现实世界部分观测导致不可避免的模型失败,这要求有一个统一的框架来同时进行轨迹预测、估算和恢复。 与以往试图同时处理观察和未观察行为的尝试不同,我们探索了一种分解的分散模型模式,配有一个单向信息阀,以区分干扰与不确定行为的干扰。 在此基础上,我们提出了一个用于任意缺失观测的统一蒙面转移模型(UniMTD ) 。 我们设计了单向关注作为阀门单位,以控制被观察地区和蒙面地区之间的信息流动方向,逐步完善缺失的观测结果,使之走向真实世界分布。我们将其建成一个单向MOE结构,处理不同比例的缺失观测。一个散装扩散模型进一步设计,以提高生产质量,同时减少计算和时间管理。我们的方法跨越了人类运动和车辆交通的巨大飞跃。UNIMTD在分钟ADE20中有效地实现了65%的改进,到达SOTA, 优势为98%、50%、73%和29%,横跨边界、速度和轨迹长度的4个忠诚度指标。我们的代码将在这里发布。

papers.title: UNIALIGN: Scaling Multimodal Alignment within One Unified Model
papers.authors: Bo Zhou, Liulei Li, Yujia Wang, Huafeng Liu, Yazhou Yao, Wenguan Wang
papers.abstract: We present UNIALIGN, a unified model to align an arbitrary number of modalities ( text e.g. , image, text, audio, 3D point cloud, etc.) through one encoder and a single training phase. Existing solutions typically employ distinct encoders for each modality, resulting in increased parameters as the number of modalities grows. In contrast, UNIALIGN proposes a modality-aware adaptation of the powerful mixture-of-experts (MoE) schema and further integrates it with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), efficiently scaling the encoder to accommodate inputs in diverse modalities while maintaining a fixed computational overhead.Moreover, prior work often requires separate training for each extended modality. This leads to task-specific models and further hinders the communication between modalities.To address this, we propose a soft modality binding strategy that aligns all modalities using unpaired data samples across datasets. Two additional training objectives are introduced to distill knowledge from well-aligned anchor modalities and prior multimodal models, elevating UNIALIGN into a high performance multimodal foundation model.Experiments on 11 benchmarks across 6 different modalities demonstrate that UNIALIGN could achieve comparable performance to SOTA approaches, while using merely 7.8M trainable parameters and maintaining an identical model with the same weight across all tasks. Our code shall be released.
papers.title_zh: UNIALIGIN: 在统一模式内实现比例化多模式对齐
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出UNIALIGIN,这是一个统一的模式,通过一个编码器和一个单一的培训阶段,对任意模式(例如文字,如图像、文字、音频、3D点云等)加以统一。 现有解决办法通常为每种模式使用不同的编码器,随着模式数量的增加,参数增加。 与此相反,UNIALIGINT建议对强大的专家混合计划进行模式意识调整,并进一步将其与低Rank适应(LORA)相结合,高效率地扩大编码器,以适应不同模式的投入,同时保持固定的计算间接费用。 此外,以往的工作往往要求对每一种延长模式进行单独培训。 为此,我们提议采取软模式约束性战略,利用各数据集之间未受控制的数据样本调整所有模式。 引入了另外两个培训目标,以从一致的锚定模式和先前的多式联运模式中提取知识,将UNIALIGN提升为高性能的多式联运基础模式,对6种不同模式的11项基准的实验表明,UNIALIGIN可以达到与SOTA方法相似的绩效,同时仅使用7.8M培训参数,并在所有任务中保持同等份量的相同模式。 我们的代码将被发布。

papers.title: Tra-MoE: Learning Trajectory Prediction Model from Multiple Domains for Adaptive Policy Conditioning
papers.authors: Jiange Yang, Haoyi Zhu, Yating Wang, Gangshan Wu, Tong He, Limin Wang
papers.abstract: Learning from multiple domains is a primary factor that influences the generalization of a single unified robot system. In this paper, we aim to learn the trajectory prediction model by using broad out-of-domain data to improve its performance and generalization ability. Trajectory model is designed to predict any-point trajectories in the current frame given an instruction and can provide detailed control guidance for robotic policy learning. To handle the diverse out-of-domain data distribution, we propose a sparsely-gated MoE (Top-1 gating strategy) architecture for trajectory model, coined as Tra-MoE. The sparse activation design enables good balance between parameter cooperation and specialization, effectively benefiting from large-scale out-of-domain data while maintaining constant FLOPs per token. In addition, we further introduce an adaptive policy conditioning technique by learning 2D mask representations for predicted trajectories, which is explicitly aligned with image observations to guide action prediction more flexibly. We perform extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world scenarios to verify the effectiveness of Tra-MoE and adaptive policy conditioning technique. We also conduct a comprehensive empirical study to train Tra-MoE, demonstrating that our Tra-MoE consistently exhibits superior performance compared to the dense baseline model, even when the latter is scaled to match Tra-MoE's parameter count.
papers.title_zh: Tra-MoE:从适应政策条件的多域学习轨迹预测模型
papers.abstract_zh: 从多个领域学习是影响单一统一机器人系统一般化的一个主要因素。 在本文中, 我们的目标是通过使用广泛的外部数据来学习轨迹预测模型, 以提高其性能和一般化能力。 轨迹模型旨在预测当前框架中的任何点轨迹, 给予指示, 并为机器人政策学习提供详细的控制指导 。 为了处理多种外向数据分布, 我们建议为轨迹模型建立一个微小的 MOE( Top-1 Gateting 战略) 结构, 以 Tra- MoE 生成。 稀疏激活设计可以在参数合作和专业化之间实现良好的平衡, 有效地受益于大规模外向数据, 同时保持恒定的 FLOP 。 此外,我们还引入了适应性政策调节技术,对预测轨迹学习2D掩码表示,这与图像观测明确一致,以更灵活地指导行动预测。我们在模拟和现实情景上进行了广泛的实验,以核实Tra-MoE和适应性政策调节技术的有效性。我们还开展了一项全面的经验研究,以培训Tra-MoE,表明我们的Tra-MoE一贯表现出优于密集基线模型的性能,即使后者的尺寸与Tra-MoE的参数数相当。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Foundation Model for Zero-shot Amodal Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhaochen Liu, Limeng Qiao, Xiangxiang Chu, Lin Ma, Tingting Jiang
papers.abstract: Aiming to predict the complete shape of partially occluded objects, amodal segmentation is an important capacity towards visual intelligence. In order to promote the practicability, zero-shot foundation model competent for the open world gains growing attention in this field. Nevertheless, prior models exhibit deficiencies in efficiency and stability. To address this problem, utilizing the implicit prior knowledge, we propose the first SAM-based amodal segmentation foundation model, SAMBA. Methodologically, a novel framework with multilevel facilitation is designed to better adapt the task characteristics and unleash the potential capabilities of SAM. In the modality level, a separation-to-fusion structure is employed that jointly learns modal and amodal segmentation to enhance mutual coordination. In the instance level, to ease the complexity of amodal feature extraction, we introduce a principal focusing mechanism to indicate objects of interest. In the pixel level, mixture-of-experts is incorporated with a specialized distribution loss, by which distinct occlusion rates correspond to different experts to improve the accuracy. Experiments are conducted on several eminent datasets, and the results show that the performance of SAMBA is superior to existing zero-shot and even supervised approaches. Furthermore, our proposed model has notable advantages in terms of speed and size.
papers.title_zh: 实现 " 零拍零拍现代分割法 " 高效基础模型
papers.abstract_zh: 为了预测部分隐蔽物体的完整形状,对视觉情报来说,现代分解是一种重要的能力;为了促进实用性,对开放世界具有能力的零点基础模型在这一领域引起越来越多的注意;然而,以前的模型在效率和稳定性方面显示出缺陷;为了解决这一问题,我们利用隐含的先前知识,提议采用第一个以SAMM为基础的基于SAMMA模式分解基础模型,SAMBA。从方法上讲,设计了一个具有多层次便利的新框架,以更好地调整任务特点,释放SAM的潜在能力。在模式一级,采用了一个从分离到融合的结构,共同学习模式和模式分解,以加强相互的协调。 在实例层面,为了减轻现代特征提取的复杂性,我们引入了一种主要重点机制,以表明感兴趣的对象。在像素层面,专家混合与专门分布损失相结合,不同的隔离率与不同专家相对应,以提高准确性。在几个知名数据集上进行了实验,结果显示SAMBA的性能优于现有的零弹射甚至受监督的方法。此外,我们提议的模型在速度和规模上都具有显著的优势。

papers.title: The Human Brain as a Dynamic Mixture of Expert Models in Video Understanding
papers.authors: Christina Sartzetaki, Anne Zonneveld, Pablo Oyarzo, Alessandro T. Gifford, Radoslaw Martin Cichy, Pascal Mettes, Iris I. A. Groen
papers.abstract: A bstract The human brain is the most efficient and versatile system for processing dynamic visual input. By comparing representations from deep video models to brain activity, we can gain insights into mechanistic solutions for effective video processing, important to better understand the brain and to build better models. Current works in model-brain alignment primarily focus on fMRI measurements, leaving open questions about fine-grained dynamic processing. Here, we introduce the first large-scale model benchmarking on alignment to dynamic electroencephalography (EEG) recordings of short natural videos. We analyze 100+ models across the axes of temporal integration, classification task, architecture, and pretraining, using our proposed Cross-Temporal Representational Similarity Analysis (CT-RSA) which matches the best time-unfolded model features to dynamically evolving brain responses, distilling 10 7 alignment scores. Our findings reveal novel insights on how continuous visual input is integrated in the brain, beyond the standard temporal processing hierarchy from low to high-level representations. After initial alignment to hierarchical static object processing, responses in posterior electrodes best align to mid-level temporally-integrative action features, showing high temporal correspondence to feature timings. In contrast, responses in frontal electrodes best align with high-level static action representations and show no temporal correspondence to the video. Additionally, temporally-integrating state-space models show superior alignment to intermediate posterior activity, in which self-supervised pretraining is also beneficial. We draw a metaphor to a dynamic mixture of expert models for the changing neural preference in tasks and temporal integration reflected in the alignment to different model types across time. We posit that a single best-aligned model would need such training and architecture as to allow combining and dynamically switching between these capacities.
papers.title_zh: 人脑作为视频理解专家模型的动态混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 人类大脑是处理动态视觉输入的最有效率和最多功能的系统。通过比较深层视频模型和大脑活动的表现,我们可以深入了解有效视频处理的机械解决方案,这对于更好地了解大脑和构建更好的模型十分重要。目前模型-脑调整工作主要侧重于FMRI测量,留下关于细微感应动态处理的开放问题。在这里,我们引入了第一个大型模型基准,用于与动态电脑造影(EEEG)短短自然视频记录相匹配。 我们分析了跨时间整合、分类任务、架构和预培训等轴线的100+模型,我们使用我们提议的跨时代表相似性分析(CT-RSA),该分析将最佳的时空无边模型特征与动态演变的大脑反应相匹配,提炼了10 7个对齐分。我们的调查结果揭示了大脑中连续视觉输入如何融合的新见解,超越了从低到高层次的标准时间处理等级结构。在初步与等级静态物体处理接轨之后,后后后,后电极的反应最符合中层时间整合动作特征,显示与特征时间的高度时间对应。 相比之下,前电极的反应最符合高层次静态动作表示,也没有显示与视频的时间对应性。 此外,时间上整合的州空间模型显示与中间后方活动高度一致,在中间后方活动中,自我监督的预培训也是有益的。 我们用专家模型的动态组合进行隐喻,以适应任务中不断变化的神经偏好和时间整合,这反映在与不同类型模型的对齐上。 我们假设,一个单一的最佳匹配模型需要这样的培训和结构,以便能够在这些能力之间进行整合和动态转换。

papers.title: Temporal-Guided Mixture-of-Experts for Zero-Shot Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Yixin Qin, Lei Zhao, Lianli Gao, Haonan Zhang, Pengpeng Zeng, Heng Tao Shen
papers.abstract: Video Question Answering (VideoQA) is a challenging task in the vision-language field. Due to the time-consuming and labor-intensive labeling process of the question-answer pairs, fully supervised methods are no longer suitable for the current increasing demand for data. This has led to the rise of zero-shot VideoQA, and some works propose to adapt large language models (LLMs) to assist zero-shot learning. Despite recent progress, the inadequacy of LLMs in comprehending temporal information in videos and the neglect of temporal differences, e.g., the different dynamic changes between scenes or objects, remain insufficiently addressed by existing attempts in zero-shot VideoQA. In light of these challenges, a novel Temporal-guided Mixture-of-Experts Network (T-MoENet) for zero-shot video question answering is proposed in this paper. Specifically, we apply a temporal module to imbue language models with the capacity to perceive temporal information. Then a temporal-guided mixture-of-experts module is proposed to further learn the temporal differences presented in different videos. It enables the model to effectively improve the capacity of generalization. Our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple zero-shot VideoQA benchmarks, notably improving accuracy by 5.6% on TGIF-FrameQA and 2.3% on MSRVTT-QA while remaining competitive with other methods in the fully supervised setting. The codes and models developed in this study will be made publicly available at <uri xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">https://github.com/qyx1121/T-MoENet</uri>.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
papers.title_zh: 零热视频解答问题实时指导专家混合混合
papers.abstract_zh: 视频问答(VideoQA)是视觉语言领域的一项艰巨任务。由于问答对口的标签过程耗时费力,因此,完全监督的方法不再适合当前日益增长的数据需求。这导致了零弹视频QA的上升,有些作品提议调整大型语言模型(LLMS)以帮助零弹学习。尽管最近取得了进展,但LLMs对视频中时间信息的理解不够,忽视时间差异,例如场景或对象之间的不同动态变化,在零弹视频QA中的现有尝试仍未充分解决。 鉴于这些挑战,本文提议为零弹式视频问答建立一个新型的T-MoENet(T-MoENet)时间-制导探索者混合网络(T-MoENet) 。 具体地说,我们应用一个时间模块,使语言模型具备感知时间信息的能力。然后建议一个时间制专家混合模块,以进一步学习不同视频中的时间差异。它使模型能够有效地提高一般化能力。我们建议的方法在多个零光视频QA基准上达到最先进的性能,显著提高了TGIF-FrameQA的精确度5.6%和MSRVTT-QA的2.3%,同时在充分监督的环境下与其他方法保持竞争。本研究开发的代码和模型将在<uri xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink>https://github.com/qyx111/T-MoENet</uri>上公布。

papers.title: Stretching Each Dollar: Diffusion Training from Scratch on a Micro-Budget
papers.authors: Vikash Sehwag, Xianghao Kong, Jingtao Li, Michael Spranger, Lingjuan Lyu
papers.abstract: As scaling laws in generative AI push performance, they simultaneously concentrate the development of these models among actors with large computational resources. With a focus on text-to-image (T2I) generative models, we aim to unlock this bottleneck by demonstrating very low-cost training of large-scale T2I diffusion transformer models. As the computational cost of transformers increases with the number of patches in each image, we propose randomly masking up to 75% of the image patches during training. We propose a deferred masking strategy that preprocesses all patches using a patch-mixer before masking, thus significantly reducing the performance degradation with masking, making it superior to model downscaling in reducing computational cost. We also incorporate the latest improvements in transformer architecture, such as the use of mixture-of-experts layers, to improve performance and further identify the critical benefit of using synthetic images in micro-budget training. Finally, using only 37M publicly available real and synthetic images, we train a 1.16 billion parameter sparse transformer with only 1,890 USD economical cost and achieve a 12.7 FID in zero-shot generation on the COCO dataset. Notably, our model achieves competitive performance across both automated and human-centric evaluations, as well as high-quality generations, while incurring 118xlower costs than Stable Diffusion models and 14xlower costs than the current state-of-the-art approach, which costs 28,400. We also further investigate the influence of synthetic images on performance and demonstrate that micro-budget training on only synthetic images is sufficient for achieving high-quality data generation. Our end-to-end training pipeline and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/SonyResearch/micro_diffusion.
papers.title_zh: 将每一美元拉伸:微预算从Scratch向Scratch的传播培训
papers.abstract_zh: 作为在创新的AI推动业绩方面扩大法律规模,它们同时将开发这些模型的重点放在拥有大量计算资源的行为者之间。 以文字到图像(T2I)的基因化模型为重点,我们的目标是通过展示对大型T2I扩散变压器模型的低成本培训来解开这一瓶颈。 随着变压器的计算成本随着每张图像中的补丁数量而增加,我们提议在培训期间随机遮盖高达75%的图像补丁。 我们提议一项推迟的遮罩战略,在遮罩前先使用补丁混合器处理所有补丁,从而显著减少遮罩的性能退化,使其优于降低计算成本的模型降尺度。 我们还纳入了变压器结构的最新改进,例如使用专家混合层,以改进业绩,并进一步确定在微观预算培训中使用合成图像的重要好处。 最后,我们仅使用公开提供的37M真实和合成图像,用1 890美元的经济成本培训了11.6亿个参数稀释变压器,并在COCO数据集上实现了12.7个零速生成的FID。 值得注意的是,我们的模型在自动化评价和以人为中心的评价以及高素质的一代人之间都取得了竞争性业绩,而比稳定传播模式成本低118x倍,比目前最先进的方法成本低14x倍,后者成本为28 400美元。 我们还进一步调查合成图像对性能的影响,并表明仅对合成图像进行微观预算培训足以实现高质量数据生成。 我们的端对端培训管道和示范检查站可在https://github.com/SonyResearch/micro_difulation上查阅。

papers.title: SPMTrack: Spatio-Temporal Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Mixture of Experts for Scalable Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Wenrui Cai, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang
papers.abstract: Most state-of-the-art trackers adopt one-stream paradigm, using a single Vision Transformer for joint feature extraction and relation modeling of template and search region images. However, relation modeling between different image patches exhibits significant variations. For instance, background regions dominated by target-irrelevant information require reduced attention allocation, while foreground, particularly boundary areas, need to be be emphasized. A single model may not effectively handle all kinds of relation modeling simultaneously. In this paper, we propose a novel tracker called SPMTrack based on mixture-of-experts tailored for visual tracking task (TMoE), combining the capability of multiple experts to handle diverse relation modeling more flexibly. Benefiting from TMoE, we extend relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context, further improving tracking accuracy with minimal increase in model parameters. Moreover, we employ TMoE as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, substantially reducing trainable parameters, which enables us to train SPMTrack of varying scales efficiently and preserve the generalization ability of pretrained models to achieve superior performance. We conduct experiments on seven datasets, and experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. The source code is available at https://github.com/WenRuiCai/SPMTrack.
papers.title_zh: SPMTrack: 与可缩放视觉跟踪专家混合进行SPMTRK: SPATIO-TTP-时时参数-高效精密授精
papers.abstract_zh: 多数最先进的跟踪者采用一流模式,使用单一的Vision Transformer对模板和搜索区域图像进行联合特征提取和关系模型模拟。然而,不同图像补丁之间的关系模型存在重大差异。例如,以目标不相关信息为主的背景区域需要减少关注分配,而需要强调前景区域,特别是边境地区。单一模型可能无法同时有效处理所有类型的关系模型。在本文中,我们提议使用一种新型跟踪器,称为SPMTTrac, 其基础是专门为视觉跟踪任务设计的专家混合(TMoE),将多个专家更灵活地处理不同关系模型的能力结合起来。 从TMoE中受益,我们扩展了从图像配对到时空环境的关系模型,进一步提高了跟踪准确性,模型参数的增幅最小。此外,我们使用TMoE作为一种具有参数效率的微调方法,大大减少了可培训参数,从而使我们能够高效地培训不同规模的SPMTRack,并保持预先培训模型的普及能力,以取得优异的性能。我们在7个数据集上进行实验,实验结果显示,我们的方法大大优于目前最先进的跟踪者。源代码见https://github.com/WenRuiCai/SPMTrack。

papers.title: Soft-Masked Mixture of Experts for Point-Cloud Denoising
papers.authors: Jian Liu, Yanli Yang, Mingwu Ren
papers.abstract: With LiDAR increasingly used in autonomous driving and robotics, robust point-cloud denoising is essential for accurate 3D understanding. Yet mainstream score- and flowbased frameworks still struggle to balance structure preservation and noise suppression on highly non-uniform or reflective surfaces. We propose a lightweight, generic residual-head plugin that strengthens common denoisers via (i) adaptive residual control and (ii) selective expert fusion: a soft residual mask attenuates uncertain updates, and a two-expert MoE with a scalar gate plus mild balance regularizer blends detail-preserving and smoothing behaviors. The head is backbone-agnostic by design, requiring only per-point features and a residual/score output. We instantiate it on PD-LTS and add a minimal cross-backbone check showing gains on PD-Flow and IterativePFN. On PUNet, test EMD improves from 0.038 to 0.006 under matched training. Ablations and multi-seed statistics indicate the mask stabilizes early training while the gate improves the bias-variance tradeoff, supporting the method's stability, interpretability, and plug-and-play generalization.
papers.title_zh: 点环低温专家软模软混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 随着LiDAR越来越多地用于自主驾驶和机器人,强大的点球拆卸对于准确的三维理解至关重要。然而主流分数和流动框架仍然在努力平衡高度非统一或反射表面的结构维护和噪音抑制。我们提议了一个轻量级、通用的残余头插件,通过(一) 适应性残余控制,和(二) 选择性专家聚合:软残余面罩可以降低不确定的更新,以及双专家模件,配有螺旋门,加上微量平衡调节器的组合细节保存和平滑行为。头在设计上具有骨干性,只需要每个点的特征和残余/核心输出。我们将其立即放在PD-LTS上,并添加一个显示PD-Flow和IterativePFN收益的最小交叉骨检查。 在PUNet上,测试EMD在匹配的培训下从0.038提高到0.006。 减法和多种子统计数据显示,面具稳定了早期培训,而大门则改善了偏差权衡,支持了该方法的稳定性、可解释性以及插头和玩耍的概括化。 在PUNet上,测试EMD的EMD在培训匹配下从0.038提高到0.006。 减法和多种子统计数据显示,面具稳定了早期培训,而大门则改善了偏差权衡,支持了该方法的稳定性、可解释性以及插头和玩耍的概括化。

papers.title: Smart CSWin-UNet: Integrating prototype attention gate and mixture-of-experts skip connections for medical image segmentation
papers.authors: Chuanbo Feng, Xuebao Lu, Jing Qin, Daoqiang Zhang, Xiaoke Hao
papers.title_zh: Smart CSWin-UNet: 整合原型关注门和专家混合连接的医学图像分割连接

papers.title: RS-MoE: A Vision–Language Model With Mixture of Experts for Remote Sensing Image Captioning and Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Hui Lin, Danfeng Hong, Shaodi Ge, Chuyao Luo, Kai Jiang, Hao Jin, Congcong Wen
papers.abstract: Remote sensing image captioning (RSIC) presents unique challenges and plays a critical role in applications such as environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management. Traditional RSIC methods often struggle to produce rich and diverse descriptions. Recently, with significant advancements in vision-language models (VLMs), efforts have emerged to integrate these models into the remote sensing domain and to introduce richly descriptive datasets specifically designed to enhance VLM training. However, most current RSIC models generally apply only fine-tuning to these datasets without developing models tailored to the unique characteristics of remote sensing imagery. This article proposes RS-MoE, the first mixture of expert (MoE)-based VLM specifically customized for remote sensing domain. Unlike traditional MoE models, the core of RS-MoE is the MoE block, which incorporates a novel instruction router and multiple lightweight large language models (LLMs) as expert models. The instruction router is designed to generate specific prompts tailored for each corresponding LLM, guiding them to focus on distinct aspects of the RSIC task. This design not only allows each expert LLM to concentrate on a specific subset of the task, thereby enhancing the specificity and accuracy of the generated captions, but also improves the scalability of the model by facilitating parallel processing of subtasks. In addition, we present a two-stage training strategy for tuning our RS-MoE model to prevent performance degradation due to sparsity. We fine-tuned our model on the RSICap dataset using our proposed training strategy. Experimental results on the RSICap dataset, along with evaluations on other traditional datasets where no additional fine-tuning was applied, demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating precise and contextually relevant captions. Notably, our RS-MoE-1B variant achieves performance comparable to 13B VLMs, demonstrating the efficiency of our model design. Moreover, our model demonstrates promising generalization capabilities by consistently achieving state-of-the-art performance on the remote sensing visual question answering (RSVQA) task.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
papers.title_zh: RS-MOE:与遥感图像描述和视觉问题解答专家混合的视觉-语言模型
papers.abstract_zh: 遥感图像字幕(RSIC)是独特的挑战,在环境监测、城市规划和灾害管理等应用中发挥着关键作用,传统的RSIC方法往往难以产生丰富多样的描述,最近,随着视觉语言模型(VLM)的显著进步,人们开始努力将这些模型纳入遥感领域,并引进大量专为增强VLM培训而设计的描述数据集,然而,大多数目前的RSIC模型一般只对这些数据集进行微调,而没有开发适合遥感图像独特特点的模型。 与传统的MoE模型不同,RS-MOE的核心是MoE的单元,其中包括一个新的教学路由器和多种轻量级大语言模型(LLMS)作为专家模型。教学路由器的设计是为了产生针对每个相应的LLM的具体提示,指导它们注重RSIC任务的不同方面。这一设计不仅使每个专家LLM能够集中从事具体的任务,从而增强所产生说明的特性和准确性,而且通过促进子任务平行处理,提高模型的可扩展性。此外,我们提出了一个两阶段培训战略,以调整我们的RS-MOE模型,防止由于松散而造成性能退化。我们利用拟议的培训战略对RSICap数据集模型进行了调整。 RSICap数据集的实验结果,加上对其他传统数据集的评价,没有进行额外的微调,都表明我们的模型在制作精确和符合背景的字幕方面达到了最先进的性能,值得注意的是,我们的RS-MOE-1B变量的性能相当于13BVLM,显示了我们模型设计的效率。此外,我们的模型通过在遥感直观回答(RSVQA)任务上不断实现最先进的性能,显示了有希望的概括性能力。

papers.title: Robustifying Routers Against Input Perturbations for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Masahiro Kada, Ryota Yoshihashi, Satoshi Ikehata, Rei Kawakami, Ikuro Sato
papers.abstract: Mixture of experts with a sparse expert selection rule has been gaining much attention recently because of its scalability without compromising inference time. However, unlike standard neural networks, sparse mixture-of-experts models inherently exhibit discontinuities in the output space, which may impede the acquisition of appropriate invariance to the input perturbations, leading to a deterioration of model performance for tasks such as classification. To address this issue, we propose Pairwise Router Consistency (PRC) that effectively penalizes the discontinuities occurring under natural deformations of input images. With the supervised loss, the use of PRC loss empirically improves classification accuracy on ImageNet-1 K, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 datasets, compared to a baseline method. Notably, our method with 1-expert selection slightly outperforms the baseline method using 2-expert selection. We also confirmed that models trained with our method experience discontinuous changes less frequently under input perturbations.
papers.venue: IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing
papers.title_zh: 为专家的视觉Transformer提供强大的路由器,防止专家的浅状混集物投入扰动
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,专家与专家甄选规则稀少的专家混合,因其可伸缩性而不损害推论时间,引起了人们的极大注意,然而,与标准的神经网络不同,分散的专家混合模型在产出空间本身就表现出不连续,这可能会妨碍对输入干扰的适当变化,导致诸如分类等任务的模型性能恶化。为了解决这一问题,我们提议对输入图像的自然变形所造成的不连续行为给予有效惩罚,但与基线方法相比,利用PRC损失实际提高了图像Net-1K、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集的分类准确性。 值得注意的是,我们采用1名专家选择的方法略优于使用2名专家选择的基线方法。 我们还确认,接受过我们方法培训的模型在输入干扰下经历不连续变化的情况较少。

papers.title: Resilient Sensor Fusion Under Adverse Sensor Failures via Multi-Modal Expert Fusion
papers.authors: Konyul Park, Yecheol Kim, Daehun Kim, Jun Won Choi
papers.abstract: Modern autonomous driving perception systems utilize complementary multi-modal sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras. Although sensor fusion architectures enhance performance in challenging environments, they still suffer significant performance drops under severe sensor failures, such as LiDAR beam reduction, LiDAR drop, limited field of view, camera drop, and occlusion. This limitation stems from inter-modality dependencies in current sensor fusion frameworks. In this study, we introduce an efficient and robust LiDAR-camera 3D object detector, referred to as MoME, which can achieve robust performance through a mixture of experts approach. Our MoME fully decouples modality dependencies using three parallel expert decoders, which use camera features, LiDAR features, or a combination of both to decode object queries, respectively. We propose Multi-Expert Decoding (MED) framework, where each query is decoded selectively using one of three expert decoders. MoME utilizes an Adaptive Query Router (AQR) to select the most appropriate expert decoder for each query based on the quality of camera and LiDAR features. This ensures that each query is processed by the best-suited expert, resulting in robust performance across diverse sensor failure scenarios. We evaluated the performance of MoME on the nuScenes-R benchmark. Our MoME achieved state-of-the-art performance in extreme weather and sensor failure conditions, significantly outperforming the existing models across various sensor failure scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 通过多模式专家融合,在反感感应器故障下,通过多模式专家融合,具有弹性感感应器融合
