papers.authors: Zador Pataki, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Johannes L. Schönberger, Marc Pollefeys
papers.abstract: While Structure-from-Motion (SfM) has seen much progress over the years, state-of-the-art systems are prone to failure when facing extreme viewpoint changes in low-overlap, low-parallax or high-symmetry scenarios. Because capturing images that avoid these pitfalls is challenging, this severely limits the wider use of SfM, especially by non-expert users. We overcome these limitations by augmenting the classical SfM paradigm with monocular depth and normal priors inferred by deep neural networks. Thanks to a tight integration of monocular and multi-view constraints, our approach significantly outperforms existing ones under extreme viewpoint changes, while maintaining strong performance in standard conditions. We also show that monocular priors can help reject faulty associations due to symmetries, which is a long-standing problem for SfM. This makes our approach the first capable of reliably reconstructing challenging indoor environments from few images. Through principled uncertainty propagation, it is robust to errors in the priors, can handle priors inferred by different models with little tuning, and will thus easily benefit from future progress in monocular depth and normal estimation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/mpsfm.
papers.title_zh: MP-SfM:强力结构-调出运动的单表表面前置
papers.abstract_zh: 多年来,结构-从运动(SfM)取得了很大进展,但当面临低重叠、低平行或高对称情景的极端观点变化时,最先进的系统容易失败。 由于捕捉避免这些陷阱的图像具有挑战性,这严重限制了SfM的更广泛使用,特别是非专家用户的使用。 我们克服了这些限制,以单眼深度和由深层神经网络推断的正常前科来强化传统SfM模式。 由于单眼和多视角制约的紧密结合,我们的方法在极端观点变化的情况下大大优于现有方法,同时在标准条件下保持强劲的业绩。 我们还表明,单眼前科可以帮助拒绝因对称而形成的错误协会,这对SfM来说是一个长期存在的问题。 这使得我们的方法成为第一个能够从少数图像中可靠地重建具有挑战性的室内环境的方法。 通过传播有原则的不确定性,它强于前题错误,可以处理不同模型的前科,但微调不多,因此很容易从单眼深度和正常估计的未来进展中受益。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/cvg/mpsfm上公开查阅。

papers.title: MotionBench: Benchmarking and Improving Fine-grained Video Motion Understanding for Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Wenyi Hong, Yean Cheng, Zhuoyi Yang, Weihan Wang, Lefan Wang, Xiaotao Gu, Shiyu Huang, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.abstract: In the quest for artificial general intelligence, Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a focal point in recent advancements. However, the predominant focus remains on developing their capabilities in static image understanding. The potential of MLLMs in processing sequential visual data is still insufficiently explored, highlighting the absence of a comprehensive, high-quality assessment of their performance. In this paper, we introduce Video-MME, the first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis. Our work distinguishes from existing benchmarks through four key features: 1) Diversity in video types, spanning 6 primary visual domains with 30 subfields to ensure broad scenario generalizability; 2) Duration in temporal dimension, encompassing both short-, medium-, and long-term videos, ranging from 11 seconds to 1 hour, for robust contextual dynamics; 3) Breadth in data modalities, integrating multi-modal inputs besides video frames, including sub- titles and audios, to unveil the all-round capabilities of MLLMs; 4) Quality in annotations, utilizing rigorous manual labeling by expert annotators to facilitate precise and reliable model assessment. 900 videos with a total of 254 hours are manually selected and annotated by repeatedly viewing all the video content, resulting in 2,700 question-answer pairs. With Video-MME, we extensively evaluate various state-of-the-art MLLMs, including GPT-4 series and Gemini 1.5 Pro, as well as open-source image models like InternVL-Chat-V1.5 and video models like LLaVA-NeXT-Video. Our experiments reveal that Gemini 1.5 Pro is the best-performing commercial model, significantly outperforming the open-source models with an average accuracy of 75%, compared to 71.9% for GPT-4o. The results also demonstrate that Video-MME is a universal benchmark, which applies to both image and video MLLMs. Further analysis indicates that subtitle and audio information could significantly enhance video understanding. Besides, a decline in MLLM performance is observed as video duration increases for all models. Our dataset along with these findings underscores the need for further improvements in handling longer sequences and multi-modal data, shedding light on future MLLM development. Project page: https://video-mme.github.io.
papers.title_zh: 动议时间:为视觉语言模式设定基准和改进精制视频动议的视频动议理解
papers.abstract_zh: 在寻求人造一般情报的过程中,多式大语言模型(MLLM)已成为最近进展的协调中心,但主要重点仍然是发展他们了解静态图像的能力。 MLLMS在处理连续视觉数据方面的潜力仍未得到充分探索,突出显示没有对其业绩进行全面、高质量的评估。 在本文中,我们介绍视频MME,这是有史以来第一个全光谱、多模式评价基准,即视频分析中MLLMs的MV-MME。 我们的工作通过四个关键特征与现有基准有区别:(1) 视频类型的多样性,涵盖6个主要视觉领域,有30个子领域,以确保广泛的情景可概括性;(2) 时间层面,包括短、中、长期视频,从11秒到1小时,以保持稳健的背景动态;(3) 数据模式的粗体,将视频框架以外的多模式投入,包括副标题和音频,整合为多模式投入,以展示MLLMs的全方位能力;(4) 说明质量,利用专家说明员的严格手工标签,促进准确和可靠的模型评估。 总共254小时的900个视频由手工选择,通过反复观看所有视频内容附加说明,结果产生了2 700对问答。 我们利用MME视频,广泛评价各种最新的MLLMs,包括GPT-4系列和Gemini 1.5 Pro,以及InternVL-Chat-V1.5等开放源图像模型和LalaVA-NeXT-Video等视频模型。 我们的实验显示,Gemini 1.5 Pro是最佳商业模型,明显优于开放源码模型,平均精确度为75%,而GPT-4o为71.9 % 。 实验结果还表明,视频MME是一个通用基准,适用于图像和视频MLLMS。 进一步的分析表明,字幕和音频信息可大大增进视频理解,此外,随着所有模型的视频持续时间增加,LLM的性能也有所下降。 我们的数据集连同这些调查结果突出表明,在处理较长序列和多模式数据方面需要进一步改进,说明未来的MLLM开发情况,项目网页:https://vieva-mme.github.io。

papers.title: MoEE: Mixture of Emotion Experts for Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
papers.authors: Huaize Liu, Wenzhang Sun, Donglin Di, Shibo Sun, Jiahui Yang, Changqing Zou, Hujun Bao
papers.abstract: The generation of talking avatars has achieved significant advancements in precise audio synchronization. However, crafting lifelike talking head videos requires capturing a broad spectrum of emotions and subtle facial expressions. Current methods face fundamental challenges: a) the absence of frameworks for modeling single basic emotional expressions, which restricts the generation of complex emotions such as compound emotions; b) the lack of comprehensive datasets rich in human emotional expressions, which limits the potential of models. To address these challenges, we propose the following innovations: 1) the Mixture of Emotion Experts (MoEE) model, which decouples six fundamental emotions to enable the precise synthesis of both singular and compound emotional states; 2) the DH-FaceEmoVid-150 dataset, specifically curated to include six prevalent human emotional expressions as well as four types of compound emotions, thereby expanding the training potential of emotion-driven models; 3) an emotion-to-latents module that leverages multimodal inputs, aligning diverse control signals--such as audio, text, and labels--to enhance audio-driven emotion control. Through extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations, we demonstrate that the MoEE framework, in conjunction with the DH-FaceEmoVid-150 dataset, excels in generating complex emotional expressions and nuanced facial details, setting a new benchmark in the field. These datasets will be publicly released.
papers.title_zh: MoEE: 情感专家为音频驱动动动画动画而混合的情感专家
papers.abstract_zh: 在准确的音频同步方面,一代有声的阿凡达人已经取得了显著进步。 然而,制作像生命一样的有声头视频需要捕捉广泛的情感和微妙的面部表情。 目前的方法面临基本挑战:(a) 缺乏单一基本情感表达方式模型框架,限制了复合情感等复杂情感的产生;(b) 缺乏丰富人类情感表达方式的综合数据集,限制了模型的潜力。 为了应对这些挑战,我们建议以下创新:(1) 情感专家混合模型,它将六种基本情感分离出来,以便能够精确地综合单一和复合情感状态;(2) DH-FaceEmoVid-150数据集,专门设计包括六种普遍的人类情感表达以及四种类型的复合情感,从而扩大情感驱动模式的培训潜力;(3) 情感对语言模块,利用多式联运投入,调和多种控制信号,如音频、文字和标签,以加强音频驱动情感控制。 通过广泛的定量和定性评估,我们证明MoE框架与DH-FaceEmoVid-150数据集一起,在产生复杂的情感表达方式和细微面部细节、制定实地新基准方面十分出色。 这些数据集将公开发布。

papers.title: MoDE: Mixture of Diffusion Experts for Any Occluded Face Recognition
papers.authors: Qiannan Fan, Zhuoyang Li, Jitong Li, Chenyang Cao
papers.abstract: With the continuous impact of epidemics, people have become accustomed to wearing masks. However, most current occluded face recognition (OFR) algorithms lack prior knowledge of occlusions, resulting in poor performance when dealing with occluded faces of varying types and severity in reality. Recognizing occluded faces is still a significant challenge, which greatly affects the convenience of people's daily lives. In this paper, we propose an identity-gated mixture of diffusion experts (MoDE) for OFR. Each diffusion-based generative expert estimates one possible complete image for occluded faces. Considering the random sampling process of the diffusion model, which introduces inevitable differences and variations between the inpainted faces and the real ones. To ensemble effective information from multi-reconstructed faces, we introduce an identity-gating network to evaluate the contribution of each reconstructed face to the identity and adaptively integrate the predictions in the decision space. Moreover, our MoDE is a plug-and-play module for most existing face recognition models. Extensive experiments on three public face datasets and two datasets in the wild validate our advanced performance for various occlusions in comparison with the competing methods.
papers.title_zh: DE: 任何隐蔽面部识别的传播专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 随着流行病的持续影响,人们已经习惯了戴面具,然而,大多数目前隐蔽的面部识别算法(OFR)缺乏先前的隔离知识,导致在处理现实中不同类型和严重程度的隐蔽面孔时表现不佳。 认识到隐蔽的面孔仍是一项重大挑战,严重影响人们日常生活的方便性,在本文中,我们提议为OFR提供一种身份化的传播专家混合体(MoDE)。每个基于传播的遗传学专家都估计出一种可能的隐蔽面孔完整图像。 考虑到扩散模型的随机抽样过程,该过程在面部和真实面部之间带来不可避免的差异和差异。 为了从多层重建的面孔中获得一整套有效信息,我们引入了身份定位网络,以评价每个重建后的面孔对身份认同的贡献,并适应性地将预测纳入决策空间。 此外,我们的MoE是大多数现有面部识别模型的插座和游戏模块。 野外三套公共面部数据集和两套数据集的广泛实验验证了与竞争方法相比我们各种排斥的先进性能。

papers.title: MMVU: Measuring Expert-Level Multi-Discipline Video Understanding
papers.authors: Yilun Zhao, Haowei Zhang, Lujing Xie, Tongyan Hu, Guo Gan, Yitao Long, Zhiyuan Hu, Weiyuan Chen, Chuhan Li, Zhijian Xu, Chengye Wang, Ziyao Shangguan, Zhenwen Liang, Yixin Liu, Chen Zhao, Arman Cohan
papers.abstract: We introduce MMVU, a comprehensive expert-level, multi-discipline benchmark for evaluating foundation models in video understanding. MMVU includes 3,000 expert-annotated questions spanning 27 subjects across four core disciplines: Science, Healthcare, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Engineering. Compared to prior benchmarks, MMVU features three key advancements. First, it challenges models to apply domain-specific knowledge and perform expert-level reasoning to analyze specialized-domain videos, moving beyond the basic visual perception typically assessed in current video benchmarks. Second, each example is annotated by human experts from scratch. We implement strict data quality controls to ensure the high quality of the dataset. Finally, each example is enriched with expert-annotated reasoning rationals and relevant domain knowledge, facilitating in-depth analysis. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 36 frontier multimodal foundation models on MMVU. The latest System-2-capable models, o1 and Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking, achieve the highest performance among the tested models. However, they still fall short of matching human expertise. Through in-depth error analyses and case studies, we offer actionable insights for future advancements in expert-level, knowledge-intensive video understanding for specialized domains.
papers.title_zh: MMVU: 计量专家级多媒体视频理解
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入MMVU,这是评估视频理解基础模型的全面的专家、多纪律基准,包括3 000个专家附加说明的问题,涉及四个核心学科的27个学科:科学、保健、人文和社会科学以及工程。 与以往的基准相比,MVVU有三个主要进展:第一,它挑战采用具体领域知识的模式,并在专家一级进行推理,分析专业领域视频,超越目前视频基准中通常评估的基本视觉观念。 第二,由人类专家从头开始对每个例子加以说明,我们实行严格的数据质量控制,以确保数据集的高质量,最后,每个例子都以专家附加说明的推理理性和相关领域知识加以充实,便于深入分析。 我们对MMVU的36个前沿多式联运基础模型进行了广泛评估,最新的System-2能力模型(O1和Gemini 2.0闪电思维模型)在经过测试的模型中取得了最高绩效,但是,它们仍然没有达到与人的专门知识相匹配的水平。 通过深入的错误分析和案例研究,我们为今后在专业领域专家级知识密集型视频理解方面取得进展,提供了可操作的洞察力。

papers.title: Mixture of Submodules for Domain Adaptive Person Search
papers.authors: Minsu Kim, Seungryong Kim, Kwanghoon Sohn
papers.abstract: Existing technique on domain adaptive person search commonly utilizes the unified framework for jointly localizing and identifying the person across domains. This framework, however, inevitably results in the gradient conflict problem, particularly in cross-domain scenarios with contradictory objectives, as the unified framework employs shared parameters to simultaneously address person detection and re-identification tasks across the domains. To overcome this, we present a novel mixture of submodules framework, dubbed MoS, that dynamically modulates the combination of submodules depending on the specific task to perform person detection and re-identification, separately. We further design the mixtures of submodules that vary depending on the domain, enabling domain-specific knowledge transfer. Especially, we decompose the main model into several submodules and employ diverse mixtures of submodules that vary depending on the tasks and domains through the conditional routing policy. In addition, we also present counterpart domain sample generation that synthesizes the augmented sample and uses them to learn domain invariant representation for person re-identification through the contrastive domain alignment. We conduct experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our MoS over the existing domain adaptive person search method and provide ablation studies.
papers.title_zh: 域适应人员搜索子模块混合
papers.abstract_zh: 现有领域适应人员搜索技术通常使用统一框架,共同确定和确定跨领域的人员。 然而,这一框架不可避免地导致梯度冲突问题,特别是在目标相互矛盾的跨领域情景中,因为统一框架使用共同参数,同时处理各领域的人员发现和重新识别任务。 为了克服这一点,我们提出了一种新颖的子模块框架组合,称为MOS,这种组合动态调节子模块的组合,这取决于分别进行个人检测和重新识别的具体任务。 我们进一步设计因域而异的子模块混合物,使特定领域的知识转让成为可能。 特别是,我们将主要模型分解成几个子模块,并采用因任务和领域而异的不同组合子模块,这些组合通过有条件的路线政策因任务和领域而异。 此外,我们还提供对应的域抽样数据,综合扩大的抽样数据,并利用这些数据学习域内无变动的表示法,通过对比性域对齐,重新确定人的身份。 我们进行实验,以证明我们部在现有适应性人员搜索方法领域的效力,并提供通奸研究。

papers.title: Mixture of Global and Local Experts with Diffusion Transformer for Controllable Face Generation
papers.authors: Xuechao Zou, Shun Zhang, Xing Fu, Yue Li, Kai Li, Yushe Cao, Congyan Lang, Pin Tao, Junliang Xing
papers.abstract: Controllable face generation poses critical challenges in generative modeling due to the intricate balance required between semantic controllability and photorealism. While existing approaches struggle with disentangling semantic controls from generation pipelines, we revisit the architectural potential of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) through the lens of expert specialization. This paper introduces Face-MoGLE, a novel framework featuring: (1) Semantic-decoupled latent modeling through mask-conditioned space factorization, enabling precise attribute manipulation; (2) A mixture of global and local experts that captures holistic structure and region-level semantics for fine-grained controllability; (3) A dynamic gating network producing time-dependent coefficients that evolve with diffusion steps and spatial locations. Face-MoGLE provides a powerful and flexible solution for high-quality, controllable face generation, with strong potential in generative modeling and security applications. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in multimodal and monomodal face generation settings and its robust zero-shot generalization capability. Project page is available at https://github.com/XavierJiezou/Face-MoGLE.
papers.title_zh: 全球和地方专家与可控的一代人传播Transformer的混合组合
papers.abstract_zh: 由于语义可控性和光真主义之间需要复杂的平衡,可控面部生成在基因模型方面构成重大挑战。 虽然现有方法与从代管中分离出语义控制的方法挣扎不休,但我们通过专家专业化的视角,重新审视了传播Transformer的建筑潜力。 本文介绍Face-MoGLE这一新框架,其特点包括:(1) 通过隐蔽的空间因子化进行语义解耦的潜在模型,便于精确的属性操纵;(2) 全球和当地专家的组合,收集整体结构和区域级的语义,用于细微的可控性;(3) 一个动态的格格网络,产生随着扩散步骤和空间位置而变化的取决于时间的系数。 面部教育为高质量、可控的面部生成提供了强有力和灵活的解决方案,在基因建模和安全应用方面具有巨大潜力。 广泛的实验表明其在多式联运和单一模式面部生成环境中的有效性及其强力零光化能力,项目网页见https://github.com/XavierJiezou/Face-MoGLE。

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via DPO: On-Policy Data Hold the Key
papers.authors: Zhihe Yang, Xufang Luo, Dongqi Han, Yunjian Xu, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Hallucination remains a major challenge for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has gained increasing attention as a simple solution to hallucination issues. It directly learns from constructed preference pairs that reflect the severity of hallucinations in responses to the same prompt and image. Nonetheless, different data construction methods in existing works bring notable performance variations. We identify a crucial factor here: outcomes are largely contingent on whether the constructed data aligns on-policy w.r.t the initial (reference) policy of DPO. Theoretical analysis suggests that learning from off-policy data is impeded by the presence of KL-divergence between the updated policy and the reference policy. From the perspective of dataset distribution, we systematically summarize the inherent flaws in existing algorithms that employ DPO to address hallucination issues. To alleviate the problems, we propose On-Policy Alignment (OPA)-DPO framework, which uniquely leverages expert feedback to correct hallucinated responses and aligns both the original and expert-revised responses in an on-policy manner. Notably, with only 4.8k data, OPA-DPO achieves an additional reduction in the hallucination rate of LLaVA-1.5-7B: 13.26% on the AMBER benchmark and 5.39% on the Object-Hal benchmark, compared to the previous SOTA algorithm trained with 16k samples.
papers.title_zh: 通过DPO在大型视觉语言模型中减轻幻觉:政策数据掌握关键
papers.abstract_zh: 幻觉仍然是大型视觉-语言模型面临的一项重大挑战,直接偏好优化作为幻觉问题的简单解决办法日益受到重视。 然而,现有工程中不同的数据构建方法带来了显著的性能差异。 我们在此确定了一个关键因素:结果主要取决于构建的数据是否与残疾人组织最初(参考)的政策相一致。 理论分析表明,从非政策性数据中学习受到更新政策和参考政策之间存在KL比重的阻碍。 从数据集分布的角度来看,我们系统地总结了利用残疾人组织处理幻觉问题的现有算法的内在缺陷。 为了缓解这些问题,我们提出了政策上的协调(OPA) -- -- DPO框架,这一框架以独特的方式利用专家反馈,以正确的幻觉反应,并以政策方式调整最初的和经过专家修订的反应。 值得注意的是,由于只有4.8k数据,与以前经过16k样本培训的SOTA算法相比,OPA-DPO实现了LLAVA-1.5-7B的幻觉率进一步下降:AMBER基准为13.26%,Object-Hal基准为5.39%。

papers.title: MicroVQA: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Microscopy-Based Scientific Research
papers.authors: James Burgess, Jeffrey J Nirschl, Laura Bravo-Sánchez, Alejandro Lozano, Sanket Rajan Gupte, Jesus G. Galaz-Montoya, Yuhui Zhang, Yuchang Su, Disha Bhowmik, Zachary Coman, Sarina M Hasan, Alexandra Johannesson, William D. Leineweber, Malvika G Nair, Ridhi Yarlagadda, Connor Zuraski, Wah Chiu, Sarah Cohen, Jan N. Hansen, Manuel D Leonetti, Chad Liu, Emma Lundberg, Serena Yeung-Levy
papers.abstract: Scientific research demands sophisticated reasoning over multimodal data, a challenge especially prevalent in biology. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for AI-assisted research, existing multimodal reasoning benchmarks only target up to college-level difficulty, while research-level benchmarks emphasize lower-level perception, falling short of the complex multimodal reasoning needed for scientific discovery. To bridge this gap, we introduce MicroVQA, a visual-question answering (VQA) benchmark designed to assess three reasoning capabilities vital in research workflows: expert image understanding, hypothesis generation, and experiment proposal. MicroVQA consists of 1,042 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) curated by biology experts across diverse microscopy modalities, ensuring VQA samples represent real scientific practice. In constructing the benchmark, we find that standard MCQ generation methods induce language shortcuts, motivating a new two-stage pipeline: an optimized LLM prompt structures question-answer pairs into MCQs; then, an agent-based 'RefineBot' updates them to remove shortcuts. Benchmarking on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a peak performance of 53%; models with smaller LLMs only slightly underperform top models, suggesting that language-based reasoning is less challenging than multimodal reasoning; and tuning with scientific articles enhances performance. Expert analysis of chain-of-thought responses shows that perception errors are the most frequent, followed by knowledge errors and then overgeneralization errors. These insights highlight the challenges in multimodal scientific reasoning, showing MicroVQA is a valuable resource advancing AI-driven biomedical research. MicroVQA is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jmhb/microvqa and project at https://jmhb0.github.io/microvqa.
papers.title_zh: 微微VQA:基于显微镜的科学研究的多式联运理由基准
papers.abstract_zh: 科学研究要求对多式联运数据进行复杂的推理,这是生物学中特别普遍的挑战。 尽管最近在用于AI协助研究的多式大语言模型(MLLM)方面取得了进展,但现有的多式推理基准仅针对大学一级的困难,而研究水平基准则强调较低层次的观念,没有达到科学发现所需的复杂的多式推理。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了微小VQA,这是一个直观回答(VQA)基准,旨在评估研究工作流程中三个至关重要的推理能力:专家形象理解、假想生成和实验建议。 微小VQA由生物专家以各种显微镜形式阐述的1,042个多选择问题组成,确保VQA样本代表真正的科学实践。 在建立基准时,我们发现标准的MCQ生成方法诱发语言快捷键,激发一个新的两阶段管道:优化的LLM快速结构问答对接进入MCQ;然后,以代理为基础的“RefineBot”更新它们以删除快捷键。 对最新MLLMs基准的衡量显示,最高性能为53%;小型LLMs模型的顶级模型稍有不足,表明语言推理不如多式推理具有挑战性;与科学文章的调整提高了绩效。 对思考链答复的专家分析表明,认知错误最为常见,其次是知识错误,然后是过度概括错误。 这些洞察力凸显了多式科学推理的挑战,表明微小VQA是推动AI驱动的生物医学研究的宝贵资源。 微小VQA可在以下网址查阅:https://huggingface.co/datasets/jmhb/microvqa和项目:https://jmhb0.github.io/microvqa。

papers.title: M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-view Multi-person Pose Dataset for Fitness Activity Understanding in Real-world Settings
papers.authors: Qingzheng Xu, Ru Cao, Xin Shen, Heming Du, Sen Wang, Xin Yu
papers.abstract: Human pose estimation is a critical task in computer vision for applications in sports analysis, healthcare monitoring, and human-computer interaction. However, existing human pose datasets are collected either from custom-configured laboratories with complex devices or they only include data on single individuals, and both types typically capture daily activities. In this paper, we introduce the M3GYM dataset, a large-scale multimodal, multi-view, and multi-person pose dataset collected from a real gym to address the limitations of existing datasets.Specifically, we collect videos for 82 sessions from the gym, each session lasting between 40 to 60 minutes. These videos are gathered by 8 cameras, including over 50 subjects and 47 million frames. These sessions include 51 Normal fitness exercise sessions as well as 17 Pilates and 14 Yoga sessions. The exercises cover a wide range of poses and typical fitness activities, particularly in Yoga and Pilates, featuring poses with stretches, bends, and twists, e.g., humble warrior, fire hydrants and knee hover side twists. Each session involves multiple subjects, leading to significant self-occlusion and mutual occlusion in single views.Moreover, the gym has two symmetric floor mirrors, a feature not seen in previous datasets, and seven lighting conditions. We provide frame-level multimodal annotations, including 2D&3D keypoints, subject IDs, and meshes. Additionally, M3GYM uniquely offers labels for over 500 actions along with corresponding assessments from sports experts.We benchmark a variety of state-of-the-art methods for several tasks, i.e., 2D human pose estimation, single-view and multi-view 3D human pose estimation, and human mesh recovery. To simulate real-world applications, we also conduct cross-domain experiments across Normal, Yoga, and Pilates sessions. The results show that M3GYM significantly improves model generalization in complex real-world settings.
papers.title_zh: M3GYM:在现实世界环境中了解健身活动大型多式多视角多视角多视角多人波斯数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 人类构成估计是计算机视觉中一项关键任务,用于体育分析、保健监测和人与计算机互动方面的应用。 然而,现有的人类构成数据集是从定制的装有复杂装置的实验室收集的,或者只包括单个个人的数据,而且这两种类型通常都记录日常活动。 在本文中,我们介绍M3GYM数据集,这是一个大型多式联运、多视角和多人组合数据集,从一个真正的健身房收集,以解决现有数据集的局限性。 具体地说,我们从健身房收集82个课的录像,每次课时为40至60分钟。 这些录像由8个摄像头收集,包括50多个科目和4 700万个框架,其中包括51次正常健身锻炼、17次普拉提和14次瑜伽。 这些演习包括各种姿势和典型的健身活动,特别是在瑜伽和普拉提,其特点是有伸展、弯曲和失真的姿势,例如谦卑的勇士、消防水合剂和膝盖盘旋侧。 每场比赛都涉及多个主题,导致在单一视图中出现显著的自我隔离和相互隔离。 此外,健身房有两面对称地面镜,这是以前数据集中未见的特征,还有七个照明条件。 我们提供框架一级的多式联运说明,包括2D和3D关键点、主题标识和网目。 此外,M3GYM独家提供500多项行动的标签以及体育专家的相应评估。 为了模拟真实世界应用,我们还在正常、瑜伽和普拉提会议之间进行跨域实验。 结果表明M3GYM在复杂的真实世界环境中极大地改进了模型的概括化。

papers.title: Low-Rank Expert Merging for Multi-Source Domain Adaptation in Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Taha Mustapha Nehdi, Nairouz Mrabah, Atif Belal, Marco Pedersoli, Eric Granger
papers.abstract: Adapting person re-identification (reID) models to new target environments remains a challenging problem that is typically addressed using unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods. Recent works show that when labeled data originates from several distinct sources (e.g., datasets and cameras), considering each source separately and applying multi-source domain adaptation (MSDA) typically yields higher accuracy and robustness compared to blending the sources and performing conventional UDA. However, state-of-the-art MSDA methods learn domain-specific backbone models or require access to source domain data during adaptation, resulting in significant growth in training parameters and computational cost. In this paper, a Source-free Adaptive Gated Experts (SAGE-reID) method is introduced for person reID. Our SAGE-reID is a cost-effective, source-free MSDA method that first trains individual source-specific low-rank adapters (LoRA) through source-free UDA. Next, a lightweight gating network is introduced and trained to dynamically assign optimal merging weights for fusion of LoRA experts, enabling effective cross-domain knowledge transfer. While the number of backbone parameters remains constant across source domains, LoRA experts scale linearly but remain negligible in size (<= 2% of the backbone), reducing both the memory consumption and risk of overfitting. Extensive experiments conducted on three challenging benchmarks: Market-1501, DukeMTMC-reID, and MSMT17 indicate that SAGE-reID outperforms state-of-the-art methods while being computationally efficient.
papers.title_zh: 个人身份识别方面多来源域适应的低排放专家合并
papers.abstract_zh: 使个人重新识别(再识别)模型适应新的目标环境,仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题,通常使用不受监督的域适应方法加以解决。 最近的工作表明,当贴有标签的数据来源于若干不同来源(例如数据集和相机)时,分别考虑每个来源并应用多源域适应(MSDA),通常比混合来源和进行传统的UDA产生更高的准确性和可靠性。 然而,最先进的MSDA方法学习特定领域的主干模型,或在适应期间需要获得源领域数据,从而导致培训参数和计算成本的大幅增长,本文为个人再开发采用了无源适应性专家(SAGE-reID)方法。 我们的SAGE-REID是一种成本效益高、没有源的MSDA方法,它首先通过无源UDA培训个别源特有的低级适应器(LORA)。 其次,引入并培训了轻量级带宽网络,以动态地分配最佳合并权重,以融合LORA专家,使有效的跨领域知识转让成为可能。 虽然各源域主干参数的数量保持不变,但LORA专家的线性规模仍然微不足道(占主干网的2%),减少了内存消耗和超装风险。 围绕三个具有挑战性的基准进行了广泛的实验:市场1501、DukeMTMC-reID和MSMT17,表明SAGE-reID在计算效率的同时,优于最新技术。

papers.title: Localized Concept Erasure for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models Using Training-Free Gated Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.authors: Byung Hyun Lee, Sungjin Lim, Se Young Chun
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning based concept erasing has demonstrated promising results in preventing generation of harmful contents from text-to-image diffusion models by removing target concepts while preserving remaining concepts. To maintain the generation capability of diffusion models after concept erasure, it is necessary to remove only the image region containing the target concept when it locally appears in an image, leaving other regions intact. However, prior arts often compromise fidelity of the other image regions in order to erase the localized target concept appearing in a specific area, thereby reducing the overall performance of image generation. To address these limitations, we first introduce a framework called localized concept erasure, which allows for the deletion of only the specific area containing the target concept in the image while preserving the other regions. As a solution for the localized concept erasure, we propose a training-free approach, dubbed Gated Low-rank adaptation for Concept Erasure (GLoCE), that injects a lightweight module into the diffusion model. GLoCE consists of low-rank matrices and a simple gate, determined only by several generation steps for concepts without training. By directly applying GLoCE to image embeddings and designing the gate to activate only for target concepts, GLoCE can selectively remove only the region of the target concepts, even when target and remaining concepts coexist within an image. Extensive experiments demonstrated GLoCE not only improves the image fidelity to text prompts after erasing the localized target concepts, but also outperforms prior arts in efficacy, specificity, and robustness by large margin and can be extended to mass concept erasure.
papers.title_zh: 利用无培训、低温低温适应的文本到图像传播模型的地方化概念时代
papers.abstract_zh: 基于微调概念的删除表明,通过删除目标概念,同时保留其余概念,在防止从文字到图像传播模式产生有害内容方面,取得了有希望的成果。 为了在概念消化后保持传播模型的生成能力,必须只在当地图像中出现目标概念时,删除含有目标概念的图像区域,使其他区域完好无损。 然而,先行艺术往往损害其他图像区域的忠实性,以便消除某个特定区域出现的局部目标概念,从而降低图像生成的整体性能。 为了克服这些限制,我们首先引入了一个称为局部概念消除的框架,它只允许删除图像中包含目标概念的具体领域,同时保留其他区域。 作为本地化概念消化的解决方案,我们建议采用一种无培训办法,称为 " 概念时代 " (GLOCE)的低级别适应,向扩散模式注入轻量级模块。 GLOCE由低级矩阵和一个简单的大门组成,仅由几代人不经过培训的概念步骤决定。 通过直接将GLOCE应用于图像嵌入,并设计只为目标概念启动的大门,GLOCE只能有选择地删除目标概念的区域,即使目标概念和其余概念在图像中同时存在。 广泛的实验显示,GLOCE不仅提高了在删除本地目标概念后对文本的图像忠实性,而且还在效力、特性和强健性方面超越了先前的艺术,而且有很大的幅度,可以扩大到大规模概念消化。

papers.title: LiVOS: Light Video Object Segmentation with Gated Linear Matching
papers.authors: Qin Liu, Jianfeng Wang, Zhengyuan Yang, Linjie Li, Kevin Lin, Marc Niethammer, Lijuan Wang
papers.abstract: Semi-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) has been largely driven by space-time memory (STM) networks, which store past frame features in a spatiotemporal memory to segment the current frame via softmax attention. However, STM networks face memory limitations due to the quadratic complexity of softmax matching, restricting their applicability as video length and resolution increase. To address this, we propose LiVOS, a lightweight memory network that employs linear matching via linear attention, reformulating memory matching into a recurrent process that reduces the quadratic attention matrix to a constant-size, spatiotemporal-agnostic 2D state. To enhance selectivity, we introduce gated linear matching, where a data-dependent gate matrix is multiplied with the state matrix to control what information to retain or discard. Experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrated the effectiveness of our method. It achieved 64.8 J&F on MOSE and 85.1 J&F on DAVIS, surpassing all non-STM methods and narrowing the gap with STM-based approaches. For longer and higher-resolution videos, it matched STM-based methods with 53% less GPU memory and supports 4096p inference on a 32G consumer-grade GPU--a previously cost-prohibitive capability--opening the door for long and high-resolution video foundation models.
papers.title_zh: LiVOS: 使用 Ged 线性匹配的光视频对象截面
papers.abstract_zh: 半受监督的视像物体分离(VOS)主要由时空内存(STM)网络驱动,这些网络将过去框架的特征储存在时空空间内存中,通过软式注意力将当前框架分解。 然而,STM网络的内存有限,原因是软式匹配的二次复杂,随着视频长度和分辨率的增加,其适用性受到限制。 为了解决这个问题,我们建议使用一个轻量级的记忆网络LiVOS。 这个网络使用线性匹配,通过线性关注进行线性匹配,将记忆匹配重新组合成一个经常性过程,将二次注意矩阵降低到一个不变大小的、时空波段的2D状态。 为了提高选择性,我们引入了闭门线性匹配,根据数据的大门矩阵与州矩阵相乘,以控制哪些信息可以保留或丢弃。 对不同基准的实验显示了我们方法的有效性。 它在MOSE和DAVIS分别取得了64.8和85.1和85.1的J和F,超过了所有非STM方法,缩小了与STM方法的差距。 对于较长和更高分辨率的视频,它将基于STM的方法与53%的GPU内存相匹配,并且支持对32G消费者级GPU-以前成本-预防能力的4096p推论,为长高分辨率视频基建模型打开大门。

papers.title: LiT: Delving into a Simple Linear Diffusion Transformer for Image Generation
papers.authors: Jiahao Wang · Ning Kang · Lewei Yao · Mengzhao Chen · Chengyue Wu · Songyang Zhang · Shuchen Xue · Yong Liu · Taiqiang Wu · Xihui Liu · Kaipeng Zhang · Shifeng Zhang · Wenqi Shao · Zhenguo Li · Ping Luo
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how to convert a pre-trained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) into a linear DiT, as its simplicity, parallelism, and efficiency for image generation. Through detailed exploration, we offer a suite of ready-to-use solutions, ranging from linear attention design to optimization strategies. Our core contributions include 5 practical guidelines: 1) Applying depth-wise convolution within simple linear attention is sufficient for image generation. 2) Using fewer heads in linear attention provides a free-lunch performance boost without increasing latency. 3) Inheriting weights from a fully converged, pre-trained DiT. 4) Loading all parameters except those related to linear attention. 5) Hybrid knowledge distillation: using a pre-trained teacher DiT to help the training of the student linear DiT, supervising not only the predicted noise but also the variance of the reverse diffusion process. These guidelines lead to our proposed Linear Diffusion Transformer (LiT), which serves as a safe and efficient alternative baseline for DiT with pure linear attention. In class-conditional 256×256 and 512×512 ImageNet generation, LiT can be quickly adapted from DiT using only 20% and 33% of DiT’s training steps, respectively, while achieving comparable performance. LiT also rivals methods based on Mamba or Gated Linear Attention. Moreover, the same guidelines generalize to text-to-image generation: LiT can be swiftly converted from PixArt-Σ to generate high-quality images, maintaining comparable GenEval scores. Additionally, LiT supports offline deployment on a laptop, enabling 1K resolution photorealistic image generation.
papers.title_zh: LiT: 切换成用于图像生成的简单线性扩散变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们调查了如何将受过培训的传播Transformer(DIT)转化为线性二T,作为图像生成的简单性、平行性和效率。 通过详细探索,我们提供了一套现成的解决方案,从线性关注设计到优化战略。 我们的核心贡献包括5项实用准则:1) 在简单的线性关注范围内应用深度变化足以产生图像。 2) 使用较少的线性关注头可以提高免费的绩效,同时又不增加延迟。 3) 从完全趋同的、经过事先训练的DIT中继承的权重 4) 装载除线性注意有关的参数之外的所有参数。 5) 混合知识蒸馏:使用训练有素的教师DitT帮助培训学生线性Dit,不仅监督预测的噪音,而且监督反向扩散过程的差异。 这些准则导致我们拟议中的线性扩散Transformer(LiT),该Transformer是具有纯线性关注的DiT安全有效的替代基准。 在等级条件下的256x256和512x512图像网络生成中,LiT可以快速地从DiT中改编,使用DiT培训步骤的20%和33%,同时取得类似的业绩。 LiT也与基于 Mamba 或 Gated 线性关注的方法相对应。 此外,同样的准则也概括了文本到图像的生成:LiT可以从PixArt-__快速转换为生成高质量的图像,同时保持可比较的GenEval分数。 此外,LiT支持在笔记本电脑上离线部署,从而能够生成1K分辨率的摄影现实图像。

papers.title: LION-FS: Fast & Slow Video-Language Thinker as Online Video Assistant
papers.authors: Wei Li, Bing Hu, Rui Shao, Leyang Shen, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: First-person video assistants are highly anticipated to enhance our daily life through online video dialogue. However, existing online video assistants often sacrifice assistant efficacy for real-time efficiency by processing low-frame-rate videos with coarse-grained visual features. To overcome the trade-off between efficacy and efficiency, we propose "**F**ast & **S**low Video-Language Thinker" as on**LI**ne vide**O** assista**N**t, **LION-FS**, achieving real-time, proactive, temporally accurate, and contextually precise responses. LION-FS adopts a two-stage optimization strategy: **1) Fast Path: Routing-Based Response Determination** evaluates frame-by-frame whether a immediate response is necessary. To enhance responses determination accuracy and handle higher frame-rate inputs efficiently, we employ Token Aggregation Routing to dynamically fuse spatiotemporal features without increasing token numbers, while utilizing Token Dropping Routing to eliminate redundant features, and **2) Slow Path: Multi-granularity Keyframe Augmentation** optimizes keyframes during response generation. To provide comprehensive and detailed responses beyond atomic actions constrained by training data, fine-grained spatial features and human-environment interaction features are extracted through multi-granular pooling. They are further integrated into a meticulously designed multimodal Thinking Template to guide more precise response generation. Comprehensive evaluations on online video tasks demonstrate that LION-FS achieves state-of-the-art efficacy and efficiency. The codes will be released soon.
papers.title_zh: LION-FS: 作为在线视频助理快速和慢视频语言思想家
papers.abstract_zh: 第一人称视频助理被高度期望通过在线视频对话改善我们的日常生活,但现有的在线视频助理往往通过处理带有粗略视觉特征的低框架视频,牺牲助理的实时效率。 为了克服效率和效率之间的权衡,我们提议“**F**ast & **S**low Vide-Language Thinker”作为**LI**ne vide**O** helpa**N**t,**LION-FS**,实现实时、主动性、时间准确和符合具体情况的反应。 LION-FS采取两阶段优化战略:**1)快速道路:基于运行的应对决定** 逐个框架评估是否需要立即应对。 为了提高反应确定准确性并高效处理更高的框架率投入,我们采用Token聚合号,在不增加象征性数字的情况下,按动态引信时空特性逐行运行,同时利用Token 丢弃路程消除冗余特性,** 慢路:多组合关键框架增加** 优化反应生成过程中的关键框架。 为了在受培训数据制约的原子行动之外提供全面和详细的应对办法,通过多层联合利用提取细微的空间特征和人类-环境互动特征。 对在线视频任务的全面评价表明,LION-FS取得了最先进的效益和效率。 这些代码将很快发布。

papers.title: Learning on Model Weights using Tree Experts
papers.authors: Eliahu Horwitz, Bar Cavia, Jonathan Kahana, Yedid Hoshen
papers.abstract: The number of publicly available models is rapidly increasing, yet most remain undocumented. Users looking for suitable models for their tasks must first determine what each model does. Training machine learning models to infer missing documentation directly from model weights is challenging, as these weights often contain significant variation unrelated to model functionality (denoted nuisance). Here, we identify a key property of real-world models: most public models belong to a small set of Model Trees, where all models within a tree are fine-tuned from a common ancestor (e.g., a foundation model). Importantly, we find that within each tree there is less nuisance variation between models. Concretely, while learning across Model Trees requires complex architectures, even a linear classifier trained on a single model layer often works within trees. While effective, these linear classifiers are computationally expensive, especially when dealing with larger models that have many parameters. To address this, we introduce Probing Experts (ProbeX), a theoretically motivated and lightweight method. Notably, ProbeX is the first probing method specifically designed to learn from the weights of a single hidden model layer. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ProbeX by predicting the categories in a model's training dataset based only on its weights. Excitingly, ProbeX can map the weights of Stable Diffusion into a weight-language embedding space, enabling model search via text, i.e., zero-shot model classification.
papers.title_zh: 利用树木专家学习模型比重
papers.abstract_zh: 公开提供的模式数量正在迅速增加,但大多数模式仍然没有记录。 寻找适合其任务的模式的用户必须首先决定每个模式都做什么。 培训机器学习模式,直接从模型加权数中推断缺失的文件,这具有挑战性,因为这些加权数往往含有与模型功能无关的重大差异(注意到的麻烦)。 在这里,我们确定了现实世界模型的关键属性:大多数公共模型都属于一小套模型树,其中树内的所有模型都与共同的祖先(例如基础模型)相微调。 重要的是,我们发现在每棵树内,模型之间的烦恼变化较少。 具体地说,虽然跨模型树的学习需要复杂的结构,但即使是在单一模型层上受过训练的线性分类师也常常在树中起作用。 这些线性分类师虽然有效,但计算成本很高,特别是在处理具有许多参数的较大模型时。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了探查专家(Probex),这是一种以理论为动机的轻量级方法,特别是,Probex是第一个专门设计用来从单一隐藏模型层的重量中学习的探查方法。 我们通过预测模型培训数据集中仅仅基于其重量的类别来证明Probex的有效性。 Probex可以将稳定扩散的重量映射成一个重语言嵌入空间,通过文本(即零光模型分类)进行模型搜索。

papers.title: Learning Audio-guided Video Representation with Gated Attention for Video-Text Retrieval
papers.authors: Boseung Jeong, Jicheol Park, Sungyeon Kim, Suha Kwak
papers.abstract: Video-text retrieval, the task of retrieving videos based on a textual query or vice versa, is of paramount importance for video understanding and multimodal information retrieval. Recent methods in this area rely primarily on visual and textual features and often ignore audio, although it helps enhance overall comprehension of video content.Moreover, traditional models that incorporate audio blindly utilize the audio input regardless of whether it is useful or not, resulting in suboptimal video representation. To address these limitations, we propose a novel video-text retrieval framework, Audio-guided VIdeo representation learning with GATEd attention (AVIGATE), that effectively leverages audio cues through a gated attention mechanism that selectively filters out uninformative audio signals.In addition, we propose an adaptive margin-based contrastive loss to deal with the inherently unclear positive-negative relationship between video and text, which facilitates learning better video-text alignment.Our extensive experiments demonstrate that AVIGATE achieves state-of-the-art performance on all the public benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: 学习音频制导视频演示,带引导注意的视频视频视频检索
papers.abstract_zh: 视频文本检索是根据文字Query检索视频的任务,反之亦然,对于视频理解和多式信息检索至关重要。 这方面最近采用的方法主要依靠视觉和文字特征,往往忽视音频,尽管它有助于提高对视频内容的总体理解。 为了克服这些限制,我们提议建立一个新型的视频文本检索框架,即 " 以GATEd 关注度学习音频引导VIDEO " ,通过有选择地过滤无信息化音频信号的封闭式关注机制,有效地利用音频提示。 此外,我们提议一个适应性的基于边际的对比性损失,以处理视频和文本之间内在的不明确的正反向关系,这有助于学习更好的视频文本协调。 我们的广泛实验表明,AVIGATE在所有公共基准上都取得了最先进的业绩。

papers.title: Layer- and Timestep-Adaptive Differentiable Token Compression Ratios for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Haoran You, Connelly Barnes, Yuqian Zhou, Yan Kang, Zhenbang Du, Wei Zhou, Lingzhi Zhang, Yotam Nitzan, Xiaoyang Liu, Zhe Lin, Eli Shechtman, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Yingyan Celine Lin
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) image generation quality but suffer from high latency and memory inefficiency, making them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained devices. One major efficiency bottleneck is that existing DiTs apply equal computation across all regions of an image. However, not all image tokens are equally important, and certain localized areas require more computation, such as objects. To address this, we propose DiffCR, a dynamic DiT inference framework with differentiable compression ratios, which automatically learns to dynamically route computation across layers and timesteps for each image token, resulting in efficient DiTs. Specifically, DiffCR integrates three features: (1) A token-level routing scheme where each DiT layer includes a router that is fine-tuned jointly with model weights to predict token importance scores. In this way, unimportant tokens bypass the entire layer's computation; (2) A layer-wise differentiable ratio mechanism where different DiT layers automatically learn varying compression ratios from a zero initialization, resulting in large compression ratios in redundant layers while others remain less compressed or even uncompressed; (3) A timestep-wise differentiable ratio mechanism where each denoising timestep learns its own compression ratio. The resulting pattern shows higher ratios for noisier timesteps and lower ratios as the image becomes clearer. Extensive experiments on text-to-image and inpainting tasks show that DiffCR effectively captures dynamism across token, layer, and timestep axes, achieving superior trade-offs between generation quality and efficiency compared to prior works. The project website is available at https://www.haoranyou.com/diffcr.
papers.title_zh: 高效扩散变压器的图层和时间步骤-时间步骤-适应性差异化可调制缩缩压比率
papers.abstract_zh: 传播Transformer(DITs)已经达到了最先进的图像生成质量,但具有较高的延时率和记忆效率低的问题,因此难以在资源有限的装置上部署这些Transformer。 一个主要的效率瓶颈是,现有的 DIT 在所有图像区域都应用相同的计算方法。 但是,并非所有图像符号都同等重要,某些局部区域需要更多计算,例如对象。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议DiffCR,这是一个动态的DiT推理框架,具有不同的压缩比率,自动学会在每一图像符号的层次和时间段之间动态地进行计算,从而产生高效的DiT。 具体地说,DiffCR综合了三个特点:(1) 象征性路由计划,其中每个DiT层都包括一个路由器,与模型重量一道进行微调,以预测象征性重要分数。 这样一来,不重要的象征物绕过整个层的计算; (2) 一种从层到层的不同比率机制,即不同的DiT层从零初始化中自动学习不同的压缩比率,导致冗余层的压缩比率很大,而其他层的压缩比率则不那么压缩甚至不压缩; (3) 一种从时间步骤到时间步骤的不同比率机制,每个取消时间步骤都学习自己的压缩比率。 由此得出的模式显示,随着图像更加清晰,音响时间步骤的比率较高,而且比例较低。 关于文字到图像和油漆任务的广泛实验表明,DiffCR有效捕捉了象征、层和定时轴之间的活力,实现了与以往工程相比,在生产质量和效率之间实现更优的平衡,项目网站见https://www.haoranyou.com/diffcr。

papers.title: JarvisIR: Elevating Autonomous Driving Perception with Intelligent Image Restoration
papers.authors: Yunlong Lin, Zixu Lin, Haoyu Chen, Panwang Pan, Chenxin Li, Sixiang Chen, Kairun Wen, Yeying Jin, Wenbo Li, Xinghao Ding
papers.abstract: Vision-centric perception systems often struggle with unpredictable and coupled weather degradations in the wild. Current solutions are often limited, as they either depend on specific degradation priors or suffer from significant domain gaps. To enable robust and autonomous operation in real-world conditions, we propose JarvisIR, a VLM-powered agent that leverages the VLM (e.g., Llava-Llama3) as a controller to manage multiple expert restoration models. To further enhance system robustness, reduce hallucinations, and improve generalizability in real-world adverse weather, JarvisIR employs a novel two-stage framework consisting of supervised fine-tuning and human feedback alignment. Specifically, to address the lack of paired data in real-world scenarios, the human feedback alignment enables the VLM to be fine-tuned effectively on large-scale real-world data in an unsupervised manner. To support the training and evaluation of JarvisIR, we introduce CleanBench, a comprehensive dataset consisting of high-quality and large-scale instruction-responses pairs, including 150K synthetic entries and 80K real entries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that JarvisIR exhibits superior decision-making and restoration capabilities. Compared with existing methods, it achieves a 50% improvement in the average of all perception metrics on CleanBench-Real.
papers.title_zh: JarvisIR: 提高自主驱动感知和智能图像恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的解决办法往往有限,因为它们要么取决于具体的退化前期,要么存在巨大的领域差距。 为了在现实世界条件下开展有力和自主的行动,我们提议贾维斯里公司,这是一个利用VLM(如Llava-Llama3)作为控制器的VLM(如Llava-Llama3)的VLM动力代理人,负责管理多个专家恢复模型。 为了进一步加强系统的稳健性,减少幻觉,并提高现实世界恶劣天气的可概括性,JarvisIR采用了一个新的两阶段框架,其中包括监督的微调和人类反馈协调。 具体地说,为了解决现实世界情景中缺乏配对数据的问题,人类反馈调整使甚大现实世界数据能够以不受监督的方式对甚大现实世界数据进行有效的微调。 为了支持对JarvisIR的培训和评价,我们引入了CleanBench,这是一套综合数据集,由高质量和大规模的对教学反应组合组成,包括150K合成条目和80K实际条目。 广泛的实验表明,JarvisIR具有较高的决策和恢复能力。 与现有方法相比,它实现了清洁港内所有感知指标平均50%的改善。

papers.title: InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions
papers.authors: Sirui Xu, Hung Yu Ling, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui
papers.abstract: Achieving realistic simulations of humans interacting with a wide range of objects has long been a fundamental goal. Extending physics-based motion imitation to complex human-object interactions (HOIs) is challenging due to intricate human-object coupling, variability in object geometries, and artifacts in motion capture data, such as inaccurate contacts and limited hand detail. We introduce InterMimic, a framework that enables a single policy to robustly learn from hours of imperfect MoCap data covering diverse full-body interactions with dynamic and varied objects. Our key insight is to employ a curriculum strategy -- perfect first, then scale up. We first train subject-specific teacher policies to mimic, retarget, and refine motion capture data. Next, we distill these teachers into a student policy, with the teachers acting as online experts providing direct supervision, as well as high-quality references. Notably, we incorporate RL fine-tuning on the student policy to surpass mere demonstration replication and achieve higher-quality solutions. Our experiments demonstrate that InterMimic produces realistic and diverse interactions across multiple HOI datasets. The learned policy generalizes in a zero-shot manner and seamlessly integrates with kinematic generators, elevating the framework from mere imitation to generative modeling of complex human-object interactions.
papers.title_zh: 模拟:对基于物理的人体和物体相互作用实行普遍全体控制
papers.abstract_zh: 实现现实的模拟人类与各种物体相互作用,长期以来一直是一个基本目标。 将物理学模拟运动扩大到复杂的人体物体相互作用(HOIs)具有挑战性,因为复杂的人体物体交织、物体的地形变化以及运动中的文物采集数据,如不准确的接触和有限的手工细节。 我们引入了“互动”框架,这一框架使单一政策能够从不完善的数据中有力地学习小时的不完善的数据,这些数据涵盖与动态和不同对象的多种全面互动。 我们的关键见解是采用课程战略,首先完美,然后推广。 我们首先训练针对特定主题的教师政策,以模仿、重新定位和完善运动捕获数据。 其次,我们把这些教师提炼成学生政策,由教师作为在线专家提供直接监督和高质量的参考资料。 值得注意的是,我们引入了学生政策的RL微调,以超越单纯的示范复制,实现更高质量的解决方案。 我们的实验表明,“Intermic”在多个HOI数据集中产生了现实和多样的互动。 所学的政策以零射方式概括,与运动发电机无缝结合,将框架从单纯模仿提升到复杂人体与物体相互作用的基因模型。

papers.title: Hypergraph Vision Transformers: Images are More than Nodes, More than Edges
papers.authors: Joshua Fixelle
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in computer vision have highlighted the scalability of Vision Transformers (ViTs) across various tasks, yet challenges remain in balancing adaptability, computational efficiency, and the ability to model higher-order relationships. Vision Graph Neural Networks (ViGs) offer an alternative by leveraging graph-based methodologies but are hindered by the computational bottlenecks of clustering algorithms used for edge generation. To address these issues, we propose the Hypergraph Vision Transformer (HgVT), which incorporates a hierarchical bipartite hypergraph structure into the vision transformer framework to capture higher-order semantic relationships while maintaining computational efficiency. HgVT leverages population and diversity regularization for dynamic hypergraph construction without clustering, and expert edge pooling to enhance semantic extraction and facilitate graph-based image retrieval. Empirical results demonstrate that HgVT achieves strong performance on image classification and retrieval, positioning it as an efficient framework for semantic-based vision tasks.
papers.title_zh: 高光图视野Transformer:图像比节点多,比边缘多
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机视觉的近期进展突出表明,Vision Transformer(VITs)跨越各种任务,具有可伸缩性,但在平衡适应性、计算效率和建立较高级关系模型的能力方面仍然存在挑战。 视觉图神经网络(ViGs)通过利用基于图表的方法提供了一种替代方法,但受到用于边缘生成的集群算法的计算瓶颈的阻碍。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用高射线视野Transformer(HgVT),将两边的分级高射电结构纳入视觉Transformer框架,以便在保持计算效率的同时,捕捉更高级的语义关系。 汞蒸气利用人口和多样性的正规化,在没有集群的情况下进行动态高压建筑,并集中专家优势,以加强语义提取,便利基于图表的图像检索。 实证结果表明,HogVT在图像分类和检索方面表现良好,成为基于语义的视觉任务的有效框架。

papers.title: How to Merge Your Multimodal Models Over Time?
papers.authors: Sebastian Dziadzio, Vishaal Udandarao, Karsten Roth, Ameya Prabhu, Zeynep Akata, Samuel Albanie, Matthias Bethge
papers.abstract: Model merging combines expert models---each finetuned from a shared foundation model on diverse tasks and domains---into a single, more capable base model. However, existing model merging approaches assume all experts to be available simultaneously. In reality, new tasks and domains emerge continuously, prompting the need for a dynamic process of integrating these experts over time, which we call temporal model merging. The temporal dimension introduces unique challenges not addressed in prior work: At each task, should expert training start from merged previous experts or the original base model? Should all models be merged at every time step? Which merging techniques are best suited for temporal merging? Should different strategies be used for the training initialization and deployment phases? To tackle these questions, we propose a unified framework called TIME---Temporal Integration of Model Expertise---that defines temporal model merging across three axes: (1) Initialization Phase, (2) Deployment Phase, and (3) Merging Technique. Utilizing TIME, we study temporal model merging across model sizes, tasks, and compute budgets on the large-scale FoMo-in-Flux benchmark for continual multimodal pretraining. Systematic experiments across TIME and FoMo-in-Flux allow us to arrive at several crucial key insights for temporal model merging to better understand current limits and best practices for successful model merging across time.
papers.title_zh: 如何将您的多模式模型与时俱进?
papers.abstract_zh: 合并模式将专家模型(每个模型)从关于不同任务和领域的共同基础模型(纳入一个单一的、更有能力的基础模型)中加以微调,并入一个单一的、更有能力的基础模型,但现有的合并模式办法假定所有专家同时可用。 在现实中,新的任务和领域不断出现,促使需要一种动态的过程,随着时间的推移将这些专家融合在一起,我们称之为时间模式合并。 时间因素带来了以往工作中未涉及的独特挑战:在每项任务中,专家培训应从合并的前专家开始还是从最初的基础模式开始?所有模型都应在每一个阶段合并?哪些合并技术最适合时间合并? 是否应在培训启动和部署阶段采用不同的战略? 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个统一框架,称为 " 模型专门知识的时间 -- -- 时间 -- -- 时间 -- -- 临时一体化 -- -- 以界定跨越三个轴的合并时间模式:(1) 初始化阶段,(2) 部署阶段,(3) 合并技术。 利用时间,我们研究时间模型,将各种模型的规模、任务合并在一起,并计算用于持续多式联运预培训的大型富豪流动基准的预算。 跨越时空和流动模式的系统实验使我们能够得出若干关键的关键见解,以便合并时间模型,更好地了解目前的限制和成功模型在不同时间合并的最佳做法。

papers.title: HOIGen-1M: A Large-scale Dataset for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
papers.authors: Kun Liu, Qi Liu, Xinchen Liu, Jie Li, Yongdong Zhang, Jiebo Luo, Xiaodong He, Wu Liu
papers.abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has made tremendous progress in generating complicated scenes based on texts. However, human-object interaction (HOI) often cannot be precisely generated by current T2V models due to the lack of large-scale videos with accurate captions for HOI. To address this issue, we introduce HOIGen-1M, the first large-scale dataset for HOI Generation, consisting of over one million high-quality videos collected from diverse sources. In particular, to guarantee the high quality of videos, we first design an efficient framework to automatically curate HOI videos using the powerful multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and then the videos are further cleaned by human annotators. Moreover, to obtain accurate textual captions for HOI videos, we design a novel video description method based on a Mixture-of-Multimodal-Experts (MoME) strategy that not only generates expressive captions but also eliminates the hallucination by individual MLLM. Furthermore, due to the lack of an evaluation framework for generated HOI videos, we propose two new metrics to assess the quality of generated videos in a coarse-to-fine manner. Extensive experiments reveal that current T2V models struggle to generate high-quality HOI videos and confirm that our HOIGen-1M dataset is instrumental for improving HOI video generation.
papers.title_zh: HOIGen-1M: 人类物体互动视频生成大型数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到视频(T2V)一代在创造基于文本的复杂场景方面取得了巨大进展,然而,由于缺少具有HOI准确字幕的大型视频,目前T2V模型往往无法准确生成人体物体互动(HOI)。 为了解决这一问题,我们介绍HOIGen-1M,这是HOI一代的第一个大型数据集,由从不同来源收集的100多万段高质量视频组成。 特别是,为了保证视频的高质量,我们首先设计一个有效的框架,利用强大的多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)自动制作HOI视频,然后由人类广告师进一步清理视频。 此外,为了为HOI视频获取准确的文字字幕,我们设计了一种新颖的视频描述方法,其依据是混合模块-专家(MME)战略,不仅生成了表达式字幕,而且消除了个人MLLM的幻觉。 此外,由于缺乏对制作的HOI视频的评价框架,我们建议采用两个新的衡量标准,以粗略到正确的方式评估制作的视频的质量。 大量实验显示,目前T2V模型正在努力生成高质量的HOI视频,并确认我们的HOIGen-1M数据集有助于改进HOI视频生成。

papers.title: HeMoRa: Unsupervised Heuristic Consensus Sampling for Robust Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Shaocheng Yan, Yiming Wang, Kaiyan Zhao, Pengcheng Shi, Zhenjun Zhao, Yongjun Zhang, Jiayuan Li
papers.abstract: Heuristic information for consensus set sampling is essential for correspondence-based point cloud registration, but existing approaches typically rely on supervised learning or expert-driven parameter tuning. In this work, we propose HeMoRa, a new unsupervised framework that trains a Heuristic information Generator (HeGen) to estimate sampling probabilities for correspondences using a Multi-order Reward Aggregator (MoRa) loss. The core of MoRa is to train HeGen through extensive trials and feedback, enabling unsupervised learning. While this process can be implemented using policy optimization, directly applying the policy gradient to optimize HeGen presents challenges such as sensitivity to noise and low reward efficiency. To address these issues, we propose a Maximal Reward Propagation (MRP) mechanism that enhances the training process by prioritizing noise-free signals and improving reward utilization. Experimental results show that equipped with HeMoRa, the consensus set sampler achieves improvements in both robustness and accuracy. For example, on the 3DMatch dataset with FCGF feature, the registration recall of our unsupervised methods (Ours+SM and Ours+SC^2) even outperforms the state-of-the-art supervised method VBreg. Our code is available at href https://github.com/Laka-3DV/HeMoRa texttt HeMoRa .
papers.title_zh: 赫莫拉:强点云登记不受监督的雄力共识抽样
papers.abstract_zh: 用于协商一致的成套抽样的稳妥信息对于通信点云登记至关重要,但现行办法通常依赖监督的学习或专家驱动的参数调整。 在这项工作中,我们提议HeMoRa,这是一个无人监督的新框架,用于培训一个Heuristic信息生成器(HeGen),以便利用多订单报偿聚合器(MoRa)损失来估计信件的抽样概率。 MoRa的核心是通过广泛的试验和反馈对HeGen进行培训,从而在不受监督的情况下进行学习。 虽然这一过程可以用政策优化来实施,但直接应用政策梯度优化HeGen带来了挑战,比如对噪音的敏感度和低报酬效率。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个最大增益机制(MRP),通过优先考虑无噪音信号和改进奖励利用来强化培训进程。 实验结果表明,配有HeMoRA的协商一致样本在稳健性和准确性方面都取得了进步。 例如,在具有FCGF特征的3DMatch数据集中,登记了我们无人监督的方法(我们+SM和我们+SC2),甚至超过了最先进的VBreg监督方法。我们的代码可以在href https://github.com/Laka-3DV/HeMoRa Texttt HeMoRa上查到。

papers.title: Hard Spatial Gating for Precision-Driven Brain Metastasis Segmentation: Addressing the Over-Segmentation Paradox in Deep Attention Networks
papers.authors: Rowzatul Zannath Prerona
papers.abstract: Brain metastasis segmentation in MRI remains a formidable challenge due to diminutive lesion sizes (5-15 mm) and extreme class imbalance (less than 2% tumor volume). While soft-attention CNNs are widely used, we identify a critical failure mode termed the "over-segmentation paradox," where models achieve high sensitivity (recall > 0.88) but suffer from catastrophic precision collapse (precision < 0.23) and boundary errors exceeding 150 mm. This imprecision poses significant risks for stereotactic radiosurgery planning. To address this, we introduce the Spatial Gating Network (SG-Net), a precision-first architecture employing hard spatial gating mechanisms. Unlike traditional soft attention, SG-Net enforces strict feature selection to aggressively suppress background artifacts while preserving tumor features. Validated on the Brain-Mets-Lung-MRI dataset (n=92), SG-Net achieves a Dice Similarity Coefficient of 0.5578 +/- 0.0243 (95% CI: 0.45-0.67), statistically outperforming Attention U-Net (p < 0.001) and ResU-Net (p < 0.001). Most critically, SG-Net demonstrates a threefold improvement in boundary precision, achieving a 95% Hausdorff Distance of 56.13 mm compared to 157.52 mm for Attention U-Net, while maintaining robust recall (0.79) and superior precision (0.52 vs. 0.20). Furthermore, SG-Net requires only 0.67M parameters (8.8x fewer than Attention U-Net), facilitating deployment in resource-constrained environments. These findings establish hard spatial gating as a robust solution for precision-driven lesion detection, directly enhancing radiosurgery accuracy.
papers.title_zh: 精密驱动脑元构型分割的硬空间定位:解决深度关注网络中的超层分解问题
papers.abstract_zh: 由于二分形损伤大小(5-15毫米)和极端阶级不平衡(肿瘤体积不到2%),在磁共振中脑转移分离仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。 虽然软关注有线电视被广泛使用,但我们发现了一种称为“超分区悖论”的关键故障模式,即模型具有高度敏感性(回召 > 0.88),但遭受灾难性精确崩溃(精确度 < 0.23)和超过150毫米的边界误差。 这种不精确对立体射电外科规划构成重大风险。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了空间定位网(SG-Net),这是一个使用硬空间定位机制的精密第一结构。 与传统的软注意力不同,SG-Net强制实行严格的特征选择,以便在保留肿瘤特征的同时大力压制背景文物。 SG-Net在脑-Mets-Lung-MRI数据集(n=92)上验证后,实现了0.5578+/-0.0243(95%的CI:0.45-0.67),统计效果超过U-Net(p <0.001)和ResU-Net(p <0.001)。 最关键的是,SG-Net显示边界精确度提高了三倍,达到95%的Hausdorff距离56.13毫米,而注意U-Net为157.52毫米,同时保持强力召回(0.79)和高精度(0.52对0.20)。 此外,SG-Net只要求0.67M参数(比注意U-Net少8.8x),以便利在资源受限制的环境中部署,这些结论将硬空间定位确定为精确驱动损伤检测的可靠解决方案,直接提高放射外科手术的准确性。

papers.title: Gated Temporal Diffusion for Stochastic Long-term Dense Anticipation
papers.authors: Olga Zatsarynna · Emad Bahrami · Yazan Abu Farha · Gianpiero Francesca · Juergen Gall
papers.abstract: Long-term action anticipation has become an important task for many applications such as autonomous driving and human-robot interaction. Unlike short-term anticipation, predicting more actions into the future imposes a real challenge with the increasing uncertainty in longer horizons. While there has been a significant progress in predicting more actions into the future, most of the proposed methods address the task in a deterministic setup and ignore the underlying uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a novel temporal diffusion network that models the uncertainty of both the observation and the future predictions. As generator, we introduce a Gated Anticipation Network (GTAN) to model both observed and unobserved frames of a video in a mutual representation. On the one hand, using a mutual representation for past and future allows us to jointly model ambiguities in the observation and future, while on the other hand by design GTAN can intrinsically treat the observed and unobserved parts differently and steer the information flow between them. Our model achieves state-of-the-art results on the Breakfast, Assembly101 and 50Salads datasets in both stochastic and deterministic settings.
papers.title_zh: 用于长期耐久耐毒长期预测的时空传播
papers.abstract_zh: 长期行动预测已成为许多应用领域的重要任务,如自主驱动和人类-机器人互动。 与短期预测不同,预测未来会有更多的行动带来了真正的挑战,因为长期的不确定性越来越大。 虽然在预测今后将采取更多行动方面取得了重大进展,但大多数拟议方法都以决定性的方式处理这项任务,而忽略了潜在的不确定性。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个新型的时间扩散网络,对观测和未来预测的不确定性进行模型分析。 作为生成者,我们引入了Gatet预测网络(GTAN),以相互代表的方式对视频的观测和未观测框架进行模型分析。 一方面,对过去和将来采用相互代表的做法,使我们能够在观察和将来共同树立模棱两可的模棱两可的模式,另一方面,通过设计,GTAN可以本质上以不同的方式对待观察到和看不到的部分,并指导它们之间的信息流动。 我们的模型在早餐、大会101和50Salads数据库中,在随机和确定性环境中,取得了最新的最新结果。

papers.title: FSG-Net: Frequency-Spatial Synergistic Gated Network for High-Resolution Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.authors: Zhongxiang Xie, Shuangxi Miao, Yuhan Jiang, Zhewei Zhang, Jing Yao, Xuecao Li, Jianxi Huang, Pedram Ghamisi
papers.abstract: Change detection from high-resolution remote sensing images lies as a cornerstone of Earth observation applications, yet its efficacy is often compromised by two critical challenges. First, false alarms are prevalent as models misinterpret radiometric variations from temporal shifts (e.g., illumination, season) as genuine changes. Second, a non-negligible semantic gap between deep abstract features and shallow detail-rich features tends to obstruct their effective fusion, culminating in poorly delineated boundaries. To step further in addressing these issues, we propose the Frequency-Spatial Synergistic Gated Network (FSG-Net), a novel paradigm that aims to systematically disentangle semantic changes from nuisance variations. Specifically, FSG-Net first operates in the frequency domain, where a Discrepancy-Aware Wavelet Interaction Module (DAWIM) adaptively mitigates pseudo-changes by discerningly processing different frequency components. Subsequently, the refined features are enhanced in the spatial domain by a Synergistic Temporal-Spatial Attention Module (STSAM), which amplifies the saliency of genuine change regions. To finally bridge the semantic gap, a Lightweight Gated Fusion Unit (LGFU) leverages high-level semantics to selectively gate and integrate crucial details from shallow layers. Comprehensive experiments on the CDD, GZ-CD, and LEVIR-CD benchmarks validate the superiority of FSG-Net, establishing a new state-of-the-art with F1-scores of 94.16%, 89.51%, and 91.27%, respectively. The code will be made available at https://github.com/zxXie-Air/FSG-Net after a possible publication.
papers.title_zh: FSG-Net:高分辨率遥感变化探测高分辨率遥感变化高频同步总网
papers.abstract_zh: 从高分辨率遥感图像中探测到的变化是地球观测应用的基石,但其效力往往受到两个重大挑战的损害。 首先,假警报普遍存在,因为模型将时间变化(例如照明、季节)的辐射测量变化误解为真正的变化。 第二,深层抽象特征与浅层细节丰富特征之间非可忽略的语义差距往往阻碍其有效融合,最终导致边界划分不一。 为了进一步解决这些问题,我们提议建立频率空间同步Gate网络(FSG-Net),这是一个新颖的范例,旨在系统地将语义变化与骚扰性变化区分开来。 具体地说,FSG-Net首先在频率域内运行,在这个域内,一个差异-软件波动互动模块(DAWIM)通过辨别处理不同频率组件,适应性地减轻假变化。 随后,通过一个同步时空空间注意模块(SSTSAM)加强了空间领域的精细特征,该模块增强了真正变化区域的显著性。 为了最终弥合语义差距,轻量级GGFU组合股利用高级别语义学来有选择地打开大门,并整合浅层的重要细节。 关于CDD、GZ-CD和LEVIR-CD基准的全面实验证实FSG-Net的优越性,建立了一个新的最新技术,F1-score分别为94.16%、89.51%和91.27%,在可能发表之后,将在https://github.com/zxXie-Air/FSG-Net上提供该代码。

papers.title: Fraesormer: Learning Adaptive Sparse Transformer for Efficient Food Recognition
papers.authors: Shun Zou, Yi Zou, Mingya Zhang, Shipeng Luo, Zhihao Chen, Guangwei Gao
papers.abstract: In recent years, Transformer has witnessed significant progress in food recognition. However, most existing approaches still face two critical challenges in lightweight food recognition: (1) the quadratic complexity and redundant feature representation from interactions with irrelevant tokens; (2) static feature recognition and single-scale representation, which overlook the unstructured, non-fixed nature of food images and the need for multi-scale features. To address these, we propose an adaptive and efficient sparse Transformer architecture (Fraesormer) with two core designs: Adaptive Top-k Sparse Partial Attention (ATK-SPA) and Hierarchical Scale-Sensitive Feature Gating Network (HSSFGN). ATK-SPA uses a learnable Gated Dynamic Top-K Operator (GDTKO) to retain critical attention scores, filtering low query-key matches that hinder feature aggregation. It also introduces a partial channel mechanism to reduce redundancy and promote expert information flow, enabling local-global collaborative modeling. HSSFGN employs gating mechanism to achieve multi-scale feature representation, enhancing contextual semantic information. Extensive experiments show that Fraesormer outperforms state-of-the-art methods. code is available at https://zs1314.github.io/Fraesormer.
papers.title_zh: Fraesormer:学习适应性零散Transformer,促进高效食品识别
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,Transformer在粮食确认方面取得了重大进展。 然而,在轻量级食品承认方面,大多数现有办法仍面临两个重大挑战:(1) 与不相关象征物互动产生的四面形复杂性和冗余特征代表;(2) 静态特征确认和单一规模代表,忽视了食品形象的无结构、非固定性质和需要多规模特征。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个适应性强、效率高的稀有Transformer结构(Fraesormer),有两个核心设计:适应性高压分散部分注意(ATK-SPA)和等级级规模感知特征定位网(HSSFGN)。 ATK-SPA使用一个可学习的Gated动态顶级操作员(GDTKO)来保留关键关注分数,过滤阻碍特征聚合的低调Query键匹配,还引入一个部分渠道机制,以减少冗余,促进专家信息流动,促成地方-全球合作建模。 广泛实验显示,Fraesormer的成绩优于最先进的方法。 代码可在https://zs1314.github.io/Fraesormer查阅。

papers.title: FOCUS: Knowledge-enhanced Adaptive Visual Compression for Few-shot Whole Slide Image Classification
papers.authors: Zhengrui Guo, Conghao Xiong, Jiabo Ma, Qichen Sun, Lishuang Feng, Jinzhuo Wang, Hao Chen
papers.abstract: Few-shot learning presents a critical solution for cancer diagnosis in computational pathology (CPath), addressing fundamental limitations in data availability, particularly the scarcity of expert annotations and patient privacy constraints. A key challenge in this paradigm stems from the inherent disparity between the limited training set of whole slide images (WSIs) and the enormous number of contained patches, where a significant portion of these patches lacks diagnostically relevant information, potentially diluting the model's ability to learn and focus on critical diagnostic features. While recent works attempt to address this by incorporating additional knowledge, several crucial gaps hinder further progress: (1) despite the emergence of powerful pathology foundation models (FMs), their potential remains largely untapped, with most approaches limiting their use to basic feature extraction; (2) current language guidance mechanisms attempt to align text prompts with vast numbers of WSI patches all at once, struggling to leverage rich pathological semantic information. To this end, we introduce the knowledge-enhanced adaptive visual compression framework, dubbed FOCUS, which uniquely combines pathology FMs with language prior knowledge to enable a focused analysis of diagnostically relevant regions by prioritizing discriminative WSI patches. Our approach implements a progressive three-stage compression strategy: we first leverage FMs for global visual redundancy elimination, and integrate compressed features with language prompts for semantic relevance assessment, then perform neighbor-aware visual token filtering while preserving spatial coherence. Extensive experiments on pathological datasets spanning breast, lung, and ovarian cancers demonstrate its superior performance in few-shot pathology diagnosis. Codes are available at https://github.com/dddavid4real/FOCUS.
papers.title_zh: FOCUS: 微短镜头全幻灯片图像分类知识增强的适应性视觉压缩
papers.abstract_zh: 少见的学习是计算病理学(CPath)中癌症诊断的关键解决办法,解决了数据可用性的根本限制,特别是专家说明的匮乏和病人隐私限制。 这一范式中的一个关键挑战源于整个幻灯片图象的有限培训组合与大量包含的补丁之间的内在差距,其中很大一部分补丁缺乏与诊断相关的信息,有可能削弱模型学习和关注关键诊断特征的能力。 虽然最近的工作试图通过纳入更多的知识来解决这一问题,但若干关键差距阻碍了进一步的进展:(1) 尽管出现了强大的病理基础模型,但其潜力基本上仍未开发,大多数方法都将其使用限于基本特征提取;(2) 目前的语言指导机制试图使文本提示与大量战地安全倡议的补丁同时一致,努力利用丰富的病理语义信息。 为此,我们引入了称为FOCUS(FOCUS)的增强知识的适应性视觉压缩框架,这一框架将病理调频和先前语言知识的独特结合,以便通过优先考虑歧视性的WSI补丁,对诊断相关区域进行重点分析。 我们的方法是执行一个渐进的三阶段压缩战略:我们首先利用调频器来消除全球视觉冗余,并将压缩功能与语言提示结合起来,以进行语义相关性评估,然后在保持空间一致性的同时,进行邻居认知的视觉标志过滤。 有关乳腺癌、肺癌和卵巢癌病理数据集的广泛实验表明,在几发病理诊断中,其性能优异,可在https://github.com/dddavid4real/FOCUS查阅代码。

papers.title: FANeRV: Frequency Separation and Augmentation based Neural Representation for Video
papers.authors: Li Yu, Zhihui Li, Chao Yao, Jimin Xiao, Moncef Gabbouj
papers.abstract: Neural representations for video (NeRV) have gained considerable attention for their strong performance across various video tasks. However, existing NeRV methods often struggle to capture fine spatial details, resulting in vague reconstructions. In this paper, we present a Frequency Separation and Augmentation based Neural Representation for video (FANeRV), which addresses these limitations with its core Wavelet Frequency Upgrade Block. This block explicitly separates input frames into high and low-frequency components using discrete wavelet transform, followed by targeted enhancement using specialized modules. Finally, a specially designed gated network effectively fuses these frequency components for optimal reconstruction. Additionally, convolutional residual enhancement blocks are integrated into the later stages of the network to balance parameter distribution and improve the restoration of high-frequency details. Experimental results demonstrate that FANeRV significantly improves reconstruction performance and excels in multiple tasks, including video compression, inpainting, and interpolation, outperforming existing NeRV methods.
papers.title_zh: FANERV: 频率分离和增强基于神经显示录像
papers.abstract_zh: 视频神经显示(NeRV)在各种视频任务中表现优异,引起了相当的重视,但是,现有的NeRV方法往往难以捕捉到细细的空间细节,导致模糊不清的重建。 在本文中,我们提出一个基于频率分离和增强的神经图示视频(FANERV),用其核心波波莱频率升级块处理这些限制。 这一块将输入框架明确分为高频和低频元件,使用离散波子变换,然后使用专门模块进行有针对性的增强。最后,一个专门设计的闭门网络将这些频率元件有效引信,以便进行最佳重建。 此外,将富集性残余增强块纳入网络的后期阶段,以平衡参数分布和改进高频细节的恢复。 实验结果表明,FANERV大大改进了重建业绩,在包括视频压缩、油漆和内插在内的多种任务方面表现优于现有NERV方法。

papers.title: Exploiting Temporal State Space Sharing for Video Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Syed Ariff Syed Hesham, Yun Liu, Guolei Sun, Henghui Ding, Jing Yang, Ender Konukoglu, Xue Geng, Xudong Jiang
papers.abstract: Video semantic segmentation (VSS) plays a vital role in understanding the temporal evolution of scenes. Traditional methods often segment videos frame-by-frame or in a short temporal window, leading to limited temporal context, redundant computations, and heavy memory requirements. To this end, we introduce a Temporal Video State Space Sharing (TV3S) architecture to leverage Mamba state space models for temporal feature sharing. Our model features a selective gating mechanism that efficiently propagates relevant information across video frames, eliminating the need for a memory-heavy feature pool. By processing spatial patches independently and incorporating shifted operation, TV3S supports highly parallel computation in both training and inference stages, which reduces the delay in sequential state space processing and improves the scalability for long video sequences. Moreover, TV3S incorporates information from prior frames during inference, achieving long-range temporal coherence and superior adaptability to extended sequences. Evaluations on the VSPW and Cityscapes datasets reveal that our approach outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new standard for VSS with consistent results across long video sequences. By achieving a good balance between accuracy and efficiency, TV3S shows a significant advancement in spatiotemporal modeling, paving the way for efficient video analysis. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Ashesham/TV3S.git.
papers.title_zh: 利用时空状态空间共享利用视频语义分割
papers.abstract_zh: 视频语义分离(VSS)在理解场景的时空演变方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 传统方法往往按框或短时间窗口对视频进行片段,导致有限的时间环境、重复的计算和沉重的内存要求。 为此,我们推出时空视频国家空间共享(TV3S)架构,利用Mamba州空间模型进行时间特征共享。 我们的模式有选择性的标记机制,通过视频框架有效传播相关信息,从而不再需要一个记忆重的特征库。 TV3S通过独立处理空间补丁和将转移的操作结合起来,支持在培训和推断阶段进行高度平行的计算,从而减少相继状态空间处理的延迟,并改进长视频序列的可缩放性。 此外,TV3S在推断期间纳入了先前框架的信息,实现了远程时间一致性和对延长序列的高度适应性。 对VSPW和城市景观数据集的评价表明,我们的方法优于目前的最新方法,为VSS制定了新的标准,在长视频序列中取得了一致的结果。 TV3S通过在准确性和效率之间取得良好平衡,在时空建模方面取得了显著进展,为高效的视频分析铺平了道路,该代码可在https://github.com/Ashesham/TV3S.git上公开查阅。

papers.title: ExpertAF: Expert Actionable Feedback from Video
papers.authors: Kumar Ashutosh, Tushar Nagarajan, Georgios Pavlakos, Kris Kitani, Kristen Grauman
papers.abstract: Feedback is essential for learning a new skill or improving one's current skill-level. However, current methods for skill-assessment from video only provide scores or compare demonstrations, leaving the burden of knowing what to do differently on the user. We introduce a novel method to generate actionable feedback (AF) from video of a person doing a physical activity, such as basketball or soccer. Our method takes a video demonstration and its accompanying 3D body pose and generates (1) free-form expert commentary describing what the person is doing well and what they could improve, and (2) a visual expert demonstration that incorporates the required corrections. We show how to leverage Ego-Exo4D's videos of skilled activity and expert commentary together with a strong language model to create a weakly-supervised training dataset for this task, and we devise a multimodal video-language model to infer coaching feedback. Our method is able to reason across multi-modal input combinations to output full-spectrum, actionable coaching--expert commentary, expert video retrieval, and expert pose generation--outperforming strong vision-language models on both established metrics and human preference studies.
papers.title_zh: 专家AF:来自视频的专家可采取行动的反馈
papers.abstract_zh: 反馈对于学习新技能或提高当前技能水平至关重要,然而,目前从视频中进行技能评估的方法只提供分数或比较演示,让用户承担了解不同做法的责任。 我们引入了一种新的方法,从一个人从事篮球或足球等体育活动的视频中产生可采取行动的反馈(AF)。 我们的方法是进行视频演示及其随附的3D身体摆设,产生(1) 自由形式专家评论,描述个人正在做的好事和他们可以改进什么,(2) 包含所需更正的视觉专家示范。 我们展示如何利用Ego-Exo4D的熟练活动视频和专家评论,以及强大的语言模式,为这项任务创建受微弱监督的培训数据集,我们设计了多式视频语言模式,以推断指导反馈。 我们的方法能够通过多模式投入组合来解释产出全方位、可操作的教练-专家评论、专家视频检索和专家在既定计量和人类偏好研究中都提出了一代人外的强大视觉语言模型。

papers.title: Enhancing SAM with Efficient Prompting and Preference Optimization for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Aishik Konwer, Zhijian Yang, Erhan Bas, Cao Xiao, Prateek Prasanna, Parminder Bhatia, Taha Kass-Hout
papers.abstract: Foundational models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) are gaining traction in medical imaging segmentation, supporting multiple downstream tasks. However, such models are supervised in nature, still relying on large annotated datasets or prompts supplied by experts. Conventional techniques such as active learning to alleviate such limitations are limited in scope and still necessitate continuous human involvement and complex domain knowledge for label refinement or establishing reward ground truth. To address these challenges, we propose an enhanced Segment Anything Model (SAM) framework that utilizes annotation-efficient prompts generated in a fully unsupervised fashion, while still capturing essential semantic, location, and shape information through contrastive language-image pretraining and visual question answering. We adopt the direct preference optimization technique to design an optimal policy that enables the model to generate high-fidelity segmentations with simple ratings or rankings provided by a virtual annotator simulating the human annotation process. State-of-the-art performance of our framework in tasks such as lung segmentation, breast tumor segmentation, and organ segmentation across various modalities, including X-ray, ultrasound, and abdominal CT, justifies its effectiveness in low-annotation data scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 加强SAM,对半监督医疗图像分割进行高效快速和优先优化的半监督医疗图像分割
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如 " 片段 " 模式(SAM)等基本模型在医学成像分离方面正在获得牵引作用,支持多项下游任务,然而,这类模型在性质上受到监督,仍然依赖大量附加说明的数据集或专家提供的提示。 诸如积极学习以减轻这种限制的常规技术,其范围有限,仍需要人的持续参与和复杂的领域知识,以完善标签或确立奖励性的实地真相。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议一个强化的 " 部分无所事事模式 " 框架,利用以完全不受监督的方式生成的注释高效提示提示,同时仍然通过对比性语言图像培训前和视觉问题回答掌握基本的语义、位置和形状信息。 我们采用了直接优惠优化技术,以设计一种最佳政策,使该模型能够产生高纤维分化,通过模拟人类批注过程的虚拟代言人提供简单的评级或排名。 我们的框架在诸如肺分解、乳腺癌分解以及包括X射线、超声波和腹部CT在内的各种模式的器官分解等任务方面最先进的业绩证明,在低批注数据情景中,它的有效性是有道理的。

papers.title: Enhancing Online Continual Learning with Plug-and-Play State Space Model and Class-Conditional Mixture of Discretization
papers.authors: Sihao Liu, Yibo Yang, Xiaojie Li, David A. Clifton, Bernard Ghanem
papers.abstract: Online continual learning (OCL) seeks to learn new tasks from data streams that appear only once, while retaining knowledge of previously learned tasks. Most existing methods rely on replay, focusing on enhancing memory retention through regularization or distillation. However, they often overlook the adaptability of the model, limiting the ability to learn generalizable and discriminative features incrementally from online training data.To address this, we introduce a plug-and-play module, S6MOD, which can be integrated into most existing methods and directly improve adaptability. Specifically, S6MOD introduces an extra branch after the backbone, where a mixture of discretization selectively adjusts parameters in a selective state space model, enriching selective scan patterns such that the model can adaptively select the most sensitive discretization method for current dynamics.We further design a class-conditional routing algorithm for dynamic, uncertainty-based adjustment and implement a contrastive discretization loss to optimize it. Extensive experiments combining our module with various models demonstrate that S6MOD significantly enhances model adaptability, leading to substantial performance gains and achieving the state-of-the-art results. The code is available at https://github.com/MyToumaKazusa/S6MOD.
papers.title_zh: 利用插和插插国家空间模型和分类条件分解混合,加强在线持续学习
papers.abstract_zh: 在线持续学习(OCL)试图从仅出现一次的数据流中学习新任务,同时保留对以往所学到任务的知识。 大多数现有方法依靠重播,侧重于通过正规化或蒸馏加强记忆保留。 然而,他们往往忽视模型的可调适性,限制了从在线培训数据中逐步学习普遍和歧视性特征的能力。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一个插接和游戏模块S6MOD, 它可以融入大多数现有方法,直接改进适应性。 具体地说,S6MOD在主干后引入了一个额外的分支,其中分解化组合有选择地调整了选择性国家空间模型中的参数,丰富了选择性扫描模式,使模型能够适应性地选择当前动态的最敏感分解方法。 我们还为动态的、基于不确定性的调整设计了级条件路径算法,并实施了对比性分解损失以优化其优化。 将我们的模块与各种模型相结合的广泛实验表明,S6MOD极大地增强了模型的适应能力,从而取得了巨大的绩效收益并取得了最新成果,该代码可在https://github.com/MyToumaKazusa/S6MOD上查阅,网址是https://github.com/MyToumaKazusa/S6MOD。

papers.title: EMOE: Modality-Specific Enhanced Dynamic Emotion Experts
papers.authors: Yiyang Fang, Wenke Huang, Guancheng Wan, Kehua Su, Mang Ye
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) aims to predict human emotions by leveraging multiple modalities, such as vision, acoustics, and language. However, due to the heterogeneity of these modalities, MER faces two key challenges: modality balance dilemma and modality specialization disappearance. Existing methods often overlook the varying importance of modalities across samples in tackling the modality balance dilemma. Moreover, mainstream decoupling methods, while preserving modality-specific information, often neglect the predictive capability of unimodal data. To address these, we propose a novel model, Modality-Specific Enhanced Dynamic Emotion Experts (EMOE), consisting of: (1) Mixture of Modality Experts for dynamically adjusting modality importance based on sample features, and (2) Unimodal Distillation to retain single-modality predictive ability within fused features. EMOE enables adaptive fusion by learning a unique modality weight distribution for each sample, enhancing multimodal predictions with single-modality predictions to balance invariant and specific features in emotion recognition. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that EMOE achieves superior or comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, we extend EMOE to Multimodal Intent Recognition (MIR), further demonstrating its effectiveness and versatility.
papers.title_zh: EMOE: 模式-具体特点增强动态情感专家
papers.abstract_zh: 多模式情感认知(MER)旨在通过利用多种模式(如视觉、声学和语言)预测人的情感,但是,由于这些模式的多样性,MER面临两大挑战:模式平衡两难和模式专业化消失。 现有方法往往忽略了不同样本在解决模式平衡难题方面不同模式的不同重要性。 此外,主流解耦方法在保留特定模式信息的同时,往往忽视单模式数据的预测能力。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个新型模式,即 " 模式特异增强动态情感专家 " (EMOE),其中包括:(1) 模式专家组合,以便根据样本特征动态调整模式的重要性,以及(2) 将单一模式预测能力保留在引信特性中。 EMOE通过学习每种样本独特的模式重量分布,加强多式预测,加上单一方式预测,以平衡情感识别的变异性和具体特征,使适应性融合成为可能。 基准数据集的实验结果表明,EMOE的性能优于或可比于最先进的方法。 此外,我们把EMOE推广到多模式元素识别(MIR ) , 进一步证明了其有效性和多功能性。

papers.title: Efficient Concertormer for Image Deblurring and Beyond
papers.authors: Pin-Hung Kuo · Jinshan Pan · Shao-Yi Chien · Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: The Transformer architecture has excelled in NLP and vision tasks, but its self-attention complexity grows quadratically with image size, making high-resolution tasks computationally expensive. We introduce { ours}, featuring Concerto Self-Attention (CSA) for image deblurring. CSA splits self-attention into global and local components while retaining partial information in additional dimensions, achieving linear complexity. A Cross-Dimensional Communication module enhances expressiveness by linearly combining attention maps. Additionally, our gated-dconv MLP merges the two-staged Transformer design into a single stage. Extensive evaluations show our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art works in deblurring, deraining, and JPEG artifact removal. Code and models will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 图像稀释及其他图像高效协奏器
papers.abstract_zh: 变换器结构在NLP和视觉任务中取得了卓越成就,但其自我关注的复杂性随着图像大小的四重奏式增长,高分辨率任务在计算上变得昂贵。 我们引入了 { ours} , 以协奏自控( CSA)为主 , 用于图像破碎 。 加空局将自我关注分为全球和地方部分,同时保留额外部分信息,实现线性复杂度,跨多功能通信模块通过线性合并关注地图,提高表达性。 此外,我们的Gated-dconv MLP将两级变形器设计合并到一个单一的阶段。 广泛的评估表明,我们的方法优于最先进的拆解、排污和JPEG工艺品清除工程。 代码和模型将公开提供。

papers.title: Dynamic Attention Mechanism in Spatiotemporal Memory Networks for Object Tracking
papers.authors: Meng Zhou, Jiadong Xie, Mingsheng Xu
papers.abstract: Mainstream visual object tracking frameworks predominantly rely on template matching paradigms. Their performance heavily depends on the quality of template features, which becomes increasingly challenging to maintain in complex scenarios involving target deformation, occlusion, and background clutter. While existing spatiotemporal memory-based trackers emphasize memory capacity expansion, they lack effective mechanisms for dynamic feature selection and adaptive fusion.
