papers.title: Automatic Controllable Colorization via Imagination
papers.authors: Xiaoyan Cong, Yue Wu, Qifeng Chen, Chenyang Lei
papers.abstract: We propose a framework for automatic colorization that allows for iterative editing and modifications. The core of our framework lies in an imagination module: by understanding the content within a grayscale image we utilize a pre-trained image generation model to generate multiple images that contain the same content. These images serve as references for coloring mimicking the process of human experts. As the synthesized images can be imperfect or different from the original grayscale image we propose a Reference Refinement Module to select the optimal reference composition. Unlike most previous end-to-end automatic colorization algorithms our framework allows for iterative and localized modifications of the colorization results because we explicitly model the coloring samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our framework over existing automatic colorization algorithms in editability and flexibility. Project page: https://xy-cong.github.io/imagine-colorization/.
papers.title_zh: 通过想象的自动控制色彩化
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提议一个自动色化框架,允许迭代编辑和修改。 我们框架的核心在于想象模块:通过理解灰度图像中的内容,我们使用一个经过培训的图像生成模型生成包含相同内容的多个图像。 这些图像是模仿人类专家过程的色彩化参考。 由于合成图像可能不完善或与原始灰度图像不同,我们建议建立一个参考精炼模块,以选择最佳参考构成。 与以往大多数端到端自动颜色化算法不同,我们的框架允许对颜色化结果进行迭代和局部修改,因为我们明确地模拟了颜色化样本。 广泛的实验表明,在可编辑性和灵活性方面,我们的框架优于现有的自动色化算法,项目网页:https://xy-cong.github.io/imagine-colorization/。

papers.title: Are They the Same? Exploring Visual Correspondence Shortcomings of Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Yikang Zhou · Tao Zhang · Shilin Xu · Shihao Chen · Qianyu Zhou · Yunhai Tong · Shunping Ji · Jiangning Zhang · Lu Qi · Xiangtai Li
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal large language models (MLLM) have shown a strong ability in visual perception, reasoning abilities, and vision-language understanding. However, the visual matching ability of MLLMs is rarely studied, despite finding the visual correspondence of objects is essential in computer vision. Our research reveals that the matching capabilities in recent MLLMs still exhibit systematic shortcomings, even with current strong MLLMs models, GPT-4o. In particular, we construct a Multimodal Visual Matching (MMVM) benchmark to fairly benchmark over 30 different MLLMs. The MMVM benchmark is built from 15 open-source datasets and Internet videos with manual annotation. In addition, we have designed an automatic annotation pipeline to generate the MMVM SFT dataset, including 220K visual matching data with reasoning annotation. To our knowledge, this is the first MLLMs dataset and benchmark for the MLLM community. Finally, we present CoLVA, a novel contrastive MLLM with two novel technical designs: fine-grained vision expert with object-level contrastive learning and instruction augmentation strategy. The former learns instance discriminative tokens, while the latter further improves instruction following ability. CoLVA-InternVL2-4B achieves an overall accuracy (OA) of 49.80% on the MMVM benchmark, surpassing GPT-4o and the best open-source MLLM, Qwen2VL-72B, by 7.15% and 11.72% OA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our MMVM SFT dataset and our novel technical designs. Code, benchmark, dataset, and models will be released.
papers.title_zh: 探索多模式LMS的视觉对应缺陷
papers.abstract_zh: 最近多式大型语言模型(MLLM)的进步在视觉感知、推理能力和视觉语言理解方面显示出很强的能力。 然而,尽管发现物体的视觉对应在计算机视觉中至关重要,但很少研究MLLMS的视觉匹配能力。 我们的研究显示,最近的MLLMs的匹配能力仍然表现出系统性的缺陷,即使目前强大的MLLMs模型(GPT-4o ) , 也存在系统性的缺陷。 特别是,我们构建了一个多模式视觉匹配基准(MMVM ) , 以相当程度上衡量超过30个MLMs。 MMVM基准来自15个公开源数据集和带有人工注释的互联网视频,此外,我们还设计了一个自动注解管道,以生成MMVM SFT数据集,包括220K视觉匹配数据与推理注解。 据我们所知,这是MLLM社区的第一个MLLM数据集和基准。 最后,我们向大家介绍COLVA(COLVA),这是一个新颖的对比性MLLM(COLLM),拥有两种新颖的技术设计:精细的视觉专家,具有目标水平的对比学习和教学增强战略。 前者学习歧视符号实例,而后者则根据能力进一步提高教学质量。 CoLVA-InternVL2-4B在MMVM基准上达到49.80%的总精确度,分别超过GPT-4o和最佳开放源MLLM,Qwen2VL-72B, 分别为7.15%和11.72% OA。 这些结果表明,我们的MMVM SFT数据集和我们新的技术设计是有效的。 代码、基准、数据集和模型将予公布。

papers.title: AdaShift: Learning Discriminative Self-Gated Neural Feature Activation With an Adaptive Shift Factor
papers.authors: Sudong Cai
papers.abstract: Nonlinearities are decisive in neural representation learning. Traditional Activation (Act) functions impose fixed inductive biases on neural networks with oriented biological intuitions. Recent methods leverage self-gated curves to compensate for the rigid traditional Act paradigms in fitting flexibility. However substantial improvements are still impeded by the norm-induced mismatched feature re-calibrations (see Section 1) i.e. the actual importance of a feature can be inconsistent with its explicit intensity such that violates the basic intention of a direct self-gated feature re-weighting. To address this problem we propose to learn discriminative neural feature Act with a novel prototype namely AdaShift which enhances typical self-gated Act by incorporating an adaptive shift factor into the re-weighting function of Act. AdaShift casts dynamic translations on the inputs of a re-weighting function by exploiting comprehensive feature-filter context cues of different ranges in a simple yet effective manner. We obtain the new intuitions of AdaShift by rethinking the feature-filter relationships from a common Softmax-based classification and by generalizing the new observations to a common learning layer that encodes features with updatable filters. Our practical AdaShifts built upon the new Act prototype demonstrate significant improvements to the popular/SOTA Act functions on different vision benchmarks. By simply replacing ReLU with AdaShifts ResNets can match advanced Transformer counterparts (e.g. ResNet-50 vs. Swin-T) with lower cost and fewer parameters.
papers.title_zh: AdaShifft:学习带有适应性转变因子的有歧视的自制神经特征活动
papers.abstract_zh: 非线性在神经代言学习中具有决定性作用,传统活动功能对具有定向生物直觉的神经网络施加固定的直觉偏见,最近采用的方法利用自制曲线来弥补僵硬的传统法律模式,使其具有适当的灵活性。 然而,规范引起的不匹配特征重新校准(见第1节)仍然阻碍着实质性的改进,即一个特征的实际重要性可能与其明确强度不符,从而违反直接自我调整特征重新加权的基本意图。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议学习《歧视性神经特征法》,采用新颖的原型,即Adashift, 通过在该法的重新加权功能中纳入适应性转变因素,加强典型的自我调整法。 Adashift以简单而有效的方式利用不同范围的综合特征过滤器提示,对重新加权功能的投入进行动态翻译。 我们从共同的Softmax分类中重新思考特征过滤器关系,将新的观察结果归纳为共同的学习层次,将高端过滤器编码成共同的学习层次,从而获得阿达希夫特的新直觉。 我们基于新法案原型的实用Ada Shifts(Ada Shifts)展示了民众/SOTA(SOTA)法案在不同视觉基准上的功能的重大改进。 简单地用Adahifts ResNets(ReLU)取代ReLU(ReLU )可以将先进的Transformer对应方(如ResNet-50对Swin-T)与较低成本和较少参数相匹配。

papers.title: AdaIFL: Adaptive Image Forgery Localization via a Dynamic and Importance-aware Transformer Network
papers.authors: Yuxi Li · Fuyuan Cheng · Wangbo Yu · Guangshuo Wang · Guibo Luo · Yuesheng Zhu
papers.abstract: The rapid development of image processing and manipulation techniques poses unprecedented challenges in multimedia forensics, especially in Image Forgery Localization (IFL). This paper addresses two key challenges in IFL: (1) Various forgery techniques leave distinct forensic traces. However, existing models overlook variations among forgery patterns. The diversity of forgery techniques makes it challenging for a single static detection method and network structure to be universally applicable. To address this, we propose AdaIFL, a dynamic IFL framework that customizes various expert groups for different network components, constructing multiple distinct feature subspaces. By leveraging adaptively activated experts, AdaIFL can capture discriminative features associated with forgery patterns, thereby enhancing the model's generalization ability. (2) Many forensic traces and artifacts are located at the boundaries of the forged region. Existing models either ignore the differences in discriminative information or use edge supervision loss to force the model to focus on the region boundaries. This hard-constrained approach is prone to attention bias, causing the model to be overly sensitive to image edges or fail to finely capture all forensic traces. To address this, we propose a feature importance-aware attention, a flexible approach that adaptively perceives the importance of different regions and aggregates region features into variable-length tokens, directing the model's attention towards more discriminative and informative regions. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaIFL outperforms state-of-the-art image forgery localization methods.
papers.title_zh: AdaIFL:通过动态和有重要意识的变形器网络使适应性图像伪造本地化
papers.abstract_zh: 图像处理和操纵技术的迅速发展给多媒体法证工作,特别是图像伪造本地化(IFL)带来了前所未有的挑战,本文讨论了IFL的两个主要挑战:(1) 各种伪造技术留下不同的法证痕迹。 然而,现有的模型忽略了伪造模式的差异,伪造技术的多样性使得单一静态探测方法和网络结构难以普遍适用。 为此,我们提议AdaIFL,这是一个动态的IFL框架,针对不同网络组件定制不同的专家组,建造多个不同的特征子空间。 通过利用适应性活化专家,AdaIFL可以捕捉与伪造模式有关的歧视性特征,从而加强模型的概括能力。 (2) 许多法医痕迹和人工制品位于伪造区域的边界。 现有模型要么忽视歧视性信息的差异,要么利用边缘监管损失迫使模型关注区域边界。 这种严格限制的做法容易引起注意偏差,导致模型对图像边缘过于敏感,或者无法精确地捕捉所有法证痕迹。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采取特别重视的重要态度,采取灵活的做法,适应性地认识到不同区域和综合区域特点的重要性,形成不同长度的象征物,将模型的注意力引向更具有歧视和信息性的区域。 关于基准数据集的广泛实验表明,AdaIFL的成像率超过了最先进的伪造图像本地化方法。

papers.title: Active Prompt Learning in Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Jihwan Bang, Sumyeong Ahn, Jae-Gil Lee
papers.abstract: Pre-trained Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated notable progress in various zero-shot tasks such as classification and retrieval. Despite their performance because improving performance on new tasks requires task-specific knowledge their adaptation is essential. While labels are needed for the adaptation acquiring them is typically expensive. To overcome this challenge active learning a method of achieving a high performance by obtaining labels for a small number of samples from experts has been studied. Active learning primarily focuses on selecting unlabeled samples for labeling and leveraging them to train models. In this study we pose the question "how can the pre-trained VLMs be adapted under the active learning framework?" In response to this inquiry we observe that (1) simply applying a conventional active learning framework to pre-trained VLMs even may degrade performance compared to random selection because of the class imbalance in labeling candidates and (2) the knowledge of VLMs can provide hints for achieving the balance before labeling. Based on these observations we devise a novel active learning framework for VLMs denoted as PCB. To assess the effectiveness of our approach we conduct experiments on seven different real-world datasets and the results demonstrate that PCB surpasses conventional active learning and random sampling methods.
papers.title_zh: 视力语言模式的积极快速学习
papers.abstract_zh: 预先培训的视觉语言模型(VLMs)在分类和检索等各种零结果任务方面取得了显著进展,尽管由于改进新任务的业绩需要具体任务知识,因此它们必须加以调整。 为克服这一挑战,已经研究过一种方法,通过从专家获得少量样本的标签,实现高性能。 积极学习的主要重点是选择未贴标签的样本进行标签,并利用这些样本培训模型。 在这项研究中,我们提出了这样一个问题,即“在积极的学习框架内如何调整经过培训的甚低频LM?” 在回答这项询问时,我们注意到:(1) 仅仅对经过培训的甚低频LMS适用常规的积极学习框架,可能与随机选择相比降低业绩,因为给候选人贴标签的阶级不平衡;(2) 对甚低频LMS的知识可以提供在标签之前实现平衡的提示。 根据这些观察结果,我们为VLMs设计了一个称为PCB的新颖的积极学习框架。 为了评估我们方法的有效性,我们用七个不同的真实世界数据集进行实验,结果显示PCB超过了常规的积极学习和随机抽样方法。

papers.title: A2XP: Towards Private Domain Generalization
papers.authors: Geunhyeok Yu, Hyoseok Hwang
papers.abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have become pivotal in various fields especially in computer vision outperforming previous methodologies. A critical challenge in their deployment is the bias inherent in data across different domains such as image style and environmental conditions leading to domain gaps. This necessitates techniques for learning general representations from biased training data known as domain generalization. This paper presents Attend to eXpert Prompts (A2XP) a novel approach for domain generalization that preserves the privacy and integrity of the network architecture. A2XP consists of two phases: Expert Adaptation and Domain Generalization. In the first phase prompts for each source domain are optimized to guide the model towards the optimal direction. In the second phase two embedder networks are trained to effectively amalgamate these expert prompts aiming for an optimal output. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that A2XP achieves state-of-the-art results over existing non-private domain generalization methods. The experimental results validate that the proposed approach not only tackles the domain generalization challenge in DNNs but also offers a privacy-preserving efficient solution to the broader field of computer vision.
papers.title_zh: A2XP: 走向私有领域普遍化
papers.abstract_zh: 深神经网络(DNNs)在各个领域都变得至关重要,特别是在计算机视觉超过以往方法方面。 其部署所面临的一个重大挑战是,在图像风格和环境条件等不同领域的数据中存在固有的偏差,导致领域差距。 因此,必须采用各种技术,从所谓的域别概括化的有偏见的培训数据中学习一般说明,本文介绍了对eXpert Expresss(A2XP)的处理,这是对域别概括的一种新办法,它维护了网络架构的隐私和完整性。 A2XP由两个阶段组成:专家适应和广域化。第一阶段,优化每个源域的提示,以引导模型走向最佳方向。第二阶段,培训了两个嵌入器网络,以有效地将这些专家提示结合起来,从而实现最佳产出。 我们的广泛实验表明,A2XP相对于现有的非私人领域的普遍化方法而言,取得了最先进的成果。 实验结果证实,拟议办法不仅解决了DNN的域域泛化挑战,而且为更广泛的计算机视野领域提供了保护隐私的有效解决办法。

papers.title: Video Relationship Detection Using Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Ala Shaabana, Zahra Gharaee, Paul Fieguth
papers.abstract: Machine comprehension of visual information from images and videos by neural networks suffers from two limitations: (1) the computational and inference gap in vision and language to accurately determine which object a given agent acts on and then to represent it by language, and (2) the shortcoming in stability and generalization of the classifier trained by a single, monolithic neural network. To address these limitations, we propose MoE-VRD, a novel approach to visual relationship detection via a mixture of experts. MoE-VRD recognizes language triplets in the form of a < subject, predicate, object > tuple to extract the relationship between subject, predicate, and object from visual processing. Since detecting a relationship between a subject (acting) and the object(s) (being acted upon) requires that the action be recognized, we base our network on recent work in visual relationship detection. To address the limitations associated with single monolithic networks, our mixture of experts is based on multiple small models, whose outputs are aggregated. That is, each expert in MoE-VRD is a visual relationship learner capable of detecting and tagging objects. MoE-VRD employs an ensemble of networks while preserving the complexity and computational cost of the original underlying visual relationship model by applying a sparsely-gated mixture of experts, which allows for conditional computation and a significant gain in neural network capacity. We show that the conditional computation capabilities and massive ability to scale the mixture-of-experts leads to an approach to the visual relationship detection problem which outperforms the state-of-the-art.
papers.title_zh: 利用专家混合体探测视频关系
papers.abstract_zh: 神经网络对图像和视频的图像和视频的机能理解存在两个限制:(1) 视觉和语言的计算和推论差距,以准确确定某一代理人对哪一种物体采取行动,然后用语言代表该物体;(2) 由一个单一单一神经网络培训的分类员的稳定性和普遍性存在缺陷。 为解决这些限制,我们建议MoE-VRD,这是一个通过专家混合探测视觉关系的新办法。 MoE-VRD承认语言三重,其形式为 < 主体、 上游、 对象 > ,以从视觉处理中提取对象、 上游和对象之间的关系。 由于发现一个主体(行为)与对象(行为)之间的关系要求承认有关行动,我们网络以近期的视觉关系探测工作为基础。 为解决单一单一单一石板网络的局限性,我们的专家混合以多种小型模型为基础,其产出是综合的,即MoE-VRD的每一位专家都是视觉关系学习者,能够探测和标记物体。 能源部-VRD采用一系列网络,同时通过采用分散的专家混合方法,保持原始基本视觉关系模型的复杂性和计算成本,从而可以有条件地计算和大幅提高神经网络能力。 我们显示,有条件的计算能力和大规模扩大专家混合能力导致对视觉关系探测问题采取一种方法,其表现优于最新技术。

papers.title: TaskExpert: Dynamically Assembling Multi-Task Representations with Memorial Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Hanrong Ye, Dan Xu
papers.abstract: Learning discriminative task-specific features simultaneously for multiple distinct tasks is a fundamental problem in multi-task learning. Recent state-of-the-art models consider directly decoding task-specific features from one shared task-generic feature (e.g., feature from a backbone layer), and utilize carefully designed decoders to produce multi-task features. However, as the input feature is fully shared and each task decoder also shares decoding parameters for different input samples, it leads to a static feature decoding process, producing less discriminative task-specific representations. To tackle this limitation, we propose TaskExpert, a novel multi-task mixture-of-experts model that enables learning multiple representative task-generic feature spaces and decoding task-specific features in a dynamic manner. Specifically, TaskExpert introduces a set of expert networks to decompose the backbone feature into several representative task-generic features. Then, the task-specific features are decoded by using dynamic task-specific gating networks operating on the decomposed task-generic features. Furthermore, to establish long-range modeling of the task-specific representations from different layers of TaskExpert, we design a multi-task feature memory that updates at each layer and acts as an additional feature expert for dynamic task-specific feature decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our TaskExpert clearly outperforms previous best-performing methods on all 9 metrics of two competitive multi-task learning benchmarks for visual scene understanding (i.e., PASCAL-Context and NYUD-v2). Code and models will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 任务专家:以纪念专家混合组合方式动态组合多任务代表机构
papers.abstract_zh: 为多重不同的任务同时学习歧视性任务特点,是多任务学习中的一个根本问题。 最近最先进的模型考虑从一个共同的任务类型特征(例如,主干层的特征)直接解码特定任务特征,并利用精心设计的解码器生成多任务特征。 然而,由于投入特征完全共享,每个任务编码器也共享不同输入样本的解码参数,因此导致静态特征解码过程,产生较少歧视性的特定任务表述。 为了克服这一限制,我们提议任务专家,这是一个新的多任务专家混合模式,能够以动态方式学习具有代表性的多重任务 -- -- 遗传特征空间和具体任务的解码特征。 具体而言,任务专家引入了一套专家网络,将主干特征分解成若干具有代表性的任务类型特征,然后,通过使用以分解的任务类型特征为操作功能的动态任务特定格子网络,对任务特定特征进行解码。 此外,为了建立任务专家不同层面具体任务代表的长程模型,我们设计了多任务特征记忆,在每一层面更新,并担任动态任务具体特点解码的又一名专题专家。 广泛的实验表明,我们的任务专家在两种竞争性多任务学习基准(即PASCAL-Context和NYUD-v2)的所有9个衡量标准上,明显优于以往的最佳业绩方法,以了解视觉场景。 守则和模型将公布于众。

papers.authors: Zhenxing Mi, Dan Xu
papers.title_zh: Switch-NERRF:学习场景分解,与大型神经辐射场专家混合

papers.title: Sparsely-gated Mixture-of-Expert Layers for CNN Interpretability
papers.authors: Svetlana Pavlitska, Christian Hubschneider, Lukas Struppek, J. Marius Zöllner
papers.abstract: Sparsely-gated Mixture of Expert (MoE) layers have been recently successfully applied for scaling large transformers, especially for language modeling tasks. An intriguing side effect of sparse MoE layers is that they convey inherent interpretability to a model via natural expert specialization. In this work, we apply sparse MoE layers to CNNs for computer vision tasks and analyze the resulting effect on model interpretability. To stabilize MoE training, we present both soft and hard constraint-based approaches. With hard constraints, the weights of certain experts are allowed to become zero, while soft constraints balance the contribution of experts with an additional auxiliary loss. As a result, soft constraints handle expert utilization better and support the expert specialization process, while hard constraints maintain more generalized experts and increase overall model performance. Our findings demonstrate that experts can implicitly focus on individual sub-domains of the input space. For example, experts trained for CIFAR-100 image classification specialize in recognizing different domains such as flowers or animals without previous data clustering. Experiments with RetinaNet and the COCO dataset further indicate that object detection experts can also specialize in detecting objects of distinct sizes.
papers.title_zh: 用于CNN可解释性的 分散式带宽的专家混合图层
papers.abstract_zh: 最近成功应用了分散式的专家混合(MoE)层来缩放大型变压器,特别是语言模型任务。 稀疏的MOE层的一个有趣的副作用是它们通过自然专家专业化将内在的解释传递给模型。 在这项工作中,我们对CNN的计算机视觉任务应用了微薄的MoE层次,并分析了对模型可解释性的影响。 为了稳定MoE的培训,我们提出了软和硬的制约性方法。 在困难的制约下,某些专家的权重被允许为零,而软性限制则在专家的贡献与额外附带损失之间取得平衡。 因此,软性限制能更好地利用专家,支持专家专业化进程,而硬性限制能维持更普遍的专家和提高总体示范业绩,我们的研究结果表明,专家可以隐含地侧重于投入空间的个别次领域。 例如,受过CIFAR-100图像分类培训的专家专门认识不同领域,如花卉或动物,而没有以前的数据组合。 与RetinaNet和COCO数据集进行的实验进一步表明,物体探测专家也可以专门探测不同大小的物体。

papers.title: ShiftAddViT: Mixture of Multiplication Primitives Towards Efficient Vision Transformer
papers.authors: Haoran You, Huihong Shi, Yipin Guo, Yingyan
papers.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown impressive performance and have become a unified backbone for multiple vision tasks. However, both the attention mechanism and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) in ViTs are not sufficiently efficient due to dense multiplications, leading to costly training and inference. To this end, we propose to reparameterize pre-trained ViTs with a mixture of multiplication primitives, e.g., bitwise shifts and additions, towards a new type of multiplication-reduced model, dubbed $ShiftAddViT$, which aims to achieve end-to-end inference speedups on GPUs without requiring training from scratch. Specifically, all $MatMuls$ among queries, keys, and values are reparameterized using additive kernels, after mapping queries and keys to binary codes in Hamming space. The remaining MLPs or linear layers are then reparameterized with shift kernels. We utilize TVM to implement and optimize those customized kernels for practical hardware deployment on GPUs. We find that such a reparameterization on attention maintains model accuracy, while inevitably leading to accuracy drops when being applied to MLPs. To marry the best of both worlds, we further propose a new mixture of experts (MoE) framework to reparameterize MLPs by taking multiplication or its primitives as experts, e.g., multiplication and shift, and designing a new latency-aware load-balancing loss. Such a loss helps to train a generic router for assigning a dynamic amount of input tokens to different experts according to their latency. Extensive experiments on various 2D/3D Transformer-based vision tasks consistently validate the effectiveness of our proposed ShiftAddViT, achieving up to $5.18$ times$$ latency reductions on GPUs and $42.9$% energy savings, while maintaining a comparable accuracy as original or efficient ViTs.
papers.title_zh: ShiftAddVVT:实现高效视觉转换器的乘数驱动组合
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉Transformer表现出令人印象深刻的业绩,成为多重视觉任务的统一骨干,然而,由于倍增密度大,关注机制和维特的多层感知器(MLPs)效率都不够高,导致培训和推论费用高昂。 为此,我们建议对经过训练的VIT机进行重新校准,同时结合乘法原体,例如,按位推移和添加,改用一种新型的倍增减制模型,称为ShiftAddVit$,目的是在不需要从零开始培训的情况下,实现GPU的端到端推导加速。 具体地说,Query、钥匙和数值中所有MatMuls美元都使用添加式内核进行重新计量,在哈明空间绘制Query和二进制代码钥匙之后,再使用添加式内核进行重新计量。 其余的 MLP 或线性层则用移动内核进行重新计量。 我们利用TVM来实施和优化这些定制的内核,以便在GPU上实际部署硬件。 我们发现,这种关注的重新校准保持模型准确性,同时在应用到MLP时不可避免地导致精确性下降。 为了与两个世界中最好的人结合,我们进一步提议一个新的专家混合框架,通过乘法或原始的专家,如乘法和转换,以及设计新的长期通识负载平衡损失,对最低限值重新进行重新计量。 这种损失有助于培训通用路由器,以便根据不同专家的潜伏状态,向他们分配大量动态输入物证。 在基于2D/3D的变革型视觉任务方面进行的广泛试验始终如一地验证了我们拟议的 ShiftAddViT的有效性,实现了对通用燃料单位的5.18美元比0.1美元和42.9%的节能,同时保持了与原始或高效的虚拟技术相当的准确性。

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Dynamic Parameter for Video Inpainting Transformer
papers.authors: Eunhye Lee, Jinsu Yoo, Yunjeong Yang, Sungyong Baik, Tae Hyun Kim
papers.abstract: Recent learning-based video inpainting approaches have achieved considerable progress. However, they still cannot fully utilize semantic information within the video frames and predict improper scene layout, failing to restore clear object boundaries for mixed scenes. To mitigate this problem, we introduce a new transformer-based video inpainting technique that can exploit semantic information within the input and considerably improve reconstruction quality. In this study, we use the mixture-of-experts scheme and train multiple experts to handle mixed scenes, including various semantics. We leverage these multiple experts and produce locally (token-wise) different network parameters to achieve semantic-aware inpainting results. Extensive experiments on YouTube-VOS and DAVIS benchmark datasets demonstrate that, compared with existing conventional video inpainting approaches, the proposed method has superior performance in synthesizing visually pleasing videos with much clearer semantic structures and textures.
papers.title_zh: 视频油漆变形器的语义- 软件动态参数
papers.abstract_zh: 最近以学习为基础的录像油漆方法取得了相当大的进展,但是,它们仍然不能充分利用录像框内的语义信息并预测不当的场景布局,无法为混杂场景恢复清晰的物体边界。 为了缓解这一问题,我们采用了一种新的基于变压器的视频油漆技术,可以在投入中利用语义信息,大大改善重建质量。 在这项研究中,我们使用专家混合计划,并培训多位专家处理混杂的场景,包括各种语义学。 我们利用这些多位专家,并在当地(以现代方式)生成不同的网络参数,以取得语义认知的涂料效果。 有关YouTube-VOS和DAVIS基准数据集的广泛实验表明,与现有的传统视频油漆方法相比,拟议方法在以更清晰的语义结构和纹理综合视觉上令人愉快的视频方面表现优异。

papers.title: Robust Mixture-of-Expert Training for Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Yihua Zhang, Ruisi Cai, Tianlong Chen, Guanhua Zhang, Huan Zhang, Pin-Yu Chen, Shiyu Chang, Zhangyang Wang, Sijia Liu
papers.abstract: Sparsely-gated Mixture of Expert (MoE), an emerging deep model architecture, has demonstrated a great promise to enable high-accuracy and ultra-efficient model inference. Despite the growing popularity of MoE, little work investigated its potential to advance convolutional neural networks (CNNs), especially in the plane of adversarial robustness. Since the lack of robustness has become one of the main hurdles for CNNs, in this paper we ask: How to adversarially robustify a CNN-based MoE model? Can we robustly train it like an ordinary CNN model? Our pilot study shows that the conventional adversarial training (AT) mechanism (developed for vanilla CNNs) no longer remains effective to robustify an MoE-CNN. To better understand this phenomenon, we dissect the robustness of an MoE-CNN into two dimensions: Robustness of routers (i.e., gating functions to select data-specific experts) and robustness of experts (i.e., the router-guided pathways defined by the subnetworks of the backbone CNN). Our analyses show that routers and experts are hard to adapt to each other in the vanilla AT. Thus, we propose a new router-expert alternating Adversarial training framework for MoE, termed AdvMoE. The effectiveness of our proposal is justified across 4 commonly-used CNN model architectures over 4 benchmark datasets. We find that AdvMoE achieves 1% 4% adversarial robustness improvement over the original dense CNN, and enjoys the efficiency merit of sparsity-gated MoE, leading to more than 50% inference cost reduction.
papers.title_zh: 为革命神经网络提供强力专家混合培训
papers.abstract_zh: 正在形成的深层模型结构 -- -- 分散式专家混合体(MOE) -- -- 展现出一种巨大的希望,可以使高精确度和超高效模型推论成为可能。 尽管MoE越来越受欢迎,但很少调查该部推进神经神经网络(CNNs)的潜力,特别是在对抗性强力方面的潜力。 由于缺乏强力已成为CNN的主要障碍之一,我们在本文中询问:如何对抗性地巩固基于CNN的MOE模式? 我们能否像普通CNN模式那样大力训练它? 我们的试点研究表明,传统对抗性培训机制(为香草CNNs开发)不再有效加强MoE-CNN。 为了更好地了解这一现象,我们将MoE-CNN的稳健性分为两个层面:路由器的强健性(即指定具体数据专家的职能)和专家的稳健性(即CNN主干线子网络界定的路由器引导路径)。 我们的分析表明,在香草AT中,路由器和专家很难相互适应。 因此,我们提议为MoE(AdvMoE)建立一个新的路由器-专家交替对接培训框架。 我们的建议在四个常用的CNN模型结构(超过4个基准数据集)中的有效性是有道理的。 我们发现AdvMOE比原密集的CNN实现了1%4%的对抗性强力改善,并享受着分散化的MOE的效率优势,导致50%以上的推论成本降低。

papers.title: Multimodal Gated Mixture of Experts Using Whole Slide Image and Flow Cytometry for Multiple Instance Learning Classification of Lymphoma
papers.authors: Noriaki Hashimoto, Hiroyuki Hanada, Hiroaki Miyoshi, Miharu Nagaishi, Kensaku Sato, Hidekata Hontani, Koichi Ohshima, Ichiro Takeuchi
papers.abstract: In this study, we present a deep-learning-based multimodal classification method for lymphoma diagnosis in digital pathology, which utilizes a whole slide image (WSI) as the primary image data and flow cytometry (FCM) data as auxiliary information. In pathological diagnosis of malignant lymphoma, FCM serves as valuable auxiliary information during the diagnosis process, offering useful insights into predicting the major class (superclass) of subtypes. By incorporating both images and FCM data into the classification process, we can develop a method that mimics the diagnostic process of pathologists, enhancing the explainability. In order to incorporate the hierarchical structure between superclasses and their subclasses, the proposed method utilizes a network structure that effectively combines the mixture of experts (MoE) and multiple instance learning (MIL) techniques, where MIL is widely recognized for its effectiveness in handling WSIs in digital pathology. The MoE network in the proposed method consists of a gating network for superclass classification and multiple expert networks for (sub)class classification, specialized for each superclass. To evaluate the effectiveness of our method, we conducted experiments involving a six-class classification task using 600 lymphoma cases. The proposed method achieved a classification accuracy of 72.3%, surpassing the 69.5% obtained through the straightforward combination of FCM and images, as well as the 70.2% achieved by the method using only images. Moreover, the combination of multiple weights in the MoE and MIL allows for the visualization of specific cellular and tumor regions, resulting in a highly explanatory model that cannot be attained with conventional methods. It is anticipated that by targeting a larger number of classes and increasing the number of expert networks, the proposed method could be effectively applied to the real problem of lymphoma diagnosis.
papers.title_zh: 利用全幻灯片图像和流动电量测量法对伦巴马多例学习分类进行多式学习的专家的多式混合组合
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中,我们提出一种基于深学习的多式分类方法,用于数字病理学中的淋巴瘤诊断,这种方法使用整个幻灯片图像作为原始图像数据和流动细胞测量数据作为辅助信息。 在恶性淋巴瘤的病理诊断中,氟化烃在诊断过程中是宝贵的辅助信息,为预测子类型的主要类别(超级类别)提供了有用的洞察力。 通过将图像和含氯氟烃数据纳入分类过程,我们可以开发一种方法,模仿病理学家的诊断过程,提高解释性。 为了纳入超级类及其子类之间的等级结构,拟议方法采用了一种网络结构,有效地将专家(MoE)和多实例学习(MIL)技术相结合,在数字病理学中处理西方SI的效果被广泛承认为MIL。 拟议方法中的MoE网络包括一个超级级分类格子网和多个专家(次级)分类(次级)网络,专门针对每个超级级。 为了评估我们的方法的有效性,我们进行了实验,涉及使用600个淋巴瘤病例的六类分类任务。 拟议方法的分类精确度达到72.3%,超过了通过直接结合含氯氟烃和图像获得的69.5%的分类精确度,以及仅使用图像的方法达到的70.2%的分类精确度。 此外,MoE和MoE的多重权重相结合,使得特定细胞和肿瘤区域的可视化成为可能,从而形成了一种无法用常规方法达到的高度解释性模型。 预计,通过以更多的班级为目标和增加专家网络的数量,拟议方法可以有效地适用于淋巴瘤诊断的实际问题。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Gated Mixture of Local-to-Global Experts for Dynamic Image Fusion
papers.authors: Bing Cao, Yiming Sun, Pengfei Zhu, Qinghua Hu
papers.abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to integrate comprehensive information from multiple sources to achieve superior performances on various practical tasks, such as detection, over that of a single modality. However, most existing methods directly combined the texture details and object contrast of different modalities, ignoring the dynamic changes in reality, which diminishes the visible texture in good lighting conditions and the infrared contrast in low lighting conditions. To fill this gap, we propose a dynamic image fusion framework with a multi-modal gated mixture of local-to-global experts, termed MoE-Fusion, to dynamically extract effective and comprehensive information from the respective modalities. Our model consists of a Mixture of Local Experts (MoLE) and a Mixture of Global Experts (MoGE) guided by a multi-modal gate. The MoLE performs specialized learning of multi-modal local features, prompting the fused images to retain the local information in a sample-adaptive manner, while the MoGE focuses on the global information that complements the fused image with overall texture detail and contrast. Extensive experiments show that our MoE-Fusion outperforms state-of-the-art methods in preserving multi-modal image texture and contrast through the local-to-global dynamic learning paradigm, and also achieves superior performance on detection tasks. Our code is available: https://github.com/SunYM2020/MoE-Fusion.
papers.title_zh: 动态图像融合地方到全球专家多模式组合组合
papers.abstract_zh: 红外和可见的图像集成旨在综合多种来源的全面信息,以便在各种实际任务上取得优异的业绩,例如探测,而不是单一模式。 然而,大多数现有方法直接结合了纹理细节和不同模式的对象对比,忽视了现实中动态变化,这种变化减少了在良好照明条件下可见的纹理,减少了在低照明条件下的红外对比。 为了填补这一空白,我们提议建立一个动态图像融合框架,由当地专家到全球专家(称为MoE)的多模式组合,以动态方式从各自的模式中获取有效和全面的信息。 我们的模式由当地专家混合体(MOLE)和全球专家混合体(MOGE)组成,由多模式大门指导。 劳动与就业部对多模式地方特征进行专门学习,促使集成图像以采样适应的方式保留当地信息,而两性平等部则侧重于全球信息,以总体纹理细节和对比补充已装装成的图像。 广泛的实验表明,我们的MoE在保存多模式图像质地方面表现优于最先进的方法,并通过地方到全球的动态学习模式加以对比,并在探测任务上取得优异的成绩。 我们的代码可以查到:https://github.com/SunYM200/MoE-Fusion。

papers.title: Mod-Squad: Designing Mixtures of Experts As Modular Multi-Task Learners
papers.authors: Zitian Chen, Yikang Shen, Mingyu Ding, Zhenfang Chen, Hengshuang Zhao, Erik G. Learned-Miller, Chuang Gan
papers.abstract: Optimization in multi-task learning (MTL) is more challenging than single-task learning (STL), as the gradient from different tasks can be contradictory. When tasks are related, it can be beneficial to share some parameters among them (cooperation). However, some tasks require additional parameters with expertise in a specific type of data or discrimination (specialization). To address the MTL challenge, we propose Mod-Squad, a new model that is Modularized into groups of experts (a 'Squad'). This structure allows us to formalize cooperation and specialization as the process of matching experts and tasks. We optimize this matching process during the training of a single model. Specifically, we incorporate mixture of experts (MoE) layers into a transformer model, with a new loss that incorporates the mutual dependence between tasks and experts. As a result, only a small set of experts are activated for each task. This prevents the sharing of the entire backbone model between all tasks, which strengthens the model, especially when the training set size and the number of tasks scale up. More interestingly, for each task, we can extract the small set of experts as a standalone model that maintains the same performance as the large model. Extensive experiments on the Taskonomy dataset with 13 vision tasks and the PASCALContext dataset with 5 vision tasks show the superiority of our approach. The project page can be accessed at https://vis-www.cs.umass.edu/mod-squad.
papers.title_zh: 模形平方:将专家混合体设计为模块多任务学习者
papers.abstract_zh: 多任务学习(MTL)的最佳化比单任务学习(STL)更具挑战性,因为不同任务的梯度可能相互矛盾。 当任务相关时,分享某些参数(合作)可能是有益的。 然而,有些任务需要额外参数,在特定类型的数据或歧视(专门化)方面具备专门知识。 为了应对MTL的挑战,我们建议采用Mod-Squd, 这是一种新模式,将它分为专家组(“Squd”)。 这一结构使我们能够正式确定合作和专业化,作为匹配专家和任务的过程,我们在培训单一模式时优化这一匹配过程。 具体地说,我们把专家混合层纳入变压器模式,造成新的损失,包括任务和专家之间的相互依存,因此,每项任务只有一小部分专家被激活。 这阻碍了所有任务之间分享整个主干模式,这加强了模式,特别是当培训组的规模和任务数量扩大时。 更有趣的是,对于每一项任务,我们可以抽出一小批专家,作为保持与大型模型相同性能的独立模型。 具有13项视觉任务的任务的关于任务性数据集的广泛实验和有5项视觉任务的PACALContext数据集的大规模实验显示了我们方法的优势。 项目网页可在https://vis-www.cs.umass.edu/mod-squd上查阅。

papers.title: Mobile V-MoEs: Scaling Down Vision Transformers via Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Erik Daxberger, Floris Weers, Bowen Zhang, Tom Gunter, Ruoming Pang, Marcin Eichner, Michael Emmersberger, Yinfei Yang, Alexander Toshev, Xianzhi Du
papers.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models (MoEs) have recently gained popularity due to their ability to decouple model size from inference efficiency by only activating a small subset of the model parameters for any given input token. As such, sparse MoEs have enabled unprecedented scalability, resulting in tremendous successes across domains such as natural language processing and computer vision. In this work, we instead explore the use of sparse MoEs to scale-down Vision Transformers (ViTs) to make them more attractive for resource-constrained vision applications. To this end, we propose a simplified and mobile-friendly MoE design where entire images rather than individual patches are routed to the experts. We also propose a stable MoE training procedure that uses super-class information to guide the router. We empirically show that our sparse Mobile Vision MoEs (V-MoEs) can achieve a better trade-off between performance and efficiency than the corresponding dense ViTs. For example, for the ViT-Tiny model, our Mobile V-MoE outperforms its dense counterpart by 3.39% on ImageNet-1k. For an even smaller ViT variant with only 54M FLOPs inference cost, our MoE achieves an improvement of 4.66%.
papers.title_zh: 移动V-MoEs:通过Sparse Mixture 专家的 Sparse Mixture 移动V-MoEs: 向下扩展视野Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,由于能够将模型大小与推论效率解耦,只为任何特定输入符号激活一个很小的模型参数子集,因此Sprassy Mixture of-Experts 模型(MOEs)最近越来越受欢迎。 因此,MoE的缺乏使规模空前扩大,导致自然语言处理和计算机视觉等领域取得巨大成功。 相反,在这项工作中,我们探索利用稀疏的MoE来缩小视觉Transformer的规模,使其对资源受限制的视觉应用更具吸引力。 为此,我们提出一个简化的移动友好型MoE设计,将整个图像而不是单个的补丁交给专家。 我们还提议了一个稳定的MoE培训程序,该程序使用超级类信息来引导路由器。 我们的经验显示,我们稀少的移动视野MoE(V-MOEs)可以比相应的密集维特公司更好地权衡业绩和效率。 例如,在Vit-Tiny模型中,我们的移动V-MoE模型在图像Net-1k上比其密度对应方高出3.39%。 对于一个规模更小的VIT变量(只有54M FLOPs 推算成本54M FLOPs ) , 我们的MoE实现了4.66%的改善。

papers.title: MixPHM: Redundancy-Aware Parameter-Efficient Tuning for Low-Resource Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Jingjing Jiang, Nanning Zheng
papers.abstract: Recently, finetuning pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) has been a prevailing paradigm for achieving state-of-the-art performance in VQA. However, as VLMs scale, it becomes computationally expensive, storage inefficient, and prone to overfitting when tuning full model parameters for a specific task in low-resource settings. Although current parameter-efficient tuning methods dramatically reduce the number of tunable parameters, there still exists a significant performance gap with full finetuning. In this paper, we propose MixPHM, a redundancy-aware parameter-efficient tuning method that outperforms full finetuning in low-resource VQA. Specifically, MixPHM is a lightweight module implemented by multiple PHM-experts in a mixture-of-experts manner. To reduce parameter redundancy, we reparameterize expert weights in a low-rank subspace and share part of the weights inside and across MixPHM. Moreover, based on our quantitative analysis of representation redundancy, we propose Redundancy Regularization, which facilitates MixPHM to reduce task-irrelevant redundancy while promoting task-relevant correlation. Experiments conducted on VQA v2, GQA, and OK-VQA with different low-resource settings show that our MixPHM outperforms state-of-the-art parameter-efficient methods and is the only one consistently surpassing full finetuning.
papers.title_zh: MixPHM: 低资源视觉问题解答的冗余-软件参数有效计票
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,微调经过训练的视力语言模型(VLMs)已成为在VQA实现SOTA 性能的一个普遍范例。 然而,由于VLMS的规模,在计算上变得昂贵,储存效率低,在为低资源环境中的具体任务调整完整的模型参数时容易过于合适。 虽然目前的参数效率调试方法大大减少了金枪鱼可选参数的数量,但随着全面微调,绩效差距仍然很大。 在本文中,我们建议采用“MixPHM”这一冗余、能见度参数效率调试方法,该方法在低资源VQA中比完全微调效果好。 具体地说,MixPHM是一个轻量级模块,由多位PHM-专家以专家混合方式实施。 为了减少参数冗余,我们重新对位于低位子空间的专家重量进行校准,并分担MixPHM内部和整个MixPHM的重量部分。 此外,根据我们对代表冗余的定量分析,我们提议裁员正规化,这有利于MixPHM公司减少与任务相关的冗余,同时促进与任务相关的关联。 在 VQA v2, GQA和 OK-VQA 上进行的实验显示,我们的MixPHM优于最先进的参数效率方法,并且是唯一一直超过全面微调的。

papers.title: MetaBEV: Solving Sensor Failures for 3D Detection and Map Segmentation
papers.authors: Chongjian Ge, Junsong Chen, Enze Xie, Zhongdao Wang, Lanqing Hong, Huchuan Lu, Zhenguo Li, Ping Luo
papers.abstract: Perception systems in modern autonomous driving vehicles typically take inputs from complementary multi-modal sensors, e.g., LiDAR and cameras. However, in real-world applications, sensor corruptions and failures lead to inferior performances, thus compromising autonomous safety. In this paper, we propose a robust framework, called MetaBEV, to address extreme real-world environments, involving overall six sensor corruptions and two extreme sensor-missing situations. In MetaBEV, signals from multiple sensors are first processed by modal-specific encoders. Subsequently, a set of dense BEV queries are initialized, termed meta-BEV. These queries are then processed iteratively by a BEV-Evolving decoder, which selectively aggregates deep features from either LiDAR, cameras, or both modalities. The updated BEV representations are further leveraged for multiple 3D prediction tasks. Additionally, we introduce a new moe structure to alleviate the performance drop on distinct tasks in multi-task joint learning. Finally, MetaBEV is evaluated on the nuScenes dataset with 3D object detection and BEV map segmentation tasks. Experiments show MetaBEV outperforms prior arts by a large margin on both full and corrupted modalities. For instance, when the LiDAR signal is missing, MetaBEV improves 35.5% detection NDS and 17.7% segmentation mIoU upon the vanilla BEVFusion model; and when the camera signal is absent, MetaBEV still achieves 69.2% NDS and 53.7%mIoU, which is even higher than previous works that perform on full-modalities. Moreover, MetaBEV performs moderately against previous methods in both canonical perception and multi-task learning settings, refreshing state-of-the-art nuScenes BEV map segmentation with 70.4% mIoU.
papers.title_zh: MetaBEV: 解决3D探测和地图分割的传感器故障
papers.abstract_zh: 现代自主驾驶车辆的感知系统一般会从辅助性多式传感器(如利达雷达和照相机)得到投入,但在现实应用中,感官腐败和失灵导致性能低下,从而损害自主安全。 在本文中,我们提出了一个强有力的框架 — — 称为MetaBEV — — 以解决极端现实环境的问题,它涉及六种感官腐败和两种极端感官错位情况。 在MetaBEV中,来自多个传感器的信号首先由特定模式的编码器处理。 随后,开始了一系列密集的BEVQuery,称为元BEV。然后,这些Query由BEV-Evolve 解码器进行迭接处理,该解码器有选择地综合了来自LIDAR、照相机或两种模式的深层特征。 此外,我们引入了新的摩尔结构,以缓解多任务联合学习中不同任务的业绩下降。 最后,用3D对象探测和BEV地图分割任务对NuScenes数据集进行MetABEV进行评估。实验显示,MetABEV在完全和腐蚀的形态上都大大优于以前的艺术。 例如,当缺少LiDAR信号时,MetABEV改进了香草BEVFusion模型35.5%的检测NDS和17.7%的分解 mIOU;如果没有相机信号,MetABEV仍然达到69.2% NDS和53.7%的mIOU,这甚至高于以前在全模式上进行的工程。 此外,MetBEV与以往的方法相比,在卡门感知和多任务学习环境中都表现得比较中度,以70.4% mIoU来刷新最先进的nuScenes BEV地图分割法。

papers.title: MEID: Mixture-of-Experts with Internal Distillation for Long-Tailed Video Recognition
papers.authors: Xinjie Li, Huijuan Xu
papers.abstract: The long-tailed video recognition problem is especially challenging, as videos tend to be long and untrimmed, and each video may contain multiple classes, causing frame-level class imbalance. The previous method tackles the long-tailed video recognition only through frame-level sampling for class re-balance without distinguishing the frame-level feature representation between head and tail classes. To improve the frame-level feature representation of tail classes, we modulate the frame-level features with an auxiliary distillation loss to reduce the distribution distance between head and tail classes. Moreover, we design a mixture-of-experts framework with two different expert designs, i.e., the first expert with an attention-based classification network handling the original long-tailed distribution, and the second expert dealing with the re-balanced distribution from class-balanced sampling. Notably, in the second expert, we specifically focus on the frames unsolved by the first expert through designing a complementary frame selection module, which inherits the attention weights from the first expert and selects frames with low attention weights, and we also enhance the motion feature representation for these selected frames. To highlight the multi-label challenge in long-tailed video recognition, we create two additional benchmarks based on Charades and CharadesEgo videos with the multi-label property, called CharadesLT and CharadesEgoLT. Extensive experiments are conducted on the existing long-tailed video benchmark VideoLT and the two new benchmarks to verify the effectiveness of our proposed method with state-of-the-art performance. The code and proposed benchmarks are released at https://github.com/VisionLanguageLab/MEID.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: MMEID: 与内部蒸馏用于长期学习视频识别的专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 长尾视频识别问题尤其具有挑战性,因为视频往往长且未剪剪,每段视频可能包含多个班级,造成框架级班级失衡。 前一种方法仅通过对类别重新平衡进行框架级抽样,而不区分头类和尾类之间的框架级特征表示,从而解决长尾视频识别问题。 为了改进尾品类的轮廓级特征表示,我们调整框架级特征,减少辅助蒸馏损失,以减少头类和尾品类之间的分配距离。 此外,我们设计了一个专家混合框架,有两种不同的专家设计,即第一位专家,拥有关注型分类网络,处理原长尾分配,以及第二位专家,处理与类别平衡抽样的重新平衡分配问题。 值得注意的是,在第二位专家中,我们特别侧重于第一位专家未解决的框架,设计了一个补充框架选择模块,该模块继承了第一位专家的注意权重,选择了低关注权重的框架,我们还加强了这些选定框架的动作特征代表。 为了突出长尾视频识别的多标签挑战, 我们根据《夏令》和《夏令》Ego视频, 建立两个附加基准, 多标签属性, 称为《夏令LT》和《夏令》EgoLT。 对现有长尾视频基准视频视频LT和两个新基准进行了广泛的试验,以核实我们拟议方法的实效和SOTA 性能,守则和拟议基准在https://github.com/VisionLanguageLab/MEID上公布。

papers.title: Long-Tailed Visual Recognition via Self-Heterogeneous Integration With Knowledge Excavation
papers.authors: Yan Jin, Mengke Li, Yang Lu, Yiu-ming Cheung, Hanzi Wang
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks have made huge progress in the last few decades. However, as the real-world data often exhibits a long-tailed distribution, vanilla deep models tend to be heavily biased toward the majority classes. To address this problem, state-of-the-art methods usually adopt a mixture of experts (MoE) to focus on different parts of the long-tailed distribution. Experts in these methods are with the same model depth, which neglects the fact that different classes may have different preferences to be fit by models with different depths. To this end, we propose a novel MoE-based method called Self-Heterogeneous Integration with Knowledge Excavation (SHIKE). We first propose Depth-wise Knowledge Fusion (DKF) to fuse features between different shallow parts and the deep part in one network for each expert, which makes experts more diverse in terms of representation. Based on DKF, we further propose Dynamic Knowledge Transfer (DKT) to reduce the influence of the hardest negative class that has a non-negligible impact on the tail classes in our MoE framework. As a result, the classification accuracy of long-tailed data can be significantly improved, especially for the tail classes. SHIKE achieves the state-of-the-art performance of 56.3%, 60.3%, 75.4%, and 41.9% on CIFAR100-LT (IF100), ImageNet-LT, iNaturalist 2018, and Places-LT, respectively. The source code is available at https://github.com/jinyan-06/SHIKE.
papers.title_zh: 通过与知识挖掘相结合的自我异质融合,长期学习的视觉识别
papers.abstract_zh: 在过去几十年里,深神经网络取得了巨大进步。 然而,由于真实世界数据往往呈现出长期的分布,香草深层模型往往严重偏向多数阶级。 为解决这一问题,最先进的方法通常采用专家混合方法,侧重于长期分销的不同部分。 这些方法的专家具有同样的深度模型,这忽略了不同类别可能具有不同的偏好,由不同深度的模型来适应。 为此,我们建议采用基于MoE的新颖方法,称为“与知识挖掘的自我异质融合 ” ( SHIKE ) 。 首先,我们建议深度知识融合(DKF)将不同浅层和深层部分的特征结合到每个专家的一个网络中,从而使专家的代表性更加多样化。 根据DKF,我们进一步提议动态知识传输(DKT),以减少在MoE框架内对尾类产生不可忽略影响的最负面类的影响,从而大大改进长尾类数据的分类准确性,特别是尾类数据的分类准确性。 SHIKE在CIFAR100-LT(IF100)、图象网-LT、iNatulist 2018和Places-LT方面分别实现了56.3%、60.3%、75.4%和41.9%的SOTA 性能,源代码见https://github.com/jinyan-06/SHIKE。

papers.title: Learning a Sparse Transformer Network for Effective Image Deraining
papers.authors: Xiang Chen, Hao Li, Mingqiang Li, Jinshan Pan
papers.abstract: Transformers-based methods have achieved significant performance in image deraining as they can model the non-local information which is vital for high-quality image reconstruction. In this paper, we find that most existing Transformers usually use all similarities of the tokens from the query-key pairs for the feature aggregation. However, if the tokens from the query are different from those of the key, the self-attention values estimated from these tokens also involve in feature aggregation, which accordingly interferes with the clear image restoration. To overcome this problem, we propose an effective DeRaining network, Sparse Transformer (DRSformer) that can adaptively keep the most useful self-attention values for feature aggregation so that the aggregated features better facilitate high-quality image reconstruction. Specifically, we develop a learnable top-k selection operator to adaptively retain the most crucial attention scores from the keys for each query for better feature aggregation. Simultaneously, as the naive feed-forward network in Transformers does not model the multi-scale information that is important for latent clear image restoration, we develop an effective mixed-scale feed-forward network to generate better features for image deraining. To learn an enriched set of hybrid features, which combines local context from CNN operators, we equip our model with mixture of experts feature compensator to present a cooperation refinement deraining scheme. Extensive experimental results on the commonly used benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable performance against state-of-the-art approaches. The source code and trained models are available at https://github.com/cschenxiang/DRSformer.
papers.title_zh: 学习简单变换器网络, 以有效解析图像
papers.abstract_zh: 以Transformer为基础的方法在图像排减方面取得了显著成绩,因为它们可以模拟非本地信息,而非本地信息对于高质量的图像重建至关重要。 在本文中,我们发现大多数现有的Transformer通常使用Query键对的标志的所有相似性来聚合特性。 然而,如果Query的标记与钥匙的标记不同,从这些标记中估计的自注意力值也涉及特性聚合,因此干扰了清晰图像的恢复。 为了克服这一问题,我们建议建立一个有效的脱射网络,即斯普鲁斯Transformer(Sprassy Transformer),能够适应性地保持特征汇总最有用的自注意力值,以便综合特征能够更好地促进高质量的形象重建。 具体而言,我们开发了一个可学习的顶级选手,以适应性地保留每个Query的钥匙中最关键的关注分数,以便更好地集成特征。 同时,由于Transformer中的天真的进化前网络并不模拟对潜在清晰图像恢复十分重要的多尺度信息,我们开发了一个有效的混合进化前网络,以产生更好的图像排减特征。 为了学习一套结合有线电视新闻网操作员当地情况的丰富混合特征,我们为模型配备了专家的特效补偿者,以提出一个合作改进排减计划。 关于常用基准的广泛实验结果表明,拟议方法与最新方法相比,取得了有利的业绩,源代码和经过培训的模型见https://github.com/cschenxiang/DRSexw。

papers.title: Graph Mixture of Experts: Learning on Large-Scale Graphs with Explicit Diversity Modeling
papers.authors: Haotao Wang, Ziyu Jiang, Yuning You, Yan Han, Gaowen Liu, Jayanth Srinivasa, Ramana Kompella, Zhangyang "Atlas" Wang

papers.title: Enhancing NeRF akin to Enhancing LLMs: Generalizable NeRF Transformer with Mixture-of-View-Experts
papers.authors: Wenyan Cong, Hanxue Liang, Peihao Wang, Zhiwen Fan, Tianlong Chen, Mukund Varma, Yi Wang, Zhangyang Wang
papers.abstract: Cross-scene generalizable NeRF models, which can directly synthesize novel views of unseen scenes, have become a new spotlight of the NeRF field. Several existing attempts rely on increasingly end-to-end "neuralized" architectures, i.e., replacing scene representation and/or rendering modules with performant neural networks such as transformers, and turning novel view synthesis into a feed-forward inference pipeline. While those feedforward "neuralized" architectures still do not fit diverse scenes well out of the box, we propose to bridge them with the powerful Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) idea from large language models (LLMs), which has demonstrated superior generalization ability by balancing between larger overall model capacity and flexible per-instance specialization. Starting from a recent generalizable NeRF architecture called GNT, we first demonstrate that MoE can be neatly plugged in to enhance the model. We further customize a shared permanent expert and a geometry-aware consistency loss to enforce cross-scene consistency and spatial smoothness respectively, which are essential for generalizable view synthesis. Our proposed model, dubbed GNT with Mixture-of-View-Experts (GNT-MOVE), has experimentally shown state-of-the-art results when transferring to unseen scenes, indicating remarkably better cross-scene generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings. Our codes are available at https://github.com/VITA-Group/GNT-MOVE.
papers.title_zh: 增强类似于增强力的NERF:通用NERFTransformer和混合查看-专家
papers.abstract_zh: 能够直接综合对不可见场景的新观点的跨层通用NERF模型已成为NERF领域的新焦点。 一些现有的尝试依赖日益终端到终端的“神经化”结构,即用变压器等性能神经网络取代现场表现和/或转换模块,并将新观点合成转化为进料向导导管。 虽然这些进料的“内化”结构仍然不适应外外外的各种不同场景,但我们建议将它们与来自大型语言模型的强大的专家混合(Mixture of-Experters)理念联系起来,后者通过平衡更大的总体模型能力和灵活的每个企业的专业化,显示了超强的普及能力。 我们首先证明MoE可以畅通无阻地插插进去, 来强化模型。 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 我们进一步定制一个共同的常任专家和一个几何一致性损失,以分别实施跨场一致性和空间平滑性,这对可普遍综合的观点至关重要。 我们提议的模型称为GNT,称为Mixture of View-Experts(GNT-MOVE),在向看不见的场景转移时,实验性地展示了最新的结果,表明在零点和微小的场景设置中,交叉场景的概括性明显改进。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/VITA-Group/GNT-MOVE查阅。

papers.title: Efficient and Degradation-Adaptive Network for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Lei Zhang
papers.abstract: "Efficient and effective real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) is a challenging task due to the unknown complex degradation of real-world images and the limited computation resources in practical applications. Recent research on Real-ISR has achieved significant progress by modeling the image degradation space; however, these methods largely rely on heavy backbone networks and they are inflexible to handle images of different degradation levels. In this paper, we propose an efficient and effective degradation-adaptive super-resolution (DASR) network, whose parameters are adaptively specified by estimating the degradation of each input image. Specifically, a tiny regression network is employed to predict the degradation parameters of the input image, while several convolutional experts with the same topology are jointly optimized to specify the network parameters via a non-linear mixture of experts. The joint optimization of multiple experts and the degradation-adaptive pipeline significantly extend the model capacity to handle degradations of various levels, while the inference remains efficient since only one adaptively specified network is used for super-resolving the input image. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that DASR is not only much more effective than existing methods on handling real-world images with different degradation levels but also efficient for easy deployment. Codes, models and datasets are available at https://github.com/csjliang/DASR."
papers.title_zh: 实时世界图像高效和退化-适应网络超级分辨率
papers.abstract_zh: 快速而有效的真实世界图像超分辨率(Real-ISR)是一项具有挑战性的任务, 最近关于Real-ISR的研究通过模拟图像降解空间取得了显著进展;然而,这些方法主要依赖重主干网络,无法灵活地处理不同降解水平的图像。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个高效和有效降解适应性超分辨率网络,其参数通过估计每个输入图像的退化情况加以调整确定。 具体而言,使用一个微小的回归网络来预测输入图像的降解参数,同时对具有相同地形的若干富集专家进行联合优化,以便通过非线性专家混合确定网络参数。 多位专家的共同优化和降解适应管道大大扩展了处理不同层次退化的模型能力,而推断仍然有效,因为只有一个适应性特定网络用于超级解析输入图像。 我们的广泛实验表明,DASR不仅比现有的处理具有不同降解程度的现实世界图像的方法更有效,而且对容易部署也有效。 代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/csjliang/DASSR上查阅。

papers.title: Bootstrapping Multi-View Representations for Fake News Detection
papers.authors: Qichao Ying, Xiaoxiao Hu, Yangming Zhou, Zhenxing Qian, Dan Zeng, Shiming Ge
papers.abstract: Previous researches on multimedia fake news detection include a series of complex feature extraction and fusion networks to gather useful information from the news. However, how cross-modal consistency relates to the fidelity of news and how features from different modalities affect the decision-making are still open questions. This paper presents a novel scheme of Bootstrapping Multi-view Representations (BMR) for fake news detection. Given a multi-modal news, we extract representations respectively from the views of the text, the image pattern and the image semantics. Improved Multi-gate Mixture-of-Expert networks (iMMoE) are proposed for feature refinement and fusion. Representations from each view are separately used to coarsely predict the fidelity of the whole news, and the multimodal representations are able to predict the cross-modal consistency. With the prediction scores, we reweigh each view of the representations and bootstrap them for fake news detection. Extensive experiments conducted on typical fake news detection datasets prove that BMR outperforms state-of-the-art schemes.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: 用于假新闻探测的多视图演示工具
papers.abstract_zh: 先前关于多媒体假新闻探测的研究包括一系列复杂的特征提取和聚合网络,以便从新闻中收集有用的信息。 然而,跨模式的一致性如何与新闻的忠实性相关,不同模式的特征如何影响决策,这些仍然是尚未解决的问题。 本文提出了一个新颖的计划 — — 采用多视角代表制(BMR)进行假新闻检测。 鉴于多式新闻,我们分别从文字、图像图案和图像语义的角度进行表述,建议改进多门专家混合网络(iMMOE),以完善和融合特色。 每种观点的表述都分别用来粗略地预测整个新闻的真实性,而多式联运的表述能够预测跨模式的一致性。 随着预测分数,我们将每个观点的表述都重新对比,并把它们套起来,以进行假新闻探测。 对典型的假冒新闻探测数据集进行的广泛实验证明,BMR的绩效超过了最新水平的计划。

papers.title: AdaMV-MoE: Adaptive Multi-Task Vision Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Tianlong Chen, Xuxi Chen, Xianzhi Du, Abdullah Rashwan, Fan Yang, Huizhong Chen, Zhangyang Wang, Yeqing Li
papers.abstract: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is becoming a promising paradigm for multi-task learning (MTL). Instead of compressing multiple tasks' knowledge into a single model, MoE separates the parameter space and only utilizes the relevant model pieces given task type and its input, which provides stabilized MTL training and ultra-efficient inference. However, current MoE approaches adopt a fixed network capacity (e.g., two experts in usual) for all tasks. It potentially results in the over-fitting of simple tasks or the under-fitting of challenging scenarios, especially when tasks are significantly distinctive in their complexity. In this paper, we propose an adaptive MoE framework for multi-task vision recognition, dubbed AdaMV-MoE. Based on the training dynamics, it automatically determines the number of activated experts for each task, avoiding the laborious manual tuning of optimal model size. To validate our proposal, we benchmark it on ImageNet classification and COCO object detection & instance segmentation which are notoriously difficult to learn in concert, due to their discrepancy. Extensive experiments across a variety of vision transformers demonstrate a superior performance of AdaMV-MoE, compared to MTL with a shared backbone and the recent state-of-the-art (SoTA) MTL MoE approach. Codes are available online: https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/moe_mtl.
papers.title_zh: Adamva-MoE:适应性多任务视觉组合专家
papers.abstract_zh: 分散激活的专家混合体正在成为多任务学习的有希望的范例(MTL)。 MoE没有将多重任务的知识压缩成单一模型,而是将参数空间分开,只使用相关模型,给定任务类型及其输入,提供稳定的MTL培训和超高效的推断。 然而,目前MoE的做法对所有任务都采用固定的网络能力(例如,通常有两名专家),这可能导致任务过于简单,或对挑战性情景的适应不足,特别是当任务的复杂性明显不同时。 在本文中,我们提出了一个适应性多任务视觉识别MoE框架,称为AdaMV-MOE。 根据培训动态,它自动确定每项任务中被激活专家的人数,避免对最佳模型规模进行艰苦的手工调整。 为了验证我们的提案,我们将其基准以图像网络分类和COCO物体探测和实例分解为基准,这些分解因差异而难以协调学习,这众所周知是难以学习的。 各种视觉变压器的广泛实验表明,AdaMV-MOE的性能优于具有共同骨干和最近最先进的MTL(SoTA)MTL MoE方法的MTL。 代码可在网上查阅:https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/moe_mtl。

papers.title: Vision Relation Transformer for Unbiased Scene Graph Generation
papers.authors: Gopika Sudhakaran, Devendra Singh Dhami, Kristian Kersting, Stefan Roth
papers.abstract: Recent years have seen a growing interest in Scene Graph Generation (SGG), a comprehensive visual scene understanding task that aims to predict entity relationships using a relation encoder-decoder pipeline stacked on top of an object encoder-decoder backbone. Unfortunately, current SGG methods suffer from an information loss regarding the entities' local-level cues during the relation encoding process. To mitigate this, we introduce the Vision rElation TransfOrmer (VETO), consisting of a novel local-level entity relation encoder. We further observe that many existing SGG methods claim to be unbiased, but are still biased towards either head or tail classes. To overcome this bias, we introduce a Mutually Exclusive ExperT (MEET) learning strategy that captures important relation features without bias towards head or tail classes. Experimental results on the VG and GQA datasets demonstrate that VETO + MEET boosts the predictive performance by up to 47% over the state of the art while being 10x smaller.
papers.title_zh: 无偏见景景区图生成的视觉变形器
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,人们对《景象图集》(SGG)的兴趣日益浓厚,这是一项全面的视觉场景理解任务,目的是利用堆在物体编码器-编码器主干线之上的连接编码器-编码器管道预测实体关系。 不幸的是,目前的SGG方法在关系编码过程中,在实体的地方一级提示信息丢失了。 为了减轻这一损失,我们引入了“视觉通缩转换器 ” ( VETO ) , 由新的地方一级实体关系编码器组成。 我们还注意到,许多现有的SGG方法声称是不偏不倚的,但仍然偏向于头类或尾类。 为了克服这一偏向,我们引入了相互排斥ExperT(MEET)学习战略,在不偏向头类或尾类的情况下捕捉重要的关系特征。 VG和GQA数据集的实验结果显示,VETO+MEET将预测性能提升到最高47%,比最新工艺水平低10倍。

papers.title: Variational Causal Inference Network for Explanatory Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Dizhan Xue, Shengsheng Qian, Changsheng Xu
papers.abstract: Explanatory Visual Question Answering (EVQA) is a recently proposed multimodal reasoning task that requires answering visual questions and generating multimodal explanations for the reasoning processes. Unlike traditional Visual Question Answering (VQA) which focuses solely on answering, EVQA aims to provide user-friendly explanations to enhance the explainability and credibility of reasoning models. However, existing EVQA methods typically predict the answer and explanation separately, which ignores the causal correlation between them. Moreover, they neglect the complex relationships among question words, visual regions, and explanation tokens. To address these issues, we propose a Variational Causal Inference Network (VCIN) that establishes the causal correlation between predicted answers and explanations, and captures cross-modal relationships to generate rational explanations. First, we utilize a vision-and-language pretrained model to extract visual features and question features. Secondly, we propose a multimodal explanation gating transformer that constructs cross-modal relationships and generates rational explanations. Finally, we propose a variational causal inference to establish the target causal structure and predict the answers. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of VCIN over state-of-the-art EVQA methods.
papers.title_zh: 解释性视觉问题解析解答变因果推断网络
papers.abstract_zh: 解释性视觉问题回答(EVQA)是一项最近提出的多式联运推理任务,需要回答视觉问题,并为推理过程提出多式解释。 与仅侧重于回答的传统视觉问题解答(VQA)不同,EVQA旨在提供方便用户的解释,以提高推理模型的解释性和可信度。 然而,现有的 " EVQA " 方法通常会分别预测答案和解释,忽略了它们之间的因果关系。 此外,它们忽略了问题词、视觉区域和解释符号之间的复杂关系。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个变式因果关系网络,确定预测的答案和解释之间的因果关系,并捕捉跨模式的关系,以便作出合理的解释。 首先,我们利用一个预设的视觉和语言模型来提取视觉特征和问题特征。 其次,我们建议采用多式解释式变压器来构建跨模式关系,并做出合理的解释。 最后,我们提出一个变式因果推论,以确定目标因果结构并预测答案。 全面实验表明VCIN优于最先进的EVQA方法。

papers.title: V3Det: Vast Vocabulary Visual Detection Dataset
papers.authors: Jiaqi Wang, Pan Zhang, Tao Chu, Yuhang Cao, Yujie Zhou, Tong Wu, Bin Wang, Conghui He, Dahua Lin
papers.abstract: Recent advances in detecting arbitrary objects in the real world are trained and evaluated on object detection datasets with a relatively restricted vocabulary. To facilitate the development of more general visual object detection, we propose V3Det, a vast vocabulary visual detection dataset with precisely annotated bounding boxes on massive images. V3Det has several appealing properties: 1) Vast Vocabulary: It contains bounding boxes of objects from 13,204 categories on real-world images, which is 10 times larger than the existing large vocabulary object detection dataset, e.g., LVIS. 2) Hierarchical Category Organization: The vast vocabulary of V3Det is organized by a hierarchical category tree which annotates the inclusion relationship among categories, encouraging the exploration of category relationships in vast and open vocabulary object detection. 3) Rich Annotations: V3Det comprises precisely annotated objects in 243k images and professional descriptions of each category written by human experts and a powerful chatbot. By offering a vast exploration space, V3Det enables extensive benchmarks on both vast and open vocabulary object detection, leading to new observations, practices, and insights for future research. It has the potential to serve as a cornerstone dataset for developing more general visual perception systems. V3Det is available at https://v3det.openxlab.org.cn/.
papers.title_zh: V3Det: 大字典视觉探测数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中探测任意物体方面最近取得的进展,在使用相对有限的词汇的物体探测数据集方面得到了培训和评价。 为了便利发展更一般性的视觉物体探测,我们提议V3Det,这是一个庞大的词汇目视探测数据集,在大型图像上有精确的附加说明的捆绑框。 V3Det具有若干具有吸引力的属性:1)大词汇:它包含从真实世界图像上的13,204类物体的捆绑箱,比现有的大型词汇对象探测数据集,例如LVIS,大10倍。 2) 等级类组织:V3Det的庞大词汇由一棵等级类树组成,该树说明各类别之间的包容关系,鼓励在广泛和公开的词汇对象探测中探索类别关系。 3) 丰富的说明:V3Det包含243k图像中精确的附加说明的物体,以及由人类专家和强大的聊天室编写的每一类的专业说明。 V3Det通过提供广阔的探索空间,为广泛和开放的词汇对象探测提供了广泛的基准,为未来研究提供了新的观测、实践和洞察力。 V3Det有可能成为开发更一般的视觉感知系统的基石数据集。 V3Det可查阅https://v3det.openxlab.org.cn/。

papers.title: Tree Structure-Aware Few-Shot Image Classification via Hierarchical Aggregation
papers.authors: Min Zhang, Siteng Huang, Wenbin Li, Donglin Wang
papers.abstract: "In this paper, we mainly focus on the problem of how to learn additional feature representations for few-shot image classification through pretext tasks (e.g., rotation or color permutation and so on). This additional knowledge generated by pretext tasks can further improve the performance of few-shot learning (FSL) as it differs from human-annotated supervision (i.e., class labels of FSL tasks). To solve this problem, we present a plug-in Hierarchical Tree Structure-aware (HTS) method, which not only learns the relationship of FSL and pretext tasks, but more importantly, can adaptively select and aggregate feature representations generated by pretext tasks to maximize the performance of FSL tasks. A hierarchical tree constructing component and a gated selection aggregating component is introduced to construct the tree structure and find richer transferable knowledge that can rapidly adapt to novel classes with a few labeled images. Extensive experiments show that our HTS can significantly enhance multiple few-shot methods to achieve new state-of-the-art performance on four benchmark datasets. The code is available at: https://github.com/remiMZ/HTS-ECCV22."
papers.title_zh: 通过等级式聚合对树结构- 结构- 工具少于热的图像分类
papers.abstract_zh: 本文主要讨论如何透过藉由(如轮值或颜色变换等), 由托辞任务产生的这种额外知识可以进一步改善短视学习(FSL)的绩效,因为它不同于附加人文说明的监督(即FSL任务的类标签)。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个插接式等级树木结构意识(HTS)方法,它不仅了解FSL与托辞任务的关系,而且更重要的是,它能够因地制宜地选择和综合以托辞任务产生的特征表现,以最大限度地发挥FSL任务的绩效。 引入了树的等级结构构件和封闭式选择集成组件,以构建树木结构,并找到较丰富的可转让知识,这些知识可以迅速适应带有几幅标签图像的新颖类。 广泛的实验表明,我们的HTS可以大大加强多种短片方法,在四个基准数据集上实现新的SOTA 性能。 代码可以在https://github.com/remiMZ/HTS-ECCV22上查到。 ”

papers.title: Taxonomy Adaptive Cross-Domain Adaptation in Medical Imaging via Optimization Trajectory Distillation
papers.authors: Jianan Fan, Dongnan Liu, Hang Chang, Heng Huang, Mei Chen, Weidong Cai
papers.abstract: The success of automated medical image analysis depends on large-scale and expert-annotated training sets. Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been raised as a promising approach to alleviate the burden of labeled data collection. However, they generally operate under the closed-set adaptation setting assuming an identical label set between the source and target domains, which is over-restrictive in clinical practice where new classes commonly exist across datasets due to taxonomic inconsistency. While several methods have been presented to tackle both domain shifts and incoherent label sets, none of them take into account the common characteristics of the two issues and consider the learning dynamics along network training. In this work, we propose optimization trajectory distillation, a unified approach to address the two technical challenges from a new perspective. It exploits the low-rank nature of gradient space and devises a dual-stream distillation algorithm to regularize the learning dynamics of insufficiently annotated domain and classes with the external guidance obtained from reliable sources. Our approach resolves the issue of inadequate navigation along network optimization, which is the major obstacle in the taxonomy adaptive cross-domain adaptation scenario. We evaluate the proposed method extensively on several tasks towards various endpoints with clinical significance. The results demonstrate its effectiveness and improvements over previous methods.
papers.title_zh: 通过优化利用轨迹蒸馏法进行医学成像中的 分类法适应性适应性跨主题适应性适应性
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化医学图像分析的成功取决于大规模和专家附加说明的培训组合,无人监督的域适应(UDA)被提出为减轻标签数据收集负担的一种有希望的办法。 然而,它们通常在封闭式适应设置下运作,假设源领域和目标领域之间有相同的标签,在临床实践中,这种标签过于严格,因为由于分类不一致,各数据集之间通常有新的类别。 虽然已提出几种方法来处理域变换和不一致的标签,但没有一种方法考虑到这两个问题的共同特点,并考虑网络培训过程中的学习动态。 在这项工作中,我们提议优化轨迹蒸馏,这是从新角度处理两个技术挑战的统一办法。 它利用了梯度空间的低级别性质,并设计了双流蒸馏算法,以便利用从可靠来源获得的外部指导,规范说明不足的域和班级的学习动态。 我们的方法解决了在网络优化过程中航行不力的问题,这是分类学适应性跨领域适应性适应方案的主要障碍。 我们广泛评估了针对具有临床重要性的不同端点的若干任务的拟议方法。 结果表明,与以往方法相比,其效力和改进是有效的。
