papers.title: Hierarchical Visual Primitive Experts for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Hanjae Kim, Jiyoung Lee, Seongheon Park, Kwanghoon Sohn
papers.abstract: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize unseen compositions with prior knowledge of known primitives (attribute and object). Previous works for CZSL often suffer from grasping the contextuality between attribute and object, as well as the discriminability of visual features, and the long-tailed distribution of real-world compositional data. We propose a simple and scalable framework called Composition Transformer (CoT) to address these issues. CoT employs object and attribute experts in distinctive manners to generate representative embeddings, using the visual network hierarchically. The object expert extracts representative object embeddings from the final layer in a bottom-up manner, while the attribute expert makes attribute embeddings in a top-down manner with a proposed object-guided attention module that models contextuality explicitly. To remedy biased prediction caused by imbalanced data distribution, we develop a simple minority attribute augmentation (MAA) that synthesizes virtual samples by mixing two images and oversampling minority attribute classes. Our method achieves SoTA performance on several benchmarks, including MIT-States, C-GQA, and VAW-CZSL. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of CoT in improving visual discrimination and addressing the model bias from the imbalanced data distribution. The code is available at https://github.com/HanjaeKim98/CoT.
papers.title_zh: 零热组合学习的等级视觉原始专家
papers.abstract_zh: (CZSL)旨在识别先前对已知原始物(属性和对象)有知识的无形成分。 CZSL 先前的作品往往因掌握属性与对象之间的背景质量、视觉特征的可视性以及真实世界成份数据的长期快速分布而受到影响。 我们提议了一个简单、可扩展的框架,称为“组成变换器”(CoT),以解决这些问题。CoT以独特的方式使用对象和属性专家,利用视觉网络,按等级生成有代表性的嵌入。 对象专家以自下而上的方式从最后一层提取具有代表性的物体嵌入,而属性专家则以自上而下的方式进行属性嵌入,并采用一个拟议的目标引导关注模块,明确模拟背景质量。 为了纠正数据分布不平衡造成的有偏见的预测,我们开发了一个简单的少数民族属性增强(MAA),通过混合两种图像和过度抽样调查少数民族属性类别,合成虚拟样本。 我们的方法在几个基准(包括麻省理工学院国家、C-GQA和VAW-CZSL)上实现了SoTA的业绩,我们还展示了COT在改善视觉歧视和解决数据分布不平衡造成的模式偏差方面的效力,该代码可在https://github.com/HanjaeKim98/CoT上查阅。

papers.title: Hierarchical Separable Video Transformer for Snapshot Compressive Imaging
papers.authors: Ping Wang · Yulun Zhang · Lishun Wang · Xin Yuan
papers.abstract: Recently, deep learning models have achieved impressive success on solving the inverse problem of Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI) for video, ie, reconstructing multiple high-fidelity frames from a single-shot observation. However, existing works lack an insight into the mixed degradation of spatial masking and temporal aliasing, and empirically follow the designs of successful plain video restoration ( eg, denoising, deblurring) models, limiting the overall performance. In this work, we tailor a network architecture and a Hierarchical Separable Video Transformer (HiSViT) as building block, composed of Cross-Scale Separable Multi-head Self-Attention (CSS-MSA) and Gated Self-Modulated Feed-Forward Network (GSM-FFN). CSS-MSA decomposes spatio-temporal similarity calculations into spatial and temporal dimensions but attends to all spatio-temporal tokens at a controllable scale within a single attention layer. GSM-FFN is design to bring locality to CSS-MSA via gated mechanism and space-time separable convolutions. HiSViT is built by multiple groups of CSS-MSA plus GSM-FFN, each of which focuses on different scales, enabling multi-scale interaction and long-range modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
papers.title_zh: 用于抓图压缩成像的分解视频变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,深层学习模式在解决截图压缩成像(SCI)的反面问题方面取得了令人印象深刻的成功。 然而,现有工作缺乏对空间遮蔽和时间化假名混合降解的洞察力,并缺乏经验地遵循成功的平面视频恢复模型(例如,去除、去除、去除)的设计,从而限制了总体性能。 在这项工作中,我们设计了一个网络架构和一个等级分立的视频变形器(HisViT)作为构件,由跨比例分立的多头人自我意识(CSS-MSA)和Gated自变型进餐前进网络(GSM-FFN)组成。 CSS-MSA将时空相近性计算分解成时空空间和时空,但在单一关注层以可控制的规模处理所有时空口号。 GSM-FFN设计通过门形机制和空间时间可分离的演变,将地点移到中央SS-MSA。 HISVYT是由CSS-MSA+GSM-FFN的多个组群组成的,每个组群侧重于不同的尺度,能够进行多尺度的互动和远程建模。 广泛的实验表明,我们的模型取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Gram-based Attentive Neural Ordinary Differential Equations Network for Video Nystagmography Classification
papers.authors: Xihe Qiu, Shaojie Shi, Xiaoyu Tan, Chao Qu, Zhijun Fang, Hailing Wang, Yongbin Gao, Peixia Wu, Huawei Li
papers.abstract: Video nystagmography (VNG) is the diagnostic gold standard of benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV), which requires medical professionals to examine the direction, frequency, intensity, duration, and variation in the strength of nystagmus on a VNG video. This is a tedious process heavily influenced by the doctor's experience, which is error-prone. Recent automatic VNG classification methods approach this problem from the perspective of video analysis without considering medical prior knowledge, resulting in unsatisfactory accuracy and limited diagnostic capability for nystagmographic types, thereby preventing their clinical application. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end data-driven novel BPPV diagnosis framework (TC-BPPV) by considering this problem as an eye trajectory classification problem due to the disease's symptoms and experts' prior knowledge. In this framework, we utilize an eye movement tracking system to capture the eye trajectory and propose the Gram-based attentive neural ordinary differential equations network (Gram-AODE) to perform classification. We validate our framework using the VNG dataset provided by the collaborative university hospital and achieve state-of-the-art performance. We also evaluate Gram-AODE on multiple open-source benchmarks to demonstrate its effectiveness in trajectory classification. Code is available at https://github.com/XiheQiu/Gram-AODE.
papers.title_zh: 视频Ny Stymagraphic 分类普通差异平等网络
papers.abstract_zh: 视网膜镜像(VNG)是良性低氧表面姿势脊椎动物(BPPV)的诊断金标准,它要求医疗专业人员在VNG视频上检查鼻梁的动向、频率、强度、持续时间和强度的变化。 这是一个受医生经验严重影响的乏味过程,容易出错。 近期的VNG自动分类方法从视频分析的角度处理这一问题,而没有考虑医疗前知识,导致对鼻腔类的准确性不令人满意,诊断能力有限,从而阻碍了临床应用。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个端对端数据驱动的新BPPV诊断框架(TC-BPPV),将这一问题视为由于该疾病症状和专家先前的知识而导致的眼线分类问题。 在此框架内,我们利用眼睛运动跟踪系统捕捉眼睛轨迹,并提议采用基于Gram的注意神经正常差异方程式网络(Gram-AODE)进行分类。 我们利用合作大学医院提供的VNG数据集验证我们的框架,并取得SOTA 性能,我们还评估了Gram-AODE的多种开放源基准,以表明其在轨迹分类方面的有效性。 法规可在https://github.com/XiheQiu/Gram-AODE查阅。

papers.title: Global Balanced Experts for Federated Long-Tailed Learning
papers.authors: Yaopei Zeng, Lei Liu, Li Liu, Li Shen, Shaoguo Liu, Baoyuan Wu
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a prevalent distributed machine learning approach that enables collaborative training of a global model across multiple devices without sharing local data. However, the presence of long-tailed data can negatively deteriorate the model's performance in real-world FL applications. Moreover, existing re-balance strategies are less effective for the federated long-tailed issue when directly utilizing local label distribution as the class prior at the clients' side. To this end, we propose a novel Global Balanced Multi-Expert (GBME) framework to optimize a balanced global objective, which does not require additional information beyond the standard FL pipeline. In particular, a proxy is derived from the accumulated gradients uploaded by the clients after local training, and is shared by all clients as the class prior for re-balance training. Such a proxy can also guide the client grouping to train a multi-expert model, where the knowledge from different clients can be aggregated via the ensemble of different experts corresponding to different client groups. To further strengthen the privacy-preserving ability, we present a GBME-p algorithm with a theoretical guarantee to prevent privacy leakage from the proxy. Extensive experiments on long-tailed decentralized datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GBME and GBME-p, both of which show superior performance to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 联邦长期学习全球平衡专家
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习(FL)是一种普遍的分布式机器学习方法,它使得能够通过多种设备合作培训全球模式,而无需分享当地数据,然而,长期数据的存在会不利地恶化该模式在现实世界FL应用中的性能。 此外,当直接使用当地标签分配作为客户方面之前的等级时,现有的再平衡战略对联邦长期处理的问题效果较差。 为此,我们提议建立一个新的全球平衡多专家框架,以优化平衡的全球目标,该全球目标不需要超出标准FL管道范围的额外信息。 特别是,代理由客户在当地培训后上传的累积梯度产生,所有客户作为重新平衡培训的先期班共享。 这种代理也可以指导客户群体培训多专家模式,通过不同客户群体不同专家的组合,将不同客户的知识汇集在一起。 为了进一步加强隐私保护能力,我们提出了一个GBME-p算法,其中提供理论保障,防止代理人泄露隐私。 关于长期分散化数据集的广泛实验表明GBME和GBME-p的功效,两者都显示优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: GLIGEN: Open-Set Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Yuheng Li, Haotian Liu, Qingyang Wu, Fangzhou Mu, Jianwei Yang, Jianfeng Gao, Chunyuan Li, Yong Jae Lee
papers.abstract: Large-scale text-to-image diffusion models have made amazing advances. However, the status quo is to use text input alone, which can impede controllability. In this work, we propose GLIGEN: Open-Set Grounded Text-to-Image Generation, a novel approach that builds upon and extends the functionality of existing pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models by enabling them to also be conditioned on grounding inputs. To preserve the vast concept knowledge of the pre-trained model, we freeze all of its weights and inject the grounding information into new trainable layers via a gated mechanism. Our model achieves open-world grounded text2img generation with caption and bounding box condition inputs, and the grounding ability generalizes well to novel spatial configurations and concepts. GLIGEN's zero-shot performance on COCO and LVIS outperforms existing supervised layout-to-image baselines by a large margin.
papers.title_zh: GLIGEN: 开放的、有固定基础的文本到图像生成
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模文本到图像传播模型取得了惊人的进步,但现状是只使用文本输入,这可能会妨碍可控性。 在这项工作中,我们提议GLIGEN:开放基础的文本到图像生成,这是一种新颖的做法,它以现有的经培训的文本到图像传播模型为基础,并扩展了这些模型的功能,使这些模型也能够以基础投入为条件。 为了保存关于预先培训模式的广泛概念知识,我们冻结其所有重量,并通过封闭机制将地面信息注入新的可训练层。 我们的模型实现了以字幕和捆绑框条件输入的开放世界的基于基础的文本生成2img , 基底能力对新的空间配置和概念非常概括。 GLIGEN在COCO和LVIS上的零弹性能比现有的受监督的布局到图像基线高出很大距离。

papers.title: Generalist: Decoupling Natural and Robust Generalization
papers.authors: Hongjun Wang, Yisen Wang
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks obtained by standard training have been constantly plagued by adversarial examples. Although adversarial training demonstrates its capability to defend against adversarial examples, unfortunately, it leads to an inevitable drop in the natural generalization. To address the issue, we decouple the natural generalization and the robust generalization from joint training and formulate different training strategies for each one. Specifically, instead of minimizing a global loss on the expectation over these two generalization errors, we propose a bi-expert framework called Generalist where we simultaneously train base learners with task-aware strategies so that they can specialize in their own fields. The parameters of base learners are collected and combined to form a global learner at intervals during the training process. The global learner is then distributed to the base learners as initialized parameters for continued training. Theoretically, we prove that the risks of Generalist will get lower once the base learners are well trained. Extensive experiments verify the applicability of Generalist to achieve high accuracy on natural examples while maintaining considerable robustness to adversarial ones. Code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ML/Generalist.
papers.title_zh: 通则:自然和强力解耦
papers.abstract_zh: 通过标准培训获得的深神经网络不断受到对抗性实例的困扰,尽管对抗性培训表明它有能力抵御对抗性实例,但不幸的是,它导致自然的概括性不可避免地下降。 为了解决这一问题,我们将自然的概括和有力的概括与联合培训解耦,并为每个培训制定不同的培训战略。 具体地说,我们建议一个称为通才的双专家框架,同时对基础学习者进行有任务意识战略的培训,以便他们能够专门从事自己的领域,而不是尽可能减少对这两个一般化错误的预期造成的全球损失。 在培训过程中,收集基础学习者的参数并将其合并,每隔一段时间形成全球学习者,然后将全球学习者作为继续培训的初始参数分发给基础学习者。 从理论上讲,我们证明,一旦基础学习者受过良好培训,通才的风险就会降低。 广泛的实验可以验证通才是否适合在自然例子方面实现高度准确性,同时对对抗性例子保持相当强健。 守则可在https://github.com/PKU-ML/Genist查阅。

papers.title: Gated Stereo: Joint Depth Estimation From Gated and Wide-Baseline Active Stereo Cues
papers.authors: Stefanie Walz, Mario Bijelic, Andrea Ramazzina, Amanpreet Walia, Fahim Mannan, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: We propose Gated Stereo, a high-resolution and long-range depth estimation technique that operates on active gated stereo images. Using active and high dynamic range passive captures, Gated Stereo exploits multi-view cues alongside time-of-flight intensity cues from active gating. To this end, we propose a depth estimation method with a monocular and stereo depth prediction branch which are combined in a final fusion stage. Each block is supervised through a combination of supervised and gated self-supervision losses. To facilitate training and validation, we acquire a long-range synchronized gated stereo dataset for automotive scenarios. We find that the method achieves an improvement of more than 50 % MAE compared to the next best RGB stereo method, and 74 % MAE to existing monocular gated methods for distances up to 160 m. Our code, models and datasets are available here: https://light.princeton.edu/gatedstereo/.
papers.title_zh: Gated 立体立体:根据Gated和广基活性立体立体立体对Gated和广基活性立体立体进行的共同深度估计
papers.abstract_zh: 我们建议采用高分辨率和长程深度估计技术Gated Steeo,该技术使用活跃的闭门立体图像。 Gated Steeo使用主动和高动态范围被动捕捉器,在飞行时间强度提示的同时,利用主动悬浮的多视角提示。 为此,我们提出一个深度估算方法,配有一个单眼和立体深度预测分支,在最后的核聚变阶段加以合并,每个区块都通过监督的和封闭的自我监督损失相结合进行监督。 为了便利培训和验证,我们获得了一套汽车假想情况的长距离同步闭门立体数据集。 我们发现该方法比次最佳RGB立体法改进了50%以上的MAE, 现有单眼闭门法改进了74%的MAE,距离可达160米。 我们的代码、模型和数据集可在此查阅:https://light.prienceton.edu/gaatestereo/。

papers.title: Gated Multi-Resolution Transfer Network for Burst Restoration and Enhancement
papers.authors: Nancy Mehta, Akshay Dudhane, Subrahmanyam Murala, Syed Waqas Zamir, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
papers.abstract: Burst image processing is becoming increasingly popular in recent years. However, it is a challenging task since individual burst images undergo multiple degradations and often have mutual misalignments resulting in ghosting and zipper artifacts. Existing burst restoration methods usually do not consider the mutual correlation and non-local contextual information among burst frames, which tends to limit these approaches in challenging cases. Another key challenge lies in the robust up-sampling of burst frames. The existing up-sampling methods cannot effectively utilize the advantages of single-stage and progressive up-sampling strategies with conventional and/or recent up-samplers at the same time. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Gated Multi-Resolution Transfer Network (GMTNet) to reconstruct a spatially precise high-quality image from a burst of low-quality raw images. GMTNet consists of three modules optimized for burst processing tasks: Multi-scale Burst Feature Alignment (MBFA) for feature denoising and alignment, Transposed-Attention Feature Merging (TAFM) for multi-frame feature aggregation, and Resolution Transfer Feature Up-sampler (RTFU) to up-scale merged features and construct a high-quality output image. Detailed experimental analysis on five datasets validate our approach and sets a new state-of-the-art for burst super-resolution, burst denoising, and low-light burst enhancement. Our codes and models are available at https://github.com/nanmehta/GMTNet.
papers.title_zh: Gated 恢复和加强沉重恢复和加强多分辨率传输网络
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,污泥图像处理越来越受欢迎,然而,这是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为个人爆裂图像经历了多重退化,而且经常发生相互错配,导致幽灵和拉链手工艺品。 现有防爆恢复方法通常不考虑防爆框架之间相互关系和非当地背景信息,因为防爆框架往往在具有挑战性的情况下限制这些方法,另一个关键挑战在于强力地标出防爆框架。 现有的上标方法无法同时有效地利用单一阶段和渐进式上标战略与传统和(或)最近的上标战略的优势。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个新型的GMT多分辨率传输网络(GMTNet),从一连串低质量原始图像中重建空间精确的高质量图像。 GMTNet由三个为爆破处理任务优化的模块组成:用于特征拆卸和对齐的多尺度布局特征调整模块、用于多框架特征聚合的转储-惯性特征合并模块和用于升级合并功能和构建高质量输出图像的分辨率传输特性更新模块(RTFU)。 对五个数据集的详细实验分析证实了我们的方法,并为爆破超级分辨率、爆破破破分解和低光爆破强化设定了新的最新技术,我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/nanmehta/GMTNet上查阅。

papers.title: Full or Weak Annotations? An Adaptive Strategy for Budget-Constrained Annotation Campaigns
papers.authors: Javier Gamazo Tejero, Martin S. Zinkernagel, Sebastian Wolf, Raphael Sznitman, Pablo Márquez-Neila
papers.abstract: Annotating new datasets for machine learning tasks is tedious, time-consuming, and costly. For segmentation applications, the burden is particularly high as manual delineations of relevant image content are often extremely expensive or can only be done by experts with domain-specific knowledge. Thanks to developments in transfer learning and training with weak supervision, segmentation models can now also greatly benefit from annotations of different kinds. However, for any new domain application looking to use weak supervision, the dataset builder still needs to define a strategy to distribute full segmentation and other weak annotations. Doing so is challenging, however, as it is a priori unknown how to distribute an annotation budget for a given new dataset. To this end, we propose a novel approach to determine annotation strategies for segmentation datasets, whereby estimating what proportion of segmentation and classification annotations should be collected given a fixed budget. To do so, our method sequentially determines proportions of segmentation and classification annotations to collect for budget-fractions by modeling the expected improvement of the final segmentation model. We show in our experiments that our approach yields annotations that perform very close to the optimal for a number of different annotation budgets and datasets.
papers.title_zh: 完整说明还是弱说明? 受预算限制的批注运动的适应战略
papers.abstract_zh: 指出机器学习任务的新数据集既乏味又费时又费钱。 对于分割应用,负担特别沉重,因为人工划定相关图像内容往往非常昂贵,或者只能由拥有特定领域知识的专家完成。 由于转移学习和培训方面的发展以及监督不力,分化模式现在也可以大大受益于不同种类的说明。 然而,对于任何试图使用薄弱监督手段的新域应用程序,数据集构建器仍需要确定一项战略,以分发完全分解和其他薄弱的注释。 然而,这样做具有挑战性,因为事先不知道如何为特定的新数据集分配注解预算。 为此,我们提议采取新办法,确定分解数据集的说明战略,根据固定预算估算分解和分类说明中应收集的比例。 为此,我们采用的方法通过模拟最终分割模式的预期改进,按顺序确定为预算违规收集的分区和分类说明的比例。 我们在实验中显示,我们的方法产生说明,非常接近于若干不同的说明预算和数据集的最佳效果。

papers.title: Flexi-FSCIL: Adaptive Knowledge Retention for Breaking the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
papers.authors: Wufei Xie · Yalin Wang · Chenliang Liu · Zhaohui Jiang · Xue Yang
papers.abstract: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) is challenged by limited data and expanding class spaces, leading to overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods, which often freeze feature extractors and use Nearest Class Mean classifiers, sacrifice adaptability to new feature distributions. To address these issues, we propose Flexi-FSCIL, a semi-supervised framework that integrates three novel strategies: Adaptive Gated Residual Fusion (AGRF), Attention-Guided Dynamic Hybrid Distillation (ADHD), and Prototype Offset Equilibrium (POE). Flexi-FSCIL effectively balances stability and plasticity in FSCIL. AGRF resolves the rigidity of frozen feature extractors by integrating both frozen and trainable components, enabling adaptive feature learning while retaining old-class knowledge. ADHD tackles the imbalance between old and new tasks by dynamically aligning features using cross-attention maps and direct matching, preserving old-class knowledge while facilitating new-class learning. POE addresses the issue of prototype drift in semi-supervised settings by selecting high-quality unlabeled samples, maintaining feature space separability and preventing overfitting. Evaluated on three benchmark datasets, Flexi-FSCIL achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing FSCIL methods with only 12.97 performance drop on CUB200.
papers.title_zh: FLIF-FSCIL:在少温级入门学习中打破稳定-弹性困难的适应性知识保留
papers.abstract_zh: 数据有限,班级空间扩大,导致过度适应和灾难性的遗忘。 现有方法往往冻结特征提取器和使用近等中值分类,牺牲了对新特征分布的适应性。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用弹性-FSCIL(Flexi-FSCIL)这一半监督框架,将以下三种新颖战略结合起来:适应性Gated残余融合(AGRF)、引人注意的动态混合蒸馏(ADHD)和原型平衡平衡(POE),弹性-FSCIL(FFFSCIL)有效地平衡了FSCI的稳定性和可塑性。 AGERF通过整合冻结和可训练的部件,解决冷冻特征提取器的僵硬问题,使适应性特征学习成为可能,同时保留古老的知识。 DADHD解决新旧任务之间的不平衡问题,办法是动态地统一各种特征,使用相互注意的地图和直接匹配,保留旧知识,同时促进新班的学习。 POE通过选择高质量的无标签样本、保持特征空间分离性并防止过度装配,解决半监督环境中原型漂移的问题。 在对三个基准数据集进行评估后,Flexi-FSCIL取得了SOTA 性能,大大优于现有的FSCIL方法,CUB200的绩效仅下降12.97。

papers.title: FineDance: A Fine-grained Choreography Dataset for 3D Full Body Dance Generation
papers.authors: Ronghui Li, Junfan Zhao, Yachao Zhang, Mingyang Su, Zeping Ren, Han Zhang, Yansong Tang, Xiu Li
papers.abstract: Generating full-body and multi-genre dance sequences from given music is a challenging task, due to the limitations of existing datasets and the inherent complexity of the fine-grained hand motion and dance genres. To address these problems, we propose FineDance, which contains 14.6 hours of music-dance paired data, with fine-grained hand motions, fine-grained genres (22 dance genres), and accurate posture. To the best of our knowledge, FineDance is the largest music-dance paired dataset with the most dance genres. Additionally, to address monotonous and unnatural hand movements existing in previous methods, we propose a full-body dance generation network, which utilizes the diverse generation capabilities of the diffusion model to solve monotonous problems, and use expert nets to solve unreal problems. To further enhance the genrematching and long-term stability of generated dances, we propose a Genre&Coherent aware Retrieval Module. Besides, we propose a new metric named Genre Matching Score to measure the genre matching between dance and music. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the quality of FineDance, and the state-of-the-art performance of FineNet.
papers.title_zh: FineDance: 3D 全体舞蹈制作的精美舞蹈数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 从特定音乐中产生全体和多族舞蹈序列是一项艰巨的任务,因为现有数据集有限,精细的手动和舞蹈风格具有内在的复杂性。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议“FineDance ” ( FineDance ) , 它包含14.6小时的音乐舞蹈配对数据,配有精细的手动、精细的基因(22个舞蹈流派 ) 和准确的姿势。 据我们所知,“FineDance ” 是最大的音乐舞蹈配对数据集,配有最多舞蹈流派。 此外,为解决以往方法中存在的单体和非自然手动问题,我们提议建立一个全体舞蹈生成网络,利用扩散模型的多种生成能力解决单体问题,并利用专家网解决非现实问题。 为了进一步加强舞蹈的流派和长期稳定性,我们提议了一个常识和和谐意识回收模块。 此外,我们提议了一个名为“珍尔匹配得分”的新指标,以测量舞蹈和音乐的流派匹配率。 我们建议用“珍尔匹配得分 ” ( Genre 匹配得分 ) , 以测量舞蹈和音乐的流派匹配率。 定量和定性实验显示了罚款的质量以及罚款网的最新表现。

papers.title: FIGARO: Controllable Music Generation using Learned and Expert Features
papers.authors: Dimitri von Rütte, Luca Biggio, Yannic Kilcher, Thomas Hofmann
papers.title_zh: FIGARO:利用知识和专家特点,可控的音乐制作

papers.title: FACET: Fairness in Computer Vision Evaluation Benchmark
papers.authors: Laura Gustafson, Chloe Rolland, Nikhila Ravi, Quentin Duval, Aaron Adcock, Cheng-Yang Fu, Melissa Hall, Candace Ross
papers.abstract: Computer vision models have known performance disparities across attributes such as gender and skin tone. This means during tasks such as classification and detection, model performance differs for certain classes based on the demographics of the people in the image. These disparities have been shown to exist, but until now there has not been a unified approach to measure these differences for common use-cases of computer vision models. We present a new benchmark named FACET (FAirness in Computer Vision EvaluaTion), a large, publicly available evaluation set of 32k images for some of the most common vision tasks - image classification, object detection and segmentation. For every image in FACET, we hired expert reviewers to manually annotate person-related attributes such as perceived skin tone and hair type, manually draw bounding boxes and label fine-grained person-related classes such as disk jockey or guitarist. In addition, we use FACET to benchmark state-of-the-art vision models and present a deeper understanding of potential performance disparities and challenges across sensitive demographic attributes. With the exhaustive annotations collected, we probe models using single demographics attributes as well as multiple attributes using an intersectional approach (e.g. hair color and perceived skin tone). Our results show that classification, detection, segmentation, and visual grounding models exhibit performance disparities across demographic attributes and intersections of attributes. These harms suggest that not all people represented in datasets receive fair and equitable treatment in these vision tasks. We hope current and future results using our benchmark will contribute to fairer, more robust vision models. FACET is available publicly at https://facet.metademolab.com
papers.title_zh: FACET: 计算机远景评估基准的公平性
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机视觉模型在性别和肤色等属性之间存在已知的性能差异,这意味着在诸如分类和检测等任务期间,根据图像中的人的人口统计,某些类别的模型性能不同。 这些差异已经证明存在,但到目前为止,还没有统一的方法来衡量计算机视觉模型共同使用情况的这些差异。 我们提出了一个新的基准,名为FACET(计算机视觉天文卫星的危险性),这是一套由32k图像组成的大型公开评价,用于一些最常见的视觉任务 -- -- 图像分类、物体探测和分割。 对于FACET中的每张图像,我们雇用专家审查员手动说明与人有关的属性,例如人们所认为的肤色和发型,手动绘制捆绑盒,并贴上磁盘骑手或吉他手等精细的与人有关的分类标签。 此外,我们利用FACET为最先进的远景模型基准,更深入地了解敏感人口特征之间潜在的业绩差距和挑战。 我们收集了详尽无遗的说明,通过交叉方法(如毛发颜色和感知的肤色),用单一人口特征和多重属性来调查模型。 我们的结果表明,分类、检测、分解和视觉定位模型在人口特征和特征交叉方面表现出不同性能差异。 这些伤害表明,并非所有在数据集中任职的人在这些视觉任务中得到公正和公平的待遇。 我们希望使用我们基准的当前和未来成果将有助于建立更公平、更健全的视觉模型,FACET可在https://facet.metademolab.com上公开查阅。

papers.title: FaceCLIPNeRF: Text-driven 3D Face Manipulation using Deformable Neural Radiance Fields
papers.authors: Sungwon Hwang, Junha Hyung, Daejin Kim, Min-Jung Kim, Jaegul Choo
papers.abstract: As recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have enabled high-fidelity 3D face reconstruction and novel view synthesis, its manipulation also became an essential task in 3D vision. However, existing manipulation methods require extensive human labor, such as a user-provided semantic mask and manual attribute search unsuitable for non-expert users. Instead, our approach is designed to require a single text to manipulate a face reconstructed with NeRF. To do so, we first train a scene manipulator, a latent code-conditional deformable NeRF, over a dynamic scene to control a face deformation using the latent code. However, representing a scene deformation with a single latent code is unfavorable for compositing local deformations observed in different instances. As so, our proposed Position-conditional Anchor Compositor (PAC) learns to represent a manipulated scene with spatially varying latent codes. Their renderings with the scene manipulator are then optimized to yield high cosine similarity to a target text in CLIP embedding space for text-driven manipulation. To the best of our knowledge, our approach is the first to address the text-driven manipulation of a face reconstructed with NeRF. Extensive results, comparisons, and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.title_zh: FaceCLIPNERF: 使用变形神经辐射场进行文字驱动的 3D 脸部操纵
papers.abstract_zh: 由于神经辐射场(NERF)最近的进展使高度忠诚的3D能够面对重建和新颖的观点合成,操纵3D视觉也成为一项基本任务。 然而,现有的操纵方法需要大量的人力劳动,比如用户提供的语义遮罩和人工属性搜索,这些都不适合非专家用户。 相反,我们的方法是要求用单一文本来操纵用NeRF重建的面孔。 为了做到这一点,我们首先训练一个现场操纵器,一个潜伏的代码条件变形的NeRF,在一个动态的场景上,用潜伏代码控制面部变形。 然而,代表一个带有单一潜伏代码的场景变形,对于在不同情况下观察到的局部变形的合成来说是不可取的。 因此,我们提出的定位条件锚组合器(PAC)学会以空间上不同的潜在代码来代表一个被操纵的场景。 然后,它们与现场操纵器的图像得到优化,产生与CLIP中用于文本驱动操作的嵌入空间的目标文本高度相似的共弦性。 就我们所知,我们的方法是第一个解决文本驱动的对用NeRF重建的面孔的操纵。 广泛的结果、比较和通货膨胀研究表明了我们的方法的有效性。
