papers.title: ERNIE-ViLG 2.0: Improving Text-to-Image Diffusion Model With Knowledge-Enhanced Mixture-of-Denoising-Experts
papers.authors: Zhida Feng, Zhenyu Zhang, Xintong Yu, Yewei Fang, Lanxin Li, Xuyi Chen, Yuxiang Lu, Jiaxiang Liu, Weichong Yin, Shikun Feng, Yu Sun, Li Chen, Hao Tian, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Recent progress in diffusion models has revolutionized the popular technology of text-to-image generation. While existing approaches could produce photorealistic high-resolution images with text conditions, there are still several open problems to be solved, which limits the further improvement of image fidelity and text relevancy. In this paper, we propose ERNIE-ViLG 2.0, a large-scale Chinese text-to-image diffusion model, to progressively upgrade the quality of generated images by: (1) incorporating fine-grained textual and visual knowledge of key elements in the scene, and (2) utilizing different denoising experts at different denoising stages. With the proposed mechanisms, ERNIE-ViLG 2.0 not only achieves a new state-of-the-art on MS-COCO with zero-shot FID-30k score of 6.75, but also significantly outperforms recent models in terms of image fidelity and image-text alignment, with side-by-side human evaluation on the bilingual prompt set ViLG-300.
papers.title_zh: ERNIE-VILG 2.0:改进有知识强化混合销毁-专家的文本到图像传播模型
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在传播模型方面的进展使流行的文本到图像生成技术发生了革命性的变化。 虽然现有办法可以产生具有文字条件的具有摄影现实性的高分辨率图像,但仍有一些尚未解决的问题有待解决,这限制了图像忠诚性和文字相关性的进一步改善。 在本文中,我们建议 " ERNIE-VILG 2.0 " ,即一个大型中文文本到图像扩散模型,通过下列方式逐步提高生成图像的质量:(1) 纳入对现场关键要素的精细文字和视觉知识,(2) 利用不同拆分阶段的不同非净化专家。 在拟议的机制下,ERNIE-VILG 2.0不仅在MS-CO上实现了新的最新技术,FID-30k零射分为6.75,而且在图像忠诚和图像-文字调整方面大大优于最近的模型,同时对双语的速成VILG-300进行人际评价。

papers.title: Ensemble-based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Vehicle Routing Problems under Distribution Shift
papers.authors: YUAN JIANG, Zhiguang Cao, Yaoxin Wu, Wen Song, Jie Zhang
papers.title_zh: 在分配轮档下对车辆运行问题进行基于集合体的深强化学习

papers.title: EMQ: Evolving Training-free Proxies for Automated Mixed Precision Quantization
papers.authors: Peijie Dong, Lujun Li, Zimian Wei, Xin Niu, Zhiliang Tian, Hengyue Pan
papers.abstract: Mixed-Precision Quantization (MQ) can achieve a competitive accuracy-complexity trade-off for models. Conventional training-based search methods require time-consuming candidate training to search optimized per-layer bit-width configurations in MQ. Recently, some training-free approaches have presented various MQ proxies and significantly improve search efficiency. However, the correlation between these proxies and quantization accuracy is poorly understood. To address the gap, we first build the MQ-Bench-101, which involves different bit configurations and quantization results. Then, we observe that the existing training-free proxies perform weak correlations on the MQ-Bench-101. To efficiently seek superior proxies, we develop an automatic search of proxies framework for MQ via evolving algorithms. In particular, we devise an elaborate search space involving the existing proxies and perform an evolution search to discover the best correlated MQ proxy. We proposed a diversity-prompting selection strategy and compatibility screening protocol to avoid premature convergence and improve search efficiency. In this way, our Evolving proxies for Mixed-precision Quantization (EMQ) framework allows the auto-generation of proxies without heavy tuning and expert knowledge. Extensive experiments on ImageNet with various ResNet and MobileNet families demonstrate that our EMQ obtains superior performance than state-of-the-art mixed-precision methods at a significantly reduced cost. The code will be released.
papers.title_zh: EMQ:自动混合精密度量化方面不断发展的无培训替代物
papers.abstract_zh: 混合精度量化(MQ)可以实现对模型的竞争性精确度和复杂度的权衡。 常规培训搜索方法需要耗时的候选培训,以搜索MQ中优化的每层位宽配置。 最近,一些无培训做法呈现出多种最低质量标准替代物,大大提高了搜索效率,但对这些替代物与量化准确度之间的相互关系了解甚少。 为了弥补这一差距,我们首先建立MQ-Bench-101,它涉及不同的位元配置和量化结果。 然后,我们观察到,现有的无培训代理在MQ-Bench-101上存在薄弱的关联。 为了高效地寻找上级代理人,我们开发了一种通过演进的算法自动搜索MQ代理框架的方法。 特别是,我们设计了一个复杂的搜索空间,让现有的代理参与其中,并进行进化搜索,以发现最相联的 MQ 代理。 我们提出了一个多样性快速选择战略和兼容性筛选程序,以避免过早的趋同并提高搜索效率。 这样,我们混合精度量化(EMQ)框架(EMQ)不断演变,使得替代物的自动生成无需高调和专业知识。 与各种ResNet和移动网络家庭进行的广泛图像网络实验表明,我们的EMQ的性能优于最先进的混合精度方法,成本大大降低。 代码将被发布。

papers.title: Efficient Frequency Domain-Based Transformers for High-Quality Image Deblurring
papers.authors: Lingshun Kong, Jiangxin Dong, Jianjun Ge, Mingqiang Li, Jinshan Pan
papers.abstract: We present an effective and efficient method that explores the properties of Transformers in the frequency domain for high-quality image deblurring. Our method is motivated by the convolution theorem that the correlation or convolution of two signals in the spatial domain is equivalent to an element-wise product of them in the frequency domain. This inspires us to develop an efficient frequency domain-based self-attention solver (FSAS) to estimate the scaled dot-product attention by an element-wise product operation instead of the matrix multiplication in the spatial domain. In addition, we note that simply using the naive feed-forward network (FFN) in Transformers does not generate good deblurred results. To overcome this problem, we propose a simple yet effective discriminative frequency domain-based FFN (DFFN), where we introduce a gated mechanism in the FFN based on the Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) compression algorithm to discriminatively determine which low- and high-frequency information of the features should be preserved for latent clear image restoration. We formulate the proposed FSAS and DFFN into an asymmetrical network based on an encoder and decoder architecture, where the FSAS is only used in the decoder module for better image deblurring. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs favorably against the state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.title_zh: 高效频率 高品质图像稀释以域为基础的高品质图像变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个有效、高效的方法,探索变形器在高品质图像破损频域的特性。 我们的方法的动因是,在空间域中,两个信号的相关性或相联性相当于它们在频率域中的元素产物。 这激励我们开发一个高效频域域自控自控求解器(FSAS),以估计通过元素化产品操作而不是空间域矩阵乘法而缩小的点产品关注度。 此外,我们注意到,仅仅在Transformer中使用天真的进食前向网络(FFN)并不能产生好的腐蚀结果。 为了克服这一问题,我们建议采用一种简单而有效的基于歧视频率的、基于域的FFFFF(FFFF FF),在FFFF内采用基于联合摄影专家组压缩算法的封闭机制,以区别地确定应保留哪些关于这些特征的低频和高频信息,以便潜在的清晰图像恢复。 我们把拟议的FSAS和DFFN发展成一个基于编码器和解码器结构的不对称网络,其中FSAS只用于解码器模块,以更好地解码。 实验结果显示,拟议的方法与最先进的方法相对应。

papers.title: Efficient Discovery and Effective Evaluation of Visual Perceptual Similarity: A Benchmark and Beyond
papers.authors: Oren Barkan, Tal Reiss, Jonathan Weill, Ori Katz, Roy Hirsch, Itzik Malkiel, Noam Koenigstein
papers.abstract: Visual similarities discovery (VSD) is an important task with broad e-commerce applications. Given an image of a certain object, the goal of VSD is to retrieve images of different objects with high perceptual visual similarity. Although being a highly addressed problem, the evaluation of proposed methods for VSD is often based on a proxy of an identification-retrieval task, evaluating the ability of a model to retrieve different images of the same object. We posit that evaluating VSD methods based on identification tasks is limited, and faithful evaluation must rely on expert annotations. In this paper, we introduce the first large-scale fashion visual similarity benchmark dataset, consisting of more than 110K expert-annotated image pairs. Besides this major contribution, we share insight from the challenges we faced while curating this dataset. Based on these insights, we propose a novel and efficient labeling procedure that can be applied to any dataset. Our analysis examines its limitations and inductive biases, and based on these findings, we propose metrics to mitigate those limitations. Though our primary focus lies on visual similarity, the methodologies we present have broader applications for discovering and evaluating perceptual similarity across various domains.
papers.title_zh: 有效发现和有效评价视觉概念相似性:基准及以后
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉相似性发现(VSD)是具有广泛的电子商务应用的重要任务。 鉴于特定物体的图像,VSD的目标是检索具有高度视觉相似性的不同物体的图像。 虽然评价VSD的拟议方法是一个高度处理的问题,但评价往往以身份识别-检索任务的代理为基础,评价模型检索同一对象不同图像的能力。 我们假设基于识别任务对VSD方法的评价是有限的,而忠实的评价必须依靠专家说明。 在本文中,我们引入了第一个大型时尚视觉相似性基准数据集,由110K以上专家附加说明的图像配对组成。 除了这一重大贡献之外,我们还分享了我们在整理这一数据集时所面临的挑战的见解。 基于这些见解,我们建议了一个新的、高效的标签程序,可用于任何数据集。 我们的分析审查了其局限性和暗示偏见,根据这些调查结果,我们提出了减轻这些局限性的衡量标准。 虽然我们的主要重点是视觉相似性,但我们提出的方法在发现和评价各个领域的观念相似性方面有更广泛的应用。

papers.title: DynamicISP: Dynamically Controlled Image Signal Processor for Image Recognition
papers.authors: Masakazu Yoshimura, Junji Otsuka, Atsushi Irie, Takeshi Ohashi
papers.abstract: Image Signal Processors (ISPs) play important roles in image recognition tasks as well as in the perceptual quality of captured images. In most cases, experts make a lot of effort to manually tune many parameters of ISPs, but the parameters are sub-optimal. In the literature, two types of techniques have been actively studied: a machine learning-based parameter tuning technique and a DNN-based ISP technique. The former is lightweight but lacks expressive power. The latter has expressive power, but the computational cost is too heavy on edge devices. To solve these problems, we propose "DynamicISP," which consists of multiple classical ISP functions and dynamically controls the parameters of each frame according to the recognition result of the previous frame. We show our method successfully controls the parameters of multiple ISP functions and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with low computational cost in single and multi-category object detection tasks.
papers.title_zh: D动态ISP: 图像识别动态控制图像信号处理器
papers.abstract_zh: 图像信号处理器(ISPs)在图像识别任务以及被捕获图像的感知质量方面发挥着重要作用。 在大多数情况下,专家会做出大量努力手动调整ISP的许多参数,但参数是次优的。 在文献中,对两种技术进行了积极研究:机械学习参数调试技术和基于DNN的ISP技术,前者为轻量级,但缺乏表达力,后者具有表达力,但边缘装置的计算成本太高。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议“动态系统”,它由多种古典ISP功能组成,根据前一个框架的确认结果,动态控制每个框架的参数。 我们展示我们的方法成功控制了多个ISP功能的参数,并在单个和多类物体探测任务中以低计算成本实现了最先进的精确度。

papers.title: DynamicDet: A Unified Dynamic Architecture for Object Detection
papers.authors: Zhihao Lin, Yongtao Wang, Jinhe Zhang, Xiaojie Chu
papers.abstract: Dynamic neural network is an emerging research topic in deep learning. With adaptive inference, dynamic models can achieve remarkable accuracy and computational efficiency. However, it is challenging to design a powerful dynamic detector, because of no suitable dynamic architecture and exiting criterion for object detection. To tackle these difficulties, we propose a dynamic framework for object detection, named DynamicDet. Firstly, we carefully design a dynamic architecture based on the nature of the object detection task. Then, we propose an adaptive router to analyze the multi-scale information and to decide the inference route automatically. We also present a novel optimization strategy with an exiting criterion based on the detection losses for our dynamic detectors. Last, we present a variable-speed inference strategy, which helps to realize a wide range of accuracy-speed trade-offs with only one dynamic detector. Extensive experiments conducted on the COCO benchmark demonstrate that the proposed DynamicDet achieves new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs. For instance, with comparable accuracy, the inference speed of our dynamic detector Dy-YOLOv7-W6 surpasses YOLOv7-E6 by 12%, YOLOv7-D6 by 17%, and YOLOv7-E6E by 39%. The code is available at https://github.com/VDIGPKU/DynamicDet.
papers.title_zh: DiveDet:用于物体探测的统一动态结构
papers.abstract_zh: 动态神经网络是深层学习中新出现的研究课题。 随着适应性的推论,动态模型可以实现惊人的准确性和计算效率。 然而,设计一个强大的动态探测器是具有挑战性的,因为没有合适的动态结构,也没有关于天体探测的标准。 为了解决这些困难,我们提议了一个名为动态数据(DiveDet)的动态天体探测框架。 首先,我们根据物体探测任务的性质仔细设计一个动态结构。然后,我们建议一个适应性路由器来分析多尺度信息,并自动决定推论路线。 我们还提出了一个新颖的优化战略,根据我们动态探测器的探测损失标准推出一个退出标准。 最后,我们提出了一个可变速度推论战略,它帮助实现广泛的精确速度权衡,只有一个动态探测器。 对COCO基准进行的广泛实验表明,拟议的动态Det实现了新的最先进的精确速度平衡。 比如,以可比的准确性,我们的动态探测器Dy-YOLOv7-W6的推论速度超过YOLOv7-E6的12%,YOLOv7-D6的17%,YOLOv7-E6的39%。 该代码可在https://github.com/VDIGPKU/DynamicDet查阅。

papers.title: DualRel: Semi-Supervised Mitochondria Segmentation From a Prototype Perspective
papers.authors: Huayu Mai, Rui Sun, Tianzhu Zhang, Zhiwei Xiong, Feng Wu
papers.abstract: Automatic mitochondria segmentation enjoys great popularity with the development of deep learning. However, existing methods rely heavily on the labor-intensive manual gathering by experienced domain experts. And naively applying semi-supervised segmentation methods in the natural image field to mitigate the labeling cost is undesirable. In this work, we analyze the gap between mitochondrial images and natural images and rethink how to achieve effective semi-supervised mitochondria segmentation, from the perspective of reliable prototype-level supervision. We propose a novel end-to-end dual-reliable (DualRel) network, including a reliable pixel aggregation module and a reliable prototype selection module. The proposed DualRel enjoys several merits. First, to learn the prototypes well without any explicit supervision, we carefully design the referential correlation to rectify the direct pairwise correlation. Second, the reliable prototype selection module is responsible for further evaluating the reliability of prototypes in constructing prototype-level consistency regularization. Extensive experimental results on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art semi-supervised segmentation methods. Importantly, with extremely few samples used for training, DualRel is also on par with current state-of-the-art fully supervised methods.
papers.title_zh: 双Rel: 从原型角度的半有效米托昆德里亚分割
papers.abstract_zh: 随着深层学习的发展,自动微分分法非常受欢迎。 但是,现有的方法严重依赖经验丰富的领域专家的劳动密集型手工收集。 在自然图像领域使用半监督的分解方法来降低标签成本是不可取的。 在这项工作中,我们从可靠的原型监督角度,分析线粒体图像与自然图像之间的差距,并重新思考如何实现有效的半监督的米多支离子分解。 我们提议建立一个新型端对端双可靠(DualRel)网络,包括一个可靠的像素组合模块和一个可靠的原型选择模块。 拟议的双雷尔具有若干优点。 首先,为了在没有任何明确监督的情况下很好地学习原型,我们仔细设计了特惠关系,以纠正直接对等关系。 第二,可靠的原型选择模块负责进一步评价原型的可靠性,以建立原型一致性规范化。 在三个具有挑战性的基准上的广泛实验结果表明,我们的方法与最先进的半监督分解方法相比,效果良好。 重要的是,在培训中使用的样本极少的情况下,DualRel(DualRel)也与目前最先进的完全监督的方法相当。

papers.title: Diffusion Probabilistic Model Made Slim
papers.authors: Xingyi Yang, Daquan Zhou, Jiashi Feng, Xinchao Wang
papers.abstract: Despite the visually-pleasing results achieved, the massive computational cost has been a long-standing flaw for diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs), which, in turn, greatly limits their applications on resource-limited platforms. Prior methods towards efficient DPM, however, have largely focused on accelerating the testing yet overlooked their huge complexity and size. In this paper, we make a dedicated attempt to lighten DPM while striving to preserve its favourable performance. We start by training a small-sized latent diffusion model (LDM) from scratch but observe a significant fidelity drop in the synthetic images. Through a thorough assessment, we find that DPM is intrinsically biased against high-frequency generation, and learns to recover different frequency components at different time-steps. These properties make compact networks unable to represent frequency dynamics with accurate high-frequency estimation. Towards this end, we introduce a customized design for slim DPM, which we term as Spectral Diffusion (SD), for lightweight image synthesis. SD incorporates wavelet gating in its architecture to enable frequency dynamic feature extraction at every reverse steps, and conducts spectrum-aware distillation to promote high-frequency recovery by inverse weighting the objective based on spectrum magnitudes. Experimental results demonstrate that, SD achieves 8-18x computational complexity reduction as compared to the latent diffusion models on a series of conditional and unconditional image generation tasks while retaining competitive image fidelity.
papers.title_zh: 传播概率模型
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管取得了目光令人振奋的成果,但庞大的计算成本一直是传播概率模型的长期缺陷,而传播概率模型反过来又大大限制了其在资源有限的平台上的应用。 然而,在采用高效的虫害防治方法之前,我们主要侧重于加快测试速度,但忽略了测试的庞大复杂性和规模。 在本文中,我们专门致力于在努力保持其良好性能的同时,减轻虫害防治。 我们首先从零开始训练一个小型潜伏扩散模型(LDM),但注意到合成图像的忠诚性显著下降。 通过全面评估,我们发现DPM本质上对高频生成有偏见,并学会在不同时间步骤中回收不同频率组件。 这些特性使得紧凑网络无法代表精确高频估计的频率动态。 为此,我们为微缩的 DPM 推出一个定制的设计, 我们称之为光谱扩散(SD), 用于轻量级图像合成。 SD在其结构结构中包含波子凝结,使每个反向步骤都能进行频率动态特征提取,并进行频谱蒸馏,通过根据频谱大小对目标进行反加权,促进高频恢复。 实验结果表明,与一系列有条件和无条件的图像生成任务的潜在扩散模型相比,SD实现了8-18x的计算复杂性降低,同时保持了竞争性图像忠诚。

papers.title: Depth Estimation From Camera Image and mmWave Radar Point Cloud
papers.authors: Akash Deep Singh, Yunhao Ba, Ankur Sarker, Howard Zhang, Achuta Kadambi, Stefano Soatto, Mani Srivastava, Alex Wong
papers.abstract: We present a method for inferring dense depth from a camera image and a sparse noisy radar point cloud. We first describe the mechanics behind mmWave radar point cloud formation and the challenges that it poses, i.e. ambiguous elevation and noisy depth and azimuth components that yields incorrect positions when projected onto the image, and how existing works have overlooked these nuances in camera-radar fusion. Our approach is motivated by these mechanics, leading to the design of a network that maps each radar point to the possible surfaces that it may project onto in the image plane. Unlike existing works, we do not process the raw radar point cloud as an erroneous depth map, but query each raw point independently to associate it with likely pixels in the image -- yielding a semi-dense radar depth map. To fuse radar depth with an image, we propose a gated fusion scheme that accounts for the confidence scores of the correspondence so that we selectively combine radar and camera embeddings to yield a dense depth map. We test our method on the NuScenes benchmark and show a 10.3% improvement in mean absolute error and a 9.1% improvement in root-mean-square error over the best method.
papers.title_zh: 从相机图像和毫米Wave雷达点云中进行深度估计
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法,从摄像头图像和稀少的噪音雷达点云中推断密密深度。 我们首先描述了毫米Wave雷达点云层形成过程及其构成的挑战,即: 模糊的高度、吵闹的深度和方位体组件,在投射到图像时产生不正确的方位,以及现有工作如何忽略了摄像-雷达聚变中的这些细微差别。 我们的方法是由这些机械学驱动的,导致设计一个网络,绘制每个雷达的地图,指出在图像平面上可能投射到的可能表面。 与现有的工作不同,我们不把原始雷达点云作为错误的深度图处理,而是独立地Query每个原始点,将其与图像中可能的像素联系起来 -- -- 绘制半密度雷达深度图。 为了将雷达深度与图像连接起来,我们建议采用一个闭门融合计划,计算通信中的信任分数,以便我们有选择地将雷达和相机嵌入结合起来,绘制一个密集深度图。 我们用Nuscenes基准测试我们的方法,显示平均绝对误差改善10.3%,根平均值差差差比最佳方法改善9.1%。

papers.title: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Hu, Yunsheng Li, Jiancheng Lyu, Dashan Gao, Nuno Vasconcelos
papers.abstract: The problem of class incremental learning (CIL) is considered. State-of-the-art approaches use a dynamic architecture based on network expansion (NE), in which a task expert is added per task. While effective from a computational standpoint, these methods lead to models that grow quickly with the number of tasks. A new NE method, dense network expansion (DNE), is proposed to achieve a better trade-off between accuracy and model complexity. This is accomplished by the introduction of dense connections between the intermediate layers of the task expert networks, that enable the transfer of knowledge from old to new tasks via feature sharing and reusing. This sharing is implemented with a cross-task attention mechanism, based on a new task attention block (TAB), that fuses information across tasks. Unlike traditional attention mechanisms, TAB operates at the level of the feature mixing and is decoupled with spatial attentions. This is shown more effective than a joint spatial-and-task attention for CIL. The proposed DNE approach can strictly maintain the feature space of old classes while growing the network and feature scale at a much slower rate than previous methods. In result, it outperforms the previous SOTA methods by a margin of 4% in terms of accuracy, with similar or even smaller model scale.
papers.title_zh: 课堂增级学习的密集网络扩展
papers.abstract_zh: 班级递增学习(CIL)的问题得到了考虑,最先进的方法使用基于网络扩展(NE)的动态结构,每件任务中都增加一名任务专家,这些方法虽然从计算角度来说有效,但却导致随着任务数量的迅速增长模型。 提议采用新的NE方法,即密集网络扩展(DNE),以便在精确度和模型复杂性之间实现更好的权衡。 为此,在任务专家网络的中间层之间建立了密集的联系,通过特征共享和再利用将知识从旧任务转移到新任务。 这种共享是在基于新的任务关注区块(TAB)的新任务关注区块(TAB)的基础上与跨任务关注区块(TAB)的跨任务关注区块(TAB)实施的一种跨任务关注区机制下实施的,这一任务关注区块使跨任务的信息融合在一起。 与传统的关注区机制不同,TAB在特征混合层运作,并与空间关注区解耦。 这比对CIL采取共同的空间与任务关注更为有效。 拟议的DNE方法可以严格保持旧类的特色空间,同时以比以往方法慢得多的速度扩大网络和特征规模。 结果,其精确度比以前的SOTA方法高出4%的差幅,其模型规模类似甚至较小。

papers.title: Deep Factorized Metric Learning
papers.authors: Chengkun Wang, Wenzhao Zheng, Junlong Li, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.abstract: Learning a generalizable and comprehensive similarity metric to depict the semantic discrepancies between images is the foundation of many computer vision tasks. While existing methods approach this goal by learning an ensemble of embeddings with diverse objectives, the backbone network still receives a mix of all the training signals. Differently, we propose a deep factorized metric learning method (DFML) to factorize the training signal and employ different samples to train various components of the backbone network. We factorize the network to different sub-blocks and devise a learnable router to adaptively allocate the training samples to each sub-block with the objective to capture the most information. The metric model trained by DFML captures different characteristics with different sub-blocks and constitutes a generalizable metric when using all the sub-blocks. The proposed DFML achieves state-of-the-art performance on all three benchmarks for deep metric learning including CUB-200-2011, Cars196, and Stanford Online Products. We also generalize DFML to the image classification task on ImageNet-1K and observe consistent improvement in accuracy/computation trade-off. Specifically, we improve the performance of ViT-B on ImageNet (+0.2% accuracy) with less computation load (-24% FLOPs).
papers.title_zh: 深元素化计量学习
papers.abstract_zh: 学习一种通用和全面的相似性衡量标准,以描述图像之间的语义差异,这是许多计算机视觉任务的基础。 虽然现有方法通过学习一系列包含不同目标的嵌入物来实现这一目标,但骨干网络仍然得到各种培训信号的组合。 不同地说,我们建议采用一种深层次的分因素衡量学习方法(DFML),将培训信号考虑在内,并采用不同的样本来培训骨干网络的各个组成部分。 我们将网络纳入不同的小区块,并设计一个可学习的路由器,以适应性地将培训样品分配给每个小区块,目的是获取最多的信息。 DFML所培训的衡量模型掌握了不同小区块的不同特点,在使用所有小区块时构成一个通用的衡量标准。 拟议的DFML在包括CUB-200-2011、Cars196和斯坦福在线产品在内的所有三项深层计量学习基准上取得了SOTA 性能。 我们还将DFML推广到图像Net-1K的图像分类任务中,并观察到准确性/计算取舍的不断改进。 具体而言,我们在图像网络上改进VIT-B的性能(+0.2%精度),减少计算负荷(24%的FLOPs)。

papers.title: Decoupled Semantic Prototypes Enable Learning From Diverse Annotation Types for Semi-Weakly Segmentation in Expert-Driven Domains
papers.authors: Simon Reiß, Constantin Seibold, Alexander Freytag, Erik Rodner, Rainer Stiefelhagen
papers.abstract: A vast amount of images and pixel-wise annotations allowed our community to build scalable segmentation solutions for natural domains. However, the transfer to expert-driven domains like microscopy applications or medical healthcare remains difficult as domain experts are a critical factor due to their limited availability for providing pixel-wise annotations. To enable affordable segmentation solutions for such domains, we need training strategies which can simultaneously handle diverse annotation types and are not bound to costly pixel-wise annotations. In this work, we analyze existing training algorithms towards their flexibility for different annotation types and scalability to small annotation regimes. We conduct an extensive evaluation in the challenging domain of organelle segmentation and find that existing semi- and semi-weakly supervised training algorithms are not able to fully exploit diverse annotation types. Driven by our findings, we introduce Decoupled Semantic Prototypes (DSP) as a training method for semantic segmentation which enables learning from annotation types as diverse as image-level-, point-, bounding box-, and pixel-wise annotations and which leads to remarkable accuracy gains over existing solutions for semi-weakly segmentation.
papers.title_zh: 分解的语义性原型类型 能够从不同批注类型中学习,以在专家驱动域中进行半微弱分解
papers.abstract_zh: 大量图像和像素说明使我们社区得以为自然领域建立可伸缩的分解解决方案。 然而,向专家驱动的领域,如显微镜应用或医疗保健转移仍然困难重重,因为域专家是一个关键因素,因为提供像素说明的可用性有限。 为了能为这些领域提供负担得起的分解解决方案,我们需要培训战略,既能同时处理各种批注类型,又不附带昂贵的像素说明。 在这项工作中,我们分析现有的培训算法,使其具有不同批注类型和小批注制度的可伸缩性。 我们广泛评价了具有挑战性的器官分解领域,发现现有的半和半薄弱监督的培训算法无法充分利用各种批注类型。 以我们的调查结果为驱动力,我们引入了分解语义原型(DSP),作为语义分解的培训方法,以便从图象、点、边框、像素说明等不同的批注类型中学习,从而在半微分化的现有解决方案中取得显著的准确性收益。

papers.title: DA-NAS: Data Adapted Pruning for Efficient Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Xiyang Dai, Dongdong Chen, Mengchen Liu, Yinpeng Chen, Lu Yuan
papers.abstract: Efficient search is a core issue in Neural Architecture Search (NAS). It is difficult for conventional NAS algorithms to directly search the architectures on large-scale tasks like ImageNet. In general, the cost of GPU hours for NAS grows with regard to training dataset size and candidate set size. One common way is searching on a smaller proxy dataset (e.g., CIFAR-10) and then transferring to the target task (e.g., ImageNet). These architectures optimized on proxy data are not guaranteed to be optimal on the target task. Another common way is learning with a smaller candidate set, which may require expert knowledge and indeed betrays the essence of NAS. In this paper, we present DA-NAS that can directly search the architecture for large-scale target tasks while allowing a large candidate set in a more efficient manner. Our method is based on an interesting observation that the learning speed for blocks in deep neural networks is related to the difficulty of recognizing distinct categories. We carefully design a progressive data adapted pruning strategy for efficient architecture search. It will quickly trim low performed blocks on a subset of target dataset) and then gradually find the best blocks on the whole target dataset. At this time, the original candidate set becomes as compact as possible, providing a faster search in the target task. Experiments on ImageNet verify the effectiveness of our approach. It is $ extbf{2} oldsymbol{ imes}$ faster than previous methods while the accuracy is currently state-of-the-art, at $ extbf{76.2%}$ under small FLOPs constraint. It supports an argument search space (i.e., more candidate blocks) to efficiently search the best-performing architecture."
papers.title_zh: DA-NAS: 数据调整谨慎,促进高效神经结构搜索
papers.abstract_zh: 高效搜索是神经结构搜索(NAS)的一个核心问题,传统的NAS算法很难直接搜索像图像网络这样的大规模任务的结构。 一般来说,NAS的GPU小时成本在培训数据集大小和候选数据集大小方面会增加。 一种常见的方式是搜索一个较小的代用数据集(如CIFAR-10),然后转移到目标任务(如图像网络),这些根据代理数据优化的架构不能保证在目标任务上达到最佳效果。 另一种常见的方法是学习更小的一组候选人,这可能需要专家知识,而且确实背叛了NAS的精髓。 在本文中,我们介绍了DA-NAS,它可以直接搜索大规模目标任务的结构,同时允许以更有效的方式设置一个大的候选人。 我们的方法是基于一个有趣的观察,即深神经网络中街区的学习速度与识别不同类别的难度有关。 我们仔细设计了一个适应数据快速调整的修剪战略,以便高效的建筑搜索。 它将很快地在目标数据集子集上修剪低效度区块),然后逐渐在整个目标数据集中找到最佳区块。 此时,原始候选数据集尽可能紧凑,为目标任务提供更快的搜索。 图像网络上的实验可以验证我们的方法的有效性。 它比以前的方法快 $ extbf{ 2 oldsymbol{ imes} , 而准确性目前是最先进的, 在小FLOPs的限制下, 以 $ extf{76.2 $ 。 它支持一个争论搜索空间(即更多候选区块),

papers.title: Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-View 3D Style Transfer
papers.authors: Renke Wang, Guimin Que, Shuo Chen, Xiang Li, Jun Li, Jian Yang
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method for single-view 3D style transfer that generates a unique 3D object with both shape and texture transfer. Our focus lies primarily on birds, a popular subject in 3D reconstruction, for which no existing single-view 3D transfer methods have been developed. The method we propose seeks to generate a 3D mesh shape and texture of a bird from two single-view images. To achieve this, we introduce a novel shape transfer generator that comprises a dual residual gated network (DRGNet), and a multi-layer perceptron (MLP). DRGNet extracts the features of source and target images using a shared coordinate gate unit, while the MLP generates spatial coordinates for building a 3D mesh. We also introduce a semantic UV texture transfer module that implements textural style transfer using semantic UV segmentation, which ensures consistency in the semantic meaning of the transferred regions. This module can be widely adapted to many existing approaches. Finally, our method constructs a novel 3D bird using a differentiable renderer. Experimental results on the CUB dataset verify that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the single-view 3D style transfer task. Code is available at https://github.com/wrk226/creative_birds.
papers.title_zh: 创意鸟类:自我监督的单视3D风格传输
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一种单一视图 3D 风格传输的新方法,该方法产生一个独特的3D 对象,其形状和质地传输都是如此。 我们的焦点主要放在鸟类上,鸟类是3D 重建中一个受欢迎的主题,目前还没有开发出任何单一视图 3D 传输方法。 我们提出的方法试图从两张单一视图图像中生成一只鸟的 3D 网形形状和纹理。 为了实现这一目标,我们引入了一个新型的形状转换生成器,其中包括一个双层封闭网(DRGNet)和一个多层光谱(MLP) 。 DRGNet利用一个共用坐标门装置提取源和目标图像的特征,而MLP生成空间坐标用于建造3D网格。 我们还引入了一个语义性紫外线纹理传输模块,该模块使用语义性紫外线分解来实施纹理风格的传输,以确保被转移区域的语义含义的一致性。 这个模块可以广泛适用于许多现有的方法。 最后,我们的方法是用一个不同的铸造器构建一个新型的 3D 鸟。 CUB 数据集的实验结果验证了我们的方法在单一视图 3D 风格的传输任务上取得了最先进的表现。 代码可在 https://github.com/wrk226/ creative_birds 上查阅。

papers.title: CreatiLayout: Siamese Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Creative Layout-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Hui Zhang · Dexiang Hong · Yitong Wang · Jie Shao · Xinglong Wu · Zuxuan Wu · Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have been recognized for their ability to generate images that are not only visually appealing but also of high artistic quality. As a result, Layout-to-Image (L2I) generation has been proposed to leverage region-specific positions and descriptions to enable more precise and controllable generation. However, previous methods primarily focus on UNet-based models (e.g., SD1.5 and SDXL), and limited effort has explored Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs), which have demonstrated powerful image generation capabilities. Enabling MM-DiT for layout-to-image generation seems straightforward but is challenging due to the complexity of how layout is introduced, integrated, and balanced among multiple modalities. To this end, we explore various network variants to efficiently incorporate layout guidance into MM-DiT, and ultimately present SiamLayout. To Inherit the advantages of MM-DiT, we use a separate set of network weights to process the layout, treating it as equally important as the image and text modalities. Meanwhile, to alleviate the competition among modalities, we decouple the image-layout interaction into a siamese branch alongside the image-text one and fuse them in the later stage. Moreover, we contribute a large-scale layout dataset, named LayoutSAM, which includes 2.7 million image-text pairs and 10.7 million entities. Each entity is annotated with a bounding box and a detailed description.We further construct the LayoutSAM-Eval benchmark as a comprehensive tool for evaluating the L2I generation quality. Finally, we introduce the Layout Designer, which taps into the potential of large language models in layout planning, transforming them into experts in layout generation and optimization.
papers.title_zh: CrediLayout: 用于创意布局到图像生成的暹罗多模式传播Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: 传播模型因其不仅具有视觉吸引力,而且具有高艺术质量的图像生成能力而得到承认,因此,提议从布局到图像(L2I)生成,以利用特定区域的位置和描述,使生成更精确、更能控制。 然而,以往的方法主要侧重于基于UNet的模型(如SD1.5和SDXL),而有限的努力探索了多式扩散Transformer(MM-DIT),这些Transformer显示了强大的形象生成能力。 使MM-DIT能够用于制作布局到图像,似乎是直截了当的,但由于布局如何采用、整合和在多种模式之间实现平衡的复杂性,因此具有挑战性。 为此,我们探索了各种网络变体,以便有效地将布局指导纳入MM-DIT,并最终展示SiamLayout。 为了继承MM-DIT的优势,我们使用一套单独的网络权重来处理布局,对待它与图像和文本模式同等重要。 同时,为了缓解各种模式之间的竞争,我们将图像布局互动与图像文本一和图像布局一分开,在后一阶段将它们连接起来。 此外,我们还提供一套大型布局数据集,称为布局-SAAM,其中包括270万对图像-文字和1 070万个实体。 每个实体都有附加说明的框框和详细说明。 我们还将布局SAM-Eval基准作为评估L2I发电质量的综合工具。 最后,我们介绍布局设计师,它利用大语言模型在布局规划方面的潜力,将其转变成布局生成和优化的专家。

papers.title: Coreset Sampling From Open-Set for Fine-Grained Self-Supervised Learning
papers.authors: Sungnyun Kim, Sangmin Bae, Se-Young Yun
papers.abstract: Deep learning in general domains has constantly been extended to domain-specific tasks requiring the recognition of fine-grained characteristics. However, real-world applications for fine-grained tasks suffer from two challenges: a high reliance on expert knowledge for annotation and necessity of a versatile model for various downstream tasks in a specific domain (e.g., prediction of categories, bounding boxes, or pixel-wise annotations). Fortunately, the recent self-supervised learning (SSL) is a promising approach to pretrain a model without annotations, serving as an effective initialization for any downstream tasks. Since SSL does not rely on the presence of annotation, in general, it utilizes the large-scale unlabeled dataset, referred to as an open-set. In this sense, we introduce a novel Open-Set Self-Supervised Learning problem under the assumption that a large-scale unlabeled open-set is available, as well as the fine-grained target dataset, during a pretraining phase. In our problem setup, it is crucial to consider the distribution mismatch between the open-set and target dataset. Hence, we propose SimCore algorithm to sample a coreset, the subset of an open-set that has a minimum distance to the target dataset in the latent space. We demonstrate that SimCore significantly improves representation learning performance through extensive experimental settings, including eleven fine-grained datasets and seven open-sets in various downstream tasks.
papers.title_zh: 从开放版中选取用于精美获得自我监督学习的核心抽样
papers.abstract_zh: 普通领域的深层学习不断扩展到需要承认细微特征的特定领域任务。 然而,在具体领域(如预测类别、捆绑框或像素说明等)下游任务中,对精细任务的实际应用面临两个挑战:高度依赖专家知识进行说明,以及必须有一个多功能模式来完成各种下游任务。 幸运的是,最近自我监督的学习(SSL)是一种很有希望的办法,可以预先培训一个没有说明的模式,作为任何下游任务的有效初始化。 由于SSL并不依赖注释的存在,一般来说,它使用称为开放数据集的大规模无标签数据集。 从这个意义上说,我们提出一个新颖的开放自学问题,假设在培训前阶段,有一个大型的无标签开放数据集,以及精细的目标数据集。 在我们的问题设置中,关键是要考虑开放数据集和目标数据集之间的分布不匹配。 因此,我们建议SimCore算法对核心数据集进行取样,这是开放数据集的子集,与潜在空间中的目标数据集有最小距离。 我们证明,SimCore通过广泛的实验环境,包括11个精细的数据集和7个开放数据集,大大提高了代表性学习的绩效。

papers.title: Content-Aware Local GAN for Photo-Realistic Super-Resolution
papers.authors: JoonKyu Park, Sanghyun Son, Kyoung Mu Lee
papers.abstract: Recently, GAN has successfully contributed to making single-image super-resolution (SISR) methods produce more realistic images. However, natural images have complex distribution in the real world, and a single classifier in the discriminator may not have enough capacity to classify real and fake samples, making the preceding SR network generate unpleasing noise and artifacts. To solve the problem, we propose a novel content-aware local GAN framework, CAL-GAN, which processes a large and complicated distribution of real-world images by dividing them into smaller subsets based on similar contents. Our mixture of classifiers (MoC) design allocates different super-resolved patches to corresponding expert classifiers. Additionally, we introduce novel routing and orthogonality loss terms so that different classifiers can handle various contents and learn separable features. By feeding similar distributions into the corresponding specialized classifiers, CAL-GAN enhances the representation power of existing super-resolution models, achieving state-of-the-art perceptual performance on standard benchmarks and real-world images without modifying the generator-side architecture.
papers.title_zh: 用于照片真实性超分辨率的本地 GAN 软件
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,全球网络成功地帮助制作了单一图像超分辨率(SISSR)方法,制作了更现实的图像。 然而,自然图像在现实世界中分布复杂,歧视者的单一分类者可能没有足够的能力对真实和假样品进行分类,使得上述SR网络产生不愉快的噪音和工艺品。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议建立一个了解内容的新颖的本地GAN框架,即CAL-GAN,通过将真实世界图像分成基于类似内容的较小子集,处理大量复杂的真实世界图像分布。 此外,我们引入了新颖的路由和正对位损失术语,以便不同的分类者能够处理各种内容并学习可分离的特性。 CAL-GAN通过向相应的专门分类机构提供类似的分布,增强了现有超级分辨率模型的表示力,在标准基准和实际世界图像上实现了最先进的认知性表现,而没有改变生成方结构。

papers.title: CLIPTER: Looking at the Bigger Picture in Scene Text Recognition
papers.authors: Aviad Aberdam, David Bensaid, Alona Golts, Roy Ganz, Oren Nuriel, Royee Tichauer, Shai Mazor, Ron Litman
papers.abstract: Reading text in real-world scenarios often requires understanding the context surrounding it, especially when dealing with poor-quality text. However, current scene text recognizers are unaware of the bigger picture as they operate on cropped text images. In this study, we harness the representative capabilities of modern vision-language models, such as CLIP, to provide scene-level information to the crop-based recognizer. We achieve this by fusing a rich representation of the entire image, obtained from the vision-language model, with the recognizer word-level features via a gated cross-attention mechanism. This component gradually shifts to the context-enhanced representation, allowing for stable fine-tuning of a pretrained recognizer. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our model-agnostic framework, CLIPTER (CLIP TExt Recognition), on leading text recognition architectures and achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks. Furthermore, our analysis highlights improved robustness to out-of-vocabulary words and enhanced generalization in low-data regimes.
papers.title_zh: 查看场景文字识别中的大图片
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界情景中,阅读文本往往需要了解周围的环境,特别是在处理质量差的文本时。 但是,当场的文本识别者在用作物化文本图像操作时,并不了解大局。 在这项研究中,我们利用现代视觉语言模型(如CLIP)的代表性能力,向以作物为基础的识别者提供现场信息。 实现这一点的办法是通过一个封闭式交叉关注机制,将从视觉语言模式中获得的整个图像的丰富面貌与识别方字层特征混为一谈。 这一组成部分逐渐转向上下文强化的表达方式,从而可以对预先培训的识别方进行稳定的微调。 我们展示了我们的示范不可知性框架,即CLIPTER(CLIP TExt承认)在主要文本确认结构方面的有效性,并实现了跨越多个基准的最新成果。 此外,我们的分析突出显示,对词汇外的词句更加有力,在低数据制度中更加普遍化。

papers.title: CLIP2Point: Transfer CLIP to Point Cloud Classification with Image-Depth Pre-Training
papers.authors: Tianyu Huang, Bowen Dong, Yunhan Yang, Xiaoshui Huang, Rynson W.H. Lau, Wanli Ouyang, Wangmeng Zuo
papers.abstract: Pre-training across 3D vision and language remains under development because of limited training data. Recent works attempt to transfer vision-language (V-L) pre-training methods to 3D vision. However, the domain gap between 3D and images is unsolved, so that V-L pre-trained models are restricted in 3D downstream tasks. To address this issue, we propose CLIP2Point, an image-depth pre-training method by contrastive learning to transfer CLIP to the 3D domain, and adapt it to point cloud classification. We introduce a new depth rendering setting that forms a better visual effect, and then render 52,460 pairs of images and depth maps from ShapeNet for pre-training. The pre-training scheme of CLIP2Point combines cross-modality learning to enforce the depth features for capturing expressive visual and textual features and intra-modality learning to enhance the invariance of depth aggregation. Additionally, we propose a novel Gated Dual-Path Adapter (GDPA), i.e., a dual-path structure with global-view aggregators and gated fusion for downstream representative learning. It allows the ensemble of CLIP and CLIP2Point, tuning pre-training knowledge to downstream tasks in an efficient adaptation. Experimental results show that CLIP2Point is effective in transferring CLIP knowledge to 3D vision. Our CLIP2Point outperforms other 3D transfer learning and pre-training networks, achieving state-of-the-art results on zero-shot, few-shot, and fully-supervised classification.
papers.title_zh: CLIP2Point: 将CLIP转移到点云分类,并配有图像-面片培训前
papers.abstract_zh: 由于培训数据有限,关于3D视觉和语言的培训前培训仍在开发中,最近努力将视觉语言(V-L)培训前方法转换为3D视觉。 然而,3D和图像之间的域间差距尚未解决,因此V-L培训前模型在3D下游任务中受到限制。 为解决这一问题,我们提议CLIP2Point,这是一个图像深度培训前方法,通过对比性学习,将CLIP转移到3D域,并将其调整为点云分类。 我们引入一个新的深度定位设置, 形成更好的视觉效果, 然后从 ShapeNet 制作52,460对图像和深度地图, 供训练前使用。 CLIP2Point的训练前计划结合了跨模式学习,以实施深度特征,捕捉表达式视觉和文字特征,以及内部学习,以加强深度汇总的变量。 此外,我们提议建立一个新型的Gated双板适应器(GDPA),即一个双路结构,配有全球观聚合器和封隔融合,供下游有代表性的学习使用,使CLIP和CLIP2Point能够结合,使培训前知识适应下游任务,并有效地适应下游任务。 实验结果表明,CLIP2Point在将CLIP知识传输到3D视觉方面是有效的。 我们的CLIP2Point优于其他3D转移学习和培训前网络,在零射、短射和完全监督的分类上取得了最先进的成果。

papers.title: Class Prototypes Based Contrastive Learning for Classifying Multi-Label and Fine-Grained Educational Videos
papers.authors: Rohit Gupta, Anirban Roy, Claire Christensen, Sujeong Kim, Sarah Gerard, Madeline Cincebeaux, Ajay Divakaran, Todd Grindal, Mubarak Shah
papers.abstract: The recent growth in the consumption of online media by children during early childhood necessitates data-driven tools enabling educators to filter out appropriate educational content for young learners. This paper presents an approach for detecting educational content in online videos. We focus on two widely used educational content classes: literacy and math. For each class, we choose prominent codes (sub-classes) based on the Common Core Standards. For example, literacy codes include 'letter names', 'letter sounds', and math codes include 'counting', 'sorting'. We pose this as a fine-grained multilabel classification problem as videos can contain multiple types of educational content and the content classes can get visually similar (e.g., 'letter names' vs 'letter sounds'). We propose a novel class prototypes based supervised contrastive learning approach that can handle fine-grained samples associated with multiple labels. We learn a class prototype for each class and a loss function is employed to minimize the distances between a class prototype and the samples from the class. Similarly, distances between a class prototype and the samples from other classes are maximized. As the alignment between visual and audio cues are crucial for effective comprehension, we consider a multimodal transformer network to capture the interaction between visual and audio cues in videos while learning the embedding for videos. For evaluation, we present a dataset, APPROVE, employing educational videos from YouTube labeled with fine-grained education classes by education researchers. APPROVE consists of 193 hours of expert-annotated videos with 19 classes. The proposed approach outperforms strong baselines on APPROVE and other benchmarks such as Youtube-8M, and COIN. The dataset is available at https://nusci.csl.sri.com/project/APPROVE.
papers.title_zh: 分类多标签和精美教育录像等类原型类基于差异的分类化多标签和精细教育录像学习
papers.abstract_zh: 儿童在幼儿期使用在线媒体的情况最近有所增长,这就需要由数据驱动的工具,使教育者能够筛选出适合年轻学生的教育内容,本文提出了在网上视频中发现教育内容的方法。 我们关注两个广泛使用的教育内容课程:识字和数学。我们根据共同核心标准选择每个班的突出代码(次类 ) 。 例如, 识字代码包括字母名称 , “ 字母声音 ” , 数学代码包括“ 计算 ” , “分类 ” 。 我们把它说成是一个细微的多标签分类问题,因为视频可以包含多种类型的教育内容,而内容类可以取得视觉相似(例如“字母名称”与“字母声音”等)。 我们建议采用新型类原型,以监督对照学习方法,处理与多个标签有关的细粒样本。 我们学习了每个类的类原型,并运用了损失功能来尽量减少类原型与类样本之间的距离。 同样,也尽量扩大类别原型与其他类别样品之间的距离。 由于视觉提示和音频提示之间的一致性对于有效理解至关重要,因此我们认为一个多式联运变压器网络可以捕捉视频中视觉提示和音频提示之间的相互作用,同时学习视频嵌入过程。 为了评估,我们提供一套数据,即“APROVE”,使用由教育研究人员以精细教育课为标签的YouTube教育录像。 APROVE由19个课的193小时专家附加说明的录像组成。 拟议的方法在 " 实用方案 " 和其他基准,如Youtube-8M和COIN方面,优于强有力的基线,数据集见https://nusci.csl.sri.com/project/APPROVE。

papers.title: CancerUniT: Towards a Single Unified Model for Effective Detection, Segmentation, and Diagnosis of Eight Major Cancers Using a Large Collection of CT Scans
papers.authors: Jieneng Chen, Yingda Xia, Jiawen Yao, Ke Yan, Jianpeng Zhang, Le Lu, Fakai Wang, Bo Zhou, Mingyan Qiu, Qihang Yu, Mingze Yuan, Wei Fang, Yuxing Tang, Minfeng Xu, Jian Zhou, Yuqian Zhao, Qifeng Wang, Xianghua Ye, Xiaoli Yin, Yu Shi, Xin Chen, Jingren Zhou, Alan Yuille, Zaiyi Liu, Ling Zhang
papers.abstract: Human readers or radiologists routinely perform full-body multi-organ multi-disease detection and diagnosis in clinical practice, while most medical AI systems are built to focus on single organs with a narrow list of a few diseases. This might severely limit AI's clinical adoption. A certain number of AI models need to be assembled non-trivially to match the diagnostic process of a human reading a CT scan. In this paper, we construct a Unified Tumor Transformer (CancerUniT) model to jointly detect tumor existence & location and diagnose tumor characteristics for eight major cancers in CT scans. CancerUniT is a query-based Mask Transformer model with the output of multi-tumor prediction. We decouple the object queries into organ queries, tumor detection queries and tumor diagnosis queries, and further establish hierarchical relationships among the three groups. This clinically-inspired architecture effectively assists inter- and intra-organ representation learning of tumors and facilitates the resolution of these complex, anatomically related multi-organ cancer image reading tasks. CancerUniT is trained end-to-end using curated large-scale CT images of 10,042 patients including eight major types of cancers and occurring non-cancer tumors (all are pathology-confirmed with 3D tumor masks annotated by radiologists). On the test set of 631 patients, CancerUniT has demonstrated strong performance under a set of clinically relevant evaluation metrics, substantially outperforming both multi-disease methods and an assembly of eight single-organ expert models in tumor detection, segmentation, and diagnosis. This moves one step closer towards a universal high performance cancer screening tool.
papers.title_zh: 癌症UnitiT:利用大量CT扫描仪,为有效检测、分解和诊断八大癌症制定一个单一统一模式
papers.abstract_zh: 人类读者或放射科医生在临床实践中例行进行全体多机多病检测和诊断,而大多数医学人工智能系统则以单一器官为主,其中只有少数几种疾病。 这可能会严重限制人工智能的临床采用。 需要将一定数量的人工智能模型组装成非三联式,以便与人类阅读CT扫描的诊断过程相匹配。 在本文中,我们构建了一个统一肿瘤Transformer(CancerUnit)模型,以共同检测肿瘤的存在和位置,并诊断CT扫描中的八种主要癌症的肿瘤特征。 癌症UnitiT是一种基于Query的面具变异模型,具有多图谱预测的结果。 我们把对象Query分解为器官Query、肿瘤检测Query和肿瘤诊断Query,并进一步在这三个群体之间建立等级关系。 这种由临床启发的架构有效地协助组织间和内部对肿瘤的代言学习,并促进解决这些复杂、与解剖有关的多器官癌症图像阅读任务。 利用10 042名病人的大规模CT图像,包括八种主要癌症和正在发生的非癌症肿瘤(所有肿瘤都经病理学证实,放射科医生加注3D肿瘤面具)。 在由631名病人组成的测试组中,癌症联盟在一系列临床相关评价指标下表现出很强的性能,大大优于多病方法,以及肿瘤检测、分解和诊断八个单一组织专家模型的组合。 这更接近于普及高性能癌症筛查工具。

papers.title: Boosting Long-tailed Object Detection via Step-wise Learning on Smooth-tail Data
papers.authors: Na Dong, Yongqiang Zhang, Mingli Ding, Gim Hee Lee
papers.abstract: Real-world data tends to follow a long-tailed distribution, where the class imbalance results in dominance of the head classes during training. In this paper, we propose a frustratingly simple but effective step-wise learning framework to gradually enhance the capability of the model in detecting all categories of long-tailed datasets. Specifically, we build smooth-tail data where the long-tailed distribution of categories decays smoothly to correct the bias towards head classes. We pre-train a model on the whole long-tailed data to preserve discriminability between all categories. We then fine-tune the class-agnostic modules of the pre-trained model on the head class dominant replay data to get a head class expert model with improved decision boundaries from all categories. Finally, we train a unified model on the tail class dominant replay data while transferring knowledge from the head class expert model to ensure accurate detection of all categories. Extensive experiments on long-tailed datasets LVIS v0.5 and LVIS v1.0 demonstrate the superior performance of our method, where we can improve the AP with ResNet-50 backbone from 27.0% to 30.3% AP, and especially for the rare categories from 15.5% to 24.9% AP. Our best model using ResNet-101 backbone can achieve 30.7% AP, which suppresses all existing detectors using the same backbone.
papers.title_zh: 通过 " 平尾数据 " 的逐步学习促进长尾对象探测
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界数据往往经过长期的分布,在这种分布中,班级不平衡导致在培训期间校长班占主导地位。 在本文中,我们提出了一个令人沮丧的简单而有效的渐进式学习框架,以逐步提高模型检测各类长期数据集的能力。 具体地说,我们建立顺尾数据,让长尾分类分布平稳地衰落,以纠正对头类的偏向。 我们预设了整个长尾数据模型,以保持所有类别之间的差异性。 然后我们微调预培训模式的阶级不可知性模块 在头等舱主要重播数据上 以获得一个头等舱专家模型 改进了所有类别决定的界限 最后,我们培训了一个关于尾品类主要重播数据的统一模型,同时从头类专家模型中传授知识,以确保准确发现所有类别。 长尾类LVIS v0.5和LVIS v1.0的广泛试验显示了我们方法的优异性能,我们可以用ResNet-50主干网改进AP,从27.0%提高到30.3%,特别是从15.5%到24.9%的稀有类别。 我们使用ResNet-101主干网的最佳模型可以达到30.7%的AP,用同样的主干网抑制所有现有的探测器。

papers.title: BiFormer: Vision Transformer With Bi-Level Routing Attention
papers.authors: Lei Zhu, Xinjiang Wang, Zhanghan Ke, Wayne Zhang, Rynson W.H. Lau
papers.abstract: As the core building block of vision transformers, attention is a powerful tool to capture long-range dependency. However, such power comes at a cost: it incurs a huge computation burden and heavy memory footprint as pairwise token interaction across all spatial locations is computed. A series of works attempt to alleviate this problem by introducing handcrafted and content-agnostic sparsity into attention, such as restricting the attention operation to be inside local windows, axial stripes, or dilated windows. In contrast to these approaches, we propose a novel dynamic sparse attention via bi-level routing to enable a more flexible allocation of computations with content awareness. Specifically, for a query, irrelevant key-value pairs are first filtered out at a coarse region level, and then fine-grained token-to-token attention is applied in the union of remaining candidate regions (i.e., routed regions). We provide a simple yet effective implementation of the proposed bi-level routing attention, which utilizes the sparsity to save both computation and memory while involving only GPU-friendly dense matrix multiplications. Built with the proposed bi-level routing attention, a new general vision transformer, named BiFormer, is then presented. As BiFormer attends to a small subset of relevant tokens in a query-adaptive manner without distraction from other irrelevant ones, it enjoys both good performance and high computational efficiency, especially in dense prediction tasks. Empirical results across several computer vision tasks such as image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation verify the effectiveness of our design. Code is available at https://github.com/rayleizhu/BiFormer.
papers.title_zh: BiForemer: 具有双级路标关注的视觉Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: 作为视觉变压器的核心构件,注意力是捕捉远距离依赖性的有力工具,然而,这种力量是代价高昂的:它带来巨大的计算负担和沉重的记忆足迹,因为所有空间地点的配对象征性互动都是计算出来的。 为缓解这一问题,开展了一系列工作,试图通过关注手工制作和内容识别的宽度来缓解这一问题,例如将注意力限制在本地窗口、轴纹条或膨胀窗口内。 与这些办法不同,我们提议通过双级路线,对新颖的动态关注少一些,以便能够更灵活地分配具有内容意识的计算。 具体地说,对于询问,无关的关键价值对首先在粗糙的区域一级过滤出来,然后在其余候选区域(即路由区域)的联盟中采用细微的象征性注意。 我们简单而有效地落实了拟议的双层次路线关注,即利用宽度节省计算和记忆,同时只涉及方便GPU的密集矩阵乘法。 随后介绍了一个新的名为BiFormer的全景变压器,该变压器由拟议的双层路线关注组成。 由于BiFormer公司以Query适应方式处理一小部分相关标牌,而不会分心于其他无关的标牌,它的业绩良好,计算效率也很高,特别是在密集的预测任务方面。 计算机图像分类、物体探测和语义分解等若干计算机视觉任务的经验结果,验证我们设计的有效性。 代码可在https://gitub.com/rayleizhu/BiFormer查阅。

papers.title: BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detection Based on Virtual Camera via Key-Points
papers.authors: Ruihao Wang, Jian Qin, Kaiying Li, Yaochen Li, Dong Cao, Jintao Xu
papers.abstract: 3D lane detection which plays a crucial role in vehicle routing, has recently been a rapidly developing topic in autonomous driving. Previous works struggle with practicality due to their complicated spatial transformations and inflexible representations of 3D lanes. Faced with the issues, our work proposes an efficient and robust monocular 3D lane detection called BEV-LaneDet with three main contributions. First, we introduce the Virtual Camera that unifies the in/extrinsic parameters of cameras mounted on different vehicles to guarantee the consistency of the spatial relationship among cameras. It can effectively promote the learning procedure due to the unified visual space. We secondly propose a simple but efficient 3D lane representation called Key-Points Representation. This module is more suitable to represent the complicated and diverse 3D lane structures. At last, we present a light-weight and chip-friendly spatial transformation module named Spatial Transformation Pyramid to transform multiscale front-view features into BEV features. Experimental results demonstrate that our work outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in terms of F-Score, being 10.6% higher on the OpenLane dataset and 4.0% higher on the Apollo 3D synthetic dataset, with a speed of 185 FPS. Code is released at https://github.com/gigo-team/bev_lane_det.
papers.title_zh: BEV-LaneDet: 高效的三维通道探测
papers.abstract_zh: 3D车道探测在车辆行驶路线方面起着关键作用,最近已成为自主驾驶方面一个迅速发展的主题,以往的工作由于复杂的空间变换和3D车道的不灵活表现而实际地挣扎。 面对这些问题,我们的工作建议以三个主要贡献,开展名为BEV-LaneDet的高效而有力的单体3D单体3D车道探测。 首先,我们引入了虚拟相机,它统一了不同飞行器上安装的摄像机的内部/外部参数,以保证摄像机之间的空间关系的一致性,由于统一的视觉空间,它能够有效地促进学习程序。 第二,我们建议采用简单而高效的三维车道代表制,称为“关键点代表制”。这个模块更适合代表复杂多样的三维车道结构。 最后,我们提出一个轻量级和芯片友好的空间转换模块,名为空间转型金字塔,旨在将多级前视特征转换为BEV特征。 实验结果表明,我们的工作在F-Score方面超过了最先进的方法,OpenLane数据集高出10.6%,Apollo 3D合成数据集高出4.0%,速度为185 FPS。 代码公布于https://github.com/gigo-team/bev_lane_det。

papers.title: Batch Model Consolidation: A Multi-Task Model Consolidation Framework
papers.authors: Iordanis Fostiropoulos, Jiaye Zhu, Laurent Itti
papers.abstract: In Continual Learning (CL), a model is required to learn a stream of tasks sequentially without significant performance degradation on previously learned tasks. Current approaches fail for a long sequence of tasks from diverse domains and difficulties. Many of the existing CL approaches are difficult to apply in practice due to excessive memory cost or training time, or are tightly coupled to a single device. With the intuition derived from the widely applied mini-batch training, we propose Batch Model Consolidation (BMC) to support more realistic CL under conditions where multiple agents are exposed to a range of tasks. During a regularization phase, BMC trains multiple expert models in parallel on a set of disjoint tasks. Each expert maintains weight similarity to a base model through a stability loss, and constructs a buffer from a fraction of the task's data. During the consolidation phase, we combine the learned knowledge on 'batches' of expert models using a batched consolidation loss in memory data that aggregates all buffers. We thoroughly evaluate each component of our method in an ablation study and demonstrate the effectiveness on standardized benchmark datasets Split-CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, and the Stream dataset composed of 71 image classification tasks from diverse domains and difficulties. Our method outperforms the next best CL approach by 70% and is the only approach that can maintain performance at the end of 71 tasks.
papers.title_zh: 批次示范合并:多任务示范合并框架
papers.abstract_zh: 在持续学习中,需要一种模式来按顺序学习一系列任务,而不严重削弱以往所学到的任务的业绩。 目前的方法无法完成来自不同领域和困难的一长串任务。 由于记忆费或培训时间过长,或与单一装置紧密结合,许多现有的CL方法难以在实践中应用。 利用广泛应用的小型批次培训的直觉,我们建议批量模型整合(BMC)在多个代理机构面临一系列任务的条件下支持更现实的分类分类。 在正规化阶段,BMC在一系列脱节任务上同时培训多个专家模型。 每位专家通过稳定损失保持与基准模型相似的重量,并用任务数据的一部分来构建缓冲。 在整合阶段,我们结合了专家模型的“支架”知识,在汇总所有缓冲的记忆数据中采用分批合并损失。 我们在一项通货膨胀研究中彻底评估我们方法的每个组成部分,并展示标准化基准数据集Slip-CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImagageNet和由来自不同领域和困难的71项图像分类任务组成的溪流数据集的有效性。 我们的方法比下一个最佳的CL方法效果高70%,是71项任务结束时能够保持业绩的唯一方法。

papers.title: Balanced Product of Calibrated Experts for Long-Tailed Recognition
papers.authors: Emanuel Sanchez Aimar, Arvi Jonnarth, Michael Felsberg, Marco Kuhlmann
papers.abstract: Many real-world recognition problems are characterized by long-tailed label distributions. These distributions make representation learning highly challenging due to limited generalization over the tail classes. If the test distribution differs from the training distribution, e.g. uniform versus long-tailed, the problem of the distribution shift needs to be addressed. A recent line of work proposes learning multiple diverse experts to tackle this issue. Ensemble diversity is encouraged by various techniques, e.g. by specializing different experts in the head and the tail classes. In this work, we take an analytical approach and extend the notion of logit adjustment to ensembles to form a Balanced Product of Experts (BalPoE). BalPoE combines a family of experts with different test-time target distributions, generalizing several previous approaches. We show how to properly define these distributions and combine the experts in order to achieve unbiased predictions, by proving that the ensemble is Fisher-consistent for minimizing the balanced error. Our theoretical analysis shows that our balanced ensemble requires calibrated experts, which we achieve in practice using mixup. We conduct extensive experiments and our method obtains new state-of-the-art results on three long-tailed datasets: CIFAR-100-LT, ImageNet-LT, and iNaturalist-2018. Our code is available at https://github.com/emasa/BalPoE-CalibratedLT.
papers.title_zh: 长期认证校准专家的平衡产品
papers.abstract_zh: 许多真实世界的识别问题特点是标签分发时间长,由于对尾品类的概括性有限,这些分发使代表学习变得非常困难。 最近的一项工作提议为解决这一问题而学习多种不同的专家,各种技术鼓励多样性,例如,通过对头部和尾部班进行专门化的不同专家,鼓励多样性。 在这项工作中,我们采取分析方法,把对日志调整的概念扩大到集合起来形成一个专家平衡产品(BalPoE),BalPoE将一组具有不同测试时间目标分布的专家结合在一起,概括了以前的若干方法。 我们展示了如何正确界定这些分布,并结合专家,以便通过证明组合符合渔民的要求,最大限度地减少平衡的错误,实现不偏袒的预测。 我们的理论分析表明,我们平衡的组合需要经过校准的专家,而我们实际上使用混合方法实现了这一点。 我们进行了广泛的实验,我们的方法在三个长尾数据集(CIFAR-100-LT、图像网络-LT和iNatulalist-2018)上获得了最新的最新结果。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/emasa/BalPoE-CalibrateLT网站上查阅。

papers.title: Automatic Network Pruning via Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion Lasso under Information Bottleneck Principle
papers.authors: Song Guo, Lei Zhang, Xiawu Zheng, Yan Wang, Yuchao Li, Fei Chao, Chenglin Wu, Shengchuan Zhang, Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract: Most existing neural network pruning methods hand-crafted their importance criteria and structures to prune. This constructs heavy and unintended dependencies on heuristics and expert experience for both the objective and the parameters of the pruning approach. In this paper, we try to solve this problem by introducing a principled and unified framework based on Information Bottleneck (IB) theory, which further guides us to an automatic pruning approach. Specifically, we first formulate the channel pruning problem from an IB perspective, and then implement the IB principle by solving a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) Lasso problem under certain conditions. Based on the theoretical guidance, we then provide an automatic pruning scheme by searching for global penalty coefficients. Verified by extensive experiments, our method yields state-of-the-art performance on various benchmark networks and datasets. For example, with VGG-16, we achieve a 60%-FLOPs reduction by removing 76% of the parameters, with an improvement of 0.40% in top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10. With ResNet-50, we achieve a 56%-FLOPs reduction by removing 50% of the parameters, with a small loss of 0.08% in the top-1 accuracy on ImageNet. The code is available at https://github.com/sunggo/APIB.
papers.title_zh: 根据信息瓶颈原则,通过Hilbert-Schmidt独立标准Lasso 自动网络路过Hilbert-Schmidt独立标准Lasso
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数现有的神经网络运行方法都是手工制作的,其重要性标准和结构是用来处理的,这在计算方法的目标和参数方面,根据超自然学和专家经验,形成了严重和意外的依赖性。 在本文中,我们试图通过采用基于信息瓶颈理论的原则性和统一框架来解决这一问题,该框架进一步指导我们采取自动削减办法。 具体地说,我们首先从IB的角度来提出频道运行问题,然后执行IB原则,在某些情况下解决Hilbert-Schmidt独立标准(HSIC)拉索问题。 以理论指导为基础,我们然后通过寻找全球惩罚系数提供自动修剪计划。 经过广泛的实验,我们的方法在各种基准网络和数据集上取得了最先进的表现。 例如,在VGG-16中,我们通过去除76%的参数,实现了60%的氟化烃的减排,在CIFAR-10中提高了0.40%的最高一级精确度。 在ResNet-50中,我们通过去除50%的参数,实现了56%的氟化烃的减排,在图像网络中,上一级-1的精确度略微下降了0.08%。 该代码可在https://github.com/sunggo/APIB上查阅。

papers.title: Automated Knowledge Distillation via Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.authors: Lujun Li, Peijie Dong, Zimian Wei, Ya Yang
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present Auto-KD, the first automated search framework for optimal knowledge distillation design. Traditional distillation techniques typically require handcrafted designs by experts and extensive tuning costs for different teacher-student pairs. To address these issues, we empirically study different distillers, finding that they can be decomposed, combined, and simplified. Based on these observations, we build our uniform search space with advanced operations in transformations, distance functions, and hyperparameters components. For instance, the transformation parts are optional for global, intra-spatial, and inter-spatial operations, such as attention, mask, and multi-scale. Then, we introduce an effective search strategy based on the Monte Carlo tree search, modeling the search space as a Monte Carlo Tree (MCT) to capture the dependency among options. The MCT is updated using test loss and representation gap of student trained by candidate distillers as the reward for better exploration-exploitation balance. To accelerate the search process, we exploit offline processing without teacher inference, sparse training for student, and proxy settings based on distillation properties. In this way, our Auto-KD only needs small costs to search for optimal distillers before the distillation phase. Moreover, we expand Auto-KD for multi-layer and multi-teacher scenarios with training-free weighted factors. Our method is promising yet practical, and extensive experiments demonstrate that it generalizes well to different CNNs and Vision Transformer models and attains state-of-the-art performance across a range of vision tasks, including image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation. Code is provided at https://github.com/lilujunai/Auto-KD.
papers.title_zh: 通过蒙特卡洛树搜索自动知识蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们介绍Auto-KD,这是最佳知识蒸馏设计的第一个自动搜索框架,传统的蒸馏技术通常需要专家手工艺设计,以及不同师生对等的广泛调试成本。 为了解决这些问题,我们从经验上研究不同的蒸馏商,发现它们可以分解、合并和简化。 基于这些观察,我们建立了统一的搜索空间,在转换、距离功能和超参数组件方面有先进的操作。 例如,转换部分是全球、空间内和空间间业务的可选部分,如注意力、遮罩和多级业务。 然后,我们推出基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的有效搜索战略,将搜索空间建为蒙特卡洛树(MCT)模型,以捕捉各种选项之间的依赖性。 利用由候选蒸馏商培训的学生的测试损失和代表性差距作为改善勘探-开发平衡的奖励,对MCT进行了更新。 为了加快搜索进程,我们利用离线处理而无需教师推断、学生培训少和基于蒸馏特性的代理设置。 这样,我们的自动KD只需要少量成本就可以在蒸馏阶段之前寻找最佳蒸馏厂。 此外,我们还利用无培训加权因素,在多层次和多教师情景中推广自动KD。 我们的方法充满希望,但又切实可行,广泛的实验表明,它很好地概括了不同的有线电视新闻网和视觉变异模型,在包括图像分类、物体探测和语义分割在内的一系列视觉任务中取得了最先进的业绩。 守则见https://github.com/lilujunai/Auto-KD。

papers.title: Artificial Neuronal Ensembles with Learned Context Dependent Gating
papers.authors: Matthew J Tilley, Michelle Miller, David Freedman
papers.title_zh: 人造中中子组合,具有累积性环境依附性

papers.title: ARNOLD: A Benchmark for Language-Grounded Task Learning with Continuous States in Realistic 3D Scenes
papers.authors: Ran Gong, Jiangyong Huang, Yizhou Zhao, Haoran Geng, Xiaofeng Gao, Qingyang Wu, Wensi Ai, Ziheng Zhou, Demetri Terzopoulos, Song-Chun Zhu, Baoxiong Jia, Siyuan Huang
papers.abstract: Understanding the continuous states of objects is essential for task learning and planning in the real world. However, most existing task learning benchmarks assume discrete (e.g., binary) object states, which poses challenges for learning complex tasks and transferring learned policy from the simulated environment to the real world. Furthermore, the robot's ability to follow human instructions based on grounding the actions and states is limited. To tackle these challenges, we present ARNOLD, a benchmark that evaluates language-grounded task learning with continuous states in realistic 3D scenes. ARNOLD consists of 8 language-conditioned tasks that involve understanding object states and learning policies for continuous goals. To promote language-instructed learning, we provide expert demonstrations with template-generated language descriptions. We assess task performance by utilizing the latest language-conditioned policy learning models. Our results indicate that current models for language-conditioned manipulations continue to experience significant challenges when it comes to novel goal-state generalizations, scene generalizations, and object generalizations. These findings highlight the need to develop new algorithms to address this gap and underscore the potential for further research in this area.
papers.title_zh: ARNOLD:在现实的3D场景中与持续国家进行语言综合任务学习的基准
papers.abstract_zh: 了解物体的持续状态对于在现实世界中进行任务学习和规划至关重要。 然而,大多数现有任务学习基准都采用互不关联(例如二元)对象状态,这对学习复杂任务和将学习的政策从模拟环境转移到现实世界构成挑战。 此外,机器人遵循基于行动和状态的人类指令的能力是有限的。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了ARNOLD(ARNOLD ) , 这一基准用现实的三维场景来评估基于语言的任务学习的持续状态。 ARNOLD由8项有语言条件的任务组成,涉及理解对象状态和持续目标的学习政策。 为了促进语言教学,我们为专家演示提供模板生成的语言说明。 我们利用最新的以语言为条件的政策学习模式,评估任务业绩。 我们的结果表明,目前以语言为条件的操纵模式在新的目标状态概括化、场景概括化和对象概括化方面继续面临重大挑战。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要制定新的算法,以弥补这一差距,并强调在这一领域开展进一步研究的潜力。

papers.title: An Image Quality Assessment Dataset for Portraits
papers.authors: Nicolas Chahine, Stefania Calarasanu, Davide Garcia-Civiero, Théo Cayla, Sira Ferradans, Jean Ponce
papers.abstract: Year after year, the demand for ever-better smartphone photos continues to grow, in particular in the domain of portrait photography. Manufacturers thus use perceptual quality criteria throughout the development of smartphone cameras. This costly procedure can be partially replaced by automated learning-based methods for image quality assessment (IQA). Due to its subjective nature, it is necessary to estimate and guarantee the consistency of the IQA process, a characteristic lacking in the mean opinion scores (MOS) widely used for crowdsourcing IQA. In addition, existing blind IQA (BIQA) datasets pay little attention to the difficulty of cross-content assessment, which may degrade the quality of annotations. This paper introduces PIQ23, a portrait-specific IQA dataset of 5116 images of 50 predefined scenarios acquired by 100 smartphones, covering a high variety of brands, models, and use cases. The dataset includes individuals of various genders and ethnicities who have given explicit and informed consent for their photographs to be used in public research. It is annotated by pairwise comparisons (PWC) collected from over 30 image quality experts for three image attributes: face detail preservation, face target exposure, and overall image quality. An in-depth statistical analysis of these annotations allows us to evaluate their consistency over PIQ23. Finally, we show through an extensive comparison with existing baselines that semantic information (image context) can be used to improve IQA predictions.
papers.title_zh: 用于肖像的图像质量评估数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 年复一年,对智能手机照片的需求继续增长,特别是在肖像摄影领域。 因此,制造商在开发智能手机相机的过程中使用感官质量标准。 这一费用高昂的程序可以部分地由基于自动学习的图像质量评估方法(IQA)来取代,由于其主观性质,有必要估计和保证IQA进程的一致性,这是众包IQA广泛使用的平均评分中缺少的一个特征。 此外,现有的盲IQA(BIQA)数据集很少注意交叉内容评估的困难,这可能降低说明的质量。 本文介绍PIQ23,这是一套针对个人肖像的《国际质量评估》数据集,由100个智能手机获得的50种预设情景的5116张图像组成,涵盖各种品牌、模型和使用案例。 该数据集包括不同性别和族裔的个人,他们明确和知情地同意其照片用于公共研究。 从30多名图像质量专家那里收集的关于三个图像属性的图像质量比较(PWC)附加了附加说明:面孔保存、目标暴露和总体图像质量。 这些说明的深入统计分析使我们能够评估它们与PIQ23的一致性。 最后,我们通过对现有基线的广泛比较,表明可以使用语义信息(图像背景)改进对《国际质量评估》的预测。

papers.title: Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation Using Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Aimon Rahman, Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu, Ilker Hacihaliloglu, Vishal M. Patel
papers.abstract: Collective insights from a group of experts have always proven to outperform an individual's best diagnostic for clinical tasks. For the task of medical image segmentation, existing research on AI-based alternatives focuses more on developing models that can imitate the best individual rather than harnessing the power of expert groups. In this paper, we introduce a single diffusion model-based approach that produces multiple plausible outputs by learning a distribution over group insights. Our proposed model generates a distribution of segmentation masks by leveraging the inherent stochastic sampling process of diffusion using only minimal additional learning. We demonstrate on three different medical image modalities- CT, ultrasound, and MRI that our model is capable of producing several possible variants while capturing the frequencies of their occurrences. Comprehensive results show that our proposed approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art ambiguous segmentation networks in terms of accuracy while preserving naturally occurring variation. We also propose a new metric to evaluate the diversity as well as the accuracy of segmentation predictions that aligns with the interest of clinical practice of collective insights. Implementation code will be released publicly after the review process.
papers.title_zh: 使用传播模型的模糊的医学图像分割
papers.abstract_zh: 一个专家组的集体见解一直证明,在临床任务方面,比个人的最佳诊断效果要好。 关于医学形象分割的任务,目前关于基于AI的替代方法的研究更侧重于开发能够模仿最佳个人模式的模式,而不是利用专家组的力量。 在本文中,我们采用一种单一的基于传播模式的方法,通过学习群体洞察力的分布情况,产生多种可信的产出。 我们提议的模型通过利用仅使用最低限度额外学习的内在随机抽样传播过程,产生分离面罩的分布。 我们用三种不同的医学形象模式 -- -- CT、超声波和MRI -- -- 来证明我们的模型能够产生几种可能的变体,同时捕捉其发生频率。 全面结果显示,我们提议的办法在准确性方面优于现有最先进的模糊分解网络,同时保持自然产生的差异。 我们还提出了一个新的衡量标准,用以评价多样性以及符合临床集体洞见做法兴趣的分解预测的准确性,在审查进程结束后将公开发布执行守则。

papers.title: Agile Modeling: From Concept to Classifier in Minutes
papers.authors: Otilia Stretcu, Edward Vendrow, Kenji Hata, Krishnamurthy Viswanathan, Vittorio Ferrari, Sasan Tavakkol, Wenlei Zhou, Aditya Avinash, Emming Luo, Neil Gordon Alldrin, MohammadHossein Bateni, Gabriel Berger, Andrew Bunner, Chun-Ta Lu, Javier Rey, Giulia DeSalvo, Ranjay Krishna, Ariel Fuxman‎
papers.abstract: The application of computer vision methods to nuanced, subjective concepts is growing. While crowdsourcing has served the vision community well for most objective tasks (such as labeling a "zebra"), it now falters on tasks where there is substantial subjectivity in the concept (such as identifying "gourmet tuna"). However, empowering any user to develop a classifier for their concept is technically difficult: users are neither machine learning experts nor have the patience to label thousands of examples. In reaction, we introduce the problem of Agile Modeling: the process of turning any subjective visual concept into a computer vision model through a real-time user-in-the-loop interactions. We instantiate an Agile Modeling prototype for image classification and show through a user study (N=14) that users can create classifiers with minimal effort under 30 minutes. We compare this user driven process with the traditional crowdsourcing paradigm and find that the crowd's notion often differs from that of the user's, especially as the concepts become more subjective. Finally, we scale our experiments with simulations of users training classifiers for ImageNet21k categories to further demonstrate the efficacy.
papers.title_zh: 格格建模:从概念到分钟中的分类
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机视觉方法应用于细微细微的主观概念在不断增长。 虽然众包在最客观的任务(如标为“斑马 ” ) ( zebra ) 上为视觉界提供了良好的服务,但如今却在概念具有实质性主观性(如识别“金刚金枪鱼 ” ) 的任务上步履维艰。 然而,在技术上,赋予任何用户为其概念制定分类法的权力是困难的:用户既不是机器学习专家,也没有耐心标出数千个例子。 作为回应,我们引入了Agile模型问题:通过实时用户在圈内互动,将任何主观视觉概念转化为计算机视觉模型的过程。 我们即刻制作一个图像分类的Agile模型原型,并通过用户研究(N=14)显示,用户可以在30分钟以内尽量不费力地创建分类器。 我们把这个用户驱动的过程与传统的众包模式进行比较,发现人群的概念往往不同于用户的概念,特别是当概念变得更加主观时。 最后,我们通过模拟用户培训图像网络21k分类的用户来扩大我们的实验规模,以进一步展示其功效。

papers.title: AGG-Net: Attention Guided Gated-Convolutional Network for Depth Image Completion
papers.authors: Dongyue Chen, Tingxuan Huang, Zhimin Song, Shizhuo Deng, Tong Jia
papers.abstract: Recently, stereo vision based on lightweight RGBD cameras has been widely used in various fields. However, limited by the imaging principles, the commonly used RGB-D cameras based on TOF, structured light, or binocular vision acquire some invalid data inevitably, such as weak reflection, boundary shadows, and artifacts, which may bring adverse impacts to the follow-up work. In this paper, we propose a new model for depth image completion based on the Attention Guided Gated-convolutional Network (AGG-Net), through which more accurate and reliable depth images can be obtained based on the raw depth maps and the corresponding RGB images. Our model employs a UNet-like architecture which consists of two parallel branches of depth and color features. In the encoding stage, an Attention Guided Gated Convolution (AG-GConv) module is proposed to realize the fusion of depth and color features at different scales, which can effectively reduce the negative impacts of invalid depth data on the reconstruction. In the decoding stage, an Attention Guided Skip Connection (AG-SC) module is presented to avoid introducing too many depth-irrelevant features to the reconstruction. The experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the popular benchmarks NYU-Depth V2, DIML, and SUN RGB-D.
papers.title_zh: AGG-Net: 深度图像完成引人注意的GT-革命网络
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,以轻量级RGBD摄像机为基础的立体影像在各个领域被广泛使用。 然而,受成像原则的限制,基于TOF、结构光线或望远镜视觉的常用RGB-D照相机必然会获得一些无效数据,如反射不力、边界阴影和人工制品,这可能会对后续工作产生不利影响。 在本文中,我们根据 " 注意引导革命网络 " (AGG-Net)提出了新的深度图像完成模式,通过这一模式,可以根据原始深度地图和相应的RGB图像获取更准确和可靠的深度图像。 我们的模型使用一个类似UNet的建筑,由两个平行的深度和颜色特征分支组成。 在编码阶段,提议设立一个 " 注意引导革命(AG-GConv) " 模块,以在不同尺度上实现深度和彩色特征的融合,从而有效减少无效深度数据对重建的负面影响。 在解码阶段,提出了“关注引导跳过连接(AG-SC)”模块,以避免在重建中引入太多与深度无关的特征。 实验结果表明,我们的方法优于流行基准NYU-Depth V2、DIML和SUN RGB-D的最新方法。

papers.title: Affordance Grounding From Demonstration Video To Target Image
papers.authors: Joya Chen, Difei Gao, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.abstract: Humans excel at learning from expert demonstrations and solving their own problems. To equip intelligent robots and assistants, such as AR glasses, with this ability, it is essential to ground human hand interactions (i.e., affordances) from demonstration videos and apply them to a target image like a user's AR glass view. The video-to-image affordance grounding task is challenging due to (1) the need to predict fine-grained affordances, and (2) the limited training data, which inadequately covers video-image discrepancies and negatively impacts grounding. To tackle them, we propose Affordance Transformer (Afformer), which has a fine-grained transformer-based decoder that gradually refines affordance grounding. Moreover, we introduce Mask Affordance Hand (MaskAHand), a self-supervised pretraining technique for synthesizing video-image data and simulating context changes, enhancing affordance grounding across video-image discrepancies. Afformer with MaskAHand pre-training achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, including a substantial 37% improvement on the OPRA dataset. Code is made available at https://github.com/showlab/afformer.
papers.title_zh: 从示范视频到目标图像
papers.abstract_zh: 人类在从专家示威中学习和解决自身问题方面非常出色。 为了装备智能机器人和助工,如AR眼镜,以这种能力,必须用演示录像将人手的相互作用(即负担)定位在演示录像中,并将其应用到目标图像中,如用户的AR玻璃视图。 由于:(1) 需要预测精细的购买力,(2) 培训数据有限,不足以涵盖视频图像差异和不利影响,因此视频到图像提供能力的定位任务具有挑战性。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议 " 价廉变换器 " (Afexer),该变换器有一个精细的变压器拆解器,逐步完善发价变换场。 此外,我们介绍Mask Affordance Hand(MaskAHand),这是一个自我监督的训练前技术,用于综合视频图像数据和模拟环境变化,加强在视频图像差异之间打地的支付能力。 与MaskAH和训练前的退伍人员在多项基准上取得了最先进的业绩,其中包括对OPRA数据集的重大改进37%,守则可在https://github.com/showlab/afexe查阅。

papers.title: Adaptive Spiral Layers for Efficient 3D Representation Learning on Meshes
papers.authors: Francesca Babiloni, Matteo Maggioni, Thomas Tanay, Jiankang Deng, Ales Leonardis, Stefanos Zafeiriou
papers.abstract: The success of deep learning models on structured data has generated significant interest in extending their application to non-Euclidean domains. In this work, we introduce a novel intrinsic operator suitable for representation learning on 3D meshes. Our operator is specifically tailored to adapt its behavior to the irregular structure of the underlying graph and effectively utilize its long-range dependencies, while at the same time ensuring computational efficiency and ease of optimization. In particular, inspired by the framework of Spiral Convolution, which extracts and transforms the vertices in the 3D mesh following a local spiral ordering, we propose a general operator that dynamically adjusts the length of the spiral trajectory and the parameters of the transformation for each processed vertex and mesh. Then, we use polyadic decomposition to factorize its dense weight tensor into a sequence of lighter linear layers that separately process features and vertices information, hence significantly reducing the computational complexity without introducing any stringent inductive biases. Notably, we leverage dynamic gating to achieve spatial adaptivity and induce global reasoning with constant time complexity benefitting from an efficient dynamic pooling mechanism based on Summed-Area-tables. Used as a drop-in replacement on existing architectures for shape correspondence our operator significantly improves the performance-efficiency trade-off, and in 3D shape generation with morphable models achieves state-of-the-art performance with a three-fold reduction in the number of parameters required. Project page: https://github.com/Fb2221/DFC
papers.title_zh: 利用适应性螺旋图层提高3D在贝壳上的代表性学习效率
papers.abstract_zh: 关于结构化数据的深层学习模式的成功已引起人们极大的兴趣,希望将其应用范围扩大到非欧洲域。 在这项工作中,我们引入了一个新的内在操作者,适合在3D型甲壳类中进行代表性学习。 我们的操作员是专门为适应基本图的不正常结构而专门设计的,并有效利用其长期依赖性,同时确保计算效率和优化的便利。 特别是,在刺激3D网格按当地螺旋顺序提取和变换3D网格的螺旋变动框架的启发下,我们提议设立一个总操作员,以动态方式调整螺旋轨的长度以及每个加工的顶峰和网格的变换参数。 然后,我们用聚氯乙烯分解法将其稠密的重量拉成一系列较轻的线性层,这些线性层分别处理信息,从而大大降低计算的复杂性,而不会引入任何严格的感性偏差。 值得注意的是,我们利用动态引力实现空间适应性,并引领全球推理,使时间持续复杂,受益于基于苏麦底地区表的高效动态集资机制。 我们的操作者用来对现有结构进行掉进替换,以形成通信,大大改进了性能效率的权衡,用可变模型生成的3D形状实现了最先进的性能,所需参数数减少了3倍。 项目网页:https://github.com/Fb2221/DFC

papers.title: Adaptive Selective Sampling for Online Prediction with Experts
papers.authors: Rui Castro, Fredrik Hellström, Tim van Erven
