papers.title: AdaNIC: Towards Practical Neural Image Compression via Dynamic Transform Routing
papers.authors: Lvfang Tao, Wei Gao, Ge Li, Chenhao Zhang
papers.abstract: Compressive autoencoders (CAEs) play an important role in deep learning-based image compression, but large-scale CAEs are computationally expensive. We propose a framework with three techniques to enable efficient CAE-based image coding: 1) Spatially-adaptive convolution and normalization operators enable block-wise nonlinear transform to spend FLOPs unevenly across the image to be compressed, according to a transform capacity map. 2) Just-unpenalized model capacity (JUMC) optimizes the transform capacity of each CAE block via rate-distortion-complexity optimization, finding the optimal capacity for the source image content. 3) A lightweight routing agent model predicts the transform capacity map for the CAEs by approximating JUMC targets. By activating the best-sized sub-CAE inside the slimmable supernet, our approach achieves up to 40% computational speed-up with minimal BD-Rate increase, validating its ability to save computational resources in a content-aware manner.
papers.title_zh: AdaNIC:通过动态变换路由实现实际神经图像压缩
papers.abstract_zh: 压缩式压缩自动编码器(CAE)在深层学习图像压缩中发挥着重要作用,但大规模压缩式自动编码器在计算上费用昂贵。 我们提出一个框架,采用三种技术,使基于CAE的高效图像编码能够做到:(1) 空间适应性变异和正常化操作者能够根据变换能力图,使成块性非线性变异能够将FLOP不均匀地花在要压缩的图像上。 2) 公正不惩罚的模型能力(JUMC)通过速率失真-复杂度优化,优化每个CAE区块的变换能力,找到源图像内容的最佳能力。 3)轻量级路由代理模型通过接近JUMC目标,预测CAEs变换能力图。 通过在微薄的超级网内激活最小型的子CAE,我们的方法实现了高达40%的计算速度,而BD-Rate的增幅最小,从而证实它有能力以内容意识的方式节省计算资源。

papers.title: Active Self-Supervised Learning: A Few Low-Cost Relationships Are All You Need
papers.authors: Vivien Cabannes, Leon Bottou, Yann Lecun, Randall Balestriero
papers.abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as the solution of choice to learn transferable representations from unlabeled data. However, SSL requires to build samples that are known to be semantically akin, i.e. positive views. Requiring such knowledge is the main limitation of SSL and is often tackled by ad-hoc strategies e.g. applying known data-augmentations to the same input. In this work, we generalize and formalize this principle through Positive Active Learning (PAL) where an oracle queries semantic relationships between samples. PAL achieves three main objectives. First, it is a theoretically grounded learning framework that encapsulates standard SSL but also supervised and semi-supervised learning depending on the employed oracle. Second, it provides a consistent algorithm to embed a priori knowledge, e.g. some observed labels, into any SSL losses without any change in the training pipeline. Third, it provides a proper active learning framework yielding low-cost solutions to annotate datasets, arguably bringing the gap between theory and practice of active learning that is based on simple-to-answer-by-non-experts queries of semantic relationships between inputs.
papers.title_zh: 活跃的自我监督学习:少许低成本关系,你需要的一切
papers.abstract_zh: 自我监督学习(SSL)已成为选择从未贴标签的数据中学习可转移的表示方式的解决方案,然而,SSL要求建立已知具有生理近似性的样本,即正面观点。 要求这种知识是SSL的主要限制,往往通过临时战略来解决,例如,对同一投入应用已知的数据缩略语,在这项工作中,我们通过积极积极学习(PAL)来概括和正式确定这一原则,其中甲骨文Query样品之间的语义关系。 PAL实现了三个主要目标。 首先,这是一个基于理论的学习框架,它包罗了标准SSL,但也根据雇用的甲骨文进行了监督和半监督的学习。 其次,它提供了一种一致的算法,用于嵌入先验知识,例如先验知识。 一些已观察到的标签,包括任何SSL损失,培训管道没有任何改变。 第三,它提供了一个适当的积极学习框架,为批注数据集提供低成本解决办法,可以说,它根据非专家对投入之间语义关系的简单解答询问,在积极学习的理论和实践之间带来了差距。

papers.title: Active Ranking of Experts Based on their Performances in Many Tasks
papers.authors: El Mehdi Saad, Nicolas Verzelen, Alexandra Carpentier
papers.title_zh: 根据其在许多任务中的表现积极安排专家的级别

papers.title: A Unified HDR Imaging Method With Pixel and Patch Level
papers.authors: Qingsen Yan, Weiye Chen, Song Zhang, Yu Zhu, Jinqiu Sun, Yanning Zhang
papers.abstract: Mapping Low Dynamic Range (LDR) images with different exposures to High Dynamic Range (HDR) remains nontrivial and challenging on dynamic scenes due to ghosting caused by object motion or camera jitting. With the success of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), several DNNs-based methods have been proposed to alleviate ghosting, they cannot generate approving results when motion and saturation occur. To generate visually pleasing HDR images in various cases, we propose a hybrid HDR deghosting network, called HyHDRNet, to learn the complicated relationship between reference and non-reference images. The proposed HyHDRNet consists of a content alignment subnetwork and a Transformer-based fusion subnetwork. Specifically, to effectively avoid ghosting from the source, the content alignment subnetwork uses patch aggregation and ghost attention to integrate similar content from other non-reference images with patch level and suppress undesired components with pixel level. To achieve mutual guidance between patch-level and pixel-level, we leverage a gating module to sufficiently swap useful information both in ghosted and saturated regions. Furthermore, to obtain a high-quality HDR image, the Transformer-based fusion subnetwork uses a Residual Deformable Transformer Block (RDTB) to adaptively merge information for different exposed regions. We examined the proposed method on four widely used public HDR image deghosting datasets. Experiments demonstrate that HyHDRNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively, achieving appealing HDR visualization with unified textures and colors.
papers.title_zh: 具有像素和补丁级的统一的《人类发展报告》成像方法
papers.abstract_zh: 由于物体运动或照相机跳动造成的幽灵,对不同接触高动态距离(HDR)的低动态范围图像进行测绘时,在动态场景上,由于物体运动或照相机跳动造成的幽灵,对不同接触高动态距离(HDR)的图像仍然不起作用和具有挑战性。 随着深神经网络的成功,已提出若干基于DNN的方法来缓解鬼魂现象,当运动和饱和发生时,这些方法无法产生批准结果。 为了在各种情况下产生令人目光满意的《人类发展报告》图像,我们提议建立一个称为HyHDRNet的混合《人类发展报告》启蒙网络,以了解参考图像和非参考图像之间的复杂关系。 拟议的HyHDRNet由内容对齐子网络和以Transformer为基础的聚变子网络组成。 具体地说,为有效避免从源头产生鬼魂,内容校正子网络利用补丁聚合和幽灵注意将其他非参考图像中的类似内容与补丁相融合,并将不受欢迎的部件与像素相连接。 为了在补丁层面和像素层面之间实现相互指导,我们利用一个格子模块,在幽灵和饱和地区充分交换有用信息。 此外,为了获得高质量的《人类发展报告》图像,基于Transformer的聚变子网络利用残余变异Transformer区块(RDTB)对不同暴露区域的信息进行适应性合并,我们审查了关于四种广泛使用的公众使用的《人类发展报告》图像破损数据集的拟议方法。 实验表明,HHHDRNet在数量和质量上都优于最先进的方法,实现了具有吸引力的《人类发展报告》可视化,具有统一的质地和颜色。

papers.title: A Unified Continual Learning Framework with General Parameter-Efficient Tuning
papers.authors: Qiankun Gao, Chen Zhao, Yifan Sun, Teng Xi, Gang Zhang, Bernard Ghanem, Jian Zhang
papers.abstract: The "pre-training - downstream adaptation" presents both new opportunities and challenges for Continual Learning (CL). Although the recent state-of-the-art in CL is achieved through Parameter-Efficient-Tuning (PET) adaptation paradigm, only prompt has been explored, limiting its application to Transformers only. In this paper, we position prompting as one instantiation of PET, and propose a unified CL framework with general PET, dubbed as Learning-Accumulation-Ensemble (LAE). PET, e.g., using Adapter, LoRA, or Prefix, can adapt a pre-trained model to downstream tasks with fewer parameters and resources. Given a PET method, our LAE framework incorporates it for CL with three novel designs. 1) Learning: the pre-trained model adapts to the new task by tuning an online PET module, along with our adaptation speed calibration to align different PET modules, 2) Accumulation: the task-specific knowledge learned by the online PET module is accumulated into an offline PET module through momentum update, 3) Ensemble: During inference, we respectively construct two experts with online/offline PET modules (which are favored by the novel/historical tasks) for prediction ensemble. We show that LAE is compatible with a battery of PET methods and gains strong CL capability. For example, LAE with Adaptor PET surpasses the prior state-of-the-art by 1.3% and 3.6% in last-incremental accuracy on CIFAR100 and ImageNet-R datasets, respectively.
papers.title_zh: 统一持续学习框架,配有通用参数有效计票
papers.abstract_zh: “培训前-下游适应”为持续学习提供了新的机遇和挑战。 尽管最近的科技水平是通过参数-效率-调试(PET)适应模式实现的,但只是迅速探索了,将其应用仅限于Transformer。 在本文中,我们把 " 适应 " 定位为 " 适应 " 的即时反应,并提议一个统一的 " 适应 " 框架,称为 " 学习-积累-集合-集合(LAE) " (LAE)。 " 适应 " 、 " LoRA " 或 " 前缀 " 等通用 " 适应 " ,可以使预先培训的模式适应下游任务,其参数和资源较少。 根据PET方法,我们的LAE框架结合了CL的三种新设计。 (1) 学习:预培训模式适应新任务,调整在线PET模块,同时调整我们的适应速度校准,以调整不同的PET模块,(2) 累积:在线PET模块所学到的具体任务知识通过动力更新积累到离线的PET模块中,(3) 组合:在推断期间,我们分别建造了两名专家,配有在线/离线PET模块(新颖/历史任务偏爱这些模块),用于预测组合。 我们发现LAE与一电池的PET方法相容,并获得了强大的CL能力。 例如,LAE与调适器PET分别比CIFAR100和图像网络-R数据集中最新精确度高出1.3%和3.6%。

papers.title: A Light Weight Model for Active Speaker Detection
papers.authors: Junhua Liao, Haihan Duan, Kanghui Feng, Wanbing Zhao, Yanbing Yang, Liangyin Chen
papers.abstract: Active speaker detection is a challenging task in audio-visual scenarios, with the aim to detect who is speaking in one or more speaker scenarios. This task has received considerable attention because it is crucial in many applications. Existing studies have attempted to improve the performance by inputting multiple candidate information and designing complex models. Although these methods have achieved excellent performance, their high memory and computational power consumption render their application to resource-limited scenarios difficult. Therefore, in this study, a lightweight active speaker detection architecture is constructed by reducing the number of input candidates, splitting 2D and 3D convolutions for audio-visual feature extraction, and applying gated recurrent units with low computational complexity for cross-modal modeling. Experimental results on the AVA-ActiveSpeaker dataset reveal that the proposed framework achieves competitive mAP performance (94.1% vs. 94.2%), while the resource costs are significantly lower than the state-of-the-art method, particularly in model parameters (1.0M vs. 22.5M, approximately 23x) and FLOPs (0.6G vs. 2.6G, approximately 4x). Additionally, the proposed framework also performs well on the Columbia dataset, thus demonstrating good robustness. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/Junhua-Liao/Light-ASD.
papers.title_zh: 活跃音速探测光重模型
papers.abstract_zh: 积极检测扬声器是视听情景中一项具有挑战性的任务,目的是检测在一种或多种扬声器情景中发言的人,这一任务由于在许多应用中至关重要而得到了相当的重视。 现有研究试图通过输入多个候选信息和设计复杂模型来改进业绩,虽然这些方法取得了出色的业绩,但其记忆力和计算力消耗高,难以应用于资源有限的情况。 因此,在本研究报告中,通过减少投入候选者的数量、将2D和3D相分离以提取视听特征,以及将计算复杂度低的封闭式经常性单元用于跨模式建模,构建了一个轻量级主动语音检测结构。 AVA-AvisionSpeaker数据集的实验结果显示,拟议框架实现了具有竞争力的 mAP性能(94.1%对94.2%),而资源成本大大低于最先进的方法,特别是在模型参数(1.0M对22.5M,约23x)和FLOPs(0.6G对94.2%)方面。 此外,拟议框架还很好地利用了哥伦比亚数据集,从而显示了良好的可靠性,代码和模型权重见https://github.com/Junhua-Liao/Light-ASD。

papers.title: A Dynamic Multi-Scale Voxel Flow Network for Video Prediction
papers.authors: Xiaotao Hu, Zhewei Huang, Ailin Huang, Jun Xu, Shuchang Zhou
papers.abstract: The performance of video prediction has been greatly boosted by advanced deep neural networks. However, most of the current methods suffer from large model sizes and require extra inputs, e.g., semantic/depth maps, for promising performance. For efficiency consideration, in this paper, we propose a Dynamic Multi-scale Voxel Flow Network (DMVFN) to achieve better video prediction performance at lower computational costs with only RGB images, than previous methods. The core of our DMVFN is a differentiable routing module that can effectively perceive the motion scales of video frames. Once trained, our DMVFN selects adaptive sub-networks for different inputs at the inference stage. Experiments on several benchmarks demonstrate that our DMVFN is an order of magnitude faster than Deep Voxel Flow and surpasses the state-of-the-art iterative-based OPT on generated image quality. Our code and demo are available at https://huxiaotaostasy.github.io/DMVFN/.
papers.title_zh: 动态多空间Voxel视频预测流程网络
papers.abstract_zh: 先进的深层神经网络大大促进了视频预测的性能,但是,目前大多数方法都具有大型号,需要额外投入,例如语义/深度地图,才能有良好的性能。 为了提高效率,我们在本文中提议建立一个动态多规模Voxel流动网络,以比以往方法更低的计算成本实现更好的视频预测性能,只有RGB图像。 我们的DMVFN的核心是一个不同的路由模块,能够有效地看到视频框架的动作尺度。 一旦经过培训,我们的DMVFN将选择适应性子网络在推论阶段用于不同的投入。 在几个基准上进行的实验表明,我们的新生力量机动车辆的量级比深福瑟流动速度快,在生成图像质量方面超过了最先进的迭代巴勒斯坦被占领土。 我们的代码和演示可在https://huxiaotaostasy.github.io/DMVFN/上查阅。

papers.title: 3D-CVF: Generating Joint Camera and LiDAR Features Using Cross-View Spatial Feature Fusion for 3D Object Detection
papers.authors: Jin Hyeok Yoo, Yecheol Kim, Jisong Kim, Jun Won Choi
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a new deep architecture for fusing camera and LiDAR sensors for 3D object detection. Because the camera and LiDAR sensor signals have different characteristics and distributions, fusing these two modalities is expected to improve both the accuracy and robustness of 3D object detection. One of the challenges presented by the fusion of cameras and LiDAR is that the spatial feature maps obtained from each modality are represented by significantly different views in the camera and world coordinates; hence, it is not an easy task to combine two heterogeneous feature maps without loss of information. To address this problem, we propose a method called 3D-CVF that combines the camera and LiDAR features using the cross-view spatial feature fusion strategy. First, the method employs auto-calibrated projection, to transform the 2D camera features to a smooth spatial feature map with the highest correspondence to the LiDAR features in the bird's eye view (BEV) domain. Then, a gated feature fusion network is applied to use the spatial attention maps to mix the camera and LiDAR features appropriately according to the region. Next, camera-LiDAR feature fusion is also achieved in the subsequent proposal refinement stage. The low-level LiDAR features and camera features are separately pooled using region of interest (RoI)-based feature pooling and fused with the joint camera-LiDAR features for enhanced proposal refinement. Our evaluation, conducted on the KITTI and nuScenes 3D object detection datasets, demonstrates that the camera-LiDAR fusion offers significant performance gain over the LiDAR-only baseline and that the proposed 3D-CVF achieves state-of-the-art performance in the KITTI benchmark."
papers.title_zh: 3D-CVF:为3D天体探测生成联合相机和利用跨视野空间地貌分解生成的激光雷达特征
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了用于3D天体探测的引信相机和激光雷达传感器的新的深层结构。 因为相机和激光雷达传感器信号具有不同的特性和分布,因此两种模式的引信将提高3D天体探测的准确性和可靠性。 照相机和LiDAR的结合所带来的挑战之一是,从每种方式获得的空间特征图在照相机和世界坐标上所持的观点大不相同;因此,将两种不同特征图结合起来而不丢失信息并非易事。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议一种称为3D-CVF的方法,利用交叉视角空间特征融合战略,将相机和激光雷达特征结合起来。 首先,该方法采用自动校准的投影法,将2D摄像功能转换为光滑的空间特征图,与鸟类眼视(BEV)域的LiDAR特征最接近。 然后,将使用一个封闭的特征聚合网络,使用空间关注图,根据区域情况适当混合相机和激光雷达特征,然后在随后提案的完善阶段实现相机-激光雷达特征融合。 低水平的LIDAR特征和照相机特征分别使用以区域感兴趣的特征集合,并与联合照相机-LiDAR特征结合,以加强提案的完善。 我们对KITTI和NuScenes 3D天体探测数据集进行的评估表明,相机-LiDAR聚变比仅使用LIDAR的基线具有显著的性能收益,拟议的3D-CVF在KITTI基准中达到了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Uni-Perceiver-MoE: Learning Sparse Generalist Models with Conditional MoEs
papers.authors: Jinguo Zhu, Xizhou Zhu, Wenhai Wang, Xiaohua Wang, Hongsheng Li, Xiaogang Wang, Jifeng Dai
papers.abstract: To build an artificial neural network like the biological intelligence system, recent works have unified numerous tasks into a generalist model, which can process various tasks with shared parameters and do not have any task-specific modules. While generalist models achieve promising results on various benchmarks, they have performance degradation on some tasks compared with task-specialized models. In this work, we find that interference among different tasks and modalities is the main factor to this phenomenon. To mitigate such interference, we introduce the Conditional Mixture-of-Experts (Conditional MoEs) to generalist models. Routing strategies under different levels of conditions are proposed to take both the training/inference cost and generalization ability into account. By incorporating the proposed Conditional MoEs, the recently proposed generalist model Uni-Perceiver can effectively mitigate the interference across tasks and modalities, and achieves state-of-the-art results on a series of downstream tasks via prompt tuning on 1% of downstream data. Moreover, the introduction of Conditional MoEs still holds the generalization ability of generalist models to conduct zero-shot inference on new tasks, e.g., video-text retrieval and video caption. Code and pre-trained generalist models shall be released.
papers.title_zh: Uni-Perceiver-MoE:学习有条件的部的简单通用主义模式
papers.abstract_zh: 为了建立一个像生物情报系统这样的人工神经网络,最近的工作将许多任务统一成一个通才模式,它可以处理各种任务,具有共同的参数,没有任何具体任务模块。 虽然一般模式在各种基准方面取得了有希望的成果,但与任务专门模式相比,这些模式在某些任务上的业绩下降,在这项工作中,我们发现不同任务和模式之间的干扰是造成这一现象的主要因素。 为了减轻这种干扰,我们向通才模式引入了 " 有条件的专家混合(有条件的部) " ,并提议在不同条件下采取分流战略,既考虑培训/推断成本,也考虑概括能力。 最近提议的通用主义模式Uni-Perceiver通过纳入拟议的有条件的MoE,可以有效减轻任务和模式之间的干扰,并通过迅速调整1%的下游数据,在一系列下游任务上取得最新成果。 此外,引入有条件的MoE仍然能够使通才模式普遍化,对新的任务,如录相文本检索和视频字幕等进行零点推论,将公布守则和预先培训的通才模式。

papers.title: Sparse Video Representation Using Steered Mixture-of-Experts With Global Motion Compensation
papers.authors: Rolf Jongebloed, Erik Bochinski, Thomas Sikora
papers.abstract: Steered-Mixtures-of Experts (SMoE) present a unified framework for sparse representation and compression of image data with arbitrary dimensionality. Recent work has shown great improvements in the performance of such models for image and light-field representation. However, for the case of videos the straight-forward application yields limited success as the SMoE framework leads to a piece-wise linear representation of the underlying imagery which is disrupted by nonlinear motion. We incorporate a global motion model into the SMoE framework which allows for higher temporal steering of the kernels. This drastically increases its capabilities to exploit correlations between adjacent frames by only adding 2 to 8 motion parameters per frame to the model but decreasing the required amount of kernels on average by 54.25%, respectively, while maintaining the same reconstruction quality yielding higher compression gains.
papers.title_zh: 使用具有全球运动补偿的Steered Mixture 专家的Steered Mixture
papers.abstract_zh: Steered-Mixtures of Expert (SMoE) 提供了一个统一的框架,可以任意地以多维方式对图像数据进行稀疏的表述和压缩,最近的工作显示,这些图像和光场表述模型的性能大有改进。 然而,就视频而言,直向应用的成功有限,因为SMoE框架导致对基础图像的片段直线表示,非线性运动干扰了基本图像。 我们把全球运动模式纳入SMoE框架,从而可以对内核进行更高的时间引导。 这大大提高了它利用相邻框架之间相互关系的能力,在模型中只增加了每个框架2至8个运动参数,但平均平均将所需内核减少54.25%,同时保持同样的重建质量,以产生更高的压缩收益。

papers.title: RoME: Role-aware Mixture-of-Expert Transformer for Text-to-Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Burak Satar, Hongyuan Zhu, Hanwang Zhang, Joo‐Hwee Lim
papers.abstract: Seas of videos are uploaded daily with the popularity of social channels; thus, retrieving the most related video contents with user textual queries plays a more crucial role. Most methods consider only one joint embedding space between global visual and textual features without considering the local structures of each modality. Some other approaches consider multiple embedding spaces consisting of global and local features separately, ignoring rich inter-modality correlations. We propose a novel mixture-of-expert transformer RoME that disentangles the text and the video into three levels; the roles of spatial contexts, temporal contexts, and object contexts. We utilize a transformer-based attention mechanism to fully exploit visual and text embeddings at both global and local levels with mixture-of-experts for considering inter-modalities and structures' correlations. The results indicate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the YouCook2 and MSR-VTT datasets, given the same visual backbone without pre-training. Finally, we conducted extensive ablation studies to elucidate our design choices.
papers.title_zh: RoME: 用于文本到视频检索的具备作用的混合技术专家变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 每天在社交频道的普及下上传视频内容;因此,以用户文字Query检索最相关的视频内容,可发挥更关键的作用。 大多数方法只考虑全球视觉和文字特征之间的一个联合嵌入空间,而不考虑每种模式的本地结构。 其他一些方法则考虑由全球和本地特征分别构成的多个嵌入空间,忽略了丰富多彩的时际相互关系。 我们建议建立一个新型的专家变压器RoME,将文字和视频分解为三个层面:空间背景、时间背景和对象背景的作用。 我们利用以变压器为基础的关注机制,充分利用全球和地方各级的视觉和文字嵌入器,与专家混合考虑各种模式和结构的相互关系。 结果显示,我们的方法优于YouCook2和MSR-VTT数据集的最新方法,因为同样的视觉骨干没有预先训练。 最后,我们进行了广泛的实验研究,以阐明我们的设计选择。

papers.title: Probabilistic Rainfall Estimation from Automotive Lidar
papers.authors: Robin Karlsson, David Wong, Kazunari Kawabata, Simon Thompson, Naoki Sakai
papers.abstract: Robust sensing and perception in adverse weather conditions remain one of the biggest challenges for realizing reliable autonomous vehicle mobility services. Prior work has established that rainfall rate is a useful measure for the adversity of atmospheric weather conditions. This work presents a probabilistic hierarchical Bayesian model that infers rainfall rate from automotive lidar point cloud sequences with high accuracy and reliability. The model is a hierarchical mixture of experts model, or a probabilistic decision tree, with gating and expert nodes consisting of variational logistic and linear regression models. Experimental data used to train and evaluate the model is collected in a large-scale rainfall experiment facility from both stationary and moving vehicle platforms. The results show prediction accuracy comparable to the measurement resolution of a disdrometer, and the soundness and usefulness of the uncertainty estimation. The model achieves RMSE 2.42mm/h after filtering out uncertain predictions. The error is comparable to the mean rainfall rate change of 3.5mm/h between measurements. Model parameter studies show how predictive performance changes with tree depth, sampling duration, and crop box dimension. A second experiment demonstrates the predictability of higher rainfall above 300mm/h using a different lidar sensor, demonstrating sensor independence.
papers.title_zh: Automotive Lidar公司估算的概率降雨量
papers.abstract_zh: 恶劣天气条件下的强力感知和感知仍然是实现可靠的自动机动车辆服务的最大挑战之一,先前的工作已经确定降雨率是应对大气气候条件逆境的有用措施。 这项工作提出了一种概率性贝叶斯等级模型,从汽车圆点云序列中精确可靠地推断出降雨速率。 该模型是一种专家的等级混合模型,或一种概率决策树,配有由变异物流和线性回归模型组成的格子节点和专家节点。 用于训练和评价模型的实验数据是在固定式和移动式车辆平台上的大型降雨试验设施中收集的。 结果表明,预测的准确性与测算的贫度分辨率相当,以及不确定性估计的可靠性和有用性,模型在过滤出不确定的预测后,实现了RMSE 2.42mm/h。 该误差与测量结果之间平均降雨率变化3.5毫米/小时相当,示范参数研究显示,在树木深度、取样时间和作物盒尺寸方面,预测性能变化如何。 第二次实验表明,使用不同的里雷达传感器,降雨量高于300毫米/小时的降雨量可以预测,这表明传感器是独立的。

papers.title: MoESR: Blind Super-Resolution using Kernel-Aware Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Mohammad Emad, Maurice Peemen, Henk Corporaal
papers.abstract: Modern deep learning super-resolution approaches have achieved remarkable performance where the low-resolution (LR) input is a degraded high-resolution (HR) image by a fixed known kernel i.e. kernel-specific super-resolution (SR). However, real images often vary in their degradation kernels, thus a single kernel-specific SR approach does not often produce accurate HR results. Recently, degradation-aware networks are introduced to generate blind SR results for unknown kernel conditions. They can restore images for multiple blur kernels. However, they have to compromise in quality compared to their kernel-specific counterparts. To address this issue, we propose a novel blind SR method called Mixture of Experts Super-Resolution (MoESR), which uses different experts for different degradation kernels. A broad space of degradation kernels is covered by kernel-specific SR networks (experts). We present an accurate kernel prediction method (gating mechanism) by evaluating the sharpness of images generated by experts. Based on the predicted kernel, our most suited expert network is selected for the input image. Finally, we fine-tune the selected network on the test image itself to leverage the advantage of internal learning. Our experimental results on standard synthetic datasets and real images demonstrate that MoESR outperforms state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively. Especially for the challenging ×4 SR task, our PSNR improvement of 0.93 dB on the DIV2KRK dataset is substantial <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> .

papers.title_zh: MoESR: 使用核心软件专家混合器的盲人超级分辨率
papers.abstract_zh: 现代深层学习超分辨率方法取得了显著的成绩,低分辨率(LR)输入是固定的已知内核即内核特定超分辨率(SR)的退化高分辨率(HR)图像。 然而,真实图像的降解内核往往各不相同,因此单一的内核特定SR方法往往不会产生准确的人力资源结果。 最近,引入了退化意识网络,以产生未知内核条件下的盲性SR结果。 它们可以恢复多个模糊内核的图像。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用名为“专家超级分辨率混合”的新颖的盲目SR方法,该方法使用不同的专家处理不同的降解内核。 内核特定SR网络(专家)覆盖了广泛的降解内核空间,我们通过评价专家产生的图像的清晰度,提出了准确的内核预测方法(引核机制),根据预测内核,我们最合适的专家网络被选为输入图像。 最后,我们用测试图像本身来微调所选网络,以利用内部学习的优势。 我们在标准合成数据集和真实图像上的实验结果显示,在数量和质量上,经济、社会、文化权利委员会的成绩都超过了最新的最新方法。 特别是对于具有挑战性的x4SR任务,我们的PSNR在DIV2KRK数据集上改进了0.93 dB, 其数量可观 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"1 </sup>。

papers.title: Go Wider Instead of Deeper
papers.authors: Fuzhao Xue, Ziji Shi, Futao Wei, Yuxuan Lou, Yong Liu, Yang You
papers.abstract: More transformer blocks with residual connections have recently achieved impressive results on various tasks. To achieve better performance with fewer trainable parameters, recent methods are proposed to go shallower by parameter sharing or model compressing along with the depth. However, weak modeling capacity limits their performance. Contrastively, going wider by inducing more trainable matrixes and parameters would produce a huge model requiring advanced parallelism to train and inference. In this paper, we propose a parameter-efficient framework, going wider instead of deeper. Specially, following existing works, we adapt parameter sharing to compress along depth. But, such deployment would limit the performance. To maximize modeling capacity, we scale along model width by replacing feed-forward network (FFN) with mixture-of-experts (MoE). Across transformer blocks, instead of sharing normalization layers, we propose to use individual layernorms to transform various semantic representations in a more parameter-efficient way. To evaluate our plug-and-run framework, we design WideNet and conduct comprehensive experiments on popular computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks. On ImageNet-1K, our best model outperforms Vision Transformer (ViT) by 1.5% with 0.72 times trainable parameters. Using 0.46 times and 0.13 times parameters, our WideNet can still surpass ViT and ViT-MoE by 0.8% and 2.1%, respectively. On four natural language processing datasets, WideNet outperforms ALBERT by 1.8% on average and surpass BERT using factorized embedding parameterization by 0.8% with fewer parameters.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: 更宽而非深更深
papers.abstract_zh: 更多具有剩余连接的变压器块最近在许多任务上取得了令人印象深刻的成果。 为了以较少的可训练参数取得更好的业绩,建议最近采用的方法通过参数共享或模型压缩与深度一同向更浅处倾斜。 然而,薄弱的建模能力限制了它们的性能。 与此相反,通过引入更多的可培训的矩阵和参数来扩大规模将产生一个庞大的模型,需要先进的平行式培训和推论。 在本文中,我们提出了一个参数效率框架,其范围要宽一些而不是更深一些。 特别地,在现有工程完成后,我们调整了参数共享以进行深度压缩。 但是,这种部署会限制性能。 为了最大限度地扩大模型能力,我们按照模型宽度,用专家混合(MoE)取代进料前网络(FFN ) 。 跨变压器区块, 我们提议使用单个的层北, 以更符合参数效率的方式改变各种语义表达方式, 而不是共享正常化层。 为了评估我们的插接运行框架,我们设计了广域网,并在流行计算机视觉和自然语言处理基准方面进行了全面的实验。 在图像网-1K上,我们最好的模型比视觉Transformer(VT)高1.5 % , 可培训参数为0.72倍。 在图像网-1K上,我们最好的模型比视觉Transformer(VT)高1.5 % 。 使用0.46倍和0.13倍参数,我们的广域网仍然可以分别超过VIT和VIT-MOE 0.8% 和 2.1% 。 在四种自然语言处理数据集中,广域网平均比ALBERT高1.8 % , 比BERT高0.8% , 使用因数嵌入参数比重为0.8% , 参数更少。

papers.title: FMP-Net: Fractal Multi-Gate Mixture-of-Experts Panoramic Segmentation for Point Cloud
papers.authors: Chengzhe Yang
papers.abstract: Panoramic segmentation in LiDAR point clouds is in its nascent stage, which unifies the semantic and instance seg-mentation tasks that receive increasing attentions. This paper proposed a fractal multi-gate mixture-of-experts panoramic segmentation network (FMP-Net) consists of encode and de-code, which is able to perform panoramic segmentation tasks on large-scale scenes point clouds. The fractal multi-gate mixture-of-experts (FMMoE) module is proposed in the de-code part, which integrates the multi-gate mixture-of-experts (MMoE) module and binary tree. The FMMoE module is able to divide the features extracted by the encoder step by step, eventually determining the features to be used for each sub-task in panoramic segmentation. We used a hierarchical clus-tering algorithm to obtain instance information while improving the overall network inference speed. The experimental results illustrated that our proposed method achieve Panoptic Quality(PQ) of 40.7% and the Intersection over Union(mIoU) of 62.3% on the public dataset NuScenes. The source code is available at: https://github.com/ChazYang/FMP-Net.

papers.title_zh: FMP-Net: 点云四分形多基因混合物
papers.abstract_zh: LiDAR点云的全景分解处于初创阶段,它统一了受到日益关注的语义和实例分解任务。 该文件提议建立一个由编码和代码组成的分形多门专家全景分解混合网络(FMP-Net),能够在大型场景点云层上执行全景分解任务。 在解码部分提出了分形多门专家混合单元,该单元将多门专家混合单元和二进制树结合起来。 FMMoE 模块能够一步一步地分割编码器所提取的特征,最终确定在全局分割中每个子任务所使用的特征。 我们使用一个等级级闭路算法获取实例信息,同时提高整个网络的推断速度。 实验结果表明,我们拟议方法在公共数据集Nuscenes上达到40.7%的全光质量(PQ)和62.3%的全光质量(mIU),来源代码见https://github.com/ChazYang/FMP-Net。

papers.title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Joint Diagnosis of Multiple Mental Disorders on MRI Scans
papers.authors: Zhi-An Huang, Yao Hu, Rui Liu, Xiaoming Xue, Zexuan Zhu, Linqi Song, Kay Chen Tan
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Deep learning (DL) techniques have been introduced to assist doctors in the interpretation of medical images by detecting image-derived phenotype abnormality. Yet the privacy-preserving policy of medical images disables the effective training of DL model using sufficiently large datasets. As a decentralized computing paradigm to address this issue, federated learning (FL) allows the training process to occur in individual institutions with local datasets, and then aggregates the resultant weights without risk of privacy leakage. METHODS: We propose an effective federated multi-task learning (MTL) framework to jointly identify multiple related mental disorders based on functional magnetic resonance imaging data. A federated contrastive learning-based feature extractor is developed to extract high-level features across client models. To ease the optimization conflicts of updating shared parameters in MTL, we present a federated multi-gate mixture of expert classifier for the joint classification. The proposed framework also provides practical modules, including personalized model learning, privacy protection, and federated biomarker interpretation. RESULTS: On real-world datasets, the proposed framework achieves robust diagnosis accuracies of 69.48 ± 1.6%, 71.44 ± 3.2%, and 83.29 ± 3.2% in autism spectrum disorder, attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder, and schizophrenia, respectively. CONCLUSION: The proposed framework can effectively ease the domain shift between clients via federated MTL. SIGNIFICANCE: The current work provides insights into exploiting the advantageous knowledge shared in related mental disorders for improving the generalization capability of computer-aided detection approaches.
papers.title_zh: MRI扫描中多重精神疾病联合诊断的联邦多任务学习
papers.abstract_zh: 目标:引进深层学习技术,通过检测图像衍生的苯型异常,协助医生解读医学图像,然而,医疗图像的隐私保护政策妨碍了对使用足够大数据集的DL模型进行有效培训。 作为解决这一问题的分散化计算模式,联合学习(FL)使培训过程能够在拥有当地数据集的个别机构进行,然后在不出现隐私渗漏风险的情况下汇总由此产生的加权数。 方法:我们建议一个有效的联合多任务学习框架,根据功能磁共振成像数据,共同确定多重相关精神障碍。 为了缓解更新MTL中共享参数的优化冲突,我们为联合分类提供了由专家分类员组成的联合多门混合体,拟议框架还提供实用模块,包括个性化模型学习、隐私保护和联名生物标志解释。 成果:在现实世界数据集中,拟议框架在自闭症谱系障碍、注意力不足/高活性障碍和精神分裂症方面分别实现了69.48% + 1.6%、 71.44 + 3.2% 和 83.29 + 3.2% 的稳健诊断,分别达到69.48% + 1.6%、 71.44 + 3.2% 和 83.29 + 3.2%。 结论:拟议框架能够有效地减轻客户之间通过联合MTL. SIGNIFIONCE:目前的工作使人们深入了解如何利用在相关精神疾病方面分享的有利知识,提高计算机辅助检测方法的普及能力。

papers.title: Winoground: Probing Vision and Language Models for Visio-Linguistic Compositionality
papers.authors: Tristan Thrush, Ryan Jiang, Max Bartolo, Amanpreet Singh, Adina Williams, Douwe Kiela, Candace Ross
papers.abstract: We present a novel task and dataset for evaluating the ability of vision and language models to conduct visio-linguistic compositional reasoning, which we call Winoground. Given two images and two captions, the goal is to match them correctly--but crucially, both captions contain a completely identical set of words, only in a different order. The dataset was carefully hand-curated by expert annotators and is labeled with a rich set of fine-grained tags to assist in analyzing model performance. We probe a diverse range of state-of-the-art vision and language models and find that, surprisingly, none of them do much better than chance. Evidently, these models are not as skilled at visio-linguistic compositional reasoning as we might have hoped. We perform an extensive analysis to obtain insights into how future work might try to mitigate these models' shortcomings. We aim for Winoground to serve as a useful evaluation set for advancing the state of the art and driving further progress in the field. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/winoground.
papers.title_zh: 展望:虚拟语言构成的展望和语言模型
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个新任务和数据集,用于评价视觉和语言模型的能力,以进行视觉语言构成推理,我们称之为Winoground。 从两个图像和两个标题来看, 目标是要正确匹配它们, 但关键是, 两个标题都包含完全相同的词组, 只有不同的顺序 。 该数据集由专家说明员精心手工制作,并贴上丰富的精细标记,以协助分析模型性能。 我们探索了多种最先进的视觉和语言模型,发现令人惊讶的是,它们中没有一个比机会好得多。 显然,这些模型并不像我们所希望的那样精通语言构成的推理。 我们进行了广泛的分析,以深入了解未来工作如何设法减轻这些模型的缺点。 我们的目标是 " Winoground " 作为一种有用的评价工具,用以推动最新进展,推动这一领域的进一步进展,数据集见https://huggingface.co/datasts/facebook/winoground。

papers.title: Weakly-Supervised Metric Learning With Cross-Module Communications for the Classification of Anterior Chamber Angle Images
papers.authors: Jingqi Huang, Yue Ning, Dong Nie, Linan Guan, Xiping Jia
papers.abstract: As the basis for developing glaucoma treatment strategies, Anterior Chamber Angle (ACA) evaluation is usually dependent on experts' judgements. However, experienced ophthalmologists needed for these judgements are not widely available. Thus, computer-aided ACA evaluations become a pressing and efficient solution for this issue. In this paper, we propose a novel end-to-end framework GCNet for automated Glaucoma Classification based on ACA images or other Glaucoma-related medical images. We first collect and label an ACA image dataset with some pixel-level annotations. Next, we introduce a segmentation module and an embedding module to enhance the performance of classifying ACA images. Within GCNet, we design a Cross-Module Aggregation Net (CMANet) which is a weakly-supervised metric learning network to capture contextual information exchanging across these modules. We conduct experiments on the ACA dataset and two public datasets REFUGE and SIGF. Our experimental results demonstrate that GCNet outperforms several state-of-the-art deep models in the tasks of glaucoma medical image classifications. The source code of GCNet can be found at https://github.com/Jingqi-H/GCNet.
papers.title_zh: 用于前厅角图像分类的跨模块通信的薄弱和超强计量学习
papers.abstract_zh: 作为制定青光眼治疗战略的基础,前厅Angle(ACA)的评估通常取决于专家的判断,然而,这些判断所需的有经验的眼科医生并不普遍。 因此,计算机辅助的ACA评价成为解决这一问题的一个紧迫而有效的解决办法。 在本文中,我们提议根据ACA图像或其他与Glaucoma有关的医学图像建立一个新型的端对端框架GCNet,用于Glaucoma自动分类。 我们首先收集和标注一个 AACA 图像数据集, 并加一些像素级的注释。 接下来, 我们引入一个分割模块和一个嵌入模块, 以提高 AACA 图像分类的性能 。 在GCNet内部,我们设计了一个跨模块聚合网(CMANet),这是一个监督不力的衡量学习网络,可以捕捉这些模块之间的背景信息交流。 我们在ACA数据集和两个公共数据集(REFUGE和SIGF)上进行了实验。 我们的实验结果显示,GCNet在青光眼医学图像分类的任务中优于若干最先进的深层模型,GCNet的来源代码见https://github.com/Jingqi-H/GCNet。

papers.title: VGSE: Visually-Grounded Semantic Embeddings for Zero-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Wenjia Xu, Yongqin Xian, Jiuniu Wang, Bernt Schiele, Zeynep Akata
papers.abstract: Human-annotated attributes serve as powerful semantic embeddings in zero-shot learning. However, their annotation process is labor-intensive and needs expert supervision. Current unsupervised semantic embeddings, i.e., word embeddings, enable knowledge transfer between classes. However, word embeddings do not always reflect visual similarities and result in inferior zero-shot performance. We propose to discover semantic embeddings containing discriminative visual properties for zero-shot learning, without requiring any human annotation. Our model visually divides a set of images from seen classes into clusters of local image regions according to their visual similarity, and further imposes their class discrimination and semantic relatedness. To associate these clusters with previously unseen classes, we use external knowledge, e.g., word embeddings and propose a novel class relation discovery module. Through quantitative and qualitative evaluation, we demonstrate that our model discovers semantic embeddings that model the visual properties of both seen and unseen classes. Furthermore, we demonstrate on three benchmarks that our visually-grounded semantic embeddings further improve performance over word embeddings across various ZSL models by a large margin. Code is available at https://github.com/wenjiaXu/VGSE
papers.title_zh: VGSE: 用于零热学习的视觉四轮语义嵌入
papers.abstract_zh: 人类附加说明的属性是零光学习中强大的语义嵌入。 但是,它们的批注过程是劳动密集型的,需要专家监督。 目前不受监督的语义嵌入,即文字嵌入,可以让各班之间进行知识转让。 然而,字嵌入并不总能反映视觉上的相似性,并导致低劣的零弹性表现。 我们建议发现含有歧视性视觉特性的语义嵌入,用于零弹学习,而不需要任何人类的批注。 我们的模型根据视觉相似性,将一组图像从可见的类别分为当地图像区域分组,并进一步强加了他们的阶级歧视和语义关联。 为了将这些组群与先前看不见的类群联系起来,我们使用外部知识,例如,文字嵌入,并提出一个新的类关系发现模块,以发现这些类群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群群。 通过定量和定性评价,我们证明,我们的模型发现了语义嵌入物,这种语义嵌入物模拟了可见和看不见的阶级的视觉特性。 此外,我们还在三个基准上表明,我们基于视觉的语义嵌入进一步大大改进了在ZSL各模型中与字嵌入相比的性能。 代码可在https://github.com/wenjiaXu/VGSE上查阅。

papers.title: Unpaired Cartoon Image Synthesis via Gated Cycle Mapping
papers.authors: Yifang Men, Yuan Yao, Miaomiao Cui, Zhouhui Lian, Xuansong Xie, Xian-Sheng Hua
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present a general-purpose solution to cartoon image synthesis with unpaired training data. In contrast to previous works learning pre-defined cartoon styles for specified usage scenarios (portrait or scene), we aim to train a common cartoon translator which can not only simultaneously render exaggerated anime faces and realistic cartoon scenes, but also provide flexible user controls for desired cartoon styles. It is challenging due to the complexity of the task and the absence of paired data. The core idea of the proposed method is to introduce gated cycle mapping, that utilizes a novel gated mapping unit to produce the category-specific style code and embeds this code into cycle networks to control the translation process. For the concept of category, we classify images into different categories (e.g., 4 types: photo/cartoon portrait/scene) and learn finer-grained category translations rather than overall mappings between two domains (e.g., photo and cartoon). Furthermore, the proposed method can be easily extended to cartoon video generation with an auxiliary dataset and a new adaptive style loss. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method over the state of the art and validate its effectiveness in the brand-new task of general cartoon image synthesis.
papers.title_zh: 通过 Gated 循环绘图进行未受光化卡通图像合成
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个通用解决方案,用未受重视的培训数据来合成卡通图象。 与以往学习特定使用情景(轮廓或场景)预定义的漫画风格的工作相比,我们的目标是培训一个通用的漫画翻译,不仅能同时制作夸张的动画面和现实的漫画场景,而且能为想要的漫画风格提供灵活的用户控制。 由于任务的复杂性和缺乏配对数据,这具有挑战性。 拟议方法的核心理念是引入闭门周期绘图,利用新颖的闭门绘图单位制作特定类别风格代码,并将该代码嵌入循环网络以控制翻译过程。 就类别概念而言,我们将图像分为不同类别(如4种类型:照片/卡通肖像/摄像),学习精细的分类翻译,而不是在两个领域(如照片和卡通)之间绘制总体地图。 此外,拟议的方法可以很容易地推广到配有辅助数据集和新的适应风格损失的卡通视频制作。 实验结果显示,拟议方法优于最新技术,并证实其在通用卡通图像合成这一全新的全新任务中的有效性。

papers.title: Trustworthy Long-Tailed Classification
papers.authors: Bolian Li, Zongbo Han, Haining Li, Huazhu Fu, Changqing Zhang
papers.abstract: Classification on long-tailed distributed data is a challenging problem, which suffers from serious class-imbalance and accordingly unpromising performance especially on tail classes. Recently, the ensembling based methods achieve the state-of-the-art performance and show great potential. However, there are two limitations for current methods. First, their predictions are not trustworthy for failure-sensitive applications. This is especially harmful for the tail classes where the wrong predictions is basically frequent. Second, they assign unified numbers of experts to all samples, which is redundant for easy samples with excessive computational cost. To address these issues, we propose a Trustworthy Long-tailed Classification (TLC) method to jointly conduct classification and uncertainty estimation to identify hard samples in a multi-expert framework. Our TLC obtains the evidence-based uncertainty (EvU) and evidence for each expert, and then combines these uncertainties and evidences under the Dempster-Shafer Evidence Theory (DST). Moreover, we propose a dynamic expert engagement to reduce the number of engaged experts for easy samples and achieve efficiency while maintaining promising performances. Finally, we conduct comprehensive experiments on the tasks of classification, tail detection, OOD detection and failure prediction. The experimental results show that the proposed TLC outperforms existing methods and is trustworthy with reliable uncertainty.
papers.title_zh: 值得信赖的长途游船长期受信赖的分类
papers.abstract_zh: 长期分类分布数据分类是一个具有挑战性的问题,它存在严重的阶级不平衡,因此表现不尽人意,特别是尾类。 最近,以组合为基础的方法取得了最先进的表现并显示出巨大的潜力。 然而,目前的方法有两个局限性。 首先,它们的预测对于对故障敏感的应用不可信。 这对基本经常出现错误预测的尾端类别特别有害。 第二,它们为所有样品指定了统一数目的专家,这对计算成本过高的简单样品来说是多余的。 为解决这些问题,我们建议采用可信赖的长尾目分类方法,共同进行分类和不确定性估计,以便在多专家框架内确定硬样品。 我们的TLC获得了每位专家基于证据的不确定性(EvU)和证据,然后根据Dempster-Shafer证据理论(DST)将这些不确定性和证据结合起来。 此外,我们建议活跃的专家参与,以减少容易采样的受聘专家人数,提高效率,同时保持有希望的业绩,最后,我们对分类、尾矿探测、OOOD探测和故障预测等任务进行全面试验。 实验结果显示,拟议的TLC比现有方法要好,而且可靠的不确定性也值得信赖。

papers.title: Towards Real-World Navigation With Deep Differentiable Planners
papers.authors: Shu Ishida, João F. Henriques
papers.abstract: We train embodied neural networks to plan and navigate unseen complex 3D environments, emphasising real-world deployment. Rather than requiring prior knowledge of the agent or environment, the planner learns to model the state transitions and rewards. To avoid the potentially hazardous trial-and-error of reinforcement learning, we focus on differentiable planners such as Value Iteration Networks (VIN), which are trained offline from safe expert demonstrations. Although they work well in small simulations, we address two major limitations that hinder their deployment. First, we observed that current differentiable planners struggle to plan long-term in environments with a high branching complexity. While they should ideally learn to assign low rewards to obstacles to avoid collisions, these penalties are not strong enough to guarantee collision-free operation. We thus impose a structural constraint on the value iteration, which explicitly learns to model impossible actions and noisy motion. Secondly, we extend the model to plan exploration with a limited perspective camera under translation and fine rotations, which is crucial for real robot deployment. Our proposals significantly improve semantic navigation and exploration on several 2D and 3D environments, succeeding in settings that are otherwise challenging for differentiable planners. As far as we know, we are the first to successfully apply them to the difficult Active Vision Dataset, consisting of real images captured from a robot.
papers.title_zh: 以深有差异的规划者实现现实世界导航
papers.abstract_zh: 我们训练包含神经网络,以规划和导航看不见的复杂的3D环境,强调现实世界的部署。 规划者不要求事先了解物剂或环境,而是学习以国家过渡和奖励为模范。 为了避免可能具有危险性的强化学习试验和危险,我们侧重于不同的规划者,如价值迭代网络(VIN),这些网络通过安全专家演示获得离线培训。 尽管在小型模拟中它们运作良好,但我们解决了阻碍其部署的两大限制。 首先,我们注意到,目前不同的规划人员在极复杂的分支环境中难以规划长期计划。 尽管他们最好学会对避免碰撞的障碍给予低奖赏,但这些惩罚力度不足以保证不发生碰撞。 因此,我们对价值的迭代施加了结构性限制,因为它明确学会模拟不可能的行动和吵闹的运动。 第二,我们扩展这一模式,以便在翻译和精细轮换下,用有限视角摄像头规划探索,这对真正的机器人部署至关重要。 我们的建议大大改善了若干2D和3D环境的语义导航和勘探,在本来对不同规划者具有挑战性的环境中成功。 据我们所知,我们是第一个成功地将其应用到困难的动态视觉数据集中的第一个,该数据集由机器人拍摄的真实图像组成。

papers.title: Towards Low-Cost and Efficient Malaria Detection
papers.authors: Waqas Sultani, Wajahat Nawaz, Syed Javed, Muhammad Sohail Danish, Asma Saadia, Mohsen Ali
papers.abstract: Malaria, a fatal but curable disease claims hundreds of thousands of lives every year. Early and correct diagnosis is vital to avoid health complexities, however, it depends upon the availability of costly microscopes and trained experts to analyze blood-smear slides. Deep learning-based methods have the potential to not only decrease the burden of experts but also improve diagnostic accuracy on low-cost microscopes. However, this is hampered by the absence of a reasonable size dataset. One of the most challenging aspects is the reluctance of the experts to annotate the dataset at low magnification on low-cost microscopes. We present a dataset to further the research on malaria microscopy over the low-cost microscopes at low magnification. Our large-scale dataset consists of images of blood-smear slides from several malaria-infected patients, collected through microscopes at two different cost spectrums and multiple magnifications. Malarial cells are annotated for the localization and life-stage classification task on the images collected through the high-cost microscope at high magnification. We design a mechanism to transfer these annotations from the high-cost microscope at high magnification to the low-cost microscope, at multiple magnifications. Multiple object detectors and domain adaptation methods are presented as the baselines. Furthermore, a partially supervised domain adaptation method is introduced to adapt the object-detector to work on the images collected from the low-cost microscope. The dataset and benchmark models will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 实现低成本和高效率的疟疾检测
papers.abstract_zh: 疟疾是一种致命但可以治愈的疾病,每年夺去数十万人的生命。 早期和正确的诊断对于避免健康的复杂性至关重要,然而,它取决于能否获得昂贵的显微镜和训练有素的专家来分析血浆幻灯片。 深层学习方法不仅有可能减轻专家的负担,而且可以提高低成本显微镜的诊断准确性,但由于缺乏合理的大小数据集,这一点受到阻碍。 最具挑战性的一个方面是专家不愿意在低成本显微镜上以低放大度表示数据集,我们提出了一个数据集,用以在低放大度的低成本显微镜上进一步研究疟疾显微镜。 我们的大规模数据集包括几个疟疾患者的血浆幻灯片图像,通过显微镜以两种不同的成本频谱和多种放大镜收集。 对通过高放大度高成本显微镜收集的图像进行本地化和生命阶段分类的任务附加说明。 我们设计了一种机制,将这些说明从高放大度高成本显微镜转到多放大度高成本显微镜,多物体探测器和领域适应方法作为基线。 此外,还采用了一种部分监督的域适应方法,使天体探测器适应低成本显微镜所收集图像的工作,并将公布数据集和基准模型。

papers.title: The Auto Arborist Dataset: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multiview Urban Forest Monitoring Under Domain Shift
papers.authors: Sara Beery, Guanhang Wu, Trevor Edwards, Filip Pavetic, Bo Majewski, Shreyasee Mukherjee, Stanley Chan, John Morgan, Vivek Rathod, Jonathan Huang
papers.abstract: Generalization to novel domains is a fundamental challenge for computer vision. Near-perfect accuracy on benchmarks is common, but these models do not work as expected when deployed outside of the training distribution. To build computer vision systems that truly solve real-world problems at global scale, we need benchmarks that fully capture real-world complexity, including geographic domain shift, long-tailed distributions, and data noise. We propose urban forest monitoring as an ideal testbed for studying and improving upon these computer vision challenges, while simultaneously working towards filling a crucial environmental and societal need. Urban forests provide significant benefits to urban societies (e.g., cleaner air and water, carbon sequestration, and energy savings among others). However, planning and maintaining these forests is expensive. One particularly costly aspect of urban forest management is monitoring the existing trees in a city: e.g., tracking tree locations, species, and health. Monitoring efforts are currently based on tree censuses built by human experts, costing cities millions of dollars per census and thus collected infrequently. Previous investigations into automating urban forest monitoring focused on small datasets from single cities, covering only common categories. To address these shortcomings, we introduce a new large-scale dataset that joins public tree censuses from 23 cities with a large collection of street level and aerial imagery. Our Auto Arborist dataset contains over 2.5M trees and 344 genera and is >2 orders of magnitude larger than the closest dataset in the literature. We introduce baseline results on our dataset across modalities as well as metrics for the detailed analysis of generalization with respect to geographic distribution shifts, vital for such a system to be deployed at-scale.
papers.title_zh: Auto Arborist数据集:在地域转移下进行多视角城市森林监测的大型基准
papers.abstract_zh: 普及到新领域是计算机视觉的根本挑战。 基准的近乎完美准确性是常见的,但这些模式在培训分配之外部署时没有达到预期效果。 为了建立真正解决全球范围现实世界问题的计算机视觉系统,我们需要能够充分反映现实世界复杂性的基准,包括地理域变换、长尾分发和数据噪音。 我们建议将城市森林监测作为研究和改进这些计算机远景挑战的理想检验台,同时努力满足环境和社会方面的关键需要。 城市森林为城市社会带来重大惠益(如清洁空气和水、碳固存和节能等),但规划和维护这些森林费用昂贵。 城市森林管理的一个特别昂贵的方面是监测城市中现有的树木:例如,追踪树木位置、物种和健康,监测工作目前以人类专家建立的树木普查为基础,每次普查花费城市数百万美元,因此收集很少。 以往对城市森林监测自动化的调查集中在单一城市的小型数据集上,只覆盖共同类别。 为了解决这些缺陷,我们引入了一个新的大规模数据集,与23个城市的公共树木普查相结合,大量收集街道水平和航空图像。 我们的Auto Arborist数据集包含2.5M以上树木和344 genra,其数量大于文献中最接近的数据集的大于2个数量级。 我们介绍关于我们跨模式数据集的基线结果,以及详细分析地理分布变化一般化的衡量标准,这对于在规模上部署这样一个系统至关重要。

papers.title: Surpassing the Human Accuracy: Detecting Gallbladder Cancer From USG Images With Curriculum Learning
papers.authors: Soumen Basu, Mayank Gupta, Pratyaksha Rana, Pankaj Gupta, Chetan Arora
papers.abstract: We explore the potential of CNN-based models for gallbladder cancer (GBC) detection from ultrasound (USG) images as no prior study is known. USG is the most common diagnostic modality for GB diseases due to its low cost and accessibility. However, USG images are challenging to analyze due to low image quality, noise, and varying viewpoints due to the handheld nature of the sensor. Our exhaustive study of state-of-the-art (SOTA) image classification techniques for the problem reveals that they often fail to learn the salient GB region due to the presence of shadows in the USG images. SOTA object detection techniques also achieve low accuracy because of spurious textures due to noise or adjacent organs. We propose GBCNet to tackle the challenges in our problem. GBCNet first extracts the regions of interest (ROIs) by detecting the GB (and not the cancer), and then uses a new multi-scale, second-order pooling architecture specializing in classifying GBC. To effectively handle spurious textures, we propose a curriculum inspired by human visual acuity, which reduces the texture biases in GBCNet. Experimental results demonstrate that GBCNet significantly outperforms SOTA CNN models, as well as the expert radiologists. Our technical innovations are generic to other USG image analysis tasks as well. Hence, as a validation, we also show the efficacy of GBCNet in detecting breast cancer from USG images. Project page with source code, trained models, and data is available at https://gbc-iitd.github.io/gbcnet.
papers.title_zh: 超越人类的准确性:从有课程学习的USG图像中检测到球囊癌
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探索有线电视新闻网的从超声波(USG)图像中检测胆囊癌(GBC)模型的潜力,因为以前没有研究过,USG是GB疾病最常见的诊断模式,因为它的成本和可获取性都很低。 然而,由于图像质量低、噪音和传感器的手持性质造成不同观点,USG图像难以分析。 我们对该问题最新图像分类技术的详尽研究显示,由于USG图像中存在阴影,他们往往无法了解显著的GB区域。 SOTA物体探测技术也由于噪音或相邻器官的虚假质地而达到低精度,我们建议GBCNet处理我们问题的挑战。 GBCNet首先通过检测GB(而不是癌症)来提取感兴趣的区域,然后使用新的多级、二级集合结构,专门对GBC进行分类。 为了有效处理虚假的纹理,我们提出了一个人类视觉敏锐启发的课程,以减少GBCNet的纹理偏差。 实验结果表明,GBCNet明显优于SOTA有线电视新闻网模型以及放射专家。 我们的技术创新也与其他副秘书长的图像分析任务相同,因此,作为一种验证,我们还展示了全球BCNet在从副秘书长的图像中检测乳腺癌方面的功效,项目网页有源代码、经过培训的模型和数据,可查阅https://gbc-iitd.github.io/gbcnet。

papers.title: Stacked Hybrid-Attention and Group Collaborative Learning for Unbiased Scene Graph Generation
papers.authors: Xingning Dong, Tian Gan, Xuemeng Song, Jianlong Wu, Yuan Cheng, Liqiang Nie
papers.abstract: Scene Graph Generation, which generally follows a regular encoder-decoder pipeline, aims to first encode the visual contents within the given image and then parse them into a compact summary graph. Existing SGG approaches generally not only neglect the insufficient modality fusion between vision and language, but also fail to provide informative predicates due to the biased relationship predictions, leading SGG far from practical. Towards this end, in this paper, we first present a novel Stacked Hybrid-Attention network, which facilitates the intra-modal refinement as well as the inter-modal interaction, to serve as the encoder. We then devise an innovative Group Collaborative Learning strategy to optimize the decoder. Particularly, based upon the observation that the recognition capability of one classifier is limited towards an extremely unbalanced dataset, we first deploy a group of classifiers that are expert in distinguishing different subsets of classes, and then cooperatively optimize them from two aspects to promote the unbiased SGG. Experiments conducted on VG and GQA datasets demonstrate that, we not only establish a new state-of-the-art in the unbiased metric, but also nearly double the performance compared with two baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/dongxingning/SHA-GCL-for-SGG.
papers.title_zh: 为无偏见的景象生成图案进行混合和小组协作学习
papers.abstract_zh: 场景图生成一般遵循普通编码器-解码器管道,目的是首先在给定图像中编码视觉内容,然后将其分析成一个紧凑的简图。 现有的小额赠款办法通常不仅忽视了视力和语言之间融合模式不足,而且由于对有偏见的关系预测,未能提供信息的前提,导致小额赠款办法远非实用。 为此,在本文中,我们首先提出一个新型的堆积混合-意向网络,它既能促进模式内改进,又能促进模式间互动,作为编码器,然后我们设计一个创新的小组协作学习战略,以优化编码器。 特别是,根据一种意见,即一个分类者的承认能力限于极不平衡的数据集,我们首先部署一组分类人员,他们应精于区分不同类别子集,然后从两个方面合作优化分类人员,以促进无偏见的小额GG。 对VG和GQA数据集进行的实验表明,我们不仅在不偏倚的衡量标准方面建立了新的最新水平,而且与两个基线相比,业绩几乎翻了一番,我们的代码可在https://github.com/dongxingning/SHA-GCL-for-SGG上查阅。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Gating-Adjacency GCN for Human Motion Prediction
papers.authors: Chongyang Zhong, Lei Hu, Zihao Zhang, Yongjing Ye, Shihong Xia
papers.abstract: Predicting future motion based on historical motion sequence is a fundamental problem in computer vision, and it has wide applications in autonomous driving and robotics. Some recent works have shown that Graph Convolutional Networks(GCN) are instrumental in modeling the relationship between different joints. However, considering the variants and diverse action types in human motion data, the cross-dependency of the spatio-temporal relationships will be difficult to depict due to the decoupled modeling strategy, which may also exacerbate the problem of insufficient generalization. Therefore, we propose the Spatio-Temporal Gating-Adjacency GCN(GAGCN) to learn the complex spatio-temporal dependencies over diverse action types. Specifically, we adopt gating networks to enhance the generalization of GCN via the trainable adaptive adjacency matrix obtained by blending the candidate spatio-temporal adjacency matrices. Moreover, GAGCN addresses the cross-dependency of space and time by balancing the weights of spatio-temporal modeling and fusing the decoupled spatio-temporal features. Extensive experiments on Human 3.6M, AMASS, and 3DPW demonstrate that GAGCN achieves state-of-the-art performance in both short-term and long-term predictions.

papers.title: Sparse Refinement for Efficient High-Resolution Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhijian Liu · Zhuoyang Zhang · Samir Khaki · Shang Yang · Haotian Tang · Chenfeng Xu · Kurt Keutzer · Song Han
papers.abstract: Semantic segmentation empowers numerous real-world applications, such as autonomous driving and augmented/mixed reality. These applications often operate on high-resolution images (e.g., 8 megapixels) to capture the fine details. However, this comes at the cost of considerable computational complexity, hindering the deployment in latency-sensitive scenarios. In this paper, we introduce SparseRefine, a novel approach that enhances dense low-resolution predictions with sparse high-resolution refinements. Based on coarse low-resolution outputs, SparseRefine first uses an entropy selector to identify a sparse set of pixels with high entropy. It then employs a sparse feature extractor to efficiently generate the refinements for those pixels of interest. Finally, it leverages a gated ensembler to apply these sparse refinements to the initial coarse predictions. SparseRefine can be seamlessly integrated into any existing semantic segmentation model, regardless of CNN- or ViT-based. SparseRefine achieves significant speedup: 1.5 to 3.9 times when applied to HRNet-W48, SegFormer-B5, Mask2Former-T/L and SegNeXt-L on Cityscapes, with negligible to no loss of accuracy. We will release the code to reproduce our results. Our "dense+sparse'' paradigm paves the way for efficient high-resolution visual computing.
papers.title_zh: 高效高分辨率语义分解的微缩精细精细
papers.abstract_zh: 语义分解可以增强许多真实世界的应用能力,如自主驱动和强化/混合现实。 这些应用通常使用高分辨率图像(如8兆像素)来捕捉精细的细节。 然而,这样做的代价是计算的复杂性相当大,阻碍了在潜伏敏感情景中的部署。 在本文中,我们引入了SprasseRefine(SprasseRefine),这是一种新颖的方法,它能加强密集低分辨率预测,而高分辨率的改进则很少。 基于粗略的低分辨率输出, SpassarRefine 首先使用一个 entropy 选择器来识别少量的像素, 并且使用一个稀有的特性提取器来高效生成这些感兴趣的像素的精细精细。 最后,它利用一个闭门的集合器将这些稀疏的精细应用到最初粗糙的预测中。 粗糙的Refine可以无缝地融入任何现有的语义分解模型中,不管是否以CNN或VIT为基础。 SprasserRefine取得了显著的加速:对HRNet-W48、SegFormer-B5、Mask2Former-T/L和SegNeXt-L应用了1.5至3.9次,准确性可忽略不计。我们将发布代码来复制我们的结果。 我们的“ense+sparse”范式为高效的高分辨率视觉计算铺平了道路。

papers.title: Simple Multi-Dataset Detection
papers.authors: Xingyi Zhou, Vladlen Koltun, Philipp Krähenbühl
papers.abstract: How do we build a general and broad object detection system? We use all labels of all concepts ever annotated. These labels span diverse datasets with potentially inconsistent taxonomies. In this paper, we present a simple method for training a unified detector on multiple large-scale datasets. We use dataset-specific training protocols and losses, but share a common detection architecture with dataset-specific outputs. We show how to automatically integrate these dataset-specific outputs into a common semantic taxonomy. In contrast to prior work, our approach does not require manual taxonomy reconciliation. Experiments show our learned taxonomy outperforms a expert-designed taxonomy in all datasets. Our multi-dataset detector performs as well as dataset-specific models on each training domain, and can generalize to new unseen dataset without fine-tuning on them. Code is available at https://github.com/xingyizhou/UniDet.
papers.title_zh: 简单多数据集检测
papers.abstract_zh: 我们如何建立通用和宽度天体探测系统? 我们使用所有附加说明的概念的所有标签。 这些标签覆盖不同数据集, 可能存在不一致的分类。 在本文中, 我们提出了一个简单的方法, 用于对多个大型数据集的统一探测器进行培训 。 我们使用特定数据集的训练规程和损失,但有一个共同的检测结构,其中含有特定数据集的产出。 我们展示了如何将这些特定数据集的产出自动纳入共同的语义分类。 与以往的工作不同,我们的方法并不需要人工分类调节。 实验显示,我们所学的分类学在所有数据集中都优于专家设计的分类学。 我们的多数据集探测器运行以及每个培训领域的特定数据集模型,可以在不对其进行微调的情况下推广到新的无形数据集。 代码可在https://github.com/xingyizhou/UniDet查阅。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Aggregation of Diverse Experts for Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Recognition
papers.authors: Yifan Zhang, Bryan Hooi, Lanqing Hong, Jiashi Feng
papers.title_zh: 测试、不可接受、长期不及格长期承认问题专家的自我监督聚合

papers.title: RAGO: Recurrent Graph Optimizer for Multiple Rotation Averaging
papers.authors: Heng Li, Zhaopeng Cui, Shuaicheng Liu, Ping Tan
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a deep recurrent Rotation Averaging Graph Optimizer (RAGO) for Multiple Rotation Averaging (MRA). Conventional optimization-based methods usually fail to produce accurate results due to corrupted and noisy relative measurements. Recent learning-based approaches regard MRA as a regression problem, while these methods are sensitive to initialization due to the gauge freedom problem. To handle these problems, we propose a learnable iterative graph optimizer minimizing a gauge-invariant cost function with an edge rectification strategy to mitigate the effect of inaccurate measurements. Our graph optimizer iteratively refines the global camera rotations by minimizing each node's single rotation objective function. Besides, our approach iteratively rectifies relative rotations to make them more consistent with the current camera orientations and observed relative rotations. Furthermore, we employ a gated recurrent unit to improve the result by tracing the temporal information of the cost graph. Our framework is a real-time learning-to-optimize rotation averaging graph optimizer with a tiny size deployed for real-world applications. RAGO outperforms previous traditional and deep methods on real-world and synthetic datasets. The code is available at github.com/sfu-gruvi-3dv/RAGO
papers.title_zh: RAGO: 多旋转动动的经常图表优化
papers.abstract_zh: 本文建议对多旋转动动(MRA)采用一个反复出现的深层旋转动动动图优化器(RAGO),常规优化法通常无法产生准确的结果,原因是对相关测量方法进行腐蚀和吵闹。 最近以学习为基础的方法将相互承认协定视为一个倒退问题,而由于衡量自由问题,这些方法对初始化十分敏感。 为了处理这些问题,我们建议采用可学习的迭代图形优化器,尽量减少计量变化成本功能,并采用边边校正战略,以减轻不准确测量的影响。 我们的图形优化迭接式通过将每个节点的单个旋转目标功能最小化来完善全球相机旋转。 此外,我们的方法反复调整相对旋转,使其与当前相机方向更加一致,并观察到相对旋转。 此外,我们使用一个封闭的经常性单位,通过跟踪成本图的时间信息来改进结果,我们的框架是一个实时学习优化旋转平均图形优化器,其规模小于实际应用。 RAGO在现实世界和合成数据集方面比以往的传统和深层方法表现优于以往,该代码可在 Github.com/sfu-gruvi-3dv/RAGO查阅。

papers.title: R(Det)2: Randomized Decision Routing for Object Detection
papers.authors: Yali Li, Shengjin Wang
papers.abstract: In the paradigm of object detection, the decision head is an important part, which affects detection performance significantly. Yet how to design a high-performance decision head remains to be an open issue. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to combine decision trees and deep neural networks in an end-to-end learning manner for object detection. First, we disentangle the decision choices and prediction values by plugging soft decision trees into neural networks. To facilitate the effective learning, we propose the randomized decision routing with node selective and associative losses, which can boost the feature representative learning and network decision simultaneously. Second, we develop the decision head for object detection with narrow branches to generate the routing probabilities and masks, for the purpose of obtaining divergent decisions from different nodes. We name this approach as the randomized decision routing for object detection, abbreviated as R(Det)^2. Experiments on MS-COCO dataset demonstrate that R(Det)^2 is effective to improve the detection performance. Equipped with existing detectors, it achieves 1.4~ 3.6% AP improvement. Code will be released soon.
papers.title_zh: R(Det) 2: 用于探测物体的随机决定路标
papers.abstract_zh: 在物体探测范式中,决策主管是一个重要的部分,对探测业绩产生重大影响,但如何设计高性能决策主管仍是一个未决问题。 在本文中,我们提出一种新的方法,将决策树和深层神经网络结合起来,以端对端学习的方式进行物体探测。 首先,我们通过将软决策树插入神经网络来分解决策选择和预测值。 为了促进有效学习,我们提议随机决策路线,加上节点选择性和关联性损失,这可以同时促进特色代议学习和网络决策。 其次,我们开发使用狭小分支的物体探测决策头,以产生路径概率和遮罩,目的是从不同的节点获得不同的决定。我们将此方法命名为用于物体探测的随机决定路径,缩写为R(Det)2。 在MS-COCO数据集上进行的实验表明,R(Det)%2对于提高探测性能是有效的,在现有探测器的辅助下,它实现了1.4%至3.6%的AP改进。

papers.title: Post-hoc estimators for learning to defer to an expert
papers.authors: Harikrishna Narasimhan, Wittawat Jitkrittum, Aditya Menon, Ankit Rawat, Sanjiv Kumar
papers.title_zh: 选择后估算员学习听从专家的考评

papers.title: PINA: Learning a Personalized Implicit Neural Avatar From a Single RGB-D Video Sequence
papers.authors: Zijian Dong, Chen Guo, Jie Song, Xu Chen, Andreas Geiger, Otmar Hilliges
papers.abstract: We present a novel method to learn Personalized Implicit Neural Avatars (PINA) from a short RGB-D sequence. This allows non-expert users to create a detailed and personalized virtual copy of themselves, which can be animated with realistic clothing deformations. PINA does not require complete scans, nor does it require a prior learned from large datasets of clothed humans. Learning a complete avatar in this setting is challenging, since only few depth observations are available, which are noisy and incomplete (i.e. only partial visibility of the body per frame). We propose a method to learn the shape and non-rigid deformations via a pose-conditioned implicit surface and a deformation field, defined in canonical space. This allows us to fuse all partial observations into a single consistent canonical representation. Fusion is formulated as a global optimization problem over the pose, shape and skinning parameters. The method can learn neural avatars from real noisy RGB-D sequences for a diverse set of people and clothing styles and these avatars can be animated given unseen motion sequences.
papers.title_zh: PINA: 从单一RGB-D视频序列中学习个性化隐性神经神像
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个从一个简短的 RGB-D 序列中学习个性化隐形神像(PINA)的新颖方法。 这让非专家用户能够创建出一个详细和个性化的虚拟自我复制本,这个虚拟拷贝可以用现实的衣着变形来动画。 PINA并不需要完整的扫描,也不需要事先从衣着人的大量数据集中学习。 在这一背景下学习完整的阿凡达具有挑战性,因为只有很少的深度观测,这些观测是吵闹和不完整的(即每个框架只有部分身体可见度 ) 。 我们提出一种方法,通过在金刚石空间定义的装配条件的隐含表面和变形场来学习形状和非硬化变形。 这使得我们可以将所有局部观测结果整合成一个单一一致的圆柱形表示法。 混凝土被描述成一个全球最佳化问题,它覆盖着外形、形状和皮革参数。 这种方法可以从真正吵闹的 RGB-D 序列中为各种各样的人和衣着风格学习神经动因,这些变异体可以根据看不见的动作序列进行动画。

papers.title: NeurMiPs: Neural Mixture of Planar Experts for View Synthesis
papers.authors: Zhi-Hao Lin, Wei-Chiu Ma, Hao-Yu Hsu, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Shenlong Wang
papers.abstract: We present Neural Mixtures of Planar Experts (NeurMiPs), a novel planar-based scene representation for modeling geometry and appearance. NeurMiPs leverages a collection of local planar experts in 3D space as the scene representation. Each planar expert consists of the parameters of the local rectangular shape representing geometry and a neural radiance field modeling the color and opacity. We render novel views by calculating ray-plane intersections and composite output colors and densities at intersected points to the image. NeurMiPs blends the efficiency of explicit mesh rendering and flexibility of the neural radiance field. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance and speedup compared to other 3D representations for novel view synthesis.
papers.title_zh: NeurMIPs: 用于查看合成的平板专家神经混合物
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍计划专家(NeurMIPs)的神经混合物,这是用于建模几何和外观的新颖的基于平面的场景示意图。 NeurMIPs利用3D空间当地平面专家的集合作为场面示意图。 每个平面专家由代表几何的本地矩形参数和以颜色和不透明为模型的神经弧度场组成。 我们通过计算射线飞机交叉点和图像交叉点的复合输出颜色和密度来提供新观点。 NeurMIP 混合了神经光亮场的清晰网格和灵活性。 实验表明,与新观点合成的其他 3D 表示相比,我们拟议方法的性能和速度更高。

papers.title: Nested Collaborative Learning for Long-Tailed Visual Recognition
papers.authors: Jun Li, Zichang Tan, Jun Wan, Zhen Lei, Guodong Guo
papers.abstract: The networks trained on the long-tailed dataset vary remarkably, despite the same training settings, which shows the great uncertainty in long-tailed learning. To alleviate the uncertainty, we propose a Nested Collaborative Learning (NCL), which tackles the problem by collaboratively learning multiple experts together. NCL consists of two core components, namely Nested Individual Learning (NIL) and Nested Balanced Online Distillation (NBOD), which focus on the individual supervised learning for each single expert and the knowledge transferring among multiple experts, respectively. To learn representations more thoroughly, both NIL and NBOD are formulated in a nested way, in which the learning is conducted on not just all categories from a full perspective but some hard categories from a partial perspective. Regarding the learning in the partial perspective, we specifically select the negative categories with high predicted scores as the hard categories by using a proposed Hard Category Mining (HCM). In the NCL, the learning from two perspectives is nested, highly related and complementary, and helps the network to capture not only global and robust features but also meticulous distinguishing ability. Moreover, self-supervision is further utilized for feature enhancement. Extensive experiments manifest the superiority of our method with outperforming the state-of-the-art whether by using a single model or an ensemble.
papers.title_zh: 长期学习视力识别合作学习
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管培训环境相同,但接受过长尾数据集培训的网络差别很大,这表明长尾学习有很大的不确定性。 为了缓解不确定性,我们提议采用“内行协作学习”办法,通过合作学习多位专家,共同解决这一问题。 NCL由两个核心部分组成,即Nested个人学习(NIL)和Nested平衡在线蒸馏(NBOD),分别侧重于每名专家的个人监督学习和多位专家之间的知识转让。 为了更透彻地了解各种表述,NIL和NBOD都是以嵌套方式形成的,不仅从全面的角度对所有类别进行学习,而且从局部的角度对一些硬性类别进行学习。 关于部分学习,我们通过使用拟议硬分类采矿(HCM),具体选择了预测得分高的负面类别作为硬类别。 从两个角度的学习是嵌套的、高度相关和互补的,有助于网络不仅捕捉全球强健的特征,而且捕捉细致的区分能力。 此外,自我监督还被进一步用于增强功能。 广泛的实验显示了我们方法的优越性,它优于最先进的技术,无论是使用单一模型还是组合模型。

papers.title: Multimodal Dynamics: Dynamical Fusion for Trustworthy Multimodal Classification
papers.authors: Zongbo Han, Fan Yang, Junzhou Huang, Changqing Zhang, Jianhua Yao
papers.abstract: Integration of heterogeneous and high-dimensional data (e.g., multiomics) is becoming increasingly important. Existing multimodal classification algorithms mainly focus on improving performance by exploiting the complementarity from different modalities. However, conventional approaches are basically weak in providing trustworthy multimodal fusion, especially for safety-critical applications (e.g., medical diagnosis). For this issue, we propose a novel trustworthy multimodal classification algorithm termed Multimodal Dynamics, which dynamically evaluates both the feature-level and modality-level informativeness for different samples and thus trustworthily integrates multiple modalities. Specifically, a sparse gating is introduced to capture the information variation of each within-modality feature and the true class probability is employed to assess the classification confidence of each modality. Then a transparent fusion algorithm based on the dynamical informativeness estimation strategy is induced. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to jointly model both feature and modality variation for different samples to provide trustworthy fusion in multi-modal classification. Extensive experiments are conducted on multimodal medical classification datasets. In these experiments, superior performance and trustworthiness of our algorithm are clearly validated compared to the state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 多式联运动态:可信赖的多式联运分类的动态融合
papers.abstract_zh: 整合多种数据和高维数据(如多组化)正变得越来越重要,现有的多式联运分类算法主要侧重于利用不同模式的互补性来改进业绩。 然而,传统方法在提供可靠的多式联运聚合,特别是安全关键应用(如医疗诊断)方面基本上薄弱。 对于这一问题,我们建议采用新的、可信赖的多式联运分类算法,称为多模式动力学,该算法动态地评价不同样本的特征水平和模式水平信息,从而信任地结合多种模式。 具体地说,引入了一种稀疏的格子来捕捉每种模式内特征的信息差异,而真正的等级概率被用来评估每种模式的分类信任度。 然后,根据动态信息性估计战略引入一种透明的聚合算法。 就我们所知,这是首次共同为不同样品的特征和模式变异模式提供共同模型,以便在多模式分类中提供可信赖的聚合,并在多式医疗分类数据集方面进行了广泛的实验。 在这些实验中,与最先进的方法相比,我们的算法的优异性能和可信赖性得到明确验证。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Alignment Domain Adaptation for Object Detection
papers.authors: Wenzhang Zhou, Dawei Du, Libo Zhang, Tiejian Luo, Yanjun Wu
papers.abstract: Domain adaptive object detection is challenging due to distinctive data distribution between source domain and target domain. In this paper, we propose a unified multi-granularity alignment based object detection framework towards domain-invariant feature learning. To this end, we encode the dependencies across different granularity perspectives including pixel-, instance-, and category-levels simultaneously to align two domains. Based on pixel-level feature maps from the backbone network, we first develop the omni-scale gated fusion module to aggregate discriminative representations of instances by scale-aware convolutions, leading to robust multi-scale object detection. Meanwhile, the multi-granularity discriminators are proposed to identify which domain different granularities of samples (i.e., pixels, instances, and categories) come from. Notably, we leverage not only the instance discriminability in different categories but also the category consistency between two domains. Extensive experiments are carried out on multiple domain adaptation scenarios, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework over state-of-the-art algorithms on top of anchor-free FCOS and anchor-based Faster R-CNN detectors with different backbones.
papers.title_zh: 用于物体探测的多组合对齐域适应
papers.abstract_zh: 由于源域和目标域之间存在独特的数据分布,因此域适应性物体探测具有挑战性。在本文中,我们提议为域-变量特性学习建立一个统一的多色谱调整目标探测框架。 为此,我们将不同颗粒角度的相互依存性编码成,包括像素、实例和类别层面,同时对两个领域进行对齐。 根据主干网的像素级地貌图,我们首先开发了全称闭门聚变模块,通过规模变迁对实例进行综合的歧视性描述,从而形成强有力的多尺度物体探测。 与此同时,提出多管区歧视者是为了确定样本的不同颗粒(例如像素、实例和类别)来自哪个领域。 值得注意的是,我们不仅利用不同类别中的情况差异性,而且利用两个领域之间的类别一致性。 对多个领域的适应设想方案进行了广泛的实验,展示了我们的框架在无锚FCOS和基于锚的快速R-CNN探测器和不同骨干检测器之上对最新算法的有效性。

papers.title: Monocular Semantic Scene Completion via Masked Recurrent Networks
papers.authors: Xuzhi Wang · Xinran Wu · Song Wang · Lingdong Kong · Ziping Zhao
papers.abstract: Monocular Semantic Scene Completion (MSSC) aims to predict the voxel-wise occupancy and semantic category from a single-view RGB image. Existing methods adopt a single-stage framework that aims to simultaneously achieve visible region segmentation and occluded region hallucination, while also being affected by inaccurate depth estimation. Such methods often achieve suboptimal performance, especially in complex scenes. We propose a novel two-stage framework that decomposes MSSC into coarse MSSC followed by the Masked Recurrent Network. Specifically, we propose the Masked Sparse Gated Recurrent Unit (MS-GRU) which concentrates on the occupied regions by the proposed mask updating mechanism, and a sparse GRU design is proposed to reduce the computation cost. Additionally, we propose the distance attention projection to reduce projection errors by assigning different attention scores according to the distance to the observed surface. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed unified framework, MonoMRN, effectively supports both indoor and outdoor scenes and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the NYUv2 and SemanticKITTI datasets. Furthermore, we conduct robustness analysis under various disturbances, highlighting the role of the Masked Recurrent Network in enhancing the model's resilience to such challenges. The code will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 通过遮盖的经常网络完成单显性语语义场景补全
papers.abstract_zh: 单视 RGB 图像中,单视语义词谱补全(MSSC)旨在预测从 voxel 角度的占用和语义类别。 现有方法采用单一阶段框架,目的是同时实现可见的区域分割和隐蔽的区域幻觉,同时也受到不准确的深度估计的影响。 这种方法往往取得不理想的性能,特别是在复杂场景中。 我们建议建立一个新的两阶段框架,将毛里求斯航天公司分解成粗糙的毛里求斯航天公司,然后是蒙面经常网。 具体地说,我们提议设立蒙面零散经常股(MS-GRU),通过拟议的蒙面更新机制集中处理被占领地区,并提议采用稀疏的GRU设计,以减少计算费用。 此外,我们提出通过根据与观测表面的距离分配不同的关注分数来减少预测误差的远距离注意预测。 实验结果表明,我们拟议的统一框架MonorMRN有效地支持了室内和室外场景,并在NYUv2和SemanticKITTI数据集上取得了SOTA 性能。 此外,我们还在各种骚乱中进行稳健性分析,强调蒙面经常网在增强模型抗御此类挑战的能力方面的作用。

papers.title: MLSLT: Towards Multilingual Sign Language Translation
papers.authors: Aoxiong Yin, Zhou Zhao, Weike Jin, Meng Zhang, Xingshan Zeng, Xiaofei He
papers.abstract: Most of the research to date focuses on bilingual sign language translation (BSLT). However, such models are inefficient in building multilingual sign language translation systems. To solve this problem, we introduce the multilingual sign language translation (MSLT) task. It aims to use a single model to complete the translation between multiple sign languages and spoken languages. Then, we propose MLSLT, the first MSLT model, which contains two novel dynamic routing mechanisms for controlling the degree of parameter sharing between different languages. Intra-layer language-specific routing controls the proportion of data flowing through shared parameters and language-specific parameters from the token level through a soft gate within the layer, and inter-layer language-specific routing controls and learns the data flow path of different languages at the language level through a soft gate between layers. In order to evaluate the performance of MLSLT, we collect the first publicly available multilingual sign language understanding dataset, Spreadthesign-Ten (SP-10), which contains up to 100 language pairs, e.g., CSL->en, GSG->zh. Experimental results show that the average performance of MLSLT outperforms the baseline MSLT model and the combination of multiple BSLT models in many cases. In addition, we also explore zero-shot translation in sign language and find that our model can achieve comparable performance to the supervised BSLT model on some language pairs. Dataset and more details are at https://mlslt.github.io/.
papers.title_zh: MLLLLT:争取多语言手语手语翻译
papers.abstract_zh: 迄今为止,大部分研究侧重于双语手语翻译(BSLT),然而,这些模式在建立多语言手语翻译系统方面效率低下,为解决这一问题,我们引入了多语言手语翻译(MSLT)任务。 它旨在使用单一模式完成多种手语和口语之间的翻译。 然后,我们提出MLSLT,即第一个MSLT模式,其中包含两个新的动态路线机制,以控制不同语言之间参数共享的程度。 具体语言的定线控制了数据通过共享参数和特定语言参数流出的比例,这些参数和具体语言参数从象征性水平流出,到一层内部的软门,以及针对不同语言的定线控制,并通过层之间的软门在语言层面学习不同语言的数据流路径。 为了评价MLSLT的绩效,我们收集了第一个公开提供的多语言手语理解数据集,即 " 扩展信号-十 " (SP-10),该数据集包含多达100对语文,例如CSL-en、GSG->zh。 实验结果显示,MLSLT的平均性能在许多情况下超过基线MSLT模型和多个BSLT模型的组合。 此外,我们还探索手语的零点译文,发现我们的模型可以取得与一些对语种受监督的BSLT模型的类似业绩。 数据集和更多详情见https://mlslt.github.io/。

papers.title: MAXIM: Multi-Axis MLP for Image Processing
papers.authors: Zhengzhong Tu, Hossein Talebi, Han Zhang, Feng Yang, Peyman Milanfar, Alan Bovik, Yinxiao Li
papers.abstract: Recent progress on Transformers and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) models provide new network architectural designs for computer vision tasks. Although these models proved to be effective in many vision tasks such as image recognition, there remain challenges in adapting them for low-level vision. The inflexibility to support high-resolution images and limitations of local attention are perhaps the main bottlenecks. In this work, we present a multi-axis MLP based architecture called MAXIM, that can serve as an efficient and flexible general-purpose vision backbone for image processing tasks. MAXIM uses a UNet-shaped hierarchical structure and supports long-range interactions enabled by spatially-gated MLPs. Specifically, MAXIM contains two MLP-based building blocks: a multi-axis gated MLP that allows for efficient and scalable spatial mixing of local and global visual cues, and a cross-gating block, an alternative to cross-attention, which accounts for cross-feature conditioning. Both these modules are exclusively based on MLPs, but also benefit from being both global and 'fully-convolutional', two properties that are desirable for image processing. Our extensive experimental results show that the proposed MAXIM model achieves state-of-the-art performance on more than ten benchmarks across a range of image processing tasks, including denoising, deblurring, deraining, dehazing, and enhancement while requiring fewer or comparable numbers of parameters and FLOPs than competitive models. The source code and trained models will be available at https://github.com/google-research/maxim.
papers.title_zh: MAXIM: 用于图像处理的多轴 MLP
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,在变形器和多层感知器模型(MLP)模型(MLP)方面取得的进展为计算机视觉任务提供了新的网络建筑设计。 尽管这些模型在图像识别等许多视觉任务中被证明是有效的,但在调整这些模型以适应低水平视觉方面仍然存在挑战。 支持高分辨率图像的不灵活性和当地关注的局限性或许是主要的瓶颈。 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个基于多轴MLP(MAXIM)的架构,该架构可以作为图像处理任务的高效和灵活的普通用途视觉主干。 MAXIM使用UNet-形状的等级结构,支持空间式多层模型促成的远程互动。 具体地说,MAXIM包含两个基于多轴封闭式MLP的建筑块:一个多轴封闭式MLP,使当地和全球视觉信号能够有效和可扩展的空间混合,另一个交叉式板块,作为交叉注意力的替代物,它考虑到交叉特征调节。 这两个模块都完全以多功能项目为基础,但也受益于全球和“全面革命”这两个对图像处理可取的属性。 我们广泛的实验结果显示,拟议的MAXIM模型在一系列图像处理任务,包括拆卸、拆卸、排污、拆解和增强,同时需要比竞争性模型少或可比数量的参数和FLOP,在十多个基准上取得了SOTA 性能。 来源代码和经过培训的模式可在https://github.com/google-research/maxim上查阅。
