papers.title: Adaptive Gating for Single-Photon 3D Imaging
papers.authors: Ryan Po, Adithya Pediredla, Ioannis Gkioulekas
papers.abstract: Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are growing in popularity for depth sensing tasks. However, SPADs still struggle in the presence of high ambient light due to the effects of pile-up. Conventional techniques leverage fixed or asynchronous gating to minimize pile-up effects, but these gating schemes are all non-adaptive, as they are unable to incorporate factors such as scene priors and previous photon detections into their gating strategy. We propose an adaptive gating scheme built upon Thompson sampling. Adaptive gating periodically updates the gate position based on prior photon observations in order to minimize depth errors. Our experiments show that our gating strategy results in significantly reduced depth reconstruction error and acquisition time, even when operating outdoors under strong sunlight conditions.
papers.title_zh: 单Photon 3D 成像的适应性定位
papers.abstract_zh: 单磷雪崩二极管(SPADs)越来越受深度感测任务欢迎,然而,由于堆积效应的影响,SPADs仍然在高环境光线下挣扎。 常规技术利用固定或非同步加热法尽量减少堆积效应,但这些加热法都是非适应性的,因为它们无法将现场前科和先前的光子探测等因素纳入其加热战略。 我们建议采用基于汤普森取样的适应性带宽办法。适应性带宽根据先前的光子观测结果定期更新大门位置,以尽量减少深度误差。 我们的实验表明,我们的格言战略大大缩短了深度重建错误和获取时间,即使在阳光下户外活动时也是如此。

papers.title: A Study on the Distribution of Social Biases in Self-Supervised Learning Visual Models
papers.authors: Kirill Sirotkin, Pablo Carballeira, Marcos Escudero-Viñolo
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks are efficient at learning the data distribution if it is sufficiently sampled. However, they can be strongly biased by non-relevant factors implicitly incorporated in the training data. These include operational biases, such as ineffective or uneven data sampling, but also ethical concerns, as the social biases are implicitly present--even inadvertently, in the training data or explicitly defined in unfair training schedules. In tasks having impact on human processes, the learning of social biases may produce discriminatory, unethical and untrustworthy consequences. It is often assumed that social biases stem from supervised learning on labelled data, and thus, Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) wrongly appears as an efficient and bias-free solution, as it does not require labelled data. However, it was recently proven that a popular SSL method also incorporates biases. In this paper, we study the biases of a varied set of SSL visual models, trained using ImageNet data, using a method and dataset designed by psychological experts to measure social biases. We show that there is a correlation between the type of the SSL model and the number of biases that it incorporates. Furthermore, the results also suggest that this number does not strictly depend on the model's accuracy and changes throughout the network. Finally, we conclude that a careful SSL model selection process can reduce the number of social biases in the deployed model, whilst keeping high performance. The code is available at https://github.com/vpulab/SB-SSL.
papers.title_zh: 关于自我监督学习视觉模型中社会偏见分布的研究
papers.abstract_zh: 深神经网络如果有足够的样本,在了解数据分布方面是有效的,但是,它们可能受到培训数据中隐含的非相关因素的强烈偏向。 这些偏见包括操作上的偏见,例如数据抽样无效或不均衡,但也包括伦理问题,因为社会偏见在培训数据中含蓄地出现,甚至在无意中出现,或在不公平的培训时间表中明确界定。 在影响人类进程的任务中,学习社会偏见可能产生歧视性、不道德和不可信的后果。 人们常常认为,社会偏见源于对贴标签数据的监督学习,因此,自我监督学习被错误地视为一种有效和不带偏见的解决办法,因为它不需要贴标签的数据,但最近证明流行的SSL方法也含有偏见。 在本文中,我们研究了一组不同的SSL视觉模型的偏向性,这些模型使用图像网络数据进行培训,使用心理专家设计的方法和数据集来衡量社会偏向,我们表明SSL模型的类型与它包含的偏向数量之间存在关联。 此外,结果还表明,这一数字并不严格取决于模型的准确性和整个网络的变化,最后,我们的结论是,仔细的SSL模式选择过程可以减少所部署模式中的社会偏见数量,同时保持高绩效。 该代码可在https://github.com/vpulab/SB-SSL上查阅。

papers.title: A Few Expert Queries Suffices for Sample-Efficient RL with Resets and Linear Value Approximation
papers.authors: Philip Amortila, Nan Jiang, Dhruv Madeka, Dean Foster
papers.title_zh: 少量专家Query,用于带有Resets和线性值近似值的样本有效RL

papers.title: VDSM: Unsupervised Video Disentanglement With State-Space Modeling and Deep Mixtures of Experts
papers.authors: Matthew J. Vowels, Necati Cihan Camgoz, Richard Bowden
papers.abstract: Disentangled representations support a range of downstream tasks including causal reasoning, generative modeling, and fair machine learning. Unfortunately, disentanglement has been shown to be impossible without the incorporation of supervision or inductive bias. Given that supervision is often expensive or infeasible to acquire, we choose to incorporate structural inductive bias and present an unsupervised, deep State-Space-Model for Video Disentanglement (VDSM). The model disentangles latent time-varying and dynamic factors via the incorporation of hierarchical structure with a dynamic prior and a Mixture of Experts decoder. VDSM learns separate disentangled representations for the identity of the object or person in the video, and for the action being performed. We evaluate VDSM across a range of qualitative and quantitative tasks including identity and dynamics transfer, sequence generation, Frechet Inception Distance, and factor classification. VDSM achieves state-of-the-art performance and exceeds adversarial methods, even when the methods use additional supervision.
papers.title_zh: VDSM:不受监督的录像与国家空间建模和深层专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 分解的表述支持一系列下游任务,包括因果推理、基因模型和公平机器学习。 不幸的是,如果不纳入监督或情感偏见,分解已经证明是不可能的。 鉴于监督往往费用昂贵或难以获得,我们选择纳入结构性的感性偏见,并提供一个不受监督的深层国家空间-视频分离模式(VDSM)。 该模型通过将等级结构与前动态和专家解码器混合体相结合,分解了潜在的时间变化和动态因素。 VDSM学会了视频中对象或人的身份和所采取行动的不同分解的表达方式。 我们从一系列质量和数量上评估VDSM任务,包括身份和动态传输、序列生成、Frechet Inpeption距离和要素分类。 VDSM达到最先进的性能并超过对抗性方法,即使方法使用额外的监督。

papers.title: Scaling Vision with Sparse Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Carlos Riquelme, Joan Puigcerver, Basil Mustafa, Maxim Neumann, Rodolphe Jenatton, André Susano Pinto, Daniel Keysers, Neil Houlsby
papers.abstract: Sparsely-gated Mixture of Experts networks (MoEs) have demonstrated excellent scalability in Natural Language Processing. In Computer Vision, however, almost all performant networks are "dense", that is, every input is processed by every parameter. We present a Vision MoE (V-MoE), a sparse version of the Vision Transformer, that is scalable and competitive with the largest dense networks. When applied to image recognition, V-MoE matches the performance of state-of-the-art networks, while requiring as little as half of the compute at inference time. Further, we propose an extension to the routing algorithm that can prioritize subsets of each input across the entire batch, leading to adaptive per-image compute. This allows V-MoE to trade-off performance and compute smoothly at test-time. Finally, we demonstrate the potential of V-MoE to scale vision models, and train a 15B parameter model that attains 90.35% on ImageNet.
papers.title_zh: 利用专家的松散混合体扩大视野
papers.abstract_zh: 分散化的专家网络混合(MoEs)在自然语言处理中表现出了极佳的伸缩性。 然而,在计算机视野中,几乎所有表现良好的网络都是“密集的 ” , 也就是说,每一个输入都由每个参数处理。 我们提出了一个视野变换器(V-MOE),这是视野变换器的稀疏版本,与最稠密的网络具有可扩展性和竞争力。 当应用到图像识别时,V-MOE与最先进的网络的性能相匹配,而计算推算时间则需要不到一半的计算时间。 此外,我们提议扩展路线算法,该算法可以在整个批次中优先排列每项输入的子集,从而导致适应性人均图像计算。 这使得V-MOE能够进行权衡,并在测试时进行顺利计算。 最后,我们展示V-MOE在规模化视觉模型方面的潜力,并培训15B参数模型,在图像网络上达到90.35%。

papers.title: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks
papers.authors: Xiaoxiao Long, Lingjie Liu, Wei Li, Christian Theobalt, Wenping Wang
papers.abstract: We present a novel method for multi-view depth estimation from a single video, which is a critical task in various applications, such as perception, reconstruction and robot navigation. Although previous learning-based methods have demonstrated compelling results, most works estimate depth maps of individual video frames independently, without taking into consideration the strong geometric and temporal coherence among the frames. Moreover, current state-of-the-art (SOTA) models mostly adopt a fully 3D convolution network for cost regularization and therefore require high computational cost, thus limiting their deployment in real-world applications. Our method achieves temporally coherent depth estimation results by using a novel Epipolar Spatio-Temporal (EST) transformer to explicitly associate geometric and temporal correlation with multiple estimated depth maps. Furthermore, to reduce the computational cost, inspired by recent Mixture-of-Experts models, we design a compact hybrid network consisting of a 2D context-aware network and a 3D matching network which learn 2D context information and 3D disparity cues separately. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves higher accuracy in depth estimation and significant speedup than the SOTA methods.
papers.title_zh: 利用Epippolar Spadio-时空网络多视深度估计
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个从一个视频中进行多视角深度估计的新方法,这是各种应用,如感知、重建和机器人导航中的一项关键任务。 虽然以往以学习为基础的方法已经显示出令人信服的结果,但大多数工程都独立地估计单个视频框架的深度地图,而没有考虑到各框架之间强有力的几何和时间一致性。 此外,目前最先进的模型大多采用完全3D变迁网络来规范成本,因此需要高的计算成本,从而限制了在现实应用中的应用。 我们的方法实现了时间上一致的深度估计结果,方法是使用一个新型的Epipolar Spatio-Temporal(EST)变压器,将几何和时间相关性与多个估计深度地图明确联系起来。 此外,为了降低计算成本,在近期专家混合模型的启发下,我们设计了一个由2D背景意识网络和3D匹配网络组成的小型混合网络,分别学习2D背景信息和3D差异提示。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在深度估计和大幅度加快方面比SOTA方法更准确。

papers.title: MiCE: Mixture of Contrastive Experts for Unsupervised Image Clustering
papers.authors: Tsung Wei Tsai, Chongxuan Li, Jun Zhu
papers.abstract: We present Mixture of Contrastive Experts (MiCE), a unified probabilistic clustering framework that simultaneously exploits the discriminative representations learned by contrastive learning and the semantic structures captured by a latent mixture model. Motivated by the mixture of experts, MiCE employs a gating function to partition an unlabeled dataset into subsets according to the latent semantics and multiple experts to discriminate distinct subsets of instances assigned to them in a contrastive learning manner. To solve the nontrivial inference and learning problems caused by the latent variables, we further develop a scalable variant of the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm for MiCE and provide proof of the convergence. Empirically, we evaluate the clustering performance of MiCE on four widely adopted natural image datasets. MiCE achieves significantly better results than various previous methods and a strong contrastive learning baseline.
papers.title_zh: MICE: 未经监督的图像集成反竞争专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了竞争专家混合(MICE),这是一个统一的概率分组框架,同时利用通过对比性学习和潜在混合模式所捕捉的语义结构所学会的歧视性表述。 在专家混合的推动下,MICE使用一种格子功能,根据潜在的语义学和多位专家,将未贴标签的数据集分成子集,以反常的学习方式区别对待分配给他们的不同子集。 为了解决潜在变数造成的非技术性推论和学习问题,我们进一步开发了 MiCE预期-最大化算法的可缩放变方,并提供了趋同的证据。 我们经常评估MICE在四套广泛采用的自然图像数据集上的组合表现。 MICE取得了比以往各种方法更好的显著成果,并且具有鲜明的对比性学习基线。

papers.title: Improving Video-Text Retrieval by Multi-Stream Corpus Alignment and Dual Softmax Loss
papers.authors: Xing Cheng, Hezheng Lin, Xiangyu Wu, Fan Yang, Dong Shen
papers.abstract: Employing large-scale pre-trained model CLIP to conduct video-text retrieval task (VTR) has become a new trend, which exceeds previous VTR methods. Though, due to the heterogeneity of structures and contents between video and text, previous CLIP-based models are prone to overfitting in the training phase, resulting in relatively poor retrieval performance. In this paper, we propose a multi-stream Corpus Alignment network with single gate Mixture-of-Experts (CAMoE) and a novel Dual Softmax Loss (DSL) to solve the two heterogeneity. The CAMoE employs Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to extract multi-perspective video representations, including action, entity, scene, etc., then align them with the corresponding part of the text. In this stage, we conduct massive explorations towards the feature extraction module and feature alignment module. DSL is proposed to avoid the one-way optimum-match which occurs in previous contrastive methods. Introducing the intrinsic prior of each pair in a batch, DSL serves as a reviser to correct the similarity matrix and achieves the dual optimal match. DSL is easy to implement with only one-line code but improves significantly. The results show that the proposed CAMoE and DSL are of strong efficiency, and each of them is capable of achieving State-of-The-Art (SOTA) individually on various benchmarks such as MSR-VTT, MSVD, and LSMDC. Further, with both of them, the performance is advanced to a big extend, surpassing the previous SOTA methods for around 4.6 % R@1 in MSR-VTT.
papers.title_zh: 通过多层平流 Corpus 对齐和双软体损失改进视频文本检索率
papers.abstract_zh: 采用大规模预先培训的CLIP模型进行视频文本检索任务已成为新趋势,超过了以往的VTR方法。 虽然由于视频和文本的结构和内容不一,以前基于CLIP的模型在培训阶段容易过于适合,导致检索性能较差。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个多流Corpus Confilation网络,配有单一门型专家混合体(CAMOE)和一个新颖的双软体损失(DSL),以解决两种差异性。 CAMOE使用专家混合(MOE)提取多视角视频演示,包括动作、实体、场景等,然后将其与文本的相应部分相匹配。 在现阶段,我们大规模探索特征提取模块和特征校正模块。 提议 DSL 是为了避免以往对比性方法中出现的单向最佳匹配。 在分批引入每对对的内在前端, DSL 充当审校,以纠正相似性矩阵并实现双向最佳匹配。 DSL容易实施,只有一行代码,但有显著改进。 结果表明,拟议的CAMoE和DSL具有很强的效率,每一个都能够根据诸如MSR-VTT、MSVD和LSMDC等各种基准分别实现艺术状态(SOTA ) 。 此外,由于两者,其性能都大大扩展,在MSR-VTT中超过以前SOTA方法4.6%左右的R@1。

papers.title: Generalizable Person Re-Identification With Relevance-Aware Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Yongxing Dai, Xiaotong Li, Jun Liu, Zekun Tong, Ling-Yu Duan
papers.abstract: Domain generalizable (DG) person re-identification (ReID) is a challenging problem because we cannot access any unseen target domain data during training. Almost all the existing DG ReID methods follow the same pipeline where they use a hybrid dataset from multiple source domains for training, and then directly apply the trained model to the unseen target domains for testing. These methods often neglect individual source domains' discriminative characteristics and their relevances w.r.t. the unseen target domains, though both of which can be leveraged to help the model's generalization. To handle the above two issues, we propose a novel method called the relevance-aware mixture of experts (RaMoE), using an effective voting-based mixture mechanism to dynamically leverage source domains' diverse characteristics to improve the model's generalization. Specifically, we propose a decorrelation loss to make the source domain networks (experts) keep the diversity and discriminability of individual domains' characteristics. Besides, we design a voting network to adaptively integrate all the experts' features into the more generalizable aggregated features with domain relevance. Considering the target domains' invisibility during training, we propose a novel learning-to-learn algorithm combined with our relation alignment loss to update the voting network. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed RaMoE outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 与相关性软件专家混合相结合的可实现普遍人重新确定身份
papers.abstract_zh: 通用域(DG)人员重新识别(ReID)是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为我们在培训期间无法获得任何看不见的目标域数据。 几乎所有现有的DGReID方法都遵循同样的管道,它们使用来自多个来源领域的混合数据集进行培训,然后直接将经过培训的模式应用于无形的目标领域进行测试。 这些方法往往忽视了单个源域的歧视性特点及其关联性,忽略了看不见的目标领域,尽管这两个领域都可以用来帮助模型的概括化。 为了处理上述两个问题,我们提议采用一种新颖的方法,称为相关意识的专家混合(RaMoE),利用有效的投票混合机制,动态地利用源域的各种特点,改进模式的概括性。 具体地说,我们提议进行一项相关的设计损失,使源域网(专家)保持个别域特性的多样性和差异性。 此外,我们设计了一个投票网络,以便适应性地将专家的所有特点纳入具有领域相关性的更普遍的综合特点中。 考虑到目标领域在培训期间的隐形性,我们建议采用一种新的学习到学习的算法,加上我们的关系调整损失,以更新投票网络。 广泛的实验表明,我们提议的拉莫埃(RamoE)比最先进的方法表现得更好。

papers.title: Few-Shot and Continual Learning With Attentive Independent Mechanisms
papers.authors: Eugene Lee, Cheng-Han Huang, Chen-Yi Lee
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are known to perform well when deployed to test distributions that shares high similarity with the training distribution. Feeding DNNs with new data sequentially that were unseen in the training distribution has two major challenges --- fast adaptation to new tasks and catastrophic forgetting of old tasks. Such difficulties paved way for the on-going research on few-shot learning and continual learning. To tackle these problems, we introduce Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM). We incorporate the idea of learning using fast and slow weights in conjunction with the decoupling of the feature extraction and higher-order conceptual learning of a DNN. AIM is designed for higher-order conceptual learning, modeled by a mixture of experts that compete to learn independent concepts to solve a new task. AIM is a modular component that can be inserted into existing deep learning frameworks. We demonstrate its capability for few-shot learning by adding it to SIB and trained on MiniImageNet and CIFAR-FS, showing significant improvement. AIM is also applied to ANML and OML trained on Omniglot, CIFAR-100 and MiniImageNet to demonstrate its capability in continual learning.
papers.title_zh: 与独立机制一起开展很少热和持续学习
papers.abstract_zh: 深神经网络(DNNs)在部署测试与培训分布高度相似的分布时表现良好。 以培训分配过程中未见的新数据按顺序向 DNN 提供新的数据有两大挑战 -- -- 即快速适应新任务和灾难性地忘记旧任务。这些困难为正在进行的关于少见的学习和持续学习的研究铺平了道路。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了 " 注意独立机制 " (AIM),结合DNN的特征提取和高阶概念学习解耦,纳入使用快速和慢速权重学习的概念。 AIM是为更高层次的概念学习设计的,由各种专家组成,他们竞相学习独立的概念,以解决新的任务,AIM是一个模块部分,可以插入现有的深层次学习框架。 我们通过将其添加到SIB并在MiniimageNet和CIFAR-FS上接受培训,展示出显著的改进,展示出它进行微小学习的能力,AIM还适用于在Omniglot、CIFAR-100和MiniimageNet上接受过Omniglot、CIFAR-100和OML培训的ANML和OML,以展示其不断学习的能力。

papers.title: DSelect-k: Differentiable Selection in the Mixture of Experts with Applications to Multi-Task Learning
papers.authors: Hussein Hazimeh, Zhe Zhao, Aakanksha Chowdhery, Maheswaran Sathiamoorthy, Yihua Chen, Rahul Mazumder, Lichan Hong, Ed Chi
papers.title_zh: Dselect-k:在应用多任务学习的专家混合组合中选择不同选择

papers.title: ZFlow: Gated Appearance Flow-Based Virtual Try-On With 3D Priors
papers.authors: Ayush Chopra, Rishabh Jain, Mayur Hemani, Balaji Krishnamurthy
papers.abstract: Image-based virtual try-on involves synthesizing perceptually convincing images of a model wearing a particular garment and has garnered significant research interest due to its immense practical applicability. Recent methods involve a two-stage process: i) warping of the garment to align with the model ii) texture fusion of the warped garment and target model to generate the try-on output. Issues arise due to the non-rigid nature of garments and the lack of geometric information about the model or the garment. It often results in improper rendering of granular details. We propose ZFlow, an end-to-end framework, which seeks to alleviate these concerns regarding geometric and textural integrity (such as pose, depth-ordering, skin and neckline reproduction) through a combination of gated aggregation of hierarchical flow estimates termed Gated Appearance Flow, and dense structural priors at various stage of the network. ZFlow achieves state-of-the-art results as observed qualitatively, and on benchmark image quality measures (PSNR, SSIM, and FID scores). The paper also presents extensive comparisons with existing state-of-the-art including a detailed user study and ablation studies to gauge the effectiveness of each of our contributions on multiple datasets
papers.title_zh: ZFlow: Gated 外观流动虚拟试镜,与 3D 前科
papers.abstract_zh: 以图像为基础的虚拟试演涉及综合一个穿着特定服装的模型的感知力令人信服的图像,并因其巨大的实用性而引起了重要的研究兴趣。 最近的方法涉及一个两阶段的过程:(一) 失真服装以便与模型一致;(二) 失真服装的纹理融合和产生试制输出的目标模型,由于服装的非硬性以及缺乏关于模型或服装的几何信息,产生了问题。 这往往导致颗粒细节的不正确表述。 我们提出ZFlow,这是一个端对端框架,力求通过将称为Gate外观流动的等级流量估计加起来,结合网络各个阶段的密集结构前科,设法减轻对几何和轮廓完整性(例如姿势、深度排序、皮肤和颈部生殖)的关切。 ZFlow在质量和基准图像质量衡量(PSNR、SSIM和FID评分)上取得了最先进的观测结果。 本文还介绍了与现有最新技术的广泛比较,包括详细的用户研究和通货膨胀研究,以衡量我们为多个数据集所作的每项贡献的有效性。

papers.title: Your "Flamingo" is My "Bird": Fine-Grained, or Not
papers.authors: Dongliang Chang, Kaiyue Pang, Yixiao Zheng, Zhanyu Ma, Yi-Zhe Song, Jun Guo
papers.abstract: Whether what you see in Figure 1 is a "flamingo" or a "bird", is the question we ask in this paper. While fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) strives to arrive at the former, for the majority of us non-experts just "bird" would probably suffice. The real question is therefore -- how can we tailor for different fine-grained definitions under divergent levels of expertise. For that, we re-envisage the traditional setting of FGVC, from single-label classification, to that of top-down traversal of a pre-defined coarse-to-fine label hierarchy -- so that our answer becomes "bird"="Phoenicopteriformes"="Phoenicopteridae"="flamingo". To approach this new problem, we first conduct a comprehensive human study where we confirm that most participants prefer multi-granularity labels, regardless whether they consider themselves experts. We then discover the key intuition that: coarse-level label prediction exacerbates fine-grained feature learning, yet fine-level feature betters the learning of coarse-level classifier. This discovery enables us to design a very simple albeit surprisingly effective solution to our new problem, where we (i) leverage level-specific classification heads to disentangle coarse-level features with fine-grained ones, and (ii) allow finer-grained features to participate in coarser-grained label predictions, which in turn helps with better disentanglement. Experiments show that our method achieves superior performance in the new FGVC setting, and performs better than state-of-the-art on traditional single-label FGVC problem as well. Thanks to its simplicity, our method can be easily implemented on top of any existing FGVC frameworks and is parameter-free. Codes are available at: https://github.com/PRIS-CV/Fine-Grained-or-Not
papers.title_zh: 你的"Flamingo"就是我的"鸟":
papers.abstract_zh: 在图1中,你所看到的是“flamingo”还是“bird ” , 是我们在本文中提出的问题。 尽管精细的视觉分类(FGVC)努力达到前者,但我们大多数非专家只是“bird ” ( bird)可能就足够了。 因此,真正的问题是 -- -- 我们如何在不同的专业知识水平下适应不同的精细定义。 为此,我们重新设计了FGVC的传统设置,从单一标签分类,到预先定义的粗到软标签等级的自上而下的自上而下跨行, 这样我们的答案就变成了“鸟”=“观光软件”=“观光软件”=“Flamingo”。 面对这一新问题,我们首先进行一项全面的人类研究,确认大多数参与者更喜欢多岛屿标签,而不管他们是否认为自己是专家。 然后我们发现关键直觉:粗劣的标签预测会加剧精细的特征学习, 而精细的特征则会让粗糙的分类师学习得更好。 这一发现使我们能够设计出一个非常简单但出乎意料的有效办法来解决我们的新问题,即我们(一) 利用特定等级的分类头来解开粗粗的特征,用细粗的分类头;(二) 允许细细的特征参与粗粗的标签预测,这反过来有助于更好地分解。 实验表明,我们的方法在新的FGVC环境中取得了优异的性能,并且也比传统单一标签FGVC问题的最新水平表现更好。 由于其简单化,我们的方法可以很容易地在任何现有的FGVC框架之上实施,并且没有参数。 代码可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/PRIS-CV/Fine-Grained-or-Not。

papers.title: Where Are You Heading? Dynamic Trajectory Prediction With Expert Goal Examples
papers.authors: He Zhao, Richard P. Wildes
papers.abstract: Goal-conditioned approaches recently have been found very useful to human trajectory prediction, when adequate goal estimates are provided. Yet, goal inference is difficult in itself and often incurs extra learning efforts. We propose to predict pedestrian trajectories via the guidance of goal expertise, which can be obtained with modest expense through a novel goal-search mechanism on already seen training examples. There are three key contributions in our study. First, we devise a framework that exploits the nearest examples for high-quality goal position inquiry. This approach naturally considers multi-modality, physical constraints, compatibility with existing methods and is model-free; it therefore does not require additional learning efforts typical in goal inference. Second, we present an end-to-end trajectory predictor that can efficiently associate goal retrievals to past motion information and dynamically infer possible future trajectories. Third, with these two novel techniques in hand, we conduct a series of experiments on two broadly explored datasets (SDD and ETH/UCY) and show that our approach surpasses previous state-of-the-art performance by notable margins and reduces the need for additional parameters.
papers.title_zh: 动态轨迹预测与专家目标实例
papers.abstract_zh: 最近发现,在充分提供目标估计数时,以目标为条件的方法对于人类轨迹预测非常有用,然而,目标推论本身很困难,而且往往需要额外的学习努力。 我们提出通过指导目标专门知识预测行人轨迹,通过对已经看到的培训实例进行新的目标搜索机制,可以以少量费用获得这种轨迹。 我们的研究有三个关键贡献。 首先,我们设计一个框架,利用最近的高质量目标定位调查实例。 这种方法自然考虑到多种模式、物理限制、与现有方法的兼容性,并且没有模式;因此,不需要在目标推论中典型的额外学习努力。 第二,我们提出了一个端对端轨道预测器,能够有效地将目标检索与过去运动信息联系起来,并动态地推断出未来可能的轨迹。 第三,在掌握了这两种新技术后,我们对两个广泛探索的数据集(二元和二元/二元)进行了一系列试验,并表明我们的方法比以往的先进性能高出显著的边际,减少了对额外参数的需要。

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification via Heterogeneous Expert Collaborative Consistency Learning
papers.authors: Yafei Zhang · Lingqi Kong · Huafeng Li · Jie Wen
papers.abstract: To reduce the reliance of visible-infrared person re-identification (ReID) models on labeled cross-modal samples, this paper explores a weakly supervised cross-modal person ReID method that uses only single-modal sample identity labels, addressing scenarios where cross-modal identity labels are unavailable. To mitigate the impact of missing cross-modal labels on model performance, we propose a heterogeneous expert collaborative consistency learning framework, designed to establish robust cross-modal identity correspondences in a weakly supervised manner. This framework leverages labeled data from each modality to independently train dedicated classification experts. To associate cross-modal samples, these classification experts act as heterogeneous predictors, predicting the identities of samples from the other modality. To improve prediction accuracy, we design a cross-modal relationship fusion mechanism that effectively integrates predictions from different experts. Under the implicit supervision provided by cross-modal identity correspondences, collaborative and consistent learning among the experts is encouraged, significantly enhancing the model’s ability to extract modality-invariant features and improve cross-modal identity recognition. Experimental results on two challenging datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.title_zh: 通过异质专家协作一致性学习,对可见-红外线人员通过异质专家协作一致学习重新确定身份
papers.abstract_zh: 为减少隐性红外线人员重新识别(ReID)模型对标签的跨模式样本的依赖,本文探讨了一种监管薄弱的跨模式人员重新识别方法,这种方法仅使用单一模式样本身份标签,处理无法提供跨模式身份标签的情形。 为了减轻缺失的跨模式标签对模型性能的影响,我们提议建立一个多样化的专家协作一致性学习框架,目的是以监督不力的方式建立强有力的跨模式身份通信。 该框架利用每种模式的贴标签数据独立培训专门的分类专家,这些分类专家将跨模式样本联系起来,充当多种预测者,从另一种模式预测样本的身份。 为了提高预测的准确性,我们设计了一个跨模式关系融合机制,有效地综合不同专家的预测。 在跨模式身份通信提供的隐含监督之下,鼓励专家相互协作和一致学习,大大提高了模型提取模式变化特征和改善跨模式身份识别的能力。 两个具有挑战性的数据集的实验结果验证了拟议方法的有效性。

papers.title: Unsupervised 3D Pose Estimation for Hierarchical Dance Video Recognition
papers.authors: Xiaodan Hu, Narendra Ahuja
papers.abstract: Dance experts often view dance as a hierarchy of information, spanning low-level (raw images, image sequences), mid-levels (human poses and bodypart movements), and high-level (dance genre). We propose a Hierarchical Dance Video Recognition framework (HDVR). HDVR estimates 2D pose sequences, tracks dancers, and then simultaneously estimates corresponding 3D poses and 3D-to-2D imaging parameters, without requiring ground truth for 3D poses. Unlike most methods that work on a single person, our tracking works on multiple dancers, under occlusions. From the estimated 3D pose sequence, HDVR extracts body part movements, and therefrom dance genre. The resulting hierarchical dance representation is explainable to experts. To overcome noise and interframe correspondence ambiguities, we enforce spatial and temporal motion smoothness and photometric continuity over time. We use an LSTM network to extract 3D movement subsequences from which we recognize dance genre. For experiments, we have identified 154 movement types, of 16 body parts, and assembled a new University of Illinois Dance (UID) Dataset, containing 1143 video clips of 9 genres covering 30 hours, annotated with movement and genre labels. Our experimental results demonstrate that our algorithms outperform the state-of-the-art 3D pose estimation methods, which also enhances our dance recognition performance.
papers.title_zh: 无人监督的 3D 立体舞蹈舞蹈视频识别的 3D Pose Pose 估计
papers.abstract_zh: 舞蹈专家通常将舞蹈视为信息等级,其范围包括低层次(原始图像、图像序列)、中级(人造和身体运动)和高级(舞蹈流派 ) 。 我们提议建立一个等级式舞蹈视频识别框架(HDVR ) 。 HDVR估计 2D 构成序列, 轨道舞者, 然后同时估算相应的 3D 姿势和 3D 到 2D 成像参数, 而不需要 3D 构成的地面真实性。 与大多数针对一个人的工作方法不同, 我们的跟踪工作是针对多个舞者, 排斥性不足 。 从估计的 3D 构成序列中, HDVR 提取身体部分运动,然后从舞蹈流派中产生。 由此产生的等级舞蹈代表可以向专家解释。 为了克服噪音和跨框架通信的模糊性,我们实施时空运动的平稳和光度测量连续性,我们使用LSTM网络提取3D运动后继序列,我们从中识别舞蹈流。 在实验中,我们确定了154种运动类型,共16个身体部分,并组装了一个新的伊利诺伊大学舞蹈数据集,其中包括1 143个视频剪辑,9种类型,为期30小时,附有运动和种类标签。 我们的实验结果显示 我们的算法 超过了最先进的 3D 构成估计方法, 这也提高了我们的舞蹈识别性能。

papers.title: Triple-Cooperative Video Shadow Detection
papers.authors: Zhihao Chen, Liang Wan, Lei Zhu, Jia Shen, Huazhu Fu, Wennan Liu, Jing Qin
papers.abstract: Shadow detection in single image has received signifi-cant research interests in recent years. However, much lessworks has been explored in shadow detection over dynamicscenes. The bottleneck is the lack of a well-establisheddataset with high-quality annotations for video shadow de-tection. In this work, we collect a new video shadow detec-tion dataset (ViSha), which contains120videos with11,685frames, covering 60 object categories, varying lengths, anddifferent motion/lighting conditions. All the frames are an-notated with a high-quality pixel-level shadow mask. Tothe best of our knowledge, this is the first learning-orienteddataset for video shadow detection. Furthermore, we de-velop a new baseline model, named triple-cooperative videoshadow detection network (TVSD-Net). It utilizes tripleparallel networks in a cooperative manner to learn discrim-inative representations at intra-video and inter-video lev-els. Within the network, a dual gated co-attention moduleis proposed to constrain features from neighboring framesin the same video, while an auxiliary similarity loss is in-troduced to mine semantic information between differentvideos. Finally, we conduct a comprehensive study on ViShadataset, systematically evaluating 10 state-of-the-art mod-els (including single image shadow detectors, video ob-ject and saliency detection methods). Experimental resultsdemonstrate that our model outperforms SOTA competitors.
papers.title_zh: 三组合作视频影影探测
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,单一图像中的暗影探测得到了信号化扫描研究兴趣,但是,在动态探测的影子探测中,探索的作品要少得多。 瓶颈在于缺乏一套完善的数据集,其中含有高品质的视频阴影脱色说明。 在这项工作中,我们收集了一个新的视频影视分解数据集(ViSha),其中包含120个视频,有11 685个框架,涵盖60个对象类别、不同长度和不同运动/照明条件。所有框架都配有高质量的像素水平的影子面具。 从我们所知,这是第一个以学习为导向的视频影子探测数据集。 此外,我们还开发了一个新的基线模型,名为三重合作视频阴影探测网络(TVSD-Net ) 。 它以合作方式利用三边平行网络,学习在视频内和视频间路面上进行辩驳。 在网络内部,一个双门共同注意模块提议限制同一视频中相邻框架的特征,同时对不同视频之间的矿藏语义信息造成辅助相似性损失。 最后,我们对ViShadataset进行一项全面研究,系统评估10个最先进的模型(包括单一图像影子探测器、视频反弹和突出检测方法 ) 。 实验结果证明我们的模型优于SOTA竞争对手。

papers.title: TRAR: Routing the Attention Spans in Transformer for Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Yiyi Zhou, Tianhe Ren, Chaoyang Zhu, Xiaoshuai Sun, Jianzhuang Liu, Xinghao Ding, Mingliang Xu, Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract: Due to the superior ability of global dependency modeling, Transformer and its variants have become the primary choice of many vision-and-language tasks. However, in tasks like Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Referring Expression Comprehension (REC), the multimodal prediction often requires visual information from macro- to micro-views. Therefore, how to dynamically schedule the global and local dependency modeling in Transformer has become an emerging issue. In this paper, we propose an example-dependent routing scheme called TRAnsformer Routing (TRAR) to address this issue. Specifically, in TRAR, each visual Transformer layer is equipped with a routing module with different attention spans. The model can dynamically select the corresponding attentions based on the output of the previous inference step, so as to formulate the optimal routing path for each example. Notably, with careful designs, TRAR can reduce the additional computation and memory overhead to almost negligible. To validate TRAR, we conduct extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets of VQA and REC, and achieve superior performance gains than the standard Transformers and a bunch of state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: TRAR:在变换器中运行注意力spans 用于视觉问答
papers.abstract_zh: 由于全球依赖型模型的优越能力,变形器及其变体已成为许多视觉和语言任务的主要选择。 然而,在视觉问题解答(VQA)和表达理解(REC)等任务中,多式联运预测往往需要从宏观到微观的视觉信息。 因此,如何动态地安排变形器中全球和本地依赖型建模已成为一个新问题。 在本文中,我们提出了一种以实例为依托的路线计划 — — 称为TRAR(TRAR)来解决这一问题。 具体来说,在TRAR中,每个视觉变形器层都配备了一条路线模块,关注范围不同。 模型可以根据上一个推论步骤的输出动态地选择相应的关注点,以便为每个例子制定最佳路径。 值得注意的是,如果设计周密,TRAR可以将额外的计算和内存间接费用降低到几乎可忽略不计。 为了验证TRAR,我们对VQA和REC的五个基准数据集进行了广泛的试验,并取得了优于标准变换器和一系列最先进的方法的业绩收益。

papers.title: Trajectory Prediction With Latent Belief Energy-Based Model
papers.authors: Bo Pang, Tianyang Zhao, Xu Xie, Ying Nian Wu
papers.abstract: Human trajectory prediction is critical for autonomous platforms like self-driving cars or social robots. We present a latent belief energy-based model (LB-EBM) for diverse human trajectory forecast. LB-EBM is a probabilistic model with cost function defined in the latent space to account for the movement history and social context. The low-dimensionality of the latent space and the high expressivity of the EBM make it easy for the model to capture the multimodality of pedestrian trajectory distributions. LB-EBM is learned from expert demonstrations (i.e., human trajectories) projected into the latent space. Sampling from or optimizing the learned LB-EBM yields a belief vector which is used to make a path plan, which then in turn helps to predict a long-range trajectory. The effectiveness of LB-EBM and the two-step approach are supported by strong empirical results. Our model is able to make accurate, multi-modal, and social compliant trajectory predictions and improves over prior state-of-the-arts performance on the Stanford Drone trajectory prediction benchmark by 10.9% and on the ETH-UCY benchmark by 27.6%.
papers.title_zh: 利用以内在信念为基础的以能源为基础的模型的轨迹预测
papers.abstract_zh: 人类轨迹预测对于自驾汽车或社交机器人等自主平台至关重要。 我们为人类轨迹预测提供了一种基于潜在信仰的能源模型(LB-EBM ) 。 LB-EBM是一种概率模型,其成本功能在潜在空间中界定,以说明运动历史和社会背景,潜在空间的低维度和EBM的高度直观性使得该模型易于捕捉行人轨道分布的多式。 LB-EBM是从射入潜在空间的专家演示(即人类轨迹)中学习的。从所学的LB-EBM中取样或优化生成一个用于制定路径规划的信仰矢量,这反过来又有助于预测远程轨迹。 LB-EBM和分两步走办法的有效性得到了强有力的实证结果的支持。 我们的模型能够作出准确、多模式和符合社会要求的轨迹预测,并比以前斯坦福无人机轨道预测基准的先进性能提高10.9%,比埃克西山基准的先进性能提高27.6%。

papers.title: Towards Effective Foundation Model Adaptation for Extreme Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Fei Zhou · Peng Wang · Lei Zhang · Wei Wei · Chen Ding · Guosheng Lin · Yanning Zhang
papers.abstract: Large-scale pre-trained foundation models have demonstrated remarkable generalization capabilities across diverse computer vision tasks through fine-tuning. However, existing fine-tuning approaches often encounter challenges in extreme cross-domain few-shot learning scenarios, primarily due to the significant domain shift between pre-training data and target tasks, as well as the scarcity of annotated target samples. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel absorption adaptation learning framework which meticulously regularizes the fine-tuning procedure of foundation model using an expert model with the same architecture but trained from scratch on the targeted data in two aspects. On one hand, we first design a masked cross-model unidirectional reconstruction scheme, which forces the foundation model to recover the intermediate feature of the expert model in a randomly masked manner. On the other hand, a decision graph association loss is developed to encourage the consistency of token similarity matrix between these two models. By doing these, the task-relevant semantic knowledge in the expert model from both intermediate feature and the final decision levels are appropriately extracted and absorbed by the foundation model during its fine-tuning, thus mitigating the performance drop caused by domain gap and limited annotation. Sufficient experiments with further observations and analyses underpin our observation and argument.
papers.title_zh: 走向有效的基金会基础模式,以适应极端跨域少热学习模式
papers.abstract_zh: 通过微调,大规模培训前基础模型在各种计算机视觉任务中表现出非凡的普及能力。 然而,现有的微调方法往往在极端的跨域、几眼不见的学习情景中遇到挑战,这主要是由于培训前数据和目标任务之间的重要领域转移,以及缺少附加说明的目标样本。 为缓解这一问题,我们提议建立一个新的吸收适应学习框架,对基础模型的微调程序进行严格规范,采用同一结构的专家模型,但从零到零地就目标数据在两个方面进行了培训。 一方面,我们首先设计了一个蒙面的跨模范单向重建计划,它迫使基础模型以随机蒙面的方式恢复专家模型的中间特征。 另一方面,为鼓励这两种模式之间象征性相似性矩阵的一致性,制定了一个决定图表关联损失。 通过这样做,从中间特征和最后决定级别上得出的专家模型中与任务相关的语义知识在基础模型进行微调时被适当提取和吸收,从而减轻域差和注释有限造成的性能下降。 进行充分实验,进一步观察和分析,作为我们观察和论点的基础。

papers.title: Temporal Cue Guided Video Highlight Detection With Low-Rank Audio-Visual Fusion
papers.authors: Qinghao Ye, Xiyue Shen, Yuan Gao, Zirui Wang, Qi Bi, Ping Li, Guang Yang
papers.abstract: Video highlight detection plays an increasingly important role in social media content filtering, however, it remains highly challenging to develop automated video highlight detection methods because of the lack of temporal annotations (i.e., where the highlight moments are in long videos) for supervised learning. In this paper, we propose a novel weakly supervised method that can learn to detect highlights by mining video characteristics with video level annotations (topic tags) only. Particularly, we exploit audio-visual features to enhance video representation and take temporal cues into account for improving detection performance. Our contributions are threefold: 1) we propose an audio-visual tensor fusion mechanism that efficiently models the complex association between two modalities while reducing the gap of the heterogeneity between the two modalities; 2) we introduce a novel hierarchical temporal context encoder to embed local temporal clues in between neighboring segments; 3) finally, we alleviate the gradient vanishing problem theoretically during model optimization with attention-gated instance aggregation. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets (YouTube Highlights and TVSum) have demonstrated our method outperforms other state-of-the-art methods with remarkable improvements.
papers.title_zh: 低 Rank 音频-视觉融合低射速探测时光导导视频高亮光探测
papers.abstract_zh: 视频亮点检测在社交媒体内容过滤中发挥着越来越重要的作用,然而,开发自动视频亮点检测方法仍极具挑战性,因为缺乏用于监督学习的时间说明(即重要时刻在长视频中)。 在本文中,我们建议采用一种新颖的、监督不力的方法,通过采矿视频特征来探测亮点,只有视频层面的注释(专题标签)才能发现亮点。 特别是,我们利用视听功能来提高视频代表性,并在提高探测性能时考虑到时间提示。 我们的贡献有三重:(1) 我们建议建立一个视听多发融合机制,有效地模拟两种模式之间的复杂联系,同时缩小两种模式之间的差异;(2) 我们引入一个新的等级时间背景编码器,将当地时间线索嵌入相邻段之间;(3) 最后,我们在模型优化过程中从理论上缓解梯度消失的问题,同时将注意力集中到实例汇总中。 在两个基准数据集(YouTube高亮光和TVSum)上进行的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比其他最先进的方法要好,取得了显著的改进。

papers.title: Task Programming: Learning Data Efficient Behavior Representations
papers.authors: Jennifer J. Sun, Ann Kennedy, Eric Zhan, David J. Anderson, Yisong Yue, Pietro Perona
papers.abstract: Specialized domain knowledge is often necessary to accurately annotate training sets for in-depth analysis, but can be burdensome and time-consuming to acquire from domain experts. This issue arises prominently in automated behavior analysis, in which agent movements or actions of interest are detected from video tracking data. To reduce annotation effort, we present TREBA: a method to learn annotation-sample efficient trajectory embedding for behavior analysis, based on multi-task self-supervised learning. The tasks in our method can be efficiently engineered by domain experts through a process we call "task programming", which uses programs to explicitly encode structured knowledge from domain experts. Total domain expert effort can be reduced by exchanging data annotation time for the construction of a small number of programmed tasks. We evaluate this trade-off using data from behavioral neuroscience, in which specialized domain knowledge is used to identify behaviors. We present experimental results in three datasets across two domains: mice and fruit flies. Using embeddings from TREBA, we reduce annotation burden by up to a factor of 10 without compromising accuracy compared to state-of-the-art features. Our results thus suggest that task programming and self-supervision can be an effective way to reduce annotation effort for domain experts.
papers.title_zh: 任务方案拟订:学习数据高效行为代表
papers.abstract_zh: 专门领域知识对于准确说明用于深入分析的成套培训往往十分必要,但从领域专家那里获取可能既麻烦又费时。 这一问题在自动行为分析中突出出现,在自动行为分析中,从视频跟踪数据中检测到有关物剂的移动或行动。 为了减少批注努力,我们介绍了TREBA:一种根据多任务自我监督的学习,学习批注和模拟有效轨迹的方法,用于行为分析。 我们的方法中的任务可以通过一个我们称之为“任务规划”的过程,由域专家通过一个我们称之为“任务规划”的过程来有效地规划。 这个过程利用程序将来自域专家的结构化知识明确编码。 可以通过交换数据说明时间来完成为数不多的计划任务来减少总领域专家的努力。 我们利用行为神经科学的数据来评估这一权衡,其中利用专业领域知识来识别行为。 我们展示了三个领域(小鼠和果蝇)的实验结果:小鼠和果蝇。利用TRABA的嵌入,我们将批注负担降低到10倍,而不会影响准确性,而不会影响最新特征。 因此,我们的结果表明,任务方案编制和自我监督可以成为减少域专家说明努力的有效途径。

papers.title: STR-GQN: Scene Representation and Rendering for Unknown Cameras Based on Spatial Transformation Routing
papers.authors: Wen-Cheng Chen, Min-Chun Hu, Chu-Song Chen
papers.abstract: Geometry-aware modules are widely applied in recent deep learning architectures for scene representation and rendering. However, these modules require intrinsic camera information that might not be obtained accurately. In this paper, we propose a Spatial Transformation Routing (STR) mechanism to model the spatial properties without applying any geometric prior. The STR mechanism treats the spatial transformation as the message passing process, and the relation between the view poses and the routing weights is modeled by an end-to-end trainable neural network. Besides, an Occupancy Concept Mapping (OCM) framework is proposed to provide explainable rationals for scene-fusion processes. We conducted experiments on several datasets and show that the proposed STR mechanism improves the performance of the Generative Query Network (GQN). The visualization results reveal that the routing process can pass the observed information from one location of some view to the associated location in the other view, which demonstrates the advantage of the proposed model in terms of spatial cognition.
papers.title_zh: STR-GQN:基于空间变换运行的未知相机的场景展示和显示
papers.abstract_zh: 在最近的深层学习结构中广泛应用了几何感知模块,用于现场展示和制作,但是这些模块需要内在的照相机信息,而这些信息可能无法准确获得。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个空间转换路由机制,以模拟空间特性,而无需事先应用任何几何特征。 可疑交易报告机制将空间转换视为传递信息的过程,视象与路由权重之间的关系由端到端可训练神经网络模拟。 此外,还提议了一个占用概念绘图框架,以便为现场融合过程提供可解释的理性,我们在若干数据集上进行了实验,并表明拟议的可疑交易报告机制改善了生成Query网络的性能。 可视化结果显示,路由过程可将观测到的信息从某种观点的一个地点传递到另一种观点的相关地点,这表明拟议模式在空间认知方面的优势。

papers.title: STEM: An Approach to Multi-Source Domain Adaptation With Guarantees
papers.authors: Van-Anh Nguyen, Tuan Nguyen, Trung Le, Quan Hung Tran, Dinh Phung
papers.abstract: Multi-source Domain Adaptation (MSDA) is more practical but challenging than the conventional unsupervised domain adaptation due to the involvement of diverse multiple data sources. Two fundamental challenges of MSDA are: (i) how to deal with the diversity in the multiple source domains and (ii) how to cope with the data shift between the target domain and the source domains. In this paper, to address the first challenge, we propose a theoretical-guaranteed approach to combine domain experts locally trained on its own source domain to achieve a combined multi-source teacher that globally predicts well on the mixture of source domains. To address the second challenge, we propose to bridge the gap between the target domain and the mixture of source domains in the latent space via a generator or feature extractor. Together with bridging the gap in the latent space, we train a student to mimic the predictions of the teacher expert on both source and target examples. In addition, our approach is guaranteed with rigorous theory offered insightful justifications of how each component influences the transferring performance. Extensive experiments conducted on three benchmark datasets show that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performances to the best of our knowledge.
papers.title_zh: STEM: 有担保的多来源领域适应办法
papers.abstract_zh: 多源域适应(MSDA)比传统的不受监督的域适应(由于多种数据源的参与)更实际,但更具挑战性。 MSDA的两个基本挑战是:(一) 如何处理多种来源领域的多样性,(二) 如何处理目标领域与来源领域之间数据转移的问题。 在本文中,为了应对第一个挑战,我们建议采取一种理论保障的办法,将在当地接受过自身源域培训的域专家结合起来,以建立一个综合的多来源教师队伍,在全球对源域的混合情况作出良好的预测。 为了应对第二个挑战,我们提议通过生成器或特征提取器弥合目标领域与潜在空间源领域混合之间的差距。 在弥补潜在空间差距的同时,我们培训了一位学生模仿教师专家对源和目标实例的预测。 此外,严格的理论也保证了我们的方法,为每个组成部分如何影响转移性能提供了深刻的理由。 对三个基准数据集进行的广泛试验表明,我们拟议的方法能够以我们最丰富的知识取得最先进的业绩。

papers.title: SSH: A Self-Supervised Framework for Image Harmonization
papers.authors: Yifan Jiang, He Zhang, Jianming Zhang, Yilin Wang, Zhe Lin, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Simon Chen, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Sarah Kong, Zhangyang Wang
papers.abstract: Image harmonization aims to improve the quality of image compositing by matching the "appearance"" (e.g., color tone, brightness and contrast) between foreground and background images. However, collecting large-scale annotated datasets for this task requires complex professional retouching. Instead, we propose a novel Self-Supervised Harmonization framework (SSH) that can be trained using just "free"" natural images without being edited. We reformulate the image harmonization problem from a representation fusion perspective, which separately processes the foreground and background examples, to address the background occlusion issue. This framework design allows for a dual data augmentation method, where diverse [foreground, background, pseudo GT] triplets can be generated by cropping an image with perturbations using 3D color lookup tables (LUTs). In addition, we build a real-world harmonization dataset as carefully created by expert users, for evaluation and benchmarking purposes. Our results show that the proposed self-supervised method outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods in terms of reference metrics, visual quality, and subject user study. Code and dataset will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: SSH:图像统一自我监督框架
papers.abstract_zh: 图像统一的目的是通过匹配前景图像和背景图像之间的“亮度、亮度和对比度”来提高图像组合的质量。 然而,为此项任务收集大型附加说明的数据集需要复杂的专业调整。 相反,我们建议建立一个全新的自我监督统一框架(SSH), 无需编辑即可使用“免费”自然图像进行培训。 我们从代表聚合的角度重新界定图像统一问题,分别处理前景和背景实例,以解决背景排斥问题。 这一框架设计允许采用双重数据增强法,通过使用 3D 色调表(LUTs) 绘制图象,可产生各种[前景、背景、假GT]三重成形。 此外,我们建立了一个由专家用户为评估和基准设定目的仔细创建的、真实世界统一数据集。 我们的结果表明,拟议中的自监督方法在参考度量、视觉质量和主题用户研究方面优于以往最先进的方法。 代码和数据集将公布于众。

papers.title: SP-Net: Slowly Progressing Dynamic Inference Networks
papers.authors: Huanyu Wang, Wenhu Zhang, Shihao Su, Hui Wang, Zhenwei Miao, Xin Zhan, Xi Li
papers.abstract: "Dynamic inference networks improve computational efficiency by executing a subset of network components, i.e., executing path, conditioned on input sample. Prevalent methods typically assign routers to computational blocks so that a computational block can be skipped or executed. However, such inference mechanisms are prone to suffer instability in the optimization of dynamic inference networks. First, a dynamic inference network is more sensitive to its routers than its computational blocks. Second, the components executed by the network vary with samples, resulting in unstable feature evolution throughout the network. To alleviate the problems above, we propose a slowly progressing dynamic inference network to stabilize the optimization. First, we design a dynamic auxiliary module to slow down the progress in routers. Moreover, we regularize the feature evolution directions across the network to smoothen the feature extraction. As a result, we conduct extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks and show that our proposed SP-Nets achieve state-of-the-art performance in terms of efficiency and accuracy."
papers.title_zh: SP-Net: 缓慢推进动态推断网络
papers.abstract_zh: “动态推断网络通过执行网络组成部分的子集,即执行路径,以输入样本为条件,提高了计算效率。前置方法通常指派路由器到计算区块,以便可以跳过或执行计算区块。 然而,这种推论机制在优化动态推论网络方面容易受到不稳定的影响。 首先,动态推论网络比计算区块对其路由器更为敏感。 第二,网络执行的部件因样本而异,导致整个网络的特征演变不稳定。 为了缓解上述问题,我们建议建立一个缓慢进步的动态推论网络,以稳定优化。 首先,我们设计了一个动态辅助模块来减缓路由器的进展。此外,我们还规范了整个网络的特征演变方向,以平滑特征提取。 因此,我们在三大广泛使用的基准上进行了广泛的实验,并表明我们提议的SP-Net在效率和准确性方面达到了最先进的业绩。”

papers.title: Skip-Convolutions for Efficient Video Processing
papers.authors: Amirhossein Habibian, Davide Abati, Taco S. Cohen, Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi
papers.abstract: We propose Skip-Convolutions to leverage the large amount of redundancies in video streams and save computations. Each video is represented as a series of changes across frames and network activations, denoted as residuals. We reformulate standard convolution to be efficiently computed on residual frames: each layer is coupled with a binary gate deciding whether a residual is important to the model prediction,e.g. foreground regions, or it can be safely skipped,e.g. background regions. These gates can either be implemented as an efficient network trained jointly with convolution kernels, or can simply skip the residuals based on their magnitude. Gating functions can also incorporate block-wise sparsity structures, as required for efficient implementation on hardware platforms. By replacing all convolutions with Skip-Convolutions in two state-of-the-art architectures, namely EfficientDet and HRNet, we reduce their computational cost consistently by a factor of 3 4x for two different tasks, without any accuracy drop. Extensive comparisons with existing model compression, as well as image and video efficiency methods demonstrate that Skip-Convolutions set a new state-of-the-art by effectively exploiting the temporal redundancies in videos.
papers.title_zh: 高效视频处理跳过会议
papers.abstract_zh: 我们建议跳过革命来利用视频流的大量冗余,并节省计算。 每段视频都是一系列跨框架和网络激活的变化,被称为剩余。 我们重新拟订标准演变,以便在剩余框架上有效计算:每一层都配有一个二进制门,决定残余物对模型预测是否重要,例如前景区域,还是可以安全地跳过,例如背景区域。 这些大门要么可以作为一个高效的网络,与革命内核联合培训,要么可以根据其规模跳过残留物。 定位功能还可以包括块状宽度结构,这是在硬件平台上高效实施所需的。 通过用两个最先进的结构,即高效 Det 和 HRNet, 取代以跳过革命取代所有革命, 我们不断降低其计算成本, 以3 4x的乘数来计算两项不同的任务, 与现有模型压缩以及图像和视频高效方法的广泛比较表明, " 跳跃 " 革命通过有效利用视频中的时间冗余,确立了新的最新技术。

papers.title: SignAvatars: A Large-scale 3D Sign Language Holistic Motion Dataset and Benchmark
papers.authors: Zhengdi Yu · Shaoli Huang · yongkang cheng · Tolga Birdal
papers.abstract: We present SignAvatars, the first large-scale, multi-prompt 3D sign language (SL) motion dataset designed to bridge the communication gap for Deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals. While there has been an exponentially growing number of research regarding digital communication, the majority of existing communication technologies primarily cater to spoken or written languages, instead of SL, the essential communication method for Deaf and hard-of-hearing communities. Existing SL datasets, dictionaries, and sign language production (SLP) methods are typically limited to 2D as annotating 3D models and avatars for SL is usually an entirely manual and labor-intensive process conducted by SL experts, often resulting in unnatural avatars. In response to these challenges, we compile and curate the SignAvatars dataset, which comprises 70,000 videos from 153 signers, totaling 8.34 million frames, covering both isolated signs and continuous, co-articulated signs, with multiple prompts including HamNoSys, spoken language, and words. To yield 3D holistic annotations, including meshes and biomechanically-valid poses of body, hands, and face, as well as 2D and 3D keypoints, we introduce an automated annotation pipeline operating on our large corpus of SL videos. SignAvatars facilitates various tasks such as 3D sign language recognition (SLR) and the novel 3D SL production (SLP) from diverse inputs like text scripts, individual words, and HamNoSys notation. Hence, to evaluate the potential of SignAvatars, we further propose a unified benchmark of 3D SL holistic motion production. We believe that this work is a significant step forward towards bringing the digital world to the Deaf and hard-of-hearing communities as well as people interacting with them.
papers.title_zh: 信号站:大规模3D手语整体动态数据集和基准
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍SignAvatars(SignAvatars)(SignAvatars),这是第一个大规模、多速三维手语(SL)运动数据集,旨在弥合聋人和重听者的沟通差距。 虽然关于数字通信的研究数量成倍增长,但大多数现有通信技术主要以口头或书面语言为对象,而不是SL,而SL是聋人和听力困难社区的基本通信方法。 现有的SL数据集、词典和手语制作方法一般限于2D,因为3D型型号注解,SL的Avatars通常是完全人工和劳动密集型的过程,由SL专家进行,往往造成非自然的Avatars。 针对这些挑战,我们汇编和整理SignAvatars数据集。 该数据集由153个签名者的70 000个视频组成,共834万个框架,覆盖孤立的标志和连续的、共同显示的标志,包括HamNoSys、口语和单词等多种提示。 为了产生3D整体说明,包括体、手和面部的模具和生物机能有效的外形,以及2D和3D关键点,我们采用了一个自动注解管道,在大量SL视频上运行。 SignAvatars为诸如3D手语识别(SLR)和新颖的3D SL制作(SLP)等各种任务提供了便利,它们来自各种投入,如文字脚本、单词和HamNoSys符号。 因此,为了评估SignAvatars的潜力,我们进一步提出了3D SL整体运动生产的统一基准,我们认为,这项工作是朝着将数字世界推向聋人和听力困难社区以及与其互动的人们迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Real-to-Sim Scene Generation
papers.authors: Aayush Prakash, Shoubhik Debnath, Jean-Francois Lafleche, Eric Cameracci, Gavriel State, Stan Birchfield, Marc T. Law
papers.abstract: Synthetic data is emerging as a promising solution to the scalability issue of supervised deep learning, especially when real data are difficult to acquire or hard to annotate. Synthetic data generation, however, can itself be prohibitively expensive when domain experts have to manually and painstakingly oversee the process. Moreover, neural networks trained on synthetic data often do not perform well on real data because of the domain gap. To solve these challenges, we propose Sim2SG, a self-supervised automatic scene generation technique for matching the distribution of real data. Importantly, Sim2SG does not require supervision from the real-world dataset, thus making it applicable in situations for which such annotations are difficult to obtain. Sim2SG is designed to bridge both the content and appearance gaps, by matching the content of real data, and by matching the features in the source and target domains. We select scene graph (SG) generation as the downstream task, due to the limited availability of labeled datasets. Experiments demonstrate significant improvements over leading baselines in reducing the domain gap both qualitatively and quantitatively, on several synthetic datasets as well as the real-world KITTI dataset.

papers.title: RPVNet: A Deep and Efficient Range-Point-Voxel Fusion Network for LiDAR Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.authors: Jianyun Xu, Ruixiang Zhang, Jian Dou, Yushi Zhu, Jie Sun, Shiliang Pu
papers.abstract: Point clouds can be represented in many forms (views), typically, point-based sets, voxel-based cells or range-based images(i.e., panoramic view). The point-based view is geometrically accurate, but it is disordered, which makes it difficult to find local neighbors efficiently. The voxel-based view is regular, but sparse, and computation grows cubicly when voxel resolution increases. The range-based view is regular and generally dense, however spherical projection makes physical dimensions distorted. Both voxel- and range-based views suffer from quantization loss, especially for voxels when facing large-scale scenes. In order to utilize different view's advantages and alleviate their own shortcomings in fine-grained segmentation task, we propose a novel range-point-voxel fusion network, namely RPVNet. In this network, we devise a deep fusion framework with multiple and mutual information interactions among these three views, and propose a gated fusion module (termed as GFM), which can adaptively merge the three features based on concurrent inputs. Moreover, the proposed RPV interaction mechanism is highly efficient, and we summarize it to a more general formulation. By leveraging this efficient interaction and relatively lower voxel resolution, our method is also proved to be more efficient. Finally, we evaluated the proposed model on two large-scale datasets, i.e., SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, and it shows state-of-the-art performance on both of them. Note that, our method currently ranks 1st on SemanticKITTI leaderboard without any extra tricks.
papers.title_zh: RPVNet:一个用于激光雷达雷达点云分割的深度和效率高的射点-点-Voxel聚变网络
papers.abstract_zh: 点云可以以多种形式(视图 ) ( views) 表示, 典型的、 点基集、 oxel 基细胞或以范围为基础的图像( 即全景 ) 。 基于点的视角是几何精确的,但却是混乱的,因此很难有效地找到本地邻居。 以 voxel 为基础的视图是常规的,但很少,当 voxel 分辨率增加时计算会越来越少。 基于 范围 的视图是常规的,通常密度很大,但球形的投影会失真物理维度。 反氧化物和基于范围的观点都因量化损失而受损,特别是在面临大规模场景的反氧化物方面。 为了利用不同观点的优势并减轻自身在细微分解任务中的缺陷,我们提议建立一个新型的射程点-voxel聚变网络,即RPVNet(RPVNet ) 。 在这个网络中,我们设计了一个深度融合框架,在这三个观点之间进行多重和相互的信息互动,并提议一个封闭的融合模块(称为GFM),该模块可以适应性地将基于同时投入的三个特征合并在一起。 此外,拟议的遥控飞行器互动机制效率很高,我们将其归纳为更一般性的提法。 通过利用这种高效的互动和相对较低的反毒分辨率,我们的方法也证明更有效率。 最后,我们评估了两个大型数据集的拟议模型,即SemanticKITTI和nuScenes,它显示了这两个数据集的最新表现。 请注意,我们的方法目前排在SionticKITTI领导板的第1位,没有任何额外的花招。

papers.title: Robust Neural Routing Through Space Partitions for Camera Relocalization in Dynamic Indoor Environments
papers.authors: Siyan Dong, Qingnan Fan, He Wang, Ji Shi, Li Yi, Thomas Funkhouser, Baoquan Chen, Leonidas J. Guibas
papers.abstract: Localizing the camera in a known indoor environment is a key building block for scene mapping, robot navigation, AR, etc. Recent advances estimate the camera pose via optimization over the 2D/3D-3D correspondences established between the coordinates in 2D/3D camera space and 3D world space. Such a mapping is estimated with either a convolution neural network or a decision tree using only the static input image sequence, which makes these approaches vulnerable to dynamic indoor environments that are quite common yet challenging in the real world. To address the aforementioned issues, in this paper, we propose a novel outlier-aware neural tree which bridges the two worlds, deep learning and decision tree approaches. It builds on three important blocks: (a) a hierarchical space partition over the indoor scene to construct the decision tree; (b) a neural routing function, implemented as a deep classification network, employed for better 3D scene understanding; and (c) an outlier rejection module used to filter out dynamic points during the hierarchical routing process. Our proposed algorithm is evaluated on the RIO-10 benchmark developed for camera relocalization in dynamic indoor environments. It achieves robust neural routing through space partitions and outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches by around 30% on camera pose accuracy, while running comparably fast for evaluation.
papers.title_zh: 动态室内环境相机重新定位
papers.abstract_zh: 将相机定位在已知室内环境中是现场制图、机器人导航、AR等的关键组成部分。 最近的进步估计,摄像头通过优化在2D/3D-3D摄像空间坐标与3D世界空间坐标之间建立的2D/3D-3D通信。 这种绘图是用一个变幻神经网络或决策树来估计的,只有静态输入图像序列,使这些方法易受动态室内环境的影响,而这种环境在现实世界中非常常见,但具有挑战性。 为了解决上述问题,在本文中,我们提议建立一个新颖的超能神经树,将两个世界、深层学习和决策树方法联系起来。 它建立在三个重要区块上:(a) 室内空间分层,以建造决策树;(b) 神经路由功能,作为深层分类网络实施,用于更好地了解3D场景;(c) 外向拒绝模块,用于在分层路由过程中过滤动态点。 我们提议的算法是根据RIO-10基准进行评估的,该基准是为摄影机在动态室内环境中重新定位而开发的。它通过空间分区实现坚固的神经路由,在摄影机上实现比最新技术高30%的超能力,具有准确性,同时在评估方面运行的相对快。

papers.title: Representation Learning via Global Temporal Alignment and Cycle-Consistency
papers.authors: Isma Hadji, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Allan D. Jepson
papers.abstract: We introduce a weakly supervised method for representation learning based on aligning temporal sequences (e.g., videos) of the same process (e.g., human action). The main idea is to use the global temporal ordering of latent correspondences across sequence pairs as a supervisory signal. In particular, we propose a loss based on scoring the optimal sequence alignment to train an embedding network. Our loss is based on a novel probabilistic path finding view of dynamic time warping (DTW) that contains the following three key features: (i) the local path routing decisions are contrastive and differentiable, (ii) pairwise distances are cast as probabilities that are contrastive as well, and (iii) our formulation naturally admits a global cycle consistency loss that verifies correspondences. For evaluation, we consider the tasks of fine-grained action classification, few shot learning, and video synchronization. We report significant performance increases over previous methods. In addition, we report two applications of our temporal alignment framework, namely 3D pose reconstruction and fine-grained audio/visual retrieval.
papers.title_zh: 通过全球时间配合和周期一致性进行代表性学习
papers.abstract_zh: 我们采用了一种监督不力的代言学习方法,其基础是同一过程的时间序列(例如人类行动)的一致(例如视频),主要想法是使用全球对序列之间潜在通信时间顺序作为监督信号。 特别是,我们提出以取得最佳序列调整的评分为基础进行损失,以训练嵌入网络。 我们的损失是基于一种新颖的动态时间失真概率分析方法(DTW),它包含以下三个关键特征:(一) 当地路径路径选择决定具有对比性和可区别性;(二) 双向距离被描绘为也具有对比性的概率;(三) 我们的表述自然承认全球周期一致性损失可以核实通信。 在评估方面,我们考虑的是精细行动分类、少见的学习和视频同步等任务。 我们报告的业绩比以往方法大增。 此外,我们报告了我们时间调整框架的两种应用,即3D构成重建和微小的视听检索。

papers.title: ReAgent: Point Cloud Registration Using Imitation and Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Dominik Bauer, Timothy Patten, Markus Vincze
papers.abstract: Point cloud registration is a common step in many 3D computer vision tasks such as object pose estimation, where a 3D model is aligned to an observation. Classical registration methods generalize well to novel domains but fail when given a noisy observation or a bad initialization. Learning-based methods, in contrast, are more robust but lack in generalization capacity. We propose to consider iterative point cloud registration as a reinforcement learning task and, to this end, present a novel registration agent (ReAgent). We employ imitation learning to initialize its discrete registration policy based on a steady expert policy. Integration with policy optimization, based on our proposed alignment reward, further improves the agent's registration performance. We compare our approach to classical and learning-based registration methods on both ModelNet40 (synthetic) and ScanObjectNN (real data) and show that our ReAgent achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. The lightweight architecture of the agent, moreover, enables reduced inference time as compared to related approaches.
papers.title_zh: 借方:利用吸收和强化学习进行点云登记
papers.abstract_zh: 点云登记是许多3D计算机视觉任务(如天体构成估计)的共同步骤,其中3D模型与观测相吻合。 经典注册方法非常适用于新领域,但如果观察到噪音或初始化错误,则失败。 相比之下,以学习为基础的方法更为健全,但缺乏概括能力。 我们提议将迭代点云登记视为强化学习任务,并为此提供一个新的注册代理(Regent Agency ) 。 我们利用模仿学习来启动基于稳定的专家政策的独立注册政策。 根据我们提议的调整奖励,与政策优化相结合可以进一步提高该代理人的注册业绩。 我们比较了我们对模型Net40(合成)和ScanObjectNN(真实数据)的古典和基于学习的注册方法,并表明我们的ReAgent实现了最新准确性。 此外,该剂的轻量级结构使得与相关方法相比,推论时间缩短。

papers.title: RDI-Net: Relational Dynamic Inference Networks
papers.authors: Huanyu Wang, Songyuan Li, Shihao Su, Zequn Qin, Xi Li
papers.abstract: Dynamic inference networks, aimed at promoting computational efficiency, go along an adaptive executing path for a given sample. Prevalent methods typically assign a router for each convolutional block and sequentially make block-by-block executing decisions, without considering the relations during the dynamic inference. In this paper, we model the relations for dynamic inference from two aspects: the routers and the samples. We design a novel type of router called the relational router to model the relations among routers for a given sample. In principle, the current relational router aggregates the contextual features of preceding routers by graph convolution and propagates its router features to subsequent ones, making the executing decision for the current block in a long-range manner. Furthermore, we model the relation between samples by introducing a Sample Relation Module (SRM), encouraging correlated samples to go along correlated executing paths. As a whole, we call our method the Relational Dynamic Inference Network (RDI-Net). Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet show that RDI-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance and computational cost reduction. Our code and models will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: RDI-Net: 关系动态推断网络
papers.abstract_zh: 为提高计算效率而建立的动态推论网络为特定样本采用适应性执行路径。 预置方法通常为每个革命区划指定一个路由器,并依次逐个区块做出执行决定,而不考虑动态推论期间的关系。 在本文中,我们从两个方面来模拟动态推论关系:路由器和样品。 我们设计了一种新型的路由器,叫做关系路由器,为特定样品的路由器建立关系模型。 原则上,目前的关联路由器通过图解变形汇总前路由器的背景特征,并将其路由器特征传播给随后的路由器,以远程方式做出当前路段的执行决定。 此外,我们通过引入样本关系模块(SRM)来模拟样本之间的关系,鼓励相关样本走相关执行路径。 总体而言,我们称我们的方法为关系动态推断网络(RDI-Net ) 。 关于CIFAR-10/100和图像网络的广泛实验表明,RDI-Net实现了SOTA 性能和计算成本的降低,我们的代码和模型将公开提供。

papers.title: Quantifying Explainers of Graph Neural Networks in Computational Pathology
papers.authors: Guillaume Jaume, Pushpak Pati, Behzad Bozorgtabar, Antonio Foncubierta, Anna Maria Anniciello, Florinda Feroce, Tilman Rau, Jean-Philippe Thiran, Maria Gabrani, Orcun Goksel
papers.abstract: Explainability of deep learning methods is imperative to facilitate their clinical adoption in digital pathology. However, popular deep learning methods and explainability techniques (explainers) based on pixel-wise processing disregard biological entities' notion, thus complicating comprehension by pathologists. In this work, we address this by adopting biological entity-based graph processing and graph explainers enabling explanations accessible to pathologists. In this context, a major challenge becomes to discern meaningful explainers, particularly in a standardized and quantifiable fashion. To this end, we propose herein a set of novel quantitative metrics based on statistics of class separability using pathologically measurable concepts to characterize graph explainers. We employ the proposed metrics to evaluate three types of graph explainers, namely the layer-wise relevance propagation, gradient-based saliency, and graph pruning approaches, to explain Cell-Graph representations for Breast Cancer Subtyping. The proposed metrics are also applicable in other domains by using domain-specific intuitive concepts. We validate the qualitative and quantitative findings on the BRACS dataset, a large cohort of breast cancer RoIs, by expert pathologists. The code and models will be released upon acceptance.
papers.title_zh: 计算病理学图表神经网络的量化解释
papers.abstract_zh: 深层学习方法的可解释性对于促进其在数字病理学中的临床应用至关重要,然而,流行的深层学习方法和基于像素处理的可解释性技术(解释者)无视生物实体的概念,从而使病理学家的理解复杂化。 在这项工作中,我们通过采用基于生物实体的图表处理和图表解释,使病理学家能够提供解释。 在这方面,一个重大挑战是发现有意义的解释,特别是以标准化和量化的方式。 为此,我们在此提出一套新的定量指标,以分类分离性统计数字为基础,利用病理学上可衡量的概念来说明图表解释者的特点。 我们采用拟议指标来评价三种图表解释器,即分层适切性传播、梯度突出度法和图表裁剪法,以解释乳癌分型的细胞格表征。 通过使用特定领域直观概念,拟议指标也适用于其他领域。我们验证了专家病理学家对BRACS数据集(大量乳腺癌RoIs)的定性和定量调查结果。一旦被接受,代码和模型将发布。

papers.title: Pyramid Point Cloud Transformer for Large-Scale Place Recognition
papers.authors: Le Hui, Hang Yang, Mingmei Cheng, Jin Xie, Jian Yang
papers.abstract: Recently, deep learning based point cloud descriptors have achieved impressive results in the place recognition task. Nonetheless, due to the sparsity of point clouds, how to extract discriminative local features of point clouds to efficiently form a global descriptor is still a challenging problem. In this paper, we propose a pyramid point cloud transformer network (PPT-Net) to learn the discriminative global descriptors from point clouds for efficient retrieval. Specifically, we first develop a pyramid point transformer module that adaptively learns the spatial relationship of the different local k-NN graphs of point clouds, where the grouped self-attention is proposed to extract discriminative local features of the point clouds. Furthermore, the grouped self-attention not only enhances long-term dependencies of the point clouds, but also reduces the computational cost. In order to obtain discriminative global descriptors, we construct a pyramid VLAD module to aggregate the multi-scale feature maps of point clouds into the global descriptors. By applying VLAD pooling on multi-scale feature maps, we utilize the context gating mechanism on the multiple global descriptors to adaptively weight the multi-scale global context information into the final global descriptor. Experimental results on the Oxford dataset and three in-house datasets show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art on the point cloud based place recognition task. Code is available at https://github.com/fpthink/PPT-Net.
papers.title_zh: 大型地点识别金字点云变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,基于深层学习的点云描述符在定位任务中取得了令人印象深刻的成果。 然而,由于点云的广度,如何从局部中提取点云的歧视性特征以有效地形成全球描述符仍然是一个挑战性的问题。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个金字塔点云变压器网络(PPT-Net),以便从点云中学习具有歧视性的全球描述器,以便有效地检索。 具体地说,我们首先开发一个金字塔点变压器模块,该模块适应性地学习不同地方k-NN点云图的空间关系,建议组合自注意力来提取点云具有歧视性的地方特征。 此外,分组的自我关注不仅加强了点云的长期依赖性,还降低了计算成本。 为了获得歧视性的全球描述符,我们建造了一个金字塔VLAD模块,将点云的多尺度地貌图汇总到全球描述符中。 通过将VLAD汇集在多尺度地貌图上,我们利用关于多个全球描述符的背景说明机制,将多尺度的全球背景信息适应性地加权到最终的全球描述符中。 牛津数据集和三个内部数据集的实验结果显示,我们的方法在基于点云的确认地点任务上达到了最新水平。 代码可在https://github.com/fpindig/PPT-Net上查阅。

papers.title: PT-CapsNet: A Novel Prediction-Tuning Capsule Network Suitable for Deeper Architectures
papers.authors: Chenbin Pan, Senem Velipasalar
papers.abstract: Capsule Networks (CapsNets) create internal representations by parsing inputs into various instances at different resolution levels via a two-phase process -- part-whole transformation and hierarchical component routing. Since both of these internal phases are computationally expensive, CapsNets have not found wider use. Existing variations of CapsNets mainly focus on performance comparison with the original CapsNet, and have not outperformed CNN-based models on complex tasks. To address the limitations of the existing CapsNet structures, we propose a novel Prediction-Tuning Capsule Network (PT-CapsNet), and also introduce fully connected PT-Capsules (FC-PT-Caps) and locally connected PT-Capsules (LC-PT-Caps). Different from existing CapsNet structures, our proposed model (i) allows the use of capsules for more difficult vision tasks and provides wider applicability; and (ii) provides better than or comparable performance to CNN-based baselines on these complex tasks. In our experiments, we show robustness to affine transformations, as well as the lightweight and scalability of PT-CapsNet via constructing larger and deeper networks and performing comparisons on classification, semantic segmentation and object detection tasks. The results show consistent performance improvement and significant parameter reduction compared to various baseline models. Code is available at https://github.com/Christinepan881/PT-CapsNet.git.
papers.title_zh: PT-CapsNet:一个适合深层建筑的新预测-发射信封网络
papers.abstract_zh: Capsule Networks(CapsNets)通过一个两阶段过程 -- -- 整个部件转换和分级部件路由 -- -- 将投入分解到不同分辨率层次的不同实例,从而产生内部代表。 由于这两个内部阶段的计算成本都很高,CapsNet没有找到更广泛的用途。 CapsNet的现有变异主要侧重于与原CapsNet的性能比较,并且没有在复杂任务方面超过CNN模式。 为解决现有CapsNet结构的局限性,我们提议建立一个新的预测-交付-交付能力网络(PT-CapsNet),并引进完全连通的PT-能力(FC-PT-Caps)和地方连通的PT-Capsule(LC-PT-Caps)。 与现有的CapsNet结构不同,我们提议的模式(一) 允许利用胶囊执行更困难的视觉任务,提供更广泛的适用性;以及(二) 比有线电视新闻网提供的这些复杂任务的基线业绩更好或可比。 在我们的实验中,我们通过建立更大和更深的网络和在分类、语义分解和物体探测任务方面进行比较,展示了亲近转换的稳健性,以及PT-CapsNet的轻量和可扩缩性。 结果表明,与各种基线模型相比,业绩不断改善,参数显著减少,《守则》可在https://github.com/Christinepan881/PT-CapsNet.git查阅。

papers.title: PPR10K: A Large-Scale Portrait Photo Retouching Dataset With Human-Region Mask and Group-Level Consistency
papers.authors: Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Miaomiao Cui, Xuansong Xie, Lei Zhang
papers.abstract: Different from general photo retouching tasks, portrait photo retouching (PPR), which aims to enhance the visual quality of a collection of flat-looking portrait photos, has its special and practical requirements such as human-region priority (HRP) and group-level consistency (GLC). HRP requires that more attention should be paid to human regions, while GLC requires that a group of portrait photos should be retouched to a consistent tone. Models trained on existing general photo retouching datasets, however, can hardly meet these requirements of PPR. To facilitate the research on this high-frequency task, we construct a large-scale PPR dataset, namely PPR10K, which is the first of its kind to our best knowledge. PPR10K contains 1, 681 groups and 11, 161 high-quality raw portrait photos in total. High-resolution segmentation masks of human regions are provided. Each raw photo is retouched by three experts, while they elaborately adjust each group of photos to have consistent tones. We define a set of objective measures to evaluate the performance of PPR and propose strategies to learn PPR models with good HRP and GLC performance. The constructed PPR10K dataset provides a good benchmark for studying automatic PPR methods, and experiments demonstrate that the proposed learning strategies are effective to improve the retouching performance. Datasets and codes are available: https://github.com/csjliang/PPR10K.
papers.title_zh: PPR10K:用人类-区域面具和小组级一致性的大型光谱照片修改数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 与一般照片改头换面任务不同的是,照片改头换面(PPR)旨在提高平面肖像照片收藏的视觉质量,它有其特殊和实际要求,如人类区域优先事项和群体一致性(GLC)。 HRP要求更多关注人类区域,而GLC则要求一组肖像照片应调整为一致的基调。 然而,关于现有一般照片修改数据集的培训模式几乎无法满足PPR的这些要求。 为了便于研究这一高频任务,我们建立了一个大型PR数据集,即PPR10K,这是我们最了解的同类数据中第一个。PPR10K包含1,681个组和11,161张高质量的原始肖像照片,提供了人类区域高分辨率分解面罩。 每张原始照片都由三名专家重修,他们详细调整每组照片,使其具有一致的音调。 我们制定了一套客观措施来评估人民进步党的绩效,并提出战略来学习具有良好HRP和GLC表现的人民进步党模式。 已经建成的PPR10K数据集为研究自动PPR方法提供了一个良好的基准,实验表明,拟议的学习战略对改进补习性能是有效的,数据集和代码见https://github.com/csjliang/PPR10K。

papers.title: Not All Operations Contribute Equally: Hierarchical Operation-Adaptive Predictor for Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Ziye Chen, Yibing Zhan, Baosheng Yu, Mingming Gong, Bo Du
papers.abstract: Graph-based predictors have recently shown promising results on neural architecture search (NAS). Despite their efficiency, current graph-based predictors treat all operations equally, resulting in biased topological knowledge of cell architectures. Intuitively, not all operations are equally significant during forwarding propagation when aggregating information from these operations to another operation. To address the above issue, we propose a Hierarchical Operation-adaptive Predictor (HOP) for NAS. HOP contains an operation-adaptive attention module (OAM) to capture the diverse knowledge between operations by learning the relative significance of operations in cell architectures during aggregation over iterations. In addition, a cell-hierarchical gated module (CGM) further refines and enriches the obtained topological knowledge of cell architectures, by integrating cell information from each iteration of OAM. The experimental results compared with state-of-the-art predictors demonstrate the capability of our proposed HOP. In specific, only using 0.1% training data, HOP improves kendall's Tau by 3.45%, N@5 by 20 places on NASBech-101; only using 1% training data, HOP improves kendall's Tau by 2.12%, N@5 by 18 places on NASBench-201, respectively.
papers.title_zh: 并非所有行动都作出同样的贡献:神经结构搜索的等级行动-适应行动预测仪
papers.abstract_zh: 图表预测器最近显示神经结构搜索(NAS)有希望的结果。 尽管其效率很高,但目前基于图表的预测器对所有操作一视同仁,导致对细胞结构有偏颇的地形学知识。 直观地说,并非所有行动在将这些行动的信息汇集到另一个行动时,在传播过程中都具有同等的重要性,为了解决上述问题,我们提议为国家安全局配备一个等级行动适应性预测员(HOP ) (HOP ) (HOP ) ( HOP ) ( HOP ) ( HOP ) ( HOP ) 。 HOP包含一个操作适应关注模块(OAM),通过在迭代组合期间了解细胞结构中操作的相对重要性,掌握不同操作之间的不同知识。 此外,一个细胞等级门式模块(CGM)通过整合OAM每次迭代的细胞信息,进一步改进和丰富获得的细胞结构的地形学知识。 实验结果与最先进的预测器相比表明了我们拟议的HOP的能力。 具体地说,只使用0.1%的培训数据,HOP将Kendall的Tau改进3.45%,N@5在NASBech-101上增加20个位子;HOP只使用1%的培训数据,Kendall的Tau则分别改进2.12%,N@5在NASBench-201上增加18个位子。

papers.title: NeuralRecon: Real-Time Coherent 3D Reconstruction From Monocular Video
papers.authors: Jiaming Sun, Yiming Xie, Linghao Chen, Xiaowei Zhou, Hujun Bao
papers.abstract: We present a novel framework named NeuralRecon for real-time 3D scene reconstruction from a monocular video. Unlike previous methods that estimate single-view depth maps separately on each key-frame and fuse them later, we propose to directly reconstruct local surfaces represented as sparse TSDF volumes for each video fragment sequentially by a neural network. A learning-based TSDF fusion module based on gated recurrent units is used to guide the network to fuse features from previous fragments. This design allows the network to capture local smoothness prior and global shape prior of 3D surfaces when sequentially reconstructing the surfaces, resulting in accurate, coherent, and real-time surface reconstruction. The experiments on ScanNet and 7-Scenes datasets show that our system outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of both accuracy and speed. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first learning-based system that is able to reconstruct dense coherent 3D geometry in real-time. Code is available at the project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralrecon/.
papers.title_zh: 神经功能:实时协调的 3D 重塑独视视频
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个新的框架 名为神经再生 实时3D场景重建 从一个单眼视频。 与以往分别估计每个关键框架的单视深度地图并随后将其连接起来的方法不同,我们提议直接重建当地表面,这些表层被神经网络按顺序显示为每个视频碎片的稀薄的TSDF体积。 利用基于门锁的常规单元的基于学习的TSDF聚变模块,指导网络从以前的碎片中获取引信特性。 这一设计使网络能够在连续重建地表时,在3D表面之前取得当地平坦的先前和全球的形状,从而导致准确、一致和实时的地表重建。 在ScanNet和7-Scenses数据集的实验显示,我们的系统在准确性和速度方面都超过了最先进的方法。 据我们所知,这是第一个能够实时重建密度连贯的3D几何的以学习为基础的系统。 法规可在项目网页上查阅:https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralrecon/。
