papers.title: Event-Based Fusion for Motion Deblurring with Cross-Modal Attention
papers.authors: Lei Sun, Christos Sakaridis, Jingyun Liang, Qi Jiang, Kailun Yang, Peng Sun, Yaozu Ye, Kaiwei Wang, Luc Van Gool
papers.abstract: "Traditional frame-based cameras inevitably suffer from motion blur due to long exposure times. As a kind of bio-inspired camera, the event camera records the intensity changes in an asynchronous way with high temporal resolution, providing valid image degradation information within the exposure time. In this paper, we rethink the event-based image deblurring problem and unfold it into an end-to-end two-stage image restoration network. To effectively fuse event and image features, we design an event-image cross-modal attention module applied at multiple levels of our network, which allows to focus on relevant features from the event branch and filter out noise. We also introduce a novel symmetric cumulative event representation specifically for image deblurring as well as an event mask gated connection between the two stages of our network which helps avoid information loss. At the dataset level, to foster event-based motion deblurring and to facilitate evaluation on challenging real-world images, we introduce the Real Event Blur (REBlur) dataset, captured with an event camera in an illumination-controlled optical laboratory. Our Event Fusion Network (EFNet) sets the new state of the art in motion deblurring, surpassing both the prior best-performing image-based method and all event-based methods with public implementations on the GoPro dataset (by up to 2.47dB) and on our REBlur dataset, even in extreme blurry conditions. The code and our REBlur dataset are available at https://ahupujr.github.io/EFNet/"
papers.title_zh: 跨模式注意的移动分解事件融合
papers.abstract_zh: “传统框架摄影机因长期接触而不可避免地受到模糊变化的影响。作为一种生物启发的摄影机,事件摄像头以无同步的方式记录高时间分辨率的强度变化,在接触时间内提供有效的图像降解信息。 在本文中,我们重新思考以事件为基础的图像破碎问题,并将其发展成一个端至端两阶段图像恢复网络。 为了有效地引信事件和图像特征,我们设计了一个在网络多个级别上应用的事件图像跨模式关注模块,该模块能够侧重于事件分支的相关特征,并过滤噪音。 我们还引入了一种新的对称累积事件表征,专门用于图像破碎,以及我们网络两个阶段之间的蒙面连接,这有助于避免信息丢失。 在数据集一级,为了促进以事件为基础的运动分流并促进对具有挑战性的现实世界图像的评价,我们介绍了真实事件Blur(REBlur)数据集,该数据集是在受照明控制的光学实验室中用事件相机拍摄的。 我们的活动融合网络(EFNet)设置了最新的最新动态,在GoPro数据集(最多为2.47dB)和我们的REBlur数据集上,甚至在极端模糊的条件下,都超越了先前以图像为基础的最佳功能方法和所有事件为基础的方法,在公共执行上(甚至达到2.47dB)和在我们的REBlur数据集上,甚至超越了以往以图像为基础的最佳功能方法和所有事件为基础的方法。 该代码和我们的REBlur数据集可在https://ahupujr.github.io/EFNet/上查阅。”

papers.title: Dynamic Face Video Segmentation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yujiang Wang, Mingzhi Dong, Jie Shen, Yang Wu, Shiyang Cheng, Maja Pantic
papers.abstract: For real-time semantic video segmentation, most recent works utilised a dynamic framework with a key scheduler to make online key/non-key decisions. Some works used a fixed key scheduling policy, while others proposed adaptive key scheduling methods based on heuristic strategies, both of which may lead to suboptimal global performance. To overcome this limitation, we model the online key decision process in dynamic video segmentation as a deep reinforcement learning problem and learn an efficient and effective scheduling policy from expert information about decision history and from the process of maximising global return. Moreover, we study the application of dynamic video segmentation on face videos, a field that has not been investigated before. By evaluating on the 300VW dataset, we show that the performance of our reinforcement key scheduler outperforms that of various baselines in terms of both effective key selections and running speed. Further results on the Cityscapes dataset demonstrate that our proposed method can also generalise to other scenarios. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to use reinforcement learning for online key-frame decision in dynamic video segmentation, and also the first work on its application on face videos.
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习进行动态面部视频分割
papers.abstract_zh: 对于实时语义视频分割,最近的一些作品利用一个动态框架和一个关键排程器来作出在线键/非键决定。 有些工作采用了固定的关键日程安排政策,而另一些工作则根据超自然战略提出了适应性的关键日程安排方法,这两种方法都可能导致全球业绩不理想。 为了克服这一限制,我们将在线关键决策程序作为动态视频分割模式,作为强化学习的一个深层问题,并从决策史专家信息以及全球回报最大化进程中学习一项高效率和有成效的时间安排政策。 此外,我们研究在脸部视频中应用动态视频分割法,这个领域以前从未进行过调查。 通过对300VW数据集的评估,我们表明,从有效的关键选择和运行速度来看,我们的加固关键调度仪表仪的性能超过了各种基线的性能。 就我们所知,这是在动态视频路段中利用强化学习进行在线关键框架决定的首项工作,也是在面对面视频上应用该关键框架的首项工作。

papers.title: Dynamic Convolutions: Exploiting Spatial Sparsity for Faster Inference
papers.authors: Thomas Verelst, Tinne Tuytelaars
papers.abstract: Modern convolutional neural networks apply the same operations on every pixel in an image. However, not all image regions are equally important. To address this inefficiency, we propose a method to dynamically apply convolutions conditioned on the input image. We introduce a residual block where a small gating branch learns which spatial positions should be evaluated. These discrete gating decisions are trained end-to-end using the Gumbel-Softmax trick, in combination with a sparsity criterion. Our experiments on CIFAR, ImageNet, Food-101 and MPII show that our method has better focus on the region of interest and better accuracy than existing methods, at a lower computational complexity. Moreover, we provide an efficient CUDA implementation of our dynamic convolutions using a gather-scatter approach, achieving a significant improvement in inference speed on MobileNetV2 and ShuffleNetV2. On human pose estimation, a task that is inherently spatially sparse, the processing speed is increased by 60% with no loss in accuracy.
papers.title_zh: 动态演变:利用空间公平加速推论
papers.abstract_zh: 现代进化神经网络对图像中的每个像素应用同样的操作。 但是,并非所有图像区域都同等重要。 为了解决这种效率低下的问题,我们建议了一种方法来动态应用以输入图像为条件的进化。 我们引入了一个剩余区块, 让一个小带宽的分支学习哪些空间位置应该被评估。 这些离散带宽的决定是使用 Gumbel-Softmax 骗术, 结合一个宽度标准, 被训练为端对端的决定 。 我们关于CIFAR、图像网、Food-101和MPII的实验表明,我们的方法比现有方法更注重感兴趣的区域,更准确,计算复杂性较低。 此外,我们利用收集散射方法,为CUDA高效实施我们动态的演变,大大改进了移动网络2和ShuffleNetV2的推论速度。 人类构成估计,这一任务在空间上固有的稀少,加工速度增加60%,准确性不减。

papers.title: Discriminative Multi-Modality Speech Recognition
papers.authors: Bo Xu, Cheng Lu, Yandong Guo, Jacob Wang
papers.abstract: Vision is often used as a complementary modality for audio speech recognition (ASR), especially in the noisy environment where performance of solo audio modality significantly deteriorates. After combining visual modality, ASR is upgraded to the multi-modality speech recognition (MSR). In this paper, we propose a two-stage speech recognition model. In the first stage, the target voice is separated from background noises with help from the corresponding visual information of lip movements, making the model 'listen' clearly. At the second stage, the audio modality combines visual modality again to better understand the speech by a MSR sub-network, further improving the recognition rate. There are some other key contributions: we introduce a pseudo-3D residual convolution (P3D)-based visual front-end to extract more discriminative features; we upgrade the temporal convolution block from 1D ResNet with the temporal convolutional network (TCN), which is more suitable for the temporal tasks; the MSR sub-network is built on the top of Element-wise-Attention Gated Recurrent Unit (EleAtt-GRU), which is more effective than Transformer in long sequences. We conducted extensive experiments on the LRS3-TED and the LRW datasets. Our two-stage model (audio enhanced multi-modality speech recognition, AE-MSR) consistently achieves the state-of-the-art performance by a significant margin, which demonstrates the necessity and effectiveness of AE-MSR.
papers.title_zh: 具有争议性的多方式语音识别
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉常被用作语音语音识别的一种补充模式,特别是在音频模式性能显著恶化的吵闹环境中。 在将视觉模式相结合后,视觉语音识别升级为多式语音识别。 在本文中,我们提出了一个两阶段的语音识别模式。 在第一阶段,目标声音与背景噪音分离,同时借助相应的嘴唇运动视觉信息,使模型“听得很清楚 ” 。 在第二阶段,音频模式再次结合视觉模式,以更好地了解一个MSR子网络的演讲,进一步提高识别率。 还有其他一些关键贡献:我们引入了假的三维残余革命(P3D)基础的视觉前端来提取更具歧视性的特征;我们用时间革命网络(TCN)升级了1D ResNet的时空革命区块,使之更适合时间革命网络(TCN);MSR子网络建在元素-注意-注意-经常单元(EleAtt-GRU)的顶端,在长序列中比Transformer更有效。 我们对LRS3-TED和LRW数据集进行了广泛的实验,我们的两阶段模型(AE-MSR)一贯以相当大的幅度实现最新表现,这表明AE-MSR的必要性和有效性。

papers.title: Densely Connected Search Space for More Flexible Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Jiemin Fang, Yuzhu Sun, Qian Zhang, Yuan Li, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
papers.abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) has dramatically advanced the development of neural network design. We revisit the search space design in most previous NAS methods and find the number and widths of blocks are set manually. However, block counts and block widths determine the network scale (depth and width) and make a great influence on both the accuracy and the model cost (FLOPs/latency). In this paper, we propose to search block counts and block widths by designing a densely connected search space, i.e., DenseNAS. The new search space is represented as a dense super network, which is built upon our designed routing blocks. In the super network, routing blocks are densely connected and we search for the best path between them to derive the final architecture. We further propose a chained cost estimation algorithm to approximate the model cost during the search. Both the accuracy and model cost are optimized in DenseNAS. For experiments on the MobileNetV2-based search space, DenseNAS achieves 75.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with only 361MB FLOPs and 17.9ms latency on a single TITAN-XP. The larger model searched by DenseNAS achieves 76.1% accuracy with only 479M FLOPs. DenseNAS further promotes the ImageNet classification accuracies of ResNet-18, -34 and -50-B by 1.5%, 0.5% and 0.3% with 200M, 600M and 680M FLOPs reduction respectively. The related code is available at https://github.com/JaminFong/DenseNAS.
papers.title_zh: 用于更灵活神经建筑建筑搜索的连接宽广搜索空间
papers.abstract_zh: 神经结构搜索(NAS)极大地推动了神经网络设计的发展。 我们用大多数先前的NAS方法重新审视搜索空间设计,发现区块的数量和宽度是手工设定的。 然而,区块数和区块宽度决定了网络规模(深度和宽度),对准确度和模型成本(FLOPs/延缓度)产生很大影响。 在本文中,我们提议通过设计一个紧密相连的搜索空间,即DensenNAS,来搜索区块数和区块宽度。 新的搜索空间代表着一个密集的超级网络,它建立在我们设计的路径块之上。 在超级网络中,路径块密不可分,我们寻找它们之间的最佳路径以建立最终结构。 我们进一步建议采用一个连锁成本估算算法,以在搜索期间估算模型成本,在登纳斯系统中优化准确性和模型成本。 在移动网络V2基搜索空间上进行的实验中,DensenNAS在图像网络上实现了75.3%的最高一级精确度,只有361MB FLOPs和17.9ms lantency on sing TITAN-XP。 DensenNAS所搜索的更大模型实现了76.1%的精确度,只有479M FLOPs。 DensenNAS进一步促进ResNet-18、-34和-50-B的图像网络分类普及度,分别为1.5%、0.5%和0.3%,分别减少200M、600M和680M FLOPs,有关代码见https://github.com/JaminFong/DensenNAS。

papers.title: CPR-GCN: Conditional Partial-Residual Graph Convolutional Network in Automated Anatomical Labeling of Coronary Arteries
papers.authors: Han Yang, Xingjian Zhen, Ying Chi, Lei Zhang, Xian-Sheng Hua
papers.abstract: Automated anatomical labeling plays a vital role in coronary artery disease diagnosing procedure. The main challenge in this problem is the large individual variability inherited in human anatomy. Existing methods usually rely on the position information and the prior knowledge of the topology of the coronary artery tree, which may lead to unsatisfactory performance when the main branches are confusing. Motivated by the wide application of the graph neural network in structured data, in this paper, we propose a conditional partial-residual graph convolutional network (CPR-GCN), which takes both position and CT image into consideration, since CT image contains abundant information such as branch size and spanning direction. Two majority parts, a Partial-Residual GCN and a conditions extractor, are included in CPR-GCN. The conditions extractor is a hybrid model containing the 3D CNN and the LSTM, which can extract 3D spatial image features along the branches. On the technical side, the Partial-Residual GCN takes the position features of the branches, with the 3D spatial image features as conditions, to predict the label for each branches. While on the mathematical side, our approach twists the partial differential equation (PDE) into the graph modeling. A dataset with 511 subjects is collected from the clinic and annotated by two experts with a two-phase annotation process. According to the five-fold cross-validation, our CPR-GCN yields 95.8% meanRecall, 95.4% meanPrecision and 0.955 meanF1, which outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.title_zh: CPR-GCN:冠状动脉自动解剖标签中有条件的半恢复部分成形图变网络
papers.abstract_zh: 自动解剖标签在冠状动脉疾病诊断程序中发挥着至关重要的作用,这个问题的主要挑战是人类解剖中遗留下来的巨大个人变异性。 现有方法通常依赖冠状动脉树的位置信息和先前对冠状动脉树地形学的了解,如果主要分支混淆不清,可能导致业绩不令人满意。 由于在结构化数据中广泛应用图形神经网络,我们在本文中提议建立一个有条件的局部再生图形革命网络(CPR-GCN),既考虑位置又考虑CT图像,因为CT图像包含大量信息,如分支大小和横跨方向。 环境提取器是一种混合模型,包含3DCNN和LSTM,可以沿各分支提取3D空间图像特征。 在技术方面,部分恢复式GCN采用分支的位置特征,以3D空间图像特征作为条件来预测每个分支的标签。 在数学方面,我们的方法将部分差异方程(PDE)失真为图形模型。 从诊所收集了511个科目的数据集,由两名专家附加说明,分两个阶段进行注解,根据五重交叉验证,我们的CPR-GCN平均值为95.8%(回想)、95.4%(中度精度)和0.955(中度)F1,这超过了最先进的方法。

papers.authors: Hussein Mozannar, David Sontag

papers.title: Conditional Channel Gated Networks for Task-Aware Continual Learning
papers.authors: Davide Abati, Jakub Tomczak, Tijmen Blankevoort, Simone Calderara, Rita Cucchiara, Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi
papers.abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks experience catastrophic forgetting when optimized on a sequence of learning problems: as they meet the objective of the current training examples, their performance on previous tasks drops drastically. In this work, we introduce a novel framework to tackle this problem with conditional computation. We equip each convolutional layer with task-specific gating modules, selecting which filters to apply on the given input. This way, we achieve two appealing properties. Firstly, the execution patterns of the gates allow to identify and protect important filters, ensuring no loss in the performance of the model for previously learned tasks. Secondly, by using a sparsity objective, we can promote the selection of a limited set of kernels, allowing to retain sufficient model capacity to digest new tasks. Existing solutions require, at test time, awareness of the task to which each example belongs to. This knowledge, however, may not be available in many practical scenarios. Therefore, we additionally introduce a task classifier that predicts the task label of each example, to deal with settings in which a task oracle is not available. We validate our proposal on four continual learning datasets. Results show that our model consistently outperforms existing methods both in the presence and the absence of a task oracle. Notably, on Split SVHN and Imagenet-50 datasets, our model yields up to 23.98% and 17.42% improvement in accuracy w.r.t. competing methods.
papers.title_zh: 任务软件持续学习有条件的频道 Geded 网络
papers.abstract_zh: 革命神经网络在优化一系列学习问题时,经历了灾难性的遗忘:当它们达到当前培训实例的目标时,它们在以往工作中的表现急剧下降。 在这项工作中,我们引入了一个以有条件计算来解决这个问题的新框架。我们为每个革命层配备了具体任务标签模块,选择了在给定输入上应用的过滤器。这样,我们就能实现两个有吸引力的属性。 首先,大门的执行模式允许识别和保护重要的过滤器,确保以往学到的任务模式的执行不会受到任何损失。 第二,通过使用宽度目标,我们可以促进选择一组有限的内核,允许保留足够的模型能力来消化新任务。 现有的解决方案需要在测试时了解每个例子所属的任务。 然而,在许多实际情况下,这种知识可能无法提供。 因此,我们另外引入了一个任务分类器,预测每个例子的任务标签,以处理没有任务符的设置。 我们验证了我们关于四个持续学习数据集的建议。 结果显示,我们的模型在存在和没有任务符的情况下都始终优于现有方法。 值得注意的是,在Split SVHN和图像网-50数据集中,我们的模型在准确性上取得了23.98%和17.42%的提高(w.r.t. ) 。

papers.title: Composing Good Shots by Exploiting Mutual Relations
papers.authors: Debang Li, Junge Zhang, Kaiqi Huang, Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: Finding views with a good composition from an input image is a common but challenging problem. There are usually at least dozens of candidates (regions) in an image, and how to evaluate these candidates is subjective. Most existing methods only use the feature corresponding to each candidate to evaluate the quality. However, the mutual relations between the candidates from an image play an essential role in composing a good shot due to the comparative nature of this problem. Motivated by this, we propose a graph-based module with a gated feature update to model the relations between different candidates. The candidate region features are propagated on a graph that models mutual relations between different regions for mining the useful information such that the relation features and region features are adaptively fused. We design a multi-task loss to train the model, especially, a regularization term is adopted to incorporate the prior knowledge about the relations into the graph. A data augmentation method is also developed by mixing nodes from different graphs to improve the model generalization ability. Experimental results show that the proposed model performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods, and comprehensive ablation studies demonstrate the contribution of each module and graph-based inference of the proposed method.
papers.title_zh: 利用相互关系利用好枪弹组合好枪弹
papers.abstract_zh: 从输入图像中找到良好构成的观点是一个共同但具有挑战性的问题。 通常至少有几十名候选人(区域)在图像中,如何评价这些候选人是主观的。 大多数现有方法只使用与每个候选人相应的功能来评价质量。 然而,由于这一问题的比较性质,来自图像的候选人之间的相互关系在形成一个好镜头方面发挥着至关重要的作用,为此,我们提议了一个基于图表的模块,配有一扇门的功能更新功能,以模拟不同候选人之间的关系。 候选区域的特征以图表形式传播,该图以不同区域之间在采矿方面的相互关系为模型,提供有用的信息,使关系特征和区域特征适应性地融合在一起。 我们设计了一个多任务损失来训练模型,特别是,采用了一个正规化术语,将先前对关系的知识纳入图中。 数据增强方法也通过混合不同图表的节点来开发,以提高模型的概括能力。 实验结果显示,拟议的模型优于最先进的方法,全面通货膨胀研究显示,每个模块和以图表为基础的对拟议方法的推论都有贡献。

papers.title: Bi-Directional Relationship Inferring Network for Referring Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhiwei Hu, Guang Feng, Jiayu Sun, Lihe Zhang, Huchuan Lu
papers.abstract: Most existing methods do not explicitly formulate the mutual guidance between vision and language. In this work, we propose a bi-directional relationship inferring network (BRINet) to model the dependencies of cross-modal information. In detail, the vision-guided linguistic attention is used to learn the adaptive linguistic context corresponding to each visual region. Combining with the language-guided visual attention, a bi-directional cross-modal attention module (BCAM) is built to learn the relationship between multi-modal features. Thus, the ultimate semantic context of the target object and referring expression can be represented accurately and consistently. Moreover, a gated bi-directional fusion module (GBFM) is designed to integrate the multi-level features where a gate function is used to guide the bi-directional flow of multi-level information. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms other state-of-the-art methods under different evaluation metrics.
papers.title_zh: 参考图像分割的双向关系引用网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们提议建立一个双向关系推断网络(BRINet),以模拟跨模式信息的依赖性。 详细来说,视觉引导语言关注被用于学习与每个视觉区域相应的适应性语言背景,与语言引导视觉关注相结合,建立了一个双向跨模式关注模块(BCAM),以学习多模式特征之间的关系。 因此,目标对象和参考表达方式的最终语义背景可以准确和一致地表达。 此外,还设计了一个双向闭锁聚变模块(GBFM),用于整合多级功能,即使用门功能指导多级信息的双向流动。 对四个基准数据集的广泛试验表明,拟议方法在不同的评价指标下优于其他最先进的方法。

papers.authors: Isabella Pozzi, Sander Bohte, Pieter Roelfsema
papers.title_zh: 引人注意的大脑传播:大脑如何实施基于奖励的错误反向传播

papers.title: Attention Convolutional Binary Neural Tree for Fine-Grained Visual Categorization
papers.authors: Ruyi Ji, Longyin Wen, Libo Zhang, Dawei Du, Yanjun Wu, Chen Zhao, Xianglong Liu, Feiyue Huang
papers.abstract: Fine-grained visual categorization (FGVC) is an important but challenging task due to high intra-class variances and low inter-class variances caused by deformation, occlusion, illumination, etc. An attention convolutional binary neural tree architecture is presented to address those problems for weakly supervised FGVC. Specifically, we incorporate convolutional operations along edges of the tree structure, and use the routing functions in each node to determine the root-to-leaf computational paths within the tree. The final decision is computed as the summation of the predictions from leaf nodes. The deep convolutional operations learn to capture the representations of objects, and the tree structure characterizes the coarse-to-fine hierarchical feature learning process. In addition, we use the attention transformer module to enforce the network to capture discriminative features. The negative log-likelihood loss is used to train the entire network in an end-to-end fashion by SGD with back-propagation. Several experiments on the CUB-200-2011, Stanford Cars and Aircraft datasets demonstrate that the proposed method performs favorably against the state-of-the-arts.
papers.title_zh: 用于精细可见视觉分类的 进取二进制神经树
papers.abstract_zh: 精细的视觉分类是一项重要但具有挑战性的任务,因为由于变形、隔离、照明等导致的阶级内部差异很大,阶级之间差异较小。 提出了一种关注进化双神经树结构,以解决受监管薄弱的FGVC的这些问题。 具体地说,我们结合了树木结构边缘的革命操作,并使用每个节点的路线函数来确定树内的根到叶的计算路径。最后决定是用叶节点预测的和数来计算。 深层革命操作学会捕捉物体的表示,而树结构是粗糙至细细的等级特征学习过程的特点。 此外,我们使用关注变压器模块强制实施网络以捕捉歧视特征。 负对数损失被SGD用于对整个网络进行终端至终端式的反向宣传培训。关于CUB-200-2011、斯坦福汽车和飞机数据集的几项实验表明,拟议方法对最新技术效果良好。

papers.title: ALFRED: A Benchmark for Interpreting Grounded Instructions for Everyday Tasks
papers.authors: Mohit Shridhar, Jesse Thomason, Daniel Gordon, Yonatan Bisk, Winson Han, Roozbeh Mottaghi, Luke Zettlemoyer, Dieter Fox
papers.abstract: We present ALFRED (Action Learning From Realistic Environments and Directives), a benchmark for learning a mapping from natural language instructions and egocentric vision to sequences of actions for household tasks. ALFRED includes long, compositional tasks with non-reversible state changes to shrink the gap between research benchmarks and real-world applications. ALFRED consists of expert demonstrations in interactive visual environments for 25k natural language directives. These directives contain both high-level goals like "Rinse off a mug and place it in the coffee maker." and low-level language instructions like "Walk to the coffee maker on the right." ALFRED tasks are more complex in terms of sequence length, action space, and language than existing vision- and-language task datasets. We show that a baseline model based on recent embodied vision-and-language tasks performs poorly on ALFRED, suggesting that there is significant room for developing innovative grounded visual language understanding models with this benchmark.
papers.title_zh: ALLRED:每日任务解释基础指示的基准
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了 " 从现实环境和指令中学习行动 " ,这是从自然语言指令和以自我为中心的视觉到家庭任务行动顺序的绘图的一个基准。 ALFRED包括长期的构成任务,其不可逆的状态变化缩小研究基准与现实应用之间的差距。 ALFRED包括在互动视觉环境中专家演示25k项自然语言指令。 这些指令包含两个高层次的目标, 比如“ 从杯子上冲出来, 放在咖啡机里 ” 。 以及“ 向右边的咖啡机前进” 等低层次语言指令。 ALFRED的任务在序列长度、 行动空间和语言上比现有的视觉和语言任务数据集复杂。 我们表明,基于最近体现的视觉和语言任务的基线模型在 " ALFRED " 上表现不佳,这表明,用这一基准来开发创新的、有根有基的视觉语言理解模型有很大的余地。

papers.title: Adaptive Probing Policies for Shortest Path Routing

papers.title: A Boundary Based Out-of-Distribution Classifier for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Xingyu Chen, Xuguang Lan, Fuchun Sun, Nanning Zheng
papers.abstract: Generalized Zero-Shot Learning (GZSL) is a challenging topic that has promising prospects in many realistic scenarios. Using a gating mechanism that discriminates the unseen samples from the seen samples can decompose the GZSL problem to a conventional Zero-Shot Learning (ZSL) problem and a supervised classification problem. However, training the gate is usually challenging due to the lack of data in the unseen domain. To resolve this problem, in this paper, we propose a boundary based Out-of-Distribution (OOD) classifier which classifies the unseen and seen domains by only using seen samples for training. First, we learn a shared latent space on a unit hyper-sphere where the latent distributions of visual features and semantic attributes are aligned class-wisely. Then we find the boundary and the center of the manifold for each class. By leveraging the class centers and boundaries, the unseen samples can be separated from the seen samples. After that, we use two experts to classify the seen and unseen samples separately. We extensively validate our approach on five popular benchmark datasets including AWA1, AWA2, CUB, FLO and SUN. The experimental results show that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art approaches by a significant margin."
papers.title_zh: 通用零热学习基于边界的分发分类
papers.abstract_zh: 普遍零热学习(GZSL)是一个具有挑战性的议题,在许多现实的情景下前景光明。 使用区分从所见样品中采集的未见样品的格子机制,可以将GZSL问题分解为常规的零热学习问题和受监督的分类问题,然而,由于在未见领域缺乏数据,培训大门通常具有挑战性。 为解决这一问题,我们在本文中提议建立一个基于边界的分流分类系统,仅将可见和可见区域分类,仅将可见样本用于培训。 首先,我们学习一个单位超视距的共享潜在空间, 在那里,视觉特征和语义属性的潜在分布可以对齐等级。 然后我们找到每个等级的边界和元件中心。 通过利用班级中心和边界,可以将看不见的样品与所看到的样品分开。 之后,我们用两名专家对所看到和看不见的样品分别进行分类。 我们广泛验证了我们在五个流行的基准数据集上的做法,包括AWA1、AW2、CUB、FLO和SUN。 实验结果显示我们的方法大大超过最先进的方法。

papers.title: Towards Accurate and Efficient 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Mixture-of-Experts Computing System on Edge
papers.authors: Linshen Liu · Boyan Su · Junyue Jiang · Guanlin Wu · Cong Guo · Ceyu Xu · Hao Frank Yang
papers.abstract: The paper introduces Edge-based Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Collaborative Computing (EMC2) system, the first multimodal MoE framework designed to address the conflicting requirements of low latency and high accuracy in diverse traffic scenarios for autonomous driving safety. EMC2’s key innovation is its scenario-aware computing architecture optimized for edge devices, which adaptively fuses LiDAR and image inputs by leveraging the complementary strengths of sparse 3D point clouds and dense 2D pixel grids. Specifically, an adaptive multimodal data bridge is designed that preprocesses LiDAR and image data using customized multi-scale pooling. A scenario-adaptive dispatcher then routes these fused features to specialized experts based on the object clarity and distance. Three collaborative expert models with complementary encoder-decoder architectures are designed and trained using a novel hierarchical multimodal loss and balanced sampling strategies. Then, in the inference stage, the EMC2 incorporates hardware-software co-optimization, spanning CPU thread allocation, GPU memory management, and computational graph optimization, to collaboratively enable efficient deployment on edge computing devices. Extensive evaluations conducted on open-source datasets demonstrate EMC2's superior performance, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 3.58% and an impressive 159.06% inference speedup compared to 15 leading methods on Jetson platforms. Such enhancements clearly meet the real-time operational expectations for autonomous vehicles, directly contributing to safer future transportation.
papers.title_zh: 实现为自主驾驶而精确和高效的三维物体探测:边缘专家混合计算机系统
papers.abstract_zh: 该文件介绍了以边缘为基础的专家混合协作计算系统(EMC2),这是第一个多式联运电子计算框架,旨在解决不同交通情况中低潜伏和高精确度对自主驾驶安全的相互冲突的要求。 EMC2的关键创新是其为边缘设备优化的情景认知计算结构,它通过利用稀疏的三维点云和稠密的二维像素网的互补优势,在适应性上将LiDAR和图像投入结合在一起。 具体地说,设计了一个适应性多式联运数据桥梁,用定制的多尺度集散处理LiDAR和图像数据,然后根据目标清晰度和距离将这些装配的装置传送给专门专家。 三个合作专家模型与补充编码器-编码器结构相结合,利用新的等级式多式联运损失和平衡抽样战略来设计和培训。 然后,在推论阶段,EMC2包含硬件软件共同优化、跨越CPU线分配、GPU内存管理和计算图优化,以便协作在边缘计算设备上有效部署。 对开放源码数据集进行的广泛评价表明EMC2的优异性能,平均精度提高3.58%,推断速度加快159.06%,比Jetson平台的15种主要方法快得多。 这种改进显然满足了对自治车辆的实时运行预期,直接有助于未来运输更加安全。

papers.title: Steered Mixture-of-Experts for Light Field Images and Video: Representation and Coding
papers.authors: Ruben Verhack, Thomas Sikora, Glenn Van Wallendael, Peter Lambert
papers.abstract: Research in light field (LF) processing has heavily increased over the last decade. This is largely driven by the desire to achieve the same level of immersion and navigational freedom for camera-captured scenes as it is currently available for CGI content. Standardization organizations such as MPEG and JPEG continue to follow conventional coding paradigms in which viewpoints are discretely represented on 2-D regular grids. These grids are then further decorrelated through hybrid DPCM/transform techniques. However, these 2-D regular grids are less suited for high-dimensional data, such as LFs. We propose a novel coding framework for higher-dimensional image modalities, called Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE). Coherent areas in the higher-dimensional space are represented by single higher-dimensional entities, called kernels. These kernels hold spatially localized information about light rays at any angle arriving at a certain region. The global model consists thus of a set of kernels which define a continuous approximation of the underlying plenoptic function. We introduce the theory of SMoE and illustrate its application for 2-D images, 4-D LF images, and 5-D LF video. We also propose an efficient coding strategy to convert the model parameters into a bitstream. Even without provisions for high-frequency information, the proposed method performs comparable to the state of the art for low-to-mid range bitrates with respect to subjective visual quality of 4-D LF images. In case of 5-D LF video, we observe superior decorrelation and coding performance with coding gains of a factor of 4x in bitrate for the same quality. At least equally important is the fact that our method inherently has desired functionality for LF rendering which is lacking in other state-of-the-art techniques: (1) full zero-delay random access, (2) light-weight pixel-parallel view reconstruction, and (3) intrinsic view interpolation and super-resolution.
papers.title_zh: 光场图像和视频:代表性和编码
papers.abstract_zh: 过去十年来,光场(LF)加工的研究大量增加,这主要是由于希望使摄像场的沉浸和导航自由达到与目前供全球安全协调组使用的内容相同的水平。 诸如MPEG和JPEG等标准化组织继续遵循传统编码模式,在2D常规网格上独立代表各种观点,然后通过混合DPCM/变换技术进一步规范这些网格。 然而,这些二维常规网格不那么适合高维数据,如低频数据。 我们为高维图像模式提议了一个新型的编码框架,称为“SmoE ” ( Steered Mixture- of-Experts ) 。 高维空间的相协调区域由称为内核的单一高维实体代表,这些内核在到达某一区域的任何角度上都掌握着光线的空间局部信息。 因此,全球模型由一组内核组成,这些内核界定了基本光学功能的连续近似值。 我们引入了SMoE理论,并演示了该理论对二维图像、四维LF图像和五维LF视频的应用。 我们还提出了将模型参数转换为位流的有效编码战略。 即使没有提供高频信息,拟议方法在四维低频图像的主观视觉质量方面也与中低距离比特率的先进水平相当。 在5-D LF视频的情况下,我们观察到高端的装饰和编码性能,以同一质量的比特速率乘以4x系数的编码收益。 至少同样重要的是,我们的方法本身就具备了LF生成的预期功能,而其他最先进的技术却缺乏这种功能:(1) 完全无延迟随机访问,(2) 轻量象素平行观察重建,以及(3) 内在观点内插和超分辨率。

papers.title: Quantized and Regularized Optimization for Coding Images Using Steered Mixtures-of-Experts
papers.authors: Rolf Jongebloed, Erik Bochinski, Lieven Lange, Thomas Sikora
papers.abstract: Compression algorithms that employ Mixtures-of-Experts depart drastically from standard hybrid block-based transform domain approaches as in JPEG and MPEG coders. In previous works we introduced the concept of Steered Mixtures-of-Experts (SMoEs) to arrive at sparse representations of signals. SMoEs are gating networks trained in a machine learning approach that allow individual experts to explain and harvest directional long-range correlation in the N-dimensional signal space. Previous results showed excellent potential for compression of images and videos but the reconstruction quality was mainly limited to low and medium image quality. In this paper we provide evidence that SMoEs can compete with JPEG2000 at mid-and high-range bit-rates. To this end we introduce a SMoE approach for compression of color images with specialized gates and steering experts. A novel machine learning approach is introduced that optimizes RD-performance of quantized SMoEs towards SSIM using fake quantization. We drastically improve our previous results and outperform JPEG by up to 42%.
papers.title_zh: 利用专家的固定混合物对编码图像进行量化和规范化优化
papers.abstract_zh: 使用混合式专家的压缩算法与标准的混合式块基转换域法大相径庭,如JPEG和MPEG编码器。在以前的著作中,我们引入了Steered Mixtures of-Experters(SMoEs)的概念,以达到信号很少的表达方式。 SMoE正在建立经过机械学习方法培训的网络,使个别专家能够解释和收获N-维信号空间的定向远程相关关系。 先前的成果显示,压缩图像和视频的潜力极佳,但重建质量主要限于中低图像质量。 在本文中,我们提供了证据,证明SMOEs可以中、高比特率与JPEG2000竞争。 为此,我们引入了配有专门门和指导专家的彩色图像压缩SMoE方法。 引入了新型机器学习方法,优化量化的SMOEs的RD-表现,以假量化方式向SSSIM优化。 我们大幅改善我们先前的成果,并比JPEG高高达42%。

papers.title: Nesti-Net: Normal Estimation for Unstructured 3D Point Clouds Using Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Yizhak Ben-Shabat, Michael Lindenbaum, Anath Fischer
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a normal estimation method for unstructured 3D point clouds. This method, called Nesti-Net, builds on a new local point cloud representation which consists of multi-scale point statistics (MuPS), estimated on a local coarse Gaussian grid. This representation is a suitable input to a CNN architecture. The normals are estimated using a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture, which relies on a data-driven approach for selecting the optimal scale around each point and encourages sub-network specialization. Interesting insights into the network's resource distribution are provided. The scale prediction significantly improves robustness to different noise levels, point density variations and different levels of detail. We achieve state-of-the-art results on a benchmark synthetic dataset and present qualitative results on real scanned scenes.
papers.title_zh: Nesti-Net:利用进化神经网络对无结构的三维点云进行正常估计
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们为未结构化的三维点云提出了一个正常估计方法。这个方法叫做Nesti-Net,它基于一个新的局部点云表示法,由多尺度点统计组成,根据当地粗粗高斯电网估算。 这种代表方式是对CNN架构的适当输入。 正常情况使用专家混合架构估算,该架构依靠数据驱动方法选择每个点的最佳比例,并鼓励子网络专业化。 提供了对网络资源分布的有趣见解,对规模的预测大大提高了不同噪音水平、点密度变化和不同细节水平的稳健性。 我们在基准合成数据集上取得最新成果,并在实际扫描场景上提出质量成果。

papers.title: Mimic Embedding via Adaptive Aggregation: Learning Generalizable Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Boqiang Xu, Jian Liang, Lingxiao He, Zhenan Sun
papers.abstract: "Domain generalizable (DG) person re-identification (ReID) aims to test across unseen domains without access to the target domain data at training time, which is a realistic but challenging problem. In contrast to methods assuming an identical model for different domains, Mixture of Experts (MoE) exploits multiple domain-specific networks for leveraging complementary information between domains, obtaining impressive results. However, prior MoE-based DG ReID methods suffer from a large model size with the increase of the number of source domains, and most of them overlook the exploitation of domain-invariant characteristics. To handle the two issues above, this paper presents a new approach called Mimic Embedding via adapTive Aggregation (META) for DG person ReID. To avoid the large model size, experts in META do not adopt a branch network for each source domain but share all the parameters except for the batch normalization layers. Besides multiple experts, META leverages Instance Normalization (IN) and introduces it into a global branch to pursue invariant features across domains. Meanwhile, META considers the relevance of an unseen target sample and source domains via normalization statistics and develops an aggregation module to adaptively integrate multiple experts for mimicking unseen target domain. Benefiting from a proposed consistency loss and an episodic training algorithm, META is expected to mimic embedding for a truly unseen target domain. Extensive experiments verify that META surpasses state-of-the-art DG person ReID methods by a large margin."
papers.title_zh: 通过适应性聚合体嵌入微生物:学习一般人重新认同
papers.abstract_zh: 无法在训练时间获取目标域数据, 这是一项现实但具有挑战性的问题。 校对:Soup 与为不同领域设想相同模式的方法不同的是,专家混合利用多个具体领域的网络,利用不同领域之间的互补信息,取得令人印象深刻的成果。 然而,以前以MoE为基础的DG ReID方法由于源域数目的增加而具有庞大的模型规模,其中多数忽视了对域变量特性的利用。 为处理上述两个问题,本文为DG 人雷伊德介绍了一种新办法,称为“通过适应性聚合嵌入”Micic Emplication(META),为避免模型规模大,META的专家没有为每个源域采用分支网络,而是除批次正常化层外共享所有参数。 除了多位专家外,META还利用《公约》的正常化,将其引入一个全球分支,以追求各领域的不变特征。 同时,META通过正常化统计,考虑一个无形目标样本和源域的相关性,并开发一个汇总模块,以适应性地融合多个专家,以模拟无形目标域。 META从拟议的一致性损失和偶发培训算法中获益,预计将模仿嵌入一个真正不可见的目标域。 广泛的实验证实META大大超过最先进的DG人雷伊德方法。 ”

papers.title: Learning to Compose Topic-Aware Mixture of Experts for Zero-Shot Video Captioning
papers.authors: Xin Wang, Jiawei Wu, Da Zhang, Yu Su, William Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Although promising results have been achieved in video captioning, existing models are limited to the fixed inventory of activities in the training corpus, and do not generalize to open vocabulary scenarios. Here we introduce a novel task, zeroshot video captioning, that aims at describing out-of-domain videos of unseen activities. Videos of different activities usually require different captioning strategies in many aspects, i.e. word selection, semantic construction, and style expression etc, which poses a great challenge to depict novel activities without paired training data. But meanwhile, similar activities share some of those aspects in common. Therefore, we propose a principled Topic-Aware Mixture of Experts (TAMoE) model for zero-shot video captioning, which learns to compose different experts based on different topic embeddings, implicitly transferring the knowledge learned from seen activities to unseen ones. Besides, we leverage external topic-related text corpus to construct the topic embedding for each activity, which embodies the most relevant semantic vectors within the topic. Empirical results not only validate the effectiveness of our method in utilizing semantic knowledge for video captioning, but also show its strong generalization ability when describing novel activities.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: 学习为零热视频字幕拼写主题- 软件专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然在录像字幕方面取得了可喜的成果,但现有模式仅限于培训教材中固定的活动清单,并不概括于开放词汇设想。 在此,我们介绍一项新的任务,即零光视频字幕,目的是描述无形活动的场外视频。 不同活动的视频通常需要在许多方面,即:不同标题战略。 语言选择、语义构造和风格表达等给描述没有配对培训数据的新颖活动带来了巨大挑战。 但与此同时,类似的活动也有一些共同之处。 因此,我们提议为零光视频字幕采用有原则的专题知识专家混合模型,该模型学习根据不同专题嵌入内容组成不同的专家,将从所见活动学到的知识隐含地转移到无形活动。 此外,我们利用与专题有关的外部文字材料,为每项活动构建嵌入的专题,这体现了专题内最相关的语义矢量。 经验结果不仅证实了我们利用语义知识制作视频字幕的方法的有效性,而且在描述新活动时也显示出其很强的概括能力。

papers.title: Learning a Mixture of Granularity-Specific Experts for Fine-Grained Categorization
papers.authors: Lianbo Zhang, Shaoli Huang, Wei Liu, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: We aim to divide the problem space of fine-grained recognition into some specific regions. To achieve this, we develop a unified framework based on a mixture of experts. Due to limited data available for the fine-grained recognition problem, it is not feasible to learn diverse experts by using a data division strategy. To tackle the problem, we promote diversity among experts by combing an expert gradually-enhanced learning strategy and a Kullback-Leibler divergence based constraint. The strategy learns new experts on the dataset with the prior knowledge from former experts and adds them to the model sequentially, while the introduced constraint forces the experts to produce diverse prediction distribution. These drive the experts to learn the task from different aspects, making them specialized in different subspace problems. Experiments show that the resulting model improves the classification performance and achieves the state-of-the-art performance on several fine-grained benchmark datasets.
papers.title_zh: 学习精细分类的颗粒特定专家混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 我们的目标是将微小的承认问题的空间分给某些特定区域,为此,我们根据专家混合情况,制定一个统一框架。 由于微小的认知问题可用数据有限,使用数据分割战略学习不同专家是不可行的。 为了解决这个问题,我们通过对专家逐步强化的学习战略和基于库尔贝克-利伯尔差异的制约进行梳理,促进专家的多样性。 该战略利用前专家先前的知识,在数据集方面学习新的专家,并按顺序将他们加入模型,而引进的制约因素迫使专家提供不同的预测分布。 这些实验促使专家从不同方面学习任务,使他们专门研究不同的子空间问题。 实验显示,由此形成的模型提高了分类性能,并在几个精细采集的基准数据集上取得了最先进的业绩。

papers.title: Expert Sample Consensus Applied to Camera Re-Localization
papers.authors: Eric Brachmann, Carsten Rother
papers.abstract: Fitting model parameters to a set of noisy data points is a common problem in computer vision. In this work, we fit the 6D camera pose to a set of noisy correspondences between the 2D input image and a known 3D environment. We estimate these correspondences from the image using a neural network. Since the correspondences often contain outliers, we utilize a robust estimator such as Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) or Differentiable RANSAC (DSAC) to fit the pose parameters. When the problem domain, e.g. the space of all 2D-3D correspondences, is large or ambiguous, a single network does not cover the domain well. Mixture of Experts (MoE) is a popular strategy to divide a problem domain among an ensemble of specialized networks, so called experts, where a gating network decides which expert is responsible for a given input. In this work, we introduce Expert Sample Consensus (ESAC), which integrates DSAC in a MoE. Our main technical contribution is an efficient method to train ESAC jointly and end-to-end. We demonstrate experimentally that ESAC handles two real-world problems better than competing methods, i.e. scalability and ambiguity. We apply ESAC to fitting simple geometric models to synthetic images, and to camera re-localization for difficult, real datasets.
papers.title_zh: 适用于照相机重新本地化的专家共识
papers.abstract_zh: 将模型参数与一组吵闹的数据点相匹配是计算机视觉中常见的问题。 在这项工作中,我们将6D摄像头与一组2D输入图像和已知的3D环境之间的吵闹通信相匹配。 我们使用神经网络从图像中估算这些通信。 由于信函中往往含有外部线,我们使用一个强有力的估计数据,如随机抽样共识(RANSAC)或可区分的RANSAC(DSAAC),以适应表面参数。 2D-3D所有通信的空间大小或含混不清,单一网络不覆盖域名井。 专家混合(MoE)是一项流行战略,旨在将一个问题领域分给一组专门网络,即所谓的专家,在专家网络中,由哪个专家负责某项投入。 在这项工作中,我们介绍专家抽样共识(ESAC),它将DSAC纳入MoE。 我们的主要技术贡献是联合和最终培训ESC的有效方法。 我们实验性地证明,ESC处理两个现实世界问题胜过竞争方法,即可扩缩性和模糊性。 我们应用ESAC将简单的几何模型安装到合成图像上,并用相机重新定位,用于困难的、真实的数据集。

papers.title: Convolutional mixture of experts model: A comparative study on automatic macular diagnosis in retinal optical coherence tomography imaging
papers.authors: Alireza Mehridehnavi, Reza Rasti, Hossein Rabbani, Fedra Hajizadeh
papers.abstract: Background: Macular disorders, such as diabetic macular edema (DME) and age-related macular degeneration (AMD) are among the major ocular diseases. Having one of these diseases can lead to vision impairments or even permanent blindness in a not-so-long time span. So, the early diagnosis of these diseases are the main goals for researchers in the field. Methods: This study is designed in order to present a comparative analysis on the recent convolutional mixture of experts (CMoE) models for distinguishing normal macular OCT from DME and AMD. For this purpose, we considered three recent CMoE models called Mixture ensemble of convolutional neural networks (ME-CNN), Multi-scale Convolutional Mixture of Experts (MCME), and Wavelet-based Convolutional Mixture of Experts (WCME) models. For this research study, the models were evaluated on a database of three different macular OCT sets. Two first OCT sets were acquired by Heidelberg imaging systems consisting of 148 and 45 subjects respectively and set3 was constituted of 384 Bioptigen OCT acquisitions. To provide better performance insight into the CMoE ensembles, we extensively analyzed the models based on the 5-fold cross-validation method and various classification measures such as precision and average area under the ROC curve (AUC). Results: Experimental evaluations showed that the MCME and WCME outperformed the ME-CNN model and presented overall precisions of 98.14% and 96.06% for aligned OCTs respectively. For non-aligned retinal OCTs, these values were 93.95% and 95.56%. Conclusion: Based on the comparative analysis, although the MCME model outperformed the other CMoE models in the analysis of aligned retinal OCTs, the WCME offers a robust model for diagnosis of non-aligned retinal OCTs. This allows having a fast and robust computer-aided system in macular OCT imaging which does not rely on the routine computerized processes such as denoising, segmentation of retinal layers, and also retinal layers alignment.
papers.title_zh: 进化专家混合模型模型:关于视光光光一致性断层摄影成像中自动肌肉诊断的比较研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:骨骼疾病,如糖尿病眼肿(DME)和与年龄有关的肌肉畸形(AMD)是主要的眼科疾病,其中一种疾病在不长的时间内会导致视力障碍,甚至永久失明。 因此,早期诊断这些疾病是本领域研究人员的主要目标。方法:本研究旨在对最近专家的演变混合模式进行比较分析,以区分正常的肌肉OCT与DME和AMD。 为此目的,我们审议了最近三个CMOE模型,称为 " 变幻神经网络混合组合 " (ME-CNN)、 " 专家的多规模变幻混合 " (MCME)和 " 以波盘为基础的变幻混合 " (WCME)模型。 为进行此项研究,在由三套不同的雄性OCT机组组成的数据库中对这些模型进行了评价,海德堡成像系统分别获得148个和45个科目的两套OCT机组,3组由384个生物基OCT机组组成。 为了更好地了解CMOE组合的绩效,我们广泛分析了基于5倍交叉验证方法的模型以及各种分类措施,如ROC曲线下的精确度和平均面积。 实验结果:实验性评估显示,MCME和WCME的表现超过了ME-CNN模型,对匹配的OCT的精确度分别为98.14%和96.06%。对于不结盟的视网膜OCT,这些值分别为93.95%和95.56%。 结论:根据比较分析,虽然MCME模型在分析对准视网膜有机氯乙烯时优于其他CMoE模型,但CWME为诊断不结盟视网膜有机氯乙烯提供了一个强有力的模型。 这样就可以在毛骨悚然的OCT成像中有一个快速和强大的计算机辅助系统,这种成像不依赖于常规的计算机化程序,如视网膜分解、视网膜分解和视网膜对齐。

papers.title: What Object Should I Use? - Task Driven Object Detection
papers.authors: Johann Sawatzky, Yaser Souri, Christian Grund, Jurgen Gall
papers.abstract: When humans have to solve everyday tasks, they simply pick the objects that are most suitable. While the question which object should one use for a specific task sounds trivial for humans, it is very difficult to answer for robots or other autonomous systems. This issue, however, is not addressed by current benchmarks for object detection that focus on detecting object categories. We therefore introduce the COCO-Tasks dataset which comprises about 40,000 images where the most suitable objects for 14 tasks have been annotated. We furthermore propose an approach that detects the most suitable objects for a given task. The approach builds on a Gated Graph Neural Network to exploit the appearance of each object as well as the global context of all present objects in the scene. In our experiments, we show that the proposed approach outperforms other approaches that are evaluated on the dataset like classification or ranking approaches.
papers.title_zh: 我应使用什么对象? - 任务驱动器对象探测
papers.abstract_zh: 当人类必须解决日常任务时,他们只选择最合适的对象。 具体任务应该使用哪个对象的问题对于人类来说听起来微不足道,但对于机器人或其他自主系统来说却很难回答。 然而,目前侧重于探测物体类别的物体探测基准没有涉及这一问题,因此,我们引入COCO-Tassk数据集,由大约40 000张图像组成,其中14项任务最合适的物体已加注。 我们还提出一种方法,用以探测某项任务最合适的物体,该方法以一个Gated图形神经网络为基础,利用每个物体的外观以及现场所有现有物体的全球背景。 在我们的实验中,我们表明,拟议的方法优于在数据集上评价的其他方法,如分类或排名方法。

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Energy-Based Learning for Action Segmentation
papers.authors: Jun Li, Peng Lei, Sinisa Todorovic
papers.abstract: This paper is about labeling video frames with action classes under weak supervision in training, where we have access to a temporal ordering of actions, but their start and end frames in training videos are unknown. Following prior work, we use an HMM grounded on a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) for frame labeling. Our key contribution is a new constrained discriminative forward loss (CDFL) that we use for training the HMM and GRU under weak supervision. While prior work typically estimates the loss on a single, inferred video segmentation, our CDFL discriminates between the energy of all valid and invalid frame labelings of a training video. A valid frame labeling satisfies the ground-truth temporal ordering of actions, whereas an invalid one violates the ground truth. We specify an efficient recursive algorithm for computing the CDFL in terms of the logadd function of the segmentation energy. Our evaluation on action segmentation and alignment gives superior results to those of the state of the art on the benchmark Breakfast Action, Hollywood Extended, and 50Salads datasets.
papers.title_zh: 监督薄弱的能源学习促进行动部分
papers.abstract_zh: 本文涉及将视频框架与培训监管不力的行动课贴上标签,我们可以在那里获得时间序列的行动,但培训视频中的开始和结束框架还不清楚。 在此前的工作之后,我们使用基于Gate 经常项目组(GRU)的 HMM 设置框架标签。 我们的主要贡献是一种新的受限制的歧视性前方损失(CDFL),我们在薄弱的监督下用于培训HMM和GRU。 虽然先前的工作通常估计损失是在一个单一的、推断的视频分割上损失的,但我国的CDFL对培训视频的所有有效与无效框架标签的能量加以区分。 有效的框架标签符合地面真实时间动作顺序, 而无效的标签则违反地面真相。 我们指定了一种高效的递归算法, 用于计算 CDFL , 即分离能量的对数函数 。 我们对行动分解和调整的评估,取得了优于早餐行动、好莱坞扩展和50Salads数据集基准的最新成果。

papers.title: WarpGAN: Automatic Caricature Generation
papers.authors: Yichun Shi, Debayan Deb, Anil K. Jain
papers.abstract: We propose, WarpGAN, a fully automatic network that can generate caricatures given an input face photo. Besides transferring rich texture styles, WarpGAN learns to automatically predict a set of control points that can warp the photo into a caricature, while preserving identity. We introduce an identity-preserving adversarial loss that aids the discriminator to distinguish between different subjects. Moreover, WarpGAN allows customization of the generated caricatures by controlling the exaggeration extent and the visual styles. Experimental results on a public domain dataset, WebCaricature, show that WarpGAN is capable of generating caricatures that not only preserve the identities but also outputs a diverse set of caricatures for each input photo. Five caricature experts suggest that caricatures generated by WarpGAN are visually similar to hand-drawn ones and only prominent facial features are exaggerated.
papers.title_zh: WarpGAN: 自动解剖生成
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提议,WarpGAN(WarpGAN),这是一个完全自动的网络,可以生成带输入面部照片的漫画。 WarpGAN(WarpGAN)除了传输丰富的纹理风格外,还学会自动预测一系列控制点,这些控制点可以在保存身份的同时将照片失真成一个漫画。 此外,WarpGAN(WarpGAN)允许通过控制夸大度和视觉风格来定制生成的漫画。 公共域数据集WebCaricature的实验结果显示,WarpGAN能够产生漫画,不仅保存身份,而且为每张输入照片提供各种漫画。 五名漫画专家指出,WarpGAN产生的漫画在视觉上与手工绘制的漫画相似,只有突出的面部特征被夸大。

papers.title: Video Relationship Reasoning Using Gated Spatio-Temporal Energy Graph
papers.authors: Yao-Hung Hubert Tsai, Santosh Divvala, Louis-Philippe Morency, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Ali Farhadi
papers.abstract: Visual relationship reasoning is a crucial yet challenging task for understanding rich interactions across visual concepts. For example, a relationship man, open, door involves a complex relation open between concrete entities man, door . While much of the existing work has studied this problem in the context of still images, understanding visual relationships in videos has received limited attention. Due to their temporal nature, videos enable us to model and reason about a more comprehensive set of visual relationships, such as those requiring multiple (temporal) observations (e.g., man, lift up, box vs. man, put down, box ), as well as relationships that are often correlated through time (e.g., woman, pay, money followed by woman, buy, coffee ). In this paper, we construct a Conditional Random Field on a fully-connected spatio-temporal graph that exploits the statistical dependency between relational entities spatially and temporally. We introduce a novel gated energy function parametrization that learns adaptive relations conditioned on visual observations. Our model optimization is computationally efficient, and its space computation complexity is significantly amortized through our proposed parameterization. Experimental results on benchmark video datasets (ImageNet Video and Charades) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across three standard relationship reasoning tasks: Detection, Tagging, and Recognition.
papers.title_zh: 使用Gated Spatio-Temporal能源图进行视频关系解释
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉关系推理是理解不同视觉概念的丰富互动关系的关键而具有挑战性的任务。 比如,一个开放的、敞开的男女关系人涉及具体实体之间的复杂关系。 虽然许多现有工作在静态图像背景下研究了这一问题,但了解视频中的视觉关系受到的关注有限。 由于其时间性质,视频使我们能够模拟和解释一套更全面的视觉关系,例如那些需要多次(时)观察的关系(例如,人、抬起、盒子对面等)。 女性、工资、钱财、购买、咖啡等关系。 在本文中,我们用一个完全连接的时空空间图来构建一个有条件随机场,在空间和时间上利用关系实体之间的统计依赖性。我们引入了一个新型的封闭式能源功能对称化,学习以视觉观察为条件的适应关系。 我们的模型优化是计算效率高的,其空间计算复杂性通过我们提议的参数化而大大摊销。 基准视频数据集(图像网视频和剧本)的实验结果显示,在三个标准关系推理任务:探测、拖网和承认方面,最先进的业绩表现。

papers.title: Unsupervised Face Normalization With Extreme Pose and Expression in the Wild
papers.authors: Yichen Qian, Weihong Deng, Jiani Hu
papers.abstract: Face recognition achieves great success thanks to the emergence of deep learning. However, many contemporary face recognition models still have limited invariance to strong intra-personal variations such as large pose changes. Face normalization provides an effective and cheap way to distil face identity and dispel face variances for recognition. We focus on face generation in the wild with unpaired data. To this end, we propose a Face Normalization Model (FNM) to generate a frontal, neutral expression, photorealistic face image for face recognition. FNM is a well-designed Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) with three distinct novelties. First, a face expert network is introduced to construct generator and provide the ability of retaining face identity. Second, with the reconstruction of normal face, pixel-wise loss is applied to stabilize optimization process. Third, we present a series of face attention discriminators to refine local textures. FNM could recover canonical-view, expression-free image and directly improve the performance of face recognition model. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments on both controlled and in-the-wild databases demonstrate the superiority of our face normalization method.
papers.title_zh: 野外无监督的面部正常化 与极端的花花和表情表现在野外
papers.abstract_zh: 由于深层学习的出现,面对面的承认取得了巨大成功,然而,许多当代的面对面的承认模式对于个人内部的巨大差异,如巨大的变化,仍然缺乏足够的灵活性。 面部正常化提供了一种有效和廉价的方法来提取面部特征和消除面部差异以获得承认。 我们注重在野外生成面部数据,而这些数据却得不到重视。 为此,我们建议采用面板正常化模型(FNM),以生成面部、中性表达式、照片真实面部图像,供面部识别。 FNM是一个设计完善的创世对立网络(GAN ) , 有三个独特的新颖之处。 首先,引入了面部专家网络来建造发电机和提供保持面部身份的能力;第二,随着正常面部的重建,像素损失被用于稳定优化过程。第三,我们提出了一系列面部关注歧视,以完善当地的质地。 FNM可以恢复光谱、无表达式图像,直接改善面部识别模型的性能。 在受控和动态数据库上进行广泛的定性和定量实验表明我们面部正常化方法的优越性。

papers.title: Underexposed Photo Enhancement Using Deep Illumination Estimation
papers.authors: Ruixing Wang, Qing Zhang, Chi-Wing Fu, Xiaoyong Shen, Wei-Shi Zheng, Jiaya Jia
papers.abstract: This paper presents a new neural network for enhancing underexposed photos. Instead of directly learning an image-to-image mapping as previous work, we introduce intermediate illumination in our network to associate the input with expected enhancement result, which augments the network's capability to learn complex photographic adjustment from expert-retouched input/output image pairs. Based on this model, we formulate a loss function that adopts constraints and priors on the illumination, prepare a new dataset of 3,000 underexposed image pairs, and train the network to effectively learn a rich variety of adjustment for diverse lighting conditions. By these means, our network is able to recover clear details, distinct contrast, and natural color in the enhancement results. We perform extensive experiments on the benchmark MIT-Adobe FiveK dataset and our new dataset, and show that our network is effective to deal with previously challenging images.
papers.title_zh: 利用深光光度估算法对照片进行曝光不足的强化
papers.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一个新的神经网络,以加强未受充分曝光的照片。 我们不再像以往的工作那样直接学习图像到图像绘图,而是在我们的网络中引入中间光化,将输入与预期的增强效果联系起来,从而增强网络从专家调阅的输入/产出图像配对中学习复杂的摄影调整的能力。 基于这一模型,我们制定一种损失功能,采用对照明的制约和前科,编制一套由3 000个未受充分暴露的图像配对组成的新数据集,并培训网络,以有效学习对不同照明条件的多种调整。 通过这些手段,我们的网络能够在增强成果中恢复清晰的细节、截然不同的对比和自然颜色。 我们在麻省理工学院-阿多贝五K数据库基准和我们的新数据集上进行了广泛的实验,并表明我们的网络能够有效地处理以往具有挑战性的图像。

papers.title: Uncertainty Modeling of Contextual-Connections Between Tracklets for Unconstrained Video-Based Face Recognition
papers.authors: Jingxiao Zheng, Ruichi Yu, Jun-Cheng Chen, Boyu Lu, Carlos D. Castillo, Rama Chellappa
papers.abstract: Unconstrained video-based face recognition is a challenging problem due to significant within-video variations caused by pose, occlusion and blur. To tackle this problem, an effective idea is to propagate the identity from high-quality faces to low-quality ones through contextual connections, which are constructed based on context such as body appearance. However, previous methods have often propagated erroneous information due to lack of uncertainty modeling of the noisy contextual connections. In this paper, we propose the Uncertainty-Gated Graph (UGG), which conducts graph-based identity propagation between tracklets, which are represented by nodes in a graph. UGG explicitly models the uncertainty of the contextual connections by adaptively updating the weights of the edge gates according to the identity distributions of the nodes during inference. UGG is a generic graphical model that can be applied at only inference time or with end-to-end training. We demonstrate the effectiveness of UGG with state-of-the-art results in the recently released challenging Cast Search in Movies and IARPA Janus Surveillance Video Benchmark dataset.
papers.title_zh: 不受限制的视频脸面识别跟踪之间的上下文连接的不确定性建模
papers.abstract_zh: 不受限制的视像脸部识别是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为布局、隐蔽和模糊造成的视像内差异很大。 为了解决这一问题,一个有效的想法是通过背景联系,从高品质面孔向低品质面孔传播身份,这种背景联系是以身体外貌等背景为基础的。 然而,以往的方法常常传播错误信息,原因是对吵闹的环境关联缺乏不确定性的模型。 在本文中,我们建议采用不确定性定位图(UGG ) , 以图示方式在赛道之间传播身份信息,在图中以节点表示。 通过根据推断期间节点的特征分布,适应性地更新边缘门的重量,从而明确地模拟了背景关联的不确定性。 普遍治理是一个通用图形模型,只能用于推论时间或端对端培训。 我们以最新成果展示了全球治理联盟的实效,最近发布了《电影中挑战性的种姓搜索》和《国际反贪局协会Janus监控视频基准数据集》。

papers.title: Task-Driven Modular Networks for Zero-Shot Compositional Learning
papers.authors: Senthil Purushwalkam, Maximilian Nickel, Abhinav Gupta, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato
papers.abstract: One of the hallmarks of human intelligence is the ability to compose learned knowledge into novel concepts which can be recognized without a single training example. In contrast, current state-of-the-art methods require hundreds of training examples for each possible category to build reliable and accurate classifiers. To alleviate this striking difference in efficiency, we propose a task-driven modular architecture for compositional reasoning and sample efficient learning. Our architecture consists of a set of neural network modules, which are small fully connected layers operating in semantic concept space. These modules are configured through a gating function conditioned on the task to produce features representing the compatibility between the input image and the concept under consideration. This enables us to express tasks as a combination of sub-tasks and to generalize to unseen categories by reweighting a set of small modules. Furthermore, the network can be trained efficiently as it is fully differentiable and its modules operate on small sub-spaces. We focus our study on the problem of compositional zero-shot classification of object-attribute categories. We show in our experiments that current evaluation metrics are flawed as they only consider unseen object-attribute pairs. When extending the evaluation to the generalized setting which accounts also for pairs seen during training, we discover that naive baseline methods perform similarly or better than current approaches. However, our modular network is able to outperform all existing approaches on two widely-used benchmark datasets.
papers.title_zh: 零热成份学习任务驱动模块网络
papers.abstract_zh: 人类情报的一个特征是能够将所学知识转化为新概念,这些新概念可以在没有单一培训实例的情况下得到承认。 相比之下,目前最先进的方法要求为每个可能的类别提供数百个培训范例,以建立可靠和准确的分类方法。 为了缓解效率的这一显著差异,我们提议了一个任务驱动模块架构,用于组成推理和抽样有效学习。 我们的建筑由一套神经网络模块组成,这些模块小,完全相连,在语义概念空间运行。 这些模块通过基于任务设定的格子功能配置,以产生显示输入图像与所考虑的概念之间的兼容性的特征。 这使我们能够将任务作为子任务组合来表达,并通过对一组小模块进行重新加权,将任务概括到不可见的类别。 此外,网络可以高效地培训,因为它是完全不同的,其模块在小的子空间运作。 我们的研究侧重于对象归属类别的组成零射分解问题。 我们在实验中显示,目前的评价指标存在缺陷,因为它们只考虑看不见的对象归属对。 在将评价扩大到也考虑到培训期间所看到的对子的通用环境时,我们发现天真的基线方法比当前方法效果相似或更好。 然而,我们的模块网络在两个广泛使用的基准数据集上能够超越所有现有方法。

papers.authors: Karim Ahmed, Lorenzo Torresani
papers.title_zh: STAR-Caps: 带直穿引引路运行的立体网络

papers.title: SpotTune: Transfer Learning Through Adaptive Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Yunhui Guo, Honghui Shi, Abhishek Kumar, Kristen Grauman, Tajana Rosing, Rogerio Feris
papers.abstract: Transfer learning, which allows a source task to affect the inductive bias of the target task, is widely used in computer vision. The typical way of conducting transfer learning with deep neural networks is to fine-tune a model pretrained on the source task using data from the target task. In this paper, we propose an adaptive fine-tuning approach, called SpotTune, which finds the optimal fine-tuning strategy per instance for the target data. In SpotTune, given an image from the target task, a policy network is used to make routing decisions on whether to pass the image through the fine-tuned layers or the pre-trained layers. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Our method outperforms the traditional fine-tuning approach on 12 out of 14 standard datasets. We also compare SpotTune with other state-of-the-art fine-tuning strategies, showing superior performance. On the Visual Decathlon datasets, our method achieves the highest score across the board without bells and whistles.
papers.title_zh: SpotTunne:通过适应性微调调整转移学习
papers.abstract_zh: 转移学习使源任务能够影响目标任务的感性偏差,在计算机视觉中广泛使用。 与深层神经网络进行转移学习的典型方式是利用目标任务的数据微调对源任务预先培训的模型进行微调。 在本文中,我们建议采用称为SpotTune的适应性微调办法,这种办法为目标数据逐个找到最佳微调战略。 在SpotTune,根据目标任务的形象,一个政策网络被用来就是否通过微调的层或预先培训的层通过图像作出路由决定,我们进行了广泛的实验,以证明拟议方法的有效性。 在14个标准数据集中,我们的方法超过了传统的微调方法。 我们还将SpotTune与其他最先进的微调战略进行了比较,展示了优异的性能。 在视觉的Decathlon数据集中,我们的方法在没有钟声和哨声的情况下取得了全局最高分。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Dynamics and Semantic Attribute Enriched Visual Encoding for Video Captioning
papers.authors: Nayyer Aafaq, Naveed Akhtar, Wei Liu, Syed Zulqarnain Gilani, Ajmal Mian
papers.abstract: Automatic generation of video captions is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent techniques typically employ a combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recursive Neural Networks (RNNs) for video captioning. These methods mainly focus on tailoring sequence learning through RNNs for better caption generation, whereas off-the-shelf visual features are borrowed from CNNs. We argue that careful designing of visual features for this task is equally important, and present a visual feature encoding technique to generate semantically rich captions using Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs). Our method embeds rich temporal dynamics in visual features by hierarchically applying Short Fourier Transform to CNN features of the whole video. It additionally derives high level semantics from an object detector to enrich the representation with spatial dynamics of the detected objects. The final representation is projected to a compact space and fed to a language model. By learning a relatively simple language model comprising two GRU layers, we establish new state-of-the-art on MSVD and MSR-VTT datasets for METEOR and ROUGE_L metrics.
papers.title_zh: 用于视频字幕描述的 Spatio-Tempio-Temporal动态和语义属性增强视觉编码
papers.abstract_zh: 自动生成视频字幕是计算机视觉的一个基本挑战。 最新技术通常使用革命神经网络(CNNs)和神经神经网络(RNNs)相结合的视频字幕。 这些方法主要侧重于通过本地网点定制序列学习,以更好地制作字幕,而现成的视觉特征则从CNN中借用。 我们认为,仔细设计这项任务的视觉特征同样重要,并提出了一种视觉特征编码技术,以便利用Ged 经常单元生成内容丰富的文字字幕。 我们的方法在视觉特征中嵌入了丰富的时间动态,从等级上将短 Fourier变换应用到整个视频的CNN特征中。它还从物体探测器中获取高层次的语义学,以丰富被探测到物体的空间动态的体现。 最终的表示式将投向一个紧凑的空间,并输入到一个语言模型中。 通过学习一个由两个GRU层组成的相对简单的语言模型,我们为METEOR和ROUGE_L指标建立了有关MSVD和MSR-VTT的新的最新数据组。

papers.title: Sequence-To-Sequence Domain Adaptation Network for Robust Text Image Recognition
papers.authors: Yaping Zhang, Shuai Nie, Wenju Liu, Xing Xu, Dongxiang Zhang, Heng Tao Shen
papers.abstract: Domain adaptation has shown promising advances for alleviating domain shift problem. However, recent visual domain adaptation works usually focus on non-sequential object recognition with a global coarse alignment, which is inadequate to transfer effective knowledge for sequence-like text images with variable-length fine-grained character information. In this paper, we develop a Sequence-to-Sequence Domain Adaptation Network (SSDAN) for robust text image recognition, which could exploit unsupervised sequence data by an attention-based sequence encoder-decoder network. In the SSDAN, a gated attention similarity (GAS) unit is introduced to adaptively focus on aligning the distribution of the source and target sequence data in an attended character-level feature space rather than a global coarse alignment. Extensive text recognition experiments show the SSDAN could efficiently transfer sequence knowledge and validate the promising power of the proposed model towards real world applications in various recognition scenarios, including the natural scene text, handwritten text and even mathematical expression recognition.
papers.title_zh: 强力文本图像识别序列至序列域域适应网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在缓解域转移问题方面,对域的调整已显示出大有希望的进展。 然而,最近的可视域适应工作通常侧重于非序列物体识别,全球粗略对齐,不足以转让具有可变长细微字符信息的类似序列文字图像的有效知识。 在本文中,我们开发了一个按顺序排列的适应域域网,以进行健全的文本图像识别,该网络可以通过一个关注序列编码器-编码器网络,利用不受监督的序列数据。 在SSDAN中,引入了一个封闭式关注相似单位(GAS),以适应性地侧重于将源和目标序列数据的分布与参与的性格级特征空间而不是全球粗粗对齐。 广泛的文本识别实验表明,SSDAN能够有效地转让序列知识,并验证拟议模型在各种识别情景中,包括自然场景文字、手写文字,甚至数学表达式识别,对现实世界应用的有希望的力量。

papers.title: Semi-supervised Learning with a Teacher-student Network for Generalized Attribute Prediction
papers.authors: Minchul Shin
papers.abstract: This paper presents a study on semi-supervised learning to solve the visual attribute prediction problem. In many applications of vision algorithms, the precise recognition of visual attributes of objects is important but still challenging. This is because defining a class hierarchy of attributes is ambiguous, so training data inevitably suffer from class imbalance and label sparsity, leading to a lack of effective annotations. An intuitive solution is to find a method to effectively learn image representations by utilizing unlabeled images. With that in mind, we propose a multi-teacher-single-student (MTSS) approach inspired by the multi-task learning and the distillation of semi-supervised learning. Our MTSS learns task-specific domain experts called teacher networks using the label embedding technique and learns a unified model called a student network by forcing a model to mimic the distributions learned by domain experts. Our experiments demonstrate that our method not only achieves competitive performance on various benchmarks for fashion attribute prediction, but also improves robustness and cross-domain adaptability for unseen domains."
papers.title_zh: 利用师生普遍属性预测网络进行半监督学习
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了关于半监督学习解决视觉属性预测问题的研究。 在视觉算法的许多应用中,精确识别物体的视觉属性很重要,但仍然具有挑战性。 这是因为界定阶级属性等级模棱两可,因此培训数据不可避免地会受到阶级不平衡和标签松散的影响,导致缺乏有效的说明。 一个直观的解决方案是找到一种方法,通过使用无标签图像有效学习图像表现。 考虑到这一点,我们建议采用多任务学习和半监督学习提炼所启发的多教师-单一学生办法。 我们的MTSS学习具体任务领域专家,即使用标签嵌入技术的教师网络,并学习一种统一的模式,即学生网络,强迫一种模式模仿域专家所学的分布。 我们的实验表明,我们的方法不仅在各种时尚属性预测基准上实现了竞争性业绩,而且提高了对无形领域的坚固性和跨领域适应能力。”

papers.title: SAMFusion: Sensor-Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for 3D Object Detection in Adverse Weather
papers.authors: Edoardo Palladin · Roland Dietze · Praveen Narayanan · Mario Bijelic · Felix Heide
papers.abstract: Multimodal sensor fusion is an essential capability for autonomous robots, enabling object detection and decision-making in the presence of failing or uncertain inputs. While recent fusion methods excel in normal environmental conditions, these methods fail in adverse weather conditions, e.g., heavy fog, snow, or obstructions due to soiling. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel multi sensor fusion approach tailored for adverse weather conditions. In addition to RGB and LiDAR sensors employed in recent autonomous driving literature, our sensor fusion stack is capable of learning from NIR Gated camera and radar modalities to tackle low light and adverse weather conditions. We propose to fuse multimodal sensor data through attentive, depth-based blending schemes, with learned refinement in the Bird's Eye View (BEV) domain to combine image and range features. Our detections are predicted by a transformer decoder that weights modalities based on distance and visibility. We validate that our method improves the reliability of multimodal sensor fusion in autonomous vehicles under challenging weather conditions, bridging the gap between ideal conditions and real-world edge cases and improving average precision by 17.6 AP points to the second best method in the pedestrian class in long range dense fog conditions.
papers.title_zh: SAMFusion: 用于在不利天气中进行三维天体探测的感应器-适应性多模式融合
papers.abstract_zh: 多式联运传感器聚合是自主机器人的一种基本能力,在输入失败或不确定的情况下,能够探测物体和决策。 虽然最近的聚变方法在正常环境条件下表现优异,但在恶劣的气候条件下,如大雾、雪或土壤流失造成的阻塞,这些方法都失败了。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了一种适应恶劣天气条件的新型多传感器聚变方法。 除了在最近的自主驾驶文献中使用的RGB和LIDAR传感器之外,我们的感应聚变库能够从国家清单报告Gated相机和雷达模式中学习,以应对低光和恶劣天气条件。 我们提出通过关注的、基于深度的混合计划整合多式联运传感器数据,在鸟眼观察(BEV)领域进行深思熟虑的完善,将图像和射程特征结合起来。 我们的检测是由变压器解码器预测的,变压器根据距离和可见度加权模式。 我们确认,我们的方法提高了在具有挑战性的天气条件下在自主车辆中进行多式联运感应聚变的可靠性,缩小了理想条件与现实世界边缘情况之间的差距,提高了平均精确度17.6 AP指出长距离浓雾条件下行人舱第二最佳方法。

papers.title: Recurrent MVSNet for High-Resolution Multi-View Stereo Depth Inference
papers.authors: Yao Yao, Zixin Luo, Shiwei Li, Tianwei Shen, Tian Fang, Long Quan
papers.abstract: Deep learning has recently demonstrated its excellent performance for multi-view stereo (MVS). However, one major limitation of current learned MVS approaches is the scalability: the memory-consuming cost volume regularization makes the learned MVS hard to be applied to high-resolution scenes. In this paper, we introduce a scalable multi-view stereo framework based on the recurrent neural network. Instead of regularizing the entire 3D cost volume in one go, the proposed Recurrent Multi-view Stereo Network (R-MVSNet) sequentially regularizes the 2D cost maps along the depth direction via the gated recurrent unit (GRU). This reduces dramatically the memory consumption and makes high-resolution reconstruction feasible. We first show the state-of-the-art performance achieved by the proposed R-MVSNet on the recent MVS benchmarks. Then, we further demonstrate the scalability of the proposed method on several large-scale scenarios, where previous learned approaches often fail due to the memory constraint. Code is available at https://github.com/YoYo000/MVSNet.
papers.title_zh: MVSNet 用于高分辨率多视多视深度测深推断的经常性经常网
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,深思熟虑表明,多视立体声的优异表现,但是,目前学到的多视立体声方法的一个主要限制是可缩放性:记忆耗时的成本数量正规化使学到的多视立体声难以应用于高分辨率场景。 在本文中,我们引入了一个基于经常性神经网络的可扩展多视立体框架。 拟议的经常性多视图立体网络(R-MVSNet)将沿着深度方向的2D成本图通过大门的经常单位(GRU)按顺序正规化,而不是将整个3D成本量统一起来。 这大大降低了记忆消耗量,使高分辨率重建成为可行。 我们首先展示了拟议的R-MVSNet在最近MVS基准上取得的SOTA 性能。 然后,我们进一步表明,在几种大规模假设情况下,拟议方法的可缩放性,因为以往的学习方法往往由于记忆限制而失败。 代码可在https://github.com/YoYo000/MVSNet上查阅。

papers.title: Quaternion Equivariant Capsule Networks for 3D Point Clouds
papers.authors: Yongheng Zhao, Tolga Birdal, Jan Eric Lenssen, Emanuele Menegatti, Leonidas Guibas, Federico Tombari
papers.abstract: We present a 3D capsule module for processing point clouds that is equivariant to 3D rotations and translations, as well as invariant to permutations of the input points. The operator receives a sparse set of local reference frames, computed from an input point cloud and establishes end-to-end transformation equivariance through a novel dynamic routing procedure on quaternions. Further, we theoretically connect dynamic routing between capsules to the well-known Weiszfeld algorithm, a scheme for solving iterative re-weighted least squares (IRLS) problems with provable convergence properties. It is shown that such group dynamic routing can be interpreted as robust IRLS rotation averaging on capsule votes, where information is routed based on the final inlier scores. Based on our operator, we build a capsule network that disentangles geometry from pose, paving the way for more informative descriptors and a structured latent space. Our architecture allows joint object classification and orientation estimation without explicit supervision of rotations. We validate our algorithm empirically on common benchmark datasets."
papers.title_zh: 3D点云的等量等量立点云网络
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于处理点云的 3D 胶囊模块,该模块对3D 旋转和翻译具有等同性,对输入点的变换也具有异性。 操作员收到一套稀少的当地参照框架,从输入点云中计算,并通过关于四点的新型动态航向程序,确定端对端变异。 此外,我们理论上将胶囊之间的动态路线与著名的 Weiszfeld 算法连接起来。 Weiszfeld 算法是解决迭代再加权最小平方(IRLS)问题的一种办法,具有可证实的趋同特性。 可以看出,这种集团动态路线可被解释为稳健的IRLS旋转,平均以胶囊票计算,信息根据最后的内分数进行。 以我们的操作员为基础,我们建立了一个分离几何形形的胶囊网络,为信息更加丰富的描述符和结构化的潜在空间铺平了道路。 我们的建筑允许联合物体分类和定向估算,而无需对旋转进行明确的监督。 我们在共同的基准数据集上 以经验验证我们的算法。”

papers.title: Presence-Only Geographical Priors for Fine-Grained Image Classification
papers.authors: Oisin Mac Aodha, Elijah Cole, Pietro Perona
papers.abstract: Appearance information alone is often not sufficient to accurately differentiate between fine-grained visual categories. Human experts make use of additional cues such as where, and when, a given image was taken in order to inform their final decision. This contextual information is readily available in many online image collections but has been underutilized by existing image classifiers that focus solely on making predictions based on the image contents. We propose an efficient spatio-temporal prior, that when conditioned on a geographical location and time, estimates the probability that a given object category occurs at that location. Our prior is trained from presence-only observation data and jointly models object categories, their spatio-temporal distributions, and photographer biases. Experiments performed on multiple challenging image classification datasets show that combining our prior with the predictions from image classifiers results in a large improvement in final classification performance.
papers.title_zh: 精细图像分类只具有地理上的前科
papers.abstract_zh: 光靠外观信息往往不足以准确区分细微的视觉类别,人类专家利用额外的提示,如在何时何地拍摄特定图像,以告知其最后决定。 在许多在线图像收藏中,这种背景信息很容易获得,但现有的图像分类系统没有充分加以利用,这些分类系统仅侧重于根据图像内容作出预测。 我们建议先采用高效的时空状态,在以地理位置和时间为条件时,估计该地点出现特定物体类别的概率。 我们以前接受过关于只见现场的观测数据和联合模型对象类别、其时空分布和摄影师偏见的培训。 对具有多重挑战性图像分类数据集进行的实验表明,将我们先前的图像分类与图像分类的预测结合起来,可大大改进最后分类的性能。

papers.title: Pix2Pose: Pixel-Wise Coordinate Regression of Objects for 6D Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Kiru Park, Timothy Patten, Markus Vincze
papers.abstract: Estimating the 6D pose of objects using only RGB images remains challenging because of problems such as occlusion and symmetries. It is also difficult to construct 3D models with precise texture without expert knowledge or specialized scanning devices. To address these problems, we propose a novel pose estimation method, Pix2Pose, that predicts the 3D coordinates of each object pixel without textured models. An auto-encoder architecture is designed to estimate the 3D coordinates and expected errors per pixel. These pixel-wise predictions are then used in multiple stages to form 2D-3D correspondences to directly compute poses with the PnP algorithm with RANSAC iterations. Our method is robust to occlusion by leveraging recent achievements in generative adversarial training to precisely recover occluded parts. Furthermore, a novel loss function, the transformer loss, is proposed to handle symmetric objects by guiding predictions to the closest symmetric pose. Evaluations on three different benchmark datasets containing symmetric and occluded objects show our method outperforms the state of the art using only RGB images.
papers.title_zh: Pix2Pose: 用于 6D Pose 估测的像素- Wise 协调回归对象
papers.abstract_zh: 由于隔离和对称等问题,仅使用RGB图像估计物体的6D形状仍然具有挑战性,在没有专家知识或专门扫描装置的情况下,也难以建造具有精确纹理的3D模型。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一个新型的外观估计方法(Pix2Pose),该方法预测每个对象像素的三维坐标,没有纹理模型。一个自动编码器结构旨在估计每像素的三维坐标和预期误差。 这些像素预测随后被用在多个阶段,形成 2D-3D 对应法, 直接与 PnP 算法和 RANSCAC 迭代进行拼接。 我们的方法通过利用基因对抗性训练的最新成果来精确地恢复隐蔽部分, 使排挤变得有力。 此外,还提出一种新的损失功能,即变压器损失,通过引导预测达到最接近的对称姿势来处理对称天体。 对包含对称和隐蔽天体的三种不同基准数据集的评估显示,我们的方法仅使用 RGB 图像就优于最新水平。

papers.title: Person-in-WiFi: Fine-Grained Person Perception Using WiFi
papers.authors: Fei Wang, Sanping Zhou, Stanislav Panev, Jinsong Han, Dong Huang
papers.abstract: Fine-grained person perception such as body segmentation and pose estimation has been achieved with many 2D and 3D sensors such as RGB/depth cameras, radars (e.g. RF-Pose), and LiDARs. These solutions require 2D images, depth maps or 3D point clouds of person bodies as input. In this paper, we take one step forward to show that fine-grained person perception is possible even with 1D sensors: WiFi antennas. Specifically, we used two sets of WiFi antennas to acquire signals, i.e., one transmitter set and one receiver set. Each set contains three antennas horizontally lined-up as a regular household WiFi router. The WiFi signal generated by a transmitter antenna, penetrates through and reflects on human bodies, furniture, and walls, and then superposes at a receiver antenna as 1D signal samples. We developed a deep learning approach that uses annotations on 2D images, takes the received 1D WiFi signals as input, and performs body segmentation and pose estimation in an end-to-end manner. To our knowledge, our solution is the first work based on off-the-shelf WiFi antennas and standard IEEE 802.11n WiFi signals. Demonstrating comparable results to image-based solutions, our WiFi-based person perception solution is cheaper and more ubiquitous than radars and LiDARs, while invariant to illumination and has little privacy concern comparing to cameras.
papers.title_zh: Wi-WiFi人:使用Wi-WiFi人感知
papers.abstract_zh: 通过许多2D和3D传感器,如RGB/深度摄像头、雷达(如RF-Pose)和激光雷达(如RDARs)等精细的人感知,如身体分离和估计,这些解决方案需要2D图像、深度地图或3D点人体云作为输入。 在本文中,我们向前迈出了一步,以表明即使有1D传感器(WiFi天线 ) , 也能有精细的人感知。 具体而言,我们用两套WiFi天线获得信号,即一台发射机和一台接收器。 每套天线都有3个天线横向排列,作为普通的家用无线网络路由器,由发射机天线生成的无线网络信号穿透和反射人体、家具和墙壁,然后在接收器天线上添加1D信号样本。 我们开发了一种深层次的学习方法,该方法使用2D图像的说明,将接收到的1D WiFi信号作为输入,并进行身体分解,以端对端的方式做出估计。 据我们所知,我们的解决方案是基于现成的无线网络天线和标准 IEEE 802.11n WiFi信号的首个工程。 我们的无线自网人感知解决方案展示了与图像解决方案相类似的结果,比雷达和LiDARs更便宜、更普遍,同时不易受光化影响,与相机相比,几乎没有隐私问题。
