papers.title: Non-Local Recurrent Neural Memory for Supervised Sequence Modeling
papers.authors: Canmiao Fu, Wenjie Pei, Qiong Cao, Chaopeng Zhang, Yong Zhao, Xiaoyong Shen, Yu-Wing Tai
papers.abstract: Typical methods for supervised sequence modeling are built upon the recurrent neural networks to capture temporal dependencies. One potential limitation of these methods is that they only model explicitly information interactions between adjacent time steps in a sequence, hence the high-order interactions between nonadjacent time steps are not fully exploited. It greatly limits the capability of modeling the long-range temporal dependencies since one-order interactions cannot be maintained for a long term due to information dilution and gradient vanishing. To tackle this limitation, we propose the Non-local Recurrent Neural Memory (NRNM) for supervised sequence modeling, which performs non-local operations to learn full-order interactions within a sliding temporal block and models the global interactions between blocks in a gated recurrent manner. Consequently, our model is able to capture the long-range dependencies. Besides, the latent high-level features contained in high-order interactions can be distilled by our model. We demonstrate the merits of our NRNM approach on two different tasks: action recognition and sentiment analysis.
papers.title_zh: 用于监督序列建模的非本地经常神经内存
papers.abstract_zh: 监督序列建模的典型方法以经常性神经网络为基础,以捕捉时间依赖性。 这些方法的一个潜在局限性是,它们只是按顺序明确模拟相邻时间步骤之间的信息互动,因此没有充分利用不相邻时间步骤之间的高度互动。 由于信息稀释和梯度消失,无法长期保持单级相互作用,因此,它极大地限制了模拟远距离时间依赖性的能力。 为解决这一限制,我们提议采用非本地经常神经记忆系统(NRNM)作为受监督的序列模型,进行非本地业务,以学习在滑动时间块内的全顺序互动,并以封闭的重复方式模拟各区块之间的全球互动。 因此,我们的模型能够捕捉到远程依赖性。 此外,高阶互动中的潜在高层次特征可以用我们的模型来提炼。 我们展示了我们NRNM方法在两种不同任务上的优点:行动识别和情绪分析。

papers.title: Multiple Expert Brainstorming for Domain Adaptive Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Yunpeng Zhai, Qixiang Ye, Shijian Lu, Mengxi Jia, Rongrong Ji, Yonghong Tian
papers.abstract: Often the best performing deep neural models are ensembles of multiple base-level networks, nevertheless, ensemble learning with respect to domain adaptive person re-ID remains unexplored. In this paper, we propose a multiple expert brainstorming network (MEB-Net) for domain adaptive person re-ID, opening up a promising direction about model ensemble problem under unsupervised conditions. MEB-Net adopts a mutual learning strategy, where multiple networks with different architectures are pre-trained within a source domain as expert models equipped with specific features and knowledge, while the adaptation is then accomplished through brainstorming (mutual learning) among expert models. MEB-Net accommodates the heterogeneity of experts learned with different architectures and enhances discrimination capability of the adapted re-ID model, by introducing a regularization scheme about authority of experts. Extensive experiments on large-scale datasets (Market-1501 and DukeMTMC-reID) demonstrate the superior performance of MEB-Net over the state-of-the-arts."
papers.title_zh: 多重专家集思广益促进适应性适应人员再识别
papers.abstract_zh: 通常最有效果的深层神经模型是多基级网络的组合,然而,关于适应性人领域再识别的共通学习仍未探索。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个多专家集思广益网络(MEB-Net),用于适应性人领域再开发,为在不受监督的条件下解决模式共同问题开辟了充满希望的方向。 MEB-Net采用相互学习战略,在源域内预先培训具有不同结构的多个网络,作为具备具体特点和知识的专家模型,通过专家模型集思广益(相互学习)实现适应。 MEB-Net通过引入关于专家权威的正规化计划,适应了从不同结构中学习的专家的多样性,加强了经调整的再ID模式的歧视能力。 大型数据集(Market-1501和DukeMTMC-reID)的广泛实验显示MEB-Net优于最新艺术。

papers.title: MHP-VOS: Multiple Hypotheses Propagation for Video Object Segmentation
papers.authors: Shuangjie Xu, Daizong Liu, Linchao Bao, Wei Liu, Pan Zhou
papers.abstract: We address the problem of semi-supervised video object segmentation (VOS), where the masks of objects of interests are given in the first frame of an input video. To deal with challenging cases where objects are occluded or missing, previous work relies on greedy data association strategies that make decisions for each frame individually. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to defer the decision making for a target object in each frame, until a global view can be established with the entire video being taken into consideration. Our approach is in the same spirit as Multiple Hypotheses Tracking (MHT) methods, making several critical adaptations for the VOS problem. We employ the bounding box (bbox) hypothesis for tracking tree formation, and the multiple hypotheses are spawned by propagating the preceding bbox into the detected bbox proposals within a gated region starting from the initial object mask in the first frame. The gated region is determined by a gating scheme which takes into account a more comprehensive motion model rather than the simple Kalman filtering model in traditional MHT. To further design more customized algorithms tailored for VOS, we develop a novel mask propagation score instead of the appearance similarity score that could be brittle due to large deformations. The mask propagation score, together with the motion score, determines the affinity between the hypotheses during tree pruning. Finally, a novel mask merging strategy is employed to handle mask conflicts between objects. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, especially in the case of object missing.
papers.title_zh: MHP-VOS:视频对象分割的多种假设
papers.abstract_zh: 我们处理半受监督的视像物体分割(VOS)问题,在输入视频的第一个框中,对利益对象进行遮掩。 以往的工作依靠贪婪的数据联系战略,针对每个框架分别作出决定,以应对被隐蔽或遗失物体的具有挑战性的案件。 在本文中,我们建议采取新的办法,推迟对每个框架的目标对象作出决定,直到能够确定一种全球观点,将整个视频考虑在内。 我们的方法与多假想跟踪(MHT)方法具有同样的精神,对VOS问题作了若干重要的调整。 我们使用捆绑箱(bbox)假设跟踪树的形成,通过将前面的bbox传播到从第一个框架最初的物体遮罩开始的封闭区域内检测到的bbox提案中,产生多种假设。 封闭区是由一种格子办法决定的,这种办法考虑到一种更全面的运动模式,而不是传统的MHT中简单的Kalman过滤模式。 为了进一步设计为VOS定制的更定制的算法,我们开发了一个新颖的面具传播得分,而不是由于巨大的变形而可能变得易碎的外观相似得分。 面具传播得分与运动得分一起决定了树苗修剪期间假设之间的亲近性。 最后,采用了一种新颖的面具合并战略来处理物体之间的面具冲突。 对具有挑战性的数据集进行广泛试验,表明拟议方法的有效性,特别是在缺失物体的情况下。

papers.title: Many Task Learning With Task Routing
papers.authors: Gjorgji Strezoski, Nanne van Noord, Marcel Worring
papers.abstract: Typical multi-task learning (MTL) methods rely on architectural adjustments and a large trainable parameter set to jointly optimize over several tasks. However, when the number of tasks increases so do the complexity of the architectural adjustments and resource requirements. In this paper, we introduce a method which applies a conditional feature-wise transformation over the convolutional activations that enables a model to successfully perform a large number of tasks. To distinguish from regular MTL, we introduce Many Task Learning (MaTL) as a special case of MTL where more than 20 tasks are performed by a single model. Our method dubbed Task Routing (TR) is encapsulated in a layer we call the Task Routing Layer (TRL), which applied in an MaTL scenario successfully fits hundreds of classification tasks in one model. We evaluate on 5 datasets and the Visual Decathlon (VD) challenge against strong baselines and state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.title_zh: 许多任务学习与任务路由
papers.abstract_zh: 典型的多任务学习(MTL)方法依赖于建筑调整和大型可训练参数,这些参数是共同优化若干任务所需的,但是,任务增加时,建筑调整和资源需求的复杂性也随之增加。 在本文中,我们采用了一种方法,对变速启动采用有条件的特性转换,使模型能够成功完成大量任务。 为了与常规的MTL区别开来,我们引入许多任务学习(MATL)作为MTL的特殊情况,其中20多项任务由一个单一模式执行。 我们称为任务路由(TR)的方法被封装在一个我们称之为任务路由层的层中,它适用于一个MaTL假设情景,在一个模型中成功地符合数百项分类任务。 我们根据强有力的基线和最先进的方法评估5个数据集和视觉解剖(VD)挑战。

papers.title: Leveraging Crowdsourced GPS Data for Road Extraction From Aerial Imagery
papers.authors: Tao Sun, Zonglin Di, Pengyu Che, Chun Liu, Yin Wang
papers.abstract: Deep learning is revolutionizing the mapping industry. Under lightweight human curation, computer has generated almost half of the roads in Thailand on Open- StreetMap (OSM) using high resolution aerial imagery. Bing maps are displaying 125 million computer generated building polygons in the U.S. While tremendously more efficient than manual mapping, one cannot map out everything from the air. Especially for roads, a small prediction gap by image occlusion renders the entire road useless for routing. Misconnections can be more dangerous. Therefore computer-based mapping often requires local verifications, which is still labor intensive. In this paper, we propose to leverage crowdsourced GPS data to improve and support road extraction from aerial imagery. Through novel data augmentation, GPS rendering, and 1D transpose convolution techniques, we show almost 5% improvements over previous competition winning models, and much better robustness when predicting new areas without any new training data or domain adaptation.
papers.title_zh: 利用多方联动的全球定位系统数据,从空中图像中道路提取
papers.abstract_zh: 深层学习正在使制图业发生革命。 在轻量级人类曲线下,计算机利用高清晰度航空图像生成了泰国开放街道地图(OSM)的近一半道路。 叮当地图显示美国有1.25亿个计算机生成的建筑多边形。 尽管比人工绘图效率要高得多,但人们无法从空中绘制所有地图。 特别是对于道路而言,通过图像封隔的微小预测差距使得整个道路无法通行。 连接错误可能更加危险。 因此,基于计算机的绘图往往需要本地的核查,而这仍然是劳动密集型的。 在本文中,我们提议利用众包GPS数据来改进和支持从空中图像中提取道路。 通过新的数据扩增、GPS转换和1D转换技术,我们显示出比以往的竞争胜出模式近5%的改进,以及在没有新的培训数据或领域调整的情况下预测新领域时更加稳健。

papers.title: Large-Scale Tag-Based Font Retrieval With Generative Feature Learning
papers.authors: Tianlang Chen, Zhaowen Wang, Ning Xu, Hailin Jin, Jiebo Luo
papers.abstract: Font selection is one of the most important steps in a design workflow. Traditional methods rely on ordered lists which require significant domain knowledge and are often difficult to use even for trained professionals. In this paper, we address the problem of large-scale tag-based font retrieval which aims to bring semantics to the font selection process and enable people without expert knowledge to use fonts effectively. We collect a large-scale font tagging dataset of high-quality professional fonts. The dataset contains nearly 20,000 fonts, 2,000 tags, and hundreds of thousands of font-tag relations. We propose a novel generative feature learning algorithm that leverages the unique characteristics of fonts. The key idea is that font images are synthetic and can therefore be controlled by the learning algorithm. We design an integrated rendering and learning process so that the visual feature from one image can be used to reconstruct another image with different text. The resulting feature captures important font design details while is robust to nuisance factors such as text. We propose a novel attention mechanism to re-weight the visual feature for joint visual-text modeling. We combine the feature and the attention mechanism in a novel recognition-retrieval model. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art for the important problem of large-scale tag-based font retrieval.
papers.title_zh: 使用生成功能学习的大型标记字体检索
papers.abstract_zh: 选择字体是设计工作流程中最重要的步骤之一,传统方法依赖于需要大量领域知识的定购清单,而且即使是经过培训的专业人员也往往难以使用。 在本文中,我们讨论大规模基于标签的字体检索问题,其目的是将语义引入字体选择过程,使没有专业知识的人能够有效使用字体。我们收集了大比例的高质量专业字体标签数据集。 该数据集包含近20,000个字体、2,000个标记和数十万个字体-标签关系。 我们提出一个新的基因特征学习算法, 利用字体的独特性。 关键的想法是字体图像是合成的, 因此可以由学习算法控制 。 我们设计了一个综合的翻譯和学习过程, 以便一个图像的视觉特征能够用不同的文字重建另一个图像。 由此产生的功能可以捕捉重要的字体设计细节, 而对于像文本这样的麻烦因素来说是坚固的 。 我们提出一个新的关注机制,为联合视觉-文字建模对视觉特征进行重新加权。 我们将该特征和关注机制结合到一个新的认知-检索模型中。 实验结果显示,我们的方法大大超过 大规模标签字体检索这个重要问题的最新水平。

papers.title: Large Scale High-Resolution Land Cover Mapping With Multi-Resolution Data
papers.authors: Caleb Robinson, Le Hou, Kolya Malkin, Rachel Soobitsky, Jacob Czawlytko, Bistra Dilkina, Nebojsa Jojic
papers.abstract: In this paper we propose multi-resolution data fusion methods for deep learning-based high-resolution land cover mapping from aerial imagery. The land cover mapping problem, at country-level scales, is challenging for common deep learning methods due to the scarcity of high-resolution labels, as well as variation in geography and quality of input images. On the other hand, multiple satellite imagery and low-resolution ground truth label sources are widely available, and can be used to improve model training efforts. Our methods include: introducing low-resolution satellite data to smooth quality differences in high-resolution input, exploiting low-resolution labels with a dual loss function, and pairing scarce high-resolution labels with inputs from several points in time. We train models that are able to generalize from a portion of the Northeast United States, where we have high-resolution land cover labels, to the rest of the US. With these models, we produce the first high-resolution (1-meter) land cover map of the contiguous US, consisting of over 8 trillion pixels. We demonstrate the robustness and potential applications of this data in a case study with domain experts and develop a web application to share our results. This work is practically useful, and can be applied to other locations over the earth as high-resolution imagery becomes more widely available even as high-resolution labeled land cover data remains sparse.
papers.title_zh: 利用多分辨率数据进行大型高分辨率土地覆盖物测绘
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们建议采用多分辨率数据聚合方法,从空中图像中进行深层学习、高分辨率土地覆盖物测绘。 由于缺少高分辨率标签以及输入图像在地理和质量上的差异,国家一级的土地覆被测绘问题对于共同的深层学习方法具有挑战性,因为缺少高分辨率标签。 另一方面,多种卫星图像和低分辨率地面真相标签来源广泛存在,可用于改进示范培训工作。 我们的方法包括:采用低分辨率卫星数据,以平滑高分辨率输入的质量差异,利用具有双重损失功能的低分辨率标签,以及将稀缺的高分辨率标签与若干时间点的投入配对。 我们从美国东北部的某个地方(那里有高分辨率土地覆盖物标签 ) , 向美国其他地区推广模型。 有了这些模型,我们制作了美国毗连地区第一张高分辨率(1米)土地覆盖物地图,由8万亿像素组成。 我们在与领域专家进行的案例研究中展示了这些数据的稳健性和潜在应用,并开发了一个网络应用软件,以分享我们的成果。 这项工作实际上有用,可以应用于地球上的其他地点,因为即使贴有高分辨率标签的土地覆盖物数据仍然稀少,高分辨率图像也越来越普遍。

papers.title: Knowledge-Embedded Routing Network for Scene Graph Generation
papers.authors: Tianshui Chen, Weihao Yu, Riquan Chen, Liang Lin
papers.abstract: To understand a scene in depth not only involves locating/recognizing individual objects, but also requires to infer the relationships and interactions among them. However, since the distribution of real-world relationships is seriously unbalanced, existing methods perform quite poorly for the less frequent relationships. In this work, we find that the statistical correlations between object pairs and their relationships can effectively regularize semantic space and make prediction less ambiguous, and thus well address the unbalanced distribution issue. To achieve this, we incorporate these statistical correlations into deep neural networks to facilitate scene graph generation by developing a Knowledge-Embedded Routing Network. More specifically, we show that the statistical correlations between objects appearing in images and their relationships, can be explicitly represented by a structured knowledge graph, and a routing mechanism is learned to propagate messages through the graph to explore their interactions. Extensive experiments on the large-scale Visual Genome dataset demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method over current state-of-the-art competitors.
papers.title_zh: 以知识嵌入的现场图生成路由网络
papers.abstract_zh: 要深入了解一个场景,不仅需要定位/识别个别物体,还需要推断它们之间的关系和相互作用。 然而,由于现实世界关系的分布严重不平衡,对于不太频繁的关系而言,现有方法效果很差。 在这项工作中,我们发现,对象对与其关系之间的统计相关性可以有效地规范语义空间,减少预测的模糊性,从而很好地解决分布不平衡的问题。 为此,我们将这些统计相关性纳入深层神经网络,通过开发知识型运行网络,为生成景象图提供便利。 更具体地说,我们表明,图像中的物体及其关系之间的统计相关性,可以用结构化知识图表来明确体现,并学会通过图表传播信息以探索其相互作用的路径机制。 关于大规模视觉基因组数据集的广泛实验表明,拟议的方法优于目前最先进的竞争者。

papers.title: Knowledge Distillation via Route Constrained Optimization
papers.authors: Xiao Jin, Baoyun Peng, Yichao Wu, Yu Liu, Jiaheng Liu, Ding Liang, Junjie Yan, Xiaolin Hu
papers.abstract: Distillation-based learning boosts the performance of the miniaturized neural network based on the hypothesis that the representation of a teacher model can be used as structured and relatively weak supervision, and thus would be easily learned by a miniaturized model. However, we find that the representation of a converged heavy model is still a strong constraint for training a small student model, which leads to a higher lower bound of congruence loss. In this work, we consider the knowledge distillation from the perspective of curriculum learning by teacher's routing. Instead of supervising the student model with a converged teacher model, we supervised it with some anchor points selected from the route in parameter space that the teacher model passed by, as we called route constrained optimization (RCO). We experimentally demonstrate this simple operation greatly reduces the lower bound of congruence loss for knowledge distillation, hint and mimicking learning. On close-set classification tasks like CIFAR and ImageNet, RCO improves knowledge distillation by 2.14% and 1.5% respectively. For the sake of evaluating the generalization, we also test RCO on the open-set face recognition task MegaFace. RCO achieves 84.3% accuracy on one-to-million task with only 0.8 M parameters, which push the SOTA by a large margin.
papers.title_zh: 通过 " 限制优化 " 路线进行知识蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 基于蒸馏的学习提高了微型神经网络的性能,所依据的假设是,教师模式的代表性可以用作结构化和相对薄弱的监督,因此,通过微型化的模式很容易学到。 然而,我们发现,一个趋同的重型模式的体现仍然是对一个小型学生模式的培训的强大制约,这导致一致性损失的较低约束。 在这项工作中,我们从教师路线教学课程的角度考虑知识提炼问题。 我们不是监督学生模式,而是监督教师模式的趋同模式,而是通过从教师模式通过的参数空间路线中选定的一些锚点来监督学生模式,我们称之为 " 道路限制优化 " (RCO),我们称之为 " 道路限制优化 " 。 我们实验性地证明这一简单操作极大地降低了知识蒸馏、提示和模仿学习的共性损失的下限。 在CIFAR和图像网络等近身分类任务中,RCO将知识蒸馏分别提高2.14%和1.5%。 为了评估一般化,我们还在开放式脸部识别任务Megaface上测试了RCO, 仅用0.8 M参数,将SOTA推向大差幅,在一到百万的任务上实现了84.3%的精确度。

papers.title: IRLAS: Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Architecture Search
papers.authors: Minghao Guo, Zhao Zhong, Wei Wu, Dahua Lin, Junjie Yan
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose an inverse reinforcement learning method for architecture search (IRLAS), which trains an agent to learn to search network structures that are topologically inspired by human-designed network. Most existing architecture search approaches totally neglect the topological characteristics of architectures, which results in complicated architecture with a high inference latency. Motivated by the fact that human-designed networks are elegant in topology with a fast inference speed, we propose a mirror stimuli function inspired by biological cognition theory to extract the abstract topological knowledge of an expert human-design network (ResNeXt). To avoid raising a too strong prior over the search space, we introduce inverse reinforcement learning to train the mirror stimuli function and exploit it as a heuristic guidance for architecture search, easily generalized to different architecture search algorithms. On CIFAR-10, the best architecture searched by our proposed IRLAS achieves 2.60% error rate. For ImageNet mobile setting, our model achieves a state-of-the-art top-1 accuracy 75.28%, while being 2 4x faster than most auto-generated architectures. A fast version of this model achieves 10% faster than MobileNetV2, while maintaining a higher accuracy.
papers.title_zh: IRLAS:建筑搜索反强化学习
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了建筑搜索的反强化学习方法(IRLAS),该方法培训一名代理人员学习如何搜索由人类设计的网络在地形学上启发的网络结构。 大多数现有的建筑搜索方法完全忽视了建筑的地形特征,导致建筑结构复杂,推导时间过长。 人类设计的网络在地形学上是优雅的,其快速推论速度很快。 基于这一事实,我们提议在生物认知理论的启发下,建立反射刺激功能,以提取专家人类设计网络(ResNEXT)的抽象地形学知识。 为了避免在搜索空间之前出现过强的状态,我们引入反强化学习,以训练镜子刺激功能,并把它用作建筑搜索的勤劳指导,很容易被广泛推广到不同的建筑搜索算法中。 在CIFAR-10上,我们提议的IRLAS所搜索的最佳建筑达到2.60%的错误率。 在图像网络移动设置方面,我们的模型达到了最先进的上层-1精确度75.28%,而比大多数自动生成的建筑快2 4x。 这一模型的快速版本比移动网络2快10%,同时保持更高的精确度。

papers.title: Interactive Sketch & Fill: Multiclass Sketch-to-Image Translation
papers.authors: Arnab Ghosh, Richard Zhang, Puneet K. Dokania, Oliver Wang, Alexei A. Efros, Philip H. S. Torr, Eli Shechtman
papers.abstract: We propose an interactive GAN-based sketch-to-image translation method that helps novice users easily create images of simple objects. The user starts with a sparse sketch and a desired object category, and the network then recommends its plausible completion(s) and shows a corresponding synthesized image. This enables a feedback loop, where the user can edit the sketch based on the network's recommendations, while the network is able to better synthesize the image that the user might have in mind. In order to use a single model for a wide array of object classes, we introduce a gating-based approach for class conditioning, which allows us to generate distinct classes without feature mixing, from a single generator network.
papers.title_zh: 交互式 Sletch & fill: 多类 Sletch 到图像翻译
papers.abstract_zh: 我们建议采用交互式的GAN草图到图像翻译方法,帮助新用户方便地制作简单对象的图像。 用户从草图和理想对象类别开始,然后网络建议其合理完成,并显示相应的合成图像。 这样可以建立一个反馈循环,用户可以根据网络的建议编辑草图,而网络可以更好地综合用户可能想到的图像。 为了对各种各样的物体类别使用单一的模型,我们采用了一种基于格丁基的等级调节方法,使我们能够从单一的发电机网络中产生不同类别,而没有特征混合。

papers.title: HAQ: Hardware-Aware Automated Quantization With Mixed Precision
papers.authors: Kuan Wang, Zhijian Liu, Yujun Lin, Ji Lin, Song Han
papers.abstract: Model quantization is a widely used technique to compress and accelerate deep neural network (DNN) inference. Emergent DNN hardware accelerators begin to support mixed precision (1-8 bits) to further improve the computation efficiency, which raises a great challenge to find the optimal bitwidth for each layer: it requires domain experts to explore the vast design space trading off among accuracy, latency, energy, and model size, which is both time-consuming and sub-optimal. There are plenty of specialized hardware for neural networks, but little research has been done for specialized neural network optimization for a particular hardware architecture. Conventional quantization algorithm ignores the different hardware architectures and quantizes all the layers in a uniform way. In this paper, we introduce the Hardware-Aware Automated Quantization (HAQ) framework which leverages the reinforcement learning to automatically determine the quantization policy, and we take the hardware accelerator's feedback in the design loop. Rather than relying on proxy signals such as FLOPs and model size, we employ a hardware simulator to generate direct feedback signals (latency and energy) to the RL agent. Compared with conventional methods, our framework is fully automated and can specialize the quantization policy for different neural network architectures and hardware architectures. Our framework effectively reduced the latency by 1.4-1.95x and the energy consumption by 1.9x with negligible loss of accuracy compared with the fixed bitwidth (8 bits) quantization. Our framework reveals that the optimal policies on different hardware architectures (i.e., edge and cloud architectures) under different resource constraints (i.e., latency, energy and model size) are drastically different. We interpreted the implication of different quantization policies, which offer insights for both neural network architecture design and hardware architecture design.
papers.title_zh: HAQ: 硬件-软件自动量化混合精度
papers.abstract_zh: 模型量化是一种广泛使用的技术,用于压缩和加速深神经网络(DNN)的推论。 新兴DNN硬件加速器开始支持混合精度(1-8比特)进一步提高计算效率,这带来了为每一层寻找最佳比特的巨大挑战:它要求域专家探索精度、延时、能量和模型大小之间的巨大设计空间交换,后者既耗时又不理想。 神经网络有很多专门硬件,但对于特定硬件结构的专门神经网络优化研究却很少。 常规量化算法忽略了不同的硬件结构,并且以统一的方式对所有层进行了量化。 在本文中,我们引入了硬件-软件自动量化框架(HAQ),该框架利用强化学习自动确定量化政策,我们在设计循环中采用硬件加速器的反馈。 我们不是依靠替代信号,如FLOPs和模型尺寸,而是使用硬件模拟器向RL代理器发出直接反馈信号(时间和能量)。 与传统方法相比,我们的框架是完全自动化的,可以专门为不同的神经网络结构和硬件结构制定量化政策。 我们的框架有效地将悬浮量减少了1.4-1.95x,能源消耗量减少了1.9x,与固定的位宽(8比特)量化相比,精确度损失微乎其微。 我们的框架表明,在不同资源制约(即潜伏、能源和模型大小)下,关于不同硬件结构(即边缘和云层结构)的最佳政策差别很大。 我们理解了不同量化政策的含义,这些政策为神经网络结构设计和硬件结构设计提供了深刻见解。

papers.title: Gated2Depth: Real-Time Dense Lidar From Gated Images
papers.authors: Tobias Gruber, Frank Julca-Aguilar, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: We present an imaging framework which converts three images from a gated camera into high-resolution depth maps with depth accuracy comparable to pulsed lidar measurements. Existing scanning lidar systems achieve low spatial resolution at large ranges due to mechanically-limited angular sampling rates, restricting scene understanding tasks to close-range clusters with dense sampling. Moreover, today's pulsed lidar scanners suffer from high cost, power consumption, large form-factors, and they fail in the presence of strong backscatter. We depart from point scanning and demonstrate that it is possible to turn a low-cost CMOS gated imager into a dense depth camera with at least 80m range - by learning depth from three gated images. The proposed architecture exploits semantic context across gated slices, and is trained on a synthetic discriminator loss without the need of dense depth labels. The proposed replacement for scanning lidar systems is real-time, handles back-scatter and provides dense depth at long ranges. We validate our approach in simulation and on real-world data acquired over 4,000km driving in northern Europe. Data and code are available at https://github.com/gruberto/Gated2Depth.
papers.title_zh: Gate2Depth: 从 Gated 图像中实时读取的重度 Lidar
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个成像框架,将3个图像从闭门照相机转换成高分辨率深度地图,其深度精度与脉冲象限测量相近。 由于机械限制的角取样率,现有激光雷达扫描系统在大范围内实现低空间分辨率,将现场了解任务限制在取样密集的近距离集群。 此外,今天的脉冲激光雷达扫描仪成本高,耗电量大,形式因素大,在出现强力反弹的情况下失灵。 我们从点扫描出发,通过从三张闭门图像中学习深度,证明有可能将低成本的CMOS闭门成像仪转化为至少8 000米射程的密深摄像头。 拟议的建筑结构利用跨门切片的语义环境,并接受过关于合成歧视物损失的培训,不需要密集深度标签。 拟议的扫描激光雷达系统替换是实时的,处理后散射,提供远距离密集深度。 我们验证了我们的模拟方法和在北欧获得的4 000多公里驾驶权的真实世界数据,数据和代码可在https://github.com/gruberto/Gated2Depeh上查阅。

papers.title: Gated-SCNN: Gated Shape CNNs for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Towaki Takikawa, David Acuna, Varun Jampani, Sanja Fidler
papers.abstract: Current state-of-the-art methods for image segmentation form a dense image representation where the color, shape and texture information are all processed together inside a deep CNN. This however may not be ideal as they contain very different type of information relevant for recognition. Here, we propose a new two-stream CNN architecture for semantic segmentation that explicitly wires shape information as a separate processing branch, i.e. shape stream, that processes information in parallel to the classical stream. Key to this architecture is a new type of gates that connect the intermediate layers of the two streams. Specifically, we use the higher-level activations in the classical stream to gate the lower-level activations in the shape stream, effectively removing noise and helping the shape stream to only focus on processing the relevant boundary-related information. This enables us to use a very shallow architecture for the shape stream that operates on the image-level resolution. Our experiments show that this leads to a highly effective architecture that produces sharper predictions around object boundaries and significantly boosts performance on thinner and smaller objects. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Cityscapes benchmark, in terms of both mask (mIoU) and boundary (F-score) quality, improving by 2% and 4% over strong baselines.
papers.title_zh: Gated-SCNN:用于语义分割的Gated 形状有线电视新闻网
papers.abstract_zh: 目前最先进的图像分割方法形成了一个浓密的图像表达方式,其中颜色、形状和质地信息都在深层CNN内部一起处理。 但这可能并不理想,因为它们包含非常不同的识别信息类型。 在此,我们建议一个新的有线电视新闻网双流结构,用于语义分解,明确将信息塑造成一个单独的处理分支,即形状流,与古典流平行处理信息。 此架构的密钥是将两个流的中间层连接起来的新型门端。 NAME OF TRANSLATORS NAME OF TRANSLATORS 具体地说,我们利用古典溪流中的高层次活化装置,将低层次活化装置锁定在形状溪流中,有效地消除噪音,帮助形状溪流只侧重于处理相关的边界信息。 这使我们能够使用一个非常浅的形状流结构,该结构在图像层分辨率上运行。 我们的实验显示,这导致一个非常有效的结构,在物体边界周围产生更清晰的预测,大大提升较薄和较小的物体的性能。 我们的方法在市景基准上取得了SOTA 性能,包括面具和边界质量,比强基线提高了2%和4%。

papers.title: From Strings to Things: Knowledge-Enabled VQA Model That Can Read and Reason
papers.authors: Ajeet Kumar Singh, Anand Mishra, Shashank Shekhar, Anirban Chakraborty
papers.abstract: Text present in images are not merely strings, they provide useful cues about the image. Despite their utility in better image understanding, scene texts are not used in traditional visual question answering (VQA) models. In this work, we present a VQA model which can read scene texts and perform reasoning on a knowledge graph to arrive at an accurate answer. Our proposed model has three mutually interacting modules: i. proposal module to get word and visual content proposals from the image, ii. fusion module to fuse these proposals, question and knowledge base to mine relevant facts, and represent these facts as multi-relational graph, iii. reasoning module to perform a novel gated graph neural network based reasoning on this graph. The performance of our knowledge-enabled VQA model is evaluated on our newly introduced dataset, viz. text-KVQA. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset which identifies the need for bridging text recognition with knowledge graph based reasoning. Through extensive experiments, we show that our proposed method outperforms traditional VQA as well as question-answering over knowledge base-based methods on text-KVQA.
papers.title_zh: 从字符串到事物: 知识可读和合理读的VQA模型
papers.abstract_zh: 图像中的文字不仅仅是字符串,它们为图像提供了有用的提示。 尽管它们有助于更好地理解图像,但场景文字并没有用于传统的视觉问题解答模式(VQA ) 。 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个 VQA 模型,可以阅读现场文字,对知识图表进行推理,以得出准确的答案。 我们提议的模型有三个相互互动的模块:i. 提议模块,从图像中获取文字和视觉内容建议,ii。 将这些建议、问题和知识库与相关事实相结合的聚合模块,并将这些事实作为多关系图,三. 推理模块,以基于此图表推理的新型门形图形神经网络。 我们知识化VQA模型的性能是通过我们新引进的数据集(即文本-KVQA)来评估的。 据我们所知,这是第一个数据集,它确定需要用知识图推理进行弥补文本识别。 通过广泛的实验,我们表明,我们所提议的方法优于传统的VQA和对基于知识的KVQA文本方法的问答。

papers.title: Free-Form Video Inpainting With 3D Gated Convolution and Temporal PatchGAN
papers.authors: Ya-Liang Chang, Zhe Yu Liu, Kuan-Ying Lee, Winston Hsu
papers.abstract: Free-form video inpainting is a very challenging task that could be widely used for video editing such as text removal. Existing patch-based methods could not handle non-repetitive structures such as faces, while directly applying image-based inpainting models to videos will result in temporal inconsistency (see this https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BuTYfo4bO2I&list=PLnEeMdoBDCISRm0EZYFcQuaJ5ITUaaEIb&index=1). In this paper, we introduce a deep learning based free-form video inpainting model, with proposed 3D gated convolutions to tackle the uncertainty of free-form masks and a novel Temporal PatchGAN loss to enhance temporal consistency. In addition, we collect videos and design a free-form mask generation algorithm to build the free-form video inpainting (FVI) dataset for training and evaluation of video inpainting models. We demonstrate the benefits of these components and experiments on both the FaceForensics and our FVI dataset suggest that our method is superior to existing ones. Related source code, full-resolution result videos and the FVI dataset could be found on Github: https://github.com/amjltc295/Free-Form-Video-Inpainting
papers.title_zh: 使用 3D Gateted 革命和时时光插图
papers.abstract_zh: 自由式视频油漆是一项非常艰巨的任务,可广泛用于诸如删除文本等视频编辑。 现有基于补丁的方法无法处理面部等非重复结构,而直接对视频应用基于图像的油漆模型将导致时间上的不一致(见以下网站:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Butyfo4bO2I&list=PLNEMdoBDCISRm0EYFCQUAJ5ITUaaaEb&index=1)。 在本文中,我们引入了一种基于深层学习的免费平面视频涂色模型,其中提出了3D门式演练,以解决自由面罩的不确定性,以及新颖的Tymoral PatchGAN损失,以提高时间的一致性。 此外,我们收集视频,设计一个自由式面具生成算法,以建立自由式视频油漆(FVI)数据集,用于培训和评价视频油漆模型。 我们在FaceForensics和我们的FVI数据集上展示了这些组件和实验的好处,表明我们的方法优于现有方法。 相关的源代码、完整分辨率结果视频和FVI数据集可以在Github上找到:https://github.com/amjltc295/Free-Form-Video-Inpainting。

papers.title: Free-Form Image Inpainting With Gated Convolution
papers.authors: Jiahui Yu, Zhe Lin, Jimei Yang, Xiaohui Shen, Xin Lu, Thomas S. Huang
papers.abstract: We present a generative image inpainting system to complete images with free-form mask and guidance. The system is based on gated convolutions learned from millions of images without additional labelling efforts. The proposed gated convolution solves the issue of vanilla convolution that treats all input pixels as valid ones, generalizes partial convolution by providing a learnable dynamic feature selection mechanism for each channel at each spatial location across all layers. Moreover, as free-form masks may appear anywhere in images with any shape, global and local GANs designed for a single rectangular mask are not applicable. Thus, we also present a patch-based GAN loss, named SN-PatchGAN, by applying spectral-normalized discriminator on dense image patches. SN-PatchGAN is simple in formulation, fast and stable in training. Results on automatic image inpainting and user-guided extension demonstrate that our system generates higher-quality and more flexible results than previous methods. Our system helps user quickly remove distracting objects, modify image layouts, clear watermarks and edit faces. Code, demo and models are available at: https://github.com/JiahuiYu/generative_inpainting.
papers.title_zh: 自由形式图像在革命中粉刷
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出一个基因化图像油漆系统,用自由面罩和导体完成图像。 该系统基于从数百万图像中学到的门形变迁,没有额外的标签工作。 拟议的门形变迁解决了将所有输入像素视为有效象素的香草变迁问题,通过为各层每个空间位置每个频道提供一个可学习的动态特征选择机制,概括了部分变迁。 此外,由于自由面罩可能以任何形状的图像出现在任何地方,因此为单一矩形面罩设计的全球和地方GAN不适用。 因此,我们通过对稠密的图像片段应用光谱规范化区分器,也呈现了以补丁为基础的GAN损失,名为SN-PatchGAN。 SN-PatchGAN在设计上简单明了,在培训上快速稳定。 自动图像油漆和用户指导扩展的结果显示,我们的系统比以前的方法产生质量更高、更灵活的结果。 我们的系统帮助用户迅速移除转移注意力的物体,修改图像布局,清除水印和编辑面孔。 代码、演示和模型可以在https://github.com/JiahuiYu/generative_inpainting上查阅。

papers.title: Flexible information routing in neural populations through stochastic comodulation
papers.authors: Caroline Haimerl, Cristina Savin, Eero Simoncelli
papers.title_zh: 神经群通过蒸蒸蒸气联合调制实现灵活信息路径

papers.title: Feature Weighting and Boosting for Few-Shot Segmentation
papers.authors: Khoi Nguyen, Sinisa Todorovic
papers.abstract: This paper is about few-shot segmentation of foreground objects in images. We train a CNN on small subsets of training images, each mimicking the few-shot setting. In each subset, one image serves as the query and the other(s) as support image(s) with ground-truth segmentation. The CNN first extracts feature maps from the query and support images. Then, a class feature vector is computed as an average of the support's feature maps over the known foreground. Finally, the target object is segmented in the query image by using a cosine similarity between the class feature vector and the query's feature map. We make two contributions by: (1) Improving discriminativeness of features so their activations are high on the foreground and low elsewhere; and (2) Boosting inference with an ensemble of experts guided with the gradient of loss incurred when segmenting the support images in testing. Our evaluations on the PASCAL-5i and COCO-20i datasets demonstrate that we significantly outperform existing approaches.
papers.title_zh: 偏小制动区块的功能加权和推力
papers.abstract_zh: 本文是关于图像中前景天体的微小片段。 我们训练了一部有线电视新闻网关于训练图像的小子集, 每一小片段模仿小片段设置。 在每小片段中, 一张图像作为Query, 另一张图像作为支持图像, 带有地面- 真实分段 。 有线电视新闻网首先从Query和支持图像中提取地貌图。然后,将一个类地貌矢量作为支持地貌的地貌图平均值计算。 最后,目标对象在Query图像中进行分割,方法是使用类特征矢量和Query的特征映射之间的相近性。 我们作出两项贡献:(1) 改进特征的区别性,从而使其激活在前台高空和其他地方低位;(2) 与一组专家一道促进推论,这些专家在测试中分解支持图像时遵循损失的梯度。 我们对PASCAL-5i和COCO-20i数据集的评价表明,我们的成绩大大超过现有办法。

papers.title: Equipping Experts/Bandits with Long-term Memory
papers.authors: Kai Zheng, Haipeng Luo, Ilias Diakonikolas, Liwei Wang
papers.title_zh: 向专家/具有长期记忆的银行提供设备

papers.title: Entangled Transformer for Image Captioning
papers.authors: Guang Li, Linchao Zhu, Ping Liu, Yi Yang
papers.abstract: In image captioning, the typical attention mechanisms are arduous to identify the equivalent visual signals especially when predicting highly abstract words. This phenomenon is known as the semantic gap between vision and language. This problem can be overcome by providing semantic attributes that are homologous to language. Thanks to the inherent recurrent nature and gated operating mechanism, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and its variants are the dominating architectures in image captioning. However, when designing elaborate attention mechanisms to integrate visual inputs and semantic attributes, RNN-like variants become unflexible due to their complexities. In this paper, we investigate a Transformer-based sequence modeling framework, built only with attention layers and feedforward layers. To bridge the semantic gap, we introduce EnTangled Attention (ETA) that enables the Transformer to exploit semantic and visual information simultaneously. Furthermore, Gated Bilateral Controller (GBC) is proposed to guide the interactions between the multimodal information. We name our model as ETA-Transformer. Remarkably, ETA-Transformer achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MSCOCO image captioning dataset. The ablation studies validate the improvements of our proposed modules.
papers.title_zh: 用于图像说明的嵌入式变形器
papers.abstract_zh: 在图像字幕中,典型的注意机制很难辨别等效的视觉信号,特别是在预测高度抽象的字眼时。 这一现象被称为视觉和语言之间的语义差距。 这个问题可以通过提供与语言相同的语义属性来克服,由于固有的经常性和封闭操作机制,经常性神经网络(NN)及其变体是图像字幕中的主导结构。 然而,在设计将视觉投入和语义属性融合在一起的详细关注机制时,类似RNN的变体由于其复杂性而变得不灵活。 在本文中,我们调查了一个以变换器为基础的序列建模框架,这个框架只用关注层和进料层来构建。 为了弥合语义差距,我们引入了 " 缠绕式注意 " (ETA),使Transformer能够同时利用语义和视觉信息,此外,还提议由Gated双边主计长(GBC)来指导多式信息之间的互动,我们将我们的模型命名为ETA-Transtradent。 值得注意的是,ETA- Transfer在MSCOCO图像字幕数据集上取得了最先进的表现。 通货膨胀研究证实了我们拟议模块的改进。

papers.title: Employing Deep Part-Object Relationships for Salient Object Detection
papers.authors: Yi Liu, Qiang Zhang, Dingwen Zhang, Jungong Han
papers.abstract: Despite Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) based methods have been successful in detecting salient objects, their underlying mechanism that decides the salient intensity of each image part separately cannot avoid inconsistency of parts within the same salient object. This would ultimately result in an incomplete shape of the detected salient object. To solve this problem, we dig into part-object relationships and take the unprecedented attempt to employ these relationships endowed by the Capsule Network (CapsNet) for salient object detection. The entire salient object detection system is built directly on a Two-Stream Part-Object Assignment Network (TSPOANet) consisting of three algorithmic steps. In the first step, the learned deep feature maps of the input image are transformed to a group of primary capsules. In the second step, we feed the primary capsules into two identical streams, within each of which low-level capsules (parts) will be assigned to their familiar high-level capsules (object) via a locally connected routing. In the final step, the two streams are integrated in the form of a fully connected layer, where the relevant parts can be clustered together to form a complete salient object. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed salient object detection network over the state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 使用深半物体关系来探测显性物体
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管以革命神经网络为基础的方法成功地探测了突出的物体,但其决定每个图像部分的突出强度的基本机制不能避免同一突出物体各部分的不一致。 这将最终导致被检测到的显要物体的不完整形状。 为了解决这个问题,我们挖掘部分物体关系,并史无前例地试图利用由Capsule网络(CapsNet)赋予的这些关系来探测显要物体。 整个显要物体探测系统直接建在由三个算法步骤组成的双层部分物体分配网络上。第一步,输入图像的深层地貌图被转换成一组主要胶囊。 第二步,我们把一级舱输入两个相同的流体,每个流体的低层舱(部件)将通过一个与当地连接的路线,分配给它们熟悉的高层舱(物件)。 在最后一步,两个流以一个完全相连的层的形式融合在一起,将相关部分组合在一起,形成一个完整的突出物体。实验结果显示,拟议的突出物体探测网络优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: Dynamics Are Important for the Recognition of Equine Pain in Video
papers.authors: Sofia Broome, Karina Bech Gleerup, Pia Haubro Andersen, Hedvig Kjellstrom
papers.abstract: A prerequisite to successfully alleviate pain in animals is to recognize it, which is a great challenge in non-verbal species. Furthermore, prey animals such as horses tend to hide their pain. In this study, we propose a deep recurrent two-stream architecture for the task of distinguishing pain from non-pain in videos of horses. Different models are evaluated on a unique dataset showing horses under controlled trials with moderate pain induction, which has been presented in earlier work. Sequential models are experimentally compared to single-frame models, showing the importance of the temporal dimension of the data, and are benchmarked against a veterinary expert classification of the data. We additionally perform baseline comparisons with generalized versions of state-of-the-art human pain recognition methods. While equine pain detection in machine learning is a novel field, our results surpass veterinary expert performance and outperform pain detection results reported for other larger non-human species.
papers.title_zh: 动态对承认视频中Equine Pain 的重要性
papers.abstract_zh: 成功减轻动物痛苦的一个先决条件是认识到它,这是非语言物种面临的一个巨大挑战。 此外,马等猎物往往隐藏其痛苦。 在这项研究中,我们建议建立一个深层的反复出现的双流结构,以区分马的视频中与非皮革的疼痛。 不同的模型在独特的数据集中被评估,显示在受控试验下马匹受到中度疼痛诱导的受控试验,这在先前的工作中已经作了介绍。 序列模型与单一框架模型进行实验性比较,表明数据时间层面的重要性,并参照兽医专家对数据进行的分类作为基准。 此外,我们还与最先进的人类痛苦识别方法的通用版本进行基线比较。 虽然机器学习中的黄麻疼痛检测是一个新领域,但我们的结果超过了兽医专家的绩效,并且超过了所报告的其他较大型非人类物种的疼痛检测结果。
