papers.title: Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-Sensor Fusion in 3D Object Detection and BEV Segmentation
papers.authors: Duy Tho Le · Hengcan Shi · Jianfei Cai · Hamid Rezatofighi
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have recently gained prominence as powerful deep generative models, demonstrating unmatched performance across various domains. However, their potential in multi-sensor fusion remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce ``DifFUSER'', a novel approach that leverages diffusion models for multi-modal fusion in 3D object detection and BEV map segmentation. Benefiting from the inherent denoising property of diffusion, DifFUSER is able to refine or even synthesize sensor features in case of sensor malfunction, thereby improving the quality of the fused output. In terms of architecture, our DifFUSER blocks are chained together in a hierarchical BiFPN fashion, termed cMini-BiFPN, offering an alternative architecture for latent diffusion. We further introduce a Gated Self-conditioned Modulated (GSM) latent diffusion module together with Progressive Sensor Dropout Training (PSDT) paradigm, designed to add stronger conditioning to the diffusion process and robustness to sensor failure. Our extensive evaluations on the Nuscenes dataset reveals that DifFUSER not only achieves state-of-the-art performance with a 69.1% mIOU in BEV map segmentation tasks but also competes effectively with leading transformer-based fusion techniques in 3D object detection. The codebase is at [hidden]
papers.title_zh: 3D 对象探测和 BEV 分割中强力多传感器融合扩散模型
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,传播模型作为强大的深层遗传模型越来越突出,显示了各个领域的无与伦比的性能,然而,它们在多传感器聚变方面的潜力基本上仍未开发。 在这项工作中,我们引入了“DifFUUSER'”这一新办法,利用传播模型,将多式聚合模型用于3D物体探测和BEV地图分割。 DifFUSER从扩散的内在非无污染特性中受益,能够在传感器发生故障时改进甚至合成传感器特征,从而提高引信输出的质量。 在建筑方面,我们的DifFUFSER区块以BiFPN(称为cMini-BiFPN)的分级方式被捆绑在一起,为潜在的扩散提供了替代结构。 我们进一步引入了Gated自制模制(GSM)潜伏扩散模块,以及进步感应器辍学培训模式,目的是为传播过程和传感器故障的稳健性增加更强有力的条件。 我们对Nuscenes数据集的广泛评价表明,DifFUSER不仅在BEV地图分割任务中实现了69.1%的MIOU的最新性能,而且还在3D物体探测中与以变压器为基础的主要聚变技术有效竞争。

papers.title: Destruction and Construction Learning for Fine-Grained Image Recognition
papers.authors: Yue Chen, Yalong Bai, Wei Zhang, Tao Mei
papers.abstract: Delicate feature representation about object parts plays a critical role in fine-grained recognition. For example, experts can even distinguish fine-grained objects relying only on object parts according to professional knowledge. In this paper, we propose a novel "Destruction and Construction Learning" (DCL) method to enhance the difficulty of fine-grained recognition and exercise the classification model to acquire expert knowledge. Besides the standard classification backbone network, another "destruction and construction" stream is introduced to carefully "destruct" and then "reconstruct" the input image, for learning discriminative regions and features. More specifically, for "destruction", we first partition the input image into local regions and then shuffle them by a Region Confusion Mechanism (RCM). To correctly recognize these destructed images, the classification network has to pay more attention to discriminative regions for spotting the differences. To compensate the noises introduced by RCM, an adversarial loss, which distinguishes original images from destructed ones, is applied to reject noisy patterns introduced by RCM. For "construction", a region alignment network, which tries to restore the original spatial layout of local regions, is followed to model the semantic correlation among local regions. By jointly training with parameter sharing, our proposed DCL injects more discriminative local details to the classification network. Experimental results show that our proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on three standard benchmarks. Moreover, our proposed method does not need any external knowledge during training, and there is no computation overhead at inference time except the standard classification network feed-forwarding. Source code: https://github.com/JDAI-CV/DCL.
papers.title_zh: 美分形象识别销毁和建筑学习
papers.abstract_zh: 物体部件的复杂特征说明在细微识别中起着关键作用,例如,专家甚至可以根据专业知识区分只依赖物体部件的细微识别物体。 在本文中,我们建议采用新的“修复和建设学习”方法(DCL),以增加微小识别难度,并采用分类模式获取专业知识。 除了标准分类主干网外,还引入了另一个“销毁和建造”流,以仔细“销毁”和“重建”输入图像,以学习歧视性区域和特征。 更具体地说,对于“销毁 ” , 我们首先将输入图像分割到本地区域, 然后用地区混杂机制(RCM ) 冲洗它们。 要正确识别这些被破坏的图像, 分类网络必须更加关注区分差异的歧视性区域 。 为了补偿区域协调机制带来的噪音,将原始图像与被毁坏图像区分开来的一种对抗性损失用于拒绝区域协调机制引入的噪音模式。 对于“建设”而言,一个试图恢复当地地区原始空间布局的区域调整网络被仿效,以模拟当地地区之间的语义相关性。 通过对共享参数进行联合培训,我们提议的DCL为分类网络注入了更具歧视性的地方细节。 实验结果显示,我们拟议框架在三个标准基准上取得了最先进的业绩。 此外,我们拟议方法在培训期间不需要外部知识,除了标准分类网络反馈推进之外,没有计算推论时间的间接费用。 资料来源代码:https://github.com/JDAI-CV/DCL。

papers.title: Dependency-aware Differentiable Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Buang Zhang · Xinle Wu · Hao Miao · Bin Yang · Chenjuan Guo
papers.abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) technology has reduced the burden of manual design by automatically building neural network architectures, among which differential NAS approaches such as DARTS, have gained popularity for the search efficiency. Despite achieving promising performance, the DARTS series methods still suffer two issues: 1) It does not explicitly establish dependencies between edges, potentially leading to suboptimal performance. 2) The high degree of parameter sharing results in inaccurate performance evaluations of subnets. To tackle these issues, we propose to model dependencies explicitly between different edges to construct a high-performance architecture distribution. Specifically, we model the architecture distribution in DARTS as a multivariate normal distribution with learnable mean vector and correlation matrix, representing the base architecture weights of each edge and the dependencies between different edges, respectively. Then, we sample architecture weights from this distribution and alternately train these learnable parameters and network weights by gradient descent. With the learned dependencies, we prune the search space dynamically to alleviate the inaccurate evaluation by only sharing weights among high-performance architectures. Besides, we identify good motifs by analyzing the learned dependencies, which guide human experts to manually design high-performance neural architectures. Extensive experiments and competitive results on multiple NAS Benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.title_zh: 具有依赖性、认识依赖性、有差异的神经结构搜索
papers.abstract_zh: 神经结构搜索(NAS)技术通过自动建造神经网络结构,减轻了人工设计的负担,其中不同的NAS方法,如DARTS,在搜索效率方面越来越受欢迎。 尽管取得了有希望的业绩,DARTS系列方法仍然有两个问题:(1) 它没有明确确定边缘之间的依赖关系,可能导致业绩不理想。 (2) 参数共享程度高导致子网业绩评价不准确。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议明确以不同边缘之间的相互依存为模式,以建立高性能结构分布。 具体地说,我们把DARTS的建筑分布模式作为多变量正常分布模式,采用可学习的中平均值矢量和相关矩阵,分别代表每个边缘的基本结构加权数和不同边缘之间的依赖性。 然后,我们从这种分布中抽取建筑权重,并轮流按照梯度下降来训练这些可学习的参数和网络权重。 随着所学的相互依存关系,我们动态地利用搜索空间,通过在高性能建筑中共享权重来减轻不准确的评估。 此外,我们通过分析学习到的依附关系来确定好的动机,这些依附关系指导人类专家手工设计高性能神经结构。 多项NAS基准的广泛实验和竞争结果证明了我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: DeepCaps: Going Deeper With Capsule Networks
papers.authors: Jathushan Rajasegaran, Vinoj Jayasundara, Sandaru Jayasekara, Hirunima Jayasekara, Suranga Seneviratne, Ranga Rodrigo
papers.abstract: Capsule Network is a promising concept in deep learning, yet its true potential is not fully realized thus far, providing sub-par performance on several key benchmark datasets with complex data. Drawing intuition from the success achieved by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) by going deeper, we introduce DeepCaps, a deep capsule network architecture which uses a novel 3D convolution based dynamic routing algorithm. With DeepCaps, we surpass the state-of-the-art capsule domain networks results on CIFAR10, SVHN and Fashion MNIST, while achieving a 68% reduction in the number of parameters. Further, we propose a class independent decoder network, which strengthens the use of reconstruction loss as a regularization term. This leads to an interesting property of the decoder, which allows us to identify and control the physical attributes of the images represented by the instantiation parameters.
papers.title_zh: 深空: 以囊括网络更深的深度
papers.abstract_zh: Capsule网络是深层学习的一个很有希望的概念,但其真正潜力迄今尚未充分实现,为几个关键基准数据集提供了具有复杂数据的次级业绩。 从革命神经网络(CNNs)通过更深的深度所取得的成功中汲取直觉, 我们引入了DeepCaps(DeepCaps), 这是一种深胶囊网络结构, 有了深卡普斯,我们超越了在CIFAR10、SVHN和时装MNIST上最先进的胶囊域网的结果,同时使参数数量减少了68%。 此外,我们提议建立一个等级独立的解码器网络,加强将重建损失作为正规化术语的使用。 这导致解码器的一个有趣的属性,使我们能够识别和控制即时参数所代表的图像的物理属性。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Self-Attention Network for Referring Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Linwei Ye, Mrigank Rochan, Zhi Liu, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of referring image segmentation. Given an input image and a natural language expression, the goal is to segment the object referred by the language expression in the image. Existing works in this area treat the language expression and the input image separately in their representations. They do not sufficiently capture long-range correlations between these two modalities. In this paper, we propose a cross-modal self-attention (CMSA) module that effectively captures the long-range dependencies between linguistic and visual features. Our model can adaptively focus on informative words in the referring expression and important regions in the input image. In addition, we propose a gated multi-level fusion module to selectively integrate self-attentive cross-modal features corresponding to different levels in the image. This module controls the information flow of features at different levels. We validate the proposed approach on four evaluation datasets. Our proposed approach consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 交叉模式自控网络,以查找图像分割区
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑的是图像分割的参考问题。 使用输入图像和自然语言表达方式,目标是分割图像中语言表达方式所指的对象。 这方面的现有工作将语言表达方式和输入图像在表达方式中分开处理。 它们没有充分反映这两种模式之间的长距离关联。 在本文中,我们建议采用一个跨模式的自注意力模块,以有效捕捉语言和视觉特征之间的长距离依赖性。 我们的模式可以适应性地侧重于参考表达和输入图像中重要区域的信息化词汇。 此外,我们提议了一个门锁的多层次融合模块,有选择地整合与图像中不同层次相对应的自注意力的跨模式特征。 本模块控制不同级别特征的信息流动。我们验证了四个评价数据集的拟议方法。我们的拟议方法一贯优于现有最新方法。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Relationship Inference for Grounding Referring Expressions
papers.authors: Sibei Yang, Guanbin Li, Yizhou Yu
papers.abstract: Grounding referring expressions is a fundamental yet challenging task facilitating human-machine communication in the physical world. It locates the target object in an image on the basis of the comprehension of the relationships between referring natural language expressions and the image. A feasible solution for grounding referring expressions not only needs to extract all the necessary information (i.e. objects and the relationships among them) in both the image and referring expressions, but also compute and represent multimodal contexts from the extracted information. Unfortunately, existing work on grounding referring expressions cannot extract multi-order relationships from the referring expressions accurately and the contexts they obtain have discrepancies with the contexts described by referring expressions. In this paper, we propose a Cross-Modal Relationship Extractor (CMRE) to adaptively highlight objects and relationships, that have connections with a given expression, with a cross-modal attention mechanism, and represent the extracted information as a language-guided visual relation graph. In addition, we propose a Gated Graph Convolutional Network (GGCN) to compute multimodal semantic contexts by fusing information from different modes and propagating multimodal information in the structured relation graph. Experiments on various common benchmark datasets show that our Cross-Modal Relationship Inference Network, which consists of CMRE and GGCN, outperforms all existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 定位参照表达式的跨模式关系推断
papers.abstract_zh: 地面参照表达方式是一项根本性但富有挑战性的任务,它促进物理界的人体机器交流,根据对自然语言表达方式与图像之间关系的理解,将目标物体定位在图像中。 一种可行的解决办法是,不仅需要从图像和参考表达中提取一切必要信息(即物体和它们之间的关系),而且需要从提取的信息中计算和代表多种形式背景。 遗憾的是,现有关于参考表达方式的根据工作无法准确地从参考表达方式中提取多顺序关系,而且这些表达方式所获得的背景与引用表达方式所述背景不符。 在本文中,我们提议设立一个跨模式关系提取器(CMRE),以适应性地突出与特定表达方式有联系的对象和关系,并采用跨模式关注机制,并将所提取的信息作为语言指导的视觉关系图。 此外,我们提议建立一个Ged 图表演变网络(GGCN),通过从不同模式中收集信息并在结构化关系图中传播多式联运信息,计算多式联运语义背景。 对各种共同基准数据集的实验表明,由CMRE和GGCN组成的我们的跨模式关系推断网络,优于所有现有的最新方法。

papers.title: Controllable Video Captioning With POS Sequence Guidance Based on Gated Fusion Network
papers.authors: Bairui Wang, Lin Ma, Wei Zhang, Wenhao Jiang, Jingwen Wang, Wei Liu
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose to guide the video caption generation with Part-of-Speech (POS) information, based on a gated fusion of multiple representations of input videos. We construct a novel gated fusion network, with one particularly designed cross-gating (CG) block, to effectively encode and fuse different types of representations, e.g., the motion and content features of an input video. One POS sequence generator relies on this fused representation to predict the global syntactic structure, which is thereafter leveraged to guide the video captioning generation and control the syntax of the generated sentence. Specifically, a gating strategy is proposed to dynamically and adaptively incorporate the global syntactic POS information into the decoder for generating each word. Experimental results on two benchmark datasets, namely MSR-VTT and MSVD, demonstrate that the proposed model can well exploit complementary information from multiple representations, resulting in improved performances. Moreover, the generated global POS information can well capture the global syntactic structure of the sentence, and thus be exploited to control the syntactic structure of the description. Such POS information not only boosts the video captioning performance but also improves the diversity of the generated captions. Our code is at: https://github.com/vsislab/Controllable_XGating.
papers.title_zh: 以基于 Gedate 融合网络的 POS 序列指导控制视频挂载
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们建议以多部输入视频组合为基础,用部分语音(POS)信息指导视频字幕制作工作。 我们建立了一个新型的闭门融合网络,其中有一个特别设计的交叉带(CG)块,以有效地编码和整合不同类型的表述方式,例如输入视频的动作和内容特征。 一个POS序列生成器依靠这个引信化的显示器来预测全球合成结构,然后利用这一结构来指导视频字幕生成和控制生成的句子的语法。 具体地说,提议了一种格言战略,以动态和适应性的方式将全球综合POS信息纳入生成每个词的解码器。 关于两个基准数据集(即MSR-VTT和MSVD)的实验结果表明,拟议模式可以充分利用多个表述方式提供的补充信息,从而改进业绩。 此外,生成的全球POS信息可以很好地捕捉到该句的全球合成结构,从而被利用来控制描述的合成结构。 这种POS信息不仅提升了视频字幕性能,还改善了生成的字幕的多样性。 我们的代码在https://github.com/vsislab/controllable_XGting。

papers.title: Conditional Recurrent Flow: Conditional Generation of Longitudinal Samples With Applications to Neuroimaging
papers.authors: Seong Jae Hwang, Zirui Tao, Won Hwa Kim, Vikas Singh
papers.abstract: We develop a conditional generative model for longitudinal image datasets based on sequential invertible neural networks. Longitudinal image acquisitions are common in various scientific and biomedical studies where often each image sequence sample may also come together with various secondary (fixed or temporally dependent) measurements. The key goal is not only to estimate the parameters of a deep generative model for the given longitudinal data, but also to enable evaluation of how the temporal course of the generated longitudinal samples are influenced as a function of induced changes in the (secondary) temporal measurements (or events). Our proposed formulation incorporates recurrent subnetworks and temporal context gating, which provides a smooth transition in a temporal sequence of generated data that can be easily informed or modulated by secondary temporal conditioning variables. We show that the formulation works well despite the smaller sample sizes common in these applications. Our model is validated on two video datasets and a longitudinal Alzheimer's disease (AD) dataset for both quantitative and qualitative evaluations of the generated samples. Further, using our generated longitudinal image samples, we show that we can capture the pathological progressions in the brain that turn out to be consistent with the existing literature, and could facilitate various types of downstream statistical analysis.
papers.title_zh: 有条件的经常性经常流动:有条件生成适用于神经成像的纵向抽样
papers.abstract_zh: 我们开发一个基于相继不可视神经网络的纵向图像数据集的有条件遗传模型。 纵向图像获取在各种科学和生物医学研究中很常见,其中每个图像序列样本往往还可能与各种次级(固定的或时间依赖的)测量相结合。 关键目标不仅是为特定纵向数据估计深基因模型的参数,而且还能够评价生成的纵向样本的时间过程如何因(次生)时间测量(或事件)的诱发变化而受到影响。 我们提议的配方包括经常性子网络和时间背景标签,在生成的数据的时序中提供平稳过渡,这些数据可以很容易地了解或由次要时间变数调节。 我们发现,尽管这些应用中常见的样本规模较小,但这种配方效果良好。 我们的模型在两个视频数据集和一个阿尔茨海默氏病纵向数据集中得到验证,以便对生成的样本进行定量和定性评价。 此外,利用我们生成的纵向图像样本,我们显示,我们可以捕捉大脑中与现有文献相一致的病理进展,并且可以促进各种类型的下游统计分析。

papers.title: Collective Model Fusion for Multiple Black-Box Experts
papers.authors: Minh Hoang, Nghia Hoang, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low, Carleton Kingsford
papers.title_zh: 多重黑箱专家集体混合模型

papers.title: Collaborative Learning of Semi-Supervised Segmentation and Classification for Medical Images
papers.authors: Yi Zhou, Xiaodong He, Lei Huang, Li Liu, Fan Zhu, Shanshan Cui, Ling Shao
papers.abstract: Medical image analysis has two important research areas: disease grading and fine-grained lesion segmentation. Although the former problem often relies on the latter, the two are usually studied separately. Disease severity grading can be treated as a classification problem, which only requires image-level annotations, while the lesion segmentation requires stronger pixel-level annotations. However, pixel-wise data annotation for medical images is highly time-consuming and requires domain experts. In this paper, we propose a collaborative learning method to jointly improve the performance of disease grading and lesion segmentation by semi-supervised learning with an attention mechanism. Given a small set of pixel-level annotated data, a multi-lesion mask generation model first performs the traditional semantic segmentation task. Then, based on initially predicted lesion maps for large quantities of image-level annotated data, a lesion attentive disease grading model is designed to improve the severity classification accuracy. Meanwhile, the lesion attention model can refine the lesion maps using class-specific information to fine-tune the segmentation model in a semi-supervised manner. An adversarial architecture is also integrated for training. With extensive experiments on a representative medical problem called diabetic retinopathy (DR), we validate the effectiveness of our method and achieve consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods on three public datasets.
papers.title_zh: 医疗图像半监督分类和分类合作学习
papers.abstract_zh: 医学图像分析有两个重要的研究领域:疾病分级和细微的损伤分割,虽然前者往往依赖后者,但两者通常分开研究。 疾病严重程度分级可作为一个分类问题处理,它只需要图像水平的注释,而损伤分解则需要更强的像素水平的注释。 然而,医疗图像的像素数据分级非常费时,需要域专家。 在这份文件中,我们提议一种合作学习方法,通过半监督学习和关注机制,共同改善疾病分级和损伤分化的绩效。 鉴于有少量像素级附加说明的数据,一个多等离子面罩生成模型首先执行传统的语义分解任务。 然后,根据最初预测的大量图层附加说明数据的损害图,设计了一个注意损伤的疾病分级模型,以提高严重程度分类的准确性。 同时,损伤关注模型可以利用特定班级的信息完善损伤图,以半监督的方式微调分割模型,并将对抗性结构纳入培训。 通过对一个称为糖尿病视网膜病(DR)的具有代表性的医疗问题进行广泛的实验,我们验证了我们的方法的有效性,并持续改进了三个公共数据集的最新方法。

papers.title: Channel Gating Neural Networks
papers.authors: Weizhe Hua, Yuan Zhou, Christopher De Sa, Zhiru Zhang, G. Edward Suh
papers.title_zh: 频道 GDG 神经网络

papers.title: CapsuleVOS: Semi-Supervised Video Object Segmentation Using Capsule Routing
papers.authors: Kevin Duarte, Yogesh S. Rawat, Mubarak Shah
papers.abstract: In this work we propose a capsule-based approach for semi-supervised video object segmentation. Current video object segmentation methods are frame-based and often require optical flow to capture temporal consistency across frames which can be difficult to compute. To this end, we propose a video based capsule network, CapsuleVOS, which can segment several frames at once conditioned on a reference frame and segmentation mask. This conditioning is performed through a novel routing algorithm for attention-based efficient capsule selection. We address two challenging issues in video object segmentation: 1) segmentation of small objects and 2) occlusion of objects across time. The issue of segmenting small objects is addressed with a zooming module which allows the network to process small spatial regions of the video. Apart from this, the framework utilizes a novel memory module based on recurrent networks which helps in tracking objects when they move out of frame or are occluded. The network is trained end-to-end and we demonstrate its effectiveness on two benchmark video object segmentation datasets; it outperforms current offline approaches on the Youtube-VOS dataset while having a run-time that is almost twice as fast as competing methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/KevinDuarte/CapsuleVOS.
papers.title_zh: CapsuleVOS: 使用 Capsule Routing 的半超视像目标部分
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种以胶囊为基础的半监督视频物体分割法。 当前视频物体分割法以框架为基础,常常需要光学流来捕捉跨框架的时间一致性,而这可能难以计算。 为此,我们提议建立一个基于视频的胶囊网络CapsuleVOS(CapsuleVOS),它可以同时以参考框架和分解面罩为条件对几个框架进行分解。 这种调节是通过基于关注的高效胶囊选择的新路径算法进行。 我们在视频物体分割方面处理两个具有挑战性的问题:1)小物体的分割和2)物体的跨时间隔离,小物体的分割问题通过一个缩放模块来解决,使网络能够处理该视频的小型空间区域。 除此之外,框架还利用基于经常网络的新记忆模块,帮助跟踪从框架移动或被隐蔽的物体。 该网络是经过培训的端对端网络,我们展示了其在两个基准视频物体分离数据集上的效力;它优于Youtube-VOS数据集的当前离线方法,同时运行时间几乎是竞争方法的两倍。 该守则可在https://github.com/KevinDuarte/CapsuleVOS上公开查阅。

papers.title: CAMP: Cross-Modal Adaptive Message Passing for Text-Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Zihao Wang, Xihui Liu, Hongsheng Li, Lu Sheng, Junjie Yan, Xiaogang Wang, Jing Shao
papers.abstract: Text-image cross-modal retrieval is a challenging task in the field of language and vision. Most previous approaches independently embed images and sentences into a joint embedding space and compare their similarities. However, previous approaches rarely explore the interactions between images and sentences before calculating similarities in the joint space. Intuitively, when matching between images and sentences, human beings would alternatively attend to regions in images and words in sentences, and select the most salient information considering the interaction between both modalities. In this paper, we propose Cross-modal Adaptive Message Passing (CAMP), which adaptively controls the information flow for message passing across modalities. Our approach not only takes comprehensive and fine-grained cross-modal interactions into account, but also properly handles negative pairs and irrelevant information with an adaptive gating scheme. Moreover, instead of conventional joint embedding approaches for text-image matching, we infer the matching score based on the fused features, and propose a hardest negative binary cross-entropy loss for training. Results on COCO and Flickr30k significantly surpass state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.title_zh: CAMP: 用于文本图像检索的跨模式适应性信件传递
papers.abstract_zh: 文本图像跨模式检索是语言和视觉领域的一项艰巨任务,以往大多数做法都是独立地将图像和句子嵌入一个联合嵌入空间并比较其相似之处。 然而,以往的做法很少在计算共同空间的相似之处之前先探讨图像和句子之间的相互作用。 直观地说,当图像和句子对齐时,人们或者以图像和句子的文字关注各个区域,选择最突出的信息,同时考虑到两种模式之间的互动。 在本文中,我们提议采用跨模式的适应性传递信息(CAMP),以适应性方式控制信息流,使信息传递的方式跨模式。 我们的方法不仅考虑到全面和精细的跨模式互动,而且适当地处理消极对子和不相干的信息,采用适应性喂养办法。 此外,我们不是传统的文本图像匹配联合嵌入方法,而是根据装配功能推算匹配得分,提出培训方面最不利的二进制跨热带损失。 在COCO和Flickr30k上的结果大大超过最先进的方法,显示了我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: BridgeNet: A Continuity-Aware Probabilistic Network for Age Estimation
papers.authors: Wanhua Li, Jiwen Lu, Jianjiang Feng, Chunjing Xu, Jie Zhou, Qi Tian
papers.abstract: Age estimation is an important yet very challenging problem in computer vision. Existing methods for age estimation usually apply a divide-and-conquer strategy to deal with heterogeneous data caused by the non-stationary aging process. However, the facial aging process is also a continuous process, and the continuity relationship between different components has not been effectively exploited. In this paper, we propose BridgeNet for age estimation, which aims to mine the continuous relation between age labels effectively. The proposed BridgeNet consists of local regressors and gating networks. Local regressors partition the data space into multiple overlapping subspaces to tackle heterogeneous data and gating networks learn continuity aware weights for the results of local regressors by employing the proposed bridge-tree structure, which introduces bridge connections into tree models to enforce the similarity between neighbor nodes. Moreover, these two components of BridgeNet can be jointly learned in an end-to-end way. We show experimental results on the MORPH II, FG-NET and Chalearn LAP 2015 datasets and find that BridgeNet outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: BridgeNet:年龄估计连续智能概率网络
papers.abstract_zh: 年龄估计是计算机视觉中一个重要的但非常具有挑战性的问题。 现有的年龄估计方法通常采用分而治之的战略来处理非静止老龄化过程造成的各种数据。 然而,面部老龄化过程也是一个持续的过程,不同组成部分之间的连续性关系没有得到有效利用。 在本文中,我们建议BridgeNet进行年龄估计,目的是有效消除年龄标签之间的持续关系。 拟议的BridgeNet网由地方递减和导航网络组成。 本地递减器将数据空间分割成多个重叠的子空间,以处理各种数据,而带网网则通过使用拟议的桥树结构,学习连续性,了解地方递减器结果的分量,该结构将桥梁连接成树型模型,以强化相邻节点之间的相似性。 此外,BridgeNet的这两个组成部分也可以以端到端的方式共同学习。 我们在MORPH II、FG-NET和Chalearn LAP 2015数据集上展示了实验结果,发现BridgeNet比最先进的方法要好。

papers.title: Block Annotation: Better Image Annotation With Sub-Image Decomposition
papers.authors: Hubert Lin, Paul Upchurch, Kavita Bala
papers.abstract: Image datasets with high-quality pixel-level annotations are valuable for semantic segmentation: labelling every pixel in an image ensures that rare classes and small objects are annotated. However, full-image annotations are expensive, with experts spending up to 90 minutes per image. We propose block sub-image annotation as a replacement for full-image annotation. Despite the attention cost of frequent task switching, we find that block annotations can be crowdsourced at higher quality compared to full-image annotation with equal monetary cost using existing annotation tools developed for full-image annotation. Surprisingly, we find that 50% pixels annotated with blocks allows semantic segmentation to achieve equivalent performance to 100% pixels annotated. Furthermore, as little as 12% of pixels annotated allows performance as high as 98% of the performance with dense annotation. In weakly-supervised settings, block annotation outperforms existing methods by 3-4% (absolute) given equivalent annotation time. To recover the necessary global structure for applications such as characterizing spatial context and affordance relationships, we propose an effective method to inpaint block-annotated images with high-quality labels without additional human effort. As such, fewer annotations can also be used for these applications compared to full-image annotation.
papers.title_zh: 块图示: 使用子图像分解的更好的图像图示
papers.abstract_zh: 具有高质量像素级注释的图像数据集对于语义分解很有价值:在图像中贴上每个像素标签可以确保稀有类和小对象都有附加说明。 然而,完整图解非常昂贵,专家每张图像花费最多90分钟。 我们建议用块子图像批注代替全图像批注。 尽管频繁的任务转换需要大量关注,但我们发现,与使用为全图像说明开发的现有批注工具以同等货币成本的全图像注解相比,整块注解可以更高质量地被挤出,而不是完全图像注解。 令人惊讶的是,我们发现50%的像素加上区块可以让语义分解达到100%的像素加注。 此外,只有12%的像素加注能以密集的注解达到98%的性能。 在受弱小监督的环境下,块状注解比现有方法的成绩高出3%-4%(绝对),给与相应的注解时间。 为了恢复必要的全球应用结构,如空间环境特点和承载关系等应用结构,我们建议一种有效方法,在没有额外人力努力的情况下,用高质量的标签标出附有附加说明的整块图象。 因此,与全图像注解相比,这些申请也可以少用说明。

papers.title: Attention, Learn to Solve Routing Problems!
papers.authors: Wouter Kool, Herke van Hoof, Max Welling
papers.title_zh: 注意,学习解决赛跑问题!

papers.title: An End-To-End Network for Generating Social Relationship Graphs
papers.authors: Arushi Goel, Keng Teck Ma, Cheston Tan
papers.abstract: Socially-intelligent agents are of growing interest in artificial intelligence. To this end, we need systems that can understand social relationships in diverse social contexts. Inferring the social context in a given visual scene not only involves recognizing objects, but also demands a more in-depth understanding of the relationships and attributes of the people involved. To achieve this, one computational approach for representing human relationships and attributes is to use an explicit knowledge graph, which allows for high-level reasoning. We introduce a novel end-to-end-trainable neural network that is capable of generating a Social Relationship Graph - a structured, unified representation of social relationships and attributes - from a given input image. Our Social Relationship Graph Generation Network (SRG-GN) is the first to use memory cells like Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) to iteratively update the social relationship states in a graph using scene and attribute context. The neural network exploits the recurrent connections among the GRUs to implement message passing between nodes and edges in the graph, and results in significant improvement over previous methods for social relationship recognition.
papers.title_zh: 产生社会关系图的 " 最终到最终网络 " 网络
papers.abstract_zh: 社会智慧分子对人工智能的兴趣日益浓厚。 为此,我们需要能够理解不同社会背景下社会关系的系统。 在特定视觉场景中推断出社会背景不仅涉及识别物体,而且要求更深入地了解所涉人员的关系和属性。 为此,代表人类关系和属性的一种计算方法是使用一个明确的知识图表,以便进行高级别推理。 我们引入一个新的端到端的、可培训的神经网络,它能够产生社会关系图 -- -- 社会关系和属性有条理、统一地反映社会关系和属性 -- -- 从特定输入图像中产生一个社会关系图。 我们的社会关系图生成网络(SRG-GN)是第一个使用诸如Gated 经常单元(GRUs)等记忆细胞在使用场景和属性背景的图表中反复更新社会关系状态的网络。 神经网络利用GRU之间的经常性联系,执行图中节点和边缘之间的信息传递,结果大大改进了以往的社会关系识别方法。

papers.title: AM-LFS: AutoML for Loss Function Search
papers.authors: Chuming Li, Xin Yuan, Chen Lin, Minghao Guo, Wei Wu, Junjie Yan, Wanli Ouyang
papers.abstract: Designing an effective loss function plays an important role in visual analysis. Most existing loss function designs rely on hand-crafted heuristics that require domain experts to explore the large design space, which is usually sub-optimal and time-consuming. In this paper, we propose AutoML for Loss Function Search (AM-LFS) which leverages REINFORCE to search loss functions during the training process. The key contribution of this work is the design of search space which can guarantee the generalization and transferability on different vision tasks by including a bunch of existing prevailing loss functions in a unified formulation. We also propose an efficient optimization framework which can dynamically optimize the parameters of loss function's distribution during training. Extensive experimental results on four benchmark datasets show that, without any tricks, our method outperforms existing hand-crafted loss functions in various computer vision tasks.
papers.title_zh: AM-LFS: 损失自动清除功能搜索
papers.abstract_zh: 设计有效的损失功能在视觉分析中起着重要作用,大部分现有损失功能的设计依赖手工制作的超自然学,需要领域专家探索大的设计空间,而设计空间通常不理想,而且耗时。 在本文中,我们提议对损失功能搜索采用自动运算法(AM-LFS),利用REINFORCE在培训过程中搜索损失功能。 这项工作的主要贡献是设计搜索空间,通过以统一的方式纳入现有的大量损失功能,保证不同视觉任务的普遍性和可转让性。 我们还提议一个高效优化框架,以动态优化培训期间损失函数分布的参数。 四个基准数据集的广泛实验结果显示,在没有任何花招的情况下,我们的方法在各种计算机视觉任务中超过了现有的手工制造损失功能。

papers.title: Adaptive Weighting Multi-Field-Of-View CNN for Semantic Segmentation in Pathology
papers.authors: Hiroki Tokunaga, Yuki Teramoto, Akihiko Yoshizawa, Ryoma Bise
papers.abstract: Automated digital histopathology image segmentation is an important task to help pathologists diagnose tumors and cancer subtypes. For pathological diagnosis of cancer subtypes, pathologists usually change the magnification of whole-slide images (WSI) viewers. A key assumption is that the importance of the magnifications depends on the characteristics of the input image, such as cancer subtypes. In this paper, we propose a novel semantic segmentation method, called Adaptive-Weighting-Multi-Field-of-View-CNN (AWMF-CNN), that can adaptively use image features from images with different magnifications to segment multiple cancer subtype regions in the input image. The proposed method aggregates several expert CNNs for images of different magnifications by adaptively changing the weight of each expert depending on the input image. It leverages information in the images with different magnifications that might be useful for identifying the subtypes. It outperformed other state-of-the-art methods in experiments.
papers.title_zh: 用于病理中语义分解的有线电视新闻网
papers.abstract_zh: 自动数字病理学图象分解是帮助病理学家诊断肿瘤和癌症亚型的重要任务。 对于癌症亚型病理诊断来说,病理学家通常会改变全滑动图像(WSI)查看器的放大作用。 一个关键的假设是,放大的重要性取决于输入图像的特征,例如癌症子类型。 在本文中,我们提出一种新型语义分解方法,称为适应性-视觉-多功能-观察-CNN(AWMF-CNN),可以适应性地使用从具有不同放大度的图像到输入图像中多种癌症子类型的区域。 拟议的方法通过根据输入图像适应性地改变每位专家的重量,汇总了若干有线电视新闻网专家关于不同放大度的图像,利用图像中的信息,使用不同的放大度,这些放大度可能有助于识别子类型。 在实验中,它优于其他最先进的方法。

papers.title: Adaptive Confidence Smoothing for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Yuval Atzmon, Gal Chechik
papers.abstract: Generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL) is the problem of learning a classifier where some classes have samples and others are learned from side information, like semantic attributes or text description, in a zero-shot learning fashion (ZSL). Training a single model that operates in these two regimes simultaneously is challenging. Here we describe a probabilistic approach that breaks the model into three modular components, and then combines them in a consistent way. Specifically, our model consists of three classifiers: A "gating" model that makes soft decisions if a sample is from a "seen" class, and two experts: a ZSL expert, and an expert model for seen classes. We address two main difficulties in this approach: How to provide an accurate estimate of the gating probability without any training samples for unseen classes; and how to use expert predictions when it observes samples outside of its domain. The key insight to our approach is to pass information between the three models to improve each one's accuracy, while maintaining the modular structure. We test our approach, adaptive confidence smoothing (COSMO), on four standard GZSL benchmark datasets and find that it largely outperforms state-of-the-art GZSL models. COSMO is also the first model that closes the gap and surpasses the performance of generative models for GZSL, even-though it is a light-weight model that is much easier to train and tune.
papers.title_zh: 普遍零热学习的适应性信心平滑
papers.abstract_zh: 通用零光学习(GZSL)是一个学习分类器的问题,因为有些班级有样本,而另一些班级则以零光学习方式从侧边信息(如语义属性或文字描述)中学习,如语义属性或文字描述(ZSL)。 在这两种制度下同时运行的单一模式培训具有挑战性。 在这里,我们描述一种概率方法,将模式分成三个模块组件,然后以一致的方式将其组合在一起。 具体地说,我们的模型由三个分类组成:一个“归并”模型,如果样本来自“见”类,则作出软性决定,还有两名专家:一名ZSL专家,以及一个观察类专家模型。 我们解决了这一方法中的两个主要困难:如何准确估计未经过任何培训的未见类别样本的开源概率;如何在观察其范围以外的样本时使用专家预测。 我们方法的关键见解是,在三个模型之间传递信息,以提高每个模型的准确性,同时保持模块结构。 我们用四个标准的GZSL基准数据集测试我们的方法,即适应性信心平滑(COSMO),发现它基本上优于最先进的GZSL模型。 COSMO还是第一个缩小差距并超过GZSL基因模型性能的模型,

papers.title: Adaptive Activation Thresholding: Dynamic Routing Type Behavior for Interpretability in Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Yiyou Sun, Sathya N. Ravi, Vikas Singh
papers.abstract: There is a growing interest in strategies that can help us understand or interpret neural networks -- that is, not merely provide a prediction, but also offer additional context explaining why and how. While many current methods offer tools to perform this analysis for a given (trained) network post-hoc, recent results (especially on capsule networks) suggest that when classes map to a few high level "concepts" in the preceding layers of the network, the behavior of the network is easier to interpret or explain. Such training may be accomplished via dynamic/EM routing where the network "routes" for individual classes (or subsets of images) are dynamic and involve few nodes even if the full network may not be sparse. In this paper, we show how a simple modification of the SGD scheme can help provide dynamic/EM routing type behavior in convolutional neural networks. Through extensive experiments, we evaluate the effect of this idea for interpretability where we obtain promising results, while also showing that no compromise in attainable accuracy is involved. Further, we show that the minor modification is seemingly ad-hoc, the new algorithm can be analyzed by an approximate method which provably matches known rates for SGD.
papers.title_zh: 适应性活动加速力:动态运行类型行为,以解释进进进神经网络中的可解释性
papers.abstract_zh: 人们日益关注能够帮助我们理解或解释神经网络的战略 -- -- 也就是说,不仅提供预测,而且提供解释原因和方式的更多背景。 虽然许多现行方法为特定(受过训练的)网络的热量过后分析提供了工具,但最近的结果(特别是胶囊网络的结果)表明,当类图绘制到网络前几层的几个高层次“概念”时,网络的行为更容易解释或解释。 这种培训可以通过动态/EM路由方式完成,在单个类别(或图像子集)的网络“路由”是动态的,即使整个网络可能并不稀少,但涉及的节点很少。 在本文中,我们展示了对 SGD 计划的简单修改 如何有助于提供动态/EM 路径类型的行为 在进化神经网络中。 通过广泛的实验,我们评估了这一可解释性概念在我们取得有希望的结果时的效果,同时也表明,在可实现的准确性方面不存在任何妥协。 此外,我们还表明,微小的修改似乎是临时性的,新的算法可以通过一种大致方法加以分析,这种方法可以与SGD已知的费率相当。

papers.title: 3D Point Capsule Networks
papers.authors: Yongheng Zhao, Tolga Birdal, Haowen Deng, Federico Tombari
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose 3D point-capsule networks, an auto-encoder designed to process sparse 3D point clouds while preserving spatial arrangements of the input data. 3D capsule networks arise as a direct consequence of our unified formulation of the common 3D auto-encoders. The dynamic routing scheme and the peculiar 2D latent space deployed by our capsule networks bring in improvements for several common point cloud-related tasks, such as object classification, object reconstruction and part segmentation as substantiated by our extensive evaluations. Moreover, it enables new applications such as part interpolation and replacement.
papers.title_zh: 3D 点积囊网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提议3D点焦云网络,这是一个自动编码器,旨在处理稀有的3D点云,同时保留输入数据的空间安排。 3D胶囊网络的产生,直接是因为我们统一了共同的3D自动编码器。 我们的太空舱网络所部署的动态航线安排和独特的2D潜势空间改善了一些与云有关的共同任务,如物体分类、物体重建和部分分割,我们的广泛评价证实了这些共同任务。 此外,它还能够进行新的应用,如部分内插和替换。

papers.title: Visual Saliency Prediction Using a Mixture of Deep Neural Networks
papers.authors: Samuel F. Dodge, Lina J. Karam
papers.abstract: Visual saliency models have recently begun to incorporate deep learning to achieve predictive capacity much greater than previous unsupervised methods. However, most existing models predict saliency without explicit knowledge of global scene semantic information. We propose a model (MxSalNet) that incorporates global scene semantic information in addition to local information gathered by a convolutional neural network. Our model is formulated as a mixture of experts. Each expert network is trained to predict saliency for a set of closely related images. The final saliency map is computed as a weighted mixture of the expert networks' output, with weights determined by a separate gating network. This gating network is guided by global scene information to predict weights. The expert networks and the gating network are trained simultaneously in an end-toend manner. We show that our mixture formulation leads to improvement in performance over an otherwise identical nonmixture model that does not incorporate global scene information. Additionally, we show that our model achieves better performance than several other visual saliency models.
papers.title_zh: 利用深神经网络混合体的视觉光度预测
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉显著模型最近开始纳入深层次的学习,以便实现比以往未受监督的方法更大的预测能力,然而,大多数现有模型预测出显著性,而没有对全球景象语义信息的明确了解。 我们提出了一个模型(MxSalNet),该模型除了由进化神经网络收集的当地信息外,还包含全球景象语义信息,我们的模型是作为专家混合体设计的,每个专家网络都受过培训,可以预测一组密切相关的图像的显著性。 最后突出度地图作为专家网络产出的加权组合计算,加权数由单独的格子网络决定,这一格子网络以全球场景信息为指导,以预测重量,专家网络和格子网络同时以端端方式接受培训。 我们的混合配方表明,我们的混合配方能够改善与不包含全球场景信息的原样相同的非混合模型的性能。 此外,我们还表明,我们的混合配方比其他几个视觉显著模型的性能要好。

papers.title: Steered mixture-of-experts for light field video coding
papers.authors: Glenn Van Wallendael, Ruben Verhack, Peter Lambert, Thomas Sikora, Vasileios Avramelos, Ignace Saenen
papers.abstract: Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) is a novel framework for representing multidimensional image modalities. In this paper, we propose a coding methodology for SMoE models that is readily extendable to any dimensional SMoE model, thus representing any image modality of any dimension. We evaluate the coding performance of SMoE models of light field video, a 5D image modality, i.e. time, two angular, and two spatial dimensions. The coding consists of the exploiting the redundancy between the parameters of SMoE models, i.e. a set of multivariate Gaussian distributions. We compare the performance of three multi-view HEVC (MV-HEVC) configurations that differ in terms of random access. Each subaperture view from the light field video is interpreted as a single view in MV-HEVC. Experiments validate that excellent coding performance compared to MV-HEVC for low- to midrange bitrates in terms of PSNR and SSIM with bitrate savings up to 75%.
papers.title_zh: 用于轻型现场视频视频编码的固定专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: Steered Mixture of-Experts(SMoE)是代表多维图像模式的新框架。 在本文中,我们提出了SmoE模型的编码方法,该方法可以随时推广到任何维SMoE模型,从而代表任何层面的任何图像模式。 我们评估了光场视频SMoE模型的编码性能,5D图像模式,即时间、两个角和两个空间维度。编码包括利用SMoE模型参数之间的冗余,即一组多变量高斯分布。 我们比较了三种多视图的HIVC(MV-HEVC)配置的性能,这些配置在随机访问方面有所不同。 光场视频的每个次视图都被解释为MV-HEVC的单一视图。 实验证实,就PSNR和SSIM而言,中中低比特率的MV-HEVC与MV-HEVC相比,在比特率储蓄率高达75%的比特率中低比特率和SSIM中低比特率方面,与MV-HEVC相比,其极好的编码性能。

papers.title: Regularized Gradient Descent Training of Steered Mixture of Experts for Sparse Image Representation
papers.authors: Erik Bochinski, Rolf Jongebloed, Michael Tok, Thomas Sikora
papers.abstract: The Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) framework targets a sparse space-continuous representation for images, videos, and light fields enabling processing tasks such as approximation, denoising, and coding. The underlying stochastic processes are represented by a Gaussian Mixture Model, traditionally trained by the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm. We instead propose to use the MSE of the regressed imagery for a Gradient Descent optimization as primary training objective. Further, we extend this approach with regularization terms to enforce desirable properties like the sparsity of the model or noise robustness of the training process. Experimental evaluations show that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art consistently by 1.5 dB to 6.1 dB PSNR for image representation.
papers.title_zh: 对Steered Sparse图像代表制专家混合体的定型渐渐血统培训
papers.abstract_zh: Steered Mixture of-experts(SMoE)框架针对的图像、视频和光场的空间持续性代表很少,能够进行近似、去硝化和编码等处理任务。 基本的随机过程由高斯混合模型代表,该模型传统上由期望-最大化算法培训。我们提议将递减图像的MSE作为逐步下降的层层优化的首要培训目标。 此外,我们扩展了这一方法,增加了正规化条件,以强制实施诸如模型的宽度或培训过程的噪音坚固度等适当性能。 实验性评估表明,我们的方法在图像显示方面一贯优于最新水平1.5 dB至6.1 dB PSNR。

papers.title: Quality Robust Mixtures of Deep Neural Networks
papers.authors: Samuel Dodge, Lina J. Karam
papers.abstract: We study deep neural networks for classification of images with quality distortions. Deep network performance on poor quality images can be greatly improved if the network is fine-tuned with distorted data. However, it is difficult for a single fine-tuned network to perform well across multiple distortion types. We propose a mixture of experts based ensemble method, MixQualNet, that is robust to multiple different types of distortions. The "experts" in our model are trained on a particular type of distortion. The output of the model is a weighted sum of the expert models, where the weights are determined by a separate gating network. The gating network is trained to predict weights for a particular distortion type and level. During testing, the network is blind to the distortion level and type, yet can still assign appropriate weights to the expert models. In order to reduce the computational complexity, we introduce weight sharing into the MixQualNet. We utilize the TreeNet weight sharing architecture as well as introduce the Inverted TreeNet architecture. While both weight sharing architectures reduce memory requirements, our proposed Inverted TreeNet also achieves improved accuracy.
papers.title_zh: 深神经网络质量强力混合
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究对质量失真的图像进行分类的深层神经网络;如果网络对失真的数据进行微调,那么低质量图像的深层网络性能可以大大提高;然而,单一个微调网络很难在多种失真类型之间运行良好。 我们建议一种混合的专家混合方法MixQualNet(MixQualNet),它能抵御多种不同类型的失真。 我们模型中的“专家”就某种特定的失真进行了培训。 模型的输出是专家模型的加权总和,加权数由单独的格子网决定,对格子网进行培训,以预测特定失真类型和层次的加权数。 在测试过程中,网络对失真水平和类型视而不见,但仍能给专家模型分配适当的权重。 为了降低计算的复杂性,我们引入了混合QualNet的权重共享。 我们使用树头网的权重共享架构,并引入了倒置树头网架构。 虽然两个权重共享架构都降低了记忆要求,但我们提议的倒置树头网也提高了准确性。

papers.title: Progressive Modeling of Steered Mixture-of-Experts for Light Field Video Approximation
papers.authors: Ruben Verhack, Glenn Van Wallendael, Martijn Courteaux, Peter Lambert, Thomas Sikora
papers.abstract: Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) is a novel framework for the approximation, coding, and description of image modalities. The future goal is to arrive at a representation for Six Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) image data. The goal of this paper is to introduce SMoE for 4D light field videos by including the temporal dimension. However, these videos contain vast amounts of samples due to the large number of views per frame. Previous work on static light field images mitigated the problem by hard subdividing the modeling problem. However, such a hard subdivision introduces visually disturbing block artifacts on moving objects in dynamic image data. We propose a novel modeling method that does not result in block artifacts while minimizing the computational complexity and which allows for a varying spread of kernels in the spatio-temporal domain. Experiments validate that we can progressively model light field videos with increasing objective quality up to 0.97 SSIM.
papers.title_zh: Steered 光场视频近似光场专家的Steered Mixture 逐步建模
papers.abstract_zh: Steered Mixture of-Experts(SMoE)是近似、编码和描述图像模式的新框架。 未来的目标是获得6度自由(6度自由)图像数据的代表。 本文的目的是通过纳入时间维度,为4D光场视频介绍SMoE,然而,这些视频包含大量样本,因为每个框架的浏览量很大。 以往关于静态光场图像的工作通过硬性地分解模型问题缓解了这一问题。 然而,这种硬分区在动态图像数据中,在移动物体时引入了令人目视不安的块状文物。 我们建议一种新的模型方法,不产生块状文物,同时尽量减少计算的复杂性,允许时空空间内核的不同扩散。 实验证实,我们可以逐步模拟光场视频,提高客观质量,达到0.97 SSIM。

papers.title: Hard Real-Time, Pixel-Parallel Rendering of Light Field Videos Using Steered Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Ignace Saenen, Ruben Verhack, Vasileios Avramelos, Glenn Van Wallendael, Peter Lambert
papers.abstract: Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) is a novel framework for the approximation, coding, and description of image modalities such as light field images and video. The future goal is to arrive at a representation for Six Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) image data. Previous research has shown the feasibility of real-time pixel-parallel rendering of static light field images. Each pixel is independently reconstructed by kernels that lay in its vicinity. The number of kernels involved forms the bottleneck on the achievable framerate. The goal of this paper is twofold. Firstly, we introduce pixel-level rendering of light field video, as previous work only rendered static content. Secondly, we investigate rendering using a predefined number of most significant kernels. As such, we can deliver hard real-time constraints by trading off the reconstruction quality.
papers.title_zh: 使用Steered Mixture 专家的硬实时、像素- Parallel 光场视频制作像素- Parallel
papers.abstract_zh: Steered Mixture of-Experts(SMoE)是近似、编码和描述图像模式(如光场图像和视频)的新框架。 未来的目标是获得6度自由(6DoF)图像数据的代表。 先前的研究显示,静态光场图像的实时像素-平行投影是可行的。 每一个像素都由位于其附近的内核独立重建。 所涉及的内核数量构成了可实现框架速率的瓶颈。 本文的目标是双重的 。 首先,我们引入像素水平的光场视频,因为先前的工作只提供了静态内容。 其次,我们用一个预定数量的最重要核心来调查数据。 因此,我们可以通过交换重建质量来提供硬性实时限制。

papers.title: Visual Text Correction
papers.authors: Amir Mazaheri, Mubarak Shah
papers.abstract: Videos, images, and sentences are mediums that can express the same semantics. One can imagine a picture by reading a sentence or can describe a scene with some words. However, even small changes in a sentence can cause a significant semantic inconsistency with the corresponding video/image. For example, by changing the verb of a sentence, the meaning may drastically change. There have been many efforts to encode a video/sentence and decode it as a sentence/video. In this research, we study a new scenario in which both the sentence and the video are given, but the sentence is inaccurate. A semantic inconsistency between the sentence and the video or between the words of a sentence can result in an inaccurate description. This paper introduces a new problem, called Visual Text Correction (VTC), i.e., finding and replacing an inaccurate word in the textual description of a video. We propose a deep network that can simultaneously detect an inaccuracy in a sentence, and fix it by replacing the inaccurate word(s). Our method leverages the semantic interdependence of videos and words, as well as the short-term and long-term relations of the words in a sentence. In our formulation, part of a visual feature vector for every single word is dynamically selected through a gating process. Furthermore, to train and evaluate our model, we propose an approach to automatically construct a large dataset for VTC problem. Our experiments and performance analysis demonstrates that the proposed method provides very good results and also highlights the general challenges in solving the VTC problem. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first of its kind for the Visual Text Correction task.
papers.title_zh: 视觉文字校正
papers.abstract_zh: 视频、图像和句子是能够表达相同语义的媒介。 人们可以通过阅读句子来想象图片,也可以用一些词描述场景。 但是,即使对句子稍作改动,也可能导致语义与相应的视频/图像大相径庭。 例如,通过改变一个句子的动词,其含义可能会发生巨大变化。 已经做出了许多努力来将一个视频/判刑编码,并把它破译为句子/录像。 在这个研究中,我们研究了一种既给出了该句子又给出了视频的新情景,但该句子是不准确的。 句子和视频之间的语义不一致或句子的词句不一致可能导致描述不准确。 本文提出了一个新问题,叫做视觉文字校正(VTC ) , 也就是在视频文字描述中查找和替换一个不准确的词。 我们建议建立一个深层次的网络,能够同时发现一个句子中的不准确之处,并通过替换不准确的单词来解决这个问题。 我们的方法利用了视频和单词的语义相互依存关系,以及句子中词句的短期和长期关系。 在我们的提法中,每个单词的视觉特征矢量的一部分都是通过加格过程动态选择的。 此外,为了培训和评估我们的模型,我们建议了一种方法,为VTC问题自动建立一个大型数据集。 我们的实验和业绩分析表明,拟议的方法提供了非常好的结果,也突出了解决VTC问题的总体挑战。 据我们所知,这项工作是视觉文字校正任务的首项此类工作。

papers.title: Video Re-localization
papers.authors: Yang Feng, Lin Ma, Wei Liu, Tong Zhang, Jiebo Luo
papers.abstract: Many methods have been developed to help people find the video content they want efficiently. However, there are still some unsolved problems in this area. For example, given a query video and a reference video, how to accurately localize a segment in the reference video such that the segment semantically corresponds to the query video? We define a distinctively new task, namely extbf{video re-localization}, to address this need. Video re-localization is an important enabling technology with many applications, such as fast seeking in videos, video copy detection, as well as video surveillance. Meanwhile, it is also a challenging research task because the visual appearance of a semantic concept in videos can have large variations. The first hurdle to clear for the video re-localization task is the lack of existing datasets. It is labor expensive to collect pairs of videos with semantic coherence or correspondence, and label the corresponding segments. We first exploit and reorganize the videos in ActivityNet to form a new dataset for video re-localization research, which consists of about 10,000 videos of diverse visual appearances associated with the localized boundary information. Subsequently, we propose an innovative cross gated bilinear matching model such that every time-step in the reference video is matched against the attentively weighted query video. Consequently, the prediction of the starting and ending time is formulated as a classification problem based on the matching results. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the baseline methods.
papers.title_zh: 视频重新定位
papers.abstract_zh: 已经开发了许多方法来帮助人们有效地找到他们想要的视频内容,然而,在这方面仍然存在一些尚未解决的问题。 例如,给一个Query视频和一个参考视频,如何精确地将参考视频中的一段位置定位,使该段的音义与Query视频相对应?我们定义了一种独特的新任务,即EXBF{视频重新定位},以满足这一需要。 视频重新定位是一个重要的赋能技术,有许多应用,比如快速寻找视频、视频复制检测以及视频监控。 与此同时,它也是一项具有挑战性的研究任务,因为视频中语义概念的视觉外观可以产生巨大的变化。 视频重新定位任务要清除的第一个障碍是缺少现有的数据集。 收集具有语义一致性或通信的两对视频并贴上相应部分的标签需要花费大量人力。 我们首先利用并重组“活动网”中的视频, 以形成一个新的数据集, 用于视频重新定位研究, 由大约10,000个视频组成, 随后,我们提出了一个创新的跨门双线匹配模式,使参考视频的每一个时间步骤都与仔细加权Query视频相匹配,因此,根据匹配结果,将开始和结束时间的预测作为一个分类问题。 广泛的实验结果显示,拟议方法的业绩超过了基准方法。

papers.title: Towards Robust Face Recognition with Comprehensive Search
papers.authors: Manyuan Zhang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li
papers.abstract: "Data cleaning, architecture, and loss function design are important factors contributing to high-performance face recognition. Previously, the research community tries to improve the performance of each single aspect but failed to present a unified solution on the joint search of the optimal designs for all three aspects.In this paper, we for the first time identify that these aspects are tightly coupled to each other. Optimizing the design of each aspect actually greatly limits the performance and biases the algorithmic design.Specifically, we find that the optimal model architecture or loss function is closely coupled with the data cleaning. To eliminate the bias of single-aspect research and provide an overall understanding of the face recognition model design, we first carefully design the search space for each aspect, then a comprehensive search method is introduced to jointly search optimal data cleaning, architecture, and loss function design.In our framework, we make the proposed comprehensive search as flexible as possible, by using an innovative reinforcement learning based approach.Extensive experiments on million-level face recognition benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our newly-designed search space for each aspect and the comprehensive search. We outperform expert algorithms developed for each single research track by large margins. More importantly, we analyze the difference between our searched optimal design and the independent design of the single factors. We point out that strong models tend to optimize with more difficult training datasets and loss functions. Our empirical study can provide guidance in future research towards more robust face recognition systems."
papers.title_zh: 努力以全面搜索实现硬性脸部识别
papers.abstract_zh: “数据清理、建筑和损失功能设计是促使高性能面部识别的重要因素。 以前,研究界试图改进每个方面的业绩,但未能就联合寻找所有三个方面的最佳设计提出统一的解决办法。 优化每个方面的设计实际上大大限制了性能和对算法设计的偏向。 具体地说,我们发现最佳模型结构或损失功能与数据清理密切相关。 为了消除单一区域研究的偏向,并全面了解面部识别模型的设计,我们首先仔细设计每个方面的搜索空间,然后采用全面搜索方法,共同搜索最佳数据清理、架构和损失功能设计。 在我们的框架内,我们采用创新的强化学习方法,尽可能灵活地开展拟议的全面搜索。 百万级面部识别基准的广泛实验表明我们新设计的每个方面的搜索空间和全面搜索的有效性。 更重要的是,我们分析了我们所搜索的最佳设计和单项因素的独立设计之间的区别。 我们指出,强健的模型往往以更困难的培训数据集和损失功能来优化。 我们的经验研究可以为未来研究提供指导,以建立更健全的面部识别系统。 ”

papers.title: Tips and Tricks for Visual Question Answering: Learnings From the 2017 Challenge
papers.authors: Damien Teney, Peter Anderson, Xiaodong He, Anton van den Hengel
papers.abstract: This paper presents a state-of-the-art model for visual question answering (VQA), which won the first place in the 2017 VQA Challenge. VQA is a task of significant importance for research in artificial intelligence, given its multimodal nature, clear evaluation protocol, and potential real-world applications. The performance of deep neural networks for VQA is very dependent on choices of architectures and hyperparameters. To help further research in the area, we describe in detail our high-performing, though relatively simple model. Through a massive exploration of architectures and hyperparameters representing more than 3,000 GPU-hours, we identified tips and tricks that lead to its success, namely: sigmoid outputs, soft training targets, image features from bottom-up attention, gated tanh activations, output embeddings initialized using GloVe and Google Images, large mini-batches, and smart shuffling of training data. We provide a detailed analysis of their impact on performance to assist others in making an appropriate selection.
papers.title_zh: 视觉问答提示和秘诀:从2017年挑战中学习
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了视觉问题回答的最新模型(VQA),该模型在2017年VQA挑战中名列第一位。 鉴于人工智能的多式性质、明确的评估协议和潜在的现实应用,VQA是一项对人工智能研究非常重要的任务。 VQA深层神经网络的性能非常取决于建筑和超参数的选择。 为了帮助该领域的进一步研究,我们详细描述了我们高性能、尽管相对简单的模型。 通过大规模探索代表3 000多个GPU小时的建筑和超参数,我们发现了导致其成功的窍门和技巧,即:小类输出、软培训目标、自下而上关注的图像特征、闭锁的制革装置、使用GloVe和Google图像初始化的输出嵌入、大型微型工具以及智能化的培训数据转换。 我们详细分析了它们对业绩的影响,以协助其他方面作出适当选择。

papers.title: Soft-Gated Warping-GAN for Pose-Guided Person Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Haoye Dong, Xiaodan Liang, Ke Gong, Hanjiang Lai, Jia Zhu, Jian Yin
