papers.abstract_zh: 事实证明,多式遥感对视觉跟踪很有价值,因为不同的传感器类型在处理物体外观各不相同的特定挑战性场景方面提供了独特的优势。 虽然一种能够利用所有模式的通才模式是理想的,但发展受到数据分散的阻碍,通常在实践上,一个模式只有一个。 因此,必须确保并实现从多式联运获得的知识 -- -- 例如确定相关特征和区域 -- -- 得到有效分享,即使推断无法采用某些模式。 我们冒昧地假设一个简单的假设:不同模式的类似样本比其他模式有更多的知识可以分享。 为了实现这一点,我们雇用了损失微弱的分类师,负责区分模式。 更具体地说,如果分类“失败 ” ( fails) 无法准确确定特定样本的模式,这预示着跨模式知识共享的机会。 直观地说,只要一种模式的样本足够接近和与另一种模式一致,知识转让就会得到便利。 从技术上讲,我们在为多式视频物体跟踪设计的专家混合框架内,通过将样本从一种模式向其他模式的专家输送到其他模式的专家来实现这一点。 在推断期间,选择了各自模式的专家,我们证明,由于拟议的方法,从培训期间现有的多式联运知识中受益匪浅。 通过在培训期间只使用配对RGB-E、RGB-D和RGB-T的详尽实验,我们展示了建议的RGB-X追踪器方法在推断期间的益处,比目前的SOTA提高了平均+3%的精确度。我们的源代码将被发布。

papers.title: What You Have is What You Track: Adaptive and Robust Multimodal Tracking
papers.authors: Yuedong Tan · Jiawei Shao · Eduard Zamfir · Ruanjun Li · Zhaochong An · Chao Ma · Danda Pani Paudel · Luc Gool · Radu Timofte · Zongwei Wu
papers.abstract: Multimodal data is known to be helpful for visual tracking by improving robustness to appearance variations. However, sensor synchronization challenges often compromise data availability, particularly in video settings where shortages can be temporal. Despite its importance, this area remains underexplored. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data. Unsurprisingly, under such a circumstance, existing trackers exhibit significant performance degradation, as their rigid architectures lack the adaptability needed to effectively handle missing modalities.To address these limitations, we propose a flexible framework for robust multimodal tracking. We venture that a tracker should dynamically activate computational units based on missing data rates. This is achieved through a novel Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism with adaptive complexity, coupled with a video-level masking strategy that ensures both temporal consistency and spatial completeness — critical for effective video tracking. Surprisingly, our model not only adapts to varying missing rates but also adjusts to scene complexity. Extensive experiments show that our model achieves SOTA performance across 9 benchmarks, excelling in both conventional complete and missing modality settings. The code and benchmark will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 你拥有的就是你所追踪的:适应和强健的多式联运跟踪
papers.abstract_zh: 众所周知,多模式数据有助于通过提高外观变异的稳健性进行目视跟踪,但传感器同步挑战往往会影响数据的可用性,特别是在视频环境,因为视频环境的短缺可能是短暂的。 尽管这个领域很重要,但仍未得到充分探讨。 在本文中,我们介绍关于跟踪者业绩的第一份全面研究报告,其中载有时间上不完整的多式联运数据。 不足为奇的是,在这种情况下,现有的跟踪者表现严重恶化,因为它们的僵硬结构缺乏有效处理缺失模式所需的适应能力。 为解决这些限制,我们提议为强有力的多式联运跟踪建立一个灵活的框架。 我们冒昧地说,追踪器应该根据缺失的数据率动态激活计算单位。 这是通过一种具有适应性复杂性的新颖的多样化专家混合机制实现的,加上一个视频层面的遮掩战略,确保时间一致性和空间完整性——这对有效的视频跟踪至关重要。 令人惊讶的是,我们的模型不仅适应了不同的缺失率,而且适应了场景的复杂性。 广泛的实验表明,我们的模型在9个基准中取得了SOTA的绩效,在常规完整和缺失模式设置中都取得了卓越的成绩。 代码和基准将被公布于众。

papers.title: VA-MoE: Variables-Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Incremental Weather Forecasting
papers.authors: Hao Chen · Tao Han · Song Guo · Jie ZHANG · Yonghan Dong · Yunlong Yu · LEI BAI
papers.abstract: This paper presents Variables-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (VA-MoE), a novel framework for incremental weather forecasting that dynamically adapts to evolving spatiotemporal patterns in real-time data. Traditional weather prediction models often struggle with exorbitant computational expenditure and the need to continuously update forecasts as new observations arrive. VA-MoE addresses these challenges by leveraging a hybrid architecture of experts, where each expert specializes in capturing distinct sub-patterns of atmospheric variables (e.g., temperature, humidity, wind speed). Moreover, the proposed method employs a variable-adaptive gating mechanism to dynamically select and combine relevant experts based on the input context, enabling efficient knowledge distillation and parameter sharing. This design significantly reduces computational overhead while maintaining high forecast accuracy. Experiments on real-world ERA5 dataset demonstrate that VA-MoE performs comparable against state-of-the-art models in both short-term (e.g., 1–3 days) and long-term (e.g., 5 days) forecasting tasks, with only about 25 % of trainable parameters and 50 % of the initial training data.
papers.title_zh: VA-MoE:增量天气预报专家可变适应混合
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍专家可变适应性混合模型(VA-MoE),这是一个新的增量天气预报框架,能动态地适应实时数据中不断变化的时空模式。 传统的天气预测模型往往难以应付高昂的计算支出,而且随着新的观测结果的到来,需要不断更新预测。 VA-MoE通过利用专家混合结构应对这些挑战,每位专家专门捕捉不同的大气变量亚模式(如温度、湿度、风速)。 此外,拟议方法还采用可变适应机制,根据投入情况动态地挑选和合并相关专家,以便高效的知识蒸馏和参数共享,这一设计大大减少计算间接费用,同时保持较高的预测准确性。 真实世界ERA5数据集的实验表明,VA-MOE在短期(例如1-3天)和长期(例如5天)预测任务中都与最先进的模型具有可比性,只有大约25%的可培训参数和50%的初始培训数据。

papers.title: Switch Diffusion Transformer: Synergizing Denoising Tasks with Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Byeongjun Park · Hyojun Go · Jin-Young Kim · Sangmin Woo · Seokil Ham · Changick Kim
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success across a range of generative tasks. Recent efforts to enhance diffusion model architectures have reimagined them as a form of multi-task learning, where each task corresponds to a denoising task at a specific noise level. While these efforts have focused on parameter isolation and task routing, they fall short of capturing detailed inter-task relationships and risk losing semantic information, respectively. In response, we introduce Switch Diffusion Transformer (Switch-DiT), which establishes inter-task relationships between conflicting tasks without compromising semantic information. To achieve this, we employ a sparse mixture-of-experts within each transformer block to utilize semantic information and facilitate handling conflicts in tasks through parameter isolation. Additionally, we propose a diffusion prior loss, encouraging similar tasks to share their denoising paths while isolating conflicting ones. Through these, each transformer block contains a shared expert across all tasks, where the common and task-specific denoising paths enable the diffusion model to construct its beneficial way of synergizing denoising tasks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach in improving both image quality and convergence rate, and further analysis demonstrates that Switch-DiT constructs tailored denoising paths across various generation scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 切换扩散Transformer: 将 Denoising 任务与 Sparse Mixture 专家同步
papers.abstract_zh: 传播模型在一系列基因化任务中取得了显著成功,最近加强传播模型结构的努力重新想象这些模型是多任务学习的一种形式,其中每项任务都相当于在特定噪音水平上进行无声化任务。 虽然这些努力侧重于参数孤立和任务路径,但未能分别捕捉到详细的任务间关系,并有可能失去语义信息。 作为回应,我们引入了开关传播Transformer(Switch-Dit),该Transformer在相互冲突的任务之间建立起任务间的关系,同时不损害语义信息。 为此,我们在每个变压器区段内雇用少数专家,利用语义信息,通过参数隔离处理任务冲突。 此外,我们建议传播先前的损失,鼓励开展类似工作,在分离相互冲突者的同时,分享其无名化道路。 通过这些手段,每个变压器块都包含一个从事所有任务的共同专家,共同和具体任务专用路径使扩散模型能够构建其有益的方法,以协同消除变压任务。 广泛的实验验证了我们在提高图像质量和汇合率方面的做法的有效性,进一步的分析表明,Switch-DIT在各种代际情景中构筑了量身定制的分泌路径。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Native Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Mustafa Shukor · Enrico Fini · Victor Guilherme Turrisi da Costa · Matthieu Cord · Joshua Susskind · Alaaeldin El-Nouby
papers.abstract: Building general-purpose models that can effectively perceive the world through multimodal signals has been a long-standing goal. Current approaches involve integrating separately pre-trained components, such as connecting vision encoders to LLMs and continuing training on multimodal data. While such approaches exhibit remarkable sample efficiency, it remains an open question whether such late-fusion architectures are inherently superior. In this work, we revisit the architectural design of native multimodal models (NMMs)—those trained from the ground up on all modalities—and conduct an extensive scaling laws study, spanning 457 trained models with different architectures and training mixtures. Our investigation reveals no inherent advantage to late-fusion architectures over early-fusion ones, which do not rely on pre-trained image encoders or tokenizers. On the contrary, early-fusion exhibits stronger performance at lower parameter count, is more efficient to train, and is easier to deploy. Motivated by the strong performance of the early-fusion architectures, we show that incorporating Mixture of Experts (MoEs) allows models to learn modality-specific weights, significantly benefiting performance.
papers.title_zh: 土著多模式模式法律推广
papers.abstract_zh: 建立能够通过多式联运信号有效认识世界的普通用途模式是一个长期目标,目前的做法包括将预先培训的构成部分分开,例如将视觉编码器与LLMS连接起来,以及继续提供关于多式联运数据的培训。 虽然这类方法的样本效率显著,但这种迟聚结构本身是否优越仍然是一个未决问题。 在这项工作中,我们重新审视了本地多式联运模式的建筑设计——这些模式是经过各种模式培训的,并进行了广泛的法律规模研究,涉及457个具有不同结构和培训混合物的经过培训的模型。 我们的调查显示,较之于不依赖预先训练的图像编码器或代用品的早期集成结构,后聚变结构本身没有内在优势。 相反,早期集成在较低参数计数时表现更强,更高效地进行培训,更便于部署。 以早期融合结构的强劲表现为动力,我们表明,纳入专家混合(MoEs)使模型能够学习特定模式的权重,大大有利于业绩。

papers.title: SAME: Learning Generic Language-Guided Visual Navigation with State-Adaptive Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Gengze Zhou · Yicong Hong · Zun Wang · Chongyang Zhao · Mohit Bansal · Qi Wu
papers.abstract: The academic field of learning instruction-guided visual navigation can be generally categorized into high-level category-specific search and low-level language-guided navigation, depending on the granularity of language instruction, in which the former emphasizes the exploration process, while the latter concentrates on following detailed textual commands. Despite the differing focuses of these tasks, the underlying requirements of interpreting instructions, comprehending the surroundings, and inferring action decisions remain consistent.This paper consolidates diverse navigation tasks into a unified and generic framework -- we investigate the core difficulties of sharing general knowledge and exploiting task-specific capabilities in learning navigation and propose a novel State-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (SAME) model that effectively enables an agent to infer decisions based on different-granularity language and dynamic observations. Powered by SAME, we present a versatile agent capable of addressing seven navigation tasks simultaneously that outperforms or achieves highly comparable performance to task-specific agents.
papers.title_zh: SAME: 学习通用语言指导的视觉导航,由国家适应性专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 学习教学指导视觉导航的学术领域一般可归为高级别特定类别的搜索和低级别语言指导导航,这取决于语言教学的颗粒性,前者强调探索过程,而后者则侧重于遵循详细的文字指令。 尽管这些任务的重点不同,但解释指示、理解周围环境以及推断行动决定的基本要求仍然一致。 本文将各种导航任务合并为一个统一和通用的框架 -- -- 我们调查分享一般知识和利用特定任务在学习导航方面的能力方面的核心困难,并提出一个新的国家适应性专家混合模式,使代理人能够有效地根据不同组合语言和动态观察推断决定。 在SAME的推动下,我们提出了一个多功能的代理机构,能够同时处理7项导航任务,这些任务的业绩优于或达到与具体任务代理机构高度相似的业绩。

papers.title: ROAR: Reducing Inversion Error in Generative Image Watermarking
papers.authors: Hanyi Wang · Han Fang · Shi-Lin Wang · Ee-Chien Chang
papers.abstract: Generative image watermarking enables the proactive detection and traceability of generated images. Among existing methods, inversion-based frameworks achieve highly conceal ed watermark embedding by injecting watermarks into the latent representation before the diffusion process. The robustness of this approach hinges on both the embedding mechanism and inversion accuracy. However, prior works have predominantly focused on optimizing the embedding process while overlooking inversion errors, which significantly affect extraction fidelity. In this paper, we address the challenge of inversion errors and propose ROAR, a dual-domain optimization-based framework designed to mitigate errors arising from two key sources: 1) Latent-domain errors, which accumulate across inversion steps due to inherent approximation assumptions. 2) Pixel-domain errors, which result from channel distortions such as JPEG compression. To tackle these issues, we introduce two novel components: A Regeneration-based Optimization (RO) mechanism, which incorporates an optimizable starting latent to minimize latent-domain errors; A Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based distortion-adaptive restoration (AR) network, which effectively recovers watermarked distributions from pixel-level distortions.Extensive experiments demonstrate that ROAR significantly reduces inversion errors and enhances watermark extraction robustness, thereby improving the reliability of generative image watermarking.
papers.title_zh: 注重成果的年度报告:减少生成图像水标记中的自转错误
papers.abstract_zh: 在现有的方法中,基于倒置的框架在扩散过程之前通过注入水印将高度隐蔽的水印嵌入潜在代表面。 这种方法的稳健性取决于嵌入机制和反向准确性,然而,先前的工程主要侧重于优化嵌入过程,同时忽略了反向错误,这严重影响了采掘的忠诚性。 在本文中,我们处理反向错误的挑战,并提出注重成果的年度报告,这是一个以双重领域为主的优化框架,旨在减少两个关键来源产生的错误:1) 后向域错误,由于固有的近似假设,这些错误在反向步骤之间累积。 (2) 像素域错误,这是JPEG压缩等频道失真造成的。 为了解决这些问题,我们引进了两个新的组成部分:以再生为基础的优化机制,它包含一个最理想的起始潜力,以尽量减少潜在领域错误; 专家混合(MOE)的失真-适应性恢复(AR)网络,有效地从像素级失真中回收了标记水的分布。广泛的实验表明注重成果的年度报告大大减少了倒流错误,提高了水标记提取的坚固度,从而提高了基因图象标记的可靠性。

papers.title: Occluded Gait Recognition with Mixture of Experts: An Action Detection Perspective
papers.authors: Panjian Huang · Yunjie Peng · Saihui Hou · Chunshui Cao · Xu Liu · Zhiqiang He · Yongzhen Huang
papers.abstract: Extensive occlusions in real-world scenarios pose challenges to gait recognition due to missing and noisy information, as well as body misalignment in position and scale. We argue that rich dynamic contextual information within a gait sequence inherently possesses occlusion-solving traits: 1) Adjacent frames with gait continuity allow holistic body regions to infer occluded body regions; 2) Gait cycles allow information integration between holistic actions and occluded actions. Therefore, we introduce an action detection perspective where a gait sequence is regarded as a composition of actions. To detect accurate actions under complex occlusion scenarios, we propose an Action Detection Based Mixture of Experts (GaitMoE), consisting of Mixture of Temporal Experts (MTE) and Mixture of Action Experts (MAE). MTE adaptively constructs action anchors by temporal experts and MAE adaptively constructs action proposals from action anchors by action experts. Especially, action detection as a proxy task with gait recognition is an end-to-end joint training only with ID labels. In addition, due to the lack of a unified occluded benchmark, we construct a pioneering Occluded Gait database (OccGait), containing rich occlusion scenarios and annotations of occlusion types. Extensive experiments on OccGait, OccCASIA-B, Gait3D and GREW demonstrate the superior performance of GaitMoE. OccGait is available at https://github.com/BNU-IVC/OccGait.
papers.title_zh: 与专家混合混合的隐隐性盖子识别:行动探索前景
papers.abstract_zh: 由于信息缺失和吵闹,以及位置和规模的体位失调,在现实世界情景中被广泛排斥在外,对行动识别构成挑战。 我们认为,在步态序列中丰富的动态背景信息本身就具有排他性解析特征:(1) 相近框架与步态连续性使整体机构区域能够渗透隐蔽体区域;(2) 盖特周期使整体行动和隐蔽行动之间的信息一体化。 因此,我们从行动探测角度出发,将行动顺序视为行动的构成。 为了在复杂的隔离情景下发现准确的行动,我们提议采用基于行动探测的专家混合(GaitMoE),由时间专家混合(MTE)和行动专家混合(MAE)组成。 MTE适应性构筑行动锚,由时间专家和MAE适应性构筑行动锚,由行动专家从行动锚中构筑行动提案。 特别是,作为动作识别的代理任务,行动探测是端对端联合培训,只有ID标签。 此外,由于缺乏一个统一的隐蔽基准,我们建立了一个先驱的隐蔽盖特数据库(OccGait),其中载有丰富的隐蔽情景和隐蔽类型说明。 OccGait可查阅https://github.com/BNU-IVC/OccGait。

papers.title: Not Only Vision: Evolve Visual Speech Recognition via Peripheral Information
papers.authors: Zhaoxin Yuan · Shuang Yang · Shiguang Shan · Xilin Chen
papers.abstract: Visual Speech Recognition (VSR) aims to infer spoken content by analyzing the speaker’s facial dynamics. While this technology has shown promise, a question naturally arises: Is it sufficient to rely solely on such visual information in complex real-world scenarios?Humans, on the other hand, excel at lip-reading by leveraging information beyond lip movements, such as speech-related background and prior knowledge about the task. Despite this well-recognized human capability, existing approaches have not explored incorporating such Peripheral Information into automatic frameworks.We categorize peripheral information into a hierarchical structure based on its relevance to the spoken content: (1) Content Anchors (e.g., speech topic or description), (2) Task Expertise (task-related background, e.g., human prior lip-reading experiences), and (3) Linguistic Perturbation (irrelevant information that VSR systems should process alongside meaningful signals).To unlock the valuable clues embedded in peripheral information, we propose a novel multi-modal framework that utilizes a large language model (LLM) to decode spoken content while seamlessly integrating peripheral information.Center to our framework is a new adaptation method, Synergy LoRA, which enables a coordinated adaptation of visual and textual inputs.Visual features are processed with a independent module while guided by semantic cue from peripheral information by a MoE textual adaptation module. It preserves the fine-grained spatiotemporal details of the visual modality and incorporates peripheral information to enhance recognition.On the widely-used LRS3 dataset, with readily available peripheral information, our model achieves a Word Error Rate (WER) of 22.0 %, surpassing recent approaches.Further experiments on the challenging AVSpeech dataset also show promising results in handling complex real-world scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 不仅有远见:通过周边信息认识进化视觉语音
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语音识别(VSR)旨在通过分析演讲者的面部动态来推断口语内容。 虽然这一技术带来了希望,但自然会出现一个问题:在复杂的现实世界情景中,仅仅依靠这种视觉信息是否就足够了? 另一方面,人类在唇读方面表现得卓越,在嘴唇运动之外还利用信息,例如与语言相关的背景和以前对任务的知识。 尽管有这种公认的人的能力,但现有办法尚未探索将这种外围信息纳入自动框架。 我们根据外源信息与口述内容的相关性,将外围信息分类为等级结构:(1) 内容锁定(例如语音专题或描述),(2) 任务专长(与任务有关的背景,例如人类先前的唇读经历),(3) 语言扰动(VSR系统应与有意义的信号一起处理的不相关信息),为了解开外源信息所包含的宝贵线索,我们提议了一个新的多模式框架,利用大型语言模型(LLLM)解码口语内容,同时无缝地整合外源信息。 它保留了视觉模式精细的时空细节,并纳入了外围信息以强化识别。 在广泛使用的 LRS3 数据集上,有了现成的外围信息,我们的模型实现了22.0%的单词错误率(WER),超过了最近的方法。关于具有挑战性的 AVSpeech 数据集的进一步实验也显示了处理复杂的现实世界情景的有希望的结果。

papers.title: Norface: Improving Facial Expression Analysis by Identity Normalization
papers.authors: Hanwei Liu · Rudong An · Zhimeng Zhang · Bowen Ma · Wei Zhang · Yan Song · Yujing Hu · Chen Wei · Yu Ding
papers.abstract: Facial Expression Analysis (FEA) remains a challenging task due to unexpected task-irrelevant noise, such as identity, head pose, and background. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel framework, called Norface, that is unified for both Action Unit (AU) analysis and Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) tasks. Norface consists of a normalization network and a classification network. First, the carefully designed normalization network struggles to directly remove the above task-irrelevant noise, by maintaining facial expression consistency but normalizing all original images to a common identity with consistent pose, and background. Then, these additional normalized images are fed into the classification network. Due to consistent identity and other factors (e.g. head pose, background, etc.), the normalized images enable the classification network to extract useful expression information more effectively. Additionally, the classification network incorporates a Mixture of Experts to refine the latent representation, including handling the input of facial representations and the output of multiple (AU or emotion) labels. Extensive experiments validate the carefully designed framework with the insight of identity normalization. The proposed method outperforms existing SOTA methods in multiple facial expression analysis tasks, including AU detection, AU intensity estimation, and FER tasks, as well as their cross-dataset tasks. For the normalized datasets and code please visit project page.
papers.title_zh: 准则:通过身份正常化改进简洁的表达分析
papers.abstract_zh: 由于与任务相关的意外噪音,如身份、头部姿势和背景,面部表现分析(FEA)仍是一项艰巨的任务,为解决这一问题,本文提议了一个名为Norface的新框架,这个框架对行动股(AU)的分析任务和承认面部情感(FER)的任务都统一。 Norface是一个正常化网络和一个分类网络。 首先,精心设计的正常化网络努力直接消除上述与任务相关的噪音,其方法是保持面部表达的连贯性,但将所有原始图像正常化,使其具有共同的特征,具有一致的面貌和背景。 然后,这些额外的正常化图像被输入分类网络。由于身份和其他因素(如头部姿势、背景等)的一贯性,正常化图像使分类网络能够更有效地提取有用的表达信息。 此外,分类网络还包括一种专家混合体,以完善潜在的代表性,包括处理面部表情的输入和多种(AU或情感)标签的输出。 广泛的实验通过对身份正常化的洞察力来验证精心设计的框架。 拟议的方法在多种面部表达分析任务(包括非盟检测、非盟强度估计、FER任务及其交叉数据集任务)中优于现有的SOTA方法。 正常数据集和代码请访问项目页面。

papers.title: MOERL: When Mixture-of-Experts Meet Reinforcement Learning for Adverse Weather Image Restoration
papers.authors: Tao Wang · Peiwen Xia · Bo Li · Peng-Tao Jiang · Zhe Kong · Kaihao Zhang · Tong Lu · Wenhan Luo
papers.abstract: Adverse weather conditions, such as rain, snow, and haze, introduce complex degradations that present substantial challenges for effective image restoration. Existing all-in-one models often rely on fixed network structures, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying characteristics of different weather conditions. Moreover, these models typically lack the iterative refinement process that human experts use for progressive image restoration. In this work, we propose MOERL, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) to enhance image restoration across diverse weather conditions. Our method incorporates two core types of experts, i.e., channel-wise modulation and spatial modulation experts to address task-specific degradation characteristics while minimizing task interference. In addition, inspired by human expertise, we frame the optimization process as a sequential, progressive problem, allowing the network to refine its parameters progressively and adapt to specific weather conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy and superiority of our proposed method. The code and pre-trained models will be available.
papers.title_zh: MOERL:当专家混合满足为反天气图像恢复而加强学习时
papers.abstract_zh: 雨水、雪和烟雾等不利的天气条件造成复杂的退化,对有效恢复图像构成重大挑战。 现有的 " 一体行动 " 模型往往依赖固定的网络结构,限制了它们适应不同天气条件不同特点的能力,此外,这些模型通常缺乏人类专家用于逐步恢复图像的迭接完善过程。 在这项工作中,我们建议采用专家混合模型(MOE),该模型以强化学习为优化,以加强不同天气条件下的图像恢复。 我们的方法包括两类核心专家,即频道式调制和空间调制专家,以处理任务特有的退化特点,同时尽量减少任务的干扰。 此外,在人类专门知识的启发下,我们把优化进程确定为一个循序渐进的相继问题,使网络能够逐步完善其参数,适应具体的天气条件,广泛的实验显示了我们拟议方法的功效和优越性。 守则和预培训模式将可供使用。

papers.title: MoEAD: A Parameter-efficient Model for Multi-class Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Shiyuan Meng · Wenchao Meng · Qihang Zhou · Shizhong Li · Weiye Hou · Shibo He
papers.abstract: Utilizing a unified model to detect multi-class anomalies is a promising solution to real-world anomaly detection. Despite their appeal, such models typically suffer from large model parameters and thus pose a challenge to their deployment on memory-constrained embedding devices. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel ViT-style multi-class detection approach named MoEAD, which can reduce the model size while simultaneously maintaining its detection performance. Our key insight is that the FFN layers within each stacked block (i.e., transformer blocks in ViT) mainly characterize the unique representations in these blocks, while the remaining components exhibit similar behaviors across different blocks. The finding motivates us to squeeze traditional stacked transformed blocks from N to a single block, and then incorporate Mixture of Experts (MoE) technology to adaptively select the FFN layer from an expert pool in every recursive round. This allows MoEAD to capture anomaly semantics step-by-step like ViT and choose the optimal representations for distinct class anomaly semantics, even though it shares parameters in all blocks with only one. Extensive experiments show that, compared to the state-of-the-art (SOTA) anomaly detection methods, MoEAD achieves a desirable trade-off between performance and memory consumption. It not only employs the smallest model parameters, has the fastest inference speed, but also obtains competitive detection performance.
papers.title_zh: MoEAD:多级异常探测参数效率模型
papers.abstract_zh: 使用统一的模型来检测多级异常是现实世界异常现象发现的一个很有希望的解决办法。 尽管这些模型具有吸引力,但它们通常会受到大型模型参数的影响,因此对在记忆限制的嵌入装置上部署它们构成挑战。 为应对这一挑战,本文提议采用名为MAEAD的新型VIT型多级探测方法,在同时保持探测性能的同时,可以减少模型大小。 我们的主要见解是,每个堆叠的区块(即ViT中的变压器区块)内FFFN层主要是这些区块中独特特征的特点,而其余部分在不同区块中表现出类似的行为。 这一发现激励我们将传统的堆叠式改造块从N挤压到一个区块,然后将专家混合(MoE)技术纳入每个循环轮从专家库中自适应地选择FFFFN层。 这使MoE能够逐步捕捉异常语义学学,如ViT, 并选择不同类别异常语义学的最佳表达方式, 尽管它只共享一个区块中所有区块的参数 。 广泛的实验表明,与最先进的异常现象检测方法相比,本部在性能和内存消耗之间实现了理想的权衡。 它不仅使用最小的模型参数,具有最快的推论速度,而且具有竞争性的检测性能。

papers.title: MoAI: Mixture of All Intelligence for Large Language and Vision Models
papers.authors: Byung-Kwan Lee · Beomchan Park · Chae Won Kim · Yong Man Ro
papers.abstract: The rise of large language models (LLMs) and instruction tuning has led to the current trend of instruction-tuned large language and vision models (LLVMs). This trend involves either meticulously curating numerous instruction tuning datasets tailored to specific objectives or enlarging LLVMs to manage vast amounts of vision language (VL) data. However, current LLVMs have disregarded the detailed and comprehensive real-world scene understanding available from specialized computer vision (CV) models in visual perception tasks such as segmentation, detection, scene graph generation (SGG), and optical character recognition (OCR). Instead, the existing LLVMs rely mainly on the large capacity and emergent capabilities of their LLM backbones. Therefore, we present a new LLVM, Mixture of All Intelligence (MoAI), which leverages auxiliary visual information obtained from the outputs of external segmentation, detection, SGG, and OCR models. MoAI operates through two newly introduced modules: MoAI-Compressor and MoAI-Mixer. After verbalizing the outputs of the external CV models, the MoAI-Compressor aligns and condenses them to efficiently use relevant auxiliary visual information for VL tasks. MoAI-Mixer then blends three types of intelligence—(1) visual features, (2) auxiliary features from the external CV models, and (3) language features—utilizing the concept of Mixture of Experts. Through this integration, MoAI significantly outperforms both open-source and closed-source LLVMs in numerous zero-shot VL tasks, particularly those related to real-world scene understanding such as object existence, positions, relations, and OCR without enlarging the model size or curating extra visual instruction tuning datasets.
papers.title_zh: MoAI:所有大语言和视觉模型情报的混合
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模式和教学调控的兴起,导致了目前按教学调整的大语言和视觉模式的趋势。 这一趋势涉及仔细调整许多针对具体目标的指示数据集,或扩大LLVMs,以管理大量视觉语言数据。 然而,目前的LLVMs忽视了在截断、检测、景象图生成和光学字符识别等视觉感知任务中,从专门的计算机视觉模型中获得的对真实世界场景的详细和全面的了解。 相反,现有的LLVM主要依赖其LLM骨干的巨大能力和突发能力。 因此,我们提出了一个新的LLVM,“所有情报的混合(MOAI) ” ( Mixture of All Intelligence ) , 利用外部分割、检测、SGG和OCR模型产出的辅助视觉信息。 MoAI通过两个新引入的模块运作:MOAI-压缩机和MOAI-混合机。在对外部CV模型的输出进行口头说明后,MOAI-压缩机对齐并压缩它们,以便有效利用相关的辅助视觉信息进行VL任务。 MoAI-Mixer然后将三种类型的情报((1)视觉特征,(2)外部个人简历模型的辅助特征,(3)语言特征)混合在一起,利用专家混合的概念。 通过这种整合,在很多零弹VL任务中,尤其是那些与现实世界景象理解有关的任务,如物体存在、位置、关系和OCR,莫AI在不扩大模型规模或建立外目视指示调制数据集的情况下,大大优于开放源码和封闭源码LLLVMs。

papers.title: Mixture of Experts Guided by Gaussian Splatters Matters: A new Approach to Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Giacomo D'Amicantonio · Snehashis Majhi · Quan Kong · Lorenzo Garattoni · Gianpiero Francesca · Egor Bondarev · Francois Bremond
papers.abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a challenging task due to the variability of anomalous events and the limited availability of labeled data. Under the Weakly-Supervised VAD (WSVAD) paradigm, only video-level labels are provided during training, while predictions are made at the frame level. Although state-of-the-art models perform well on simple anomalies (e.g., explosions), they struggle with complex real-world events (e.g., shoplifting). This difficulty stems from two key issues: (1) the inability of current models to address the diversity of anomaly types, as they process all categories with a shared model, overlooking category-specific features; and (2) the weak supervision signal, which lacks precise temporal information, limiting the ability to capture nuanced anomalous patterns blended with normal events. To address these challenges, we propose Gaussian Splatting-guided Mixture of Experts (GS-MoE), a novel framework that employs a set of expert models, each specialized in capturing specific anomaly types. These experts are guided by a temporal Gaussian splatting loss, enabling the model to leverage temporal consistency and enhance weak supervision. The Gaussian splatting approach encourages a more precise and comprehensive representation of anomalies by focusing on temporal segments most likely to contain abnormal events. The predictions from these specialized experts are integrated through a mixture-of-experts mechanism to model complex relationships across diverse anomaly patterns. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a 91.58 % AUC on the UCF-Crime dataset, and demonstrates superior results on XD-Violence and MSAD datasets. By leveraging category-specific expertise and temporal guidance, GS-MoE sets a new benchmark for VAD under weak supervision.
papers.title_zh: 由高山飞盘事件指导的专家混合:对微弱超载录像异常现象探测的新办法
papers.abstract_zh: 由于异常事件的多变性和标签数据有限,异常探测是一项具有挑战性的任务,在薄弱超强 VAD(WSVAD)模式下,培训期间只提供视频级别标签,而在框架一级作出预测。 虽然最先进的模型在简单的异常(例如爆炸)方面表现良好,但它们与复杂的现实世界事件(例如商店行窃)挣扎。 这一困难源于两个关键问题:(1) 目前的模式无法解决异常类型的多样性问题,因为它们处理所有类别时都有一个共同的模式,忽略了特定类别的特点;(2) 监督信号薄弱,缺乏准确的时间信息,限制了捕捉与正常事件混合在一起的细微异常模式的能力。 为了应对这些挑战,我们建议高山Splatting-制导专家混合(GS-MoE),这是一个新颖的框架,采用一套专家模型,每个模型专门捕捉特定的异常类型。 这些专家以高斯时期的重叠损失为指导,使模型能够利用时间一致性,加强薄弱的监督。 高斯平面法鼓励以最有可能包含异常事件的时间段为重点,更准确和全面地反映异常现象。 这些专门专家的预测通过专家混合机制加以整合,以模拟不同异常模式的复杂关系。 我们的方法取得了最先进的表现,UCF-犯罪数据集的ACU比例达到了91.58 % , 并展示了XD-暴力和MOSD数据集的优异结果。 通过利用特定类别的专门知识和时间指导,GS-MOE为VAD设定了一个新的监管薄弱的基准。

papers.title: MathVerse: Does Your Multi-modal LLM Truly See the Diagrams in Visual Math Problems?
papers.authors: Renrui Zhang · Dongzhi Jiang · Yichi Zhang · Haokun Lin · Ziyu Guo · Pengshuo Qiu · Aojun Zhou · Pan Lu · Kai-Wei Chang · Peng Gao · Hongsheng LI
papers.abstract: The remarkable progress of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has garnered unparalleled attention, due to their superior performance in visual contexts. However, their capabilities in visual math problem-solving remain insufficiently evaluated and understood. We investigate current benchmarks to incorporate excessive visual content within textual questions, which potentially assist MLLMs in deducing answers without truly interpreting the input diagrams. To this end, we introduce MathVerse, an all-around visual math benchmark designed for an equitable and in-depth evaluation of MLLMs. We meticulously collect 2,612 high-quality, multi-subject math problems with diagrams from publicly available sources. Each problem is then transformed by human annotators into six distinct versions, each offering varying degrees of information content in multi-modality, contributing to 15K test samples in total. This approach allows MathVerse to comprehensively assess whether and how much MLLMs can truly understand the visual diagrams for mathematical reasoning. In addition, we propose a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) evaluation strategy for a fine-grained assessment of the output answers. Rather than naively judging true or false, we employ GPT-4(V) to adaptively extract crucial reasoning steps, and then assess each step with error analysis to derive a total score, which can reveal the inner CoT reasoning quality by MLLMs. With MathVerse, we unveil that, most existing MLLMs struggle to understand math diagrams, relying heavily on textual questions. Surprisingly, some of them even achieve 5%+ higher accuracy without the visual input, e.g., Gemini-Pro and SPHINX-MoE. In contrast, GPT-4V and InternLM-XComposer2 demonstrate relatively better comprehension of the visual content for mathematical reasoning. We hope the MathVerse benchmark may provide unique insights to guide the future development of MLLMs.
papers.title_zh: MathVerse:你的多模式LLM真的看过视觉数学问题的图表吗?
papers.abstract_zh: 多模式大语言模型的显著进步由于在视觉环境中表现优异而得到前所未有的关注,但是,它们解决视觉数学问题的能力仍然没有得到充分的评估和理解。 我们调查目前的基准,将过多的视觉内容纳入文字问题,这可能有助于低语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言/语言) 为此,我们引入了数学Verse(MatthVerse),这是一个全方位的视觉数学基准,旨在对MLLMs(MLLMs)进行公平和深入的评估。 我们仔细地从公开来源的图表中收集了2,612个高质量的多科目数学问题。 然后,每个问题都由人类标注员转换为6种不同的版本,每个版本都提供不同程度的多模式信息内容,总共有助于15K检验样品。 这种方法使得数学Verse能够全面评估MLLMs能否真正理解数学推理的直观图表及其数量。 此外,我们提出了对产出答案进行精细评估的“研究链”评价战略。 我们使用GPT-4(V)来适应性地提取关键推理步骤, 然后用错误分析来评估每一步, 得出总分, 与 MathVerse 合作,我们揭晓了,大多数现有的MLLMS都很难理解数学图表,严重依赖文字问题。 令人惊讶的是,其中一些甚至实现了更高的精确度而没有视觉输入,比如Gemini-Pro和SPHINX-MoE。 相比之下,GPT-4V和InternLM-XComposer2则显示出对数学推理的视觉内容的相对理解。 我们希望数学Verse基准能够提供独特的洞察力来指导MLLMs的未来开发。

papers.title: Learning Robust Stereo Matching in the Wild with Selective Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: WANG Yun · Longguang Wang · Chenghao Zhang · Yongjian Zhang · Zhanjie Zhang · Ao Ma · Chenyou Fan · Tin Lun Lam · Junjie Hu
papers.abstract: Recently, learning-based stereo matching networks have advanced significantly.However, they often lack robustness and struggle to achieve impressive cross-domain performance due to domain shifts and imbalanced disparity distributions among diverse datasets.Leveraging Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) can intuitively enhance the model's robustness, but integrating such a model into stereo matching cost-effectively to fully realize their robustness remains a key challenge.To address this, we propose SMoEStereo, a novel framework that adapts VFMs for stereo matching through a tailored, scene-specific fusion of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules.SMoEStereo introduces MoE-LoRA with adaptive ranks and MoE-Adapter with adaptive kernel sizes. The former dynamically selects optimal experts within MoE to adapt varying scenes across domains, while the latter injects inductive bias into frozen VFMs to improve geometric feature extraction.Importantly, to mitigate computational overhead, we further propose a lightweight decision network that selectively activates MoE modules based on input complexity, balancing efficiency with accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method exhibits state-of-the-art cross-domain and joint generalization across multiple benchmarks without dataset-specific adaptation.
papers.title_zh: 与选择性专家混合在野外学习强力立体对齐
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,基于学习的立体声匹配网络取得了显著进步。 然而,由于不同数据集的域变和分布不平衡,它们往往缺乏活力,难以实现令人印象深刻的跨界性业绩。 运用视觉基础模型(VFMs)可以直观地提高模型的稳健性,但将这种模型纳入符合成本效益的立体声匹配,以充分实现其稳健性,仍是一个关键挑战。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议SMoEStereo(SmoEStereo),这是一个新颖的框架,它通过量身定制的、针对具体环境的低兰克适应模块(LORA)和Mixture-Explets(MOE)模块组合,使VFMS-LORA具有适应性,使MOE-ADapter具有适应性内核尺寸。 前者在MoE内积极挑选最佳专家,以适应不同领域的不同场景,而后者则在冻结的VFM中注入感化偏差,以改进几何特征提取。 为了减少计算间接费用,我们进一步提议建立一个轻量级决策网络,根据输入复杂性有选择地激活MoE模块,平衡效率和准确性。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法展示了最先进的跨领域和在多个基准之间联合推广,而没有具体适应数据集的方法。

papers.title: GM-MoE: Low-Light Enhancement with Gated-Mechanism Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Minwen Liao · Hao Dong · Xinyi Wang · Kurban Ubul · Ziyang Yan · Yihua Shao
papers.abstract: Low-light enhancement has wide applications in autonomous driving, 3D reconstruction, remote sensing, surveillance, and so on, which can significantly improve information utilization. However, most existing methods lack generalization and are limited to specific tasks such as image recovery. To address these issues, we propose Gated-Mechanism Mixture-of-Experts (GM-MoE), the first framework to introduce a mixture-of-experts network for low-light image enhancement. GM-MoE comprises a dynamic gated weight conditioning network and three sub-expert networks, each specializing in a distinct enhancement task. Combining a self-designed gated mechanism that dynamically adjusts the weights of the sub-expert networks for different data domains. Additionally, we integrate local and global feature fusion within sub-expert networks to enhance image quality by capturing multi-scale features. Experimental results demonstrate that the GM-MoE achieves superior generalization with respect to 25 compared approaches, reaching state-of-the-art performance on PSNR on 5 benchmarks and SSIM on 4 benchmarks, respectively.
papers.title_zh: GM-MOE: 利用Gated-机械混合技术提高低亮度
papers.abstract_zh: 低光增强在自主驱动、3D重建、遥感、监视等方面应用广泛,可以大大改进信息利用,但大多数现有方法缺乏一般化,仅限于图像恢复等具体任务。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用Gated-Mechizy Mixture of-Experts(GM-MoE),这是采用专家混合网络促进低光图像增强的第一个框架,GM-MoE包括一个动态的封闭式重量调节网络和三个次专家网络,每个网络专门从事不同的增强任务。 此外,我们还将本地和全球特质融合纳入次专家网络,以便通过捕捉多尺度的特质,提高图像质量。 实验结果显示,GM-MoE在25个比较方法方面实现了优异的概括化,分别达到PSNR5个基准和SSIM4个基准的SOTA 性能。

papers.title: GenieBlue: Integrating both Linguistic and Multimodal Capabilities for Large Language Models on Mobile Devices
papers.authors: Xudong LU · Yinghao Chen · Renshou Wu · Haohao Gao · Xi Chen · Xue Yang · Xiangyu Zhao · Aojun Zhou · Fangyuan Li · Yafei Wen · Xiaoxin Chen · shuai ren · Hongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled their deployment on mobile devices. However, challenges persist in maintaining strong language capabilities and ensuring hardware compatibility, both of which are crucial for user experience and practical deployment efficiency. In our deployment process, we observe that existing MLLMs often face performance degradation on pure language tasks, and the current NPU platforms on smartphones do not support the MoE architecture, which is commonly used to preserve pure language capabilities during multimodal training. To address these issues, we systematically analyze methods to maintain pure language capabilities during the training of MLLMs, focusing on both training data and model architecture aspects. Based on these analyses, we proposeGenieBlue, an efficient MLLM structural design that integrates both linguistic and multimodal capabilities for LLMs on mobile devices. GenieBlue freezes the original LLM parameters during MLLM training to maintain pure language capabilities. It acquires multimodal capabilities by duplicating specific transformer blocks for full fine-tuning and integrating lightweight LoRA modules. This approach preserves language capabilities while achieving comparable multimodal performance through extensive training. Deployed on smartphone NPUs, GenieBlue demonstrates efficiency and practicality for applications on mobile devices.
papers.title_zh: GenieBlue:将移动设备大语言模型的语言能力和多模式能力结合起来
papers.abstract_zh: 最近多式大语言模式(MLLMs)的进展使其得以在移动设备上部署,但在保持强大的语言能力和确保硬件兼容性方面仍然存在挑战,这对用户经验和实际部署效率都至关重要。 在我们的部署过程中,我们注意到,现有的MLLMs经常在纯语言任务上面临性能退化,而目前智能手机上的NPU平台并不支持MoE的架构,该架构通常用于在多式联运培训中维护纯语言能力。 为了解决这些问题,我们系统地分析在培训MLLMS期间保持纯语言能力的方法,重点放在培训数据和模型结构两个方面。 基于这些分析,我们提议GenieBlue,这是一个高效的MLLM结构设计,结合移动设备LLM的语文和多式联运能力,GenieBlue在MLLM培训期间冻结原LLM参数,以保持纯语言能力。 它通过在全面微调和整合轻量级LORA模块方面重复使用具体的变压器块获得多式联运能力,这种方法保留了语言能力,同时通过广泛培训实现了可比的多式联运绩效。 GenieBlue在智能手机NPUs上部署,展示了在移动设备上应用的效率和实用性。

papers.title: Forensic-MoE: Exploring Comprehensive Synthetic Image Detection Traces with Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Mingqi Fang · Ziguang Li · Lingyun Yu · Quanwei Yang · Hongtao Xie · Yongdong Zhang
papers.abstract: Recently, synthetic images have evolved incredibly realistic with the development of generative techniques.To avoid the spread of misinformation and identify synthetic content, research on synthetic image detection becomes urgent. Unfortunately, limited to the singular forensic perspective, existing methods struggle to explore sufficient traces encountered with diverse synthetic techniques. In response to this, we argue that different synthetic images encompass a variety of forensic traces, and utilizing multiple experts to explore traces from diverse perspectives will be beneficial. Accordingly, a novel detector with theMixtureof multiple forensicExperts is proposed, namedForensic-MoE. To integrate multiple experts and enhance the knowledge interaction, Forensic-MoE follows an adapter-backbone architecture. Specifically, multiple adapters trained on different synthetic images serve as the trace exploration experts, and they are uniformly integrated into a pretrained backbone model to learn the detection prior and encourage the expert interaction. By guiding multiple experts to align with each other and collaborate together, Forensic-MoE can integrate comprehensive and discriminative detection traces from multiple perspectives. Moreover, for the discrimination improvement of each expert, a multi-stage structure is proposed for efficient trace perception, and a patch decentralization strategy is applied to encourage the model's attention on every local region. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method, reflected in a 7.86% mean Acc advantage in comparison.
papers.title_zh: 法医-MoE:探索与专家混合的综合合成图像探测路径
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,合成图像随着基因化技术的发展而变得非常现实。 为了避免错误信息的传播和识别合成内容,迫切需要研究合成图像的探测。 不幸的是,仅从单一的法医角度而言,现有方法难以探索以各种合成技术遇到的足够痕迹。 对此,我们提出,不同的合成图像包含各种法医痕迹,利用多位专家从不同角度探索痕迹将是有益的。 因此,我们建议建立一个名为Forensic-MoE(Forensic-MoE)的与多个法医专家混合的新型探测器。 为了融合多位专家并加强知识互动,法医-MoE遵循一个适配器-后骨结构。 具体地说,接受过不同合成图像培训的多个适应器充当追踪探索专家,它们统一纳入一个经过预先培训的骨干模型,以便事先学习探测方法并鼓励专家互动。 通过指导多位专家相互配合和协作,法证部能够从多种角度综合综合全面、歧视性的检测痕迹。 此外,为了改善每位专家的歧视问题,建议建立一个多阶段结构,以有效跟踪认识,并采用补丁权力下放战略,鼓励该模式在每一个地方区域引起注意。 广泛的实验显示了我们方法的优越性,与Acc相比,7.86%的平均优势反映了这一点。

papers.title: FedVLA: Federated Vision-Language-Action Learning with Dual Gating Mixture-of-Experts for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Cui Miao · Tao Chang · meihan wu · Hongbin Xu · Chun Li · Ming Li · Xiaodong Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have significantly advanced robotic manipulation by enabling robots to interpret language instructions for task execution. However, training these models often relies on large-scale user-specific data, raising concerns about privacy and security, which in turn limits their broader adoption. To address this, we propose name{}, the first federated VLA learning framework, enabling distributed model training that preserves data privacy without compromising performance. Our framework integrates task-aware representation learning, adaptive expert selection, and expert-driven federated aggregation, enabling efficient and privacy-preserving training of VLA models. Specifically, we introduce an Instruction-Oriented Scene-Parsing mechanism, which decomposes and enhances object-level features based on task instructions, improving contextual understanding. To effectively learn diverse task patterns, we design a Dual Gating Mixture-of-Experts (DGMoE) mechanism, where not only input tokens but also self-aware experts adaptively decide their activation. Finally, we propose an Expert-Driven Aggregation strategy at the federated server, where model aggregation is guided by activated experts, ensuring effective cross-client knowledge transfer. Extensive simulations and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposals. Notably, DGMoE significantly improves computational efficiency compared to its vanilla counterpart, while FedVLA achieves task success rates comparable to centralized training, effectively preserving data privacy.
papers.title_zh: FFVLA: 具有机器人操纵双重专家混合的联邦视觉-语言-行动学习
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型(VLA)使机器人能够为执行任务解释语言指示,从而大大推进了机器人操纵。 然而,这些模式的培训往往依赖大规模用户专用数据,引起对隐私和安全的关切,这反过来又限制了对隐私和安全的更广泛采用。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议提出一个名称,这是第一个联邦化的VLA学习框架,使分布式示范培训成为可能,既保护数据隐私,又不损害业绩。 我们的框架将任务意识代表性学习、适应性专家选择和专家驱动的联盟汇总结合起来,从而能够对VLA模式进行有效和隐私保护培训。 具体而言,我们引入了以指示为导向的现场定位机制,根据任务指示分解和加强目标层面的特征,增进对背景的了解。 为了有效地学习不同的任务模式,我们设计了一种双重组合专家(DGMoE)机制,其中不仅有输入符号,而且有自觉的专家根据自己的需要决定其激活。 最后,我们提议在联合服务器上采用专家-驱动聚合战略,模型汇总由活跃专家指导,确保有效的跨客户知识转让,广泛的模拟和现实世界机器人实验表明我们建议的有效性。 值得注意的是,与香草对应方相比,DGMoE显著提高了计算效率,而FedVLA取得了与集中培训相当的任务成功率,从而有效地保护了数据隐私。

papers.title: Fast Training of Diffusion Transformer with Extreme Masking for 3D Point Clouds Generation
papers.authors: Shentong Mo · Enze Xie · Yue Wu · Junsong Chen · Matthias Niessner · ZHENGUO LI
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers have recently shown remarkable effectiveness in generating high-quality 3D point clouds. However, training voxel-based diffusion models for high-resolution 3D voxels remains prohibitively expensive due to the cubic complexity of attention operators, which arises from the additional dimension of voxels. Motivated by the inherent redundancy of 3D compared to 2D, we propose FastDiT-3D, a novel masked diffusion transformer tailored for efficient 3D point cloud generation, which greatly reduces training costs. Specifically, we draw inspiration from masked autoencoders to dynamically operate the denoising process on masked voxelized point clouds. We also propose a novel voxel-aware masking strategy to adaptively aggregate background/foreground information from voxelized point clouds. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with an extreme masking ratio of nearly 99%. Moreover, to improve multi-category 3D generation, we introduce Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) in 3D diffusion model. Each category can learn a distinct diffusion path with different experts, relieving gradient conflict. Experimental results on the ShapeNet dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art high-fidelity and diverse 3D point cloud generation performance. Our FastDiT-3D improves 1-Nearest Neighbor Accuracy and Coverage metrics when generating 128-resolution voxel point clouds, using only 6.5% of the original training cost.
papers.title_zh: 为三维点云生成提供极掩蔽的传播Transformer快速培训
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,传播Transformer在产生高质量的3D点云方面显示出显著的效益。 然而,高分辨率3Doxel的基于培训的Voxel扩散模型仍然过于昂贵,因为注意操作员的立方复杂,这来自Voxel的额外层面。 基于3D与2D的内在冗余,我们提议Fast DiT-3D,这是为高效的3D点云生成而专门设计的新式蒙面扩散变压器,大大降低了培训费用。 具体地说,我们从蒙面自动编码器中汲取灵感,以动态操作蒙面氧化点云的除尘过程。 我们还提出了一个新颖的反毒意识掩码策略,以适应性地汇总来自氧化点云的背景/地面信息。 我们的方法以近99%的极端掩蔽率实现了最先进的表现。 此外,为了改善多类3D一代,我们在3D扩散模型中引入了3D专家混合(MOE ) 。 每个类别都可以与不同的专家学习不同的传播路径,缓解梯度冲突。 形状网数据集的实验结果显示,我们的方法达到了最先进的高忠诚度和不同的3D点云生成性能。 我们的快速DiT-3D在产生128分辨率的福克斯点云时改进了邻居最接近的准确度和覆盖范围度量,只使用了最初培训费用的6.5%。

papers.title: DICE: Staleness-Centric Optimizations for Parallel Diffusion MoE Inference
papers.authors: Jiajun Luo · Lizhuo Luo · Jianru Xu · Jiajun Song · Rongwei Lu · Chen Tang · Zhi Wang
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts-based (MoE-based) diffusion models demonstrate remarkable scalability in high-fidelity image generation, yet their reliance on expert parallelism introduces critical communication bottlenecks. State-of-the-art methods alleviate such overhead in parallel diffusion inference through computation-communication overlapping, termed displaced parallelism. However, we identify that these techniques inherently induce severestaleness-the utilization of outdated activations from previous timesteps that significantly degrades quality, especially in expert-parallel scenarios. We tackle this fundamental tension and propose DICE, a staleness-centric optimization framework with a three-fold approach: (1) Interweaved Parallelism introduces staggered pipelines, effectively halving step-level staleness for free; (2) Selective Synchronization operates at layer-level and protects critical layers vulnerable from staled activations; and (3) Conditional Communication, a token-level, training-free method that dynamically adjusts communication frequency based on token importance. Together, these strategies effectively reduce staleness, achieving 1.26x speedup with minimal quality degradation. Empirical results establish DICE as an effective and scalable solution. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DICE-FF04
papers.title_zh: DICIC: 平行扩散部的平行扩散推论的成份-中值优化
papers.abstract_zh: 以专家为基础的混合(基于MOE的)传播模型表明,在高忠诚形象生成方面,可显著扩展,然而,这些模型依赖专家的平行性带来了关键的通信瓶颈。 最先进的方法通过计算和通信的重叠,即所谓的流离失所的平行法,通过平行的传播推论,减轻这种间接费用。 然而,我们发现,这些技术本身就会导致严重迟缓,即利用以往时间步骤中过时的引爆装置,大大降低质量,特别是在专家平行情景中。 我们处理这一根本性的紧张关系,并提议DICE, 即采用三重方法的老化、以老化为中心的优化框架:(1) 互交错的平行主义引入了交错的管道,有效地将逐步递减的免费输油管减半;(2) 选择性同步化在层层一级运作,保护容易受固定激活影响的关键层;(3) 有条件通信,这是一种象征性的、无培训的方法,根据象征性重要性动态调整通信频率。 这些战略合在一起,有效地减少了腐烂程度,实现了1.26x的加速,且质量降低到最低程度。经验成果将DICE确定为有效且可扩展的解决办法。我们的代码可在https://anonomous4open.science/r/DICE-FF04上公开查阅。

papers.title: Controllable-LPMoE: Adapting to Challenging Object Segmentation via Dynamic Local Priors from Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Yanguang Sun · Jiawei Lian · jian Yang · lei luo
papers.abstract: Large-scale pre-trained models provide powerful feature representations for downstream object segmentation tasks. However, when adapted to specific tasks through the full-parameter fine-tuning, the enormous parameters being updated often results in significant computational overhead, creating a bottleneck in training efficiency. Although existing methods attempt to fine-tune frozen models by directly embedding trainable prompts, these prompts lack inherent semantic priors, limiting the adaptability of large-scale models. In this paper, we propose a novel dynamic priors-based fine-tuning paradigm with fewer trainable parameters, dubbed Controllable-LPMoE, which adaptively modulates frozen foundation models by dynamically controlling local priors to enhance fine-grained perception for specific segmentation tasks. More specifically, we construct a lightweight dynamic mixed local priors extractor that captures diverse local priors from input images through heterogeneous convolutions while employing a gating network to dynamically output expert priors required for the subsequent fine-tuning. Furthermore, we design a bi-directional interaction adapter that employs cosine-aligned deformable attention and channel-oriented adaptive scale enhancement to interact and restructure between frozen and trainable features, achieving efficient fine-tuning. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of our Controllable-LPMoE approach, demonstrating excellent segmentation performance compared to 31 state-of-the-art methods and adaptability to multiple binary object segmentation tasks.
papers.title_zh: LPMoE:通过Mixture of-Experts的动态本地前科,适应挑战性天体分离
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模的预先培训模式为下游物体分离任务提供了强有力的特征说明。 然而,如果通过整数微调适应具体任务,经过更新的巨大参数往往会导致大量的计算间接费用,从而在培训效率方面造成瓶颈。 虽然现有方法试图通过直接嵌入可训练的提示器来微调冻结的模型,但这些提示器缺乏固有的语义前科,限制了大规模模型的适应性。 在本文中,我们提出一种新的动态前期微调模式,其可训练参数较少,称为“控制可控-LPMoE”,该模式通过动态控制当地前期,对冻结的基础模型进行适应性调整,以加强对具体分割任务的细微感知。 更具体地说,我们建立一个轻量级动态混合的本地前身提取器,通过各种变异的变异,从输入图像中捕捉不同地方的前身,同时利用一个引线网络,向动态产出专家提供随后微调所需的前科。 此外,我们设计了双向互动适配器,利用可调整的可变注意和以频道为导向的适应规模增强,在冻结和可训练的功能之间进行互动和调整,实现高效的微调。 广泛的实验验证了我们的可控LPMoE方法的优越性,表明与31种最先进的方法和适应多项二元物体分离任务的适应性相比,我们具有极佳的分离性能。

papers.title: COME: Dual Structure-Semantic Learning with Collaborative MoE for Universal Lesion Detection Across Heterogeneous Ultrasound Datasets
papers.authors: Lingyu Chen · Yawen Zeng · Yue Wang · Peng Wan · Guo-chen Ning · Hongen Liao · Daoqiang Zhang · Fang Chen
papers.abstract: Conventional single-dataset training often fails with new data distributions, especially in ultrasound (US) image analysis due to limited data, acoustic shadows, and speckle noise.Therefore, constructing a universal framework for multi-heterogeneous US datasets is imperative. However, a key challenge arises: how to effectively mitigate inter-dataset interference while preserving dataset-specific discriminative features for robust downstream task? Previous approaches utilize either a single source-specific decoder or a domain adaptation strategy, but these methods experienced a decline in performance when applied to other domains. Considering this, we propose a Universal Collaborative Mixture of Heterogeneous Source-Specific Experts (COME). Specifically, COME establishes dual structure-semantic shared experts that create a universal representation space and then collaborate with source-specific experts to extract discriminative features through providing complementary features. This design enables robust generalization by leveraging cross-datasets experience distributions and providing universal US priors for small-batch or unseen data scenarios. Extensive experiments under three evaluation modes (single-dataset, intra-organ, and inter-organ integration datasets) demonstrate COME's superiority, achieving significant mean AP improvements over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 知识库:两结构-语言学习,与合作部合作进行跨异源超声波数据集的环流探测双结构-语言学习
papers.abstract_zh: 常规单一数据集培训往往因新数据发布而失败,特别是在超声波图像分析方面,因为数据有限、声影和闪烁的噪音。 因此,为多异性美国数据集构建一个普遍框架势在必行。 然而,出现了一个关键的挑战:如何有效减少数据交换干扰,同时为强有力的下游任务保留数据集特有的歧视性特征? 以前的办法使用单一的源特定解码器或领域适应战略,但这些方法在应用到其他领域时的绩效下降。 有鉴于此,我们建议采用不同源特定专家的通用合作混合方法。 具体地说,“知识、知识、知识、知识、创新和知识”组织设立了双重结构-区域共有专家,以创造普遍代表性空间,然后与特定来源的专家合作,通过提供互补特征来提取歧视性特征。 这一设计通过利用交叉数据集的经验分布和为小型或无形数据情景提供通用的美国前科,使得能够进行有力的概括化。 在三种评价模式(单一数据集、机构内和机构间一体化数据集)下进行的广泛试验表明,知识组织具有优越性,在先进方法上取得了显著的《行动方案》进步。

papers.title: Boost Your NeRF: A Model-Agnostic Mixture of Experts Framework for High Quality and Efficient Rendering
papers.authors: Francesco Di Sario · Riccardo Renzulli · Marco Grangetto · Enzo Tartaglione
papers.abstract: Since the introduction of NeRFs, considerable attention has been focused on improving their training and inference times, leading to the development of Fast-NeRFs models. Despite demonstrating impressive rendering speed and quality, the rapid convergence of such models poses challenges for further enhancing reconstruction quality. Common strategies to improve rendering quality involves augmenting model parameters or increasing the number of sampled points. However, these computationally intensive approaches encounter limitations in achieving significant quality enhancements. This study introduces a model-agnostic framework inspired by Sparsely-Gated Mixture of Experts to enhance rendering quality without escalating computational complexity. Our approach enables specialization in rendering different scene components by employing a mixture of experts with varying resolutions. We present a novel gate formulation designed to maximize expert capabilities and propose a resolution-based routing technique to effectively induce sparsity and decompose scenes. Our work significantly enhances reconstruction quality while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.title_zh: 推进您的 NERF: 高质量和高效竞标专家框架模型-不可知混合框架
papers.abstract_zh: 自引入NeRFs以来,相当重视改进其培训和推论时间,从而发展了快速NERFs模式。 尽管这些模型在速度和质量上表现出令人印象深刻,但迅速趋同给进一步提高重建质量带来了挑战,提高质量的共同战略包括扩大模型参数或增加抽样点的数目。 然而,这些计算密集的方法在实现大幅度提高质量方面受到限制,本研究报告引入了一个模型----不可知性框架,该框架受专家粗略组合的启发,目的是提高质量,而不会增加计算复杂性。 我们的方法使得能够通过专家混合,通过不同决议,在提供不同场景组成部分方面实现专业化。 我们提出了一个新颖的大门配方,旨在最大限度地发挥专家能力,并提出基于决议的路线技术,以有效诱发混乱和分解场景。 我们的工作大大提高了重建质量,同时保持了竞争业绩。

papers.title: WISE: Whitebox Image Stylization by Example-Based Learning
papers.authors: Winfried Lötzsch, Max Reimann, Martin Büssemeyer, Amir Semmo, Jürgen Döllner, Matthias Trapp
papers.abstract: "Image-based artistic rendering can synthesize a variety of expressive styles using algorithmic image filtering. In contrast to deep learning-based methods, these heuristics-based filtering techniques can operate on high-resolution images, are interpretable, and can be parameterized according to various design aspects. However, adapting or extending these techniques to produce new styles is often a tedious and error-prone task that requires expert knowledge. We propose a new paradigm to alleviate this problem: implementing algorithmic image filtering techniques as differentiable operations that can learn parametrizations aligned to certain reference styles. To this end, we present WISE, an example-based image-processing system that can handle a multitude of stylization techniques, such as watercolor, oil, or cartoon stylization, within a common framework. By training parameter prediction networks for global and local filter parameterizations, we can simultaneously adapt effects to reference styles and image content, e.g., to enhance facial features. Our method can be optimized in a style-transfer framework or learned in a generative-adversarial setting for image-to-image translation. We demonstrate that jointly training an xDoG filter and a CNN for postprocessing can achieve comparable results to a state-of-the-art GAN-based method."
papers.title_zh: WISE: 白箱图像通过实例学习的立体化
papers.abstract_zh: 利用算法图像过滤, 以图像为基础的艺术创作可以综合各种表达风格。 与深层次的以学习为基础的方法不同,这些以超自然学为基础的过滤技术可以对高分辨率图像进行操作,可以解释,可以根据不同的设计方面进行参数化。 然而,调整或推广这些技术以产生新的风格,往往是一项乏味和容易出错的任务,需要专家知识。 我们建议一种新的模式来缓解这一问题:采用算法图像过滤技术,作为不同操作,可以学习与某些参考风格相一致的准美化。 为此,我们提出WISE,这是一个以实例为基础的图像处理系统,可在一个共同框架内处理多种石化技术,如水彩色、石油或卡通石化。 通过培训全球和地方过滤参数参数化的参数预测网络,我们可以同时调整对参考样式和图像内容的影响,例如加强面部特征。 我们的方法可以在风格传输框架内优化,或者在图像到图像翻译的基因对抗环境中学习。 我们证明联合培训一个 xDoG 过滤器和一个用于后处理的CNN能够取得与最先进的GAN 方法类似的效果。 ”

papers.title: WeaveSeg: Iterative Contrast-weaving and Spectral Feature-refining for Nuclei Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiajia Li · Huisi Wu · Jing Qin
papers.abstract: histopathology images is a fundamental task in computational pathology. It is also a very challenging task due to complex nuclei morphologies, ambiguous boundaries, and staining variations. Existing methods often struggle to precisely delineate overlapping nuclei and handle class imbalance. We introduce WeaveSeg, a novel deep learning model for nuclei instance segmentation that significantly improves segmentation performance via synergistic integration of adaptive spectral feature refinement and iterative contrast-weaving. WeaveSeg features an adaptive spectral detail refinement (SAR) module for multi-scale feature enhancement via adaptive frequency component fusion, and an iterative contrast-weaving (ICW) module that progressively refines features through integrating contrastive attention, decoupled semantic context, and adaptive gating. Furthermore, we introduce a specialized uncertainty loss to explicitly model ambiguous regions, and a novel local contrast-based self-adaptive adjustment mechanism to accommodate dynamic feature distributions. Extensive experiments on MoNuSeg and CoNSeP demonstrate WeaveSeg's SOTA performance over existing models. Code will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: WeaveSeg: 核心区段的迭代对比交织和光谱地貌调整
papers.abstract_zh: 生理病理学图像是计算病理学的一项根本任务。 由于复杂的核形态、模糊的界限和污点的变异,它也是一项非常具有挑战性的任务。 现有的方法往往难以准确划定重叠的核并处理阶级不平衡。 我们引入了WeaveSeg,这是一个新颖的关于核体分解的深层次学习模式,通过将适应性光谱特征的完善和迭接的对比度编织协同结合,显著改善分解性能。 WeaveSeg的特点是通过适应性频率元件聚合增强多尺度特征的适应性光谱细节改进模块,以及迭接式对比编织模块,该模块通过结合对比关注、分解的语义背景和适应性带宽,逐步完善特征。 此外,我们引入了一种专门的不确定性损失,以明确模拟模棱两可的地区,并引入了一种新的基于对比的本地自我适应调整机制,以适应动态特征分布。 关于MoNuSeg和CONSeP的广泛实验展示了WeaveSeg相对于现有模式的SOTA绩效。 守则将公布于众。

papers.title: Wave-MambaAD: Wavelet-driven State Space Model for Multi-class Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Qiao Zhang · Mingwen Shao · Xinyuan Chen · Xiang Lv · Kai Xu
papers.abstract: The Mamba model excels in anomaly detection through efficient long-range dependency modeling and linear complexity. However, Mamba-based anomaly detectors still face two critical challenges: (1) insufficient modeling of diverse local features leading to inaccurate detection of subtle anomalies; (2) spatial-wise scanning mechanism disrupting the spatial continuity of large-scale anomalies, resulting in incomplete localization. To address these challenges, we propose Wave-MambaAD, a wavelet-driven state space model for unified subtle and large-scale anomaly detection. Firstly, to capture subtle anomalies, we design a high-frequency state space model that employs horizontal, vertical, and diagonal scanning mechanisms for processing directionally aligned high-frequency components, enabling precise anomaly detection through multidimensional feature extraction. Secondly, for comprehensive localization of large-scale anomalies, we propose a low-frequency state space model implementing channel-adaptive dynamic scanning mechanisms to maintain structural coherence in global contexts, which facilitates large-scale anomaly detection via adaptive feature integration. Finally, we develop a dynamic spatial enhancement block to improve anomalous feature representation by enhancing feature diversity through coordinated inter-channel communication and adaptive gating mechanisms. Comprehensive experiments on benchmark anomaly detection datasets show that Wave-MambaAD achieves competitive performance at lower parameters and computational costs.
papers.title_zh: Wave-MambaAD:Wavelet驱动的多级不受监督异常探测国家空间模型
papers.abstract_zh: Mamba模型通过高效的长距离受扶养人模型和线性复杂性,在异常点探测方面优异。 然而,设在曼巴的异常点探测器仍面临两个重大挑战:(1) 不同地方特征的建模不足,导致对微妙异常点的探测不准确;(2) 空间扫描机制扰乱大规模异常点的空间连续性,造成局部化不完全。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用波浪驱动型国家空间模型,即波浪驱动型国家空间模型,以统一微妙和大规模地探测异常现象。 首先,为了捕捉微妙的异常现象,我们设计了一个高频状态空间模型,采用水平、垂直和对角扫描机制处理方向对齐的高频组件,通过多维特征提取能够准确探测出异常现象。 第二,为了将大规模异常现象全面本地化,我们提议建立一个低频国家空间模型,实施频道适应性动态扫描机制,以保持全球背景下的结构性一致性,通过适应性特征整合,促进大规模异常现象探测。 最后,我们开发了一个动态空间增强块,通过协调的渠道间通信和适应性加固机制,通过增强特征多样性,改善异常特征的代表性。 关于基准异常现象探测数据集的全面实验表明,Wave-MambaAD以较低的参数和计算成本实现了竞争性业绩。

papers.title: VRBench: A Benchmark for Multi-Step Reasoning in Long Narrative Videos
papers.authors: Jiashuo Yu · Yue Wu · Meng Chu · Zhifei Ren · Zizheng Huang · Pei Chu · Ruijie Zhang · Yinan He · Qirui Li · Songze Li · Zhenxiang Li · Zhongying Tu · Conghui He · Yu Qiao · Yali Wang · Yi Wang · Limin Wang
papers.abstract: We present VRBench, the first long narrative video benchmark crafted for evaluating large models' multi-step reasoning capabilities, addressing limitations in existing evaluations that overlook temporal reasoning and procedural validity. It comprises 1,010 long videos (average duration 1.6 hours) along with 9,468 human-labeled multi-step question-answering pairs and 30,292 reasoning steps. These videos are curated via a multi-stage filtering process including expert inter-rater reviewing to prioritize plot coherence. We develop a human-AI collaborative framework that generates coherent reasoning processes, each requiring multiple temporally grounded steps, spanning seven types (e.g., event attribution, implicit inference). VRBench designs a multi-phase evaluation pipeline that both evaluates models from the outcome and process level. Apart from the MCQs for the final results, we propose two metrics for progress-level evaluation: (1) LLM-guided scoring for logical coherence and factual accuracy, and (2) Stepwise multiple choice question decomposition to validate causal progression. Through extensive evaluations of 12 LLMs and 16 VLMs on VRBench, we undertake a thorough analysis and provide valuable insights that advance the field of multi-step reasoning. VRBench will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: VRBENCH:长语视频多层次理由基准
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍VRBench,这是为评价大型模型的多步推理能力而设计的第一个长篇叙述性视频基准,以解决现有评价中忽视时间推理和程序有效性的局限性。 它包括1 010个长长的视频(平均持续1.6小时)以及9 468个人类标签的多步问答配对和30 292个推理步骤,这些视频通过一个多阶段过滤程序,包括专家间审查,以优先考虑地块的一致性。 我们制定了一个人类-AI协作框架,产生连贯一致的推理过程,每个过程都要求采取多重基于时间的步骤,涉及七种类型(例如事件归属、隐含的推论)。 VRBENCH设计了一个多阶段评价管道,既从结果层面评价模型,又从过程层面评价模型。 除了最终结果的MCQ标准外,我们还提出了两个进度评估标准:(1) 以LLM为指南的评分,以便实现逻辑一致性和事实准确性;(2) 分步选择的多重选择问题分解,以验证因果进展。 通过对关于VRBench的12个LMs和16个VLMs进行广泛评价,我们进行了透彻的分析,提供了宝贵的见解,推进了多步骤推理领域。

papers.title: VQA-Diff: Exploiting VQA and Diffusion for Zero-Shot Image-to-3D Vehicle Asset Generation in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yibo Liu · Zheyuan Yang · Guile Wu · Yuan REN · Kejian Lin · Liu Bingbing · Yang Liu · JINJUN SHAN
papers.abstract: Generating 3D vehicle assets from in-the-wild observations is crucial to autonomous driving. Existing image-to-3D methods cannot well address this problem because they learn generation merely from image RGB information without a deeper understanding of in-the-wild vehicles (such as car models, manufacturers, etc). This leads to their poor zero-shot prediction capability to handle real-world observations with occlusion or tricky viewing angles. To solve this problem, in this work, we propose VQA-Diff, a novel framework that leverages in-the-wild vehicle images to create photorealistic 3D vehicle assets for autonomous driving. VQA-Diff exploits the real-world knowledge inherited from the Large Language Model in the Visual Question Answering (VQA) model for robust zero-shot prediction and the rich image prior knowledge in Diffusion Models for structure and appearance generation. In particular, we utilize a multi-expert Diffusion Models strategy to generate the structure information and employ a subject-driven structure-controlled generation mechanism to model appearance information. As a result, without the necessity to learn from a large-scale image-to-3D vehicle dataset collected from the real world, VQA-Diff still has a robust zero-shot image-to-novel-view generation ability. We conduct experiments on various datasets, including Pascal 3D+, Waymo, and Objaverse, to demonstrate that VQA-Diff outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
papers.title_zh: VQA-Diff:利用VQA和为自动驱动的零热图像到3D车辆资产生成进行传播
papers.abstract_zh: 从现场观察中生成3D车辆资产对于自主驾驶至关重要。 现有的图像到3D方法无法很好地解决这一问题,因为它们仅仅从图像RGB信息中学习生成,而没有更深入地了解汽车模型、制造商等。 这导致他们处理现实世界观测的零射预测能力差,无法以隐蔽或微妙的角度进行真实世界观测。 为了解决这个问题,我们在这项工作中提出VQA-Diff,这是一个新颖的框架,它能利用汽车图像来创造具有摄影现实性的三维汽车资产,用于自动驾驶。 VQA-Diff利用视觉问答模型中大语言模型遗留下来的实世知识,以进行稳健的零射预测,并利用传播模型中先前在结构和外观生成方面的丰富形象知识。 特别是,我们利用多专家传播模式战略生成结构信息,并采用主题驱动、结构控制的生成机制模拟外观信息。 因此,VQA-Diff不必从从从现实世界收集的大规模图像到3D车辆数据集中学习,仍然拥有强大的零射图像到新奇图像生成能力。 我们对各种数据集进行实验,包括Pascal 3D+、Waymo和Objaverse,以证明VQA-Diff在质量和数量上都超过了现有的最新方法。

papers.title: VideoOrion: Tokenizing Object Dynamics in Videos
papers.authors: Yicheng Feng · Yijiang Li · Wanpeng Zhang · Sipeng Zheng · Hao Luo · Zihao Yue · Zongqing Lu
papers.abstract: We present VideoOrion, a Video Large Language Model (Video-LLM) that explicitly captures the key semantic information in videos—the spatial-temporal dynamics of objects throughout the videos. VideoOrion employs expert vision models to extract object dynamics through a detect-segment-track pipeline, encoding them into a set of object tokens by aggregating spatial-temporal object features. Our method addresses the persistent challenge in Video-LLMs of efficiently compressing high-dimensional video data into semantic tokens that are comprehensible to LLMs. Compared to prior methods which resort to downsampling the original video or aggregating visual tokens using resamplers, leading to information loss and entangled semantics, VideoOrion not only offers a more natural and efficient way to derive compact, disentangled semantic representations but also enables explicit object modeling of video content with minimal computational cost. Moreover, the introduced object tokens naturally allow VideoOrion to accomplish video-based referring tasks. Experimental results show that VideoOrion can learn to make good use of the object tokens, and achieves competitive results on both general video question answering and video-based referring benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: VideoOrition: 将对象动态化为视频
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出视频大语言视频模型(Video-LLM), 明确记录视频中关键语义信息, 视频视轨利用专家视觉模型,通过探测分解轨道管道提取物体动态,通过汇总时空物体特征将其编码成一组物体标志。 我们的方法是应对视频-LLMS中长期存在的挑战,即高效率地将高维视频数据压缩为可被LLMS所理解的语义符号。 与以前采用的方法相比,以前采用的方法是利用复苏器对原始视频进行取样或汇总视觉标识,导致信息丢失和相互缠绕的语义学,而视频Orion不仅提供了一种更自然、更有效的方法,可以产生紧凑、分解的语义表达方式,而且能够以最低的计算成本对视频内容进行明确对象建模。 此外,引入的天体标牌自然可以让视频Orion完成视频参考任务。 实验结果表明,视频Orion可以学习如何很好地利用天体标牌,并在一般视频答题和视频参考基准上实现竞争性结果。

papers.title: VideoAds: Where Opensource Foundation Models Beat GPT-4o & Gemini-1.5 Pro
papers.authors: Zheyuan Zhang · Wanying Dou · Linkai Peng · Hongyi Pan · Ulas Bagci · Boqing Gong
papers.abstract: Advertisement videos serve as a rich and valuable source of purpose-driven information, encompassing high-quality visual, textual, and contextual cues designed to engage viewers. They are often more complex than general videos of similar duration due to their structured narratives and rapid scene transitions, posing significant challenges to multi-modal large language models (MLLMs). In this work, we introduce VideoAds, the first dataset tailored for benchmarking the performance of MLLMs on advertisement videos. VideoAds comprises well-curated advertisement videos with complex temporal structures, accompanied by manually annotated diverse questions across three core tasks: visual finding, video summary, and visual reasoning. We propose a quantitative measure to compare VideoAds against existing benchmarks in terms of video complexity. Through extensive experiments, we find that Qwen2.5-VL-72B, an opensource MLLM, achieves 73.35 % accuracy on VideoAds, outperforming GPT-4o (66.82 %) and Gemini-1.5 Pro (69.66 %); the two proprietary models especially fall behind the opensource model in video summarization and reasoning, but perform the best in visual finding. Notably, human experts easily achieve a remarkable accuracy of 94.27 %. These results underscore the necessity of advancing MLLMs' temporal modeling capabilities and highlight VideoAds as a potentially pivotal benchmark for future research in video-language understanding. The dataset and evaluation code will be publicly available at url{https://videoadsbenchmark.netlify.app}.
papers.title_zh: 视频片段:在开放源码基金会模型击败GPT-4o & Gemini-1.5 Pro
papers.abstract_zh: 广告视频是目的驱动信息的一个丰富和宝贵的来源,包括高质量的视觉、文字和背景提示,旨在吸引观众。 由于其结构化叙述和迅速的场景过渡,它们往往比具有类似持续时间的一般录像更为复杂,对多模式大型语言模式(MLLM)构成重大挑战。 在这项工作中,我们介绍视频Ads,这是第一个为将MLLMS在广告视频上的性能设定基准而专门设计的数据集。 视频片段包括有复杂时间结构的精密广告视频,同时还有视觉发现、视频摘要和视觉推理这三项核心任务上人工加注的不同问题。 我们建议采取定量措施,将录像片段与视频复杂程度方面的现有基准进行比较。 通过广泛的实验,我们发现,Quen2.5-VL-72B(开放源码MLLM)在视频Ads上实现了73.35%的精度,优于GPT-4o(66.82%)和Gemini-1.5 Pro(69.66%);这两种专利模型在视频总结和推理方面特别落后于开源模型,但在视觉发现方面表现最佳。 值得注意的是,人类专家很容易达到94.27%的惊人精确度。 这些结果突出表明,必须提高MLLMS的时间建模能力,并突出视频Ads,作为今后在视频理解方面研究的潜在关键基准。 数据集和评价代码将在url{https://vieviaadsbenchmark.netlify.app}上公布。

papers.title: Unsupervised Shape and Pose Disentanglement for 3D Meshes
papers.authors: Keyang Zhou, Bharat Lal Bhatnagar, Gerard Pons-Moll
papers.abstract: Parametric models of humans, faces, hands and animals have been widely used for a range of tasks such as image-based reconstruction, shape correspondence estimation, and animation. Their key strength is the ability to factor surface variations into shape and pose dependent components. Learning such models requires lots of expert knowledge and hand-defined object-specific constraints, making the learning approach unscalable to novel objects. In this paper, we present a simple yet effective approach to learn disentangled shape and pose representations in an unsupervised setting. We use a combination of self-consistency and cross-consistency constraints to learn pose and shape space from registered meshes. We additionally incorporate as-rigid-as-possible deformation(ARAP) into the training loop to avoid degenerate solutions. We demonstrate the usefulness of learned representations through a number of tasks including pose transfer and shape retrieval. The experiments on datasets of 3D humans, faces, hands and animals demonstrate the generality of our approach. Code is made available at https://virtualhumans.mpi-inf.mpg.de/unsup_shape_pose/."
papers.title_zh: 3D Meshes 不受监督的形状和波贝分离
papers.abstract_zh: 人类、面部、手和动物的参数模型被广泛用于一系列任务,如基于图像的重建、通信估计和动画。 它们的关键力量是能够将表面变化因素转化为形状并构成依附成分。 学习这种模式需要大量专家知识和手定义的特定对象制约,使得学习方法无法适用于新对象。 在本文中,我们提出了一个简单而有效的方法来学习分解的形状和在无人监督的环境中进行表达。 我们用自相矛盾和自相矛盾的制约相结合的方法来从注册的甲草胺中学习形状和塑造空间。 我们还将可能发生的硬化变形(ARAP)纳入培训循环,以避免退化的解决方案。 我们通过包括外形转移和形状检索在内的若干任务,展示了有学识的表述的有用性,关于3D人、面部、手部和动物数据集的实验显示了我们方法的普遍性。 守则可在https://viltualhumans.mpi-inf.mpg.de/unsup_shape_pose/上查阅。”

papers.title: UniPortrait: A Unified Framework for Identity-Preserving Single- and Multi-Human Image Personalization
papers.authors: Junjie He · Yifeng Geng · Liefeng Bo
papers.abstract: This paper presents UniPortrait, an innovative human image personalization framework that unifies single- and multi-ID customization with high face fidelity, extensive facial editability, free-form input description, and diverse layout generation. UniPortrait consists of only two plug-and-play modules: an ID embedding module and an ID routing module. The ID embedding module extracts versatile editable facial features with a decoupling strategy for each ID and embeds them into the context space of diffusion models. The ID routing module then combines and distributes these embeddings adaptively to their respective regions within the synthesized image, achieving the customization of single and multiple IDs. With a carefully designed two-stage training scheme, UniPortrait achieves superior performance in both single- and multi-ID customization. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the advantages of our method over existing approaches as well as its good scalability, e.g., the universal compatibility with existing generative control tools.
papers.title_zh: 单一光线:身份保留、单一和多人形象个性化统一框架
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍一个创新的人类形象个性化框架UniPrait,这个框架将单一和多ID定制化,面部高度忠诚、面部可编辑性广泛、自由形式输入描述和多种布局生成统一起来。 UniPrait 由两个插件和游戏模块组成: 一个 ID 嵌入模块和一个 ID 路由模块。 ID 嵌入模块提取多种可编辑的面部功能, 配有每个ID 的解耦策略, 并将其嵌入扩展模型的背景空间 。 ID路由模块随后将这些嵌入的嵌入模块组合起来,并在综合图像中根据各自区域的具体情况予以分发,实现单个和多个标识的定制化。 通过精心设计的两阶段培训计划,UniPrait在单一和多ID定制方面都取得了优异的成绩。 定量和定性实验表明,我们的方法优于现有方法,而且具有良好的可伸缩性,例如,与现有基因控制工具的普遍兼容性。

papers.title: Unifying Visual Perception by Dispersible Points Learning
papers.authors: Jianming Liang, Guanglu Song, Biao Leng, Yu Liu
papers.abstract: "We present a conceptually simple, flexible, and universal visual perception head for variant visual tasks, e.g., classification, object detection, instance segmentation and pose estimation, and different frameworks, such as one-stage or two-stage pipelines. Our approach effectively identifies an object in an image while simultaneously generating a high-quality bounding box or contour-based segmentation mask or set of keypoints. The method, called UniHead, views different visual perception tasks as the dispersible points learning via the transformer encoder architecture. Given a fixed spatial coordinate, UniHead adaptively scatters it to different spatial points and reasons about their relations by transformer encoder. It directly outputs the final set of predictions in the form of multiple points, allowing us to perform different visual tasks in different frameworks with the same head design. We show extensive evaluations on ImageNet classification and all three tracks of the COCO suite of challenges, including object detection, instance segmentation and pose estimation. Without bells and whistles, UniHead can unify these visual tasks via a single visual head design and achieve comparable performance compared to expert models developed for each task. We hope our simple and universal UniHead will serve as a solid baseline and help promote universal visual perception research. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Sense-X/UniHead."
papers.title_zh: 通过分散点学习统一视觉感知
papers.abstract_zh: “我们为不同的视觉任务,例如分类、物体探测、例分解和估计,以及不同框架,例如一阶段或两阶段管道,提出了一个概念简单、灵活和通用的视觉感知头。 我们的方法在图像中有效地识别对象,同时生成一个高质量的捆绑框或基于等深线的分隔面罩或一组关键点。 这种方法叫做“UniHead ” , 将不同的视觉感知任务视为通过变压器编码器结构学习的分散点。 在固定的空间坐标下,Unicle Head通过变压器编码器将它分散到不同的空间点和关于它们之间关系的理由。 它直接以多点的形式提出最后一套预测,使我们能够在不同的框架内执行不同的视觉任务,设计相同的头。 我们展示了对图像网络分类的广泛评价,以及COCO系列挑战的所有三个轨道,包括物体探测、例分解和估计。 没有钟声和哨声,大学校长可以通过单一的视觉头部设计来统一这些视觉任务,并实现与为每项任务开发的专家模型相比的类似性能。 我们希望我们简单而通用的大学校长能够成为坚实的基线,帮助促进全视感知研究。 守则和模型可在https://github.com/Sense-X/Unihead上查阅。”

papers.title: Unified Local-Cloud Decision-Making via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Kathakoli Sengupta · Zhongkai Shangguan · Sandesh Bharadwaj · Sanjay Arora · Eshed Ohn-Bar · Renato Mancuso
papers.abstract: Embodied vision-based real-world systems, such as mobile robots, require careful balancing between energy consumption, compute latency, and safety constraints to optimize operation across dynamic tasks and contexts. As local computation tends to be restricted, offloading the computation, i.e., to a remote server, can save local resources while providing access to high-quality predictions from powerful and large models. Yet, the resulting communication and latency overhead has led to limited usability of cloud models in dynamic, safety-critical, real-time settings. Towards effectively addressing this trade-off, in this work, we introduce UniLCD, a novel hybrid inference framework for enabling flexible local-cloud collaboration. By efficiently optimizing a flexible routing module via reinforcement learning and a suitable multi-task objective, UniLCD is specifically designed to support multiple constraints of safety-critical end-to-end mobile systems. We validate the proposed approach using a challenging crowded navigation task requiring frequent and timely switching between local and cloud operations. UniLCD demonstrates both improved overall performance and efficiency, by over 17% compared to state-of-the-art baselines based on various split computing strategies.
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习作出统一的地方-城市决策
papers.abstract_zh: 移动机器人等基于视觉的嵌入式现实世界系统需要谨慎地平衡能源消耗、计算延时性和安全限制,以便在动态任务和环境下优化运作。 由于本地计算往往受到限制,卸载计算,即向远程服务器卸载计算,可以节省当地资源,同时提供获得强大和大型模型高质量预测的机会。 然而,由此产生的通信和潜伏间接费用导致云模型在动态、安全、关键、实时环境下的可用性受到限制。 为了有效解决这一权衡问题,我们在这项工作中引入了“UniLCD ” ( UniLCD ) , 这是一种新颖的混合推论框架,有利于灵活的当地-集体协作。 通过通过强化学习和适当的多任务目标,高效率地优化一个灵活的路线模块,UniLCD是专门设计用来支持安全关键端对端移动系统的多重限制。 我们用艰巨的拥挤导航任务来验证拟议方法,这需要当地和云层操作之间频繁和及时的转换。 UNILCD显示总体性能和效率都有所改善,比基于各种分裂计算战略的最新基线提高了17%以上。

papers.title: Uncover Treasures in DCT: Advancing JPEG Quality Enhancement by Exploiting Latent Correlations
papers.authors: jing Yang · Qunliang Xing · Mai Xu · Minglang Qiao
papers.abstract: Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) achieves data compression by quantizing Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients, which inevitably introduces compression artifacts. Most existing JPEG quality enhancement methods operate in the pixel domain, suffering from the high computational costs of decoding. Consequently, direct enhancement of JPEG images in the DCT domain has gained increasing attention. However, current DCT-domain methods often exhibit limited performance. To address this challenge, we identify two critical types of correlations within the DCT coefficients of JPEG images. Building on this insight, we propose an Advanced DCT-domain JPEG Quality Enhancement (AJQE) method that fully exploits these correlations. The AJQE method enables the adaptation of numerous well-established pixel-domain models to the DCT domain, achieving superior performance with reduced computational complexity. Compared to the pixel-domain counterparts, the DCT-domain models derived by our method demonstrate a 0.35 dB improvement in PSNR and a 60.5% increase in enhancement throughput on average. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: DCT中未覆盖的宝藏:通过利用突发事件来提高JPEG质量
papers.abstract_zh: 联合摄影专家组(JPEG)通过量化不可避免引入压缩文物的分辨共生变异系数(DCT)实现数据压缩。 大部分现有的JPEG质量提高方法在像素领域运作,因为解码的计算成本很高。 因此,直接提升DCT域的JPEG图像得到越来越多的关注,然而,目前的DCT域方法往往表现有限,为了应对这一挑战,我们确定了JPEG图像DCT系数中的两种关键关联类型。 基于这一洞察力,我们提出了一种充分利用这些相互关系的高级DCT-域名JPEG质量提高(AJQE)方法。 AJQE方法使得许多成熟的像素-域名模型能够适应DCT领域,在计算复杂性降低的情况下实现优异性能。 与像素-域对等数据相比,通过我们的方法得出的DCT-域模型表明,PSNR改进了0.35 dB,平均增加60.5%的增强量。该代码将公布于众。

papers.title: TWIST & SCOUT: Grounding Multimodal LLM-Experts by Forget-Free Tuning
papers.authors: Aritra Bhowmik · Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani · Dennis Koelma · Yuki Asano · Martin Oswald · Cees Snoek
papers.abstract: Spatial awareness is key to enable embodied multimodal AI systems. Yet, without vast amounts of spatial supervision, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle at this task. In this paper, we introduce TWIST & SCOUT, a framework that equips pre-trained MLLMs with visual grounding ability without forgetting their existing image and language understanding skills. To this end, we propose TWIST, a twin-expert stepwise tuning module that modifies the decoder of the language model using one frozen module pre-trained on image understanding tasks and another learnable one for visual grounding tasks. This allows the MLLM to retain previously learned knowledge and skills, while acquiring what is missing. To fine-tune the model effectively, we generate a high-quality synthetic dataset we call SCOUT, which mimics human reasoning in visual grounding. This dataset provides rich supervision signals, describing a step-by-step multimodal reasoning process, thereby simplifying the task of visual grounding. We evaluate our approach on several standard benchmark datasets, encompassing grounded image captioning, zero-shot localization, and visual grounding tasks. Our method consistently delivers strong performance across all tasks, while retaining the pre-trained image understanding capabilities.
papers.title_zh: TWIST & SCOUT: 以免忘调试的方式将多模式LLM-专家设为禁地
papers.abstract_zh: 空间意识是促成体现多式通用语言系统的关键所在,然而,在缺乏大量空间监督的情况下,当前多式大语言模式在这项任务上挣扎不已。 在本文中,我们介绍TWIST & SCOUT, 这个框架让经过训练的MLLMs具备视觉定位能力, 为此,我们提议TWIST,这是一个双专家分步调制模块,它使用一个在图像理解任务方面经过预先培训的冻结模块和另一个用于视觉定位任务的可学习模块,对语言模式的解码器进行修改。 这使得MLLM能够保留先前学到的知识和技能,同时获得缺失的东西。 为了有效地微调模型,我们产生了一个高质量的合成数据集,我们称之为SCOUT,它模仿视觉地面的人类推理。 这一数据集提供了丰富的监督信号,描述了一个渐进式多式联运推理过程,从而简化了视觉定位任务。 我们评估了我们在若干标准基准数据集上的做法,其中包括有根有据的图像字幕、零投影本地化和视觉定位任务。 我们的方法始终不渝地在所有任务中提供强有力的业绩,同时保留经过培训的图像理解能力。

papers.title: Triad: Empowering LMM-based Anomaly Detection with Expert-guided Region-of-Interest Tokenizer and Manufacturing Process
papers.authors: Yuanze Li · Shihao Yuan · Haolin Wang · Qizhang Li · Ming Liu · Chen Xu · Guangming Shi · Wangmeng Zuo
papers.abstract: Although recent methods have tried to introduce large multimodal models (LMMs) into industrial anomaly detection (IAD), their generalization in the IAD field is far inferior to that for general purposes. We summarize the main reasons for this gap into two aspects. On one hand, general-purpose LMMs lack cognition of defects in the visual modality, thereby failing to sufficiently focus on defect areas.
