papers.title: Mixture of Efficient Diffusion Experts Through Automatic Interval and Sub-Network Selection
papers.authors: Alireza Ganjdanesh · Yan Kang · Yuchen Liu · Richard Zhang · Zhe Lin · Heng Huang
papers.abstract: Diffusion probabilistic models can generate high-quality samples. Yet, their sampling process requires numerous denoising steps, making it slow and computationally intensive. We propose to reduce the sampling cost by pruning a pretrained diffusion model into a mixture of efficient experts. First, we study the similarities between pairs of denoising timesteps, observing a natural clustering, even across different datasets. This suggests that rather than having a single model for all time steps, separate models can serve as ``experts'' for their respective time intervals. As such, we separately fine-tune the pretrained model on each interval, with elastic dimensions in depth and width, to obtain experts specialized in their corresponding denoising interval. To optimize the resource usage between experts, we introduce our Expert Routing Agent, which learns to select a set of proper network configurations. By doing so, our method can allocate the computing budget between the experts in an end-to-end manner without requiring manual heuristics. Finally, with a selected configuration, we fine-tune our pruned experts to obtain our mixture of efficient experts. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, DiffPruning, across several datasets, LSUN-Church, LSUN-Bedroom, FFHQ, and ImageNet, on the Latent Diffusion Model architecture.
papers.title_zh: 通过自动间间和子网络选择,将高效传播专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 传播概率模型可以产生高质量的样本。 然而,它们的取样过程需要无数的去注步骤,使其缓慢和计算密集。 我们提出通过将预先训练的推广模型转换成高效专家混合体来降低取样成本。 首先,我们研究一对取消时间步骤之间的相似之处,观察自然集群,甚至不同数据集之间的自然集群。 这表明,不同的模型不是对所有时间步骤都有一个单一的模式,而是可以作为各自时间间隔的“专家”。 因此,我们分别对预先培训的模式的每个间隔进行微调,深度和宽度都有弹性尺寸,以便获得专门从事相应脱硝间隔的专家。 为了优化专家之间的资源使用,我们引入了专家路由代理,该代理学会选择一套适当的网络配置。 通过这样做,我们的方法可以以端到端的方式在专家之间分配计算预算,而不需要人工超常。 最后,我们用一个特定的配置,微调我们精锐的专家,以获得高效的专家混合。 我们展示了我们的方法,即DiffPruning,通过几个数据集,LSUN-Church、LSUN-Bedroom、FFHQ和图像网络,在冷淡传播模型结构上的有效性。

papers.title: Meta-Sim2: Unsupervised Learning of Scene Structure for Synthetic Data Generation
papers.authors: Jeevan Devaranjan, Amlan Kar, Sanja Fidler
papers.abstract: Generation of synthetic data has allowed Machine Learning practitioners to bypass the need for costly collection and labeling of large datasets. Unfortunately the generation of such data often requires experts to carefully design sampling procedures that guarantee creation of realistic scenes. These sampling procedures typically require experts to specify certain structural aspects such as scene layout information. This is often hard to design, as scenes are generally highly complex and diverse. In this paper, we propose a generative model of synthetic scenes that reduces the distribution gap between the scene structure of generated scenes and a real target image dataset. Importantly, since labeling scene structures for real images is incredibly cumbersome, our method operates without any ground truth structure information for real data. Experiments on two synthetic datasets and a real driving dataset show that the method successfully bridges the distribution gap of discrete structural features between real and generated images."
papers.title_zh: Meta-Sim2:未经监督的合成数据生成现场结构学习
papers.abstract_zh: 合成数据的生成使机器学习实践者能够避免费用昂贵的大型数据集的收集和标签需要,不幸的是,这些数据的生成往往要求专家仔细设计取样程序,以保证创造现实的场景。 这些取样程序通常要求专家具体说明某些结构方面,如现场布局信息,这往往难以设计,因为现场一般十分复杂,而且多种多样。 在本文中,我们提出了一个合成场景的基因模型,以缩小所生成场景的场景结构与真实目标图像数据集之间的分布差距。 重要的是,由于真实图像的现场标签结构极其繁琐,因此我们的方法运作时没有任何真实数据的地面真实结构信息。 在两个合成数据集和一个真正的驱动数据集上进行的实验表明,这种方法成功地弥合了真实图像和生成图像之间离散结构特征的分布差距。”

papers.title: MCID: Multi-aspect Copyright Infringement Detection for Generated Images
papers.authors: Chuanwei Huang · Zexi Jia · Hongyan Fei · Yeshuang Zhu · Zhiqiang Yuan · Ying Deng · Jiapei Zhang · Xiaoyue Duan · Jinchao Zhang · Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of generative models, we can now create highly realistic images. This represents a significant technical breakthrough but also introduces new challenges for copyright protection. Previous methods for detecting copyright infringement in AI-generated images mainly depend on global similarity. However, real-world infringement often occurs only on certain attributes rather than being a global infringement. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Multi-aspect Copyright Infringement Detection (MCID) task, which encompasses various types of infringement, including content, style, structure, and intellectual property infringement. We further develop the Hybrid Infringement Detection Model (HIDM) to address the MCID task. By combining feature-based methods with VLMs, it enables the detection of various infringement types and provides interpretable results. To ensure the MCID task meets actual legal requirements, we construct a Large-Scale Copyright Dataset (LSCD) with clear author copyright ownership. Based on LSCD, we provide a benchmark annotated by legal experts for performance evaluation. Experimental results show that HIDM effectively detects various types of image copyright infringement and offers a more interpretable and superior solution compared to previous methods.
papers.title_zh: MCID: 生成图像的多层版权侵犯检测
papers.abstract_zh: 随着基因模型的快速发展,我们现在可以创造出高度现实的图像。 这是一项重要的技术突破,但也为版权保护带来了新的挑战。 以往在AI生成的图像中发现侵犯版权行为的方法主要取决于全球相似性。 然而,现实世界的侵权往往只发生于某些属性上,而不是全球性的侵权。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议开展一项新颖的多层版权侵犯探测任务,其中包括各种类型的侵犯,包括内容、风格、结构和知识产权侵犯。 我们进一步开发了混合侵入性探测模型,以处理刑事调查部的任务,通过将基于特征的方法与VLMs相结合,能够发现各种类型的侵犯行为,并提供可解释的结果。 为了确保刑事调查部的任务符合实际的法律要求,我们建立了一个拥有明确版权作者所有权的大型版权数据集,根据法律数据管理系统,我们提供了法律专家对业绩评价进行说明的基准。 实验结果表明,与以往的方法相比,HIDM有效检测到各种类型的侵犯形象版权的行为,并提供了更可解释和更优越的解决办法。

papers.title: Make Your ViT-based Multi-view 3D Detectors Faster via Token Compression
papers.authors: Dingyuan Zhang · Dingkang Liang · Zichang Tan · Xiaoqing Ye · Cheng Zhang · Jingdong Wang · Xiang Bai
papers.abstract: Slow inference speed is one of the most crucial concerns for deploying multi-view 3D detectors to tasks with high real-time requirements like autonomous driving. Although many sparse query-based methods have already attempted to improve the efficiency of 3D detectors, they neglect to consider the backbone, especially when using Vision Transformers (ViT) for better performance. To tackle this problem, we explore the efficient ViT backbones for multi-view 3D detection via token compression and propose a simple yet effective method called TokenCompression3D (ToC3D). By leveraging history object queries as foreground priors of high quality, modeling 3D motion information in them, and interacting them with image tokens through the attention mechanism, ToC3D can effectively determine the magnitude of information densities of image tokens and segment the salient foreground tokens. With the proposed dynamic router design, ToC3D can weigh more computing resources to important foreground tokens while compressing the information loss, leading to a more efficient ViT-based multi-view 3D detector. Extensive results on the large-scale nuScenes dataset show that our method can nearly maintain the performance of recent SOTA with up to 30% inference speedup, and the improvements are consistent after scaling up the ViT and input resolution. Code will be made available.
papers.title_zh: 通过 Token 压缩让基于 VIT 的多视图 3D 探测器更快
papers.abstract_zh: 缓慢的推论速度是部署多视3D探测器从事诸如自主驾驶等具有高实时要求的任务的最关键关切之一。 虽然许多以Query为基础的方法稀少,已经试图提高3D探测器的效率,但它们忽略了考虑主干,特别是在使用Vision Transformer提高性能时。 为了解决这一问题,我们探索通过象征性压缩进行多视3D探测的高效维特骨干,并提出一种简单而有效的方法,称为TokenCompression3D(ToC3D)。 通过利用历史对象Query作为高品质的地面前视线,在其中建模三维运动信息,并通过关注机制与图像 token进行互动, ToC3D 能够有效地确定图像 token和突出前景标记段的信息密度。 有了拟议的动态路由器设计, ToC3D 就可以在压缩信息损失的同时,将更多的计算资源用于重要的前地标牌,从而形成一个效率更高的基于VIT的多视图3D探测器。 大规模 Nuscenses 数据集的广泛结果显示,我们的方法几乎可以维持最近SOTA的性能,可加快30%的推论速度,在扩大ViT和投入决议之后,改进是一致的。 代码将公布。

papers.title: LONG3R: Long Sequence Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zhuoguang Chen · Minghui Qin · Tianyuan Yuan · Zhe Liu · Hang Zhao
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in sparse multi-view scene reconstruction have been significant, yet existing methods face limitations when processing streams of input images. These methods either rely on time-consuming offline optimization or are restricted to shorter sequences, hindering their applicability in real-time scenarios. In this work, we propose LONG3R (LOng sequence streamiNG 3D Reconstruction), a novel model designed for streaming multi-view 3D scene reconstruction over longer sequences. Our model achieves real-time processing by operating recurrently, maintaining and updating memory with each new observation. We introduce a refined decoder that facilitates coarse-to-fine interaction between memory and new observations using memory gating and a dual-source attention structure. To effectively capture long-sequence memory, we propose a 3D spatio-temporal memory that dynamically prunes redundant spatial information while adaptively adjusting resolution along the scene. To enhance our model’s performance on long sequences while maintaining training efficiency, we employ a two-stage curriculum training strategy, each stage targeting specific capabilities. Experiments on multiple multi-view reconstruction datasets demonstrate that LONG3R outperforms state-of-the-art streaming methods, particularly for longer sequences, while maintaining real-time inference speed.
papers.title_zh: 长序列流 3D重建
papers.abstract_zh: 近来在稀少的多视角场景重建方面取得了显著进展,但现有方法在处理输入图像流时面临限制。 这些方法要么依靠耗时的离线优化,要么局限于较短的顺序,从而妨碍了这些方法在实时情景中的适用性。 在这项工作中,我们提出LONG3R(LONG 序列串流 3D Reformation) , 这是一种新颖的模式,旨在将多视角 3D 场景的重建流成更长的序列。 我们的模型通过每次新观测的经常性操作、维护和更新记忆实现实时处理。 我们引入一个精细的解码器,用记忆胶合和双重来源关注结构,促进记忆与新观测之间的粗略到细微互动。 为了有效捕捉长期序列内存,我们提议3D时空内存,动态地利用冗余空间信息,同时调整现场的分辨率。 为了在保持培训效率的同时提高我们模式在长顺序上的绩效,我们采用了两阶段课程培训战略,每个阶段针对特定能力。 多个多视图重建数据集的实验表明,LONG3R在保持实时推断速度的同时,优于最先进的流方法,特别是较长序列的流方法。

papers.title: LIRA: Lifelong Image Restoration from Unknown Blended Distortions
papers.authors: Jianzhao Liu, Jianxin Lin, Xin Li, Wei Zhou, Sen Liu, Zhibo Chen
papers.abstract: Most existing image restoration networks are designed in a disposable way and catastrophically forget previously learned distortions when trained on a new distortion removal task. To alleviate this problem, we raise the novel lifelong image restoration problem for blended distortions. We first design a base fork-join model in which multiple pre-trained expert models specializing in individual distortion removal task work cooperatively and adaptively to handle blended distortions. When the input is degraded by a new distortion, inspired by adult neurogenesis in human memory system, we develop a neural growing strategy where the previously trained model can incorporate a new expert branch and continually accumulate new knowledge without interfering with learned knowledge. Experimental results show that the proposed approach can not only achieve state-of-the-art performance on blended distortions removal tasks in both PSNR/SSIM metrics, but also maintain old expertise while learning new restoration tasks."
papers.title_zh: LIRA:从未知的混合失真中实现终身图像恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数现有的图像恢复网络都是以一次性方式设计的,在接受新的失真清除任务培训时,灾难性地忘记了先前学到的失真现象。 为了缓解这一问题,我们提出了新颖的终身图像恢复问题,以弥补混合失真。 我们首先设计一个基础叉路加入模式,在这个模式中,多个专门从事个人失真清除任务的预先培训专家模式开展合作和适应性工作,处理混合失真现象。 当输入因一种新的失真而退化时,在人类记忆系统中成人神经起源的启发下,我们制定了神经成长战略,让以前培训过的模型纳入一个新的专家分支,并在不干扰所学知识的情况下不断积累新知识。 实验结果显示,拟议方法不仅能够在PSNR/SSIM衡量标准中实现混合失真清除任务的SOTA 性能,而且可以在学习新的恢复任务的同时保持旧的专门知识。”

papers.title: LEGION: Learning to Ground and Explain for Synthetic Image Detection
papers.authors: Hengrui Kang · Siwei Wen · Zichen Wen · Junyan Ye · Weijia Li · Peilin Feng · Baichuan Zhou · Bin Wang · Dahua Lin · Linfeng Zhang · Conghui He
papers.abstract: The rapid advancements in generative technology have emerged as a double-edged sword. While offering powerful tools that enhance convenience, they also pose significant social concerns. As defenders, current synthetic image detection methods often lack artifact-level textual interpretability and are overly focused on image manipulation detection, and current datasets usually suffer from outdated generators and a lack of fine-grained annotations. In this paper, we introduce SynthScars, a high-quality and diverse dataset consisting of 12,236 fully synthetic images with human-expert annotations. It features 4 distinct image content types, 3 categories of artifacts, and fine-grained annotations covering pixel-level segmentation, detailed textual explanations, and artifact category labels. Furthermore, we propose LEGION (LEarning to Ground and explain for Synthetic Image detectiON), a multimodal large language model~(MLLM)-based image forgery analysis framework that integrates artifact detection, segmentation, and explanation.Building upon this capability, we further explore LEGION as a controller, integrating it into image refinement pipelines to guide the generation of higher-quality and more realistic images. Extensive experiments show that LEGION outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks, particularly surpassing the second-best traditional expert on SynthScars by 3.31 % in mIoU and 7.75 % in F1 score. Moreover, the refined images generated under its guidance exhibit stronger alignment with human preferences. The code, model, and dataset will be released.
papers.title_zh: 课程:学习如何定位和解释合成图像探测
papers.abstract_zh: 基因技术的迅速进步已成为一把双刃剑,虽然提供了强大的工具来方便他人,但也引起了重大的社会问题。 作为维权者,目前的合成图像探测方法往往缺乏手工艺品水平的文字解释,过分侧重于图像操纵探测,目前的数据集通常有过时的生成器,缺乏细微的注释。 在本文中,我们介绍合成卫星,这是一个高质量和多样的数据集,由12 236个完整的合成图像组成,附有人类专家说明。 它有4种不同的图像内容类型、3类文物和细微的注释,包括像素层分解、详细的文字解释和文物类别标签。 此外,我们提议Groupion(Liarning to Ground)(Learning to Form),并解释合成图像探测器),这是一个基于多式联运的大型语言模型~(MLLM)的图像伪造分析框架,整合了文物探测、分解和解释。 我们利用这一能力,进一步探索GLIGion作为控制器,将其纳入图像改进管道,以引导生成更高质量、更现实的图像。 广泛的实验表明,专家组在多种基准方面表现优于现有方法,特别是超过合成汽车第二最佳传统专家3.31%(MIOU)和7.75%(F1分 ) 。 此外,在其指导下产生的精美图像更符合人类的喜好。 代码、模型和数据集将发布。

papers.title: Learning to Fit Morphable Models
papers.authors: Vasileios Choutas, Federica Bogo, Jingjing Shen, Julien Valentin
papers.abstract: "Fitting parametric models of human bodies, hands or faces to sparse input signals in an accurate, robust, and fast manner has the promise of significantly improving immersion in AR and VR scenarios. A common first step in systems that tackle these problems is to regress the parameters of the parametric model directly from the input data. This approach is fast, robust, and is a good starting point for an iterative minimization algorithm. The latter searches for the minimum of an energy function, typically composed of a data term and priors that encode our knowledge about the problem’s structure. While this is undoubtedly a very successful recipe, priors are often hand defined heuristics and finding the right balance between the different terms to achieve high quality results is a non-trivial task. Furthermore, converting and optimizing these systems to run in a performant way requires custom implementations that demand significant time investments from both engineers and domain experts. In this work, we build upon recent advances in learned optimization and propose an update rule inspired by the classic Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. We show the effectiveness of the proposed neural optimizer on three problems, 3D body estimation from a head-mounted device, 3D body estimation from sparse 2D keypoints and face surface estimation from dense 2D landmarks. Our method can easily be applied to new model fitting problems and offers a competitive alternative to well-tuned ‘traditional’ model fitting pipelines, both in terms of accuracy and speed."
papers.title_zh: 学习适合体形模型
papers.abstract_zh: 确定人体、手或脸的参数模型, 以准确、稳健和快速的方式, 找到稀有的输入信号, 有望显著改善AR和VR情景的浸入。 解决这些问题的系统的一个共同的第一步是直接从输入数据中倒退参数模型参数。 这种方法是快速、稳健的,是迭代最小化算法的良好起点。 后者寻求最起码的能源功能,通常由一个数据术语和前言组成,以记录我们对问题结构的了解。 虽然这无疑是一个非常成功的处方,但前科往往是手下界定的超自然学,在达到高质量成果的不同条件之间找到适当的平衡是一项非三重任务。 此外,要转换和优化这些系统,使之以有效益的方式运行,就需要定制实施,这需要工程师和域专家投入大量时间。 在这项工作中,我们以最近在学习优化方面取得的进展为基础,根据传统的Levenberg-Marquardt算法,提出了一项更新规则。 我们展示了拟议的神经优化器在三个问题上的有效性, 3D从一个头顶设备上进行身体估计, 3D从稀疏的 2D 关键点上进行身体估计, 以及从密集的 2D 地标上进行表面估计。 我们的方法可以很容易地适用于新模式的安装问题,并且为精度和速度两方面的完善的 " 传统 " 模式安装管道提供了一个有竞争力的替代方案。

papers.title: Learning Interpretable Queries for Explainable Image Classification with Information Pursuit
papers.authors: Stefan Kolek · Aditya Chattopadhyay · Kwan Ho Ryan Chan · Hector Andrade Loarca · Gitta Kutyniok · Rene Vidal
papers.abstract: Building image classification models that are both highly accurate and interpretable remains a challenge in computer vision. Information Pursuit (IP) is an information-theoretic framework for interpretable-by-design sequential prediction. Given a set of task-relevant and semantic data queries, IP selects a sequence of queries in order of information gain and updates the posterior at each step based on the gathered query-answer pairs. To carry out IP, previous methods construct hand-crafted dictionaries of potential data queries, curated either by a domain expert or by prompting large language models. However, in practice, such hand-crafted dictionaries are limited by the expertise of the curator and the heuristics of prompt engineering, resulting in a gap between the predictive performance of IP versus non-interpretable black-box predictors. In this work, we propose to parameterize the IP queries as a learnable dictionary defined in the latent space of vision-language models such as CLIP. Drawing inspiration from sparse dictionary learning, we propose an alternating optimization algorithm that iterates between solving IP's optimization problem for a fixed query dictionary and optimizing the dictionary to maximize classification accuracy. Empirically, our experiments show that our method learns a query dictionary that reduces the accuracy gap between explainable image classification with IP and black-box methods, while preserving interpretability.
papers.title_zh: 可解释图像分类与信息Query的可解释性学习解析Query
papers.abstract_zh: 建立高度准确和可解释的图像分类模型仍然是计算机视觉的一个挑战。 信息搜索(IP)是一个信息理论框架,可用于逐个设计连续预测。 根据一套与任务有关和语义数据Query,IP选择一系列Query,以便根据收集的对答Query,获取信息,并在每一步骤更新后继者。 为实施IP,以前的方法是建立手工制作的潜在数据Query词典,由域专家或通过推广大型语言模式来编写。 然而,在实践中,这种手工制作的词典受到保管人专门知识的限制,也受到迅速工程的超常性能的限制,造成IP的预测性能与非解释性黑盒预测器之间的差距。 在这项工作中,我们建议将IPQuery作为CLIP等视觉语言模型潜在空间定义的可学习字典加以参数化。 我们建议采用一种交替优化算法, 在解决固定Query字典IP优化问题与优化字典以尽量提高分类准确性之间进行迭接。 我们的实验生动地表明 我们的方法学习了一种Query字典 来缩小可解释的图像分类 与IP和黑盒方法之间的准确性差距 同时保留可解释性

papers.title: Joint RGB-Spectral Decomposition Model Guided Image Enhancement in Mobile Photography
papers.authors: Kailai Zhou · Lijing Cai · Yibo Wang · Mengya Zhang · Bihan Wen · Qiu Shen · Xun Cao
papers.abstract: The integration of miniaturized spectrometers into mobile devices offers new avenues for image quality enhancement and facilitates novel downstream tasks. However, the broader application of spectral sensors in mobile photography is hindered by the inherent complexity of spectral images and the constraints of spectral imaging capabilities. To overcome these challenges, we propose a joint RGB-Spectral decomposition model guided enhancement framework, which consists of two steps: joint decomposition and priors-guided enhancement. Firstly, we leverage the complementarity between RGB and Low-resolution Multi-Spectral Images (Lr-MSI) to predict shading, reflectance, and material semantic priors. Subsequently, these priors are seamlessly integrated into the established HDRNet to promote dynamic range enhancement, color mapping, and grid expert learning, respectively. Additionally, we construct a high-quality Mobile-Spec dataset to support our research, and our experiments validate the effectiveness of Lr-MSI in the tone enhancement task. This work aims to establish a solid foundation for advancing spectral vision in mobile photography.
papers.title_zh: RGB-Spectractractracl分解模型联合模型在移动摄影中引导图像增强
papers.abstract_zh: 将微型光谱仪纳入移动设备,为提高图像质量提供了新的途径,并为新的下游任务提供了便利。 然而,光谱图像的内在复杂性以及光谱成像能力的限制阻碍了光谱传感器在移动摄影中的更广泛应用。 为了克服这些挑战,我们提议建立一个联合的RGB-Spectral分解模型增强指导框架,该框架由两个步骤组成:联合分解和前导强化。 首先,我们利用RGB和低分辨率多特征图像(Lr-MSI)之间的互补性来预测阴影、反射和材料语义前科。 随后,这些前科被完全纳入既定的人类发展报告网,以促进动态范围的扩大、色谱绘制和网格专家学习。 此外,我们构建了一个高质量的移动特征数据集以支持我们的研究,我们的实验验证了Lr-MSI在增强语气任务中的有效性。 这项工作旨在为在移动摄影中推进光谱视觉奠定坚实的基础。

papers.title: Instruction-Grounded Visual Projectors for Continual Learning of Generative Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Hyundong Jin · Hyung Jin Chang · Eunwoo Kim
papers.abstract: Continual learning enables pre-trained generative vision-language models (VLMs) to incorporate knowledge from new tasks without retraining data from previous ones. Recent methods update a visual projector to translate visual information for new tasks, connecting pre-trained vision encoders with large language models. However, such adjustments may cause the models to prioritize visual inputs over language instructions, particularly learning tasks with repetitive types of textual instructions. To address the neglect of language instructions, we propose a novel framework that grounds the translation of visual information on instructions for language models. We introduce a mixture of visual projectors, each serving as a specialized visual-to-language translation expert based on the given instruction context to adapt to new tasks. To avoid using experts for irrelevant instruction contexts, we propose an expert recommendation strategy that reuses experts for tasks similar to those previously learned. Additionally, we introduce expert pruning to alleviate interference from the use of experts that cumulatively activated in previous tasks. Extensive experiments on diverse vision-language tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing continual learning approaches by generating instruction-following responses.
papers.title_zh: 持续学习创造视觉-语言模型的整形教学视觉投影仪
papers.abstract_zh: 持续学习使得经过培训的基因化视觉语言模型(VLMs)能够吸收来自新任务的知识,而无需再培训前任务的数据。 最新方法更新了视觉投影器,用于翻译用于新任务的视觉信息,将经过培训的视觉编码器与大型语言模型连接起来。 然而,这种调整可能导致模式将视觉投入置于语言指令之上,特别是学习任务,以及重复类型的文字指令。 为解决忽视语言指导的问题,我们提议建立一个新框架,根据语言模式指示翻译视觉信息。 我们采用混合的视觉投影器,每个投影机都作为专门的视觉到语言翻译专家,根据给定的教学背景来适应新的任务。 为了避免将专家用于无关的教学环境,我们提出了一项专家建议战略,重新利用专家从事与以前所学到的任务类似的任务,此外,我们引入专家修剪方法,以缓解因使用专家而引起的干扰,这些专家在以前的任务中累积地被使用。 有关不同视觉语言任务的广泛实验表明,我们的方法通过产生遵循教学的对策,优于现有的持续学习方法。

papers.title: INSTINCT: Instance-Level Interaction Architecture for Query-Based Collaborative Perception
papers.authors: yunjiang xu · Yupeng Ouyang · Lingzhi Li · Jin Wang · Benyuan Yang
papers.abstract: Collaborative perception systems overcome single-vehicle limitations in long-range detection and occlusion scenarios by integrating multi-agent sensory data, improving accuracy and safety. However, frequent cooperative interactions and real-time requirements impose stringent bandwidth constraints. Previous works proves that query-based instance-level interaction reduces bandwidth demands and manual priors, however, LiDAR-focused implementations in collaborative perception remain underdeveloped, with performance still trailing state-of-the-art approaches. To bridge this gap, we propose INSTINCT (instance-level interaction architecture), a novel collaborative perception framework featuring three core components: 1) a quality-aware filtering mechanism for high-quality instance feature selection; 2) a dual-branch detection routing scheme to decouple collaboration-irrelevant and collaboration-relevant instances; 3) a Cross Agent Local Instance Fusion module to aggregate local hybrid instance features. Additionally, we enhance the ground truth (GT) sampling technique to facilitate training with diverse hybrid instance features. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that INSTINCT achieves superior performance.Specifically, our method achieves an improvement in accuracy 13.23 %/32.24 % in DAIR-V2X and V2V4Real while reducing the communication bandwidth to 1/281 and 1/264 compared to state-of-the-art methods. The code will be released soon.
papers.title_zh: INSTINCT: 以调查为基础的协作认识的实情互动结构
papers.abstract_zh: 合作认知系统通过整合多剂感官数据,提高准确性和安全性,克服了远程探测和隔离情景中的单车辆限制,但是,频繁的合作互动和实时要求造成了严格的带宽限制。 以前的工作证明,基于Query的例级互动减少了带宽需求和人工前科,然而,以LiDAR为重点的协作性实施仍然不够完善,业绩仍然落后于最先进的方法。 为了弥合这一差距,我们提议INSTINCT(内部互动架构),这是一个新的协作概念框架,包括三个核心组成部分:(1) 高质量实例特征选择的高质量觉悟过滤机制;(2) 双重部门检测路线计划,以分离与协作相关和协作相关的情况;(3) 跨代理地方事件融合模块,以综合地方混合实例特征。 此外,我们加强实地真相取样技术,以便利具有多种混合情况特点的培训。 跨多个数据集的广泛实验表明,INSTINCT取得了优异的性能。 具体地说,我们的方法在DAIR-V2X和V2V4Real的精确度提高了13.23%/32.24%,同时与最先进的方法相比,通信带宽减少到1/281和1/264。 守则很快会发布

papers.title: Insect Identification in the Wild: The AMI Dataset
papers.authors: Aditya Jain · Fagner Cunha · Michael J Bunsen · Juan Sebastián Cañas · Léonard Pasi · Nathan Pinoy · Flemming Helsing · JoAnne Russo · Marc S Botham · Michael Sabourin · Jonathan Fréchette · Alexandre Anctil · Yacksecari Lopez · Eduardo Navarro · Filonila Pérez · Ana C Zamora · Jose Alejandro Ramirez-Silva · Jonathan Gagnon · Tom A August · Kim Bjerge · Alba Gomez Segura · Marc Belisle · Yves Basset · Kent P McFarland · David B Roy · Toke T Høye · Maxim Larrivee · David Rolnick
papers.abstract: Insects represent half of all global biodiversity, yet many of the world's insects are disappearing, with severe implications for ecosystems and agriculture. Despite this crisis, data on insect diversity and abundance remain woefully inadequate, due to the scarcity of human experts and the lack of scalable tools for monitoring. Ecologists have started to adopt camera traps to record and study insects, and have proposed computer vision algorithms as an answer for scalable data processing. However, insect monitoring in the wild poses unique challenges that have not yet been addressed within computer vision, including the combination of long-tailed data, extremely similar classes, and significant distribution shifts. We provide the first large-scale machine learning benchmarks for fine-grained insect recognition, designed to match real-world tasks faced by ecologists. Our contributions include a curated dataset of images from citizen science platforms and museums, and an expert-annotated dataset drawn from automated camera traps across multiple continents, designed to test out-of-distribution generalization under field conditions. We train and evaluate a variety of baseline algorithms and introduce a combination of data augmentation techniques that enhance generalization across geographies and hardware setups. Code and datasets will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 野生昆虫识别:AMI数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 昆虫占全球生物多样性的一半,但世界上许多昆虫正在消失,对生态系统和农业产生严重影响。 尽管发生了这一危机,但由于人类专家短缺和缺乏可扩展的监测工具,关于昆虫多样性和丰富性的数据仍然严重不足。 生态学家已开始采用摄像陷阱来记录和研究昆虫,并提议将计算机视觉算法作为可缩放数据处理的答案。 然而,野生昆虫监测带来了独特的挑战,尚未在计算机视野内得到解决,包括将长尾数据、极为相似的类别和显著的分布变化结合起来。 我们为细小的昆虫识别提供了第一批大型机器学习基准,旨在配合生态学家面临的现实世界任务。 我们的贡献包括一个公民科学平台和博物馆图像的分类数据集,以及一个专家附加说明的数据集,该数据集来自多个大陆的自动照相机陷阱,目的是在实地条件下测试分配外的通用性。 我们训练和评价各种基线算法,并采用数据扩增技术组合,加强地理和硬件配置的通用化。 代码和数据集将公布于众。

papers.title: Improving Medical Multi-modal Contrastive Learning with Expert Annotations
papers.authors: Yogesh Kumar · Pekka Marttinen
papers.abstract: We introduce eCLIP, an enhanced version of the CLIP model that integrates expert annotations in the form of radiologist eye-gaze heatmaps. It tackles key challenges in contrastive multi-modal medical imaging analysis, notably data scarcity and the ``modality gap'' -- a significant disparity between image and text embeddings that diminishes the quality of representations and hampers cross-modal interoperability. eCLIP integrates a heatmap processor and leverages mixup augmentation to efficiently utilize the scarce expert annotations, thus boosting the model's learning effectiveness. eCLIP is designed to be generally applicable to any variant of CLIP without requiring any modifications of the core architecture. Through detailed evaluations across several tasks, including zero-shot inference, linear probing, cross-modal retrieval, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) of radiology reports using a frozen Large Language Model, eCLIP showcases considerable improvements in embedding quality. The outcomes reveal enhanced alignment and uniformity, affirming eCLIP's capability to harness high-quality annotations for enriched multi-modal analysis in the medical imaging domain.
papers.title_zh: 改进与专家说明的多模式医疗矛盾学习
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了电子CLIP,这是一个强化版的CLIP模型,将专家说明以放射学家眼藻热测图的形式纳入其中。 它解决了对比鲜明的多模式医学成像分析中的关键挑战,特别是数据稀缺和“现代差距”——图像和文字嵌入之间的巨大差距,降低了表述质量,妨碍了跨模式互操作性。 eCLIP将热映射处理器和混合放大器结合起来,以便有效利用稀有的专家说明,从而提高模型的学习效率。 eCLIP旨在普遍适用于CLIP的任何变种,而无需对核心结构作任何修改。 通过对若干任务进行详细评价,包括使用冻结的大语言模型对放射学报告进行零点推断、线性检验、跨模式检索和回收增加代(RAG),电子CLIP展示了在嵌入质量方面的显著改进。 结果显示,协调统一程度有所提高,确认了电子CLIP有能力利用高质量的说明进行医学成像领域的丰富多模式分析。

papers.title: Improving Intervention Efficacy via Concept Realignment in Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.authors: Nishad Singhi · Jae Myung Kim · Karsten Roth · Zeynep Akata
papers.abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) ground image classification on human-understandable concepts to allow for interpretable model decisions. Crucially, the CBM design inherently allows for human interventions, in which expert users are given the ability to modify potentially misaligned concept choices to influence the decision behavior of the model in an interpretable fashion. However, existing approaches often require numerous human interventions per image to achieve strong performances, posing practical challenges in scenarios where obtaining human feedback is expensive. In this paper, we find that this is noticeably driven by an independent treatment of concepts during intervention, wherein a change of one concept does not influence the use of other ones in the model's final decision. To address this issue, we introduce a trainable concept intervention realignment module, which leverages concept relations to realign concept assignments post-intervention. Across standard, real-world benchmarks, we find that concept re-alignment can significantly improve intervention efficacy; significantly reducing the number of interventions needed to reach a target classification performance or concept prediction accuracy. In addition, it easily integrates into existing concept-based architectures without requiring changes to the models themselves. This reduced cost of human-model collaboration is crucial to enhance the feasibility of CBMs in resource-constrained environments.
papers.title_zh: 通过概念瓶颈模型概念调整,提高干预效率
papers.abstract_zh: 概念 " 瓶颈模型 " (CBS)根据人类可理解的概念对地面图像进行分类,以便作出可解释的模型决定。 关键是,建立信任措施的设计必然允许人的干预,在这种干预中,专家用户能够修改可能错误的概念选择,以可解释的方式影响模型的决策行为。 然而,现有办法往往要求每个形象都有许多人干预,才能取得强有力的业绩,在获取人类反馈费用昂贵的情况下,这些办法构成实际挑战。 在本文中,我们发现,这明显是由于干预期间对概念的独立处理所驱动的,在干预期间,一个概念的改变不影响模型最后决定中使用其他概念。 为解决这一问题,我们引入了一个经过培训的概念干预调整模块,该模块利用概念关系调整干预后的概念分配。 跨越标准、现实世界基准,我们发现,重新调整概念可以大大提高干预的功效;大大减少达到目标分类业绩或概念预测准确性所需的干预次数。 此外,它很容易融入现有的基于概念的结构,而不需要改变模型本身,这样降低人类模式合作的成本,对于在资源受限制的环境中加强建立信任措施的可行性至关重要。

papers.title: Image Intrinsic Scale Assessment: Bridging the Gap Between Quality and Resolution
papers.authors: Vlad Hosu · Lorenzo Agnolucci · Daisuke Iso · Dietmar Saupe
papers.abstract: Image Quality Assessment (IQA) measures and predicts perceived image quality by human observers. Although recent studies have highlighted the critical influence that variations in the scale of an image have on its perceived quality, this relationship has not been systematically quantified.To bridge this gap, we introduce the Image Intrinsic Scale (IIS), defined as the largest scale where an image exhibits its highest perceived quality. We also present the Image Intrinsic Scale Assessment (IISA) task, which involves subjectively measuring and predicting the IIS based on human judgments. We develop a subjective annotation methodology and create the IISA-DB dataset, comprising 785 image-IIS pairs annotated by experts in a rigorously controlled crowdsourcing study with verified reliability. Furthermore, we propose WIISA (Weak-labeling for Image Intrinsic Scale Assessment), a strategy that leverages how the IIS of an image varies with downscaling to generate weak labels. Experiments show that applying WIISA during the training of several IQA methods adapted for IISA consistently improves the performance compared to using only ground-truth labels. We will release the code, dataset, and pre-trained models upon acceptance.
papers.title_zh: 图像内在规模评估:弥合质量与分辨率之间的差距
papers.abstract_zh: 图像质量评估(IQA)衡量和预测了人类观察员对图像质量的看法。 虽然最近的研究突出了图像规模的变化对其感知质量的重大影响,但这种关系并没有系统地量化。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了图像内在比例(IIS),这是图像显示其感知质量最高的最大比例(IIS)。 我们还介绍了图像内部规模评估的任务,它涉及主观地根据人类判断衡量和预测国际统计系统。 我们开发一种主观的批注方法,创建ISA-DB数据集,由785对图像-IIS配对组成,这些配对由专家在一项严格控制的、经核实可靠的众包研究中附加说明。 此外,我们建议采用WISA(图像内部规模评估的微弱标签),这一战略可以利用图像的IIS变化方式,通过缩小尺度产生薄弱标签。 实验显示,在为国际质量评估协会调整的若干国际质量评估方法的培训中应用国际质量评估服务,与只使用地面真实标签相比,不断提高性能。 我们将在接受时发布代码、数据集和预先培训的模型。

papers.title: Image Demoireing in RAW and sRGB Domains
papers.authors: Shuning Xu · Binbin Song · Xiangyu Chen · Xina Liu · Jiantao Zhou
papers.abstract: Moiré patterns frequently appear when capturing screens with smartphones or cameras, potentially compromising image quality. Previous studies suggest that moiré pattern elimination in the RAW domain offers greater effectiveness compared to demoiréing in the sRGB domain. Nevertheless, relying solely on RAW data for image demoiréing is insufficient in mitigating the color cast due to the absence of essential information required for the color correction by the image signal processor (ISP). In this paper, we propose to jointly utilize both RAW and sRGB data for image demoiréing (RRID), which are readily accessible in modern smartphones and DSLR cameras. We develop Skip-Connection-based Demoiréing Module (SCDM) with Gated Feedback Module (GFM) and Frequency Selection Module (FSM) embedded in skip-connections for the efficient and effective demoiréing of RAW and sRGB features, respectively. Subsequently, we design a RGB Guided ISP (RGISP) to learn a device-dependent ISP, assisting the process of color recovery. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our RRID outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, in terms of the performance in moiré pattern removal and color cast correction by 0.62dB in PSNR and 0.003 in SSIM.
papers.title_zh: RAW 和 sRGB 域内的图像堆积
papers.abstract_zh: Moiré模式经常出现在用智能手机或相机捕捉屏幕时,这可能会损害图像质量。 以前的研究显示,在RAW领域消除moiré模式比在SRGB领域进行降级更为有效。 然而,由于缺少图像信号处理器(ISP)进行彩色校正所需的基本信息,仅仅依靠RAW数据进行图像显示,不足以减轻颜色的颜色变化。 在本文中,我们提议共同利用RAW和SRGB数据进行图像演示,这些图像在现代智能手机和DSLR摄像机中很容易获得。 我们开发基于 " 跳过-连接 " 的 " 演示模块 " (SCDM),同时将Gated反馈模块(GMM)和频率选择模块(FSM)分别嵌入跳接连接中,以便高效率和高成效地演示RAW和SRGB的特征。 随后,我们设计了一个RGB制导ISP(RGISP),学习一个依赖设备的综合ISP,协助颜色恢复过程。 广泛的实验表明,从PSNR的0.62dB和SSIM的0.003的0.62dB的去除莫雷模式和涂色校正的性能来看,我们的RRID的性能优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: Hydra-NeXt: Robust Closed-Loop Driving with Open-Loop Training
papers.authors: Zhenxin Li · Shihao Wang · Shiyi Lan · Zhiding Yu · Zuxuan Wu · Jose M. Alvarez
papers.abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving research currently faces a critical challenge in bridging the gap between open-loop training and closed-loop deployment. Current approaches are trained to predict trajectories in an open-loop environment, which struggle with quick reactions to other agents in closed-loop environments and risk generating kinematically infeasible plans due to the gap between open-loop training and closed-loop driving. In this paper, we introduce Hydra-NeXt, a novel multi-branch planning framework that unifies trajectory prediction, control prediction, and a trajectory refinement network in one model. Unlike current open-loop trajectory prediction models that only handle general-case planning, Hydra-NeXt further utilizes a control decoder to focus on short-term actions, which enables faster responses to dynamic situations and reactive agents. Moreover, we propose the Trajectory Refinement module to augment and refine the planning decisions by effectively adhering to kinematic constraints in closed-loop environments. This unified approach bridges the gap between open-loop training and closed-loop driving, demonstrating superior performance of 65.89 Driving Score (DS) and 48.20 % Success Rate (SR) on the Bench2Drive dataset without relying on external experts for data collection. Hydra-NeXt surpasses the previous state-of-the-art by 22.98 DS and 17.49 SR, marking a significant advancement in autonomous driving.
papers.title_zh: Hydra-NeXt:通过开放在线培训大力开展闭线驾驶
papers.abstract_zh: 端对端自主驱动研究目前在弥合开放通道培训和封闭通道部署之间的差距方面面临着重大挑战。 目前的方法经过培训,可以预测在开放环形环境中的轨迹,这种轨迹与在封闭环形环境中对其他物剂的快速反应挣扎,并且由于开放环形培训和封闭环形驾驶之间的差距,有可能产生动力不可行的计划。 在本文中,我们介绍一个全新的多部门规划框架,即统一轨迹预测、控制预测和一个模型的轨迹改进网络。 与目前只处理一般情况规划的开放环轨轨迹预测模型不同,Hydra-NeXt进一步利用控制解码器侧重于短期行动,以便能够对动态情况和反应剂作出更快的反应。 此外,我们提议采用轨迹改进模块,通过有效遵守闭路环境的动态限制,扩大和完善规划决定。 这一统一办法弥合了开放通道培训和闭路驾驶之间的差距,显示了65.89分和48.20%成功率的优异表现,而不必依靠外部专家收集数据,2Drive数据集的成功率是48.20%。 Hydra-NeXt在22.98 DS和17.49 SR之间超过了以往的最新水平,标志着自主驾驶方面的重大进步。

papers.title: How to Synthesize a Large-Scale and Trainable Micro-Expression Dataset?
papers.authors: Yuchi Liu, Zhongdao Wang, Tom Gedeon, Liang Zheng
papers.abstract: "This paper does not contain technical novelty but introduces our key discoveries in a data generation protocol, a database and insights. We aim to address the lack of large-scale datasets in micro-expression (MiE) recognition due to the prohibitive cost of data collection, which renders large-scale training less feasible. To this end, we develop a protocol to automatically synthesize large scale MiE training data that allow us to train improved recognition models for real-world test data. Specifically, we discover three types of Action Units (AUs) that can constitute trainable MiEs. These AUs come from real-world MiEs, early frames of macro-expression videos, and the relationship between AUs and expression categories defined by human expert knowledge. With these AUs, our protocol then employs large numbers of face images of various identities and an off-the-shelf face generator for MiE synthesis, yielding the MiE-X dataset. MiE recognition models are trained or pre-trained on MiE-X and evaluated on real-world test sets, where very competitive accuracy is obtained. Experimental results not only validate the effectiveness of the discovered AUs and MiE-X dataset but also reveal some interesting properties of MiEs: they generalize across faces, are close to early-stage macro-expressions, and can be manually defined."
papers.title_zh: 如何合成大尺度和可培训的微电荷数据集?
papers.abstract_zh: 本文并不包含技术创新, 而是在数据生成协议、数据库和洞察力中介绍我们的主要发现。 我们的目标是解决由于数据收集费用高昂,导致大规模培训不那么可行,导致微型表现(MiE)识别方面缺乏大规模数据集的问题。 为此,我们制定了一个自动合成大型 MiE 培训数据的协议,从而使我们能够为真实世界测试数据培训更好的识别模型。 具体地说,我们发现了三种可以构成可培训的 MiE的行动单位(AUs ) 。 这些AU来自现实世界的MiEs、宏观表达视频的早期框架,以及AUs与人类专家知识界定的表达类别之间的关系。 有了这些AUs,我们的协议就使用了大量各种身份的面部图像和MiE合成的现成面部生成器,生成了MiE-X数据集。 MiE识别模型在MiE-X上接受了培训或预先培训,并在真实世界测试组中进行了评估,获得了非常有竞争力的准确性。 实验结果不仅验证了所发现的AUs和MiE-X数据集的有效性,而且揭示了MiEs的一些有趣的特性:它们面部一概而论,接近早期宏观表达,可以人工定义。

papers.title: Griffon: Spelling out All Object Locations at Any Granularity with Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yufei Zhan · Yousong Zhu · Zhiyang Chen · Fan Yang · Ming Tang · Jinqiao Wang
papers.abstract: Replicating the innate human ability to detect all objects based on free-form texts at any granularity remains a formidable challenge for Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). Current LVLMs are predominantly constrained to locate a single, pre-existing object. This limitation leads to a compromise in model design, necessitating the introduction of visual expert models or the customized head structures. Beyond these constraints, our research uncovers LVLMs' capability for basic object perception, allowing them to accurately identify and locate objects of interest. Building on this insight, we introduce a novel Language-prompted Localization Dataset to fully unleash the capabilities of LVLMs in fine-grained object perception and precise location awareness. More importantly, we present Griffon, a purely LVLM-based baseline, which does not introduce any special tokens, expert models, or additional detection modules. It simply maintains a consistent structure with popular LVLMs by unifying data formats across various localization-related scenarios and is trained end-to-end through a well-designed pipeline. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Griffon not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on the fine-grained RefCOCO series and Flickrs30K Entities but also approaches the capabilities of the expert model Faster RCNN on the detection benchmark MSCOCO. Dataset, codes and models will be released.
papers.title_zh: Griffon: 使用大语言模型拼出任何颗粒中的所有对象位置
papers.abstract_zh: 复制人类在任何颗粒中根据自由形式文本探测所有物体的固有能力,对于大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)来说,仍然是一项艰巨的挑战,目前的LVLMs主要只能找到一个原有的单一物体。 这一限制导致模型设计妥协,导致引入视觉专家模型或定制头结构。 除了这些限制外,我们的研究还发现LVLMs的基本物体感知能力,使其能够准确识别和定位相关对象。 基于这一见解,我们推出新的语言促进本地化数据集,以充分释放LVLMs在精细定位物体感知和准确定位意识方面的能力。 更重要的是,我们介绍了纯粹基于LVLM的基线Griffon,该基线没有引入任何特殊标志、专家模型或额外的探测模块。 它只是通过统一各种与本地化有关的情景的数据格式,与流行的LVLMs保持一个一致的结构,并通过精心设计的管道接受端对端培训。 全面实验表明,葛里芬不仅在精细RefCO系列和Flickrs30K实体中取得了SOTA 性能,而且还接近专家模型 " 更快的RCNNN " 的能力,即探测基准MSCO。 将公布数据集、代码和模型。

papers.title: Griffon v2: Advancing Multimodal Perception with High-Resolution Scaling and Visual-Language Co-Referring
papers.authors: Yufei Zhan · Shurong Zheng · Yousong Zhu · Hongyin Zhao · Fan Yang · Ming Tang · Jinqiao Wang
papers.abstract: Large Vision Language Models have achieved fine-grained object perception, but the limitation of image resolution remains a significant obstacle to surpassing the performance of task-specific experts in complex and dense scenarios. Such limitation further restricts the model's potential to achieve nuanced visual and language referring in domains such as GUI Agents, counting, etc. To address this issue, we introduce a unified high-resolution generalist model, Griffon v2, enabling flexible object referring with visual and textual prompts. To efficiently scale up image resolution, we design a simple and lightweight down-sampling projector to overcome the input tokens constraint in Large Language Models. This design inherently preserves the complete contexts and fine details and significantly improves multimodal perception ability, especially for small objects. Building upon this, we further equip the model with visual-language co-referring capabilities through a plug-and-play visual tokenizer. It enables user-friendly interaction with flexible target images, free-form texts, and even coordinates. Experiments demonstrate that Griffon v2 can localize objects of interest with visual and textual referring, achieve state-of-the-art performance on REC and phrase grounding, and outperform expert models in object detection, object counting, and REG. Data, codes, and models will be released.
papers.title_zh: Griffon v 2: 推进具有高分辨率缩放和视觉语言共同参照的多式感知
papers.abstract_zh: 大型 " 视觉语言模型 " 已达到精细的物体感知,但图像分辨率的局限性仍然是在复杂和密集的情景下超越具体任务专家业绩的重大障碍。 这种限制进一步限制了模型在诸如图形用户界面代理、计数等领域实现细微的视觉和语言参考的潜力。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了一个统一的高分辨率通用模型,即Griffon v2, 使灵活对象能够以视觉和文字提示参考。 为了有效提升图像分辨率,我们设计了一个简单和轻量级的下取样投影仪,以克服大语言模型中输入符号的限制。 这一设计本质上保留了完整的背景和精细细节,并大大提高了多式联运的感知能力,特别是小物体的感知能力。 在此基础上,我们进一步通过插件和剧本视觉代用品为模型配备了视觉语言共同参照能力。 它能够与灵活的目标图像、自由文本甚至协调进行方便用户的互动。 实验表明,Griffon v2 可以用视觉和文字参考将感兴趣的对象本地化,在REC和短语定位方面达到最新水平的性能,在物体探测、物体计数和REG方面优异的专家模型。 数据、代码和模型将发布。

papers.title: GIViC: Generative Implicit Video Compression
papers.authors: Ge Gao · Siyue Teng · Tianhao Peng · Fan Zhang · David Bull
papers.abstract: While video compression based on implicit neural representations (INRs) has recently demonstrated great potential, existing INR-based video codecs still cannot achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance compared to their conventional or autoencoder-based counterparts given the same coding configuration. In this context, we propose aGenerativeImplicitVideoCompression framework,GIViC, aiming at advancing the performance limits of this type of coding methods. GIViC is inspired by the characteristics that INRs share with large language and diffusion models in exploitinglong-term dependencies. Through the newly designedimplicit diffusionprocess, GIViC performs diffusive sampling across coarse-to-fine spatiotemporal decompositions, gradually progressing from coarser-grained full-sequence diffusion to finer-grained per-token diffusion. A novelHierarchical Gated Linear Attention-based transformer(HGLA), is also integrated into the framework, which dual-factorizes global dependency modeling along scale and sequential axes. The proposed GIViC model has been benchmarked against SOTA conventional and neural codecs using a Random Access (RA) configuration (YUV 4:2:0, GOPSize=32), and yields BD-rate savings of 15.94%, 22.46% and 8.52% over VVC VTM, DCVC-FM and NVRC, respectively. As far as we are aware, GIViC is thefirst INR-based video codec that outperforms VTM based on the RA coding configuration. The source code will be made available.
papers.title_zh: GIVIC: 产生隐含视频压缩
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于隐含神经表象的视频压缩最近显示出巨大的潜力,但鉴于相同的编码配置,现有基于IR的视频编码器仍然无法取得与常规或自动编码器对口单位相比的最新性能。 在这方面,我们提议一个“通用抑制障碍框架”,GIVIC, 目的是提高这类编码方法的性能限度,它受到IRR在利用长期依赖性时与大量语言和传播模式共有的特征的启发。 通过新设计的隐性扩散过程,GIVIC通过粗到松的间歇时空分解法进行不同的取样,从粗到粗的全序列扩散逐渐发展到精到精的每吨扩散。 一个新的等级式直线式直线式倾斜式变压器(HGLA)也被纳入了这个框架,这个框架具有双重因素,按照规模和顺序轴构建全球依赖性模型。 拟议的GIVIC模型以SOTA常规和神经编码为基准,采用随机存取(RA)配置(YUV 4:2:0,GOPSIZE=32),比VVVC VTM、DCVC-FM和NVRC分别节省15.94%、22.46%和8.52%的BD率。 据我们所知,GIVIC是第一个以IRN为基础的视频编码器,根据RA编码配置,其性能优于VTM。

papers.title: GenFlowRL: Shaping Rewards with Generative Object-Centric Flow in Visual Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Kelin Yu · Sheng Zhang · Harshit Soora · Furong Huang · Heng Huang · Pratap Tokekar · Ruohan Gao
papers.abstract: Recent advances have shown that video generation models can enhance robot learning by deriving effective robot actions through inverse dynamics. However, these methods heavily depend on the quality of generated data and struggle with fine-grained manipulation due to the lack of environment feedback. While video-based reinforcement learning improves policy robustness, it remains constrained by the uncertainty of video generation and the challenges of collecting large-scale robot datasets for training diffusion models. To address these limitations, we propose GenFlowRL, which derives shaped rewards from generated flow trained from easy-to-collect cross-embodiment datasets. This enables learning generalizable and robust policies from expert demostrations using low-dimensional, object-centric features. Experiments on 10 manipulation tasks, both in simulation and real-world cross-embodiment evaluations, demonstrate that GenFlowRL effectively leverages manipulation features extracted from generated object-centric flow, consistently achieving superior performance across diverse and challenging scenarios.
papers.title_zh: GenFlowRL:在视觉强化学习中以产生物体-中心流来生成的奖励
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的进展表明,视频生成模型可以通过反向动态生成有效的机器人动作来增强机器人的学习能力,然而,由于缺乏环境反馈,这些方法在很大程度上取决于生成数据的质量,并在很大程度上依赖于精细操作。 虽然基于视频的强化学习提高了政策的稳健性,但因视频生成的不确定性和为培训推广模型收集大型机器人数据集的挑战而受到限制。 为了克服这些限制,我们提议GenFlowRL,它从通过容易收集的交叉录入数据集培训的源源流中获取成形的回报,从而能够从使用低维、以物体为中心的特征的专家降格中学习可概括和有力的政策。 在模拟和现实世界交叉录入评价方面对10项操纵任务进行的实验表明,GenFlowRL有效地利用了从生成的以物体为中心的流动中提取的操纵功能,在各种和具有挑战性的情景中不断取得优异业绩。

papers.title: GenerateCT: Text-Conditional Generation of 3D Chest CT Volumes
papers.authors: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci · Sezgin Er · Anjany Sekuboyina · Enis Simsar · Alperen Tezcan · Ayse Gulnihan Simsek · Sevval Nil Esirgun · Furkan Almas · Irem Dogan · Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen · Chinmay Prabhakar · Hadrien Reynaud · Sarthak Pati · Christian Bluethgen · Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir · Bjoern Menze
papers.abstract: Text-conditional medical image generation is vital for radiology, augmenting small datasets, preserving data privacy, and enabling patient-specific modeling. However, its applications in 3D medical imaging, such as CT and MRI, which are crucial for critical care, remain unexplored. In this paper, we introduce GenerateCT, the first approach to generating 3D medical imaging conditioned on free-form medical text prompts. GenerateCT incorporates a text encoder and three key components: a novel causal vision transformer for encoding 3D CT volumes, a text-image transformer for aligning CT and text tokens, and a text-conditional super-resolution diffusion model. Without directly comparable methods in 3D medical imaging, we benchmarked GenerateCT against cutting-edge methods, demonstrating its superiority across all key metrics. Importantly, we explored GenerateCT's clinical applications by evaluating its utility in a multi-abnormality classification task. First, we established a baseline by training a multi-abnormality classifier on our real dataset. To further assess the model's generalization to external datasets and its performance with unseen prompts in a zero-shot scenario, we employed an external dataset to train the classifier, setting an additional benchmark. We conducted two experiments in which we doubled the training datasets by synthesizing an equal number of volumes for each set using GenerateCT. The first experiment demonstrated an 11% improvement in the AP score when training the classifier jointly on real and generated volumes. The second experiment showed a 7% improvement when training on both real and generated volumes based on unseen prompts. Moreover, GenerateCT enables the scaling of synthetic training datasets to arbitrary sizes. As an example, we generated 100,000 3D CT volumes, fivefold the number in our real dataset, and trained the classifier exclusively on these synthetic volumes. Impressively, this classifier surpassed the performance of the one trained on all available real data by a margin of 8%. Lastly, domain experts evaluated the generated volumes, confirming a high degree of alignment with the text prompts. Access our code, model weights, training data, and generated data at https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT
papers.title_zh: 3D Chest CT 卷的文字条件生成
papers.abstract_zh: 对放射学、扩大小数据集、保护数据隐私和帮助建立病人专用模型而言,生成有条件的医学图像至关重要。 但是,在三维医学成像(如CT和MRI)中的应用(这些对关键护理至关重要)仍未被探索。 在本文中,我们引入了CenerateCT,这是产生3D医学成像的第一个方法,以自由式医学文本提示为条件。 生成CT包含一个文本编码器和三个关键组成部分:3D CT 卷编码的新因果视觉变压器,对CT 和文本符号进行对齐的文本图像变压器,以及文本条件超分辨率扩散模型。 没有直接可比的3D医学成像方法,我们对照尖端方法对CenterateCT进行了基准测试,显示了它在所有关键指标中的优越性。 重要的是,我们通过评估它在多常态分类任务中的实用性,探索了CenerateCT的临床应用。 首先,我们通过培训一个掌握真实数据集的多异常分类员,建立了一个基线。 为了进一步评估模型对外部数据集的概括化及其在零光情景下以无形提示进行性能评估,我们使用了外部数据集来培训分类员,并设定了额外的基准。 我们进行了两个实验,我们用基因CT合成每组相同数量的数量,使培训数据集翻了一番。 第一次实验显示,在对分类员进行实际和生成量联合培训时,AP分数提高了11%。 第二次实验显示,在以不可见的提示为基础进行实际量和生成量的培训时,实际量和生成量的培训都提高了7%。 此外,CenerateCT使得合成培训数据集的大小可以任意扩大。 举例来说,我们生成了100,000 3D CT 数量,是我们真实数据集的五倍,并专门就这些合成数量对分类员进行了培训。 令人印象深刻的是,这个分类员比所有现有真实数据培训的分类员的性能高出8%。 最后,域专家评价了所制作的卷,证实了与文本提示高度一致。查阅我们的代码、模型重量、培训数据,并在https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT上生成数据。

papers.title: GDKVM: Echocardiography Video Segmentation via Spatiotemporal Key-Value Memory with Gated Delta Rule
papers.authors: Rui Wang · Yimu Sun · Jingxing Guo · Huisi Wu · Jing Qin
papers.abstract: Accurate segmentation of cardiac chamber structures in echocardiogram sequences is of great significance for clinical diagnosis and treatment. The imaging noise, artifacts, and the deformation and motion of the heart pose challenges to segmentation algorithms. Existing methods based on convolutional neural networks, Transformers, and space-time memory have indeed improved segmentation accuracy to some extent, but they are often restricted by limited local receptive fields and insufficient temporal memory retrieval.In this paper, we propose a novel model for echocardiography video segmentation, called GDKVM. The model employs linear key-value associations (LKVA) to effectively model inter-frame correlations, and introduces the gated delta rule (GDR) to ideally store intermediate memory states. The key-pixel feature fusion (KPFF) module is designed to integrate local and global features at multiple scales, enhancing robustness against boundary blurring and noise interference. We validated GDKVM on two mainstream echocardiogram video datasets (CAMUS and EchoNet-Dynamic) and compared it with various state-of-the-art methods. Experimental results show that GDKVM outperforms existing approaches in terms of segmentation accuracy and robustness, while ensuring real-time performance. GDKVM provides more accurate and efficient cardiac chamber segmentation outcomes for clinical applications.The code will be released upon publication.
papers.title_zh: GDKVM: 通过使用 Gated Delta 规则的时空键值内存进行心心电图视频分割
papers.abstract_zh: 在回声心电图序列中,心室结构的准确分离对临床诊断和治疗具有重大意义。 成像噪音、人工制品以及心脏变形和运动对分解算法提出了挑战。 基于进化神经网络、变换器和时空内存的现有方法确实在某种程度上提高了断裂的准确性,但往往受到有限的局部可接收字段和时间内存检索不足的限制。 在本文中,我们提出一个称为GDKVM的回声心电图视频分离新模式。 该模型采用线性关键价值协会(LKVA),以有效模拟各框架间的相互关系,并采用门式三角洲规则(GDR),以理想地储存中间内存状态。 关键像素特征聚合模块旨在将多个尺度的当地和全球特征结合起来,加强抵御边界模糊和噪音干扰的力度。 我们用两个主流回声心电图视频数据集(CAMUS和EchoNet-Dynamic)验证了GDKVM(GDKVM ) , 并将其与各种最新方法进行了比较。 实验结果表明,GDKVM在分解准确性和稳健性方面比现有方法要好,同时确保实时性能。 GDKVM为临床应用提供更准确和高效的心室分解结果。 该代码将在公布后公布。

papers.title: Fusion Meets Diverse Conditions: A High-diversity Benchmark and Baseline for UAV-based Multimodal Object Detection with Condition Cues
papers.authors: Chen Chen · Kangcheng Bin · Hu Ting · Jiahao Qi · Xingyue Liu · Tianpeng Liu · Zhen Liu · Yongxiang Liu · Ping Zhong
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV)-based object detection with visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) images facilitates robust around-the-clock detection, driven by advancements in deep learning techniques and the availability of high-quality dataset. However, the existing dataset struggles to fully capture real-world complexity for limited imaging conditions. To this end, we introduce a high-diversity dataset ATR-UMOD covering varying scenarios, spanning altitudes from 80m to 300m, angles from 0° to 75°, and all-day, all-year time variations in rich weather and illumination conditions. Moreover, each RGB-IR image pair is annotated with 6 condition attributes, offering valuable high-level contextual information. To meet the challenge raised by such diverse conditions, we propose a novel prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF) to adaptively reassign multimodal contributions by leveraging annotated condition cues. By encoding imaging conditions as text prompts, PCDF effectively models the relationship between conditions and multimodal contributions through a task-specific soft-gating transformation. A prompt-guided condition-decoupling module further ensures the availability in practice without condition annotations. Experiments on ATR-UMOD dataset reveal the effectiveness of PCDF.
papers.title_zh: 融合满足多种条件:基于无人驾驶航空器的多式物体与条件库的多式物体探测的高度多样性基准和基线
papers.abstract_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器(无人驾驶飞行器)用可见(RGB)和红外线(IR)图像探测的无人驾驶物体,有助于在深层学习技术的进步和高质量数据集的可用性推动下,全天24小时进行严密的探测。 然而,现有的数据集很难在有限的成像条件下充分捕捉到现实世界的复杂性。 为此,我们推出一个高多样性数据集ATR-UMOD,涵盖不同情景,高度从80米至300米,角度从0°至75°,以及丰富天气和照明条件全年全年变化。 此外,每个RGB-IR图像配对都有附加说明,附有6个条件属性,提供了宝贵的高水平背景信息。 为了应对这些不同条件带来的挑战,我们建议采用新的快速指导条件意识动态聚合(PCDF),利用附加说明的条件提示,适应性地重新分配多式联运捐款。 通过将成像条件与文字提示相编码,多功能开发基金通过具体任务的软制式转换,有效地模拟了条件与多式联运贡献之间的关系。 一个快速导导条件解耦模块进一步确保了在实际中不附带条件说明的可用性。 ATR-UMOD数据集实验揭示了多氯二苯并呋喃的有效性。

papers.title: FS-COCO: Towards Understanding of Freehand Sketches of Common Objects in Context
papers.authors: Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Aneeshan Sain, Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Tao Xiang, Yulia Gryaditskaya, Yi-Zhe Song
papers.abstract: "We advance sketch research to scenes with the first dataset of freehand scene sketches, FSCOCO. With practical applications in mind, we collect sketches that convey well scene content but can be sketched within a few minutes by a person with any sketching skills. Our dataset comprises 10,000 freehand scene vector sketches with per point space-time information by 100 non-expert individuals, offering both object- and scene-level abstraction. Each sketch is augmented with its text description. Using our dataset, we study for the first time the problem of fine-grained image retrieval from freehand scene sketches and sketch captions. We draw insights on: (i) Scene salience encoded in sketches using the strokes temporal order; (ii) Performance comparison of image retrieval from a scene sketch and an image caption; (iii) Complementarity of information in sketches and image captions, as well as the potential benefit of combining the two modalities. In addition, we extend a popular vector sketch LSTM-based encoder to handle sketches with larger complexity than was supported by previous work. Namely, we propose a hierarchical sketch decoder, which we leverage at a sketch-specific “pretext” task. Our dataset enables for the first time research on freehand scene sketch understanding and its practical applications. We will release the dataset upon acceptance."
papers.title_zh: FS-COCO: 努力了解上下文中自由手件共同物品的成套工具
papers.abstract_zh: “我们用第一套手动现场草图数据集,将草图研究推进到场景,FSCO。考虑到实际应用,我们收集草图,这些草图传达了良好的场景内容,但可以在几分钟内由具有任何草图技能的人绘制。 我们的数据集由100名非专家个人提供的10 000个自由手场景矢量草图和每点空间时间信息组成,提供了对象和场景层面的抽象数据,每幅草图都用文字说明加以补充。 使用我们的数据集,我们第一次研究 如何从手持现场素描和草图字幕中 提取精细图像的问题。 我们深入了解:(一) 利用中风时间顺序在草图中编码的显著之处;(二) 现场草图图像检索和图像字幕的性能比较;(三) 草图和图像字幕中信息的互补性,以及将两种模式结合起来的潜在好处。 此外,我们扩展了一个广受欢迎的矢量草图 LSTM 的编码器,用于处理比先前工作更复杂的草图。 也就是说,我们提出一个层次的草图解码器,我们利用它来完成一个具体的草图“预言”任务。 我们的数据集首次使人们得以研究手持的现场素描理解及其实际应用。一旦被接受,我们将发布数据集。”

papers.title: From Imitation to Innovation: The Emergence of AI's Unique Artistic Styles and the Challenge of Copyright Protection
papers.authors: Zexi Jia · Chuanwei Huang · Hongyan Fei · Yeshuang Zhu · Zhiqiang Yuan · Ying Deng · Jiapei Zhang · Jinchao Zhang · Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: Current legal frameworks consider AI-generated works eligible for copyright protection when they meet originality requirements and involve substantial human intellectual input. However, systematic legal standards and reliable evaluation methods for AI art copyrights are lacking. Through comprehensive analysis of legal precedents, we establish three essential criteria for determining distinctive artistic style: stylistic consistency, creative uniqueness, and expressive accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce ArtBulb, an interpretable and quantifiable framework for AI art copyright judgment that combines a novel style description-based multimodal clustering method with multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We also present AICD, the first benchmark dataset for AI art copyright annotated by artists and legal experts. Experimental results demonstrate that ArtBulb outperforms existing models in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Our work aims to bridge the gap between the legal and technological communities and bring greater attention to the societal issue of AI art copyrights.
papers.title_zh: 《从模仿到创新:大赦国际独一艺术风格的出现和版权保护的挑战》
papers.abstract_zh: 现行法律框架认为,AI产生的作品如果符合原始要求并涉及大量人类知识投入,就有资格获得版权保护,然而,AI艺术版权缺乏系统的法律标准和可靠的评价方法。 通过全面分析法律先例,我们确立了确定独特艺术风格的三个基本标准:文体一致性、创造性独特性和表达准确性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了ArtBulb,这是大赦国际艺术版权判决的一个可解释和量化的框架,它将新型的、以描述为基础的多式联运集群法与大型多式联运语言模式相结合。 我们还介绍了AICD,这是由艺术家和法律专家附加说明的AI艺术版权首个基准数据集。 实验结果表明,ArtBulb在定量和定性评估方面都超越了现有模式。 我们的工作旨在弥合法律界与技术界之间的差距,并使人们更加关注大赦国际艺术版权的社会问题。

papers.title: FREE-Merging: Fourier Transform for Efficient Model Merging
papers.authors: Shenghe Zheng · Hongzhi Wang
papers.abstract: With the rapid growth of deep learning, there is an increasing availability of open-source models for various tasks. However, single fine-tuned models often fall short of meeting the diverse needs of users. Model merging has thus emerged as an efficient method to integrate the capabilities of existing models into a unified model. Nevertheless, existing model merging methods face challenging trade-offs between performance and deployment costs, primarily due to task interference. For the first time, we reveal that task interference is evident in the frequency domain of model parameters, yet current efforts only focus on spatial domain solutions, which are largely ineffective in addressing frequency domain interference. To mitigate the impact of frequency domain interference, we proposeFR-Merging, an innovative method that effectively filters harmful frequency domain interference on the backbone with minimal computational overhead. Since performance loss is inevitable with cost-free methods, we propose a lightweight task-specific expert module that dynamically compensates for information loss during merging. This proposed framework,FREE-Merging(FR-Merging with experts), strikes a balanced trade-off between training cost, inference latency, storage requirements, and performance. We demonstrate the effectiveness of both FR-Merging and FREE-Merging on multiple tasks across CV, NLP, and Multi-Modal domains and show that they can be flexibly adapted to specific needs.
papers.title_zh: FREE-Merging: 实现高效模型合并的四倍变换
papers.abstract_zh: 随着深层学习的迅速增长,为各种任务提供的开放源码模式越来越多,但单一的微调模式往往不能满足用户的不同需求。 因此,合并模式已成为将现有模式的能力纳入统一模式的有效方法,但是,主要由于任务干扰,现有合并模式在业绩和部署费用之间面临权衡困难。 我们第一次发现,任务干扰在模型参数的频度领域是显而易见的,但目前的努力只侧重于空间域解决办法,这些办法在处理频度域干扰方面基本上没有效力。 为了减轻频率域干扰的影响,我们提议采用FR-Merging这一创新方法,以最低计算间接费用,有效地过滤对骨干有害频域干扰。 由于以免费方法,业绩损失是不可避免的,因此我们提议一个轻量级任务专家模块,以动态方式弥补合并期间的信息损失。 这个拟议框架FREE-Merging(FR-Miging与专家一起)在培训费用、推论延迟期、储存要求和绩效之间实现平衡的权衡。 我们展示了联邦抵抗阵线和自由欧洲统一部队在CV、NLP和多模式领域多重任务方面的效力,并表明它们可以灵活地适应具体需要。

papers.title: Forest2Seq: Revitalizing Order Prior for Sequential Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.authors: Qi Sun · Hang Zhou · Wengang Zhou · Li Li · Houqiang Li
papers.abstract: Synthesizing realistic 3D indoor scenes is a challenging task that traditionally relies on manual arrangement and annotation by expert designers. Recent advances in autoregressive models have automated this process, but they often lack semantic understanding of the relationships and hierarchies present in real-world scenes, yielding limited performance. In this paper, we propose Forest2Seq, a framework that formulates indoor scene synthesis as an order-aware sequential learning problem. Forest2Seq organizes the inherently unordered collection of scene objects into structured, ordered hierarchical scene trees and forests. By employing a clustering-based algorithm and a breadth-first traversal, Forest2Seq derives meaningful orderings and utilizes a transformer to generate realistic 3D scenes autoregressively. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate Forest2Seq's superiority in synthesizing more realistic scenes compared to top-performing baselines, with significant improvements in FID and KL scores. Our additional experiments for downstream tasks and ablation studies also confirm the importance of incorporating order as a prior in 3D scene generation.
papers.title_zh: Forest2Seq: 序列室内现场合成的重置顺序
papers.abstract_zh: 综合现实的3D室内场景是一项具有挑战性的任务,传统上依赖专家设计师的手工安排和说明。 近来自动递减模式的进展使这一进程自动化,但它们往往缺乏对现实世界景象中存在的关系和等级的语义理解,导致绩效有限。 在本文中,我们提出了Forest2Seq(Forest2Seq ) , 这个框架将室内场景合成设计成一个有秩序的连续学习问题。 Forest2Seq(Forest2Seq)将原始的未经排序的场景物体收集组织成结构有序的、有顺序的级级景树木和森林。 Forest2Seq通过采用基于集群的算法和宽度第一跨行法,获得有意义的订单,并利用变压器自动后退地产生现实的3D场景。 标准基准的实验结果显示,森林2Seq在综合与业绩最佳的基线相比更现实的场景方面具有优势,国际开发公司和KL的分数有了显著改善。 我们在下游任务和通货膨胀研究方面进行的额外实验也证实,在3D场景一代中,必须先纳入秩序。

papers.title: FlashTex: Fast Relightable Mesh Texturing with LightControlNet
papers.authors: Kangle Deng · Timothy Omernick · Alexander B Weiss · Deva Ramanan · Jun-Yan Zhu · Tinghui Zhou · Maneesh Agrawala
papers.abstract: Manually creating textures for 3D meshes is time-consuming, even for expert visual content creators. We propose a fast approach for automatically texturing an input 3D mesh based on a user-provided text prompt. Importantly, our approach disentangles lighting from surface material/reflectance in the resulting texture so that the mesh can be properly relit and rendered in any lighting environment. Our method introduces LightControlNet, a new text-to-image model based on the ControlNet architecture, that allows the specification of the desired lighting as a conditioning image to the model. Our text-to-texture pipeline then constructs the texture in two stages. The first stage produces a sparse set of visually consistent reference views of the mesh using LightControlNet. The second stage applies a texture optimization based on Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) that works with LightControlNet to increase the texture quality while disentangling surface material from lighting. We show that this pipeline is significantly faster than previous text-to-texture methods, while producing high-quality and relightable textures.
papers.title_zh: FlashTex: 使用光控网快速点亮的网格纹理
papers.abstract_zh: 手动为 3D meshes 创建纹理很费时, 即使是对专业视觉内容创作者也是如此。 我们提出了一个快速方法, 用于根据用户提供的文本提示自动纹理输入 3D 网格 。 重要的是,我们的方法将照明与表面材料解耦/对由此产生的纹理的反射分离开来,以便在任何照明环境中能够适当地对网目进行再光和改造。 我们的方法引入了LightControlNet,这是一个基于控制网架构的新的文本到图像模型,它允许指定理想的照明作为模型的调节图像。 我们的文本到文本管道然后分两个阶段构建纹理。 第一阶段对使用光控网网的网状生成了少量的视觉一致参考视图。 第二阶段采用基于分蒸馏取样的质地优化,该质地优化与光控网合作,以提高质地质,同时将表面材料与照明解耦。 我们表明,这一管道比以往的文本到文本方法快得多,同时产生高质量和可点效的质地。

papers.title: Fashionpedia: Ontology, Segmentation, and an Attribute Localization Dataset
papers.authors: Menglin Jia, Mengyun Shi, Mikhail Sirotenko, Yin Cui, Claire Cardie , Bharath Hariharan, Hartwig Adam, Serge Belongie
papers.abstract: Segmentation, and an Attribute Localization Dataset","In this work, we focus on the task of instance segmentation with attribute localization. This unifies instance segmentation (detect and segment each object instance) and visual categorization of fine-grained attributes (classify one or multiple attributes). The proposed task requires both localizing an object and describing its properties. To illustrate the various aspects of this task, we focus on the domain of fashion and introduce Fashionpedia as a step toward mapping out the visual aspects of the fashion world. Fashionpedia consists of two parts: (1) an ontology built by fashion experts containing 27 main apparel categories, 19 apparel parts, and 294 fine-grained attributes and their relationships and (2) a dataset consisting of everyday and celebrity event fashion images annotated with segmentation masks and their associated fine-grained attributes, built upon the backbone of the Fashionpedia ontology. In order to solve this challenging task, we propose a novel Attribute-Mask R-CNN model to jointly perform instance segmentation and localized attribute recognition, and provide a novel evaluation metric for the task. Fashionpedia is available at https://fashionpedia.github.io/home/. "
papers.title_zh: 时装:本体学、分区和属性本地化数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 和属性本地化数据集 ” ” 。 在此工作中, 我们集中关注带有属性本地化的实例分割任务 。 此任务将实例分割( 每个对象实例的探测和段段) 和细微属性的视觉分类( 分类一个或多个属性 ) 统一为实例分割( 每个对象实例的探测和段段) 。 拟议的任务既要求物体本地化,也需要描述其特性。 为了说明这项任务的各个方面,我们把重点放在时尚领域,并引入时尚,作为绘制时尚世界视觉方面的一个步骤。 时装由两部分组成:(1) 时装专家建造的本体学,包括27个主要服装类别、19个服装部件和294个细毛属性及其关系;(2) 数据集,包括每日和名人事件时装图象,带有分解面罩及其相关的细毛属性,以时装本体为主。 为了解决这一具有挑战性的任务,我们提议采用一个新的属性-Mask R-CNN模式,共同进行实例分割和局部属性识别,并为这项任务提供新的评价标准。 " 时尚版可在https://fashionpedia.github.io/home/查阅。 "

papers.title: FADE: Fusing the Assets of Decoder and Encoder for Task-Agnostic Upsampling
papers.authors: Hao Lu, Wenze Liu, Hongtao Fu, Zhiguo Cao
papers.abstract: "We consider the problem of task-agnostic feature upsampling in dense prediction where an upsampling operator is required to facilitate both region-sensitive tasks like semantic segmentation and detail-sensitive tasks such as image matting. Existing upsampling operators often can work well in either type of the tasks, but not both. In this work, we present FADE, a novel, plug-and-play, and task-agnostic upsampling operator. FADE benefits from three design choices: i) considering encoder and decoder features jointly in upsampling kernel generation; ii) an efficient semi-shift convolutional operator that enables granular control over how each feature point contributes to upsampling kernels; iii) a decoder-dependent gating mechanism for enhanced detail delineation. We first study the upsampling properties of FADE on toy data and then evaluate it on large-scale semantic segmentation and image matting. In particular, FADE reveals its effectiveness and task-agnostic characteristic by consistently outperforming recent dynamic upsampling operators in different tasks. It also generalizes well across convolutional and transformer architectures with little computational overhead. Our work additionally provides thoughtful insights on what makes for task-agnostic upsampling. Code is available at: http://lnkiy.in/fade_in"
papers.title_zh: FADE: 解码器和编码器资产解码器和编码器资产的引信,用于任务不可知性抽样取样
papers.abstract_zh: “我们考虑在密集预测中进行任务不可知特征抽样的问题, 需要一名对区域敏感的作业, 如语义分割和图像配对等对细节敏感的作业。 现有的抽样操作员通常可以在两种任务中都能很好地发挥作用,但不能两者兼而有之。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了FADE(FADE ) , 一个新型的、插接和游戏的和任务不可知的抽样操作员。 FADE从三种设计选择中受益:(一) 考虑在采样内核生成中联合使用编码器和解码器的特征;(二) 高效的半轮变换操作器,使颗粒控制每个特征点如何有助于采样内核;(三) 一个分离器独立格机制,以加强详细划界。 我们首先研究FADE在玩具数据上的更新特征,然后对大规模语义分解和图像配对进行评估。 特别是,FADE通过在不同的任务中持续优于最近的动态抽样操作员来展示其有效性和任务不可知性特征。 我们的工作还就任务-不可知的抽取提供了深思熟虑的洞察力。 代码可在http://lnkiy.in/fade_in上查阅。

papers.title: Facial Affective Behavior Analysis with Instruction Tuning
papers.authors: Yifan Li · Anh Dao · Wentao Bao · Zhen Tan · Tianlong Chen · Huan Liu · Yu Kong
papers.abstract: Facial affective behavior analysis (FABA) is crucial for understanding human mental states from images. However, traditional approaches primarily deploy models to discriminate among discrete emotion categories, and lack the fine granularity and reasoning capability for complex facial behaviors. The advent of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has been proven successful in general visual understanding tasks. However, directly harnessing MLLMs for FABA is challenging due to the scarcity of datasets and benchmarks, neglecting facial prior knowledge, and low training efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce (i) an instruction-following dataset for two FABA tasks, e.g., emotion and action unit recognition, (ii) a benchmark FABA-Bench with a new metric considering both recognition and generation ability, and (iii) a new MLLM ''EmoLA'' as a strong baseline to the community. Our initiative on the dataset and benchmarks reveal the nature and rationale of facial affective behaviors, i.e., fine-grained facial movement, interpretability, and reasoning. Moreover, to build an effective and efficient FABA MLLM, we introduce a facial prior expert module with face structure knowledge and a low-rank adaptation module into pre-trained MLLM. We conduct extensive experiments on FABA-Bench and four commonly-used FABA datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed facial prior expert can boost the performance and EmoLA achieves the best results on our FABA-Bench. On commonly-used FABA datasets, EmoLA is competitive rivaling task-specific state-of-the-art models.
papers.title_zh: 带有指示图示的子宫性行为分析
papers.abstract_zh: 但是,传统方法主要是运用模型来区分离散情感类别,并且缺乏复杂的面部行为的细微颗粒和推理能力。 事实证明,多模式大语言模型(MLLM)的出现在一般视觉理解任务中取得了成功,但是,由于缺少数据集和基准、忽视面部先前知识以及培训效率低,直接利用MLLMS为FABA服务具有挑战性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了(一) 为FABA的两项任务(如情感和行动单位识别)提供一套遵循指令的数据集,(二) FABA-Bench基准,其中考虑到承认和生育能力的新标准,以及(三) 一个新的MLLM“EmoLA”作为社区的坚实基线。 我们关于数据集和基准的倡议揭示了面部感官行为的性质和理由,即细微的面部运动、可解释性和推理。 此外,为了建立一个有效和高效的FABA MLLM,我们将面部结构知识的面部前专家模块和一个低级适应模块引入培训前MLLM。 我们对FABA-Bench和四个常用的FABA数据集进行了广泛的实验。 结果显示,拟议的面部前专家可以提升业绩,而EmoLA在我们的FABA-Bunch上取得了最佳效果。 在常用的FABA数据集中,EmoLA是竞争对手,与具体任务最先进的模型相对应。

papers.title: Explaining Human Preferences via Metrics for Structured Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jack Langerman · Denis Rozumny · Yuzhong Huang · Dmytro Mishkin
papers.abstract: What cannot be measured cannot be improved while likely never uttered by Lord Kelvin, summarizes effectively the purpose of this work. This paper presents a detailed evaluation of automated metrics for evaluating structured 3D reconstructions. Pitfalls of each metric are discussed, and a thorough analyses through the lens of expert 3D modelers' preferences is presented. A set of systematic "unit tests" are proposed to empirically verify desirable properties, and context aware recommendations as to which metric to use depending on application are provided. Finally, a learned metric distilled from human expert judgments is proposed and analyzed.
papers.title_zh: 通过结构性重建的计量方法解释人类的偏好
papers.abstract_zh: 无法测量的东西无法改进,但Kelvin勋爵可能从未说过,他有效地总结了这项工作的目的。 本文详细评估了用于评估结构化的3D重建的自动衡量标准。 讨论了每项指标的空洞之处,从专家3D模型者的偏好角度进行了透彻的分析,提出了一套系统化的“单位测试”,以从经验上核实可取的特性,并就根据应用情况提供何种衡量标准提出了了解背景的建议。 最后,建议并分析了从人类专家判断中总结出来的一套总结经验的衡量标准。

papers.title: ERA: Expert Retrieval and Assembly for Early Action Prediction
papers.authors: Lin Geng Foo, Tianjiao Li, Hossein Rahmani, Qiuhong Ke, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: "Early action prediction aims to successfully predict the class label of an action before it is completely performed. This is a challenging task because the beginning stages of different actions can be very similar, with only minor subtle differences for discrimination. In this paper, we propose a novel Expert Retrieval and Assembly (ERA) module that retrieves and assembles a set of experts most specialized at using discriminative subtle differences, to distinguish an input sample from other highly similar samples. To encourage our model to effectively use subtle differences for early action prediction, we push experts to discriminate exclusively between samples that are highly similar, forcing these experts to learn to use subtle differences that exist between those samples. Additionally, we design an effective Expert Learning Rate Optimization method that balances the experts’ optimization and leads to better performance. We evaluate our ERA module on four public action datasets and achieve state-of-the-art performance. Code will be released."
papers.title_zh: ERA:早期行动预测专家检索和早期行动大会
papers.abstract_zh: 早期行动预测旨在成功预测一项行动在完全完成之前的分类标签。 这是一项具有挑战性的任务, 因为不同行动的起始阶段可能非常相似, 歧视的细微差别很小。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个新的专家检索和组装单元,以检索和组装一批最专门使用区别性微妙差异的专家,将输入样本与其他非常相似的样本区分开来。 为了鼓励我们的模型有效地利用细微差异进行早期行动预测,我们促使专家对非常相似的样品进行专门区分,迫使这些专家学会使用这些样品之间存在的细微差异。 此外,我们设计了一个有效的专家学习率优化方法,平衡专家的优化,并导致更好的业绩。 我们用四个公共行动数据集来评估我们的电子逆向拍卖模块,并实现最先进的绩效。 守则将发布。”

papers.title: Enhancing Plausibility Evaluation for Generated Designs with Denoising Autoencoder
papers.authors: Jiajie Fan · Amal Trigui · Thomas Bäck · Hao Wang
papers.abstract: A great interest has arisen in using Deep Generative Models (DGM) for generative design. When assessing the quality of the generated designs, human designers focus more on structural plausibility, e.g., no missing component, rather than visual artifacts, e.g., noises in the images. Meanwhile, commonly used metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) may not evaluate accurately as they tend to penalize visual artifacts instead of structural implausibility. As such, FID might not be suitable to assess the performance of DGMs for a generative design task. In this work, we propose to encode the input designs with a simple Denoising Autoencoder (DAE) and measure the distribution distance in the latent space thereof. We experimentally test our DAE-based metrics with FID and other state-of-the-art metrics on three data sets: compared to FID and some more recent works, e.g., FD (DINOv2) and topology distance, DAE-based metrics can effectively detect implausible structures and are more consistent with structural inspection by human experts.
papers.title_zh: 增强使用自定义自动编码器生成的设计的比值评价
papers.abstract_zh: 使用深创模型进行基因设计引起了极大的兴趣,在评估所产生设计的质量时,人类设计师更注重结构的可辨性,例如没有缺失的部件,而不是视觉文物,例如图像中的噪音。 与此同时,通常使用的指标,如Fréchet Inception Convention(FID)可能无法准确评估,因为它们倾向于惩罚视觉文物而不是结构性的不可信性。 因此,FID可能不适合评估DGM在基因设计任务方面的性能。 在这项工作中,我们提议用简单的Denoising Autoencoder(DAE)编码输入设计,并测量其潜在空间的分布距离。 我们实验性地用基于DAE的测量标准,用基于FID和其他最先进的测量标准来测试三个数据集:与FID和最近的一些工程,例如FD(DINOV2)和地形距离相比,基于DAE的测量标准能够有效检测出不可信的结构,更符合人类专家的结构检查。

papers.title: Elysium: Exploring Object-level Perception in Videos through Semantic Integration Using MLLMs
papers.authors: Han Wang · Yanjie Wang · Ye Yongjie · Yuxiang Nie · Can Huang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated their ability to perceive objects in still images, but their application in video-related tasks, such as object tracking, remains relatively unexplored. This lack of exploration is primarily due to two key challenges. Firstly, extensive pretraining on large-scale video datasets is required to equip MLLMs with the capability to perceive objects across multiple frames and understand inter-frame relationships. Secondly, processing a large number of frames within the context window of Large Language Models (LLMs) can impose a significant computational burden. To address the first challenge, we introduce ElysiumTrack-1M, a large-scale video dataset paired with novel tasks: Referring Single Object Tracking (RSOT) and Video Referring Expression Generation (Video-REG). ElysiumTrack-1M contains 1.27 million annotated video frames with corresponding object boxes and descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, we conduct training of MLLMs and propose a token-compression model T-Selector to tackle the second challenge. Our proposed approach, Elysium: Exploring Object-level Perception in Videos via MLLM, is an end-to-end trainable MLLM that makes the first attempt to conduct object-level tasks in videos without requiring any additional plug-in or expert models. All codes and datasets will be released soon.
papers.title_zh: Elysium: 利用 MLLMs 利用语义集成探索视频视频中对象层次的感知
papers.abstract_zh: 多式大语言模型(MLLM)已经表明它们有能力在静态图像中看到物体,但在与视频有关的任务(如物体跟踪)中应用这些模型的情况仍然相对未探索,这种缺乏探索的主要原因是两大挑战。 首先,需要对大型视频数据集进行广泛的预先培训,使MLLMS能够感知跨越多个框架的物体,并了解各框架之间的关系。 第二,在大语言模型上下文窗口内处理大量框架,可带来巨大的计算负担。 为了应对第一个挑战,我们引入了ElysiumTrack-1M,这是一个大型视频数据集,配有新的任务:参考单一物体跟踪(RSOT)和视频参考表达生成(Video-REG)。 ElysiumTrack-1M包含127万个附加说明的视频框,并配有相应的对象框和描述。 我们利用这一数据集,对MLLMS进行培训,并提出一个象征性压缩模型T-选择,以应对第二个挑战。 我们提议的方法,即Elysium:通过MLLM探索视频中的物体感知,是一个端到端可受训的MLLM,首次尝试在视频中执行物体感知,而不需要额外的插件或专家模型。所有代码和数据集不久将发布。

papers.title: Efficient Unsupervised Shortcut Learning Detection and Mitigation in Transformers
papers.authors: Lukas Kuhn · sari sadiya · Jörg Schlötterer · Florian Buettner · Christin Seifert · Gemma Roig
papers.abstract: Shortcut learning, i.e., a model's reliance on undesired features not directly relevant to the task, is a major challenge that severely limits the applications of machine learning algorithms, particularly when deploying them to assist in making sensitive decisions, such as in medical diagnostics. In this work, we leverage recent advancements in machine learning to create an unsupervised framework that is capable of both detecting and mitigating shortcut learning in transformers. We validate our method on multiple datasets. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves both worst-group accuracy (samples misclassified due to shortcuts) and average accuracy, while minimizing human annotation effort. Moreover, we demonstrate that the detected shortcuts are meaningful and informative to human experts, and that our framework is computationally efficient, allowing it to be run on consumer hardware.
papers.title_zh: 在变换器中不受监督的捷径学习探测和减缓
papers.abstract_zh: 快捷式学习,即模型依赖与任务没有直接关联的不理想特征,是一项重大挑战,严重限制了机器学习算法的应用,特别是在部署这些算法协助作出敏感决策时,例如在医疗诊断方面。 在这项工作中,我们利用最近在机器学习方面取得的进步,建立了一个不受监督的框架,既能够探测变压器中的捷径学习,又能够减轻这种学习的捷径。我们验证了我们关于多个数据集的方法。 结果表明,我们的框架大大提高了最坏群体的准确性(因捷径而误分类的样本)和平均准确性,同时尽量减少了人类的批注努力。 此外,我们证明,所发现的捷径对于人类专家来说是有意义和翔实的,而且我们的框架在计算上是有效率的,能够用消费者硬件运行。

papers.title: Efficient Frequency-Domain Image Deraining with Contrastive Regularization
papers.authors: Ning Gao · xingyu jiang · Xiuhui Zhang · Yue Deng
papers.abstract: Most current single image-deraining (SID) methods are based on the Transformer, which brings global modeling capabilities and is critical for high-quality reconstruction. However, their architectures only consider constructing long-range dependencies from the spatial domain, which suffers from a significant computational burden to keep effectiveness. Besides, these methods either overlook negative sample information in the optimization pipeline or underutilize the rain streak characteristics present in the negative ones. To tackle these problems, we propose a Frequency-Aware Deraining Transformer Framework (FADformer) that fully captures frequency domain features to achieve efficient rain removal. Specifically, we first construct the FADBlock, which comprises the Fused Fourier Convolution Mixer (FFCM) and Prior-Gated Feed-forward Network (PGFN). Unlike self-attention mechanisms, the FFCM exclusively conducts convolution operations in both spatial and frequency domains, endowing it with local-global capturing capabilities and efficiency. Simultaneously, the PGFN introduces residue channel prior in a gate-controlled manner to both enhance local details and retain the structure of features. Furthermore, we introduce a Frequency-domain Contrastive Regularization (FCR) during the training phase. The FCR facilitates contrastive learning in the frequency domain, enhancing the contribution of rain streak patterns in negative samples to improve performance.
